name: Kudrat - A Boutique Homestay
intro: Kudrat is nestled in village Bandal adjoining a beautiful forest, full of Deodar (Cedar) trees and wildlife. The property is located at an altitude of 6200 feet and faces the snow capped Tirth peaks (14,000 feet) in Great Himalayan National Park (UNESCO Heritage Site) and provides distant views of the famous Tirthan river.

news_article.title: Breathe, Unwind and Reconnect with Yourself at Kudrat
news_article.description: A Boutique Homestay in Himachal Pradesh

postcards.name: Learn about Faith and Devotion at the Durga Mata Mandir
postcards.intro: A visit to the Durga Mata Mandir near Kudrat Homestay in Tirthan Valley gifts you spiritual solace. As you wander through the beautiful village landscapes and rich local culture, you’ll feel refreshed and calm. Visiting the temple will help you learn about the community’s faith and provide a glimpse of Himalayan traditions, leaving you inspired by the simplicity of life.
postcards.story:
Visiting Durga Mata Mandir in the beautiful Tirthan Valley in Himachal Pradesh is a great chance to connect with both spirituality and the simplicity of village life. Located a mere 20-minute walk from Kudrat, the journey to the temple rewards you with gifts of nature.

The walk to the temple takes you along narrow village paths, flanked by lush green fields and dotted with quaint homes. The fresh mountain breeze and melodious songs of the birds accompany you, creating a sense of calm and joy.

As you ascend gently towards the temple, the view expands to reveal the mighty Himalayan peaks in the distance, grounding you in the beauty of your surroundings.

The temple, dedicated to Durga Mata, holds immense cultural and spiritual significance for the locals. Devotees from nearby villages and far-off areas visit to seek blessings and offer prayers. The temple’s simplicity — its stone-and-wood architecture and the peaceful sound of bells — adds to its charm. 

Watching the rituals unfold, you realise the faith that binds the community and their reverence for the goddess.

Beyond its spiritual appeal, the visit provides a glimpse into the region’s traditions. You may meet friendly villagers eager to share stories about the temple and the valley, making the experience more enriching.

At Kudrat, your host guides you with insights about the temple and the best time to visit, ensuring a smooth and memorable trip. 

This short excursion brings a sense of calm and reminds you that sometimes, the simplest journeys offer the most profound experiences.

postcards.name: Enjoy Fishing in the Tirthan River
postcards.intro: Fishing in the Tirthan River is a great escape into nature’s bliss. Famous for its trout-rich waters, this activity invites both novices and seasoned anglers to enjoy picturesque spots along the river. With a simple permit and the option to hire gear or a guide, you’ll be all set to enjoy the catch.
postcards.story:
Fishing in the Tirthan River is an experience that combines the thrill of angling with the beauty of untouched nature. 

Renowned for its crystal-clear waters and vibrant trout population, the Tirthan River draws anglers from across the globe, promising an adventure full of natural beauty.

Getting started is simple. With a daily permit costing just INR 100, you can rent a fishing rod or hire a guide to make the most of your experience. The river offers you numerous picturesque fishing spots, starting from Horenghat and stretching through Deori, Gushaini, Ropa and Bathad. 

Each location provides you with unique scenery, from dense forests to rocky riverbanks, making your journey as wonderful as the catch.
What sets fishing in Tirthan apart is the peaceful nature that surrounds the valley. 

Casting your line into the river, you’ll feel befriended by the sound of rushing water and the rustle of leaves in the wind. As you wait for the trout to bite, time seems to pause, allowing you to enjoy the valley's peace. 

The river’s cool, clear waters reflect the surrounding mountains, creating a calm moment for this meditative activity.

To make your day even more memorable, consider bringing along some snacks and drinks to sip as you fish. Many guides or rod providers can share tips about the best techniques and spots, but it’s wise to confirm all costs upfront to avoid surprises.

Even if you’ve been a seasoned angler or are trying your hand at fishing for the first time, Tirthan River promises you an unforgettable experience. Come, let’s celebrate a slower pace of life.

name: The Belgadia Palace
intro: Tucked away in the quaint heritage town of Baripada in Mayurbhanj, Odisha, the Palace is a beautiful piece of Kalinga history that redefines the idea of a hotel, and is 4-5 hours from the state capital of Odisha, Bengal and Jharkhand.

news_article.title: Indulge in Royal Luxury and Heritage at The Belgadia Palace
news_article.description: A Boutique Homestay in the Heart of Odisha

postcards.name: Be Enthralled by a Mayurbhanj Chhau Performance
postcards.intro: To witness the Chhau dance is to go on a journey through the history and culture of India, a spectacle that leaves a lasting mark on your senses. Ensure that you make time for this extraordinary cultural gem during your visit to The Belgadia Palace. It's an experience that truly deserves a coveted spot on your bucket list.
postcards.story:
A visit to The Belgadia Palace is incomplete without immersing yourself in the captivating Chhau dance of Mayurbhanj. The mesmerising performance, with its traditional costumes, rhythmic beats and skilful storytelling, transports you to a realm where tradition meets artistry. 

Chhau dance, a semi-classical Indian art form, weaves together martial and folk traditions, drawing inspiration from the valorous feats of the state army and narratives from Hindu epics such as the Ramayana and the Mahabharata. In a testament to its cultural significance, the Chhau dance was honoured with inclusion in UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2010.

The zenith of Chhau dance was reached under the generous patronage of the Bhanj dynasty, known for their unwavering support for art and culture. A historical episode recounts the 1912 performance during the visit of King George V and Queen Mary to India. Maharaja Sriram Chandra Bhanja Deo orchestrated a mesmerising ‘War Dance,' featuring 64 Chhau artistes from the palace troupe at the royal couple's reception in Calcutta. This landmark event marked the first introduction of the Chhau dance to a global audience, earning it a dazzling ovation.

Nearly 140 years ago, Maharaja Krushna Chandra Bhanja Deo introduced the Chhau dance during the State's renowned annual festival, Chaitra Parva, hosted within the palace. This grand celebration not only showcased the art form but also served as an inclusive platform, inviting royal families from neighbouring kingdoms and common people into the palace. The primary objective was to raise awareness about Chhau dance and foster the arts as a means of livelihood. 

Today, in the spirit of preserving and promoting this beautiful art form, you are cordially invited to be enchanted by the wonderful performances, continuing the legacy of cultural appreciation and artistic encouragement.

postcards.name: Visit a Traditional Handicraft Village
postcards.intro: From handwoven textiles to intricate artwork, each encounter in the handicraft village offers you a chance to connect with authentic crafts. It's a simple yet enriching way for you to appreciate the cultural diversity thriving in the vicinity of The Belgadia Palace. Are you ready to soak yourself in the diverse cultural offerings of Odisha?
postcards.story:
When you stay at The Belgadia Palace in Mayurbhanj, make sure not to miss visiting the local handicraft village. A walk to the village isn't just exciting but is also an educational and culturally rich experience. You can enjoy exploring the village lanes, witnessing skilled artisans at work and gaining insights into the region's heritage. 

Mayurbhanj is known for its exquisite sabai-based handicrafts and furniture, serving as a testament to the artistic prowess of local craftsmen while significantly contributing to the region's economy and cultural heritage. The allure of sabai handicrafts lies not only in their unique charm but also in their sustainable and eco-friendly nature, utilising sabai grass as a renewable and locally sourced material. Crafted with skill and precision, these pieces have become sought after by tourists and art enthusiasts alike for their cultural significance.

For a firsthand experience, you are invited to join a scenic drive to witness the meticulous craft of sabai grass creations by the talented women of local self-help groups. These clusters, comprised entirely of women artisans, skillfully weave an array of products – from bowls and trays to table mats and wall hangings – using nothing more than the humble sui(needle) and dhaga(thread). 

Beyond their aesthetic appeal, Sabai grass handicrafts play a pivotal role in the local economy and cultural heritage of Mayurbhanj. The craft provides livelihood opportunities for many in the community, especially women involved in self-help groups. As these crafts gain popularity among tourists and art enthusiasts, your visit contributes not only to the economic well-being of the artisans but also helps in carrying forward Mayurbhanj's rich cultural legacy.

The culmination of this craftsmanship is showcased at The Belgadia Palace’s in-house store, Hasa, offering a curated selection that allows you to take home a piece of Mayurbhanj's rich artistic heritage.

name: Rawla Bisalpur
intro: Nestled in the serene landscapes of Rajasthan, Rawla Bisalpur Jawai stands as a living testament to the splendor of Indo-European architecture and a rich cultural heritage that dates back over 300 years. This ancestral home, now transformed into a boutique heritage hotel, offers a unique blend of history, wildlife, and rural charm, making it an exceptional destination for those seeking an authentic and immersive experience.

news_article.title: Admire Three Centuries of Heritage at Rawla Bisalpur
news_article.description: A Heritage Homestay in Jawai, Rajasthan

postcards.name: Explore the Spiritual Heritage of Bisalpur on the Temple Trail
postcards.intro: The Temple Trail offers an incredible journey through Bisalpur’s rich spiritual heritage. Winding through ancient temples in scenic, secluded spots, it’s a chance for you to explore centuries-old traditions while soaking in breathtaking views. This experience connects you to the local culture, integrating spirituality with the natural beauty of Rawla Bisalpur’s raw landscape.
postcards.story:
Staying at Rawla Bisalpur offers you an opportunity to experience the Temple Trail, a journey that takes you deep into the spiritual fabric of the region. This trail winds through ancient temples, each with its own unique story and connection to the community. It’s a wonderful walk through history and devotion.

As you set out, you’ll find temples located in hidden groves and perched on rocky outcrops, merging with the beautiful landscape. The trail invites you to pause, reflect and soak in the peaceful atmosphere. The sound of the gentle breeze mixes with soft devotional chants, while the scent of incense drifts through the air. These elements create a peaceful environment, allowing you to connect with the spirituality that has shaped the lives of locals for generations.

One of the highlights is the chance to engage with the temple caretakers or local devotees. They often share fascinating stories about the temples’ origins, rituals and festivals, offering you deeper insight into the region’s cultural and spiritual heritage. Whether it’s an intricately carved shrine or a simple stone structure, each temple has a distinct charm.

The trail also rewards you with stunning views. Many temples are strategically positioned to overlook vast stretches of wilderness, providing a breathtaking background that makes the journey even more rewarding. Here, the connection between spirituality and nature is unmistakable. Exploring the Temple Trail while staying at Rawla Bisalpur is an enriching experience that combines history, spirituality and natural beauty in a way that leaves a lasting impression.

postcards.name: Witness Jawai’s Wildlife on a Wilderness Safari
postcards.intro: The adventure of the wilderness drive and safari kicks off with a bumpy ride through rugged trails, where every turn reveals the vast, raw landscape. The dry, rocky terrain stretches out under a big sky, giving you a sense of freedom and excitement as the journey unfolds.
postcards.story:
Staying at Rawla Bisalpur brings you closer to the unmatched beauty of Jawai and nothing captures that better than the wilderness drive and safari. The real thrill begins when the safari sets out in search of Jawai’s most famous residents — the leopards. These elusive predators merge wonderfully with the rocky background, making every sighting a rewarding experience. The anticipation builds as you scan the terrain, eyes peeled for any movement. When a leopard finally appears, it’s a moment of awe. Watching these majestic creatures move silently through their habitat is both humbling and exhilarating.

But leopards aren’t the only wildlife to admire here. The safari often includes stops by Jawai Bandh, where crocodiles can be seen sunbathing along the water’s edge. Their stillness contrasts sharply with the energy of the leopards, yet it’s just as exciting. Bird enthusiasts will also find plenty to marvel at, as the area is home to a variety of migratory and resident species.

What makes this experience special is how close it brings you to the wild, both physically and emotionally. There’s no glass barrier, no zoo enclosures — just you, the guide and the wilderness. The guides are knowledgeable and passionate, sharing insights that deepen your appreciation for the ecosystem.

A wilderness drive and safari from Rawla Bisalpur is truly an intimate encounter with nature that stays with you long after you’ve left the unforgettable landscapes of Jawai behind.

name: Zhiwaling Heritage
intro: Indulging in the Zhiwaling experience goes beyond a simple stay; it unfolds as an enchanting cultural and spiritual journey, weaving you into the very fabric of Bhutan's rich heritage.

news_article.title: Witness the Essence of Bhutanese Hospitality at Zhiwaling Heritage
news_article.description: Safeguarding Bhutan’s Cultural Richness

postcards.name: Experience Bhutanese Culture from the Comfort of Your Room
postcards.intro: Experience a relaxing and comfortable stay in the suites at Zhiwaling Heritage, where the focus is on providing a serene and cosy atmosphere for you to unwind and enjoy your time. These suites offer you positive and vibrant energy, providing beautiful views of the surrounding nature for a refreshing and uplifting experience.
postcards.story:
Zhiwaling Heritage marks a milestone as Bhutan's first hotel, where the journey into the very soul of Bhutanese hospitality commences. Enjoy stunning mountain views and immerse yourself in the quintessential Bhutanese lifestyle from the most spacious hotel rooms and suites in Bhutan. As you enter your suite, comfort and cultural immersion blend seamlessly. The rooms are carefully crafted, offering a calm retreat for you to relax after a day of exploration.

Indulge in the epitome of the Bhutanese journey with The Royal Raven Suite. Its name pays homage to Uzha Jarog Dongchen – the Raven Crown of Bhutan, an emblem of Mahakala and the guardian deity of the inaugural Zhabdrung. Within its sacred space, the shrine room is graced by the presence of the trinity Goddess: Namgyelma (Skt. Vijaya), Tsepame (Skt. Amitayus) and Delma (Skt. White Tara). Unified as one, these deities are invoked for the blessings of longevity, happiness and wealth.

You can even choose to relax in a Junior Suite, and absorb scenic views of the Paro Valley and the surrounding mountains from the Magnolia and Drugyel suites. You’ll notice how beautifully these suites are situated in eight separate cottages, connected to the main building by a charming pathway. 

In these spaces, you'll discover the smooth integration of modern amenities with traditional Bhutanese aesthetics. The ambience here is a gentle nudge to connect with the essence of this enchanting destination. What sets Zhiwaling Heritage apart is its commitment to providing an environment that reflects the essence of this beautiful country.

The architecture echoes the stories of the land, and the furnishings, though refined, carry the spirit of simplicity. Here, you are not just occupying a room but entering into a dialogue with the culture that surrounds you.

postcards.name: Connect with Bhutan’s Spiritual Heritage at Zhiwaling
postcards.intro: The Zhiwaling Heritage experience transcends any ordinary travel experience. It unfurls as a cultural and spiritual exploration, seamlessly integrating you into the stories of Bhutan's profound heritage. Welcome to a place that connects you with Bhutan's cultural roots on a personal level.
postcards.story:
In Bhutan, as you tread the ancient paths of spiritual heritage, you'll find a landscape woven with the threads of contemplation. Deepen your understanding of this ancient Buddhist realm and its spiritual legacy by observing the deliberate placement of revered masters, saints and lamas. The in-house Buddhist temple at Zhiwaling Heritage signifies the cultural richness of this peaceful place. Crafted from 450-year-old timbers sourced from the historic Gangtey Monastery, dating back to 1613 CE, the temple exudes a profound sense of history.

Inside, ceremonies such as the Lhab Sang Ritual unfold, marking moments of new beginnings and special occasions. The sanctity of these rituals becomes palpable within the hallowed walls, fostering a connection with the spiritual heritage that echoes through time. As you step into the temple, Guru Rinpoche takes centre stage, flanked by Terton Pema Lingpa on the left and Zhabdrug Ngawang Namgyal on the right, their timeless presence resonating with the very timbers that house them. 

This deliberate arrangement invites you to witness the embodiment of spiritual wisdom and leadership, offering a glimpse into the culture that has shaped Bhutan's Buddhist identity. In these subtle details and shared stories, the layers of Bhutan's spiritual heritage come to life, making your exploration a thoughtful and enriching experience.

In the simplicity of Bhutanese life, you’ll discover the richness of a culture shaped by a deep reverence for the sacred. The heritage of Zhiwaling isn't confined to the walls; it permeates the air you breathe and seeps into your awareness. It's an unspoken conversation between the past and the present, and you, as a mindful traveller, become an integral part of this dialogue. In every corner, you'll find an invitation to reflect and connect, making your stay a conscious journey through Bhutan's timeless heritage.

postcards.name: Admire Authentic Bhutanese Architecture
postcards.intro: Zhiwaling Heritage in Bhutan is a masterpiece of traditional architecture, built by local artisans using Bhutanese materials over five years. Combining cultural authenticity with modern comforts like underfloor heating, the property immerses you in Bhutan’s heritage. Designed to preserve tradition and promote Gross National Happiness, it offers an unparalleled stay that showcases the essence of Bhutan.
postcards.story:
Zhiwaling Heritage in Bhutan stands out for its stunning Bhutanese architecture, which captivates you the moment you arrive. Before even noticing the welcome tea, you’ll be drawn by the property’s intricate design and colourful ceramics. 

The property is the result of a five-year collaboration between a Bhutanese team and a Swiss architect. Around 300 to 500 local artisans contributed their expertise, hand-carving wooden pillars and working with traditional stonework. 

Every detail reflects the craftsmanship and heritage of Bhutan, making Zhiwaling a true embodiment of its culture. In contrast to the main building, their rooms were recently refurbished. Rooms are light and airy offering a refreshing contrast to the traditional grandeur of the main building's architecture.

Unlike many modern properties that replicate a uniform style across locations, Zhiwaling was designed to remain as true to its location as possible. While it offers modern conveniences — such as Swiss underfloor heating and golf carts for transportation — the heart of the property lies in its commitment to preserving Bhutanese traditions. 

The goal was to create a space that not only delivers luxury but also tells the story of Bhutan through its architecture and design.
Guests often describe their stay here as an authentic experience, emphasising the cultural immersion the property provides. 

This aligns with Bhutan’s philosophy of Gross National Happiness, as Zhiwaling aims to preserve and share Bhutan’s heritage in a way that respects its roots while offering modern comforts to wonderful guests like you. 

Ultimately, Zhiwaling Heritage is more than a place to stay and beautifully connects you to the essence of Bhutan.

postcards.name: Churn Butter Tea with Your Own Hands
postcards.intro: Zhiwaling Heritage’s Tea House offers a unique Bhutanese Suja butter tea-making experience. Here, you’ll learn to prepare this savoury drink using a wooden churner, blending butter and salt with tea for an authentic taste. Paired with local snacks, the ceremony provides a hands-on cultural immersion. The homey Tea House also features a library, adding to its charm and warmth.
postcards.story:
At Zhiwaling Heritage, the Tea House offers you an intimate opportunity to experience Bhutanese tradition through a butter tea-making ceremony. 

This small, homey cottage, features a modest library where you can read books. It also includes a traditional fireplace, making it a warm and inviting spot, especially in winter.

The butter tea-making ceremony is a standout experience. A member of the staff guides you through the process, starting with boiling water and adding tea leaves until the brew reaches a rich, dark colour. 

The tea is then strained and placed in a wooden churner, where butter and salt are added. Here, you’ll actively participate in churning the tea by hand, enhancing the flavour.

What sets this experience apart is the unique preparation and flavour of butter tea. Unlike conventional teas made with milk and sugar, this traditional Bhutanese Suja tea combines butter and salt, resulting in a savoury drink. Alongside the tea, local snacks made from rice are served, adding to the cultural immersion.

This ceremony is more than just tea preparation. You’ll find the process intriguing and the experience memorable, as it deeply connects you to Bhutanese culture. 

Come and enjoy your freshly churned butter tea or browse the small library during your stay. The Tea House at Zhiwaling Heritage is truly a must-have experience for learning about Bhutan’s traditions and enjoying its warm hospitality.

postcards.name: Enjoy the View of the Tiger’s Nest from the Meditation House
postcards.intro: The Samden Meditation House at Zhiwaling Heritage offers you a calm space for yoga and meditation with breathtaking views of Paro Taktsang. It features open-air and closed settings, equipped with yoga essentials. Accessible for all, including those unable to hike, it provides a serene environment for reflection, mindfulness and connection to Bhutan’s spiritual heritage.
postcards.story:
The Samden Meditation House at Zhiwaling Heritage offers you a calm space for meditation and yoga, uniquely positioned to provide stunning views of the iconic Paro Taktsang (Tiger’s Nest). 

Samden, meaning “fulfillment of desires or wishes,” reflects the house’s purpose: offering a peaceful environment for reflection, spiritual growth and mindfulness.  This location makes it an ideal spot for yoga retreats and meditation sessions, catering to both individual practitioners and organised groups.

The meditation house is accessible via stone steps and features floor-to-ceiling windows that open out beautifully. Here, you can enjoy a closed, peaceful setting or an open-air experience that spills onto the surrounding area. 

The design emphasises a connection with nature, nurturing a sense of calm and mindfulness. One of the standout features of the Samden Meditation House is its accessibility for those unable to hike up to the Tiger’s Nest. 

With a telescope available, you can view the sacred monastery from a distance, allowing you to feel its energy and serenity without the physical challenge of the hike.

 This makes the meditation house a meaningful alternative for older guests or those seeking a more relaxed way to connect with Bhutan’s spiritual heritage.

The facility is well-equipped with yoga mats, bolsters, straps and other tools for a fulfilling practice. You can either bring your own yoga instructors or request a local teacher and Zhiwaling can arrange tailored sessions to suit different needs. 

These sessions often combine gentle postures, rhythmic breathing exercises and guided meditation, providing you with a holistic wellness experience.

Whether practising yoga, meditating or simply enjoying the breathtaking views, the Samden Meditation House invites you to reconnect with yourself and the surrounding beauty of Bhutan.

postcards.name: Soak in Natural Minerals in a Hot Stone Bath
postcards.intro: Zhiwaling Heritage’s hot stone bath offers you a traditional Bhutanese experience in an open-air setting under the stars. Heated stones release minerals into a wooden tub, enhanced with Artemisia herbs for therapeutic benefits like easing joint pain and backaches. Surrounded by bamboo, the bath combines privacy with nature, providing you with a serene and authentic connection to Bhutanese wellness traditions.
postcards.story:
The hot stone bath at Zhiwaling Heritage provides you with a unique and authentic Bhutanese experience. Unlike most luxury properties that host their baths indoors, the hot stone bath at Zhiwaling is set outdoors, allowing you to relax under the open sky surrounded by bamboo groves. 

This natural setting provides both privacy and a strong connection to nature, making it a standout feature of the property.

The experience often takes place in the evening, when the stars are visible, adding to the calm atmosphere. You can watch the traditional preparation process, which includes heating stones over an open fire and carefully placing them in a tub filled with water. 

The heated stones release minerals into the water, enhancing its therapeutic qualities. Artemisia, a medicinal herb, is also added, known for its healing properties that help alleviate joint pain, backaches and other physical discomforts.

This practice is rooted in Bhutanese tradition, where hot stone baths have long been used as a remedy, particularly for postpartum care or to ease body aches. 

Historically, these baths were outdoor experiences and were a great way of recovering from injuries. Zhiwaling stays true to this tradition, offering you an open-air setup that aligns with Bhutan’s cultural heritage.

You can schedule the hot stone bath on your last evening at the property, providing a great way to wrap up your stay. The soothing warmth of the water, combined with the serene surroundings, creates a deeply rejuvenating experience.

Zhiwaling’s hot stone bath not only offers physical relief but also immerses you in an ancient Bhutanese practice. It’s a cultural experience that reflects Bhutan’s love for nature and holistic well-being.

postcards.name: Indulge in the Hands-on Experience of Ceramics at Zhiwaling
postcards.intro: Zhiwaling Heritage celebrates Bhutanese craftsmanship through its in-house ceramic art. Led by an artist with over 25 years of experience, the property offers handmade, customisable ceramics featuring traditional designs like Paro Taktsang. You can watch live ceramic painting sessions, purchase unique souvenirs or personalise pieces, creating meaningful memories of Bhutan’s rich artistic heritage.
postcards.story:
The art of ceramic painting at Zhiwaling Heritage adds a unique and creative touch to your stay. This in-house tradition is led by a skilled artist who has been with the property for over 25 years. 

Her expertise ensures that every ceramic piece reflects intricate designs inspired by Bhutan’s culture and heritage, making it a special highlight of the hotel.

The artist creates and paints ceramic items, which are displayed throughout the property and available for purchase as souvenirs. 

You can take home handmade plates, boxes or other items adorned with designs of Bhutanese landmarks like Paro Taktsang (Tiger’s Nest) or traditional motifs. Each piece can also be customised, offering you a personalised keepsake or gift.

If you’re looking to immerse yourself in this craft, Zhiwaling Heritage offers live ceramic painting sessions. Here, you can observe the artist at work, gaining insight into the detailed process of creating these beautiful pieces. 

While arranging full ceramic-making classes may not be feasible due to time constraints, watching the live painting provides a glimpse into this intricate art form.

Ceramic painting at Zhiwaling is particularly popular among guests from Asia, but it appeals to anyone who values cultural craftsmanship. 

The combination of artistry and tradition makes these ceramics more than just souvenirs — they’re a piece of Bhutan to take home.

Whether purchasing a ready-made item, customising a design or simply watching the artist at work, the ceramic art experience at Zhiwaling Heritage celebrates Bhutanese creativity and offers you a wonderful understanding of the local culture.

name: Kaner Retreat - India’s first desert botanical resort
intro: Kaner Retreat provides an intimate introduction into the quiet brilliance of the Thar Desert. The retreat is surrounded by an ‘oran’ or a sacred grove where no pruning and cutting of trees—are allowed. The result is an unspoilt landscape in which desert flora flows freely and people and wildlife live in harmony.

news_article.title: Experience a Sensory Feast in the Thar Desert at Kaner Retreat
news_article.description: India's First Desert Botanical Resort

postcards.name: Plants to platter - experience the journey of desert cuisine
postcards.intro: The signature 'thali' experience at Kaner begins with a nature walk in the sacred grove or 'oran'. Guests are introduced to the rare bounty of the desert plants and the culture behind the cuisine of the Thar. They learn about the unique ingredients and the evolution of the recipes. Guests then enjoy the 'thali' while recounting the stories.
postcards.story:
A  'thali' in India is rooted in the culture of a region. Experts say that it changes after every 15 kilometres. According to Ayurveda a 'thali 'should balance all the six tastes - sweet, sour, salty, astringent, pungent and bitter. These six tastes and the traditional recipes from the Thar make the Kaner signature 'thali' . Dishes are curated using foraged, seasonal and local ingredients. 

The highlight of this culinary experience is the guided nature walk in the sacred grove or 'oran' before savouring the 'thali' . Oran is a community land that is considered sacred - no cutting or pruning of trees is allowed here. Oran offers miles of untouched desert wilderness and hundreds of plant species. 

Through stories and anecdotes from local culture guests explore desert biology and its role in the culinary traditions of the Thar.

postcards.name: Experience Indoor - Outdoor living in the desert setting
postcards.intro:
The architecture of Kaner is an invitation to experience the quiet brilliance of the Thar Desert. Stones sourced from local mines are used to create open, expansive spaces. 
Guests can step out into their personal courtyard to gaze at the stars or have tea in the outdoors while watching the sunset. At Kaner the outdoor seamlessly blends with the indoors.
postcards.story:
The villas and public spaces at Kaner Retreat are designed to let the desert landscape in. There are 10 spacious villas in this 7 acre property. Each villa has its own private courtyard filled with scented flowers. The windows in each villa open to the desert landscape. 

The glasshouse lounge offers 360 degree views of the Thar desert. The 'hathai' room is an exclusive, private dining area. Here,  guests can enjoy their meals while feeling one with the desert setting.

postcards.name: Kaner Retreat - The song of the Oleander Flower
postcards.intro: Every time you see the vibrant Kaner, the desert rose or the oleander flower that is ubiquitous in the desert, it seems to whisper and say, "I am a kind word uttered and repeated by the voice of nature,” It blooms like a beautiful blessing in the desert and runs in the symphony of the desert like a sombre note.
postcards.story:
For Sapna Bhatia, the founder of Kaner, the flower is her childhood companion , a symbol of nostalgia as the very fragrance takes her back to the days where she would watch her grandmother offer the flowers to the gods. The flower became her muse, it carried within its petals, the idea of “home.” and no matter where she travelled, it brought back whiffs of memories with its scent. It embodied the very spirit of the desert flora.

When Sapna decided to create a resort to celebrate the virgin beauty of the desert flora, it started with the Kaner , the beautiful flower that blooms in abundance without demanding many resources and it is the resilience of the blossom that drew her to other desert flora. She was in awe of the brilliant “ Rohida” and “ Ker” flowers that added a dash of orange to the ochre landscape of the desert . 

Clusters of “ Aakda flowers, offered to Lord Shiva by the people fascinated her with their pointy petals and crowns. She started the resort to create an ode to the flora, looking beyond colours, patterns and fragrances and hoping that in her garden of love, the flowers would ensure that they do not bloom unnoticed. As she says, every tree, shrub, leaf, flower and even a thorn has a story to be told and in Kaner, they unfurl as the buds blossom.

postcards.name: Blooming from France to Rajasthan with Botanical Art
postcards.intro: A walk into a room at Kaner feels like you have entered a floral art gallery, laced with the fragrances and flavours of the desert. Every room wears a different hue, texture  and scent and is designed with local flowers as inspiration. Kaner Retreat is the first boutique hotel to commission desert botanical art to local artists.
postcards.story:
When guests enter their room, they might walk into a pink palette of the Kaner, or the soft beige textures of the 'Bui 'or desert cotton, or the bright orange mood of the 'Hazara' or marigold. In every room the flower becomes the muse. 

The inspiration for botanical art came all the way from France, from none other than Pierre-Joseph Redouté, often referred to as the “Rembrandt of botanical art”. Sapna’s fascination with botanical art began when she saw his work in the art galleries abroad and realized that there was hardly any art dedicated to the desert flora unlike tropical flowers. 

She was told by artists that the desert plants were considered invisible, with small shrubs, non-descript flowers and hardly any leaves.  But she felt that that there was poetry in the thorny plants of the Thar Desert that had to be showcased to the world through art. She commissioned two artists - Malini Saigal , who had worked on botanical illustrations and Madan Meena, who focuses on a contemporary take on traditional miniature paintings. 

The walls now burst into colours as seasons unfold through the decor. Paintings and sketches depict the beauty of the flowers. Even the furnishings wear the shades of the flowers. Every room has wild flower arrangements and the ornamental flowers make the private courtyards fragrant.

postcards.name: Khichan - A Community Conservation Story
postcards.intro: Barely 45 minutes from Kaner, is a dusty little village, lost to the world. But there is a heart-warming conservation story that makes this hamlet special. Khichan also has special guests, the avian travellers, the demoiselle crane. Each year, thousands of them make an arduous journey across the Himalayas to reach Khichan.
postcards.story:
The beautiful demoiselle cranes, called dames by the French queen Marie Antoinette are called ‘Kurja’ locally. 

Thousands of them throng here during winters all the way from Mongolia and are treated with love and reverence by the village. It all started with the 'conservation warriors', Sevaram Mali Parihar and the late Ratanlal Maloo who started feeding and protecting them after their harsh migratory journey. 

Guests at Kaner can travel to Khichan for a tete a tete with the special travellers along with their guardians - the local villagers who will narrate the conservation story. 

Khichan is also a great haven for cultural and heritage enthusiasts and for those into art and architecture with century old, ancestral havelis , owned by merchants, which have withstood the ravages of time. The tour here includes a walk in the village with more stories, while plans are afoot to showcase the interiors of these traditional havelis or mansions as well. 

The tour also includes a visit to the Olive Grove for lunch and more on this in the next postcard. But before that, a special tip: Look out for the carvings of olive leaves on the facade of the mansions.

postcards.name: Olive trees - From Negev Desert to Thar Desert
postcards.intro: It is said that the desert does not keep the weak. The tough climatic conditions pose a challenge to life, livestock and agriculture. However, there are some who not only brave the harsh conditions but also thrive. One such person is Satbiri Devi, a woman farmer who is the pioneer in Olive cultivation in the Thar Desert.
postcards.story:
The desert has many stories of resilience, patience and strength and people who live to tell the story. Kaner celebrates such people. One of them is Satbiri Devi, a woman farmer who spent ten years planting around 6000 olive trees . The saplings had travelled all the way from Negev Desert in Israel to the Thar Desert. When asked why she took on such a difficult task, she said “ "someone said it could not be done'. 

This is the spirit of the people who live in the desert, where every day is an extraordinary tale of struggle, but a labour of love that is rewarding in its way. 

Satbiri Devi’s farm is in Phalodi, which is about 45 minutes drive from Kaner Retear . While guests are there they can also soak in the scenic views of lush desert vegetation surrounding them.Satbiri Devi’s tale of love and toil has led to the delicious artisanal organic, extra virgin oil that gets produced from her farm. Guests can enjoy a Mediterranean inspired lunch made with the Olive Oil from the farm. They can also visit the Olive Garden after the tour to Khichan, which is just 10 minutes away.

postcards.name: Experience the local culture of camels
postcards.intro:
The camel is an enduring symbol of the Thar Desert and enjoys deep bonds with the herders. Camels are considered family and are decorated with elaborate jewellery and attire. 
This beloved creature is a recurring motif in the art and textiles. At Kaner, guests can enjoy the company of camels and be a part of the culture.
postcards.story:
The folk musicians of Rajasthan sing the tales of the land under the starry desert skies. Their repertoire includes a song called 'Gorbandh', it is the name of the jewellery that the herders lovingly make for their camels. The song talks about the rare bond between the camel and man. 

At Kaner, guests can explore this unique culture of camels. They can go on a camel safari in the natural habitat of the camels, spend some time with the herders and also enjoy an interactive session that traces the culture of camels. 

Over the years, urbanisation has resulted in a decrease in the camel population and the silhouette of this ubiquitous animal is disappearing. 
At Kaner, we are spearheading a campaign of camel awareness and conservation by supporting the herders.

postcards.name: Bond with a Horse and Learn about Human Relationships
postcards.intro: The horse once an exotic import is now very much part of the desert identity. At Kaner, guests visit a horse farm and through interactive activities learn about communicating with this powerful yet sensitive animal.These interactions help not only in understanding horses but also develops insights into relationships.
postcards.story:
It is said that the horse is mentioned a great deal more than the cow in Indian ancient scriptures. Preferred by aristocrats and kings and revered by the masses, the horse represents the identity of Rajasthan. 

People in the Thar Desert have grown up listening to stories of not only the kings but also the horses that accompanied them during the wars. There are tales of sacrifice and companionship.

Discover, how to befriend the horse and experience bonding in this unique workshop.

postcards.name: Mharo Khet - a sustainable collaboration
postcards.intro: In a desert, every growth, be it a wild plant or an exotic species is nothing sort of a miracle. And one of the miracles can be seen in Mharo Khet, a forty-acre experiential farm in Jodhpur. Guests from Kaner can spend a day at the farm, losing themselves in immersive walking tours and culinary dining.
postcards.story:
'Mharo Khet' meaning my farm in local language celebrates plants - not just the indigenous and native desert vegetation, but also exotic flora and over hundred species of plants. 
From superfoods like moringa to the familiar mango, from strawberries to fig, the farm also focuses on sustainable farming and community involvement, largely having women farmers who nurture the crops. 

Founded by Rajnush Agarwal and his wife Vedika. Mharo Khet is more than just a farm . It is all about transforming the arid desert landscape into a fertile verdant land for the love for fresh, local and natural produce. 

With Mharo Khet, Oxford returned Rajnush has created a new narrative in the desert landscape by introducing different varieties of produce using modern and sustainable agriculture 
Kaner Retreat and Mharo Khet stand for celebration of plants and focus on local communities, and sustainable and responsible farming.

name: The Lodge at Wah, Palampur
intro: The Wah Tea Estate Plantation stay started as an endeavour taken up by Deepak Prakash to build a home for his family and personal guests close to the tea factory. He was determined to create The Lodge at Wah as an extension of its surroundings.

news_article.title: Soak Up Nature’s Beauty at The Lodge at Wah in Palampur
news_article.description: An Eco-Friendly Retreat in Himachal Pradesh

postcards.name: Stay in an Authentic Eco Lodge
postcards.intro: Staying at The Lodge at Wah promises an immersive experience if you’re seeking a mindful escape. The eco-friendly cottages ensure that your overall stay is full of nature and comfort. Whichever room you opt for, the emphasis remains on simplicity and relaxation. It’s a holistic retreat, inviting you to unwind, connect with nature and indulge in a mindful luxury experience.
postcards.story:
The Lodge at Wah features three cottages with a total of six individual ensuite rooms. Each room has a separate entrance to the outside, and none of them are interconnected. The structures on the property are constructed using eco-friendly materials such as wood, slate and mud. The living and dining area is exclusively in the Main Cottage, where all meals are served, either indoors or on the patio and garden.

All rooms are designed in a similar earthy style, each having its distinctive character. The accommodations are equipped with all-weather air conditioners, king-size beds, bathrooms with hot and cold running water, eco-friendly ceramic toiletries, hair dryers and electrical bed warmers for winter comfort. There are no TVs in the rooms to encourage you to enjoy the serene surroundings.

The Standard rooms feature earthy decor and modern amenities. Oolong room, one of the largest standard rooms, is located on the first floor of the Main Cottage, facing the kitchen garden with traditional mud flooring. The Court room, also on the first floor, faces the mountains and garden, boasting traditional mud flooring and a private balcony made from the Old Palampur Courthouse witness box stand. It is situated across from Oolong.

Camellia and Pekoe rooms, set on the ground floor, open to the garden and each has a private sit-out area. Camellia, the farthest from the Main Cottage, offers you a cosy atmosphere with wooden floors. Pekoe, adjacent to Camellia, features wooden floors, lovely window seating and great mountain views from the bed. Both rooms share a private sit-out area. Your time at The Lodge at Wah will be truly extraordinary, ensuring that your experience is exceptionally memorable.

postcards.name: Relish the culinary art of The Lodge at Wah
postcards.intro: Indulge in nutritious and flavourful meals at The Lodge at Wah, tailored to your preferences and inspired by fresh, seasonal ingredients. Whether it's the beloved Kangra Dham, Himachali specialities, wood-fired pizzas, peach ice cream or custom requests like gluten-free and vegan options, your stay here is truly a journey of diverse flavours.
postcards.story:
The Lodge at Wah prioritises crafting healthy and flavourful meals tailored to your preferences. The menu revolves around fresh, seasonal ingredients, with a focus on Himachali, Indian, Continental and Italian dishes. Meals are served in a family-style setting, either outdoors or in the common dining area.

The staff works diligently to ensure your comfort and make an effort to conclude meals on time, respecting the commitments of the team members. The Kangra Valley offers a rich array of local flavours and this is beautifully integrated into your stay experience.

A highlight is the Kangra Dham, a special meal traditionally reserved for significant occasions. The chefs have recreated this using traditional cooking methods, including earthen and bronze pots, offering you a unique taste of Kangra. Additionally, the chef also prepares other Himachali specialities like khichri, sarson saag, makki roti and desserts such as moong dal ka halwa.

For a break from Indian cuisine, you can enjoy pancakes, khowsuey, wood-fired pizzas, barbecues and Tibetan dishes. The wood-fired oven pizzas made with fresh homemade dough and garden-fresh vegetables are particularly popular. They're also open to accommodating custom requirements, from gluten-free options to vegan substitutes, with prior notice.

Variety is a strength here, with a continuous exploration of new dishes and cuisines. Each visit offers you a unique culinary experience. The Lodge at Wah takes pride in their in-house specialities, including seasonal homemade jams, pickles, chutneys, sauces and juices. Freshly baked bread and delectable vanilla sugar cookies are standard fare, while the small-batch granola and homemade peach ice cream showcase their commitment to quality.

From iced teas to warm muffins, the diverse offerings cater to all weather preferences. You’re warmly invited to savour the simple joys of thoughtfully crafted meals and homemade delights during your stay.

name: The Lodge at Wah, Kandbari
intro: When Pooja decided to build a home in the mountains, only one place called out to her. Kandbari seemed absolutely perfect - a stream flowing alongside, a quiet village, tons of greenscape and lots of lovely paths to walk.

news_article.title: Indulge in Forest Bathing at The Lodge at Wah, Kandbari
news_article.description: Enjoy Mountain Life in Himachal Pradesh

postcards.name: Explore the charming village of Kandbari
postcards.intro: As you venture away from the bustling main road and into the heart of the village of Kandbari, a tranquil location reveals itself, belying the fervent activism that thrives within its serene facade. The air seems to hum with quiet energy as if the land itself is whispering tales of its storied past and the passions of its inhabitants.
postcards.story:
As your footsteps carry you away from the beaten path, a sense of instant serenity envelops you, transporting you to a realm where time slows and the worries of the world melt away. Along the way, quaint houses punctuate the landscape, nestled amidst verdant farmland, towering trees and meandering streams. Glimpses of majestic mountain ranges peek through the bamboo groves, inviting you to rest beneath their shade with an inspiring book in hand.

Venturing down tiny paths that diverge from the tarmac road, you'll discover hidden gems tucked away from the prying eyes of the world. Smooth rocks offer you perfect perches to soak in the symphony of nature, accompanied by the soothing melody of nearby streams. Local waterholes glisten with crystal-clear waters, enticing you to take a refreshing plunge during the warmer months, a rejuvenating respite from the heat of the day.

The village of Kandbari is full of scenic walks and panoramic views, each corner offering a new tableau of natural splendour. Go on walks through its winding pathways, where every turn reveals a postcard-worthy view of the verdant valley below. Along the way, enjoy the warmth of the village community, as invitations for endless cups of chai and lively chatter abound, each encounter leaving a strong mark on your heart.

Indeed, stepping into Kandbari feels akin to stumbling upon a beautifully serviced home nestled within the depths of an enchanted forest. Here, amidst the serenity of nature and the vibrant spirit of its people, time seems to stand still, allowing you to immerse yourself fully in the magic of the moment. So, lose yourself in the labyrinthine lanes of Kandbari, where every step is a reflection of the enduring allure of hidden treasures waiting to be discovered.

postcards.name: Go for a Wah Tea Estate Tour
postcards.intro: Go on a sensory journey through the enchanting world of tea at the esteemed Wah Tea Estate in Kandbari, where every sip tells a story of craftsmanship and tradition. Your adventure begins with a wonderful overview of the tea manufacturing process and the art of tasting, a delightful prelude to the sensory delights that await.
postcards.story:
As you wander through the lush greenery of the Wah Tea Estate, keep your eyes peeled for the skilled Wah tea pluckers, whose deft hands delicately harvest only the choicest two leaves and a bud, the very essence that infuses Wah tea with its unparalleled taste. Feel the thrill of the harvest as you try your hand at plucking the tea yourself, connecting with the age-old practice that has shaped their legacy.

Next, journey up to the heart of their operations: the factory. Here, amidst the rhythmic hum of machinery, immerse yourself in the intricacies of tea processing. Follow the journey of the tea leaf from withering to rolling, fermenting to drying and sorting, each step a reflection of the meticulous care and expertise that goes into crafting the perfect brew.

En route to witness the plucking process firsthand, marvel at the vibrant organic farm and poly-houses that dot the landscape, where an abundance of fresh produce is cultivated for consumption at The Lodge at Wah. Experience the harmony between nature and nurture as you explore these bountiful fields, a reflection of their commitment to sustainability and quality.

Your journey culminates in The Tea Room, a haven of bliss located amidst the verdant tea bushes. Here, surrounded by the gentle rustle of leaves and the fragrance of freshly brewed tea, immerse yourself in an amazing tea-tasting session. Guided by knowledgeable hosts, discover the nuances of different tea varieties as you savour each exquisite sip, a symphony of flavours dancing upon your palate. As you bask in the warm embrace of hospitality here, let the beauty of Kandbari and the richness of its tea culture envelop you, leaving you with memories to cherish long after your visit.

name: Zuri Zanzibar
intro: As the first Design Hotels member on the Tanzanian archipelago, Zuri Zanzibar is the ultimate spot to take in the natural beauty of the main island, Unguja. In this semi-autonomous region of Tanzania, East Africa, a confluence of influences from Africa, Arabia, India, and Europe means a cultural mosaic which sets the scene for a rich travel experience.

news_article.title: Enjoy Your Life’s ‘Zuri’ Moments at Zuri Zanzibar
news_article.description: White Sands, Turquoise Waters and Swahili Soul

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding and Honeymoon in Zuri Zanzibar
postcards.intro: Since love is a one-of-a-kind journey, Zuri is dedicated to crafting weddings that mirror your individuality and aspirations. Whether you envision an intimate cocktail reception, a private gathering, a grand gala dinner or the most romantic Zanzibar beach wedding, you can select from a range of exclusive and naturally stunning venues to make your special day truly unforgettable.
postcards.story:
Nestled along a stunning west-facing beach, with a backdrop of the Indian Ocean, Zuri Zanzibar is a uniquely designed destination that fuses African influences and eco-friendly architecture. Here, you'll discover an incredible beach experience, where lush greenery and native landscaping magnify the true spirit of Zanzibar. 

Zanzibar's stunning beauty sets the stage for your special moment. Your wedding day is meant to be one of the happiest days of your life. Here, you can stay assured that this unique experience is joyful and unforgettable. From the smallest floral details to the delectable culinary experiences, every aspect of your wedding day is infused with your personal touch and affection. This place makes your wedding an unforgettable chapter in your love story.

You’ll notice how an intimate atmosphere is crafted with romantic decor at the ceremony venue, complemented by a simple bouquet and buttonhole of local flowers. After the ceremony, savour sparkling wine and canapes, followed by a wedding cake. As the day concludes, enjoy a special wedding dinner by a bonfire in the presence of your loved ones.

But it’s not just about celebrating your wedding here; the celebration also extends to your honeymoon. If you’re a newly married couple, this is a perfect place to start your journey together. Here, you’ll enjoy rejuvenating spa treatments and memorable dining moments together with your partner. You can stay here for more than five days and be pampered with personalised benefits designed exclusively for honeymooners.

Maua Wellness provides you with top-tier skincare products alongside a holistic well-being program. Delve into the world of beauty services to ensure you're perfectly poised for your momentous day.

postcards.name: Bask on the Beach at Zuri Zanzibar
postcards.intro: Zuri translates to 'beautiful' in Swahili, the language of Zanzibar. Discover the charming island of Zanzibar and find inspiration in the carefully curated range of tours, from short excursions to multi-day safaris. In this mesmerising location, you’ll be greeted by a beautiful white-sand beach, turquoise waters and breathtaking sunsets. Don’t think twice; say yes to new adventures!
postcards.story:
From the grandeur of Kilimanjaro to the vast Serengeti plains, Tanzania offers a wide range of scenic wonders. But it's not just the landscapes; the warmth of its people and the richness of their traditions create a welcoming and harmonious atmosphere. The island of Zanzibar is steeped in history, with a blend of ancient architecture, bustling markets and tranquil beaches, creating a unique atmosphere. 

As the waves gently lap against the coastline and the sun dips below the horizon in shades of gold, Zanzibar encourages you to uncover its mysteries with each new stride. Zanzibar, located just a few degrees from the equator, basks in a tropical climate, treating you to abundant sunshine and the mesmerising hues of the blue ocean.

Zuri Zanzibar is situated in Kendwa village, on the island's west coast, approximately 50 kilometres from Stone Town. You’ll notice how everything at this resort seamlessly blends with the island's natural beauty. You can choose to stay in a bungalow, a suite or even a villa, all set within a lush tropical garden just a brief walk from the Indian Ocean.

Here, you can immerse yourself in the essence of Zanzibar, its serene landscapes and the warm culture of its people. At Zuri Zanzibar, the sunsets paint the sky with warm colours, creating a soothing atmosphere as you set sail. Don’t forget to sip on sundowners served onboard for a perfect end to an ideal day. If you’re here in February, you'll have the opportunity to experience the Swahili music festival, one of the most prominent and well-regarded festivals in East Africa. This is a place to enjoy life's little joys, whether you're by the beach or immersing yourself in Zanzibar's lively culture.

name: Aradura, Kohima
intro: Overlooking the verdant pine forests, Niraamaya Retreats Aradura offers a countryside escape amidst some of the most beautiful scenery in the region. The charming accommodations and spectacular vistas make your stay truly rewarding.

news_article.title: Experience the Beauty of Kohima at Niraamaya Retreats Aradura
news_article.description: A Luxurious Stay Surrounded by Pine Forests

postcards.name: Hike Along the Dzükou Valley
postcards.intro: Nestled amidst the rugged terrains of Nagaland, lies a breathtaking location of natural beauty waiting to be explored – Dzükou Valley. Imagine yourself stepping out from the comforts of Aradura, greeted by the crisp morning air, tingling with anticipation as you go on a hiking journey into the heart of this charming valley.
postcards.story:
As you set foot on the trail along the Dzükou Valley, the earthy scent of damp soil and wildflowers fills your lungs, awakening your senses to the wonders that lie ahead. Each step you take leads you deeper into a world untouched by time, where nature reigns supreme and every corner holds a new marvel to behold.

The Dzükou Valley, renowned for its delicate beauty, stands as a silent sentinel amidst a sea of green, its vibrant shades painting the landscape with splashes of colour. You find yourself captivated by the sheer abundance of flora that blankets the valley, each bloom reflects the resilience and diversity of life in this pristine wilderness.

As you continue your hike, the gentle rustle of leaves and the melodious chirping of birds serenade you along the way, creating a melody of sounds that puts you into a state of bliss. You find yourself pausing every now and then, not out of exhaustion, but out of sheer reverence for the natural beauty that surrounds you.

The trail meanders through lush meadows and towering cliffs, offering breathtaking panoramas at every turn. With each ascent, you feel as though you are ascending into the very heart of nature.

At last, as the sun begins its descent, casting a golden glow upon the valley below, you find yourself standing at the pinnacle of Dzükou, gazing out at a view so stunning that it takes your breath away. The valley stretches out before you like a vast canvas, its colours ever-changing with the shifting light of day.

And as you make your way back to Aradura, the memories of your time in Dzükou Valley will stay in your heart forever, a sign of the enduring beauty of the natural world.

postcards.name: Visit the Picturesque Shilloi Lake
postcards.intro: When you stay at Niraamaya Retreats Aradura, one of the must-visit destinations nearby is Shilloi Lake. Surrounded by majestic hills, this lake, shaped like a human foot, is a sight to behold. As you go on your journey from the retreat, you'll find yourself drawn to the enthralling beauty of this natural wonder.
postcards.story:
Arriving at Shilloi Lake, you'll immediately feel a sense of serenity wash over you. The calm waters reflect the towering hills that encircle it, creating a scene of quiet magnificence. Walking along the shoreline, you'll notice the unique shape of the lake, its resemblance to a human foot adding to its mystique.

Local lore whispers of a holy child spirit dwelling at the lake's bottom, a belief held dear by the inhabitants of Kohima. This reverence for the sacred presence imbues the surroundings with an air of reverence, prompting you to approach with a sense of respect.

Though the lake's waters shimmer invitingly under the sunlight, you'll learn that they are left undisturbed by the locals, who refrain from using them for any purpose. This tradition, steeped in spiritual significance, adds an intriguing layer to your exploration of Shilloi Lake.

As you soak in the breathtaking scenery, you might find yourself contemplating the mysteries that lie beneath the surface. The hills echo with the whispers of the wind, carrying tales of ancient legends and timeless truths.

Visiting Shilloi Lake isn't just about sightseeing but also about profoundly connecting with the natural world. The stillness of the surroundings invites introspection, offering you a chance to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in the tranquility of nature.

Leaving the lake behind, you'll carry with you a sense of peace and wonder, knowing that you've experienced something truly special. Back at Niraamaya Retreats Aradura, as you reflect on your journey, you'll find yourself grateful for the opportunity to witness the beauty of Shilloi Lake and the richness of culture and tradition that surrounds it. Are you ready to be a part of this memorable experience?

name: The Virginian Lodge
intro: Welcome to The Virginian Lodge, your perfect starting point for the ultimate Jackson Hole adventure. Set amidst the vast expanse of Jackson Hole, our nostalgically designed Wyoming lodge is fully equipped for creating lasting memories: roomy accommodations, a vibrant saloon, a pool open all year round, and warm firepits to relax by after a day of exploring.

news_article.title: Keeping it Western at The Virginian Lodge
news_article.description: A Perfect Base for Jackson Hole Adventures

postcards.name: Ski or Snowboard at Jackson Hole Mountain Resort
postcards.intro: Visit Jackson Hole Mountain Resort for the thrill of a lifetime. With its exhilarating slopes, stunning scenery and vibrant village atmosphere, it promises an unforgettable adventure for skiers and snowboarders of all levels. It’s an experience that blends adventure, comfort and natural beauty perfectly. It’s a perfect base for exploring the stunning snowy surroundings of Jackson Hole.
postcards.story:
Starting your day at The Virginian Lodge, you're greeted with a warm, rustic ambience. The lodge's friendly staff and convenient amenities make it easy to relax and prepare for the day's adventures. After a hearty breakfast, it's time to hit the slopes.

Jackson Hole Mountain Resort is just a short drive away and its towering peaks and expansive terrain are immediately impressive. The resort boasts the largest vertical drop in North America, over 4,000 feet, providing a thrilling challenge for expert skiers and snowboarders. 

The adrenaline rush as you carve down these expert runs is unparalleled, with the fresh mountain air and breathtaking views adding to the exhilaration.

If you’re a beginner or looking for a more relaxed experience, Jackson Hole offers plenty of beginner-friendly slopes. The ski school is top-notch, with patient and knowledgeable instructors who make learning fun and rewarding. 

As you gain confidence and skill, the variety of runs ensures that there's always a new challenge to conquer.

Off the slopes, the vibrant village atmosphere of the resort is a delight. You can explore charming shops, enjoy delicious meals at a range of restaurants and unwind with a hot drink by a crackling fire. 

The sense of community and the shared excitement of fellow adventurers create a lively and welcoming environment.

One of the highlights of a visit to Jackson Hole is the access to backcountry adventures. Guided tours offer the chance to explore untouched powder and pristine wilderness, providing a sense of solitude and connection to nature that's hard to find elsewhere. 

Whether you're snowshoeing through quiet forests or taking a scenic tram ride to the summit, the natural beauty of the area is always on display.

postcards.name: Go Dogsledding in a Winter Wonderland
postcards.intro: One of the highlights of a winter visit to Jackson Hole is the chance to go dogsledding. This adventure is an experience that combines excitement, natural beauty and a unique connection with animals. The lodge can help you arrange a tour and you’ll find yourself in the snowy backcountry, ready to explore some of the valley’s most beautiful landscapes.
postcards.story:
As you arrive at the dogsledding base, the eager, well-trained dogs greet you with excited barks and wagging tails. Meeting the dogs and learning about their training and care is a fascinating part of the experience. 

The guides, who are knowledgeable and passionate about dogsledding, will teach you the basics of leading a team of dogs. You’ll quickly see how each dog has its own personality and role within the team.

Once you’re ready, it’s time to hit the trails. The sled glides smoothly over the snow and the only sounds are the panting of the dogs and the swish of the sled runners. 

Cold air fills your lungs and the stunning winter scenery unfolds around you. Snow-covered trees, frozen streams and open meadows create a picturesque backdrop as you travel through the valley.

The sense of teamwork between the musher, the dogs and the passengers is truly special. You’ll take turns driving the sled, feeling the power and coordination of the dog team as they respond to your commands. 

The guides are always there to help and ensure everyone is safe and comfortable, making the experience enjoyable for both beginners and those with more experience.

As you glide through the snowy landscape, you’ll likely spot wildlife such as elk, deer and maybe even a fox. The peacefulness and beauty of the backcountry make it easy to forget the rush of everyday life.

With both half-day and full-day tours available, there’s an option for everyone, whether you’re looking for a brief taste of adventure or a full-day immersion in the wilderness. 

Overall, dogsledding in Jackson Hole is an unforgettable experience that combines the thrill of adventure with the beauty of nature and the joy of working with a team of amazing dogs.

name: Villa Beluno
intro: Between the blunt physical world and the delicate memories made under the grandeur of our Patagonia sky. We don’t come to Villa Beluno to escape, we come to remember.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Romantic Escape at Villa Beluno
news_article.description: A Charming Lakefront Villa in Argentina

postcards.name: Enjoy Kayaking on Nahuel Huapi Lake
postcards.intro: Nahuel Huapi Lake, located in the wooded eastern foothills of the Andes, stands as the largest lake and premier resort area in Argentina's lake district. Kayaking on its crystal-clear waters offers an exhilarating way to explore this natural wonder while staying at the Villa Beluno Hotel.
postcards.story:
The glacial origins of Nahuel Huapi Lake give rise to its stunningly clear blue waters, creating an exciting opportunity for kayaking adventures. With its considerable depth, the lake presents endless opportunities for exploration. Paddling along its shores, you can immerse yourself in the serene beauty of the surrounding landscape.

The beauty of Nahuel Huapi Lake extends far beyond its pristine waters. Towering Andean peaks loom in the distance, their rugged slopes cloaked in verdant forests. Islands dot the expanse, each offering a calm oasis amidst the vastness of the lake. Sandy beaches invite kayakers to pause and soak in the beauty of their surroundings.

Kayaking on Nahuel Huapi Lake offers a thrilling blend of adventure and thrill. As you navigate the blue waters, you can revel in the sense of freedom and connection to nature that kayaking provides. The rhythmic dip of the paddle, the gentle lapping of water against the hull — each moment on the lake is a chance to escape the rush of daily life and find solace in the beauty of the natural world.

Beyond the thrill of kayaking, Nahuel Huapi National Park offers a wealth of opportunities for outdoor exploration. Boating, fishing and mountaineering are just a few of the activities available to visitors eager to immerse themselves in the wonders of this pristine wilderness. Whether going on a thrilling paddle or seeking an adrenaline-fueled adventure, Nahuel Huapi Lake promises unforgettable experiences for those who venture into its embrace.

At the end of the day, as the sun dips below the horizon and casts a warm glow over the landscape, you can return to Villa Beluno Hotel with your heart full of memories and your spirit renewed by the beauty of Nahuel Huapi Lake.

postcards.name: Energise Your Spirit with Lavish Spa Treatments
postcards.intro: At Villa Beluno Hotel, you can indulge in a range of lavish spa treatments designed to promote relaxation and well-being. Prioritising wellness is essential for maintaining overall health and happiness. From massages to facials, the spa offers a variety of services to help you unwind and rejuvenate during your stay.
postcards.story:
The benefits of spa treatments extend beyond mere pampering — they play a vital role in promoting self-care and prioritising wellness. Massage therapies, for example, can help alleviate muscle tension, reduce stress and improve circulation. Facials, on the other hand, nourish the skin and promote a healthy, radiant complexion.

In addition to traditional spa treatments, you can also enjoy the serenity of the steam bath and sauna. These heat therapies not only promote relaxation but also help detoxify the body and improve overall well-being. The solarium provides a peaceful space for you to soak up the sun's rays, promoting vitamin D production and boosting mood.

One of the highlights of the spa is the hydro massage, which soothes tired muscles and promotes relaxation through the therapeutic power of water. Whether you are seeking relief from aches and pains or simply wish to unwind after a long day of activities, the hydro massage offers the perfect solution.

After indulging in spa treatments, you can further enhance your relaxation experience by taking a dip in the heated infinity edge pool. With both indoor and outdoor swimming options, the pool allows you to immerse yourself in soothing waters while taking in breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. As you float weightlessly in the pool, the stresses and worries of daily life seem to melt away, leaving you feeling refreshed.

By taking time to indulge in spa treatments and relaxation activities, you can nourish your body and mind, fostering a sense of balance and well-being that extends far beyond your stay at Villa Beluno Hotel. Whether seeking relief from physical ailments or simply wishing to unwind and recharge, the spa offers a sanctuary of solitude where you can prioritise self-care and embrace the benefits of wellness.

name: Kariappa House
intro: Kariappa House is an offering to The Mother and Sri Aurobindo. It is a home and a place of retreat for the owner, Jyoti Cariappa Saikia and for me, Kakoli, her friend and work partner. We have opened it up for like minded people who will appreciate the beauty and the quietness of this house.

news_article.title: Explore Pondicherry’s Culturally Rich Past at Kariappa House
news_article.description: Where Indian Heritage Meets French Charm

postcards.name: Unwind With Yoga and Wellness Activities in Pondicherry
postcards.intro: Escape from the hustle of daily life and soak in the Franco-Tamil influences of Pondicherry at the serene and picturesque Kariappa House. Start your day at their rooftop Yoga Shed, indulging in your private yoga practice, or join other guests for a rejuvenating Suryanamaskar session as the warm, crisp breeze of the nearby sea awakens your senses.
postcards.story:
Kariappa House, with its tropical greenery, blend of local and contemporary architecture and quiet atmosphere, offers the perfect space to ease into your holiday. This restored traditional property is perfect for slow travellers who prefer longer stays and enjoy connecting with the local community while exploring the spiritual essence of a destination. 

If this is your idea of travel, you will adore the tranquillity that washes over you the minute you set foot into their lush green property. Here, wellness can be experienced around every corner, from their natural reflexology path to their expansive yoga terrace. Open to all guests, the terrace has a thatched roof as well as a space under the open sky if you wish to bask in the morning sun or the evening breeze.

Immerse yourself in a mindful practice of greeting the sun every morning or easily flow into your asanas with Somatic Yoga, guided by experienced practitioners. Through every stretch, every bow and every moment of meditation, you will feel gratitude, contentment and stillness grounding you in the present. Enhance your yoga sessions with a variety of other healing therapies, such as ear acupuncture with essential oils, Somatic meditation and yoga for stress management.

Being Reiki practitioners themselves, the hosts and team at Kariappa House prioritise your need for holistic well-being. They are more than happy to help arrange private or customised sessions, including yoga for kids, to ensure you get the most enriching experiences during your stay. For further wellness indulgences, unwind with a full-body massage at their in-house massage room. Feel all your knots and aches loosen up under the expert hands of local masseuses as you melt into a puddle of calm, peace and relaxation.

postcards.name: Step into Pondicherry’s Vibrant Franco-Tamilian History
postcards.intro: Kariappa House is an ode to the blended traditional Tamilian and French cultures and the modern influences that draw travellers to the tourist town of Pondicherry. Spread over half an acre of land, this property invites you to live like the joint families once did, with its interconnected houses and sprawling green gardens. And that is just the start!
postcards.story:
Nestled in the quaint Vaithikuppam fishing village and near the famous French quarters, Kariappa House was restored over five years using natural materials like wood, lime and stone. The hosts wanted to recreate the original Indian and colonial architecture while mixing in contemporary amenities to ensure maximum comfort for guests. The result is this stunning property, oozing heritage around every corner, from carved doors and antique furniture to breezy courtyards where you can unwind after a day of exploration. 

This green retreat is not a hotel but a home that welcomes you with its warm ambience. Stay in one of the two cosy, restored Tamil houses and catch glimpses of its domestic history. As you reach the main door, you will notice intricate carvings all across the frame, with the top part hanging low, prompting you to bow your head to pass the door as was the tradition back in the day. 

Explore more corners to discover pieces from local artisans that are a treat to the senses, such as the vibrant, painted glass panes that add beautiful hues to the sun's rays. Here, art and culture are not just on the walls but can be found on the floor, too. As you stroll through, spot the famous Attangudi tiles and their geometric patterns handcrafted by Chettinad artisans or the oxidised flooring that was a staple in old South Indian homes.

The main house is where you can witness the beauty of authentic Franco-Tamil architecture, with materials and finishes inspired by local 1800s heritage. Lounge on the traditional Tamil thinnais (raised verandahs) or capture gorgeous pictures of the French arched windows, fluted pilasters, tall columns and rich plaster decorations.

With its tropical greenery, calming waters and charming heritage stay, Kariappa House is a mini-Pondicherry in itself!

name: Basecamp Adventure
intro: Basecamp Adventure embodies the essence of simplicity under canvas with an abundance of private open space for the intrepid explorer yearning for an atmosphere of adventure.

news_article.title: Become One With the Masai Mara at Basecamp Adventure
news_article.description: Redefine Your Safari Experience in Kenya

postcards.name: Get Involved With the ‘Eat This!’ Culinary Project
postcards.intro: Eat This! project is a journey of empowerment. Each acquisition not only adds a culinary gem to your collection but also contributes to a brighter future for passionate young Maasai pursuing their dreams. Join Saruni Basecamp in this transformative journey where every recipe savoured becomes a symbol of empowerment, resilience and the shared joy of culinary exploration.
postcards.story:
At Basecamp Adventure, your culinary journey extends beyond exquisite meals – delve into the heartwarming narrative of ‘Eat This!’ This exceptional cookbook transcends the ordinary; it's a testament to passion, courage and endless possibilities.

Curated by Executive Chef Benson Ole Soit of Saruni Basecamp in Masai Mara, this cookbook doubles as a fundraising initiative. The Saruni Basecamp concept, deeply rooted in empowerment, provides staff like Benson with opportunities for personal development. Benson, a self-made success story, learned the art of cooking through experimentation. Basecamp Management, recognising his potential, wholeheartedly supported his aspiration to become a successful chef. Since then, Benson has dedicated his career to inspiring others with a culinary passion.

Proceeds from its sale contribute to the education of a passionate young Maasai, following in Benson's footsteps. The Maasai community, traditionally pastoral, faces modernity's challenges, with education costs inhibiting many from accessing higher education. Saruni Basecamp is committed to strengthening local capacity and the scholarship initiative spearheaded by Chef Benson aims to address this barrier.

Your support matters – the cookbook's proceeds, led by Chef Benson, will fund a scholarship of up to USD 2,500 for a deserving young Maasai with a culinary passion. This scholarship covers an 18-month cooking course at the esteemed Karen Blixen Cooking School in Masai Mara. Here, hands-on training immerses students in the delicate balance between classical and modern cuisine, creative food presentation, menu planning, food costing and more.

Your impact resonates beyond the classroom – after graduation, Basecamp Adventure provides an invaluable opportunity. Graduates will work under Benson's mentorship, evolving into qualified chefs. Your direct support can change lives – purchase the Eat This! cookbook at the camps in Masai Mara. This unique chance is a stepping stone for young, aspiring Maasai chefs venturing into the hospitality industry.

postcards.name: Join an Educational Safari at Basecamp Adventure
postcards.intro: Go on an Educational Safari with Basecamp Adventure, where the spirit of ecotourism transforms your journey into a cross-cultural exploration, fostering personal growth through global engagement, knowledge exchange and hands-on experiences.
