Let the wilderness be your guide. This unique safari concept redefines your impact, emphasising minimal environmental and local community disruption.
postcards.story:
Saruni Basecamp defines an Educational Safari as an eco-conscious experience that not only immerses you in the wonders of Masai Mara but also leaves a positive footprint. Central to this safari is an experiential learning approach, delving into environmental issues like natural resource protection, endangered species and culture preservation. Through lectures, participation in conservation projects and guidance from the knowledgeable Maasai safari guides, you engage in a transformative learning journey.

Tailored for families with school-aged children, young adults, career professionals seeking knowledge expansion or returning travellers craving a deeper connection, this program adapts to your specific interests and group sizes, especially for learning institutions.

Over six enriching days, combine the thrill of safari with insightful activities covering conservation, livelihood improvement, climate change adaptation and philanthropy. Immerse yourself in the intricate relationships between wildlife, communities and responsible tourism in the Maasai Mara ecosystem and beyond.

Your Educational Safari isn't just an adventure; it's a pathway to understanding and contributing to the delicate balance of nature and culture. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, a curious mind or a passionate advocate for responsible tourism, this experience broadens your horizons.

Picture yourself gaining firsthand knowledge on conservation efforts, witnessing the positive impact of community projects and participating in meaningful discussions. This is an invitation to not only witness the wonders of Masai Mara but to actively contribute to its preservation.

So, join Basecamp Adventure on this transformative journey where the wilderness becomes your classroom and every interaction shapes your understanding of responsible tourism. The Educational Safari with Basecamp is your passport to a world where exploration is synonymous with learning and each step leaves a lasting impression on both you and the environment you explore.

name: Brij Lakshman Sagar
intro: On the fringes of the badlands of Rajasthan, Brij Lakshman Sagar is a boutique hotel that was originally built in the late 19th century as a hunting lodge by the then Thakur of Raipur, Lakshman Singh Ji.

news_article.title: Be Inspired by Indigenous Rajasthani Architecture at Brij Lakshman Sagar
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Participate in Community Activities
postcards.intro: During your stay at Brij Lakshman Sagar, immerse yourself in the richness of Rajasthan's local community. Venture beyond the confines of the hotel and connect with the heartbeat of village life. Share stories, laughter and perhaps even a few lessons of your own, as you forge connections that transcend borders and cultures.
postcards.story:
At Brij Lakshman Sagar, you'll discover more than just a place to rest your head – you'll find a gateway to the soul of Rajasthan. Step into the world of education by visiting local schools, where eager young minds are shaped and nurtured. Engage with students and educators alike, gaining firsthand insights into the challenges and triumphs of education in rural Rajasthan. 

For a taste of authenticity, explore the bustling vegetable and spice markets that teem with life and colour. Lose yourself in a whirlwind of sounds and aromas as you navigate through stalls brimming with fresh produce and aromatic spices. Engage with local vendors, learning about their techniques and traditions passed down through generations. And don't forget to savour the flavours of Rajasthan with a culinary adventure, sampling delicacies crafted from the very ingredients you've just encountered.

Delve deeper into the richness of local craftsmanship by visiting artisan shops, where skilled artisans breathe life into age-old traditions. Marvel at the intricate designs of handcrafted textiles, pottery and jewellery, each piece reflecting the artisan's dedication and expertise. Take home a piece of Rajasthan's heritage as a memento of your journey, a tangible reminder of the beauty and craftsmanship that define this land.

As the day fades into night, immerse yourself in the finer aspects of local culture with tastings of local liquor and tobacco. Sip on traditional brews and indulge in aromatic blends, each sip a journey into the soul of Rajasthan. Engage in lively conversations with fellow travellers and locals alike, sharing stories and forging bonds over shared experiences. Here, slow living isn't just a lifestyle but a philosophy, a way of celebrating the richness and beauty of local culture.

postcards.name: Go for a Refreshing Nature Walk
postcards.intro: During your stay at Brij Lakshman Sagar, you're invited to go on an immersive journey into the heart of nature with the in-house naturalist. Rise with the sun and join for a morning nature walk, where you'll meander through the serene surroundings, soaking in the stillness of the dawn.
postcards.story:
As you tread softly along the pathways on a nature walk, you'll discover a variety of flora and fauna unique to the region, guided by the expertise of the naturalist. With each step, you'll unravel the ancient topography of the land, tracing the footsteps of the past generations. Listen closely as the naturalist shares tales of the indigenous plants and trees that call this landscape home, offering insights into their medicinal properties and cultural significance. 

Keep your eyes peeled for signs of wildlife, from graceful blackbucks to elusive foxes, as they gracefully navigate their natural habitat. As the day transitions into dusk, join once again for an evening nature walk, where the golden shades of the setting sun cast a warm glow over the land. 

Delve deeper into the mysteries of the wilderness as twilight descends, enveloping you in a sense of wonder and serenity. With the guidance of the naturalist, you'll uncover hidden secret treasures tucked away amidst the rugged terrain.

For those with a passion for bird-watching, Brij Lakshman Sagar is a paradise waiting to be explored. Set your sights on the vast expanse of the sky as flocks of colourful birds soar overhead, their melodic chirps filling the air with music. From majestic eagles to dainty kingfishers, each winged creature adds to the richness of life that thrives in this pristine ecosystem.

If you're lucky, you may even catch a glimpse of the beloved mascot turtles, lazily basking in the warm glow of the sun on the peaceful shores of the lake. Watch in awe as they gracefully glide through the water, their sleek shells glistening in the sunlight. Let the in-house naturalist be your guide on this unforgettable journey, as you explore the wonders of Brij Lakshman Sagar and make memories that will last a lifetime.

name: Saruni Eagle View
intro: Saruni Eagle View is located on a panoramic escarpment in Mara Naboisho Conservancy, Masai Mara, with sweeping views over the open savannah in what is one of the most beautiful and protected areas of the Mara ecosystem.

news_article.title: Stay in a Modern Eco-Camp at Saruni Eagle View
news_article.description: A Sustainable Game-Viewing Destination in Kenya

postcards.name: Join a Walking Safari in the Heart of the Maasai Mara
postcards.intro: Going for a walking safari with Saruni Eagle View Camp in the Maasai Mara offers you a down-to-earth and immersive experience. The simplicity of stepping into the wilderness on foot allows you to connect more intimately with the natural surroundings. Accompanied by knowledgeable guides, these walks provide a genuine exploration of the diverse ecosystems in the Maasai Mara.
postcards.story:
Saruni Eagle View Camp's commitment to responsible and sustainable tourism is reflected in the guided walking safaris, ensuring minimal impact on the environment while offering a memorable and authentic encounter with the wild beauty of the Maasai Mara.

Saruni Basecamp walking safaris are guided by experienced and professional Maasai. When you walk with them, you get an authentic insight into the bush instead of just observing it. The duration of African walking safaris depends on your preference, ranging from two hours to several days. You can explore the open plains and bush at a leisurely pace during these walks.

As you traverse the landscapes, you'll witness the everyday interactions of the wildlife, gaining a unique perspective that's different from traditional game drives. The walking safari, with its unassuming approach, enables you to appreciate the smaller details of the environment, enhancing your understanding of the interconnectedness of Maasai Mara's ecosystem.

Saruni Eagle View Camp's commitment to responsible and sustainable tourism is reflected in the guided walking safaris, ensuring minimal impact on the environment while offering you a memorable and authentic encounter with nature and wildlife.

During walking safaris, you have a good chance of coming across game animals such as lions, elephants, rhinos and buffalos, as well as hyenas, hippos, giraffes, zebras and various other wildlife. The prospect of encountering the world on their terms can be an exciting experience for you.

Mara Naboisho Conservancy is a pristine wildlife territory with stunning scenery. It stands out as one of the few places within the greater Mara that lets you enjoy walking safari adventures. The slower pace and lower angle of being on foot reveal small details of the incredible wilderness. It's a chance for you to observe nature more closely and appreciate the subtleties of the environment.

postcards.name: Visit an Authentic Maasai Community
postcards.intro: A community visit is a cultural tour that invites you to engage in a meaningful encounter with the Maasai people, providing a unique opportunity for cross-cultural interaction and the enjoyment of shared experiences. Saruni Basecamp is dedicated to ensuring that you return home with a genuine understanding of the people you’ve met and the places you’ve explored.
postcards.story:
Going for an immersive Maasai visit from the Saruni Eagle View Camp opens the door to an enriching cultural journey. Nestled within the pristine landscapes of the Mara Naboisho Conservancy, Saruni Eagle View not only offers you a luxurious retreat but also serves as a gateway to authentic encounters with the Maasai people. The camp's commitment to sustainable and responsible tourism is evident as it offers you the opportunity to engage with the Maasai community in a way that respects and preserves their centuries-old traditions.

The main activity during a community visit is a guided walk led by a local Maasai guide. You'll explore various sites recommended by your guide, who will provide information about each location. The community walk includes visits to local schools, health centres, homesteads and the market. Here, the intricate design of the Maasai dwellings unfolds, revealing the cultural significance of every element. 

Interacting with the Maasai people, you’ll gain firsthand knowledge about the community's customs, family structures and the role of cattle in their daily lives. This cultural exchange fosters a deep appreciation for the resilience and vibrant heritage of the Maasai. Along the way, you can interact with the Maasai herders and gain insights into their pastoral way of life, a cornerstone of their identity. 

Most places you visit have connections to Saruni Basecamp, either through staff members residing there or the company's long-term support. The community tour is a heartwarming and inspirational experience for you and the local people, especially children.

In essence, immersive Maasai visits from the Saruni Eagle View Camp offer a nuanced and respectful exploration of Maasai culture, providing you with a holistic understanding of the local people, their traditions and the delicate balance between conservation, tourism and community well-being in the Mara Naboisho Conservancy.

name: Basecamp Wilderness
intro: Basecamp Wilderness is a nostalgic tribute to the safaris of the early explorers and safari pioneers. Free from artificial luxury and modern disturbances and providing the perfect escape close to nature with optimal tranquility and stunning sunrise views, Basecamp Wilderness is how safaris and safari camps were meant to be.

news_article.title: Discover Basecamp Wilderness
news_article.description: A Safari Camp in the Wild in Kenya

postcards.name: Let Your Children be a Part of the Young Explorers Club
postcards.intro: Going on an authentic family safari in Masai Mara holds a unique charm, and as a family-focused company, Saruni Basecamp has introduced the Young Explorers Club to elevate the experience for both parents and children. Ready to plan your family's remarkable Masai Mara adventure?
postcards.story:
Saruni Basecamp’s mission is to impart knowledge about the environment and nature while ensuring a fun-filled time within the camp surroundings. Conducted by the friendly Maasai guide, a dedicated expert naturalist oversees all activities tailored to the children's age and length of stay, keeping them engaged throughout.

The Young Explorers Club activities are diverse and include wildlife tracking, where children explore the camp surroundings to identify various animals and birds through distinctive methods like listening to bird sounds or examining footprints and droppings. Guided nature walks introduce kids to plants and trees, educating them about traditional uses within the community.

Bush survival skills take centre stage as children learn the Maasai's traditional livelihood techniques. Crafting a bow and arrow using local materials precedes practical tests, such as throwing a Maasai club or attempting hunting for a prize. Beadwork sessions with Maasai ladies teach children how to create traditional bracelets and necklaces, providing them with meaningful souvenirs.

Stargazing unfolds during the night, offering insights into the main constellations and celestial wonders. If you’re a parent, you can choose to join your kids in these learning expeditions or opt for a few hours for yourself. Storytelling around the campfire features authentic myths and folk tales, unravelling societal explanations, origins or crisis resolutions, accompanied by the mesmerising Maasai jumping dance.

Traditional face painting lets children express their creativity by decorating their faces with various patterns and shapes using Masai cultural materials. Wildlife-themed board games and puzzles add to the entertainment, ensuring a delightful experience for the younger explorers.

It's important to note that the Young Explorers Club activities are flexible and depend on the children's age and duration of stay. With sessions scheduled in the mornings and afternoons, families can tailor their safari adventure to accommodate both educational exploration and moments of relaxation.

postcards.name: Stay in Basecamp Wilderness Tents in the African Wilderness
postcards.intro: Basecamp Wilderness epitomises a unique combination of traditional safari style and modern design tents, immersing adventurous travellers in the African landscape and fostering a connection with nature and oneself. Revel in the tranquil atmosphere, complemented by top-notch cuisine and beverages.
postcards.story:
Immerse yourself in the captivating African landscape surrounding Basecamp Wilderness. The tents, thoughtfully placed to maximise privacy and views, serve as a comfortable base for exploration. The five tents are strategically positioned along the Saddle Valley rim, ensuring complete privacy and optimal views of the savannah. 

The dining tent provides a cosy setting with leather chairs, a selection of reading materials, and a vintage gramophone, creating a romantic ambience. 

The pricing is based on double occupancy, covering accommodation, all meals, mineral water, airstrip transfers, shared game drive safaris, night game drives, guided walking safaris and the Naboisho Conservancy fee. Additional costs include extra beverages, domestic and international flights and a single room supplement of 105 USD per person per night. For families with children under 12 years sharing a tent with adults, a 50 per cent discount off the full rate applies.

Each tent features comfortable double beds adorned with white linen and plush duvets, along with a separate bathroom unit equipped with bio-flush toilets and bucket showers. A private outdoor seating area offers you panoramic views of the sprawling savannah, enhancing the experience of staying in the heart of African surroundings.

Staying in a tent amid the African wilderness is an immersive experience of nature's raw beauty. Every rustle and murmur outside becomes a part of your nocturnal lullaby, offering you a unique and enchanting connection with the untamed African wilderness.

Whether relaxing in the dining tent's romantic atmosphere or enjoying the private outdoor seating areas overlooking the savannah, you’ll find solace in the simplicity and beauty of the surroundings here. The traditional safari style seamlessly merges with a modern touch, creating an authentic experience that allows you to connect with the essence of the African wilderness.

name: Saruni Leopard Hill
intro: Saruni Leopard Hill is our modern camp in the midst of the African wilderness. Sitting on the deck of your tent, the animals are so close it feels like you can touch them. You are at one with the greatness of the savannah.

news_article.title: See the Big Five on a Luxury Safari at Saruni Leopard Hill
news_article.description: Sustainable Safaris in Kenya's Masai Mara

postcards.name: Explore the Scenic African Wilderness at Saruni Leopard Hill
postcards.intro: Located in the Masai Mara, Saruni Leopard Hill is a sanctuary that offers mindful travellers a deep connection with the African wilderness. Here, the primal forces of the African wild entwine with the comforts of a luxurious, elegant retreat. Ready to enjoy some of the best wilderness experiences of your life?
postcards.story:
Nestled discreetly into the African landscape, Saruni Basecamp's Saruni Leopard Hill invites you with a gentle invitation. The canvas tents, simple yet opulent, blend seamlessly with the environment, offering panoramic views that stretch for miles. As the canvas flaps in the breeze, a sense of serenity washes over you, and you are reminded that you are not just a guest here, but a part of the wilderness itself.

Here in Masai Mara, you share your surroundings with an incredible density of wild animals. The landscape in Masai Mara is a striking mix of open grasslands and lush forests, creating a picturesque backdrop for safaris. Just beyond the campgrounds, you'll have the extraordinary opportunity to intimately observe iconic wildlife, gaining insights into their natural behaviour. You'll be serenaded by the sounds of the wild — distant lions, elephants and the gentle rustling of leaves. 

Whether you're inclined to go for a tranquil morning game drive as the sun rises or commit to an entire day of traversing the savanna on foot or in a vehicle, the choice is entirely yours. You can go on safaris in both Masai Mara National Reserve and the adjacent Naboisho Conservancy, which each offer distinct experiences. When you’re at Saruni Leopard Hill, you get the unique opportunity to explore both areas, providing a complementary African safari adventure.

As the sun sets, the magic of Saruni Leopard Hill unfolds. With a warm breeze carrying the scent of the savanna, you'll find peace and simplicity in the canvas tents that blend into the landscape, offering sweeping views of the Masai Mara. Dining beneath the African sky with candlelit tables, local cuisine, and Masai guides who share their wisdom is an unforgettable experience. It's a place where you can appreciate the beauty of Africa and support its preservation.

postcards.name: Get Yourself a Relaxing Spa Treatment at Saruni Leopard Hill
postcards.intro: At Saruni Leopard Hill, wellness is beautifully woven into your safari experience, offering you a holistic approach to rejuvenation. Set in the heart of Kenya’s Masai Mara, the camp provides a tranquil and relaxing environment where your well-being is a top priority.
postcards.story:
Your wellness journey begins with dedicated ‘wellbeing spaces’ thoughtfully placed in the quiet corners of Saruni Leopard Hill. Here, you can choose from a range of massages and treatments performed by skilled resident therapists. They combine modern techniques with traditional Maasai and Samburu knowledge, using natural ingredients like Olsinoni leaves (Lippia Javanica), known for their detoxifying properties. Each session is tailored to relax your body and clear your mind, leaving you refreshed and energised.

As you lie on the massage table, the gentle pressure of the therapist’s hands combined with the subtle aroma of natural oils creates a multi-sensory experience. The connection between body and mind becomes evident, as each stroke helps release built-up stress and anxiety. It's not just about physical relaxation; the treatments also aim to restore mental clarity and emotional balance.

The spa experience at Saruni Leopard Hill is a thoughtful journey of self-care. It allows you to step away from life’s hustle and reconnect with yourself in one of the world’s most inspiring settings.
Post-treatment, you’ll feel a profound sense of renewal, as if the wilderness itself has contributed to your healing. You can then choose to linger in the wellbeing space, sip herbal tea and soak in the tranquillity or return to your verandah, letting the calm settle deeper.

These moments help you find balance and centre yourself, enhancing the restorative power of your stay. For a more immersive experience, relax by the poolside, letting the serene surroundings further calm your senses.

At Leopard Hill, wellness is a way to reconnect with yourself and nature. Whether through a therapeutic massage, mindful yoga or a simple swim, every element is designed to restore your physical and mental balance, leaving you recharged and inspired.

name: Pegasus Suites & Spa
intro:
We welcome you to the enchanting island of Santorini and the beautiful Imerovigli.
One of the unique hotels in Imerovigli,
the luxurious 5-star Santorini hotel Pegasus Suites & Spa promises you carefree and memorable vacations while enjoying the magic and the mystery of one of the most romantic destinations around the world.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Romantic Holiday at Pegasus Suites & Spa
news_article.description: A Stay in the Enchanting Island of Santorini

postcards.name: Indulge in an Authentic Spa & Fitness Experience
postcards.intro: Indulge in the epitome of relaxation at Pegasus Suites & Spa, where every aspect of your well-being is mindfully catered to. The lavish spa invites you into a realm of tranquillity, offering you a diverse array of therapies and treatments designed to rejuvenate both your body and soul.
postcards.story:
Whether you seek a pampering facial treatment to revitalise your skin or a soothing body massage to ease away tension and stress, the expert therapists at Pegasus Suites & Spa are dedicated to ensuring your ultimate comfort and satisfaction. Step into the serene sanctuary and immerse yourself in the calming ambience as you go on a journey of holistic rejuvenation. 

Surrender to the healing touch of skilled practitioners, who harness the power of ancient techniques and modern innovations to address your specific needs and desires. Whether it's a deep tissue massage to alleviate muscular tightness or a hydrating facial to restore your natural glow, each experience is tailored to enhance your overall well-being.

If you’re seeking ultimate relaxation, the indoor heated pool awaits, offering you a tranquil oasis where you can unwind amidst the soothing embrace of warm waters and gentle jacuzzi jets. Let your cares drift away as you bask in the serenity of your surroundings, allowing the rhythmic flow of water to lull you into a state of blissful relaxation.

But relaxation doesn't end there; Pegasus Suites & Spa understands the importance of maintaining balance in all aspects of life. That's why they invite you to nourish your body and mind in their state-of-the-art fitness centre. Even amidst your travels, you'll find a space where you can continue your wellness journey, ensuring that you return home feeling rejuvenated and revitalised.

Enjoy the opportunity to preserve a piece of your everyday routine while away from home as the fitness centre provides all the amenities you need to stay active and healthy. Whether you prefer to engage in a heart-pumping cardio session, challenge yourself with strength training or participate in a revitalising yoga class, these facilities cater to all fitness levels and preferences.

postcards.name: Explore the Beautiful Santorini Island
postcards.intro: Immerse yourself in the unparalleled beauty of Santorini, an island like no other, where every corner is adorned with nature's most enchanting wonders. Santorini invites you with its mystical allure and breathtaking views that stretch across the unfathomable blue expanse of the Aegean Sea. Are you eager to discover the wonders of this beautiful island?
postcards.story:
At Pegasus Suites & Spa, you’re invited to delve into the richness of Santorini's history and natural splendour. Explore the island's unique curved shape, characterised by its famous black-sand beaches and towering cliffs in shades of black, red and grey, sculpted by the ancient volcanic eruptions that shaped its landscape over 3,500 years ago. Legend has it that Santorini may have been the lost city of Atlantis, a notion perpetuated by its inspiring Caldera — a seven-mile crater that cradles the island and serves as its majestic harbour.

Santorini basks in the embrace of the quintessential Mediterranean climate, graced by abundant sunshine that illuminates its landscape for the majority of the year. Every evening, as the sun dips below the horizon, Santorini unveils its most captivating spectacle — the sunset over the Caldera. Join in the nightly extravaganza, where the sky is painted in hues of crimson and gold, casting a magical glow over the island and creating an atmosphere of pure enchantment.

Venture beyond the shores and discover Santorini's thriving wine culture, with no less than ten wineries scattered across the island. Sample the region's distinctive wines, characterised by their dryness and mineral nuances, with the renowned Vinsanto standing out as the quintessential dessert wine, steeped in tradition as the wine of Holy Communion.

Art and craftsmanship flourish on Santorini, with local artists weaving their talents into every corner of the island. From vibrant galleries to quaint studios, the island serves as a canvas for creative expression, offering you a glimpse into its vibrant artistic heritage.

Whether you're savouring the tranquillity of a spa retreat at Pegasus Suites or going on a journey of exploration across Santorini's storied landscapes, let the island's allure inspire your wanderlust and awaken your senses to the beauty that lies within.

name: Hotel Cruz del Vado
intro: Located in one of the first neighborhoods of the city and very close to the Cruz del Vado monument, the Hotel of the same name, was arduously intervened using a fusion of traditional and modern construction techniques, preserving the essence and history of this heritage building, while giving it our own identity.

news_article.title: Experience Unmatched Luxury at Hotel Cruz del Vado
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay in the Cultural Capital of Ecuador

postcards.name: Visit the Vibrant Antique Shop in Quenca
postcards.intro: A trip without a lasting memory leaves a void. But fear not, for when you wander the streets of Cuenca, Ecuador, seeking that unique detail to make your journey unforgettable, there's a hidden gem awaiting your discovery. As a traveller with an eye for the extraordinary, you find yourself drawn to the antique shops, where every corner holds a story.
postcards.story:
Hotel Cruz del Vado, located in the historical heart of Cuenca, invites you to immerse yourself in the experience of visiting an antique shop just steps away from their doorstep. Along the picturesque streets of La Cruz del Vado neighbourhood, where history echoes through every cobblestone, lies a rich collection of souvenirs waiting to be unearthed.

As you venture along La Condamine Street, you stumble upon a private gallery that transcends time itself. Here, amidst the curated collection of antiques, the past comes alive in the form of ornaments, sculptures and paintings. Each piece is a masterpiece, an exquisite blend of artistry and history that captivates the senses and sparks the imagination.

But what truly sets this antique shop apart is not just the items on display, but the stories they hold. As you engage with the shop's owners, they become your guides, weaving tales of the del Vado neighbourhood and its rich culture. With each anecdote shared, you find yourself transported to another era, where the aristocracy of Cuenca once flourished and the way of life was defined by elegance.

The excitement of exploring the shop is palpable as you discover treasures from near and far. Local artefacts mingle with exotic finds exchanged by travellers from distant lands, creating a tableau that is diverse and interesting. From vintage toys to timeless cameras, from saints and religious figures to musical instruments that echo melodies of days gone by, each item is a reflection of the enduring legacy of Cuenca's heritage.

As you bid farewell to the antique shop and return to the comfort of Hotel Cruz del Vado, you carry with you more than just souvenirs. You carry memories — vivid, immersive and eternally cherished — that will forever remind you of the magic found in the heart of Cuenca.

postcards.name: Visit the Local Blacksmith and Indulge in Blacksmithing
postcards.intro: When you stay at Hotel Cruz del Vado, you're not just visiting a destination — you're immersing yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Cuenca. Clearly, no experience captures the essence of traditional craftsmanship quite like a visit to the local blacksmith. Are you ready to immerse yourself in the local crafts of Cuenca?
postcards.story:
Imagine stepping into the quaint workshop of Don Sergio, a master of the fire arts with over 25 years of experience. As you enter, the rhythmic clang of a hammer on an anvil fills the air, signalling the timeless craft that unfolds before you. Here, amidst the flickering glow of the forge, you'll witness the magic of blacksmithing come to life.

Don Sergio's workshop is full of handcrafted wonders, where every piece tells a story of skill, dedication and tradition. From antique skeleton-key style locks to the iconic roosters that adorn Cuenca's rooftops, his creations are as diverse as they are captivating. Interestingly, you're invited to become a part of this process.

Joining Don Sergio during his day allows you to immerse yourself in the ancient art of blacksmithing. Under his expert guidance, you'll learn to wield the hammer and shape raw metal into exquisite works of art. Whether you're forging your own figurine or crafting intricate padlocks and horseshoes, the experience is as exhilarating as it is educational.

But it's not just about the hands-on experience — visiting the blacksmith is an opportunity to delve deeper into the cultural fabric of Cuenca. As Don Sergio shares stories passed down through generations, you'll gain insight into the significance of his craft and its role in shaping the identity of the community.

As you explore the narrow streets of the Herrerías neighbourhood, you'll discover more than just a workshop. Here, tradition and innovation intertwine, forging connections that bridge the gap between past and present.
In Don Sergio's workshop, every piece bears the imprint of centuries-old techniques and the passion of a true artisan. It's a place where time pauses and the echoes of the past resonate with every strike of the hammer.

name: Angermeyer Waterfront Inn
intro: The Angermeyer Waterfront Inn is situated on one of Puerto Ayora’s most historic grounds. Until 2003 the home of Gus Angermeyer sat here. He was among the earliest settlers on the island of Santa Cruz. Having left Germany in the early 1930´s, he and his brothers set on an adventure bound for the Galapagos islands.

news_article.title: Stay on the Bay at Angermeyer Waterfront Inn on Santa Cruz Island, Ecuador
news_article.description: Your Gateway to Galapagos Adventures

postcards.name: Observe Giant Galapagos Tortoises at Charles Darwin Station
postcards.intro: When you stay at Angermeyer Waterfront Inn, a visit to the Charles Darwin Research Station is a must for understanding the Galapagos Islands' origins and conservation efforts. As the scientific hub of the Charles Darwin Foundation, this station offers you an insightful journey into the archipelago's rich biodiversity and ongoing conservation endeavours.
postcards.story:
At the Charles Darwin Research Station, you'll have the opportunity to witness firsthand the iconic giant Galapagos tortoises, a symbol of the region's unique evolutionary history. Alongside these gentle giants, you'll encounter a variety of other species, each contributing to the intricate richness of life in the Galapagos. 

Take a walk through native gardens teeming with endemic flora and delve into the island's natural history at the public library, where a wealth of knowledge awaits. Here, you'll gain valuable insights into the research and conservation efforts that have been integral to preserving the Galapagos Islands for future generations.

Adjacent to the station lies a beautiful beach, where marine iguanas bask in the sun, offering you a glimpse into their fascinating way of life. As you explore the interpretative trail, you'll unravel the life cycle and natural history of these incredible reptiles, witnessing representatives of the 11 sub-species that call the islands home.

But the experience doesn't stop there. Venture deeper into the Research and Breeding Center to encounter the unique land iguanas, whose conservation is paramount to maintaining the delicate balance of the island ecosystem. Learn about the dedicated efforts to ensure their populations thrive, securing their place in the Galapagos for generations to come.

Through guided tours offered by Angermeyer Waterfront Inn, you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in this world of scientific discovery and conservation advocacy. Whether you're a nature enthusiast or simply curious about the wonders of the natural world, a visit to the Charles Darwin Research Station promises to be an enlightening and unforgettable experience, leaving you with a deeper appreciation for the importance of safeguarding this precious natural treasure. Isn’t this exciting and worth visiting?

postcards.name: Explore the Beautiful White Sand Beaches in Tortuga Bay
postcards.intro: When you come for a stay at Angermeyer Waterfront Inn, prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience at Tortuga Bay Beach. Situated on the south side of Santa Cruz Island in the Galapagos Islands, this charming beach invites you to witness the beauty of black sea turtles nesting along its shores.
postcards.story:
Tortuga Bay Beach isn't just any ordinary stretch of sand. As you walk along its kilometres-long expanse, the distinct grains of sand melt beneath your feet, a sensation unlike any other. It's no surprise that many visitors consider this their favourite beach in the entire archipelago.

The beauty of Tortuga Bay extends beyond its picturesque shores. Ponds teeming with tropical fish dot the landscape, offering you glimpses into the vibrant underwater world of the Galapagos. Keep your eyes peeled for wildlife sightings as you traverse the trail leading to the beach — you never know what fascinating creatures you might encounter along the way. 

Here, you’ll get to see an array of fascinating creatures, from the iconic marine iguanas to the vibrant sally lightfoot crabs that dot the shoreline with their hues. Look up, and you might spot brown pelicans gracefully gliding overhead, adding to the coastal charm.

At Tortuga Bay, you're invited to indulge in all the classic beach activities. Bask in the warm sun and feel the gentle sea breeze caress your skin as you lounge on the sand. Or, if you're feeling adventurous, take a refreshing dip in the pristine turquoise waters that stretch out before you.

If you’re craving a bit more excitement, kayaking and snorkeling are popular options for exploring the marine wonders that lie just beneath the surface. Glide through the crystal-clear waters or don your snorkel gear and dive beneath the waves to encounter an array of marine life up close.

But perhaps the most magical moments at Tortuga Bay Beach are those spent simply soaking in the natural beauty that surrounds you. Whether you choose to spend an afternoon, a full day or even longer at this beautiful beach, one thing is certain: your time here will be nothing short of extraordinary.

name: Iguana Crossing
intro: Iguana Crossing Boutique Hotel is a beach front hotel in Galápagos Islands surrounded by endemic vegetation giving to guests a privileged accommodation for a memorable and relaxed stay. Named after the "iguana crossing" path, is the best place for the Galapagos tour and travel experience.

news_article.title: Indulge in an Island Travel Experience at Iguana Crossing
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel in the Galapagos Islands

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding on Galapagos Island
postcards.intro: When you choose the Iguana Crossing Boutique Hotel for your wedding or honeymoon getaway, you're opting for an experience that transcends the ordinary. Nestled on Puerto Villamil, Isabela Island, the premier property offers 14 guest rooms strategically positioned across a sprawling three-mile golden sandy beach, with the turquoise sea as your backdrop. Your adventure of love awaits.
postcards.story:
Romance and adventure converge wonderfully in the Galápagos, making it an ideal locale for tying the knot or going on a honeymoon escapade. Iguana Crossing curates unique tours that unveil the islands' breathtaking beauty, ensuring that every moment of your honeymoon is nothing short of magical and romantic. They aim to immerse you in an adventure that not only invigorates your body but also ignites your imagination and reignites your soul.

Imagine exchanging vows amidst the backdrop of pristine nature, with the sound of gentle waves serenading your union. Iguana Crossing is delighted to facilitate wedding ceremonies and tours for private groups of up to 50 people, ensuring that every aspect, from Galapagos-themed invitations to exquisite lunch/dinner receptions and live entertainment, is thoughtfully arranged to complement your special day.

What sets Iguana Crossing apart as the ultimate choice for honeymooners or couples seeking a romantic retreat is the Galápagos Islands themselves – remote, spectacular and utterly unique. Here, you'll find yourselves embraced by the wonders of nature, from the diverse wildlife to the dramatic volcanic landscapes that surpass all expectations. It's an experience that promises to be unlike any other, leaving a lasting mark on your heart.

Iguana Crossing prioritises your privacy and comfort above all else. Each moment spent within its space is imbued with tranquillity and luxury, allowing you to bask in the joy of each other's company without any distractions. Whether you're strolling hand in hand along the sun-kissed beaches or indulging in a candlelit dinner under the starry sky, every detail is tailored to create cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

So, if you're seeking an extraordinary wedding celebration or a honeymoon retreat that transcends the ordinary, look no further than Iguana Crossing.

postcards.name: Feel the Thrill of Tunnels Snorkelling Tour in the Galapagos
postcards.intro: Begin an unforgettable adventure with the Tunnels Snorkelling Tour in the Galapagos, a must-do experience during your stay at Iguana Crossing. This tour takes you to the most spectacular site for scuba diving on Isabela Island, where the waters are shallow, calm and remarkably clear – a true sea sanctuary awaiting your exploration.
postcards.story:
As you journey towards Los Tuneles aboard the boat, you'll be amazed by the beauty of the surrounding landscapes. Unique geological formations, shaped by a series of lava flows, reveal themselves in the form of intricate arcs and tunnels both above and below the water's surface. These formations serve as a habitat for a myriad of local Galapagos species, adding an element of wonder to your snorkelling adventure.

Although the entrance to the site may pose a challenge due to strong waves, the reward is well worth it. From January to May, the tunnels are at their most enchanting, offering optimal conditions for exploration. As you delve into the underwater world, you'll find yourself immersed in a snorkelling paradise, surrounded by vibrant marine life.

The extension of this underwater marvel spans 800 meters, with an average temperature ranging from 18 to 22 degrees Celsius. Keep your eyes peeled for the diverse array of seabirds perched on the banks, including the iconic albatross, flamingos and blue-footed boobies. Beneath the surface, you'll encounter distinct species such as tortoises, iguanas, sea lions and manta rays, each contributing to the richness of life on these beautiful islands.

The geological landscape offers a kaleidoscope of colours and textures, thanks to the presence of different types of volcanic lava and vibrant desert vegetation. Amidst the cacti, palo santo trees and carob trees, you'll feel a profound connection to the natural world.

As you return to the comfort of Iguana Crossing, take time to unwind and reflect on your extraordinary snorkelling adventure. Whether lounging by the pool or strolling along the beach, enjoy the tranquillity and serenity that surrounds you, knowing that you've experienced the beauty of the Galapagos in its purest form.

name: Hotel Mama Cuchara
intro: Following a meticulous renovation, this antique Spanish-colonial house was resurrected and modernized into what is now Hotel Mama Cuchara. The hotel offers guests all the charisma of a historic hotel, the deeply individual charm of a boutique hotel and the effortless comforts, services and contemporary elegance of 5 star accommodations.

news_article.title: Celebrate Art, History and Culture at Hotel Mama Cuchara
news_article.description: A Luxury Art Hotel in Ecuador

postcards.name: Learn about the Magical Job of a Mask Maker
postcards.intro: During your stay at Hotel Mama Cuchara in Ecuador, you have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the rich local culture by exploring the nearby neighbourhood of la Loma Grande. One gem waiting to be discovered is El Caretero, a renowned mask maker who has been crafting exquisite handmade paper and cardboard masks for over two decades.
postcards.story:
As you step into El Caretero's workshop, you're greeted by the sights and sounds of traditional craftsmanship. The air is filled with the earthy scent of clay and the sound of skilled hands at work. El Caretero's dedication to preserving Ecuadorian popular culture is evident in every aspect of his craft. 

Using age-old techniques passed down through generations, he molds clay into intricate shapes, creating the foundation for each mask. With expert precision, he applies paste to the molds, shaping them into recognisable characters from Ecuadorian folklore.

What truly sets El Caretero apart is his commitment to authenticity. Each mask is painstakingly painted by hand, ensuring that no two are exactly alike. As you watch him work, you're invited to participate in the creation process, gaining a deeper appreciation for the artistry and tradition behind each piece.

As you try your hand at painting, you can't help but marvel at the skill and precision required to bring the masks to life. With each brushstroke, you feel a connection to the richness of Ecuadorian culture and you're inspired to learn more about the stories and traditions that inspired these works of art.

Before you leave, El Caretero shares stories of the characters depicted in his masks, giving you insight into the vibrant world of Ecuadorian folklore. You leave his workshop with an appreciation for the magic of handmade craftsmanship and a deeper understanding of the people who call this neighbourhood home.

Your visit to El Caretero's workshop is a reminder that the true essence of travel lies in connecting with the people and traditions of a place. As you return to Hotel Mama Cuchara, you carry with you not only memories of beautiful masks but also a sense of wonder and appreciation for the rich cultural heritage of Ecuador.

postcards.name: Spark Your Creativity at the La Cuchara Gallery
postcards.intro: When you stay at Hotel Mama Cuchara in Ecuador, a visit to La Cuchara Gallery in the traditional Barrio de la Mama Cuchara is a must-do. Here, you'll find an array of handicrafts crafted with love and care by skilled Ecuadorian artisans. Come and spark your creativity at this wonderful art gallery.
postcards.story:
Stepping into La Cuchara Gallery feels like going on a journey across the country. The walls are adorned with paintings that capture the essence of Ecuador's landscapes and culture. You'll also find an impressive display of masks, each telling its own story of Ecuadorian folklore and dolls crafted with intricate detail, reflecting the craftsmanship of the artisans.

But interestingly, your visit doesn't end with just the art experience. La Cuchara Gallery offers a taste of Ecuador's culinary delights as well. You can sip on a delicious coffee sourced from the Ecuadorian Amazon, savouring its rich aroma and flavour. And don't miss the chance to indulge in the exquisite chocolate fino de aroma, renowned for its smooth texture and intense flavour. For a unique experience, try guayusa, a traditional energising drink from the eastern jungle and feel rejuvenated by its natural boost.

As you wander through the gallery, you'll encounter a vibrant mix of locals and travellers, all drawn to the beauty and authenticity of Ecuadorian craftsmanship. Whether you're admiring the artwork, relishing the flavours of Ecuador or simply soaking in the atmosphere, La Cuchara Gallery offers you a true taste of the country's diverse culture and heritage.

Before you leave, take a moment to chat with the artisans behind the creations. Their passion and dedication shine through in every piece and you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the artistry and tradition that make Ecuadorian handicrafts so special.

Leaving La Cuchara Gallery, you carry with you not only memories of beautiful artwork and delicious flavours but also a deeper understanding of Ecuador's rich culture. It's experiences like these that make travel truly meaningful, connecting you with the heart and soul of a place.

name: Hotel Otavalo
intro: Otavalo, known for the famous “Los Ponchos” market, is a must-see destination in Ecuador, as it hosts the largest fair of indigenous crafts and textiles in all of South America. Hotel Otavalo is one of the oldest buildings in city, it is located in the center of the city and was the lost jewel of Otavalo until its recent restoration.

news_article.title: Explore Mindful Luxury and Indigenous Crafts at Hotel Otavalo
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel in North Ecuador

postcards.name: Learn about Andean Musical Instruments
postcards.intro: During your stay at Hotel Otavalo, delve into the cultural richness of the Andes with a visit to Taita Gundo, a family initiative led by the esteemed musician Ali Lema. Situated in Peguche, renowned for its craftsmanship of traditional instruments, Taita Gundo stands as a beacon for those eager to explore the soulful melodies and rhythms of Quechua heritage.
postcards.story:
At Taita Gundo, you'll encounter a diverse array of Andean instruments, each carrying its own story and significance. From the haunting tones of the quena to the vibrant melodies of the sikuri, every instrument reflects the profound connection between music and the Andean cosmovision. As you immerse yourself in the sounds of the Andes, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the cultural richness woven by generations of artisans and musicians.

But Taita Gundo is more than just a museum of musical artifacts – it's a living symbol of the preservation and revitalisation of Andean musical traditions. Through its permanent school of instrument construction and interpretation, Taita Gundo empowers visitors to engage directly with the craft, fostering a deeper understanding of the techniques and cultural significance behind each instrument. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned musician, there's a wealth of knowledge waiting to be discovered.

Music transcends language and cultural barriers, serving as a universal language that connects people from all walks of life. Its melodies evoke emotions, memories and shared experiences, fostering unity and understanding. Whether it's through the rhythm of a drumbeat or the harmony of a melody, music has the power to bring people together in profound ways.

From the intricate designs adorning the instruments to the rhythms that echo through the mountains, every aspect of the experience invites contemplation and connection with the natural world.

As you depart Taita Gundo, you'll carry with you more than just memories of melodies – you'll take with you a deeper understanding of the Andean cultural heritage and its enduring legacy. Take a moment to immerse yourself in the music, reflect on the stories woven into each note and celebrate the richness of Andean tradition during your stay at Hotel Otavalo.

postcards.name: Admire Traditional Andean Handlooms and Ancestral Fabrics
postcards.intro: When you stay at Hotel Otavalo, immerse yourself in the vibrant Andean culture by venturing into the surrounding indigenous communities. Just a stone's throw away from Otavalo lies La Compañía, nestled by the calm waters of San Pablo Lake. Here, you'll encounter a family deeply rooted in the art of traditional weaving, a practice passed down through generations.
postcards.story:
Step into the humble abode of a local weaving family and witness firsthand the intricate process of weaving on traditional looms. With skill and creativity, the family brings vibrant colours and intricate designs to life, crafting girdles that hold deep cultural significance. Each thread tells a story, preserving the ancestral knowledge and traditions of their people.

As you observe the rhythmic movements of the loom, you'll gain an appreciation for the dedication required to produce these exquisite fabrics. From the vibrant shades of the Imbabura to the majestic peaks of Cotacachi, every motif reflects the natural beauty and cultural heritage of the Andean landscape.

But the experience goes beyond just watching – it's an opportunity to engage with the artisans themselves, learning about their techniques, stories and traditions firsthand. Through interactive demonstrations and guided conversations, you'll delve into the richness of Andean culture, forging connections that transcend language barriers.

Traditional handlooms are more than just tools for weaving; they're vessels of cultural heritage and craftsmanship. Preserving them ensures the continuation of age-old techniques passed down through generations, maintaining cultural identity and economic sustainability for artisans. 

Handlooms also produce unique, high-quality textiles, promoting appreciation for traditional craftsmanship and contributing to the preservation of diverse weaving traditions around the world. As you explore the intricacies of traditional embroidery, you'll come to understand its importance in maintaining the identity and heritage of indigenous communities. 

From the delicate stitches to the vibrant patterns, each piece of fabric is a reflection of the resilience and creativity of the Andean people. Allow yourself to be moved by the beauty of Andean looms and leave with a deeper understanding of the rich cultural stories that define this corner of the world.

name: Jicaro Island Lodge
intro: Hidden away on Lake Nicaragua, this nine-casitas retreat is just a short boat ride from the Colonial City of Granada — with mind-blowing views of the Mombacho Volcano.

news_article.title: Jicaro Island Lodge is Your Private Island Getaway on Lake Nicaragua
news_article.description: An Island Retreat Committed to Sustainable Tourism in Nicaragua

postcards.name: Experience Island Accommodation at Your Own Private Island
postcards.intro: From the moment you arrive at Jicaro Island Lodge, you'll find yourself surrounded by the natural beauty of this island and the simple elegance of your surroundings. Whether you're enjoying a quiet moment on your private deck or exploring different corners of this beautiful lodge, every experience is designed with your relaxation and enjoyment in mind.
postcards.story:
Your Jicaro Island retreat offers a complete experience with its outdoor amenities, including a dining area and a private pool surrounded by plush towels, lounge chairs and sunbeds. Delight in outdoor living at the swim-up bar and lounge, or find peace on the yoga deck overlooking Lake Nicaragua. The Wellness Center provides lakeside views for relaxation, and the floating dock offers a unique perspective of the Mombacho Volcano. 

With nine luxury tree-house casitas, Jicaro Island comfortably hosts up to 21 guests. Your casita is a private, two-story retreat nestled under the cool shade of rainforest trees. Your accommodation boasts an airy upstairs bedroom and a spacious downstairs living area. Step out onto your waterfront deck each morning for a serene moment with your coffee and banana bread. As you spend your afternoon relaxing in your generously sized hammock, you’ll love swaying with the gentle breeze. 

Each casita is thoughtfully designed with lake views, a terrace featuring a large hammock, a king-size bed and a queen-size bed. The bathroom is equipped with organic bath amenities, and practical elements like mosquito netting and ceiling fans ensure your comfort. Enhancing your experience, the mini-bar offers a selection of local beer and rum, completing the thoughtful details of your Jicaro Island escape.

Designed by architect Matthew Falkner, Jicaro is crafted from trees felled by Hurricane Felix. Your casita and its furnishings are meticulously fashioned from tropical hardwoods. The smart design encourages natural ventilation, complemented by ceiling fans and tree-shaded areas, ensuring a comfortably cool retreat without the need for air conditioning.

During Jicaro's construction, great care was taken to preserve the island's character and lush vegetation. No large trees were cut, and boulders were left undisturbed, allowing you to experience the untouched beauty of the island during your stay.

postcards.name: Enjoy Lakeside Dining at Jicaro Island
postcards.intro: Picture yourself dining lakeside at Jicaro Island Lodge, where you’ll find yourself enveloped in the silence of the surroundings. As you savour each bite, the subtle breeze carries the essence of the water, enhancing the flavours of your meal. You can't help but be captivated by the immersive dining experience that stays with you long after your meal is over.
postcards.story:
Dining at Jicaro Island Lodge is a culinary journey, with fresh, locally sourced ingredients transforming each meal into a delightful exploration of flavours. From the open kitchen to your plate, every bite introduces you to the unique tastes of Nicaragua. The advantage of this dining experience lies in the calming atmosphere – it's a place where you can enjoy your food in a relaxed and peaceful environment. 

Immerse yourself in the heart of the island experience at Jicaro, where dining by the lake becomes a memorable experience. Jicaro Island believes in the transformative power of fresh, flavourful ingredients, turning even the simplest dishes into something extraordinary for you.

Your culinary journey begins with artisanal products sourced close to home, crafted into gourmet delights befitting a luxury private island paradise. Pull up a chair in the open kitchen, and you're in for a taste of what's cooking — an unforgettable culinary experience awaits you on their peaceful shores.

As you indulge in three daily multi-course, a-la-carte meals, along with delectable snacks and non-alcoholic beverages, prepare yourself to relish Nicaragua's finest flavours. At Jicaro Island, the masterfully designed a-la-carte menus cater to every palate, ensuring a memorable dining experience tailored to your preferences. Here, dining is about enjoying good food without the fuss, making every meal a memorable and satisfying experience for you.

Whether you're drawn to fresh fish; organic, sustainably sourced meats; or mouthwatering vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options, there's something for every discerning taste. And don't worry — your food allergies will always be accommodated, promising a dining adventure that's uniquely yours. So, when you decide to dine lakeside at Jicaro Island Lodge, you're choosing a setting that complements your meal with peaceful moments.

name: Senda Monteverde Hotel
intro: You love freedom and ease. You take your own sweet time and don’t mind the spare moments. You make every day count. And you make it all look effortless. We know you have many choices in where to stay in Monteverde, Costa Rica.

news_article.title: Experience Nature’s Charm at Senda Monteverde Hotel
news_article.description: Wilderness Adventures in Costa Rica's Cloud Forest

postcards.name: Zipline Through Virgin and Secondary Cloud Forest
postcards.intro: Monteverde, Costa Rica invites you to explore its cloud forest through the heart-pounding thrill of ziplining. This experience promises you a unique perspective of the cloud forest, revealing its secrets and breathtaking beauty. Cheer up for the ziplining adventure and let Monteverde be the backdrop for your next chapter of exploration and exhilaration.
postcards.story:
Monteverde emerges as a haven for those seeking bucket-list-worthy experiences, beautifully blending nature's wonders with exhilarating adventures. Recognised as the birthplace of ziplining, this destination boasts renowned cloud forests teeming with biodiversity and iconic suspension bridges that stand as the country's longest. Nestled in Costa Rica's tropical highlands, Monteverde ensures there's seldom a dull day, offering you a treasure of unique encounters with nature and adrenaline-inducing activities.

Brace yourself for miles of cables connecting multiple platforms, providing unimaginable views above the clouds. This adrenaline-packed escapade is not for the faint-hearted, ensuring an unforgettable experience for thrill-seekers looking to conquer the heights of Monteverde. The surroundings truly showcase the best of the natural world.

Amidst the lush ecosystems, Monteverde shelters some of the rarest wildlife globally, offering you a chance to encounter nature in its purest form. As you navigate the suspended bridges and traverse the canopies, be prepared to witness a vibrant tapestry of life, from elusive birds like bellbirds to exotic flora. If you’re a nature enthusiast, you’ll find solace in the untouched beauty that unfolds at every step.

If you’re planning for ziplining, a crucial packing tip ensures you're ready for both adventure and comfort. A water bottle is essential to stay hydrated amidst the tropical surroundings, while a light jacket, long pants and closed-toe shoes provide maximum comfort during your explorations. Monteverde's climate can be unpredictable, so being prepared for various conditions enhances your overall experience.

In the heart of Monteverde, you're not just going on a journey but also immersing yourself in a dynamic blend of nature and adventure. With each step, the destination unfolds its wonders, inviting you to experience the thrill of discovery and the serenity of nature's embrace.

postcards.name: Wake Up Fully Rejuvenated in the Superior Rooms
postcards.intro: The Superior Rooms at Hotel Senda Monteverde promise privacy, comfort and all the essential amenities characteristic of a luxury mountain lodge. Your room offers you sweeping views of amazing cloud forests. You’ll feel relaxed and rejuvenated in such serene settings. When you’re here, you’ll effortlessly infuse each moment with purpose and grace.
postcards.story:
The contemporary mountain bungalows at Senda Monteverde provide a diverse array of suites and rooms, strategically scattered across the property to offer you a unique experience. If you’re seeking an optimal balance between budget and experience, the Superior Rooms stand out. Discover complete relaxation at this contemporary mountain bungalow, ensuring you wake up rejuvenated and fully prepared to explore all that Monteverde has in store. 

These open-concept, studio-style rooms boast a generous 40 square meters of living space, ensuring a comfortable retreat for up to three adults. Comfort meets luxury as you immerse yourself in the ambience of Senda Monteverde, allowing you to allocate your budget towards indulging in the plethora of Monteverde activities.

The Superior Room design is tailored for functionality and style. Featuring a single, spacious area, these rooms comprise a king-sized bed and a sofa bed, accommodating various sleeping arrangements. Stay in a room surrounded by nature, where the green surroundings create a peaceful and beautiful atmosphere. 

To enhance your experience, each Superior Room includes a minibar and a living area with a single sofa chair, table and chairs – a thoughtful touch for relaxation. Step outside onto the small, open-air terrace attached to every Superior Room, providing a tranquil space to savour the fresh mountain air.

This thoughtful arrangement ensures that you enjoy not only the intimacy of your accommodation but also the serenity of your surroundings. Whether you choose to unwind on your terrace, marvel at the distant Gulf of Nicoya or find solace in the enchanting cloud forests visible from your window, Senda Monteverde invites you to make the most of your stay, making lasting memories amidst the natural beauty that surrounds you.

name: Hotel Aguas Claras
intro: Hotel Aguas Claras is for The Doers. Creators. The Thinkers. And Tinkerers. The ones who seek peaceful seclusion to make way for flashes of inspiration.

news_article.title: Hotel Aguas Claras is Your Private Oasis on Costa Rica's Caribbean Coast
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel Surrounded by Tropical Ambience

postcards.name: Go Biking in Punta Uva
postcards.intro: Exploring the beautiful coastal gem of Punta Uva is an adventure that combines two worlds – the charm of the Caribbean Sea and the lush beauty of the surrounding tropical landscape. Bicycling and kayaking are the perfect ways to unravel the secrets of Punta Uva. Both activities unveil the region's natural wonders in a way that is invigorating and serene.
postcards.story:
Going on a biking adventure in Puerto Viejo is an absolute must, creating an immersive experience where you can traverse the main road on their distinctive banana bikes. The charm of this coastal town lies not just in its vibrant culture but also in the ease with which you can navigate the mostly flat roads, smoothly connecting each picturesque beach. The rhythm of the bicycle wheels aligns with the laid-back pace of Punta Uva, allowing you to absorb the mesmerising views at your leisure.

A pinnacle destination on this cycling journey is the enchanting Punta Uva. This gem not only boasts one of the finest beaches in the region but also serves as the ideal starting point for kayaking expeditions up to the serene Eduardo Creek. 

The kayaking adventure is a gateway to a tranquil encounter with wildlife. As you silently glide through the water, the richness of the rainforest reveals itself. From the comfortable seat of your kayak, observe the river turtles, playful monkeys, graceful kingfishers and a myriad of other birds and animals. This tour remains somewhat under the radar, ensuring moments of solitude on the river, allowing you to fully absorb the peace and calmness of the rainforest.

For a refreshing interlude, don't forget your bathing suit when you arrive at Punta Uva beach. The inviting waters, warm and calm, present an idyllic spot for a leisurely swim, free from the intrusion of rocks or reefs.

As a delightful touch, take advantage of the complimentary bicycles provided. Feel the wind in your hair as you pedal your way to Punta Uva, enhancing the journey with a scenic bike ride. In this coastal haven, the blend of biking, kayaking and beachcombing crafts an unforgettable experience that embodies the true spirit of Puerto Viejo.

postcards.name: Enjoy the Gandoca-Manzanillo Refuge Jungle Hike
postcards.intro: Adventurers and nature enthusiasts find solace in Aguas Claras's commitment to sustainable tourism. Enjoying the breathtaking views of the forest canopy, hiking to hidden waterfalls or simply enjoying a peaceful walk in the jungle – every activity is a chance for you to connect with nature responsibly.
postcards.story:
Located within the breathtaking landscapes of Costa Rica, the Gandoca-Manzanillo Wildlife Refuge stands as a testament to the country's natural beauty. This refuge, situated in a region characterised by a humid tropical rainforest, plays a pivotal role in preserving diverse ecological habitats. Encompassing a 10-kilometre beach strip, a 740-acre forest, a coral reef and two swamps, Gandoca-Manzanillo safeguards rare ecosystems and provides a haven for some of the area's most endangered flora and fauna.

Notably, the primary lowland small rainforest within the refuge is a unique feature, unrivalled in the region. It hosts the only natural mangrove oyster beds along the coast's reefs and boasts the sole intact mangrove swamp on the Atlantic side. This pristine environment serves as a crucial nesting area for various species, including turtles, manatees, crocodiles, caimans, tarpons and dolphins. The refuge is teeming with a diverse array of wildlife, from pacas, tapirs and tarpons to frigate birds, woodpeckers, parakeets, eagles, pelicans, toucans and motmots.

The coral reef within the refuge is a vibrant habitat, home to an array of brightly coloured fish and marine life. From the blue parrotfish and angel fish to sea anemones, urchins, Venus sea fans, shrimps, oysters, sea cucumbers, lobsters and sponges, the underwater world here is a spectacle of biodiversity.

If you’re eager to explore this natural wonder, a four-and-a-half-hour tour awaits, guided by a Private Nature Guide. This expert companion will not only accompany you through the lush jungle but also assist in interpreting the myriad sights and sounds of the ecosystem. The journey promises ample opportunities for capturing the beauty of both beach and jungle landscapes, ensuring that every moment in Gandoca-Manzanillo is a memorable encounter with the natural wonders of Costa Rica.

name: Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge
intro: Perched 1,000 feet above the Pokhara Valley with a spectacular Himalayan backdrop, Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge provides a perfect haven, the essence of tranquillity. Ideal for guests pre- and post-trek, or for those wishing to take day walks exploring local communities, bird-watching, gentle exercise, or just to relax in a typical Nepalese rural setting.

news_article.title: Relax in a Nepalese Rural Setting at Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge
news_article.description: A Pioneer of Regenerative Tourism in Nepal

postcards.name: Experience the Essence of Tranquillity at Pokhara
postcards.intro: On the slopes of the mighty and majestic Annapurna range lies the gateway to the Himalayan dreams. Welcome to the Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge – a sanctuary that abundantly provides peace and tranquillity. This lodge is your pre-and-post-trek stopover home in a typical Nepalese rural setting. Leave your worries away; it’s time for a mindful stay!
postcards.story:
Located 1,000 feet above the Pokhara Valley, the Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge is a perfect haven for strong-hearted, nature lovers and soul seekers. Other than being your pre-and-post-trek stopover, you can also enjoy small hikes and day walks, explore local communities, bird-watching, gentle exercise, or simply relax in the company of the mighty Himalayas. Stationed on a ridge half an hour outside Pokhara, the lodge is at an ideal distance from the hustle and bustle of the city.

As the sun says hello to the valley with its first rays, the tallest of the peaks first absorb its warm greetings. While trekking enthusiasts journey to the heart of the Annapurna range, many paragliders enjoy flying with the chirping birds. It’s a sight to behold when both the paragliders and birds dance flawlessly to the rhythm of the breeze. As you walk on the ancient trails, you’ll come across the lesser-known villages and some breathtaking waterfalls.

At dusk, the air fills with the fragrance of fresh food cooked in the lodge. Guests gather around the bonfire under the vast sky full of twinkling stars. What an honour it is to celebrate Nepali culture and local cuisine! With the crackling of the fire, both the body and the spirit feel the warmth of this place. 

This boutique property places its core belief in tourism with a conscience and is a pioneer of regenerative tourism in Nepal’s hills. Being certified by GSTC affiliate Travellife with Gold Standard Audits, this property leads by example to promote sustainable tourism practices. Visiting this lodge will charge the mindful and responsible traveller in you and encourage you to make a lasting impact in the destination community.

postcards.name: Living Aesthetically and Sustainably at the Tiger Mountain
postcards.intro: Nepal is a place where high mountain peaks blend with ancient culture. The Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge is breathtaking and its aesthetic design will capture anyone’s heart at first sight. Its design is thoughtfully and mindfully curated showcasing the ancient art of Nepal. So, when you come here, you’ll surely take back tons of inspiration to design your home.
postcards.story:
Nepal’s astonishing landscape is crowned by Mount Everest, the highest summit in the world. The Annapurna Mountains welcome you to Pokhara – a place blessed by nature. The Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge represents a blend of traditional Nepali architecture and modern luxury. This boutique property promotes sustainable living and as you enter the rustic lodge, you will feel welcomed by the staff here. 

The architecture of the temples and stupas decorate the landscape with their intricate carvings. As you enter the lodge, you’ll realise that the beautiful front door is a gateway to one of the most beautiful sceneries you’ve ever seen in life – the peaks of Machhapuchhare.

Anyone would be easily convinced that the architecture of the lodge effortlessly integrates with the natural surroundings in Pokhara and is crafted with stone and wood. Built of hand-cut stone, all rooms in the lodge represent local carpentry and original artwork. The parquet floors and Tibetan rugs make it feel very welcoming and homely. Every window is a natural scenery that paints the valley, mountain ranges and fresh environment at Pokhara.  

All these glorious views are a sight to behold. As you walk in the lush gardens, you can only imagine how high the majestic peaks around are. Though you’ll feel small standing in front of these peaks, this experience will be transformational for you. 

You can enjoy the mesmerising views for as long as you wish as if the entire surroundings are exclusively made for you. At night, when everything gets dark around, a candle-lit terrace for dinner will make your heart feel delighted and warm. It is here that the stories from the valley echo with a diverse set of emotions – joy, courage, bravery, humour and love.

name: Neeralaya
intro: Located right on river Beas, Neeralaya is a very treasured piece of earth. Care has been taken to see that nothing disturbs the natural flow of life - be it in the way the resort is built, the way it functions or the facilities it offers.

news_article.title: Enjoy Breathtaking Scenic Views of the Himalayas at Neeralaya
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay Surrounded by Nature in Himachal Pradesh

postcards.name: Experience Life as it Should Be at Neeralaya in Himachal
postcards.intro: Imagine a home surrounded by apple and cherry trees and breathtaking views of the snow-clad Himalayan mountains. Sometimes, we should experience life exactly like this – simple, full of nature, plenty of fresh food and surrounded by good people.
postcards.story:
The homey, warm and full-of-love cottages will make you want to believe that life is best lived in the lap of nature. The ever-flowing water of the river Beas and the chirping of the birds serve as music to the ears. There’s a lot to experience at Neeralaya even if you do nothing: afternoon naps under a tree, meditating in the fresh air, enjoying the rustling sound of the leaves and listening to the bees. This is a lovely place to enjoy the beautiful Kullu Valley and open your heart to people who will be etched in your memories forever. 

Touching the walls of the cottages that are built using the age-old technique of timber-bonded architecture of the Western Himalayas will take you back in time. The fresh home-cooked food, simple natural attractions, local vernacular architecture and mesmerising views will make you feel at home. Many people come here for long stays, while some stop over on their journey to Spiti and Ladakh. Once you’re here, there’s a lot to soak in — the adventure of river rafting, trout fishing, mountain biking and some refreshing treks. 

Simple visits to the nearby local villages and walking in the apple orchard, especially during the harvest season (August-September), add to the authentic experiences. Of course, the locals never mind it if you lend a helping hand picking and sorting the apples with them. Happiness multiplies when our furry friends enjoy playing in the green grass all around. Imagine your favourite song playing in your ears, and the breeze flowing on your face — this is a feeling that will caress the soul forever. When city life becomes chaotic, remember that heaven is not far from the Earth.

postcards.name: Go for Solitary Walks in the Apple Orchards around Neeralaya
postcards.intro: Take a deep breath, close your eyes and inhale the fresh air of the Himalayas. As you slow down and soak up the meditative breeze, you’ll feel like you’re in heaven. And when you open your eyes, you’ll see that heaven is right in front of you. Welcome to Neeralaya!
postcards.story:
Kullu in Himachal Pradesh is a spiritual haven for those seeking peace and solitude. A stay at Neeralaya will not only offer you comfort but will give you the warmth of a sweet home — a sweet home surrounded by fruit trees, numerous natural alcoves and a breathtaking exhibition of the natural world. Many snow-clad peaks can be easily visible from this boutique property. The Kullu Valley, also called the ‘Valley of Gods’, is decorated with lush, green deodar and pine trees that blanket the mountain slope, giving an aesthetic touch to the snow-capped peaks. 

The sound of the Beas River flowing near the edges of Neeralaya soothes the soul. Once you’re at Neeralaya, you can never fall short of building new experiences. While you can always go for solitary walks, activities like white-water rafting and tree-house games are worth enjoying with friends and family. 

Full of thrill and adventure, white-water rafting in the chilling Beas River is not for the weak-hearted. But since life doesn’t always offer experiences twice, it is worth wearing that safety gear and jumping into an ever-shaking raft. Take the short three-kilometre stretch for beginners or a long 12-kilometre stretch for the adventurers – the choice is all yours. 

The apple orchard hike is one of the most fulfilling hikes around Neeralaya. This hike is the perfect way to witness life in the Himalayan villages of Kullu. As you walk through the meandering lanes of the village, you will notice juicy red apples decorated like ornaments on the trees all around. This day hike becomes even more special during the harvest season (August-September), when you can even hand-pick the apples and help the villagers with the packaging. This is indeed a fulfilling feeling!

name: Atali Ganga
intro: An oasis surrounded by Reserved Forest, Atali Ganga is a thorough privilege to be so close to nature. Come with the purpose of living in the valley of India’s holiest life force, the Ganga, for the call of barking deer, or the midnight roar of leopard ; and for that lovely dull ache after a busy day in great outdoors.

news_article.title: Experience Smart Hospitality and Safe Adventure at Atali Ganga
news_article.description: A Mindful Oasis in Rishikesh

postcards.name: Experience Peace and Adventure in the City of Sagas
postcards.intro: Welcome to the land of divinity and adventure. Ever been to a place where the river's melody is a constant companion? Echoing the reminder of its timeless journey, the river Ganga teaches us about the transient nature of life. When adventure and tranquillity intertwine seamlessly, is there something more that you can ask for?
postcards.story:
Every time you are in Rishikesh, the ancient hymns of devotion reverberate through the air, the sound of bells ringing from the temples, and the calming songs of the birds and the trees embrace the soul. Amidst the ashrams and the vibrant bazaars of Rishikesh, there’s plenty of room for introspection in every corner of the city.

The adventure begins with the first sight of Atali Ganga, majestically built on a hillside as if the mountains are holding it in their arms. Pump up your lungs with oxygen as you walk a series of steps to reach your cottage. Atali Ganga is one of the best places to sync with nature and experience both luxury and sustainability. Peaceful and relaxing stays entwined with adventure activities will leave a lasting impression on your heart and mind.

Right from the beginning, Atali was built on eco-conscious principles, ensuring minimal impact on construction and operations. Being surrounded by a reserved forest gives the privilege of staying very close to nature. The call of the barking deer, the roar of the leopard, endless chirping of the birds will convince you to be a responsible and mindful traveller – one that prioritises environmental protection and conservation. 

It’s a common sight to see people take a holy dip in the Ganges. However, if adventure is etched on your mind, you can enjoy river rafting, kayaking, yoga, wall climbing, mountain biking, hiking or even camping out for a night inside the property premises. Known as the world capital of yoga and meditation, the city of Rishikesh offers pleasant weather to its visitors all throughout the year.
