With scenic views and clean surroundings, this place is full of spiritual experiences and also provokes the adventurer in you. Mountains are calling, are you listening?

postcards.name: Witness the Ever-Flowing Ganga from the Cottages at Atali
postcards.intro: Rishikesh is more than its ashrams and vibrant bazaars. It has plenty of room for introspection in every corner of the city. The Ganga River sits centre stage not just in Rishikesh, but in the entire state of Uttarakhand. At Atali Ganga, you can enjoy the view of the Ganga while comfortably sitting in your room.
postcards.story:
The city of Rishikesh promises pleasant weather to its visitors throughout the year. Scenic views and clean surroundings often ignite the spiritual seeker in you and can also charge up your inner adventurer. 

The world knows Rishikesh as a hub of yoga and meditation and a destination for the Beatles. The city is also the biggest adventure holiday destination in India. Comfortably situated 30 kilometres from Rishikesh, Atali Ganga is located in the middle of a reserved forest, with more than 300 trees on the property. Atali is not just a leading hotel in Rishikesh but also offers and delivers one of the best and safest rafting experiences on the Ganga River.

The pitched roofs coloured in green sit like a hat on the head of the cottages. Nature beautifully holds Atali in its arms and caresses each cottage with warmth. The trees and plants around the cottages make this place look heavenly. 

There are many options available for choosing your cottage. You can book an entire independent cottage and embrace solitude, or you can book an interconnected unit, with two cottages connected internally. There’s also a duplex unit available with two independent cottages. Whichever cottage you choose, you’ll always find the river mirroring the beauty of the mountains whenever you step outside. 

It is true that many vacationers are now moving towards outdoor and open spaces and are moving past the conventional four-walled hotel holidays. But Atali is a whole new experience for the mind and the soul. With sustainable tourism as a core principle, this luxury property is inspiring in its design, operations and experiences.

name: Eremito Hotelito del Alma
intro: Eremito is the ideal place for those who realise that peace and quiet are essential ingredients to find inner peace. It’s a mystical place, fruit of a long journey of self discovery. The place is majestically located within Umbrian valleys, this amplifies the sense of spirituality enchanting the eyes and the soul.

news_article.title: Experience a Digital Detox and Spirituality at Eremito Hotelito del Alma
news_article.description: Start Your Profound Journey of Self-Discovery in Italy

postcards.name: Explore the Contemporary Hermitage for Solitary Travellers
postcards.intro: If you constantly feel like slowing down and taking a break from the everyday world, then solitude, space and freedom await you in Parrano, Italy. Silence is often louder than words and you’ll understand that solitary journeys have a transformational impact on us. Are you ready to seek peace and silence? Are you ready to meet yourself?
postcards.story:
Life goes on but it goes on well when we take breaks and reflect on our journeys. Italy has always been a sensory feast with art, culture, nature and cuisine beautifully amalgamating together. Imagine the aroma of fresh tomatoes, espresso and cheese; they naturally make you fall in love with Italy. But there’s another side to this charming and bubbling city – an Italy for the solitary souls and the peace seekers.

Eremito Hotelito del Alma is a unique and relaxing hotel where you can indulge in the regeneration of your mind, body and spirit. It’s a must-visit place for a complete digital detox. You can feel the pulse of history forever beating under your feet and all around you. This journey to self-discovery is very mystical and spiritually enlightening. 

Eremito is majestically located within the Umbrian valleys, which not only feeds the soul but satisfies the eyes too. It is said that a thing of beauty is a joy forever, but when beauty is all you can find around, all that is left is joy. This place constantly beckons your spirit and will evoke a strong inner calling within you. 

The rhythm of the Earth is best heard at the Eremito Hotelito del Alma. But what does the Earth really sing? It sings about the pristine forests, the symphony of the free birds, and the rustling of the trees. Even the passing clouds silently sing the best tunes you’ll ever hear. 


The greenery surrounding Eremito will automatically cancel out the noise of everyday life. The location of the hotel allows the natural surroundings to take centre stage and those searching for isolation will often find this hotel to be an incredible path to a self-transforming journey.

postcards.name: Visit Eremito for a 360-Degree Sensory Experience
postcards.intro: Our senses are the portals to experience life in totality. It’s when you start experiencing life in totality, the magic begins. Eremito is a unique place that will help you prioritise your harmony and well-being through a soulful experience. Being one of the first digital detox hotels in Italy, Eremito is a place for the discovery of the self.
postcards.story:
In today’s world, our life is dominated by screens and digital distractions. It’s time to savour some sensory experiences that make us feel alive and full of vibrance. Eremito Hotelito del Alma is comfortably nestled in the heart of Italy's lush Umbrian wilderness. It’s a hidden gem and is among the most recognised eco-hotels globally. Being one of the best abodes for solo travellers, one can find individual guests fully engaged in celebrating the richness of life. 

This boutique hotel features a wellness centre with a heated pool and steam bath. It is surrounded by a 3000-hectare Nature Reserve and will offer you the experience of a lifetime. Guests can even enjoy yoga sessions in the morning or meditation in the afternoon on special request. Blurring the boundaries between self and the surroundings, many guided walks are also organised to nearby areas.

Every mindful moment spent in Eremito takes us close to the profound beauty that exists in the simple things in and around this place. A stay in the contemporary hermitage is worth the experience and is beyond fascinating. Eremito is located in close proximity to hermitages of the fourteenth century which still retain their authenticity and originality. 

The hermitage at Eremito is restored in full respect of the original structure and is surrounded by delightful and soothing greenery. The carpet-like green grass spread across this boutique hotel feels soothing to the bare feet and calms down the mind. And when this grass is decorated with golden leaves in autumn, it feels like your feet are dancing to a crunching sound. 

The mesmerising Umbrian landscape will surely take hold of your senses and constantly surprise you with refreshing views. If you are a seeker of inner peace, then it’s time to rejuvenate your soul at Eremito.

postcards.name: Release and let go
postcards.intro: What better than starting a journey into our Self, than immerging the body into warm salty water
postcards.story:
The desire to come to Eremito goes hand in hand with a deep desire of calmness, serenity and quiteness. To achieve it in the mind, we shall start with the care of our body. This is what our relax area will do for you. A place to settle, restore and restart.
Our Relax Area is entirely dug out from rock. It is composed by a whripool tub with cromotherapy and a steam bath with vaulted stone ceiling . Here you can find an equilibrium for mind and body. It is place to unwind.

postcards.name: Embrace Digital Detox in Nature
postcards.intro:
The essence of our human being is so intertwined with the environment around us. How much to learn from Nature, and how much we tend to forget about it.
Eremito is meant to remember us this sacred connection. Contemplating the majestic landscape to recover our humanity.
postcards.story:
Eremito is an historic mansion located in the green heart of Umbria, historic cradle of Italian spirituality. This is the land and birthplace of Saint Francis of Assisi, a green and outstanding context where for hundreds of years till now the deepest aspects of life are contemplated. Eremito is an Hermitage nestled on top of a hill overlooking the uncontaminated valley of the river Chiani – a tributary of the Tiber River - surrounded by 3000 acres of natural reserve.
Ecology, Technology, Spirituality: these are the pillars of this Eco Luxury Historic Residence restored to its original splendor: the ideal place for solo travelers and couples, who aspire to spend a spiritual holiday in silence, in a stone building warm in winter and cool in summer, renovated with the modern green building techniques, but that fully reflects the atmosphere of the medieval monastery.
Eremito has been designed for the man of the third millennium, and its urgent need to re-establish a dialogue with himself, enjoying a full digital detox break, spending a few days in the luxury of silence and peace, enjoying the simple things that are the ones that make us feel really good. 18 small rooms - the "celluzze" - with French size bed, hand-sewn hemp sheets, and a special stone sitting by the window with view; a Refectory with fireplace for sharing meals; an ethnic Reading Room with large fireplace.
Gregorian chants are often played as background music. In the evening, the atmosphere becomes magical by the light of hundreds of candles and torches. A Cave and a Chapel are available for those that need an intimate place for meditation or prayer.
Eremito is also a Farmhouse: the ingredients of its veg monastic dishes come from the garden, the orchard, the garden of herbs.

name: Cabo Serai
intro: Situated on a secluded hill, a stone’s throw away from azure waters of Cabo De Rama beach lies Cabo Serai. In the heart of Southern Goa, overlooking the Arabian Sea, our eco-conscious resort sprawls over 14 acres of lush native trees. Perched at a height of over 100 feet, Cabo Serai is home to spectacular panoramic views of the ocean.

news_article.title: Book a Tryst with Goa’s Idyllic Tropical Seascape at Cabo Serai
news_article.description: A Paradise in Goa

postcards.name: Enjoy a Table for Two with Goa’s Tropical Views
postcards.intro: Cabo Serai's exclusive al fresco dining offers private experiences with sensational tropical backdrops, making it one of the most memorable gastronomic eco-destinations in Goa. The resort curates a highly customisable menu and food experiences, toasting to your health and special occasions-- birthdays, honeymoons or bachelorettes. Food here means sharing an intimate moment of privacy with nature or people you love.
postcards.story:
Enjoy an invigorating Exclusive Beach Breakfast after an early morning yoga or dip in the sea by the Cabo De Rama coast. Let turquoise waters, the immaculate skyline and the pristine white sands set the tone for a tranquil breakfast experience. The three-course menu has some delectable smoothies, homemade granola bars, pancakes, chaffles (waffles made of healthy millet grains), eggs-to-order and more.
 
Spend your afternoons lazing by a stream under cooling coconut plantations while savouring the vistas and freshly cooked Coconut Grove Lunch. The al-a-carte menu serves some noteworthy palatable choices - tuna biryani, semolina fried prawns, stuffed squids and even an organic ice lolly to beat the heat.
 
For travellers who prefer exclusive dining with breathtaking sunsets, the Exclusive Cliff End Sundowner offers a spectacular spot that conjures a perfect backdrop through the grasslands, just 20 minutes from the retreat.  
 
For those who want sober dining, the Hilltop Sundowner by the resort cliffside offers captivating sceneries with changing hues of the horizon and the sea, nestled from the comfort of palm groves. The Sundowner menu serves finger foods, liquor and cocktails with piquant local flavours. Quinoa bowls, Kokum drinks, homemade ales and ice creams, fish cutlets and sandwiches are must-tries.
 
A path illuminated by lights leads you to this exclusive space, set amidst foliage under a star-studded sky. 
 
Dinner On The Beach is a perfect dining option for any festive occasion, being the most visually mesmerising experience. A table set for two overlooks the post-sunset sky from the seashore; magically spaced lantern posts and candle-lit tables spread light and love across the sands, making way for an intimate or romantic setting.
 
Cabo Serai also provides private picnic experiences in the groves by the river or beachside, with dedicated staff to serve you.

postcards.name: Stroll along the Cabo Serai Heritage Walk
postcards.intro: Cabo Serai, the eco-inn perched by the pristine Cabo De Rama beach, offers more than an indulgence within its tropical surroundings. The resort's Heritage Walk experience introduces travellers to Goa in stark contrast to what it is otherwise known for— a commercial tourist and party destination. The region is home to precious Indian mythological, historical and cultural relics.
postcards.story:
Cabo De Rama Fort, one of the oldest forts in Goa, is a medieval structure that weathered many seasons under different rulerships. Cabo de Rama translates to Cape of Rama, the mythical hero-king from the Indian epic Ramayana. Legend has it that he and his consort Sita sought refuge here during their 14-year exile from his kingdom Ayodhya. The Hindu Sonda monarchs built the original structure, christening it after him-- Rama Kila. 

Under the rulership of the Portuguese in the mid-17th century, the military site was renamed Cabo de Rama. In the mid-20th century, when the British took over, it was used as a prison site.

Experience the surrealistic climate where Indian mythology and post-colonialism collide. Witness some antiquated engineering marvels that stood the test of time — the entrance bridge, the moat, the bastions, ramparts and turrets, the walls and the gatehouses, and half-buried rusty cannons. The fort also has a well, two springs and a large water tank and overlooks immaculate regions of the Arabian Sea; if you are lucky, you may spot some Indo-Asian humpback dolphins here.
 
Nearby is the much-venerated 18th-century neo-Gothic Church of St. Anthony, embodying the faith of local communities, in the miraculous presence of the saint. Legend has it that labourers were being menaced by a cobra while the church was under construction. After praying and placing St Anthony's statue in the church, they found the cobra caught in a cord held in the saint's hands. 

Enjoy sensational views of the coastline, rivers and surrounding hills from the Betul lighthouse, a short trek away from the fort. 
 
You may treat yourself to a cultural evening, indulging in a continental or traditional Goan feast at Tribe Goa in Agonda - a space dedicated to elevating sustainable innovations and artists and hosting soulful musical events.

name: Hotel Hacienda de Abajo
intro: In the historic centre of Tazacorte, on the island of San Miguel de La Palma, in a privileged setting surrounded by lush vegetation, you will find the Hotel Hacienda de Abajo. This emblematic hotel, the first in the Canary Islands, located in a former 17th-century sugar plantation and completely refurbished, consists of four buildings with years of history.

news_article.title: Soak Up the History of Hotel Hacienda de Abajo
news_article.description: On a former 17th-century sugar plantation in the Canary Islands

postcards.name: Visit the Organic Market in La Palma
postcards.intro: When you stay at Hacienda de Abajo, don’t forget to visit the organic market. As you navigate the vibrant streets of La Palma, let the map-brochure be your compass, guiding you to a world of organic abundance and environmental stewardship. Together, let's embrace the journey towards a greener, more sustainable tomorrow — one organic fruit and vegetable at a time.
postcards.story:
At the heart of La Palma's commitment to organic agriculture lies the Fundación Canaria Centro Internacional de Agricultura Biológica (CIAB). Teaming up with the Asociación de Productores y Consumidores de Productos Ecológicos de La Palma (Ecopalma), CIAB is spearheading a groundbreaking initiative to promote and develop organic farming practices across the island.

Their latest endeavor involves the publication and distribution of a comprehensive map-brochure, carefully outlining the various points of sale and services offered by organic operators throughout La Palma. This invaluable resource serves as a guiding light for eco-conscious consumers, empowering them to make informed choices that support sustainable agriculture and local economies.

At the helm of this visionary project is José Adrián Hernández Montoya, the esteemed Councillor for Agriculture and Vice-President of the Cabildo of La Palma. With unwavering dedication, Montoya champions the cause of organic consumption and marketing, recognising the pivotal role it plays in fostering a healthier, more resilient community.

Timed to coincide with the commencement of 2021, designated as the International Year of Fruits and Vegetables, the publication of this leaflet signifies a rallying cry for change. Montoya emphasises the importance of embracing local, seasonal and ecological produce, not only for its nutritional value but also for its positive impact on the environment and the local economy.

A digital version of the map-brochure will provide you with easy access to vital information but also offer flexibility for updates and revisions, ensuring that you have the most accurate and up-to-date resources at your fingertips.

By harnessing the power of technology and community collaboration, CIAB and Ecopalma are paving the way for a more sustainable future. Together, they are fostering a culture of conscious consumption, where every purchase becomes a vote for a healthier planet and a thriving local community.

postcards.name: Indulge Yourself in Wine Tourism
postcards.intro: Your wine tourism experience at Hacienda de Abajo promises an unforgettable journey through La Palma's vinicultural landscape. With each sip, you'll taste the dedication and passion of local winemakers, whose craftsmanship has garnered international acclaim. Whether you're a seasoned oenophile or a curious novice, wine tours and tastings offer insights into the artistry and tradition behind La Palma's finest wines.
postcards.story:
Go on an enchanting journey of discovery at Hacienda de Abajo, where every moment is a celebration of La Palma's natural and cultural treasures. As you tour the island, immerse yourself in its unparalleled beauty, from verdant landscapes to historic landmarks. However, it's in the island's vineyards and wineries that you'll find an experience truly beyond compare.

La Palma's unique geography and diverse climate have fostered the growth of small, artisanal vineyards and wineries, renowned for their limited yet exceptional wine production. Delve into the island's winemaking heritage, tracing its roots back to the arrival of the first vines in 1505, brought by the island's early settlers. Today, more than fifteen wineries proudly bear the Denomination of Origin La Palma, boasting an unmatched variety of grape cultivars.

Among these prestigious wineries lies Acero, nestled within the captivating surroundings of a millennial estate near the La Caldera Natural Park. Here, amidst meticulously selected grape varieties and optimal climate conditions, Acero crafts exquisite wines that reflect the essence of La Palma's terroir. Indulge in the rich flavours of Aceró Tinto, a blend of Vijariego, Castellana Negra and Baboso Negro grapes or savour the aromatic notes of Aceró Malvasía Aromatic Dry. Additionally, you’re invited to discover exclusive wines like Clarisimuss, available only at the esteemed Hotel Hacienda de Abajo.

Indulge in exquisite cuisine at the renowned restaurant, where locally sourced ingredients and innovative flavours come together to create culinary masterpieces. As the sun sets over La Palma, casting a golden glow upon the landscape, reflect on the beauty and bounty of this enchanting island. With each glass raised in toast, you'll not only savour the finest wines but also create lasting memories of a truly regal experience at Hacienda de Abajo.

name: Lockhart Bungalow
intro: Set amidst 1,500 acres of tea gardens, Lockhart Bungalow is your passport to a bygone era and perfect weather. Let the mist-kissed hills, soothing climate, and endless tea plantations rejuvenate your spirit.

news_article.title: Live the Planter’s Life at Lockhart Bungalow
news_article.description: Wake Up Amid the Misty Hills of Munnar’s Oldest Tea Plantation

postcards.name: Explore Tea-Making at One of Munnar’s Oldest Tea Factories
postcards.intro: For all passionate tea lovers, this guided tour of Munnar’s famous Lockhart Tea Factory and Museum is a rare opportunity to witness and even partake in their intricate manufacturing process. Discover the traditional methods and 150-year-old machines that transform hand-picked leaves into premium tea, culminating in a delicious tasting experience with freshly brewed leaves.
postcards.story:
Welcome to the first tea factory constructed by the British in 1936. Nestled amidst the sprawling Chokramudi hills, one of the highest peaks in South India, it offers visitors a captivating glimpse into the tea-making process that has stood the test of time.

Travelling along the verdant roads to the factory, you'll meet friendly tea pluckers with baskets on their backs and special shears in hand, skilfully selecting the finest leaves for your cup. Watching their handiwork deepens your appreciation for their labour and sets the stage for the fascinating tea-making journey ahead.

Inside the factory, steeped in century-old heritage, see how the estate’s Orthodox Tea is crafted, a process dating back to 1879. Follow the tea leaves as they are withered, rolled to release aromatic tea oils, oxidised, dried and graded. Watch in awe as all these meticulous steps are carried out using machines that are over 150 years old, infusing history into every processed leaf.

Step back in time at their museum, marvelling at traditional tools, as your guide shares stories of Munnar’s rich tea legacy. Saving the best for last, the tour ends with a delightful tea-tasting session, where you can savour the goodness of signature blends while your guide explains their nuances. And, if you’re craving more, simply purchase your favourite blend from the factory outlet to enjoy at home.

For a more immersive experience, pair your visit with a trail walk along the serene plantations. Here, you’ll have a memorable opportunity to interact with the plantation workers. Amidst the surreal scenery of misty greens, the locals teach you leaf-plucking techniques and indulge you in lively banter, connecting you to the culture and community of these tea heartlands.

postcards.name: Trek to the Great Heights of Chokramudi Peak
postcards.intro: The best way to soak in Munnar’s essence is by exploring its expansive tea plantations, rolling hills and vibrant flora and fauna. Experience all this and more on a thrilling sunrise trek to Chokramudi Peak, one of Munnar’s highest points. Starting near the Lockhart Gap, the lush trails and cool morning breeze welcome you to an unforgettable adventure.
postcards.story:
Slip into comfy shoes, pack your water bottles and essentials, and get an early start to scale the majestic Chokramudi hills, towering at an altitude of 2,250 metres. Your trek first leads you through emerald-green tea plantations that stretch as far as the eye can see. Let the rustling leaves and aromatic breeze, set against a backdrop of Annamalai hills, invigorate your senses and disconnect you from the worries of the world.

As you journey forward, you will witness the landscape transform into dense grasslands. These are dotted with rocky terrain and volcanic rock faces that pose a delightful challenge for both the novice and advanced trekker. Stroll under canopies of the evergreen shola forests, indigenous to the valleys of South Indian peaks, and let the fresh, earthy scent fill your lungs and soothe your soul.

With every step down the trodden trail, keep your eyes peeled for the biome’s natural inhabitants. Since this peak is nestled within the Eravikulam National Park, you might just spot gaurs; Asian elephants; and the rare Nilgiri tahr, an endangered species of mountain goat. These rolling hills are also home to exotic flora, such as the beautiful Neelakurinji flower, which is said to bloom once every twelve years. 

Throughout this trek, you will discover that the views only get more spectacular as you climb! Pause to chase waterfalls, sit by streams or simply admire Munnar’s breathtaking greenery as chirping birds serenade you. 

The final trail is slightly more challenging, but the effort is well worth it to witness the panoramic views around Chokramudi. Watch in awe as the day's first rays illuminate the magnificent Anamudi Peak ahead, South India’s highest peak; the glistening Idukki Dam; and picturesque tea estates. And perhaps, at this summit, you will understand what ethereal beauty truly means.

name: Bio Habitat Hotel
intro: Surrounded by more than 16,000 square meters of native forest, at the highest point of the mountain, you will find Bio Habitat Hotel, a place designed in harmony with the natural environment.

news_article.title: Embrace Sustainable Living at the Bio Habitat Hotel
news_article.description: A Responsible Luxury Hotel in Colombia

postcards.name: Join a Unique Bio Trail and Learn about Sustainable Tourism
postcards.intro: Going on a Bio Trail during your stay at the Bio Habitat Hotel offers you a unique opportunity to delve into the hotel’s sustainable practices and immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. As you traverse this trail, you'll gain insights into their innovative processes for managing organic waste and wastewater in an environmentally friendly manner.
postcards.story:
Picture yourself strolling along the winding path of a Bio Trail, surrounded by lush greenery and the soothing sounds of nature. Along the way, you'll encounter various stations where you can observe the sustainable initiatives in action. At the organic waste management station, you'll learn how the Bio Habitat Hotel utilises composting techniques to transform food scraps and other organic materials into nutrient-rich soil amendments. This closed-loop system not only helps reduce landfill waste but also contributes to the health of the ecosystem.

Continuing your journey, you'll come across the wastewater treatment area, where you'll discover innovative methods for purifying water without harming the environment. Through natural filtration systems and advanced technologies, the hotel ensures that the water discharged from their facility is clean and safe for the surrounding ecosystem.

But the Bio Trail offers more than just a glimpse into waste management practices. It's also a gateway to the self-sufficiency project through permaculture. As you explore the permaculture garden, you'll witness firsthand how sustainable farming techniques are integrated with ecological principles to create a productive landscape. From organic vegetable beds to fruit orchards, every element of the garden is carefully designed to maximise biodiversity and minimise environmental impact.

What could be a better way to leave your mark on the land than by participating in the tree planting initiative? At the reforestation station, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the recovery of the forest by planting a native tree. With each sapling you plant, you'll be helping to restore habitat for local wildlife, combat climate change and preserve the natural beauty of the surroundings.

By immersing yourself in eco-friendly initiatives and participating in hands-on activities, you'll not only gain valuable knowledge but also make a positive impact on the planet.

postcards.name: Explore the Charming Quindio Towns
postcards.intro: When you go on a journey to explore the charming towns of Quindío, located in the heart of Colombia's western central region, you're in for an unforgettable adventure. Picture-perfect facades greet you at every turn, each telling a story of the region's rich history and vibrant culture.
postcards.story:
As you make your way through the winding streets of Filandia, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of colour and charm. Admire the quaint architecture, adorned with bright hues that pop against the backdrop of lush greenery. Take a moment to stop by a local café and savour a cup of the finest Colombian coffee, brewed to perfection right before your eyes. The friendly locals will welcome you with open arms, eager to share their stories and traditions with you.

Venture into the enchanting town of Salento, where time seems to stand still amidst the breathtaking mountainous scenery. Lose yourself in the labyrinth of cobblestone streets, lined with artisanal shops and homey boutiques. You'll discover hidden gems around every corner, from vibrant street art to charming restaurants serving up mouthwatering local delicacies.

But the true highlight of your journey lies in the Cocora Valley, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that will leave you speechless with its natural beauty. Towering wax palm trees stretch towards the sky, creating a surreal landscape that feels like something out of a dream. Take a leisurely hike through the valley, breathing in the fresh mountain air and marvelling at the panoramic views that surround you.

After a day of exploration, retreat to the comfort of the Bio Habitat Hotel, your home away from home in the heart of Quindío. Unwind in your room, complete with modern amenities and breathtaking views of the surrounding countryside.

With its picturesque landscapes, rich cultural heritage and warm hospitality, Quindío is a destination that will capture your heart and leave you longing for more. So pack your bags, hit the road and get ready to go on the adventure of a lifetime in this charming corner of Colombia.

name: Entre Cielos Luxury Wine Hotel
intro: Tucked among the celebrated Malbec vines that have made Mendoza one of the world’s premier wine capitals is where you’ll find Entre Cielos Luxury Wine Hotel + Spa.

news_article.title: Live Your Best Life at Entre Cielos Luxury Wine Hotel
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel Where Wine Meets Wellness

postcards.name: Feel the Benefits of the Hamam Spa
postcards.intro: At Entre Cielos Luxury Wine Hotel, you'll discover a place where relaxation integrates with tradition. As you step into Latin America's first and only authentic traditional hamam, you go on a journey of rejuvenation. Here, amidst the magnificence of Luján de Cuyo, Argentina's renowned wine-producing region, immerse yourself in the age-old Turkish rituals of cleansing and relaxation.
postcards.story:
Picture yourself unwinding in homey rooms, where the perfect balance of high temperature and humidity creates a sanctuary for your body and mind. With each circuit through the hamam, you'll feel the toxins of everyday life melting away, leaving you refreshed and revitalised. The deep penetration of heat detoxifies both tissues and cells, stimulating your metabolism and inducing a state of blissful relaxation.

The hamam experience transcends mere pampering — it's a timeless ritual that has been cherished by Eastern cultures for centuries. Here, both men and women come together to purify and relax their minds, bodies and souls. It's a communal gathering, a shared moment of tranquillity where the stresses of the outside world fade into insignificance.

In the ancient Arabic language, ‘hamam’ simply means heat, but within these walls, it signifies so much more. Each stage of the hamam journey envelops you in warmth, from the gentle humidity to the soothing steam and carefully controlled temperatures. As your body absorbs the heat, you'll feel a profound connection between your physical and spiritual selves.

But the indulgence doesn't end there. Entre Cielos believes in harnessing the restorative power of wine, right at the heart of its production. The exclusive grape-based treatments offer you a unique mix of luxury and wellness, using grape seeds and extracts to soothe and protect your skin. As you indulge in these rejuvenating therapies, you'll emerge feeling invigorated, ready to relish every moment of your stay in this enchanting corner of Argentina.

At Entre Cielos Luxury Wine Hotel, the spa experience is a journey of self-discovery, celebration of the senses and a tribute to the timeless traditions that enrich our lives. Come and treat yourself to a getaway that promises not only relaxation but also a deeper connection to yourself and the world around you.

postcards.name: Choose the Two-Night Sereni Treat Offer
postcards.intro: Imagine escaping to Entre Cielos Luxury Wine Hotel for Sereni Treat, a two-night retreat designed to nourish your body, mind and soul alongside that special someone in your life. During your stay in a Vineyard Loft or Superior Room, you'll wake up to picturesque views and enjoy a delicious daily breakfast, setting the perfect tone for your day ahead.
postcards.story:
From the moment you arrive for the Sereni Treat, you'll be welcomed with a refreshing drink, setting the stage for a truly unforgettable getaway. Dive deeper into the world of wine with a tasting class, where you'll learn to appreciate the nuances of Argentina's renowned vintages, enriching your stay with a deeper understanding of local culture and traditions.

Whether you choose to indulge in a three-course dinner or lunch, every bite will be a celebration of local flavours and culinary expertise, shared with your loved one in an intimate setting.

But the highlight of your Sereni Treat awaits at the Spa Hamam, where you'll go on a couple's vinotherapy experience. Picture yourselves enveloped in the soothing warmth of the hamam, as grape-based treatments work their magic, leaving your skin glowing and your spirits lifted. It's a sensory journey unlike any other, a moment of pure bliss shared with the one who means the most to you.

Back in your room, a complimentary bottle of wine awaits, inviting you to unwind and relish the moment together. Indulge in the convenience of a Nespresso coffee maker with unlimited capsules, ensuring that each morning begins with the perfect cup of coffee enjoyed at your leisure. And when you're in need of refreshment, complimentary infusions, bottled water and beverages are always at your fingertips.

To further enhance your well-being, embrace the tranquility of a yoga class, where you can stretch, breathe and find inner peace amidst the beauty of the vineyards. It's a chance to connect with yourself and each other, deepening the bond you share and creating memories that will last a lifetime. Treat yourselves to a getaway that promises relaxation, rejuvenation and moments of pure serenity.

name: Parador Nature Resort & Spa
intro: Internationally recognized as one of Costa Rica’s most prestigious resorts, Parador Nature Resort & Spa is the epitome of “responsible luxury.”

news_article.title: Immerse in a Soul-Searching Experience at Parador Nature Resort & Spa
news_article.description: Connect with Costa Rica’s Nature

postcards.name: Relax on the White Sand Beaches of Costa Rica
postcards.intro: Located within the charming embrace of Parador Nature Resort & Spa lies an invitation to immerse yourself in the unparalleled beauty of Costa Rica's pristine white sand beaches. As you step onto the soft, powdery sands, you're greeted by nature's melodies and an abundance of breathtaking views that stretch as far as your eyes can see.
postcards.story:
Amidst the lush landscapes of Parador's surroundings, nature trails invite you, weaving through forests adorned with an array of precious woods and countless varieties of fruit trees. These trails offer you a sanctuary for both flora and fauna, where vibrant ecosystems thrive in harmony. As you wander along these paths, you'll find yourself enveloped by the sights and sounds of the wilderness, encountering the beauty of Costa Rica's diverse wildlife.

Venturing further, the coastline unfolds before you in all its magnificence, the beauty of white sand beaches that stretch for miles along the sun-kissed shores. These pristine expanses, framed by the turquoise colour of the Pacific Ocean, offer an idyllic retreat if you’re seeking solace and serenity. Whether you're drawn to the thrill of surfing, the tranquility of sunbathing or the exhilaration of kayaking and parasailing, these beaches cater to your every desire.

Here, time slows to a gentle rhythm, allowing you to surrender to the soothing flow of the sea breeze and the rhythmic sound of the waves. As you bask in the warm glow of the sun, the cares of the world melt away, replaced by a profound sense of peace and contentment. These beaches, with their unspoiled beauty and timeless allure, offer a sanctuary for your soul, where you can reconnect with nature and find renewal amidst the beauty of the natural world.

Parador Nature Resort & Spa understands the profound connection between humanity and the environment and they strive to honour and preserve the precious surrounding ecosystems. Through sustainable practices and a deep respect for the land, they ensure that future generations can continue to experience the beauty of Costa Rica's natural treasures.

Come and escape the ordinary. It's time to reset your body and soul amidst the wonders of Costa Rica's white sand beaches.

postcards.name: Enjoy the Views of Nature and the Pacific Ocean
postcards.intro: Welcome to Parador Nature Resort & Spa, where luxury meets responsibility in the heart of Costa Rica's nature. As you step into this haven of peace, you're greeted by the breathtaking beauty of the Pacific Ocean stretching endlessly before you. Perched majestically on the Punta Quepos promontory, this resort offers a vantage point like no other.
postcards.story:
Parador Nature Resort & Spa offers you panoramic views of the pristine Pacific Ocean and the delightful sunsets that paint the sky over Manuel Antonio National Park. Here, amidst 12 acres of lush rainforest teeming with wildlife, you'll discover a sanctuary for the soul, a place where you can immerse yourself in the wonders of nature and reconnect with the essence of Costa Rica's untamed beauty. 

The grounds of Parador Nature Resort & Spa are alive with the vibrant energy of the rainforest, home to a myriad of species, from playful monkeys and sloths to colourful birds such as macaws, hawks and toucans. As you wander through the verdant gardens and forested trails, you'll find yourself amid the vibrance of life, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the natural world.

But it's not just the physical beauty of the surroundings that will captivate you; it's the profound sense of peace and tranquility that permeates the air, filling you with a sense of calm and serenity. Spending time in nature has a remarkable impact on the mind, allowing you to escape the stresses of daily life and find solace in the simple pleasures of existence. 

Whether you're gazing out at the endless expanse of the Pacific Ocean or listening to the gentle rustle of leaves in the forest, each moment spent in nature nourishes the spirit and rejuvenates the soul.

Parador Nature Resort & Spa believes in the transformative power of nature and its ability to heal, inspire and uplift. As you go on your journey of self-discovery amidst the unique offerings of Costa Rica's natural wonders, you'll find yourself renewed and invigorated, ready to enjoy life with a renewed sense of purpose and passion. Your adventure begins here!

name: Algodón Mansión
intro: Located in the heart of Buenos Aires’ most elegant residential neighborhood, Recoleta, Algodón Mansión is a beautifully restored luxury boutique design hotel dating back to 1912.

news_article.title: Immerse in Pure Relaxation at the Algodon Mansion
news_article.description: The Finest Boutique Hotel in Argentina

postcards.name: Stay Fit at the Deporte Total Fitness & Health Studio
postcards.intro: When you choose to stay at Algodon Mansion in Buenos Aires, Argentina, you're not just selecting a place to rest your head but also choosing a lifestyle that prioritises your well-being and vitality. As a guest of this esteemed hotel, you'll have the exclusive opportunity to join Deporte Total Fitness & Health, located just a block away.
postcards.story:
Imagine starting your day with a refreshing yoga session or invigorating group fitness class, all included as part of your complimentary membership. At Deporte Total, you'll discover six floors of modern facilities designed to elevate your fitness journey to new heights. From state-of-the-art Cybex and Universal machines to stationary bikes, stair climbers and free weights, every tool you need to achieve your fitness goals is at your fingertips.

But the benefits extend far beyond physical exercise. Engaging in regular fitness activities not only strengthens your body but also enhances your overall well-being. As you push yourself to new limits, you'll experience a rush of endorphins that leave you feeling energised and revitalised, ready to tackle whatever the day may bring.

Moreover, prioritising your fitness and health while travelling allows you to maintain balance in both body and mind. Amidst the excitement of exploring a new destination, it's easy to neglect self-care, but taking the time to nurture your physical and mental health is essential for a fulfilling travel experience. By joining Deporte Total Fitness & Health, you're investing in yourself, ensuring that you return home feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.

After your workout, indulge in the modern changing rooms, spacious showers and individual lockers provided by Deporte Total. Take a moment to pamper yourself and reflect on your accomplishments, knowing that you've taken a proactive step towards a healthier, happier you.
Here, true luxury encompasses not only opulent accommodations and exceptional service but also a commitment to your well-being. By receiving complimentary access to Deporte Total Fitness & Health, you’re empowered to prioritise your fitness journey while immersing yourself in the vibrant energy of Buenos Aires.

Come and seize the opportunity to enhance your stay and elevate your fitness routine. Your body and mind will thank you for it.

postcards.name: Feel the Magic of Romance on a Wedding Night Package
postcards.intro: Experience the epitome of luxury and romance at Algodon Mansion in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Nestled in the heart of the charming Recoleta neighbourhood, this lovely hotel offers an unforgettable experience for couples seeking elegance and intimacy on their special day.
postcards.story:
Imagine beginning your honeymoon journey in the most luxurious setting imaginable. From the moment you step through the doors of Algodon Mansion, you'll be greeted with warmth and hospitality, setting the stage for a truly memorable stay. As you go on this new chapter of your life together, Algodon Mansion provides the perfect romantic hideaway, where every detail is carefully curated to ensure your comfort and satisfaction.

Choosing the Wedding Night package is more than just booking a room. With this package, you’ll embrace a once-in-a-lifetime experience that will leave you with cherished memories for years to come. From the moment you arrive, you'll be enveloped in an atmosphere of love and celebration. Picture waking up to the soft glow of sunlight filtering through the windows of your luxurious suite, surrounded by the one you love.

Indulge in breakfast à la carte, served in the privacy of your suite, as you relish in the joy of being newlyweds. As a token of greetings, you'll receive a special welcome gift, adding an extra touch of magic to your stay. Fresh-cut flowers adorn your suite, filling the air with their sweet fragrance, while late checkout ensures you have ample time to relish every moment together.

Throughout your stay, you'll discover why Algodon Mansion is ranked among the best luxury hotels in the world. Here, the dedication to excellence is evident in every aspect of your experience, from the impeccable service to the exquisite accommodations. Whether you're walking through the nearby parks and green spaces or exploring the city's vibrant culinary scene, you'll find that Algodon Mansion serves as the perfect home base for your adventures.

Feel pampered as you begin a new chapter together with your partner, surrounded by warmth, elegance and the unmistakable ambience of romance.

name: Rajmahal Palace RAAS Jaipur
intro: Rajmahal Palace is an opulent heritage residence turned luxury hotel that provides some of Jaipur’s most sumptuous experiences. The hotel is eclectically decorated, combining old-world culture with a contemporary style. It’s best known for its scrumptious food at both the Polo Bar and 51 Shades of Pink. There’s also a palatial spa.

news_article.title: Delve into Mindful Luxury at the Rajmahal Palace in Jaipur
news_article.description: Journey Back into Rajasthan's Rich History

postcards.name: Experience Boutique Luxury at Rajmahal Palace in Jaipur
postcards.intro: Proudly located in the heart of Jaipur, Rajmahal Palace stands as a witness to centuries of history. For a mindful luxury traveller like you, this regal abode gently unveils its timeless charm, inviting you to go on a journey through history. Ready to hear stories of royalty and opulence?
postcards.story:
In its aged splendour, Rajmahal Palace tells the story of Rajasthan’s past, inviting you to step back in time and revel in the nostalgia of royal history. Here, you'll discover a collection of 13 exquisite rooms and suites, including two splendid Royal Apartments. Each of these spaces seamlessly combines classic and contemporary design, creating a harmonious blend of Indian Art Deco that's both captivating and comfortable. As you step into the heritage-laden halls, you'll find a seamless blend of opulence and serenity tailored just for you. 

Located within the palace's lush gardens, you'll find a magnificent and tranquil oasis. The Art Deco-style swimming pool, a true gem, invites you to unwind in style. And as you stroll through the palace, the walls come alive with the tales of Jaipur, the 'Pink City', offering a unique and romantic retreat that exudes an unmistakable sense of luxury.

This is a place where you’ll be offered some of Jaipur's most indulgent experiences. The hotel's decor is a delightful fusion of old-world charm and modern elegance, creating a unique and eclectic ambience. You'll also get to savour the exquisite flavours of Jaipur at The Bar and 51 Shades of Pink, appreciating the local cuisine and its authentic preparation. 

The understated elegance of the rooms and suites provides a comfortable sanctuary, allowing you to unwind and immerse yourself in the rich history that surrounds you. In the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jaipur, you have the opportunity to delve into the city's vibrant culture and then come back to the serenity of Rajmahal Palace. Your stay here is more than a luxurious getaway; it's a thoughtful retreat crafted to meet your desire for true relaxation and cultural immersion.

postcards.name: Relax in a Mindfully Luxurious Maharani Suite
postcards.intro: At the Maharani Suite, your accommodation experience is more than just a place to rest; it's a gateway to heart of royalty. The suite has been thoughtfully designed with your comfort in mind. You'll find spacious and well-appointed spaces, ensuring that you have all amenities you need during your stay. Come and experience what it means to live like queen.
postcards.story:
When it comes to accommodation at Rajmahal Palace, including the Maharani Suite, it's all about ensuring that you feel truly at ease. The palace offers 13 rooms and suites, each varying in size to ensure your comfort is always a priority. Every room and suite is thoughtfully furnished with a blend of family heirlooms and modern pieces. 

You'll find ample space and all the luxury amenities you need for a comfortable stay here. With this diverse range of options, there's sure to be a room that perfectly suits your preferences. The Maharani Suite, in particular, offers a serene and regal atmosphere, inviting you to unwind in style, with its unique charm and modern comforts. If you appreciate the balance of tradition and luxury, this is the right place for you to be. 

You'll find a generously sized master bedroom, a connected sitting room leading to a dressing area, a modern ensuite bathroom, a dedicated private dining space, a fully equipped service kitchen and an impressive entrance hall. As you settle into your room, you'll discover a seamless blend of heritage and modern convenience. From the moment you step inside, you'll feel at home, with all the essentials, from high-speed Wi-Fi to a well-stocked minibar, ready for your enjoyment.

To make your stay even more convenient, double doors open onto a private veranda with a refreshing plunge pool, perfect for your relaxation or entertainment. You'll find a well-appointed bathroom with both a bathtub and a walk-in shower, complete with bath salts for your relaxation. 

What also sets this experience apart is the provision of a dedicated private butler throughout your stay, ensuring your every need is promptly met. It's an all-encompassing experience, designed to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible.

name: Brunton Boatyard
intro: Stepping into Brunton Boatyard is like stepping into the distillery of history. The hotel imbibes the many influences that have made Fort Cochin what it is today and takes you back to another time, another space.

news_article.title: Rediscover the Architectural Splendour of Kochi’s Past at Brunton Boatyard
news_article.description: A Beautiful Heritage Stay in Kerala

postcards.name: Relish Culinary Offerings at Fort Kochi’s Historic Harbour
postcards.intro: The culinary offerings at Brunton Boatyard are a gourmet exploration of the region's rich heritage. Being a spice paradise, Kerala has attracted food lovers from around the world. A variety of fresh seafood and traditional idiyappam will add magic to your culinary experiences. Savour your food on a pier overlooking Kochi’s historic harbour.
postcards.story:
At Brunton Boatyard, you’ll hear plenty of stories of how the Portuguese came to trade in spices but left behind the Indian red chilli. The food here is inspired by the cultural diversity of this region. The Syrian Christian community cooked up a variety of pork and other dishes that went well with the native idiyappam or string hoppers. The Jews of Cochin found coriander delicious and used it in a variety of preparations, while the Dutch noticed that their puddings took on a whole new flavour with a pinch of fresh cinnamon.

You’ll feel excited to see a variety of dining options. If you’re here with your partner, you can dine at the pier overlooking Kochi’s historic harbour. It’s a perfect place for a romantic meal and for enjoying great food at dusk with a view of the Arabian Sea.

You can even dine at the Armoury restaurant, where the interior walls are adorned with guns and various weaponry. Stop here in the evening for a quick snack, and sit at the waterfront watching the sun dip below the horizon. Interestingly, one of the best dining experiences you’ll have is at the History Fine Dining, where the menu includes 32 cuisines from all the communities that have made Fort Kochi their home. Here, you can journey through the influences that shaped Kerala's cuisine, sampling delectable dishes infused with local spices and flavours. 

One of the most distinctive local dishes served here is the Railway Mutton Curry. Even the chef recommends it! Tasting this unique recipe invented by the Anglo-Indian community of Fort Kochi feels heavenly. Come and savour the spices, idiyappam, coconut milk and fresh seafood – all prepared with love for you!

postcards.name: The Architectural Splendour of Fort Kochi's Colonial Past
postcards.intro: Brunton Boatyard is a waterfront hotel full of colonial history. Revel in the architectural splendour of Fort Kochi, a restored Victorian shipyard that rests peacefully on scenic Cochin Harbour.
postcards.story:
Ever been to a boutique hotel that was once a busy boatyard? Brunton Boatyard is full of historical stories waiting to be shared with mindful travellers like you. When you step inside this former British shipyard, you’ll experience the ambience, amenities, service and food of a truly luxurious haven. 

Kerala has been a spice paradise since time immemorial. Many great trading houses of British India were established here. This was a time when pepper from Kerala was considered as precious as gold. Every moment spent inside the colonial walls of Brunton Boatyard transports you to an era when the British Empire's trade ships docked along the Malabar Coast. 

Its wooden beams, arched doorways and antique furniture are simply a masterpiece of design and architecture. The splendid walls and ceilings smell of nostalgia and whisper tales of the trade that once flourished in abundance here. You’ll notice the interiors reflect an eclectic but tasteful blend of English, Portuguese and Dutch influences. High ceilings, hanging fans and rare artefacts evoke grandeur and glamour. 

The lounge is reminiscent of the days of the British Raj, with its lofty ceiling and old-fashioned 'punkhas' or fans. Your room is a luxurious cocoon with an antique four-poster bed, vintage furniture and handcrafted artefacts. 

While the vibe of this place is vintage and colonial, its modern amenities ensure a comfortable stay. Capture scenic views of the sea or the lush gardens from your room and notice how each view is a living postcard that captures the essence of Fort Kochi.

name: Suryagarh
intro: When your soul searches for nourishment, the universe answers with wonder. One such place is the elemental Thar Desert, a place of freedom and of discovery with a calming silence around, and the starry heavens above.

news_article.title: Embark on a Journey of Serene Luxury at Suryagarh
news_article.description: A Regal Gateway to the Thar Desert in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Suryagarh — A Gateway to the Thar Desert
postcards.intro: Rajasthan abounds with rare and unique experiences that travellers seek. The rippling sea of golden sand stretches seemingly forever. Why bother thinking about other colours when shimmering gold welcomes you in the Golden City of India?
postcards.story:
In the historic, golden city of Jaisalmer, every view is cinematic. It offers an unparalleled travel experience for those who come to witness its charms. Spreading across the city is the beautiful Thar Desert — a peaceful haven of golden sand drifting and dancing throughout the day, and starry skies blinking at night. 

It’s a cherry on top when we live moments that feed our souls and when old traditions fuse with contemporary comforts. Suryagarh stands boldly right at the edges of the Thar, carefully preserving the culture and traditions of the past and reimagining travel experiences for modern times. 

One of the best luxury hotels in Rajasthan, Suryagarh recites its endless tales through the beautiful carvings on its walls. As you walk through its corridors, you can almost feel the echoes of laughter and the footsteps of those who once wandered here. From heritage rooms to a grand haveli, every unique accommodation welcomes you warmly, which will make you believe that home is not just about the four walls — home is a feeling. 

What more? Don a traditional Rajasthani pagdi or a colourful ghagra-choli amidst the endless golden backgrounds, and feel beautiful both inside and out.

A walk on the trails of the Thar will be an unforgettable experience, as you’ll often find yourself surrounded by people sharing stories, local traditions and beliefs. In fact, not just people, but twinkling starry skies often descend over the desert to whisper the stories they have witnessed over many centuries.

postcards.name: Witness the Spellbinding Traditions of the Thar
postcards.intro: History and nature blend seamlessly in Jaisalmer to create a landscape filled with gold – the golden sand of the Thar Desert. Delve deeper into the spellbinding traditions of the Thar and enjoy the performance of Manganiyars every evening at Suryagarh. Here’s a splendid gateway to the Thar that will nourish your soul to the fullest.
postcards.story:
The starry night sky watches over the majestic Suryagarh as it boldly stands on the edges of the Thar Desert. As the sun sets in Jaisalmer, it paints the entire city and the Thar in hues of gold and amber. Suryagarh, too, gets soaked in the golden hour in the evening enhancing its vibrance.

Horse riding at Suryagarh is an in-house activity around the property and the undulating landscapes. The three steady and dependable horses in the stable will befriend you and share with you stories of the valour of the Maharajas of Jaisalmer. 

There’s something special about this place. As you stand near the outer walls of the hotel, you will notice the sand dunes come to life with hues of orange and gold. This is indeed a breathtaking display of nature that captivates the soul. 

Camels have always been the showstoppers in the grainy desert, giving you the experience of an enthralling safari. As you go on a safari, you’ll notice the camel's rhythmic gait carrying you over the dancing sands.

Suryagarh also provides space for you to engage in archery or dhanurveda. Archery was once an important hunting and military skill before the advent of gunpowder. The Maharajas and their military were well-equipped with archery and other combat skills. This boutique property offers archery as a combat recreational activity that gives you a high adrenalin rush. You can even enjoy your own personalised space, allowing for marksmanship, shooting technique and form.

Suryagarh, along with the Thar Desert, beckons adventurers and dreamers alike to show you the hidden treasures of history, culture and nature. These magical treasures will convince you to come back to this splendid landscape and dip into the symphony of India’s heritage and traditions.

name: Karan Mahal
intro: The Karan Mahal estate and villa which was constructed in the 1920’s is located on a saddle at the foot of the Shankaracharya Hill on Gupkar Road, Srinagar.

news_article.title: Experience Regal Elegance at Karan Mahal
news_article.description: A Heritage Stay in Kashmir

postcards.name: Bask in Old-World Charm at Karan Mahal
postcards.intro: In a world that often races forward, Karan Mahal stands as a beacon of the past, inviting travellers to step back in time and bask in old-world charm. Come, let us explore the nostalgic allure of Karan Mahal, where history whispers through every corridor,  and tales of former glory await discovery.
postcards.story:
Nestled in the heart of Srinagar, Karan Mahal presents itself as an ode to the enduring charm of old-world splendour. The exterior of this heritage property immediately captures your attention, showcasing colonial architecture that stands in elegant contrast to the surrounding natural beauty. The lush manicured gardens encompassing the property further enhance its allure, creating a serene oasis of tranquillity amidst the bustling city. 

Stepping through the grand entrance, you are welcomed into a realm where history unfolds in a rich tapestry—think antique mirrors, embossed leather partitions, vintage English washbasins and unique Lalique lights. The expansive rooms and private chambers boast meticulously crafted khatamband (wooden ceilings), exemplifying the unparalleled craftsmanship for which Kashmir is celebrated. Majestic chandeliers illuminate the rooms, casting a radiant glow on the plush furniture and furnishings.

Karan Mahal offers only eight accommodations, comprising five rooms and three suites, each brimming with unique charm and character. The walls adorned with beautiful artwork showcase the cultural heritage of Kashmir. Luxurious draperies, elegantly upholstered furniture and fine hand-knotted rugs introduce levels of sophistication and comfort, enticing you to indulge. Two of the suites come with private balconies, while another suite grants exclusive access to the expansive lawn. All eight luxurious guest rooms offer breathtaking views of the Zabarwan and Pir Panjal ranges, orchards and Dal Lake.

Beyond its architectural magnificence and luxurious accommodations, this royal residence in Srinagar offers an experience that transcends mere hospitality – it is a journey into the pages of history, where the magic of the glorious past comes to life in every detail. For those seeking a retreat that gracefully blends luxury and heritage, Karan Mahal is the ideal getaway in the heart of Srinagar.

postcards.name: Relish Diverse Culinary Flavours at Karan Mahal
postcards.intro: Dining at Karan Mahal is a regal experience that goes beyond mere culinary indulgence. Here the artistry of the chefs transforms dining into a symphony of flavours, where each meticulously crafted dish whispers the grand history of the culinary legacy embedded in the heart of the region. Come, let us explore this space!
postcards.story:
Dining at Karan Mahal is no less than a royal affair. Serving a noteworthy and fine selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian fares, the culinary experience transcends mere gastronomy, as most recipes have been passed down through generations. The culinary offerings include Dogra cuisine on certain days, Nepali dishes on others, and of course, Kashmiri cuisine is a given.

Try khatta meat, a favourite dish of the Dogri community of Jammu. The distinctive sour flavour of the khatta meat comes from the use of aamchoor (dry mango powder). Vegetarians can relish Nepali dal or Maas ko dal, a richly flavoured dish that is blackened through the use of an iron pot and infused with the distinctive aroma of the Himalayan herb jimbu. 

Other notable offerings at Karan Mahal include Nepali aloo, goat yakhni (the yakhni tastes of tradition) and gucci pulav featuring the rare morel mushroom. Another noteworthy surprise in this pulav is the use of rare zeerish berries of Kashmir. 

Certainly, the colonial influence on the Karan Mahal kitchen is undeniable, given that the delectable cheese souffle and strawberry tart are as authentic as those found at Ole & Steen in Richmond-on-the Thames. Other items include modern options like chicken roulade and avocado-pomegranate salad, featuring in-house-grown greens and grilled trout. 

The property is surrounded by orchards that produce a variety of fruits including apples, apricots, cherries and strawberries, which find their way to the dining table in the form of homemade jams, chutneys and marmalades.

In essence, Karan Mahal offers not just a meal but a journey through time and taste, making it a destination where culinary excellence meets cultural heritage.

name: Hartstone Inn
intro: Those who are looking for a traditional northeast escape will love the Hartstone Inn in Camden, Maine. A short walk from the ocean, this tradition-filled Inn invites guests to enjoy our special takes on New England architecture, culture, and vacation legacies. Enjoy the bracing Atlantic breeze and fresh seafood here as part of Hartstone’s lavish and indulgent heritage.

news_article.title: Admire Fine Artwork and Luxury at Hartstone Inn
news_article.description: A Romantic Place to Stay in Maine

postcards.name: A Place where European Hospitality Meets Coastal Charm
postcards.intro: Located among the dense pines of Maine, the Hartstone Inn is a historical inn that majestically stands with timeless elegance. This is a traditional northeast escape that will enchant you with its authentic artistry and aesthetics. Here, the coastal tides welcome you to contemplate the very basis of your life. Come, let’s dive into the heart of the Hartstone Inn.
postcards.story:
If you want to explore the picturesque town of Camden in the midcoast, Hartstone Inn is the perfect spot to do so. This is a place where time flies faster than the speed of light. So, whether you’re here for a day or a week, you can enjoy scenic hikes, adventurous sailboat rides, great shopping and delicious cuisine. The area surrounding the Hartstone Inn is one of the most peaceful and nature-filled places in Maine.

The Inn is just a short walk from the ocean, which showers you with salt-tinged breezes. Every corner of the inn speaks stories of age-old traditions and mesmerises its guests with tales of architecture, culture and vacation legacies. As you savour each bite of the fresh seafood in the Atlantic breeze, your taste buds will begin conversations with your sensory receptors. The restaurant at the Inn offers lavish comfort and celebrates regional flavours.

Hartstone Inn is one of the most romantic places to stay in Maine. Every room has a unique blend of artistic touches and features original artwork, fine linens, soft robes, down comforters and pillows, flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi to create a mood of romance and luxury. 

Some rooms offer gas fireplaces, and wrapping yourself in a warm blanket with your favourite background music will make you feel at home. Enjoy the peaceful veranda, sip a glass of local wine and delve deeper into serenity. As you sit for some introspection and contemplation, you’ll feel the significance of letting go and embracing life in the present moment. 

At this beautiful haven, you’ll get to witness the love affair between Maine’s forests and the sea. The Hartstone Inn is not just a place to stay, it is an abode where all your senses come to life.

postcards.name: Discover the best things to do on the Maine Coast
postcards.intro: Maine is a lot more than its postcard-worthy landscapes. Seems like it’s stolen from the pages of a fairytale. It has some old-world charm that keeps inviting travellers to hear its stories of history, traditions and culture. The Hartstone Inn is a timeless beauty offering you some of the best things to do on the Maine Coast.
postcards.story:
If you’re an early bird, you might fall in love with the sun rising over Camden Harbor. Many central Maine activities are just a short drive away from the Hartstone Inn. The streets in Camden Town are decorated with elegant historic homes. As you walk through the streets, explore the art galleries, boutique shops and colourful flower gardens that spread the fragrance of vibrance. 

The breathtaking panoramic views of the harbour and surrounding islands leave a lasting impression on the soul. Whether you’re a sunset lover or enjoy savouring fresh lobster from the ocean, this place will invite you to keep coming back every year. One of the best parts of this journey is having a conversation with the friendly village locals. Such experiences surely convince us to return to Maine and keep living these moments. 

The team at Hartstone Inn have designed many area driving tours and day trips to wonderful destinations like Acadia National Park, Port Clyde, Stonington, Pemaquid Point, Damariscotta, Belfast and area lighthouses. You will also love the detailed Foliage Tours and Scenic Bicycling Routes. There’s something interesting for wine lovers, too. Walking past the streets to the Cellardoor Winery can be a memorable experience. A special vintage feel is spread all over this 1790s barn and farmhouse that is set on 68 acres of land. 

Whatever you do in and around Hartstone, you’ll always enjoy the air here that carries the earthy fragrance of the forest. The dew-kissed ferns smile with the first rays of the morning sun. Hiking through the trails around this boutique property, you’ll always be accompanied by the panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean touching the rugged Maine coastline. All this will make you truly feel that nature is not a place to visit, but it is your home.

name: Gratitude Heritage
intro: GRATITUDE is a Category II heritage building and although we do not have the exact age, going by events which occurred during the last few centuries, we can presume that it could be approximately 200 years old. It has gone through several owners and has probably been witness to the lives of many different generations of residents.

news_article.title: Embrace Pondicherry’s Heritage at Gratitude
news_article.description: A Stay That Promises a Journey Through Time

postcards.name: Journey Through Time at Gratitude
postcards.intro: Step into Gratitude and journey back to an era of exploration, trade and colonial intrigue. Explore the tales of men and women who left their mark on India's shores, shaping the legacy that echoes within these walls. From Abraham Guerre's Swiss origins to Pondicherry's colonial past, experience a living museum where history breathes and whispers its secrets.
postcards.story:
As you step through the doors of Gratitude, you're transported back in time to an era of exploration, trade and colonial intrigue. 

With an existence of around two centuries, this heritage building located in the quaint town of Pondicherry in South India has been a witness to the lives of several residents. And today, it is open for you to experience.

Gratitude is a haven with a healing ambiance. It is uncommon to find a place so peaceful, inviting introspection and an inner journey while maintaining complete comfort. The residence is immaculately clean and adorned with exquisite taste, showcasing the period's style. 

It is a perfect time travel capsule for anybody who, like the makers of this homestay, enjoy history and have an appreciation for natural, authentic textiles -  evident in the Anglo-French furnishings. 

Picture yourself tracing the footsteps of Abraham Guerre, a hospital administrator from St. Imier, Switzerland, who arrived in India in the early 1700s to work with the French East India Company. Abraham's marriage to Marie Brunet, a young French girl, marked the beginning of a new chapter in Pondicherry's history. Their descendants, including Jacques Guerre, continued to shape the landscape of this colonial outpost until its eventual handover to India in 1962.

Explore the remnants of this illustrious past as you wander through Gratitude, where every corner tells a story of resilience, adventure and cultural exchange. 

Admire the artefacts and paintings that bear witness to centuries of French influence in this coastal town, and marvel at handwritten documents like the sale deed from 1940, passed down through generations.

As you lose yourself in this living museum of history, you'll embark upon a journey through time, where the past comes alive in vibrant detail.

postcards.name: Experience A Heritage Stay
postcards.intro: Explore Gratitude's diverse rooms, each with a unique story. Guided by thorough research, the restored heritage home preserves its original charm. Choose from a versatile selection of rooms - bathed in natural light, artistic in appeal or even vintage in theme. Here, no two rooms are alike. You can choose the one that matches your taste and personalise your experience.
postcards.story:
As you step into Gratitude, the restored heritage home reveals diverse rooms, each with its own story to tell. Picture yourself exploring the corridors, greeted by the promise of discovery in every nook and cranny. From cosy alcoves bathed in warm sunlight to airy retreats overlooking lush surroundings, every room has its own charm.

As you explore Gratitude, you'll find that every corner bears the mark of thoughtful restoration, guided by in-depth research. The owners of this heritage home chose to preserve the original unique character and charm.  

Consider Room No. 4, perched atop the staircase, brightened by sunshine that streams in through the windows. This is an ideal choice for anybody who prioritises natural lighting in their space.

Alternatively, indulge in the vibrant ambiance of Room No. 5, where the indigo floor with a double bed sets the stage for lively conversations and moments of reflection. With easy access to the terrace and ground floor, this room invites you to enjoy the surrounding landscape.

For creative souls seeking inspiration, Room No. 8 in the new wing awaits. Ideal for solo travellers or a group of two to three, this space hosts twin beds and a surprise bunk bed.  With the very first guest in this room being a Fulbright scholar, it is safe to say this room has appealed to artists, writers and philosophers since day one.

With detailed descriptions of bed sizes and room layouts at your fingertips, choosing your sanctuary becomes a delightful adventure. Before your stay here, make sure to review the house guidelines for a seamless and enjoyable stay.

At Gratitude, the commitment is to exceed your expectations and craft an experience that resonates with your unique preferences. This is where you ignite your imagination and create cherished memories that linger long after your departure.

name: RAAS Chhatrasagar
intro: Luxury tents have always played an important part in Rajput lifestyle. Constant safari campaigns in far-flung lands meant long stays in tents in inhospitable conditions. These tents were the only luxury available and soon these ‘homes away from home’ evolved into mobile, mini-palaces. RAAS Chhatrasagar captures this romance.

news_article.title: Discover Timeless Romance at RAAS Chhatrasagar
news_article.description: Luxury Lakeside Safaris in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Relish Luxury Dining at RAAS Chhatrasagar
postcards.intro: RAAS Chhatrasagar believes in a balanced food philosophy that blends rich traditions with a contemporary touch. Their commitment to authenticity means that every culinary experience is deeply rooted in local flavours. Because each meal is crafted to order, their chefs can readily accommodate your specific dietary preferences. Come and enjoy the authentic flavours of Rajasthan.
postcards.story:
In Rajasthan, you'll discover a culinary journey that's rich in flavours and diversity. You can explore the robust taste of Rajasthani cuisine at RAAS Chhatrasagar, where local specialities are a highlight. The restaurant here offers you a laid-back dining experience with a view of Lake Chhatra Sagar on one side and the swimming pool on the other. 

You can enjoy a variety of local dishes and an extensive selection of Indian and international cuisine. Whether you're craving authentic Rajasthani flavours, the aroma of Italian dishes or robust Indian curries, the restaurant caters to your taste preferences. The chef personally selects most vegetables from their on-site organic garden.

The bar in the restaurant is well-equipped to cater to your drinking preferences, offering a range of options, including herbal-infused alcoholic and non-alcoholic cocktails. It's thoughtful to ensure you have a satisfying dining and drinking experience during your stay.

Most of their produce is sourced either from their own organic farms and gardens or from local suppliers near the hotel. This ensures that what you find on your plate is a celebration of the region's ingredients. 
By choosing RAAS, you not only savour delicious meals but also contribute to a culinary experience that celebrates local traditions and supports the surrounding community. Your dining moments reflect RAAS Chhatrasagar's dedication to providing mindful luxury that is both rooted and adaptable to your individual tastes.

You'll find that Rajasthani cuisine caters to diverse tastes, from those who appreciate bold and spicy flavours to those who prefer milder options. So, whether you're an adventurous eater or someone who enjoys familiar tastes, Rajasthani cuisine is a delightful part of your mindful luxury travel experience.

postcards.name: Enjoy the Rajput Lifestyle in a Luxury Tent in Chhatrasagar
postcards.intro: In the Rajput lifestyle, luxury tents were a crucial element due to frequent safari campaigns in distant lands, necessitating extended stays in challenging conditions. These tents, initially the only luxury option, gradually transformed into mobile, compact palaces. RAAS Chhatrasagar encapsulates this historical romance, offering you a chance to experience the charm of these 'homes away from home.'
postcards.story:
When you’re at RAAS Chhatrasagar, the beautiful landscape unfolds before you in a mesmerising blend of colours. The earthy tones of the rustic terrain of Rajasthan stretch as far as your eyes can see, interrupted only by the shimmering surface of the reservoir. Here, you’ll love how the luxury tents redefine comfort and sophistication. 

Every space here has air-conditioning and heating, so the camp remains open year-round – one of the few tented camps in India to do so. All tents are positioned to overlook the lake in the east and offer you serene natural views. These tents are spacious, well-furnished for comfort and equipped with private facilities to ensure a relaxing experience during your stay. You can't help but feel a profound connection to the earth beneath your feet.

The tents are large, sound-proofed and solid. Each is contemporary, with soft muted colours, Jodhpur stone, teak furniture and skylights; understated but chic and fresh. A new walkway to the tents allows you to sit outside your tent in addition to giving more privacy, whilst retaining the beautiful views. You wake up to the soft glow of dawn, casting a warm hue on your tent and the surroundings. There’s nothing quite like sitting on your veranda, with a good book, uninterrupted views and virtually no sign of habitation. 

Here, the calm reservoir reflects the contemplative atmosphere it evokes. You notice the steady rhythm of nature — the subtle rustle of leaves, the distant bird calls and the gentle lapping of water on the shores. It's a simple harmony that encourages you to be fully aware of the present moment, an invitation to tune in and appreciate the nature around you.

name: Spice Coast Cruises
intro: The Spice Coast Cruises give you a taste of a unique way of life that was extant in these parts. You get to journey upon a 'Kettuvalam', a traditional houseboat, that was once used to carry cargoes of rice and spices up and down these same waterways for centuries.

news_article.title: Go with the Flow on a Spice Coast Cruise with CGH Earth
news_article.description: Cruising the magical waterways of Kerala's Vembanad Lake

postcards.name: Soak up Local Life on a Traditional Kettuvallam
postcards.intro: Have you ever been on a houseboat in the backwaters of Kerala? Lovingly known as God’s Own Country, Kerala is home to numerous backwater lakes, each showcasing its natural beauty to whoever comes here with an open heart. If you desire to become immersed in natural beauty and culture of this land, step aboard a Kettuvallam – the traditional houseboat.
postcards.story:
In the southwestern corner of India lies the enchanting land of Kerala – a land exhibiting nature's artistry. The backwaters in Kerala look like a world full of dreams. Tranquil canals, emerald-green fields and countless cultural experiences offer you a glimpse into the ancient and present life of the people of Kerala. Feels like a timeless world – a world that moves at its own pace and shares its stories with those who gently tune with its rhythm.
