Living a houseboat life is a dream for many. If you crave a taste of this unique dreamy life, then a beautiful Kettuvallam awaits you at Spice Coast Cruises. 

Wondering what a Kettuvallam is? It’s a traditional houseboat that was once used to carry cargoes of rice and spices up and down the waterways of Kerala for centuries. These houseboats are simply a work of art, and take you on a journey into the waterways of the captivating Vembanad Lake. 

As you step on a Kettuvallam, the cool breeze takes you into another world – a world of fairy tales where every sight is magical. In fact, the traditional construct of the houseboats and the service and food onboard bewitches you in this beautiful heartland of Kerala. Made from natural materials, these boats are powered with solar energy and vegetable oils to reduce their impact on the lake. Such sustainable and mindful experiences make you feel like a more responsible traveller. 

The smiling faces of the crew onboard make the vibe amiable and homely. The crew of these boats are simple fisherfolk and have known these waters from their early years. This picturesque landscape beautifully displays culture, heritage and Indian experiences that linger in your heart long after your journey ends.

postcards.name: Savour Local Spices and South Indian Cuisine on a Houseboat
postcards.intro: India is known for its delightful culinary experiences. These experiences are amplified when you step onboard a traditional houseboat in Kerala to savour some South Indian cuisine. These houseboat journeys are not only a backwater voyage, but a whole culinary voyage, too! Come, let’s taste the sumptuous fish, tangy spices and sweet coconuts on a houseboat in Kerala.
postcards.story:
The moment you step on a houseboat, the boat's gentle sway feels like a rhythmic dance move, offering you a state of serene contemplation. As you begin admiring the construction and design of the boat, the fragrance of fresh food makes you deeply inhale this aromatic air. It’s a delight to your senses! Welcome onboard!

Kettuvallam journeys with Spice Coast Cruises take you on a voyage through Kerala’s culinary treasures. Slowly immersing yourself in this traditional yet luxurious experience, you’ll come across the boat's kitchen, which serves delectable dishes infused with the flavours of this region — coconut, tamarind and an array of spices. Each meal becomes a sensory delight, and every bite you take is both indulgent and nourishing.

You can see your meals being prepared by the boatmen in a local manner – fresh food with pleasant and satisfying flavours. Cooked with tangy spices and plenty of coconuts, this food leaves an indelible mark on not just your palate but also your heart. However, the highlight is undoubtedly the fish, which is caught fresh from the lake. You’ll witness the art of cooking onboard when a fish is marinated in red chillies, ginger and lime, before being grilled. 

Don’t forget to ask for the popular Karimeen Pollichathu, the local fish infused with Kerala spices and wrapped in a banana leaf. Try the Kuttanadan, the local red rice served on the houseboat, which comes from the nearby fields. You can see these fields as you pass through them on a Kettuvallam. Don’t forget to enjoy the steamed bowls of rice served with lentils and gourd that are cooked with fresh pepper and mustard seeds. Ready to immerse yourself in the abundant mindful experiences here?

name: Simbambili Game Lodge
intro: Simbambili Game Lodge is located in the northern part of the world-famous Sabi Sand Game Reserve in the Greater Kruger Park, an area renowned for its game viewing and prolific leopard sightings. Set amongst the old Knobthorns and Jackalberries, Simbambili offers sophisticated safari accommodation that echoes its unspoilt landscape. The lodge overlooks a waterhole so you’d be hard-pressed to leave.

news_article.title: Soulful Safaris at Simbambili Game Lodge
news_article.description: Roam Free in South Africa with Thornybush

postcards.name: Unveil the Unspoiled Charm of the Simbambili Game Lodge
postcards.intro: At Simbambili Game Lodge, you’ll find yourself in the heart of the African wilderness. The air is alive with the scent of the earth, and as you step onto the grounds, a subtle sense of anticipation surrounds you. The lodge itself is a quiet presence, blending smoothly into the natural environment that unfolds beyond its boundaries.
postcards.story:
Simbambili Game Lodge rests in the northern part of the renowned Sabi Sand Game Reserve, within the Greater Kruger Park — an area celebrated for its exceptional game viewing and frequent leopard sightings. Positioned amidst the ancient knobthorns and jackalberries, Simbambili offers you refined safari accommodation that mirrors its untouched surroundings. From your private deck, plunge pool and shaded Sala bed, you have an uninterrupted view of a waterhole, making you feel excited as you witness elephants gathering for a drink or playful warthogs in the mud. 

The lodge comprises seven chic suites that complement the serene surroundings. If you’re a newlywed or seeking extra seclusion with your partner, the Honeymoon and Waterhole suites are strategically located on the camp's far sides, providing added spaciousness and privacy. 

In this peaceful environment, the flavours of your food become more distinct and enjoyable. Culinary delights at Simbambili are crafted from fresh ingredients sourced from the Thornybush Community Garden and local suppliers. You’ll love the menus here that range from à la carte dining to boma barbecues, and the lodge treats you to unhurried bush breakfasts and dinners, too.

The heart of Simbambili lies in its dedication to an authentic safari experience. The rangers and trackers, your guides in this raw terrain, exude a quiet expertise. Their knowledge is not showcased in grand gestures but is evident in the subtle art of tracking, interpreting the bush and revealing the intricate stories written in the soil. Whether you're on game drives, guided bush walks or engaging in fireside conversations at night, their insights leave a lasting impression, allowing you to connect with the natural wonders that surround you.

postcards.name: Enjoy Seclusion with Your Partner in a Honeymoon Suite
postcards.intro: If you and your partner crave quiet moments amidst nature's beauty, Simbambili Game Lodge is the ideal destination. Located in the unspoiled African wilderness, this lodge offers you a warm environment for peaceful and romantic experiences that leave a lasting impression on both of you.
postcards.story:
Amidst the whirl of exploring new places, experiencing different cultures and navigating unfamiliar surroundings, having moments of seclusion provides a space for you and your partner to share genuine experiences. It's an opportunity to step away from external distractions, have candid conversations and simply enjoy each other's company without the noise of the outside world. 

If you're seeking heightened privacy and a touch of romance at Simbambili, you'll find solace in the exclusive Honeymoon Suite and Waterhole Suite. Tucked away at the far reaches of the lodge, these special retreats are tailor-made for honeymooners. As you enter your suite, the interiors reflect a commitment to comfort without sacrificing the authenticity of the environment. The furnishings are simple yet refined, inviting you to unwind after a long day of safari adventures.

Designed with a focus on intimacy, these romantic suites offer you enhanced amenities. Staying in this suite creates a romantic atmosphere where love seems to permeate the air. They feature a shower, free-standing bath, his-and-her sinks and modern finishes akin to the other suites. But what sets them apart is the inclusion of an inviting lounge area, providing an extra layer of space for relaxation. 

Yet, it's the outside deck that truly captures your heart. This expansive bush-facing deck, complete with a refreshing plunge pool and a shaded sala bed, becomes a haven for you and your partner seeking to spend a warm afternoon basking in the sun. 

Get cosy and comfortable with your partner and connect on a more personal level with them. These moments foster a stronger bond and allow for a more authentic and memorable travel experience for both of you.

name: Treehotel
intro: Welcome to Treehotel - a place where you can experience nature in a unique way. Treehotel was founded in 2010 by Kent and Britta Lindvall, and since 2022 the hotel is owned by Jonas Olsson and Hannah Wennebro Olsson.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Bird's-Eye View at Treehotel
news_article.description: Elevate Your Senses in a Swedish Forest

postcards.name: Enhance Your Fitness Journey at the Treehotel
postcards.intro: Treehotel invites you to go on a journey of holistic wellness, tailored to your desires and needs, amidst the bliss of nature. Here, you can gracefully indulge in yoga, meditation and running. Within the offerings of enriching activities, spanning two to three hours, you’ll have rejuvenating experiences designed to elevate both your body and spirit.
postcards.story:
Imagine yourself awakening amidst the serenity of the tree rooms, greeted by the gentle sounds of the forest. Your adventure begins with a spirited run along winding paths, led by a seasoned training coach who will not only guide your steps but also nourish your spirit with the pure essence of the forest air. With each stride, you'll feel your lungs expand, drawing in vitality and exhaling any traces of stress or tension.

Alternatively, immerse yourself in the ancient art of meditation, enveloped by the lush green forest. Here, amidst the verdant canopy, you'll unravel the mysteries of your own energies, honing your focus and deepening your awareness. Guided by knowledgeable instructors, you'll explore the power of breath, discovering how it can be harnessed to soothe the mind and navigate the ebb and flow of emotions.

If you’re seeking a more gentle yet transformative experience, indulge in the graceful practice of yoga. Engage in a fluid sequence of postures, each designed to enhance flexibility and instil a sense of inner peace. With expert guidance, you'll unravel tension from muscles, tendons and ligaments, leaving you feeling buoyant and revitalised from within.

Beyond the physical, the instructors offer you invaluable insights into injury prevention and rehabilitation, drawing upon a wealth of expertise in fields ranging from nursing to mountain marathons. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or a novice explorer, each session is tailored to your unique needs, ensuring a transformative experience.

If you’re seeking the ultimate in relaxation, yoga and meditation can be integrated into the soothing confines of the forest sauna, where the healing powers of heat and steam merge with the tranquil rhythms of nature. Here, you'll have the opportunity to cleanse your body and soul, emerging refreshed and renewed for the adventures that lie ahead.

postcards.name: Stay at the Guesthouse – Your Home in Nature
postcards.intro: Step into a world of timeless charm and peace at the Guesthouse. From the moment you arrive here, you're enveloped in the warmth of the preserved heritage rooms, each exuding its own unique character and charm. As you cross the threshold, leave the cares of the world behind and immerse yourself in a sanctuary of comfort, nature and relaxation.
postcards.story:
At the Guesthouse, hospitality is a way of life. From the moment you arrive, you're greeted with open arms and a genuine sense of warmth that instantly makes you feel at home. The heritage rooms transport you back to a simpler time, evoking the nostalgia of the 30s and 50s while preserving the unique essence of each era. 

As you settle into your accommodations, allow your senses to come alive as you take in the sights and sounds of your natural surroundings. From the gentle murmur of the Lule River to the crisp scent of pine in the air, every moment is an invitation to celebrate the beauty of the present moment. Savour a steaming cup of coffee as you plan your next adventure, letting the serenity of the quaint village of Harads, nestled in North Sweden, inspire your wanderlust.

With just 600 souls calling this picturesque village home, you can rest assured that you're in good hands with nature as your guide. Whether you're seeking solace in the stillness of the forest or going on a thrilling outdoor excursion, this idyllic locale offers you endless opportunities for exploration and discovery.

With six charming rooms accommodating up to 14 guests, each appointed with modern amenities and thoughtful touches, your comfort is the top priority. So, as you go on your journey with Treehotel, let the Guesthouse be your home away from home — offering you warmth, comfort and timeless hospitality that invites you to unwind, explore and create memories that will last a lifetime.

As you step through the doors, a sense of calm washes over you, inviting you to kick off your shoes and surrender to the soothing ambience of the inviting fireplace. It's the perfect finale to a day filled with inspiring sights and unforgettable experiences.

name: Patagonia National Park
intro: Created by Douglas and Kristine Tompkins, the Patagonia National Park is an authentic hidden gem that exudes an intimate, peaceful and remote atmosphere. Here, nature flourishes in its most vibrant and thriving form, captivating visitors with pristine landscapes and extraordinary wildlife.

news_article.title: Get Raw at Explora Patagonia National Park in Chile
news_article.description: One of the Few Luxury Lodges in this Untamed Wilderness

postcards.name: Celebrate the Thrill of Biking at La Tejuela
postcards.intro: A biking adventure at La Tejuela during your stay at Patagonia National Park offers you an exhilarating journey through some of the most breathtaking landscapes nature has to offer. Imagine yourself pedalling along rugged trails, surrounded by the majestic beauty of the Chacabuco Valley. With each turn of the pedal, you delve deeper into the heart of this wild terrain.
postcards.story:
As you set out on your bike, you'll have the opportunity to explore the rich history of the region firsthand. A visit to a rancher's post offers insights into the lives of the valley's early settlers, allowing you to glimpse remnants of their way of life amidst the vast expanse of wilderness. It's a chance to connect with the land and its people, gaining a deeper understanding of the cultural heritage that shapes this remote corner of Patagonia.

But the real magic of biking at La Tejuela lies in the landscape itself. Picture yourself weaving through ancient lenga forests, their towering trees casting dappled shadows across the forest floor. Along the way, you'll encounter sparkling lagoons and panoramic views that stretch as far as you can see. Each bend in the trail reveals a new wonder, from tranquil rivers to rugged mountain peaks, creating a sense of wonder that's impossible to replicate elsewhere.

As you pedal through this beautiful wilderness, you'll have the chance to encounter some of Patagonia's most iconic wildlife – puma, deer and Andean condor, among others. Transit areas frequented by huemuls and other species offer glimpses of these majestic creatures in their natural habitat, adding an extra layer of excitement to your adventure. It's a reminder of the delicate balance of life in this remote wilderness, where every encounter with nature is a privilege to be cherished.

Biking at La Tejuela isn't just about physical exertion but also about soaking the beauty of the natural world, about feeling the wind on your face and the earth beneath your wheels. It's a chance to escape the confines of everyday life and lose yourself in the grandeur of Patagonia, where every pedal stroke brings you closer to the heart of this untamed land.

postcards.name: Kayak along the Cochrane River
postcards.intro: When you go on a kayaking adventure at Blugrin during your stay at Explora Patagonia National Park, you're in for an unforgettable experience that blends the serenity of nature with the thrill of adventure. Picture yourself gliding along the Cochrane River, its tranquil waters guiding you upstream toward the breathtaking expanse of Lake Cochrane.
postcards.story:
As you paddle your kayak along the Cochrane River, you’ll witness a breathtaking landscape, where the vibrant blues of the water complement the lush greenery of the surrounding nothofagus-laden slopes.

Every stroke of your paddle propels you further into the heart of this unmatched wilderness, where the only sounds you hear are the gentle lapping of water against your kayak and the sound of the soothing breeze. The sense of calm that envelops you is unparalleled, offering you a rare opportunity to disconnect from the rush of everyday life and immerse yourself fully in the beauty of nature.

But the adventure doesn't end there. As you reach the shore and step out from your kayak, you're greeted by the untamed wilderness of the Chacabuco Valley, inviting you to explore further on foot. The journey ahead is as rewarding as it is exhilarating, with each step revealing new wonders hidden within the extensive forests that carpet the landscape.

If you have experience in distance kayaking or similar pursuits, the allure of Blugrin lies not only in its stunning scenery but also in the sense of accomplishment that comes from navigating its waters. It's a chance to push your limits, test your skills against the challenges and forge unforgettable memories that will last a lifetime.

Indeed, kayaking at Blugrin is an adventure in every sense of the word. It's about embracing the unknown, embracing the challenges and embracing the sheer joy of exploration. Here, every moment is infused with a sense of excitement and discovery that's as exhilarating as it is addictive. Kayaking at Blugrin is fun and memorable as it's an experience that stirs the soul, ignites the spirit and leaves you forever changed.

name: Destino Mío
intro: Destino Mío Mayan Jungle Retreat by AKEN Soul, a space where we can reconnect with the environment and its mirage, where we can see our own essence reflected, our most primitive being. Being in the presence of our most empathetic capacity, embracing and letting ourselves be embraced by natural force.

news_article.title: Go Deep at Destino Mio in the Mayan Jungle
news_article.description: A Mystical Adventure in Mexico's Yucatan

postcards.name: Reconnect with Yourself at AKEN Spa & Wellness – Utópika
postcards.intro: At AKEN Spa & Wellness – Utópika, located within the peaceful sanctuary of Destino Mio, you go on a journey of introspection and renewal. Grounded in the pillars of roots, reconnection and innovation, this spa promises to rejuvenate your senses and invigorate your spirit, leaving you feeling deeply relaxed and truly alive.
postcards.story:
As you step into the AKEN Spa & Wellness – Utópika, you're greeted by an atmosphere that whispers of transformation and personal insights. Here, the path you choose is a doorway to profound self-discovery. Whether you seek solace in quiet reflection or crave the thrill of active exploration, every avenue leads to a deeper understanding of yourself.

At AKEN, experiences transcend mere treatments; they become moments of resonance with your being. Guided by the dedicated personal wellness creators, you're empowered to craft rituals tailored to your unique needs. These rituals engage all your senses, offering a holistic approach to rejuvenation and self-care.

The Spa’s philosophy is grounded in three pillars: roots, reconnection and innovation. Through rituals inspired by the earth's bounty, they honour cultural heritage while infusing each touch with therapeutic intent. Every corner of the wellness sanctuary is designed to foster a reconnection with the natural world, igniting a passion for holistic well-being. Utópika blends ancient wisdom with modern trends to ensure a timeless and cutting-edge experience.

Staying at Destino Mio isn't just about indulging in luxury but is also about nourishing your soul. The serene ambience, enveloped by nature, provides the perfect backdrop for inner exploration. Here, amidst the soothing whispers of the wind, you'll find the space to unwind, reflect and rediscover your inner harmony.

Have you ever thought about why spa experiences are so profoundly rejuvenating and refreshing? That’s because this experience is about giving yourself the time and space to pause, breathe and reconnect with the essence of who you are. 

In today's fast-paced world, where constant stimulation and distraction abound, the sanctuary of a spa offers a sanctuary of stillness. It's a space where you can release tension, let go of your worries and tap into a sense of profound peace.

postcards.name: Join a Unique Retreat in the Mayan Jungle
postcards.intro: At Destino Mio, located within the heart of the Mayan jungle, you're invited to join an authentic and transformative journey. Spread across 250 hectares of pristine wilderness, this retreat is a significant space for life-changing experiences. The breathtaking scenery and the ancient stories make your experience even more special.
postcards.story:
Amidst the whispering trees and ancient ruins in the Mayan jungles, you'll find a safe space to explore and nurture every aspect of yourself — body, mind and spirit. It's a space where you can immerse yourself in the tunes of nature, reconnecting with the universe and your innermost being. Feel the jungle's vibrant energy renewing your spirit, leading you on a transformative journey of self-discovery and inner renewal.

As you step into the Holistic Center, you're greeted by the timeless wisdom of Mayan traditions. Here, the treatments are not just therapies – they're gateways to deeper understanding and healing. Guided by experienced practitioners, you'll begin a journey of self-discovery, tapping into the richness of ancient knowledge and practices.

Throughout your retreat, you'll have the opportunity to participate in guided ceremonies and rituals in sacred spaces. These experiences are designed to awaken your senses, open your heart and align you with the profound energies of the jungle. Whether it's a meditation beneath towering ceiba trees or a purification ceremony by a tranquil cenote, each moment is infused with the potent magic of the Mayan landscape.

This retreat in the Mayan jungle is a powerful and transformative experience. A profound sense of connection and belonging permeates every corner of this sacred land. Here, surrounded by the sights, sounds and scents of the jungle, you'll find yourself shedding layers of stress and distraction, returning to a state of natural harmony and balance.

If you seek a journey of self-discovery and renewal, look no further than Destino Mio. Let the ancient wisdom of the Mayan traditions guide you on a path of transformation, as you delve deep into the heart of the jungle and rediscover the true essence of who you are.

name: Gangtey Lodge
intro: Gangtey Lodge is the culmination of an adventure that began back in 2003 by owners Khin Omar Win and Brett Melzer. Founders of the iconic Balloons over Bagan and the remote Malikha Lodge in Northern Myanmar, they were invited to Bhutan to explore the possibility of ballooning together with their Bhutanese partner Yeshey Norbu.

news_article.title: Be Happy at Gangtey Lodge in Bhutan
news_article.description: Where Joy is a Way of Life

postcards.name: Indulge in the Tradition of the Hot Stone Bath
postcards.intro: Indulge in the time-honoured tradition of the Hot Stone Bath, a revered practice deeply rooted in Bhutanese culture and discover a sanctuary of relaxation and rejuvenation unlike any other. As you immerse yourself in this ancient therapeutic ritual, you'll go on a journey of holistic wellness that transcends the boundaries of time and space.
postcards.story:
Crafted from locally sourced pinewood and heated with large boulders collected from the nearby river, the Hot Stone Bath is more than just a soak — it's a combination of nature's finest elements converging to deliver a myriad of healing benefits. Allow the soothing heat and rich minerals of the water to envelop you, melting away any tension and stress with each passing moment. As the minerals released from the rocks mingle with the fragrant herbs foraged from the forest, a relaxing fusion of natural remedies unfolds, offering relief to your mind, body and soul.

To enhance your bath experience, indulge in a selection of special treats thoughtfully curated to complement the indulgence of the moment. From aromatic teas to delectable snacks, each offering is designed to tantalise your senses and elevate your experience to new heights of luxury and indulgence.

You can also step into your private sanctuary and surrender to the blissful embrace of your in-suite, deep rolltop bathtub, where panoramic views of the valley unfold before you in all their splendour. Here, amidst the serenity of your surroundings, you'll discover a profound sense of peace, as the cares of the world melt away with each gentle ripple of water.

Choose from a selection of three distinct bath experiences — Herbal, Relax and Refresh — each tailored to meet your unique needs and preferences. Whether you seek to soothe sore muscles, invigorate the senses or simply unwind and rejuvenate, there's a bath experience perfectly suited to fulfil your desires.

So, as you go on your journey of self-discovery and renewal, let the Hot Stone Bath be a relaxing space, where the healing powers of nature converge to envelop you in pure bliss.

postcards.name: Wear a Traditional Bhutanese Dress
postcards.intro: If you’re seeking a deeper understanding of Bhutanese life and culture, wearing the local Bhutanese dress is a wonderful way to connect with the heart and soul of this enigmatic land. Here, amidst the mist-shrouded mountains and prayer-flag-adorned valleys, you'll find people deeply connected to their roots, their legacy woven into every aspect of daily life.
postcards.story:
As you traverse the bustling streets of Bhutan, you'll be captivated by the sight of locals adorned in their traditional dress — a visual blend of colour, texture and symbolism that speaks volumes about the richness of Bhutanese culture. For men, the iconic Gho reigns supreme — a knee-length robe cinched at the waist with the traditional Kera belt. 

Beyond its aesthetic appeal, the Gho serves as a functional garment, with ample pockets providing practical storage for everyday essentials. Whether donned for informal gatherings or grand celebrations, the Gho embodies the essence of Bhutanese identity, a timeless emblem of tradition and grace.

Meanwhile, women grace the streets in the elegant Kira — an ankle-length dress paired with the delicate Tego jacket. Flowing effortlessly with every step, the Kira exudes an air of grace and sophistication, its intricate patterns and vibrant hues reflecting the artisanal craftsmanship and attention to detail that defines Bhutanese textile traditions. Handwoven with love and care, each Kira is a reflection of the enduring spirit of Bhutanese culture, a cherished heirloom passed down through generations.

Whether attending a festive celebration or going on a spiritual pilgrimage to the monastery, donning traditional attire offers you a glimpse into the daily rhythms and rituals of Bhutanese life, fostering a sense of kinship and camaraderie with the local community.

So, as you venture forth into the hidden valleys and sacred peaks of Bhutan, keep an eye out for the vibrant colours and intricate designs of traditional dress, for they are more than just garments — they are living expressions of a culture steeped in tradition, heritage and timeless beauty. Allow yourself to be swept away by the elegance of Bhutanese attire, and in doing so, go on a journey of discovery that will leave a lasting imprint on your soul.

name: Palais de Mahe
intro: An address in the French Quarter with a distinct colonial stamp. Palais de Mahe lies close to the sea side promenade, barely 50 metres from the cool breezes and gentle rumblings of the Bay of Bengal.

news_article.title: Stay French and Fabulous at Palais de Mahe
news_article.description: Experience a Unique Blend of Culture and Comfort

postcards.name: Explore Pondicherry on a Rickshaw
postcards.intro: Explore Pondicherry aboard a rickshaw, a delightful and eco-conscious means of travel. Glide gracefully along the town's cobblestone streets, where every turn is a new chapter of its storied past and architectural wonders. From the elegant colonial facades of the French Quarter to the bustling streets of the Tamil Quarter, every corner exudes its unique charm and character.
postcards.story:
Have you ever explored a place on a rickshaw ride? Well, if you have, you know the thrill of it, and if not, here's where you start. The street signs in Pondicherry are unique and in several languages to aid the global traveller. Its urban character is a standing tribute to diversity. 

Historic buildings jostle against charming sidewalk cafes, trendy designer wear boutiques stand next to native sari shops, and other upmarket commercial addresses share humble space with roadside bangle sellers and temple pilgrims in a bustling bazaar-like environment. Now imagine exploring this and a lot more on rickshaw rides.

Feel the gentle breeze caress your skin as you navigate through the alleys of Pondicherry, each one steeped in history and culture. Marvel at the intricate details adorning the heritage villas that line Goubert Avenue, their timeless beauty a testament to Pondicherry's French legacy.

Lose yourself in the sights and sounds of Pondicherry, where centuries-old traditions blend seamlessly with modern life. Engage with your friendly rickshaw driver, whose stories and insights offer a deeper understanding of this fascinating town. Feel the ocean breeze as you soak in the picturesque vistas.

Crossing the canal, you enter the bustling Tamil Quarter, alive with vibrant energy. Restored mansions like Hotel Maison Perumal showcase traditional Tamil architecture, boasting semi-public street verandahs, central courtyards and expansive windows. Witness daily life unfold amid the bustling streets, offering a glimpse into Pondicherry's Indian heritage.

Whether you opt for a leisurely amble or a guided tour, the experience promises to be unforgettable. At Palais de Mahe, the Front Office personnel are ready to assist you in planning your exploration of Pondicherry's quarters.

postcards.name: Explore the "City of Humanity - Auroville"
postcards.intro: Prepare for a transformative journey to the experimental town of Auroville, a land of no religion, cast or geography…just humanity.  A universal township in the making, the concept of Auroville is to build an ideal township devoted to an experiment in human unity. Just a short drive away of 10 kilometres, you can witness this world.
postcards.story:
Auroville is a marvel of architectural ingenuity blended into Pondicherry's distinctive Franco-Tamil landscape, Auroville, let your senses be enraptured by the sounds of nature's wonders.  Imagine lush forests that envelop the township, a project to showcase decades of dedicated land restoration and reforestation efforts. 

Behold the majestic canopy of indigenous trees, from the sprawling banyans to the graceful acacias and the revered neem trees, each standing tall in silent reverence to the earth's bountiful gifts.

Venture deeper into the heart of Auroville's bamboo forests, where towering stalks sway gently in the ocean breeze, their delicate leaves whispering tales of timeless elegance and grace. Here, amidst the verdant splendour, you'll find solace and inspiration, as the natural world unfolds its secrets before your very eyes.

Pause for a moment of reflection by the tranquil shores of the Bay of Bengal. Dive into the rejuvenating embrace of the sea or simply bask in the warmth of the sun as it casts its golden rays upon the pristine sands. Let the waves soothe your soul and awaken your spirit. 

In Auroville, spirituality intertwines with sustainability, creating a harmonious world of human and natural connection. Explore the vibrant markets, where local artisans showcase their craft or partake in community events that celebrate the diversity of Auroville's inhabitants. 

Every corner of this sacred township tells a story, inviting you to become part of its rich life and evolution. Open your heart to the transformative power of this sacred land.

name: Thornybush Game Lodge
intro: A grande dame in the safari industry, Thornybush Game Lodge was one of the first commercial camps in South Africa and firmly established Thornybush Nature Reserve as a world renowned game-viewing destination in the Greater Kruger Park.

news_article.title: Experience African Wilderness at Thornybush Game Lodge
news_article.description: A Renowned Game-Viewing Destination in South Africa

postcards.name: Relax and Rejuvenate with a Bush Spa at the Game Lodge
postcards.intro: Immersing yourself in the tranquillity of the bush spa at Thornybush Game Lodge promises a rejuvenating escape from the hustle and bustle of your life. As you step into this oasis of calm, you'll instantly feel a sense of peace wash over you, enveloping you in a sanctuary designed to replenish both body and mind.
postcards.story:
Indulging in a range of spa treatments tailored to your specific needs allows you to experience the ultimate in relaxation and pampering. From deep cleansing facials to soothing wellness massages, each treatment is expertly administered by the professional therapists, ensuring that you emerge feeling refreshed and revitalised.

One of the highlights of the bush spa experience at Thornybush Game Lodge is the use of all-natural Africology products. These luxurious skincare formulations harness the power of indigenous African botanicals, leaving your skin glowing with renewed vitality. As the healing hands of the therapists work their magic, you'll feel the stresses of daily life melting away, replaced by a profound sense of calm and serenity.

But the benefits of a bush spa experience extend far beyond mere relaxation. Taking the time to prioritise self-care and wellness is essential for maintaining balance and harmony in both body and mind. By treating yourself to a spa day at Game Lodge, you're investing in your own well-being, nurturing yourself from the inside out.

Moreover, the natural surroundings of the bush Spa provide a serene backdrop for your wellness journey, enhancing the overall sense of tranquillity and renewal. Surrounded by the sights and sounds of the African wilderness, you'll find yourself effortlessly drifting into a state of deep relaxation, allowing you to fully surrender to the therapeutic benefits of your chosen treatments.

In essence, indulging in a bush spa experience at Thornybush Game Lodge is not just about pampering yourself — it's about reconnecting with yourself on a deeper level, nurturing your body, mind and spirit in a setting of unparalleled beauty and tranquillity. So why not treat yourself to this truly rejuvenating experience and discover the transformative power of self-care in the heart of the African bush?

postcards.name: Immerse Yourself in the Adventures of a Solo Safari
postcards.intro: Going on a solo safari adventure at Thornybush Game Lodge offers you a unique opportunity to reconnect with yourself while immersing in the breathtaking landscapes of the Greater Kruger Park. Whether you're seeking solitude or simply craving a break from the chaos of daily life, this lodge welcomes solo travellers, prioritising your comfort and peace of mind throughout your stay.
postcards.story:
From the moment you step off the plane, the dedicated staff at Thornybush Game Lodge will be there to greet you, ensuring that you never feel alone in transit. While the idea of solo travel may initially seem daunting, the experience at Game Lodge promises to be both invigorating and enriching. 

As you set out on safari drives guided by the knowledgeable experts, you'll have the opportunity to fully immerse yourself in the wonders of the African bush. Whether it's witnessing the majestic grace of a herd of elephants or the stealthy movements of a leopard in its natural habitat, each moment spent exploring the wilderness will leave you feeling awestruck and inspired.

In addition to shared safari experiences, the lodge offers ample opportunities for personal relaxation and rejuvenation. After a day of thrilling wildlife encounters, treat yourself to a soothing spa treatment, where a range of holistic therapies await to melt away any lingering stress or tension. Alternatively, go on guided bush walks, allowing you to intimately connect with nature as you discover hidden treasures within the landscape.

For those eager to delve deeper into the local culture, Thornybush Game Lodge offers excursions to nearby eco villages and community projects, providing insight into the richness of life in rural South Africa. Whether you're learning about traditional customs or participating in conservation efforts, these experiences offer a meaningful way to engage with the community and leave a positive impact.

Thornybush Game Lodge understands that solo travel is not just about solitude but also about self-discovery and personal growth. Amidst the serene beauty of the African wilderness, you'll find the perfect environment to reflect, recharge and rediscover your sense of wonder.

name: Lapa Rios Lodge
intro: Like a unique and beautiful flower, mimicking its wild surroundings, Lapa Rios Lodge sprouted from the heart of one of the last lowland rainforests in Central America. With 1,000 acres of protected forest, home to some of the world’s most astonishing biodiversity, this special place never fails to deliver astonishing natural experiences.

news_article.title: Let Nature Transform You at Lapa Rios Lodge
news_article.description: Life-changing Adventures in Costa Rica

postcards.name: Visit Central America’s Tropical Lowland Rainforest
postcards.intro: Explore the eternal beauty of Central America's last remaining tropical lowland rainforest. Immerse yourself in the lush greenery, diverse wildlife and vibrant ecosystems that make Costa Rica a true gem. Discover the wonders of nature and experience the unique charm of a place where biodiversity thrives.
postcards.story:
Lapa Rios Lodge safeguards 1,000 acres of the last remaining tropical lowland rainforest in Central America. Even before the principles of sustainable tourism were widely recognised, Lapa Rios aimed at protecting its endangered surroundings.

Here, you'll encounter a rich variety of wildlife and breathtaking scenery, as well as exceptional staff. It’s a truly impressive eco-lodge situated on a jungle ridge in the Osa Peninsula with sweeping ocean views. Get ready for the experience of a lifetime!

In this amazing setting, you can anticipate unique rainforest adventures, wildlife encounters and ocean activities. Whether you're an adventurous explorer or someone seeking nature's tranquillity, there are plenty of chances for you to connect with this stunning ecosystem.

Lapa Rios Lodge offers you an intimate and genuine experience that is both luxurious and educational. The interpretive hikes, bird-watching walks and sustainability tours give you a genuine insight into the vibrant life of the wild Osa Peninsula.

Lapa Rios’s commitment to sustainability is evident in its design. When you’re here, you’ll notice there's a deep respect for the wildlife and natural surroundings. Renewable materials are used for sustainable and low-impact construction. You’ll notice that the emphasis is on using locally-sourced biodegradable products and organic foods whenever possible. Exclusively local staff is hired, with a focus on educating them, the local community, and mindful travellers like you about sustainability, cultural, and environmental matters.

As a mindful traveller, you'll find true luxury in surrendering yourself to the jungle. You’ll discover an environment where endangered monkeys, iconic frogs and over 300 bird species coexist. Here, nature thrives in its rawest form, inviting you to connect with the essence of the jungle.

postcards.name: Stay Above the Forest Canopy and Enjoy Stunning Ocean Views
postcards.intro: Relax in the tranquillity of Lapa Villas, where you'll find a serene escape in the heart of nature. Discover authentically-designed furniture, a cosy living area with a daybed, and a beverage nook stocked with gourmet Costa Rican coffee. Accommodating up to five people, Lapa Villas are thoughtfully designed for a memorable family rainforest adventure.
postcards.story:
Lapa Rios Lodge nestles in the heart of the Osa Peninsula in Costa Rica, offering you an authentic immersion into the arms of nature. Perched on a jungle ridge with expansive views of the ocean, the lodge inspires you with its commitment to sustainable living. Through careful design and conscientious choices, it blends seamlessly with the surrounding environment. 

Elevated above the forest canopy, the four Lapa Villas offer sweeping ocean views that immerse you in the wild beauty of the Osa Peninsula. Surrounding you is the primary rainforest teeming with birds and other wildlife, blending with the turquoise hues of the Golfo Dulce, a habitat for whales, dolphins, sea turtles and surfers' sought-after point breaks. Appreciate the natural perfection of this paradise, accompanied by the calls of monkeys traversing the treetops, the lively chatter of vibrantly coloured macaws above, and the sounds of breaching humpback whales and diving sea birds.

In each standalone villa, you'll find smooth hardwood flooring. Inside the villa, you’ll enjoy stunning views through floor-to-ceiling screens and a wide wrap-around deck. Inside, you'll also discover a living area with a daybed, and a beverage nook with gourmet Costa Rican coffee. The master bedroom includes a king bed, fine linens and eco-fans. This place is ideal for a family rainforest adventure, and if you’re here with your loved ones, you’ll surely take back many beautiful memories. 

Don’t forget to take a refreshing dip in your plunge pool. 

From captivating wildlife encounters to serene moments of contemplation, Lapa Rios offers you an unfiltered connection to the natural world. Are you excited to absorb the wonders of nature offered here?

name: Narendra Bhawan
intro: Narendra Bhawan Bikaner tells the story of the last reigning Maharaja of Bikaner, His Highness Narendra Singhji.

news_article.title: Revel in the Royal Heritage of Rajasthan at Narendra Bhawan
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel from The MRS Group in Bikaner

postcards.name: Enjoy a Royal Stay in the Colourful City of Bikaner
postcards.intro: You may have often thought about visiting Rajasthan, or the land of the kings, and immersing yourself in the wealth of experiences. The breathtaking palaces and forts endlessly wait for you to witness the grandeur of Rajasthan's past. But there’s something more that will offer you rich and authentic Rajasthani experiences – a luxurious stay at Narendra Bhawan in Bikaner.
postcards.story:
The city of Bikaner in Rajasthan is peacefully nestled in the heart of the Thar Desert. This timeless city proudly showcases its rich history, culture and heritage through its architecture, forts, clothing, food and festivals. The colourful and vibrant bazaars of Bikaner will attract even a non-shopaholic to their everlasting charm. The unconventionally curated Narendra Bhawan in this city will satisfy the luxury and mindful traveller in you. 

As you step your first foot inside this grand boutique property, you’ll notice how the theme of India prevails – both its past and present. The timeless walls of Narendra Bhawan once housed the last reigning Maharaja of Bikaner, His Highness Narendra Singhji, and showcase a one-of-a-kind legacy. These walls have witnessed the transition of India from the British Raj to Independence, holding within its ambit the memories of the past.

As you inhale the aromas, you’ll be transported to a world of dreams – dreams that you’ll see and experience with open eyes. A set of curated experiences that should be continued, preserved and celebrated will always keep you involved in something or the other. Narendra Bhawan’s majestic façade and the ochre walls of the property reflect the sweet goodbye of the setting sun in the evening. 

The ornate jharokhas and intricately carved walls, balconies and windows share stories from the times of the maharajas. There’s some magic that you’ll feel when you come here for a stay. A natural grace will reflect on your face and entire body – a feeling of relaxation, luxury and peace. This majestic world of opulence speaks of the tales of royalty in every corner. Every experience here is filled with serenity, which is naturally enhanced by the arid landscape of Bikaner.

postcards.name: Embrace Royalty and Wellness in the Landscape of the Thar
postcards.intro: The golden landscape of Bikaner adds unmatched beauty to the royal Narendra Bhawan. There’s something really special about this place, which offers you experiences that will be etched in your heart forever. Come, let’s discover the new definition of luxury and enhance your wellness when you step into this grand haven of countless royal memories.
postcards.story:
Have you ever experienced profound relaxation? Ever felt calm and cool despite being surrounded by the hot and arid Thar Desert? The rustic and ochre outer walls of this boutique hotel will pull you like a magnet to click photographs. And as you capture a picture, the intricate carvings on the walls and windows will join your frame and smile at your camera. It’s time to revel in the enchanting charm of Bikaner.

A sense of tranquillity prevails, and you’ll instantly feel welcomed by the aroma of fresh flowers and incense. Narendra Bhawan's wellness experiences are borrowed from the ancient traditions of Rajasthan. Every wellness therapy offered here harnesses the healing powers of nature augmented with cutting-edge technology, leading to your greater well-being. The spa at this wellness haven is innovative and holistic and gently relaxes and heals your mind, body and spirit. 

Inspired by the famous Bach Flower Therapy, the special Flower Essences are profoundly soothing and help instil harmony and balance. Some therapies improve microcirculation, which will promote both inner and outer radiance, and a variety of ancient oils will soothe you.

The masterpiece of interior design, vintage photo frames, the fragrance of blossoms, antique furniture and the entire vibe promotes serenity. As you step outside after a healing spa session, you’ll feel the emotional vibrations within you – something that will instantly connect you with your inner self!

Many stories await to share the culture, traditions and heritage of Rajasthan with you. Are you ready to sit back, relax and hear them?

name: Fivelements Retreat
intro: Nestled on the banks of the Ayung River, Fivelements Retreat Bali is an award-winning eco-conscious wellness retreat deeply rooted in the ancient traditions of Bali, making it a peaceful sanctuary to embrace authentic Balinese Healing, Plant-based Cuisine and Sacred Arts.

news_article.title: Recharge at Fivelements Retreat Bali
news_article.description: Journey into Bliss along Bali's Beautiful Ayung River

postcards.name: Heal Yourself with a Signature Fivelements Retreat
postcards.intro: Welcome to the Signature Fivelements Retreat – Panca Mahabhuta, a transformative experience dedicated to your regeneration, replenishment and alignment. This healing experience not only guides you in reducing the risk of chronic illnesses but also enhances overall vitality, allowing you to navigate daily challenges with greater resilience.
postcards.story:
Prioritising wellness and healing is crucial for maintaining a stable and fulfilling life. Fivelements Retreat in Bali celebrates the rich tradition of holistic Balinese-inspired therapies administered by local healers, drawing from ancient wisdom passed down through direct lineage. Their approach is rooted in the Balinese principle of Sekala-Niskala, recognising the existence of both the seen or conscious world (Sekala) and the unseen or psychic world (Niskala). During each healing session, the Balinese healers tap into the divine source to bring about profound well-being.

The signature program, the Panca Mahabhuta Retreat, takes a holistic integrative approach to tune in on the physical, emotional and spiritual levels, fostering an organic healing process. This unique journey begins by attuning to your authenticity and honouring your highest potential. Recognising and respecting your individuality, the healers collaborate with you through a personalised Guest Liaison program, guiding and nurturing a healing path that combines Balinese Healing, plant-based cuisine and Sacred Arts.

Under Balinese Healing, you’ll engage in rituals for purification, balancing and regeneration, allowing the ancient practices to restore harmony within. Dining on plant-based cuisine, will nourish your body and invigorate your life, promoting your overall well-being through the goodness of nature. Explore transformative Sacred Arts programs designed to cultivate inner strength, alignment and dedication, providing you with tools for a more mindful and centred life.

Go on a new healing journey with Fivelements, where you’re invited to immerse yourself in the mystic culture of Bali. This is an opportunity for you to discover the profound benefits of holistic healing and find alignment with the rhythms of your authentic self. Investing in wellness and healing is truly an investment in a healthier, more resilient and fulfilling life.

postcards.name: Dine at the Award-Winning Sakti Dining Room
postcards.intro: Indulge in an exceptional dining experience that caters to your well-being at Fivelements Retreat’s Sakti Dining Room. Dining here offers you a chance to relish the thoughtfully prepared, plant-based dishes in a setting that harmonises with the natural beauty of Bali, promoting not just a meal but a holistic experience for your well-being.
postcards.story:
Savour the beauty and pleasure of feeling nourished, experiencing the pure delight of stunning colours in each dish. Enjoy the innovative and life-invigorating cuisine at the award-winning Sakti Dining Room. Nestled between the sacred Ayung River and lush tropical ponds and gardens, the Sakti Dining Room at Fivelements Retreat offers you a modern dining experience in an eco-luxurious setting. 

Balinese cuisine is full of rich flavours that reflect the unique cultural heritage of the island. At the heart of Balinese meals is rice, revered not only as a staple but also as a symbol of sacred significance. The focus here is on epicurean plant-based cuisine, celebrating the essence of aliveness. The goal is straightforward – to let the vibrant tastes, textures, colours and pure flavours of Mother Nature's cuisine take centre stage.

A hallmark of Balinese culinary artistry lies in the use of aromatic spices, herbs and roots. Every dish is crafted with love, passion and thoughtful attention to detail. The menu is designed to provide optimal plant-based nutrition and high energy, creating a gastronomical journey that nurtures your body, mind and soul. This journey begins by sourcing the finest local ingredients at the peak of their growing season.

Supporting local farmers, sustainable agriculture and environmentally friendly products is part of Fivelements’s commitment. You can explore their Signature Chef’s Specialty Tasting Menus, available for both lunch and dinner or opt for the à la carte menu, designed to surprise and delight a diverse range of palates.

Whether it's a refreshing green juice; lemonade; or tempting side dishes like mushroom stir fry, grilled tofu or tempeh, garlic greens stir fry, baked sweet potato, organic red rice and homemade kimchi – the emphasis is on fresh, flavourful and healthy food.

name: Aquila Eco Lodges
intro: ﻿Nestled in the Southern Grampians, surrounded by 100 acres of private bushland, awaits the peace and quiet of Aquila. An off-the-grid ecologically sustainable retreat, Aquila Eco Lodges are your very own modern-day treehouse, connecting you to nature with the comforts of home.

news_article.title: Escape to the Aussie Bush at Aquila Eco Lodges
news_article.description: Luxury Off-the-Grid Treehouses in the Grampians, Victoria, Australia

postcards.name: Enjoy the Glorious Views of the Southern Grampians
postcards.intro: Aquila Eco Lodges showcase nature at its finest, providing you with expansive views of the Southern Grampians and the Great Dividing Range. Whether you're enjoying a quiet moment on your own or sharing the experience with others, the unspoiled views create a sense of tranquillity and appreciation for the simplicity of the natural world.
postcards.story:
If you're an avid traveller seeking a serene escape, the Grampians and the Great Dividing Range invite you to witness their natural charm. A visit to the Aquila Eco Lodges promises to envelop you in a sense of natural bliss, where moments of solitude gently guide you toward introspection. Here, you’re offered a unique connection to nature in Dunkeld, located at the Southern tip of the Grampians and the Great Dividing Range. 

The Grampians National Park, a heritage-listed area, forms part of the Gariwerd Aboriginal cultural landscape, featuring sandstone mountain ranges, diverse wildlife and wildflowers. This bushland sanctuary provides a perfect setting for enjoying scenic views. You can lose yourself in the vastness of the mountains, allowing the cool breeze to sweep away the chaos of everyday life. 

Dunkeld, nestled at the base of Mt. Abrupt and Mt. Sturgeon, serves as a home base for a thriving farming district, marking Victoria's first pastoral settlement. With its rich history, the town echoes tales of the past along the main street, at the bakery or near the old railway station. It's an idyllic and charming destination, offering a grand experience for mindful travellers like you.

As you explore the Grampians, you'll find yourself surrounded by rugged beauty and ancient landscapes. The imposing rock formations stand as silent witnesses to the passage of time, inviting you to reflect on the forces that shaped this timeless terrain.

Whether you choose to hike the trails of the Grampians or drive along the winding roads of the Great Dividing Range, you'll find solace in the simplicity of the natural world. So, as you go on your journey through these landscapes, let these mighty mountains be your guide to a mindful exploration of the world around you.

postcards.name: Stay in a Smoke Bush Treehouse
postcards.intro: Staying in a Smoke Bush treehouse surrounded by nature offers you a unique and grounded experience. The simple design of the treehouse fosters a sense of connection with the surroundings. As you wake up to the sounds of rustling leaves and bird calls, this treehouse offers you a space to appreciate the grandeur of nature.
postcards.story:
Aquila is a remarkable place that you have to see to truly grasp its charm. The unique treehouses at Aquila, recognised for their contemporary design, offer privacy within the property's 100-acre private bushland. Staying in the Smoke Bush treehouse at Aquila Eco Lodges offers you a wonderful experience. The interiors offer grand views of the Southern Grampians, all while being conveniently close to Dunkeld. Smoke Bush, with its two separate bedrooms accommodating four individuals and an optional daybed for an extra person, is an ideal choice for families or groups of friends. 

The simplicity of a treehouse stay adds to its charm. Offering a comfortable and accessible retreat, this treehouse provides ample space for communal moments around the dining table or enjoying a BBQ dinner. Its thoughtful design includes a ground-level bedroom and bathroom for convenience. The treehouse is accessible-friendly, boasting certified measurements to ensure inclusivity. 

Key amenities encompass a fully equipped kitchen, fireplace, evaporative cooler, private patio, Wi-Fi and a convenient coffee maker, ensuring a well-rounded and enjoyable stay. The practicality of these features adds convenience to your experience, allowing you to feel at home during your stay at Aquila Eco Lodges. Interestingly, the surrounding greenery becomes an integral part of your temporary abode, creating a setting that feels authentic. 

When you choose to stay in a Smoke Bush treehouse at Aquila Eco Lodges, you open the door to a multifaceted experience. Your eco-escape at Aquila ensures a comfortable and homey experience. This treehouse not only provides you with a comfortable abode but also serves as a gateway to award-winning restaurants, offering you a chance to savour local flavours and culinary excellence.

name: Plains Camp
intro: The most exclusive villa in the heart of the reserve, Plains Camp is the perfect getaway for families and friends seeking uncompromising privacy and solitude. The villa’s open-plan design, utilising canvas and timber, allows uninterrupted views of the endless plains of the Namibrand reserve. It demands nothing much, but to relax and gaze at the ever-changing colours of the desert.

news_article.title: Disconnect to Reconnect at Wolwedans Plains Camp
news_article.description: Find Serenity in the Stark Beauty of the Namibian Desert

postcards.name: Stay in a Luxurious Villa at the Plains Camp
postcards.intro: Plains Camp at Wolwedans is your special home, asking only for your relaxation as you enjoy the ever-changing colours of the desert. Discover the epitome of exclusivity in the heart of the NamibRand Nature Reserve with this beautiful camp, the ultimate retreat for you, your family and friends seeking unparalleled privacy and peace.
postcards.story:
Imagine waking up to the gentle sounds of nature, with the sun casting a warm glow on your canvas shelter. Here, the focus is on the pure beauty of the surroundings. The expansive desert paints a raw portrait of nature's magnificence. 

Crafted from timber and canvas, this unique villa at Plains Camp seamlessly merges with the desert plains, offering you a blend of indoor and outdoor living. The villa comprises four spacious en-suite rooms, including two master rooms and two luxury rooms, each featuring private 'Wolwedans Chillers'. 

A charming sala room complements the inviting accommodations. The main area boasts a generous deck, a refreshing swimming pool and a central lounge area where you'll find a study room, living room, dining area and a fully equipped kitchen. Your experience is enhanced with the inclusion of a private guide and vehicle, as well as a dedicated villa manager and chef. 

This accommodation is a homey haven designed for mindful travellers like you. The uncluttered charm allows you to appreciate the breathtaking views of the desert. As day turns to night, the simplicity of the design encourages you to connect with the quiet beauty of the landscape. Plains Camp invites you to experience a retreat where luxury meets the vast beauty of the NamibRand Nature Reserve.


Staying in this tranquil section of the reserve, you have the freedom to decide how much or how little you'd like to engage in. As you find yourself surrounded by the undulating dunes and expansive plains, there's an overwhelming feeling of connection with the raw beauty of the desert. Whether it's the warmth of the sun on your face during the day or the brilliance of the stars in the vast night sky, the experience is one of profound tranquillity.

postcards.name: Learn about The AridEden Project when you’re at Plains Camp
postcards.intro: The AridEden Project at Wolwedans is a long-term commitment to shaping a sustainable future. You can actively participate in this project while staying at the Plains Camp. By engaging yourself in this project, you can become an integral contributor to it, actively supporting Wolwedans' vision for a more sustainable, resilient and inclusive future in the Namib Desert.
postcards.story:
Plains Camp sits conveniently close to Wolwedans Village, providing you with the option to engage in The AridEden project and gain a deeper understanding of how Wolwedans operates. Wolwedans considers how tourism functions, who it benefits and how success is measured. The resulting strategy is embodied in The AridEden Project – Wolwedans Vision 2030, a practical framework aimed at developing more sustainable, resilient and inclusive tourism and conservation economies. This framework integrates Wolwedans' 5Cs sustainability commitment (Commerce, Conservation, Community, Culture and Consciousness) with five spheres of engagement for each 'C', all guided by a business philosophy that balances people, planet and profit.

Getting involved in The AridEden Project at Wolwedans is an opportunity for you to contribute to sustainable initiatives in Namibia's desert landscape. People are central to this strategy. Their well-being, development and empowerment are crucial for their success and for the progress of Namibia. Wolwedans nurtures this through vocational training programs, projects supporting the desert-based economy and by instilling a values system throughout their entire team. Consider participating in or supporting these training programs that focus on skill development and empowerment within local communities, fostering economic sustainability and enhancing the well-being of individuals. 

The potential impact of The AridEden Project lies in inspiring others to adopt similar approaches, not only in Namibia but globally – from decision-makers and industry leaders to politicians, educators and youth. Together with Wolwedans, you can raise awareness about local responses to global issues by sharing their journey and showcasing sustainable solutions.

Beyond driving change and promoting a new way, The AridEden Project is about pursuing happiness: content guests like you, a satisfied team and stakeholders and a healthy environment. Now is the best time to join this journey; are you ready to be a part of it?

name: Cranganor History Café & Riverside Château
intro: ‘Cranganor’ History Café & Riverside Château is located in the region of this old port city, which historians and archaeologists are now uncovering to be ancient India’s gateway to civilizations with a history dating back more than 3 millennia.

news_article.title: Welcome to Cranganor History Café & Riverside Château
news_article.description: Journey Through Time in Kerala

postcards.name: Learn About Kerala's Rich Handloom Weaving History
postcards.intro: Kerala’s rich handloom heritage spans thousands of years and to this day weavers work to keep the craft alive while earning a livelihood. Rasmi, the co-founder of Cranganor, is a textile conservationist and a passionate advocate for preserving traditional handloom weaving.
postcards.story:
When her quest eventually led her to Chendamangalam, a village nestled along the serene banks of the river Periyar and a hub of excellence in handloom weaving, she found her calling. For over a decade now, Rasmi has been working with weavers across Kerala, designing and adapting heritage weaving techniques to create new textile forms.
 
Cranganor’s signature Textile Trail meticulously put together by Rasmi, takes you to the roots of the area’s textile traditions while giving you glimpses of the artistry of its talented weavers.  This enchanting trail leads you through Chendamangalam village, where weaving has been a way of life for generations.

The trail begins from Cranganor and the highlight is undoubtedly the visit to the two local co-ops nestled by the riverbank. At the Chendamangalam Weaving Society and Weaving Centre, you will see the age-old craft of handloom weaving thriving amidst modernity. The head weaving master guides you through each meticulous step of the weaving process, from spinning yarn to knotting threads, showcasing generations of skill and passion. On special days, you may even see yarn being stretched across fields in preparation for weaving.

Next, head to Rasmi’s Kaithari Project studio, where woven fabrics are transformed into exquisite outfits. The clothes at the studio are fresh off the loom - made from hand-spun yarn, hand woven into fabric in tiny hamlets just a stone’s throw away from the studio 
This guided tour lasts around four hours and includes travel by boat and car, with stops at heritage locations along the way.

postcards.name: Embark on an Immersive Culinary Journey at the History Café
postcards.intro: Dive into the heart of Kerala’s culinary marvels at the History Cafe, where every bite is a journey through history. Centuries ago, seafarers from Greece, Rome, China, Arabia, Portugal, Holland, and Britain left their flavorful footprints on this coastal paradise. The result? A vibrant fusion of tastes and traditions.
postcards.story:
Savour local Kerala delicacies like karimeen polichatu and Kerala avial, a hearty range of curries and Indian breads, aromatic spices of Arabia and intricate flavours from China. Each dish at the Café is a testament to Kerala’s rich tapestry of global influences and unforgettable gastronomic adventure for you.
 
Breakfast at the Café comprises Indian and International dishes and is on the house. Mango, cashew, sapota, jackfruit, rose apple and pomegranate are grown on the property. Every month, a special all-day A La Carte menu is curated for you.

Meals are made from scratch, with fresh local ingredients and seasonal vegetables and have to be ordered in advance. The River Periyar is a few kilometres from the sea at the site of the chateau so the catch of the day is the best. The famous pearl spot, barramundi, river clam, river red snapper prawns and sailfish here are made in a variety of styles. Don’t forget to try the kitchen favourites of the month as well.
 
Curated meals for groups of eight and above are set-meal menus based on your choice of cuisine. They range from breakfast, a festive Kerala meal, off the grill and an Indian meal to a local Kerala meal.

Local snacks are a favourite at the café and tea time is a feast for the senses. The pazhampori fritters made of banana, Kozhkatta jaggery and coconut dumplings, parippu vada fritters made of lentils and onion fritters can’t be missed, even if your waistline is complaining.

name: Marli Hill Bungalow
intro: As you journey towards Marli Hill Bungalow, winding mountain roads usher you in and the air turns fresher. Sunlight dances across tea gardens, illuminating your path. And then, the bungalow comes into view.

news_article.title: Escape to Marli Hill Bungalow's Timeless Comfort
news_article.description: Modern Comfort in Idyllic Surroundings

postcards.name: Explore Scenic Landscapes on a UNESCO Heritage Train
postcards.intro: Experience the magic of the UNESCO Heritage Train, where breathtaking vistas and historic landmarks await. Discover the beauty on a journey from Mettupalayam to Coonoor, with stops at iconic spots like Dolphins Nose and the Droog. Throughout the journey, you’ll explore quaint stations, each brimming with its own unique charm.
postcards.story:
Imagine yourself aboard the UNESCO Heritage Train, embarking on a journey through the heart of Tamil Nadu’s stunning landscapes. As the train departs from Mettupalayam, you’re instantly enveloped in the lush greenery and misty mountain air that this region is renowned for. The rhythmic chugging of the vintage locomotive sets a serene pace, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the breathtaking scenery.

Your senses come alive as the train meanders through dense forests and tea plantations, the smell of fresh earth and foliage mingling with the crisp mountain air. The first stop at Dolphins Nose offers a spectacular view, where you can marvel at the expansive valley below and feel the gentle breeze against your skin. Here, the distant sound of a waterfall adds to the surreal atmosphere, creating a moment of pure serenity.

As the journey continues, the train climbs higher into the mountains, each bend revealing new and awe-inspiring vistas. You arrive at the Droog, a historic landmark steeped in legend and natural beauty. The sight of the ancient fort, perched precariously on a cliff, evokes a sense of wonder and curiosity. The panoramic views from this vantage point are simply unforgettable, providing a perfect backdrop for your photos and memories.

You’ll encounter friendly locals, taste delicious regional snacks and hear the melodic call of exotic birds. The UNESCO Heritage Train is not just a ride; it’s an experience that connects you with the rich cultural and natural heritage of this region.

By the time you reach Coonoor, you’ll have a treasure trove of memories, a camera full of stunning photos, and a heart full of joy. This journey is more than a trip, it’s an adventure that invites you to savour every moment and appreciate the timeless beauty of the world around you.

postcards.name: Explore British-Era Treasures in Nilgiris
postcards.intro: Step back in time and wander through the charming streets of Nilgiris in Ooty city, retracing the footsteps of British explorers. From St. Stephen’s Church to The Nilgiri Library, uncover the secrets of the British era that still echoes through these historic landmarks. Experience the allure of history come alive as you delve into tales that shaped this picturesque region.
postcards.story:
Begin your heritage walk at the iconic St. Stephen’s Church in the heart of Nilgiris. As you stroll along the cobblestone paths, imagine the bustling life that once surrounded this wonderful city.

 The church’s Gothic architecture stands as a testament to a time when grand designs spoke of a new world being built. Admire the intricate stained-glass windows and the solemn grandeur of the interior, where echoes of past hymns still resonate softly.

Your journey continues to The Nilgiri Library, an architectural gem and a hub of colonial intellect. As you approach, the smell of old books and polished wood fills the air, transporting you to a time when British explorers and scholars gathered to share ideas and discuss their findings. The library’s rich collection and historical ambiance offer a unique window into the past. Consider picking a book and spending a few hours here, just taking in the silence of the place. The library’s quiet corners invite reflection and provide a peaceful escape from the modern world.

Listen closely to the stories whispered by these age-old structures. The echoes of past conversations, the laughter of children playing and the distant hum of exploration come alive. Feel the cool breeze that carries with it tales of a world long gone but never forgotten. 

As you traverse these historic landmarks in Ooty, each step you take is a step closer to understanding the rich history that has shaped this mysterious and stunning landscape.

name: Callicoon Hills
intro: Callicoon Hills is a casual vacation resort nestled in the hamlet of Callicoon Center. With personable hospitality and thoughtful design, we welcome travelers looking to host an event or escape to the Catskills without sacrificing comfort or good company.

news_article.title: Relax, Unwind and Enjoy the Best of Nature at Callicoon Hills
news_article.description: Amidst the Natural Splendour of the Catskills

postcards.name: Discover World-Class Trout Fishing in the Catskills
postcards.intro: Just 10 minutes from Callicoon Hills, Roscoe promises unrivalled trout fishing adventures. Imagine casting your line into the legendary Junction Pool, where the pristine Beaverkill River and Willowemoc Creek merge, creating a haven for trout. This southwestern Catskills gem, surrounded by rugged mountains and clear rivers, offers an angling experience like no other.
postcards.story:
Located amidst the beauty of the Catskills, Roscoe stands out as a premier destination for trout fishing. This region's diverse waterways provide a variety of fishing opportunities that cater to both seasoned anglers and novices alike. Start your journey at the legendary Junction Pool, where the world-renowned Beaverkill River and Willowemoc Creek converge. Known for its exceptional trout fishing, Junction Pool is a hotspot where you can test your skills and reel in some impressive catches.

Just a short ride west of Roscoe, you'll discover the East Branch, West Branch and the Main Stem of the Delaware River. These rivers are celebrated for their abundant trout populations and offer a rich variety of fishing experiences. The East Branch is perfect for those seeking a more serene and secluded fishing spot, while the West Branch is famous for its challenging currents and rewarding catches. The Main Stem, combining the best of both branches, provides a diverse fishing environment with ample opportunities to land a trophy trout.

The picturesque setting of Roscoe enhances the fishing experience, making each trip not just about the catch but also about connecting with nature. Rugged mountains, clear rivers and lakes create an idyllic backdrop for a day of fishing. Whether you're fly fishing in the swift currents or casting a line in a calm, glassy lake, the beauty of the Catskills surrounds you, adding to the allure of the adventure.

In Roscoe, the fishing experience goes beyond the thrill of the catch. It's about immersing yourself in a region blessed with natural splendour and finding peace in its pristine landscapes. We suggest you pack your gear, head to the Catskills and discover why Roscoe is a haven for fishing enthusiasts from around the world!

postcards.name: Explore the Charming Town of Livingston Manor
postcards.intro: Experience the town of Livingston Manor, a hidden gem close to your boutique stay of Callicoon Hills in the Catskill Mountains. Explore Main Street's vibrant dining and shopping scene, join the annual 'trout parade' in June, and delve into the birthplace of American fly fishing at the Catskill Fly Fishing Center and Museum.
postcards.story:
What if we told you that during your stay at Callicoon Hill, you can explore Livingston Manor, a short 15-minute drive away? This charming town is not just a destination but a cherished experience in upstate New York.

In Livingston Manor, Main Street hosts locally-owned shops and inviting cafes and galleries showcasing regional artistry. Imagine strolling here, just like the locals do — it's an experience that truly captures the local lifestyle.

The community thrives with warmth and camaraderie, especially during the annual 'Trout Parade' each June, a vibrant celebration of Livingston Manor's rich heritage as the birthplace of American fly fishing.

While exploring the town, learn about the story of fly fishing at the Catskill Fly Fishing Center and Museum. Located on the northern edge of town, this institution honours the art, science and tradition of fly fishing through interactive exhibits and historical artefacts. This is where you can gain insight into how this quiet town on the Willowemoc River became synonymous with a sport cherished by anglers worldwide.

For those seeking outdoor adventure, a visit to Upward Brewing on the expansive "Beer Mountain" preserve is a must. A scenic hike through wooded trails that wind up the mountain slopes offers panoramic views of the Catskills at every turn. At the summit, Upward Brewing awaits - a rustic brewery perched atop the landscape. Here, you can savour locally brewed beers crafted with care, perfectly paired with sweeping vistas that stretch across the rolling hills and valleys below.

Livingston Manor is not only blessed with natural beauty but also with its welcoming spirit and rich culture. Whether you're indulging in farm-to-table dining, exploring historic landmarks or casting a line into the Willowemoc River, Livingston Manor is worth the trip.

name: Camp Comfort
intro: Originally built as an athletics club and bowling alley in the early 1860’s, Camp Comfort is another charming boutique property located in the heart of Comfort, Texas. This historic property has been lovingly restored and transformed into a cozy retreat, offering guests a unique blend of rustic charm and modern comfort.

news_article.title: Embrace Nature at Camp Comfort
news_article.description: A Cosy Retreat in the Heart of Comfort, Texas

postcards.name: Take a Texas Hill Country Wine-Tasting Tour
postcards.intro: Visit Texas Hill Country's renowned wineries, just moments from your doorstep at Camp Comfort. Whisk yourself  away to lush vineyards where each sip tells a story of passion and perseverance. This experience is sure to add value and memories to your vacation, complementing your stay at Camp Comfort.
postcards.story:
Sign up for a wine-tasting adventure, surrounded by rolling hills adorned with rows of grapevines stretching as far as the eye can see.. At Camp Comfort, your hosts curate an exclusive experience for you, partnering with nearby Texas Hill Country wineries to offer a behind-the-scenes glimpse into the artistry of winemaking.

Picture yourself stepping into a rustic tasting room, where the air is perfumed with the earthy aroma of ageing barrels and the faint murmur of winemakers discussing their craft. Your knowledgeable guide, a local connoisseur, leads you through tastings of robust reds and crisp whites, each glass revealing the terroir of this distinctive region.

As you sip, you learn about the pioneering spirit of Texas winegrowers, who have transformed this arid landscape into a haven for viticulture, rivalling renowned European regions. The wineries here boast a dedication to sustainability and innovation, reflected in every glass poured.

Outside, vine-covered trellises cast dappled shadows over quaint courtyards, inviting you to linger and savour the moment. Perhaps you'll join a guided tour of the vineyards, where the winemaker herself shares insights into grape cultivation and harvest techniques.

Whether you're a seasoned oenophile or simply curious to explore, this Texas Hill Country winery experience promises a sensory feast that lingers long after your glass is empty. 

After a day immersed in the rich flavours and stories of Texas Hill Country wines, return to Camp Comfort, where the surroundings enhance the memories you've made. Savour the evening with a glass of your favourite wine by the fire pit, under a blanket of stars that mirror the sparkle in your glass until you’re ready to call it a day!

postcards.name: Get Ready for the Ultimate Biking Escapade!
postcards.intro: Embark on an exhilarating mountain biking journey through the rugged splendour of Flat Rock Ranch, a quick drive from Camp Comfort. Explore 29 miles of thrilling trails that wind through the stunning landscapes of Texas Hill Country, offering breathtaking views and exciting challenges sure to get your heart racing.
postcards.story:
During your stay at Camp Comfort, your ultimate mountain biking escapade awaits at Flat Rock Ranch, situated amidst 1,300 acres of untamed terrain. Picture yourself navigating winding trails that meander through oak-studded hills and expansive valleys, each turn revealing a new panorama of the Hill Country's natural splendour.

As you pedal through this rugged playground, you'll encounter diverse terrain suited for all skill levels - from heart-pounding hill climbs to exhilarating downhill stretches and technical single tracks that test your agility.
