Creek crossings add an extra thrill, where you might pause to soak in the serenity of clear waters babbling beneath your wheels.

The experienced guides accompanying you, passionate about both biking and the land they traverse, ensure a safe and memorable journey. They'll tailor the experience to your preferences, whether you crave an adrenaline rush or seek a leisurely exploration of nature's wonders.

After an exhilarating ride, return to Camp Comfort where amenities await to relax tired muscles and renew your energy. Picture yourself unwinding by the crackling campfire, the scent of pine mingling with the warmth of your company as you recount the day's thrilling escapades. The starlit sky above offers a tranquil backdrop, each twinkling star a testament to the exhilaration and serenity found in the heart of Texas Hill Country.

Whether you're a seasoned rider seeking new challenges or a beginner eager to explore, your mountain biking experience at Flat Rock Ranch promises an unforgettable blend of adrenaline, scenery and camaraderie. This experience offers a gateway to the boundless beauty and adventure of Texas Hill Country.

name: Mountain Lodges of Peru
intro: Passion, reciprocity, expertise, and professionalism—we are the pioneers of luxury lodge-to-lodge travel and unique cultural connections in the Andean Highlands to Machu Picchu and beyond.

news_article.title: Go on a Journey of a Lifetime with Mountain Lodges Peru
news_article.description: Experience Unforgettable Adventures in the Andes

postcards.name: Take an Archeoastronomy Journey to Machu Picchu
postcards.intro: The archaeoastronomy journey to Machu Picchu organised by Mountain Lodges Peru offers you a unique opportunity to delve into the rich history and cosmic connections of the Andean civilisations. This adventure is designed to provide a deep understanding of how the ancient Incas aligned their architecture with the stars, transforming their sacred sites into living stone calendars.
postcards.story:
Go on an unforgettable journey to the ancient city of Cusco and its remarkable surroundings with Mountain Lodges Peru. During the autumn or spring equinox, come for an exploration that combines breathtaking views, thrilling excursions and enlightening lectures led by experts in the field. 

Your journey begins in Cusco, the historic heart of the Inca Empire. Here, you’ll explore the city’s well-preserved streets and squares, visiting significant sites like the Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun) and the impressive fortress of Sacsayhuamán. These locations provide a perfect introduction to the Inca’s sophisticated understanding of astronomy and their deep spiritual connection to the cosmos.

As you travel through the Sacred Valley, you’ll visit unique archaeological sites that are renowned for their precise stonework and strategic alignments with celestial events. Guided by experts, you’ll learn how the Incas used these alignments to mark important agricultural and ceremonial dates, ensuring the prosperity of their civilisation.

One of the highlights of this journey is the visit to Machu Picchu, the iconic lost city of the Incas. Located high in the Andes, Machu Picchu offers you a stunning example of Inca ingenuity and their reverence for the cosmos. 

As you wander through the ancient citadel, you’ll discover how its structures are perfectly aligned with the solstices and equinoxes, turning the city into a complex astronomical observatory. This hands-on experience brings to life the fascinating world of Andean archaeoastronomy.

This archaeoastronomy journey is a chance to connect with the profound wisdom of the Andean civilisations and understand how their connection to the cosmos shaped their culture and beliefs. Come and stay at Mountain Lodges Peru for an inspiring adventure that combines history, mythology and the stunning natural beauty of Peru.

postcards.name: Delve into a Wellness and Yoga Experience
postcards.intro: Join an eight-day yoga and wellness experience with Mountain Lodges Peru. This journey is a perfect integration of exhilarating hikes, wellness workshops and focused yoga practices, all set against the stunning backdrop of the Andes. What makes this adventure truly special is the meaningful cultural immersion and interaction with the Andean neighbours, providing a holistic journey like no other.
postcards.story:
Your journey begins in Cusco, the historical heart of the Inca Empire. Here, ancient temples and stone structures, aligned with the stars, offer a glimpse into a civilisation deeply connected to the cosmos. This setting is ideal for reconnecting with your inner self. 

Daily yoga and meditation sessions are designed to ground you and enhance your physical and mental well-being. These practices are not just exercises but are also powerful tools for living a balanced and mindful life, helping you find peace and clarity amidst the rush of modern life. 

As you travel through the Sacred Valley, you’ll participate in wellness workshops led by experienced instructors. These sessions cover various aspects of holistic health, from nutrition to mindfulness practices. You'll learn practical techniques to integrate wellness into your daily life, ensuring long-term benefits beyond the journey.

The hikes are tailored to all fitness levels and lead you through breathtaking landscapes, from lush valleys to towering mountains. Each hike is an opportunity to connect with nature and reflect on the beauty around you. Along the way, you'll visit local communities, where you'll interact with Andean families and learn about their traditions and way of life. This cultural exchange enriches the experience, offering a deeper understanding of the Andean spirit and its cordial relationship with nature.

A highlight of the journey is the visit to Machu Picchu. This iconic site, located high in the Andes, is not only a marvel of Inca engineering but also a place of deep spiritual significance. Guided tours of the citadel reveal its intricate design and alignment with celestial events, transforming it into a living reflection of the Inca’s advanced knowledge and spirituality. 

Practising yoga and meditation in such a powerful setting is a transformative experience, heightening your connection to the earth and the cosmos.

name: Dunya Camp
intro: High above 42 acres of a pine-filled tree line sits six luxury tents that will transport you to a world away. The seclusion blended with Dunya Camp's luxury touches make this outdoor hotel truly one-of-a-kind.

news_article.title: Stay High Above the Pine Forests at Dunya Camp
news_article.description: A Unique Camp Offering Seclusion and Luxury

postcards.name: Witness the Beauty of the Little River Canyon National Park
postcards.intro: Visiting the Little River Canyon National Park is an experience that brings you close to nature while offering a sense of peace and adventure. Each morning, the fresh scent of pine and the sound of birds greet you as you step out of your tent. Come and experience nature at its best.
postcards.story:
One of the highlights of Little River Canyon is the breathtaking views from the canyon rims. From Dunya Camp, it’s just a short drive to various overlooks where you can gaze across the expansive canyon. 

The sight of the canyon, with its dramatic cliffs and winding river, is simply stunning. Photographers and nature lovers alike will find endless inspiration here.

Hiking is a must-do activity in the park. There are miles of wooded trails that take you through diverse landscapes. One of the most enjoyable hikes is the Canyon Mouth Park Trail. It’s an easy walk that offers plenty of spots to rest and take in the scenery. 

The trail leads to a beautiful area by the river where you can relax on the sandy banks or take a dip in the cool, clear water.

Waterfalls are another major attraction. Little River Falls is particularly impressive. It’s easily accessible and provides a perfect spot for a picnic. Sitting by the falls, listening to the roar of the water and feeling the mist on your face is incredibly refreshing. 

For a bit more adventure, try the hike to Grace’s High Falls. This trail is a bit more challenging but worth it for the view of one of the tallest waterfalls in Alabama.

If you enjoy rock climbing, the park’s sandstone cliffs provide excellent opportunities. The boulders and cliffs around Little River Canyon are popular with climbers of all skill levels. Even if you’re not a climber, watching others scale the cliffs is thrilling. 

This National Park offers a mix of peace and adventure, making every moment memorable. Immerse yourself in nature's offerings and let the fresh breeze relax you. 

Unquestionably, the Little River Canyon National Park is the place to be when you stay at Dunya Camp.

postcards.name: Feel the Spray of DeSoto Falls
postcards.intro: Staying at Dunya Camp makes a visit to DeSoto Falls an enjoyable and memorable experience. The camp is comfortable and welcoming, providing an ideal starting point for your adventure. The DeSoto Falls is a fun and exciting place to explore with your family and friends.
postcards.story:
DeSoto Falls, named after the famed explorer Hernando de Soto, is a must-see. The trail to the falls is family-friendly and offers a scenic walk through the forest. 

The path is well-marked and not too challenging, making it suitable for people of all ages. Along the way, you can see beautiful views and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

The highlight of the trail is, of course, DeSoto Falls itself. As you approach, you can hear the sound of rushing water, which builds the excitement. When you finally see the waterfall, it’s breathtaking. The water cascades down a tall rock face into a clear pool below. It’s a perfect spot for taking photos or just sitting and enjoying the view.

There are plenty of spots around the falls where you can sit and relax. If you come prepared for a picnic, this is a great place to have lunch. The area around the falls is well-maintained, with benches and tables available. 

It’s a peaceful place to spend some time, whether you’re eating, reading or just enjoying the beauty of the falls.

If you’re an adventure lover, the pool at the base of the falls is a great place for a swim. The water is cool and refreshing, especially on a warm day. 

Kids and adults alike will enjoy splashing around and playing in the water. It’s a fun way to cool off and adds to the enjoyment of the visit.

Overall, visiting DeSoto Falls while staying at Dunya Camp is a delightful experience. The combination of a scenic trail, a beautiful waterfall and a family-friendly atmosphere makes it a perfect outing for people of all ages. 

Whether you’re an active explorer or a slow traveller, DeSoto Falls offers something for everyone.

name: The Bygone
intro: A recently transformed vintage roadside motor lodge into an elevated boutique hotel. The location is unmatched, with stunning hilltop views of the Blanco Valley, just 3 miles from the historic Wimberley Square.

news_article.title: Embrace Wild Wonders at The Bygone
news_article.description: A Vintage Boutique Hotel in Texas

postcards.name: Take a Refreshing Dip at Jacob’s Well
postcards.intro: Jacob's Well is a unique 81-acre park known for its stunning artesian spring and the second-largest fully submerged cave in Texas. Your adventure begins with a short drive from the charming comfort of The Bygone to this natural wonder.
postcards.story:
Upon arrival at Jacob's Well, you’re greeted by the sight of clear, cool water bubbling up from the depths of the spring. The well itself is a deep, natural pool that invites curiosity. 

For those keen on swimming, the refreshing water offers a perfect escape from the Texas heat. Diving into the crystal-clear spring, you can feel the rush of cool water enveloping you, a stark contrast to the warm air outside.

For thrill-seekers, Jacob's Well is an excellent spot for free diving. The cave below the spring is an exciting challenge for experienced divers. While it's not for the faint-hearted, diving into the depths and exploring the underwater cave system is a one-of-a-kind experience. 

However, even for non-divers, watching others explore the well can be quite wonderful.

The surrounding parkland offers plenty of opportunities for hiking and nature walks. The trails around Jacob's Well wind through beautiful Hill Country scenery, with opportunities to spot local wildlife and enjoy the diverse plant life. 

Educational tours are available and highly recommended. They provide insight into the history and geology of Jacob's Well, enriching your visit with fascinating facts about the aquifer system that feeds the spring and the ecological significance of the area. 

Knowledgeable guides share stories of the well's discovery and its importance to the local community.

After a day of exploration, returning to The Bygone feels like coming home. You can relax in the homey, rustic ambience of the hotel, reflecting on the day’s adventures. 

Whether you’re lounging in the garden or enjoying a quiet evening on the porch, The Bygone offers a perfect end to a day spent in nature. 

Visiting Jacob's Well combines adventure, relaxation and learning, making it a memorable experience for everyone.

postcards.name: Soar Through the Sky on a Wimberley Ziplining Adventure
postcards.intro: One of the most exciting activities near the Bygone is the Wimberley Ziplining Adventure, a must-try experience that will give you a fresh perspective on the beautiful Texas Hill Country. It is surely a wonderful mix of comfort and adventure. Are you all set to enjoy the breeze of thrill on your face?
postcards.story:
The Wimberley Ziplining Adventure is just a short drive away from your hotel, making it a convenient excursion from your homey base. 

Upon arrival, you’re greeted by friendly staff who guide you through the preparation process. They provide all the necessary gear and safety instructions, ensuring that even first-timers feel comfortable and confident.

Once you're harnessed up and ready to go, the anticipation builds as you climb to the first platform. The moment you step off and soar into the air, a rush of excitement and adrenaline hits. 

The zipline takes you over canyons and creeks, offering breathtaking views of the Wimberley Valley that stretch for miles. 

The sensation of flying, combined with the stunning scenery, creates a feeling of freedom and exhilaration.
There are several lines in the course, each offering a unique perspective of the landscape below. 

Between zips, you walk along well-maintained trails to the next launch point. These short hikes give you time to enjoy the natural beauty up close and share the experience with fellow adventurers.

Throughout the tour, the guides share interesting tidbits about the local flora and fauna, as well as the history of the area. Their knowledge and enthusiasm add an extra layer of enjoyment to the experience, making it both thrilling and educational. They also make sure to capture your moments of flight with photos, so you can relive the excitement long after the day is over.

After completing the zipline course, you return to The Bygone, where the relaxing ambience of the hotel awaits. Staying here and experiencing the Wimberley Ziplining Adventure provides a balanced mix of thrill and peace. 

It’s an ideal way to explore the natural beauty of the area, get your adrenaline pumping and return to a welcoming and comfortable retreat.

name: Onera
intro: A one-of-a-kind landscape hotel located in Texas Hill Country's Wine Region, just steps away from downtown Fredericksburg. Onera Fredericksburg maintains focus on nature, sustainability and mindfulness. Become fully immersed in nature with all the luxuries of modern living.

news_article.title: Choose a Nature-Inspired Forest Home at Onera
news_article.description: Your Artful Retreat in Texas Hill Country's Wine Region

postcards.name: Go Wine Tasting in Texas Hill Country
postcards.intro: Visit the Texas Hill Country wineries and step into a world where nature and craftsmanship converge to produce exceptional wines. Spanning approximately 1,000 acres, the vineyards thrive amidst the beautiful landscape, offering a taste of varietals that rival those from renowned wine regions like France, Italy and Spain.
postcards.story:
Exploring the wineries at Texas Hill Country is a journey to remember. Wine growers in this region embrace the challenges posed by the unique terroir — soil, climate and terrain — to cultivate grapes that yield distinctive flavours. 

Each winery you visit reveals a story of passion and expertise, as winemakers carefully nurture their vines and craft wines that reflect the character of the land.

At Onera, you can immerse yourself in this rich winemaking heritage through tours and tastings. Discover the art of winemaking firsthand as you tour vineyards where grapes bask in the Texas sun. 

Learn about the thoughtful process from vine to bottle, gaining insights into the techniques that enhance the flavours and aromas unique to Texas Hill Country wines.

Tasting rooms at the wineries offer you a chance to sample a variety of wines, from crisp whites to robust reds. Savour the nuances of each wine, appreciating how the distinct terroir influences its profile. 

Whether you prefer a bold Tempranillo or a refreshing Viognier, there’s a wine to suit every palate.

Beyond the wine, the wineries often boast stunning views of rolling hills and vine-covered landscapes. Enjoy walks through the vineyards or relax on shaded patios, soaking in the beauty of the surroundings. 

Some wineries also offer picnicking areas where you can pair your favourite wine with local cheese and charcuterie.

Back at Onera, evenings are perfect for reflecting on the day’s discoveries over a glass of your favourite Texas wine. Share stories of vineyard tours, favourite tastings and the beauty of the Hill Country landscape. 

The experience at Texas Hill Country Wineries and Onera is a wonderful combination of nature’s beauty and the artistry of winemaking, creating memories that stay long after you leave.

postcards.name: Visit Enchanted Rock State Natural Area
postcards.intro: Visit Enchanted Rock State Natural Area and encounter a natural wonder that captures your attention with its massive pink granite dome towering over 400 feet above the landscape. This iconic landmark offers a unique hiking experience where you can trek to the summit for breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding terrain.
postcards.story:
Exploring Enchanted Rock means immersing yourself in a landscape shaped by ancient geological forces. The hike to the top of the dome presents a moderate challenge, rewarded by expansive views that stretch as far as the eye can see. 

From the summit, you can observe the rugged beauty of the Hill Country, dotted with oak and juniper trees and perhaps catch sight of native wildlife.

The park boasts a network of trails that cater to various interests and skill levels. Wander through oak groves and past delicate wildflowers or venture among the intriguing rock formations that dot the terrain. 

Each trail offers a chance to connect with nature and discover the unique flora and fauna that thrive in this rugged environment.
If you’re interested in geology, Enchanted Rock provides a fascinating glimpse into its formation and the forces that shaped it over millions of years. 

The exposed granite surfaces reveal intricate patterns and textures, showcasing the natural artistry of erosion and weathering.
Climbing Enchanted Rock during different times of the day offers distinct experiences. Sunrise and sunset cast warm colours over the landscape, creating a magical atmosphere. 

Evenings are perfect for stargazing, with the dome providing an ideal vantage point for observing the night sky away from city lights. This adventure is unforgettable, inviting you to return time and again for its lasting fun and excitement.

Back at Onera, reflect on the beautiful views, the serenity of the trails and the sense of accomplishment that comes from reaching the summit. 

The experience at Enchanted Rock State Natural Area and Onera combines natural beauty with outdoor exploration, offering a memorable escape into the heart of Texas Hill Country. Are you ready to celebrate the explorer in you?

name: Terramor Outdoor Resort
intro: Refinement, Unpaved. Where each day is an opportunity for discovery, at your own pace; where each stay offers a fresh and unique experience, each in a different natural landscape. Where the true feeling of the outdoors is complimented by elevated service, and comfortable touches that surprise and delight.

news_article.title: Chill Out at Terramor Outdoor Resort
news_article.description: Glamping in Beautiful Bar Harbor, Maine

postcards.name: See Stunning Views from Cadillac Mountain
postcards.intro: Visiting Cadillac Mountain from Terramor Outdoor Resort is an unforgettable experience deeply rooted in Acadia National Park's natural beauty. As the highest point along the eastern seaboard accessible by car, Cadillac Mountain rewards early risers with stunning sunrise views. Don’t forget to click pictures of the stunning views!
postcards.story:
Cadillac Mountain is a must-visit during your stay at Terramor Outdoor Resort. It's the perfect place to witness nature at its finest. The journey to Cadillac Mountain begins with a scenic drive from Terramor Outdoor Resort through Acadia's winding roads. 

Arriving at the summit, you're greeted by expansive views that stretch across the park and out to the Atlantic Ocean. 

The quiet morning air and panoramic scenery create a serene atmosphere, perfect for reflecting and appreciating nature's beauty. Set out early to catch the first light touching the United States, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink over the glaciated coastal and island landscape below.

Hiking trails around Cadillac Mountain offer opportunities to explore the surrounding wilderness. Walk along the paths lined with rugged granite and wildflowers or challenge yourself with more adventurous routes that lead to hidden viewpoints. 

The diversity of trails ensures there's something for every explorer, whether seeking solitude or seeking panoramic views.

During your visit, learn about the park's ecological significance and geological history. Cadillac Mountain's formation during the last ice age is evident in its smooth granite surfaces and distinctive landscape features. 

Interpretive signs along the trails provide insights into the region's natural processes and conservation efforts, highlighting Acadia National Park's commitment to preserving its unique environment.

After a morning of exploration, return to Terramor Outdoor Resort where you can unwind and reflect on your Cadillac Mountain adventure. 

Share stories of the sunrise and scenic views over a hearty meal, perhaps featuring locally sourced ingredients that celebrate Maine's culinary traditions. 

The experience at Cadillac Mountain and Terramor Outdoor Resort offers a combination of natural wonder and outdoor adventure, inviting you to connect with Acadia's beauty in a meaningful and memorable way.

postcards.name: Cruise through an Oyster Farm
postcards.intro: When staying at Terramor Outdoor Resort, a visit to Bar Harbor Oyster Company offers you a unique and delicious taste of Maine's coastal bounty. Going on a kayak tour through the oyster farm provides an immersive experience of the region's aquaculture. As you paddle through the serene waters, you'll witness firsthand how oysters are cultivated and harvested.
postcards.story:
The oysters at Bar Harbor Oyster Company are renowned for their freshness and flavour. During the tour, you'll see rows of oyster beds where these mollusks thrive in the nutrient-rich waters of Maine's coast. 

The guides share insights into oyster farming practices, explaining how sustainable methods contribute to the ecosystem's health while ensuring top-quality seafood.

Sampling the oysters straight from the farm is a highlight of the experience. Their juicy, briny taste reflects the pristine waters they grow in, offering a true taste of the sea. Whether you're a seafood enthusiast or trying oysters for the first time, the freshness and quality are sure to impress. 

Try some oysters right there at the barge, freshly taken out of the water. These may be some of the best oysters you'll ever taste — super creamy and bursting with flavour.

Beyond the culinary experience, the kayak tour allows you to appreciate Maine's natural beauty from a unique perspective. Glide through tranquil waters surrounded by rugged coastline and lush forests. 

Keep an eye out for local wildlife, from seabirds to marine life, adding to the adventure.

Visiting Bar Harbor Oyster Company isn't just about enjoying a meal but also about connecting with the coastal environment and understanding the importance of sustainable seafood practices. 

Learning about the lifecycle of oysters and their role in Maine's culinary heritage enriches your understanding of the region's culture and economy.

Back at Terramor Outdoor Resort, reflect on the flavours, sights and experiences of the day, knowing that your visit supported local aquaculture and environmental stewardship. 

The excursion to Bar Harbor Oyster Company offers a memorable integration of adventure, education and culinary delight — a quintessential Maine experience during your stay at Terramor.

name: The Alpine House
intro: The Alpine House is where the great outdoors meets modern comfort. Our Jackson Hole hotel pairs local rustic design with plush comforts and a laid-back atmosphere surrounded by the mountains.

news_article.title: Seek Respite at The Alpine House in Jackson Hole
news_article.description: A Perfect Place to Relax or Enjoy the Outdoors

postcards.name: Admire Nature at Yellowstone National Park
postcards.intro: Yellowstone National Park is a haven for wildlife enthusiasts and you cannot miss taking your camera with you for some exceptional photographs. The Alpine House in Jackson offers you a great chance to explore the wonders of this incredible place. It’s time to go on an adventure to one of America's most iconic national parks.
postcards.story:
As you drive from The Alpine House to Yellowstone, the anticipation builds. The journey itself is scenic, with snow-capped mountains and lush forests lining the route. 

Once you enter the park, the first stop might be Old Faithful, one of Yellowstone's most famous attractions. Watching this geyser erupt is a mesmerising experience, with water shooting high into the air against the backdrop of the vast blue sky. 

It's a sight that never gets old, no matter how many times you've seen it.

Next, you could wander around the many hot springs, marvelling at their vibrant colours. The deep blues, bright greens and fiery oranges of these geothermal pools are stunning and create an almost otherworldly landscape. 

A visit to the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone is a must. Standing at Artist’s Point, you can take in the breathtaking view of the canyon's pink and yellow walls. 

The sight of the waterfall cascading down into the canyon is wonderful and provides a great opportunity to sit quietly and appreciate nature's beauty.

Whether you're driving through the park or hiking one of its many trails, there's a good chance you'll spot some of the park's famous wildlife.

Seeing a grizzly bear foraging, a herd of bison grazing or an eagle soaring overhead is an experience that stays with you. Your guide or park ranger can provide fascinating insights into the lives of these animals and the ecosystem they inhabit.

Yellowstone also offers thrilling activities like whitewater rafting on its rivers. The rush of navigating the rapids is exhilarating and provides a unique way to see the park from a different perspective. 

Visiting Yellowstone National Park is an enriching journey into some of the most beautiful and wild parts of America.

postcards.name: Sign up for a Snowmobile Tour
postcards.intro: Staying at The Alpine House in Jackson sets the stage for an incredible snowmobile tour experience. Here, you’ll experience one of the best snowmobile tours of your life. Located in the heart of Jackson, this charming inn offers a homey, welcoming retreat after a day of snowmobile adventures.
postcards.story:
As you begin gearing up for a snowmobile tour, get ready to explore the breathtaking winter landscapes of Jackson. Once you meet your guide and get fitted with all the necessary gear, you're off to the trails. 

The initial thrill of the engine roaring to life and the crisp, cold air against your face is invigorating. 

As you glide over the snow, the scenery unfolds before you – vast expanses of snow-covered meadows, towering mountain peaks and glistening frozen lakes. It's a scene straight out of a winter postcard.

If you’re a beginner, the guides are incredibly supportive, making sure you feel comfortable and safe on your snowmobile. They provide tips and instructions, so even if it's your first time, you'll quickly get the hang of it. 

For more experienced riders, the guides can take you on more challenging routes, adding a dose of excitement to your adventure.

One of the highlights of the tour is the chance to spot wildlife. Jackson is home to a variety of animals and it's not uncommon to see elk, deer or even moose wandering through the snow. 

Your guide will share interesting facts about the local wildlife and ecosystem, enriching your experience.

Midway through the tour, you'll likely stop at a scenic spot to take a break. Here, you can snap some photos, enjoy a warm drink and soak in the stunning surroundings. 

The silence of the snow-covered wilderness, broken only by the occasional call of a bird or the sound of an animal, is profoundly peaceful.

As the tour concludes and you head back to The Alpine House, there's a sense of satisfaction and joy. A snowmobile tour is truly an unforgettable journey through some of America's most stunning winter landscapes.

name: Outbound Mammoth
intro: Outbound Mammoth is an all season alpine retreat near the Sierra Nevada Mountains. Select from an array of lodging types excellent for groups, events and family holidays. With an array of onsite dining and weekly local events, come together for good vibes and good times at the doorstep to an epic outdoor adventure.

news_article.title: Find Four Seasons of Fun at Outbound Mammoth in California's Eastern Sierras
news_article.description: A New Jewel in Nook's Collection of Boutique Outdoor Hotels

postcards.name: Find Your Fun at Mammoth Mountain
postcards.intro: If you’re planning a trip to Mammoth Mountain, staying at Outbound Mammoth can elevate your experience from great to unforgettable. Located in the heart of the Inyo National Forest, this resort offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience and adventure for every winter sports enthusiast. Are you ready to conquer the mighty Mammoth Mountain?
postcards.story:
Imagine waking up to the fresh mountain breeze and the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountain peaks. Outbound Mammoth’s proximity to the mountain means you can be the first one carving fresh tracks on the 3,500 acres of diverse terrain. With easy access to the ski lifts, you can spend less time commuting and more time enjoying the snow. 

Mammoth Mountain is a paradise for skiers and snowboarders of all levels. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, the 28 lifts and 173 trails offer something for everyone. Beginners can take lessons from experienced instructors and practice on gentle slopes, while advanced riders can challenge themselves on the steeper runs and terrain parks. One of the highlights is the Unbound Terrain Parks, known for their innovative features and thoughtfully groomed jumps and rails.

If you’re up for more adventure, there’s plenty to do beyond skiing and snowboarding. Snowshoeing and cross-country skiing trails provide a different way to experience the stunning winter landscape. Every moment on Mammoth Mountain pushes your limits and offers you a chance to revel in the pure joy of winter adventure.
 
Who doesn't love mountains? Their mighty presence grounds us, while their beauty inspires us and reminds us of nature's wonders. Mountains stand as a symbol of strength and serenity, inviting us to explore and appreciate the natural world's incredible offerings.

If you’re looking to take a break from the cold, the Mammoth Lakes area is rich in history and natural beauty, with hot springs and scenic drives that are worth exploring.
A trip to Mammoth Mountain, especially when staying at Outbound Mammoth, offers you a balanced mix of excitement and relaxation. This beautiful destination is sure to leave you with lasting memories and a yearning to return.

postcards.name: Enjoy Delicious Americana Food at The Warming Hut
postcards.intro: When staying at Outbound Mammoth, make sure to check out The Warming Hut for a memorable dining experience. This all-day scratch kitchen, loved by locals and visitors alike, offers delicious Americana food with incredible cocktails. The Warming Hut has seating available for all seasons, making it a perfect spot no matter the weather.
postcards.story:
Eating at The Warming Hut is a great part of the Mammoth experience. From the moment you step into The Warming Hut, you’ll feel right at home. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with a friendly staff ready to serve you fresh, authentic food at an affordable price. The emphasis here is on quality and taste, with every dish prepared with care and attention to detail. It's a place where you can relax and enjoy a hearty breakfast, a delicious lunch, a lively happy hour or a comforting home-cooked dinner.

For breakfast, you can't go wrong with their pancakes served with Jake’s Family 100 per cent pure maple syrup. This syrup, tapped straight from Vermont trees and bottled right in Mammoth Lakes, adds a special taste to every bite. Be sure to grab a bottle to take home as a sweet reminder of your visit.

Lunch and dinner offer a variety of mouth-watering options. If you’re a fan of sandwiches, their reuben is a must-try. The slow-cooked corned beef, made in-house, is tender and flavourful, perfectly paired with sauerkraut, gruyere Swiss cheese and house-made thousand island dressing, all sandwiched between two slices of grilled rye bread. It’s so good, it might just be the best reuben this side of the Mississippi.

Another standout is the mountain Cuban. This sandwich takes a classic to new heights with slow-cooked corned beef, thinly sliced ham, dill pickles, dijon mustard and gruyere Swiss cheese grilled on a brioche bun. The combination of flavours is simply irresistible, making it a favourite among regulars.

Beyond the food, The Warming Hut is a place to unwind and enjoy the company of friends and family. The casual, laid-back vibe invites you to hang out, savouring good food and great conversations.

name: Bandhavgarh Jungle Lodge
intro: The fragrance of lemongrass pierces the air in Bandhavgarh Jungle Lodge while tall bamboo branches and fruit trees extend a warm welcome to guests arriving in this charming, 18-room lodge built by the Sankhalas, a celebrated family of conservationists. The lodge is eco-conscious and for that reason, it’s a favourite among travellers who advocate forest conservation.

news_article.title: Visit as a Tourist, Return as a Conservationist at Bandhavgarh Jungle Lodge
news_article.description: An Abode Located In The Middle of Lush Greenery

postcards.name: Sign Up For Culinary Classes
postcards.intro: Discover the vibrant flavours of Madhya Pradesh's cuisine through the fun and interactive culinary classes. As you enjoy the delicious meals in the dining hall, you'll want to recreate these flavours at home. That's where these classes come in! Led by Sadhvi and her team, you'll dive into the region's indigenous cuisine while learning eco-friendly cooking methods.
postcards.story:
Team Bandhavgarh Jungle Lodge is all about farm-to-table food; with fresh fruits, herbs and veggies grown right on site. Their hospitality does not end at feeding you delectable meals but also extends to offering a culinary class for foodies and cooking enthusiasts. Led by Sadhvi and her team of expert chefs, these classes offer a hands-on experience.

Picture yourself in the open-air kitchen, surrounded by the lush greenery of the jungle. The sun is shining, birds are chirping and the air is filled with the scent of herbs and spices. Sadhvi stands at the front, a warm smile on her face as she welcomes you to the class.

You gather around the cooking station, eager to learn the secrets of Madhya Pradesh's cuisine. Sadhvi begins by introducing you to the fresh, locally sourced ingredients that form the backbone of the dishes. From fragrant spices to vibrant vegetables, each ingredient tells a story of the region's rich culinary tradition.

With Sadhvi's guidance, you chop, sauté and stir your way through a variety of recipes, from classic curries to savoury snacks. Along the way, you learn about the eco-friendly cooking methods used at the lodge, including solar cooking techniques that minimise the impact on the environment.

As the class comes to an end, you gather around the table to enjoy the fruits of your labour. The dishes you've prepared are a feast for the senses, bursting with flavour and colour. You share stories and laughter with your fellow classmates, savouring each bite and feeling a deep connection to the land and its people.

You carry with you not just memories of a delicious meal, but also the skills and knowledge to recreate it at home.

postcards.name: Take A Nature Walk
postcards.intro: Take on a sensory journey through the wilderness with a nature walk at Bandhavgarh Jungle Lodge. Just a stone's throw away, at a distance of 200 metres from the camp gate, lies the vast expanse of the national park, teeming with wildlife waiting to be discovered. Join one of the seasoned naturalists as they guide you through the jungle ecosystem.
postcards.story:
As you step onto the forest path, the earthy scent of the forest fills your lungs, invigorating your senses. The trail winds its way through dense foliage, alive with the chatter of birds and the rustle of leaves underfoot. With every step, you become attuned to the rhythm of nature, your senses heightened by the sights and sounds around you.

Bandhavgarh is a haven for birdwatchers, with over 200 species of birds calling the region home. From colourful kingfishers to majestic eagles, the skies are alive with these winged beauties. Keep your eyes attentive for melodious calls echoing through the canopy on your walk.

But it's not just birds that await you on your nature walk. The park is also home to a diverse array of mammals, from graceful deer to playful monkeys. The naturalists are experts at tracking wildlife, their keen eyes spotting subtle signs of animal activity that might go unnoticed to the untrained eye.

As you explore further, your guide introduces you to the intricate web of life that sustains the ecosystem. Learn about the vital role played by microorganisms in maintaining the balance of nature, from decomposers breaking down organic matter to pollinators ensuring the survival of plant species.

With each passing moment, you feel more connected to the natural world around you, a sense of wonder and awe filling your heart. As the sun begins to set, casting a golden glow over the landscape, you are sure to realise that this experience has left an indelible mark on your soul. And as you return to camp, you carry with you not just memories, but a newfound appreciation for the beauty and complexity of the wilderness.

name: Sitla Estate
intro: Sitla Estate, nestled in the Kumaon Himalayas, beckons you to a unique escape. Imagine waking up to breathtaking 200° views of majestic mountains, surrounded by the crisp, clean air of a Reserve Forest. It’s not just a stay; it’s an experience crafted for those seeking tranquillity and a deep connection with nature.

news_article.title: Relax in a Quiet Mountain Getaway at Sitla Estate
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel in Uttarakhand, India

postcards.name: Spot Colourful Birds in an Exciting Birdwatching Experience
postcards.intro: Staying at Sitla Estate offers you a unique birdwatching experience that is both inspiring and deeply connected to nature. Located in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, this place is a paradise for bird enthusiasts. The estate's serene environment and diverse habitats attract a wide variety of bird species, making it an ideal spot for birdwatching.
postcards.story:
Waking up to the melodious calls of the birds is a refreshing start to your day. As the sun begins to rise, the estate comes alive with the sounds of chirping and flapping wings. The clear morning air, filled with the scent of pine and wildflowers, sets the perfect backdrop for a day of birdwatching.

Walking through the estate's lush orchards and dense oak forests, you can spot many birds. The vibrant colours of the Himalayan bulbul and the blue whistling thrush catch your eye as they flit between the branches. The majestic crested serpent eagle can sometimes be seen soaring high above, its sharp eyes scanning the ground for prey.

The estate's guides are well-versed in the local birdlife and can point out species that might otherwise go unnoticed. They can help you identify the different birds by their calls and plumage. With their guidance, you might spot the elusive koklass pheasant or the beautiful Himalayan monal, the state bird of Uttarakhand.

The forest trails around Sitla Estate offer a more immersive birdwatching experience. As you walk quietly along these paths, you might encounter mixed flocks of warblers and flycatchers. The rhythmic drumming of woodpeckers and the occasional call of a cuckoo add to the sounds that define this place.

Afternoons can be spent sitting on the estate's verandas, where you can watch birds come to feed on the fruit trees or bathe in nearby water sources. These peaceful moments and the sight of birds in their natural habitat create a sense of peace and connection with nature.

Evenings bring a different kind of magic. As the light fades, nocturnal birds like the mountain owl begin their calls. Staying at Sitla Estate for birdwatching is all about experiencing nature in a profound and meaningful way.

postcards.name: Hike through the Jungles around Sitla Estate
postcards.intro: Enjoy an incredible jungle hiking experience that delves you deeper into the raw beauty of nature. Located in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, the estate is surrounded by dense forests and rugged terrain, making it an ideal spot for those who love to hike.
postcards.story:
Starting your day early for a hike, you step out into the cool morning air. The sounds of the forest waking up – the soothing bird calls and the occasional sounds of unseen creatures – create an atmosphere full of promise and adventure. The trails around Sitla Estate vary in difficulty, catering to both casual hikers and those seeking a more challenging trek.

As you walk through the forest, you encounter a rich variety of flora. Tall oak and pine trees create a canopy overhead, their leaves filtering the sunlight into a gentle, green glow. Underfoot, the ground is soft with fallen leaves and pine needles, adding a natural cushion to your steps. The air is fresh, filled with the scent of earth and vegetation, making each breath feel invigorating.

Wildflowers decorate the landscape, adding rich colour to the greenery. Every now and then, you come across small clearings where you can pause and enjoy the expansive views of the Himalayas. These moments of stillness allow you to fully appreciate the beauty of the mountains, standing tall against the sky.

One of the highlights of jungle hiking is the chance to encounter wildlife. You might spot a group of langurs swinging through the trees or catch a glimpse of a barking deer darting through the underbrush. 

The trails sometimes lead to hidden streams and waterfalls. The sound of running water adds another layer to the experience, inviting you to stop and enjoy a moment of calm. The clear, cool water is refreshing, especially after a long stretch of walking.

Evenings are a great time for a shorter hike, as the forest takes on a different character. The fading light creates a peaceful atmosphere, with the sounds of the day giving way to the quieter noises of night.

name: Wordsworth Lodge
intro: Nestled on a forested slope of Gurushikar, the highest peak in the Aravali Range, Wordsworth Lodge is a quaint boutique hotel in Mount Abu, Rajasthan’s most famous hill station. Originally envisioned as a private home in the 1960s by an English woman with a romantic connection to the region, it offers breathtaking views and the serenity of its natural surroundings.

news_article.title: Cherish Spectacular Sunset Views at the Wordsworth Lodge
news_article.description: A Charming Boutique Hotel in Mount Abu, Rajasthan

postcards.name: Step Out for a Nature Walk to the Nakki Lake
postcards.intro: Wordsworth Lodge in Mount Abu offers you a unique opportunity to experience the serene beauty of the region's only hill station. One of the most accessible and peaceful nature walks from the lodge is a ten-minute walk to the peaceful mini Nakki Lake. Are you ready for this memorable experience?
postcards.story:
Starting from Wordsworth Lodge, the path to Nakki Lake winds through lush greenery, providing a refreshing escape from your everyday life. As you walk, you'll breathe clean air typical of Mount Abu, which immediately helps you feel more connected to nature. The path is well-marked and easy to follow, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels.

Along the way, the sounds of chirping birds create a soothing natural soundtrack. The trees lining the path offer shade, making the walk pleasant on warmer days. This short trek allows you to immerse yourself in the peaceful ambience of the forested area, making it an ideal start to your day or a relaxing end to an afternoon.

As you approach the mini Nakki Lake, the first thing you'll notice is the stillness of the water, reflecting the surrounding Gurushekhar range of mountains. The lake's calm setting provides a perfect spot for quiet reflection or simply enjoying the beauty of nature. Benches around the lake offer comfortable places to sit and take in the view. Watching the reflection of the mountains in the clear water is a calming experience that encourages mindfulness and relaxation.

If you're an early riser, visiting the lake at dawn offers a chance to see the sunrise over the mountains, casting golden colours over the water.

If you’re interested in a bit more exploration, there are several small trails around the lake. These paths offer different vantage points of the water and the surrounding landscape, each providing a unique perspective on the natural beauty of Mount Abu. Whether you choose to sit quietly by the water's edge or explore the nearby trails, the experience at Nakki Lake is one of peace and connection with nature.

postcards.name: Watch Beautiful and Stunning Sunsets
postcards.intro: Staying at Wordsworth Lodge in Mount Abu offers you a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the stunning sunsets by the lakes. One of the most memorable experiences is watching the sunset near the calm lakes, where the day's light fades into the evening.
postcards.story:
A short walk from Wordsworth Lodge takes you to several scenic lakes, each offering its own unique charm. As you approach the lakes, you begin to notice the calmness of the water and the surrounding natural beauty.

As the sun starts to set, the sky transforms into a space of warm colours — shades of orange, pink and purple mix together, reflecting off the surface of the lakes. The stillness of the water mirrors the sky, creating a breathtaking view that is both calming and inspiring. Sitting by the lake, you can watch the changing colours of the sky and the way they play on the water's surface.

The quiet environment around the lakes enhance your experience. This place is perfect for unwinding and enjoying the beauty of the sunset. It's a great time to reflect on the day's activities or enjoy the moment.

If you like photography, the sunset offers an excellent opportunity to capture the beauty of Mount Abu. The vibrant colours and the peaceful setting make for stunning photos that you'll cherish. Even without a camera, the memories of the sunset by the lakes will stay with you.

The lakes near Wordsworth Lodge are also ideal for an evening walk. As the day transitions to night, the air cools and the surroundings become even more tranquil. Walking around the lake, you can find different spots to sit and watch the sunset, each offering a slightly different view and experience.

In conclusion, watching the sunset near the lakes close to Wordsworth Lodge is a simple yet profound experience. The natural beauty and the changing colours of the sky create a moment of peace and reflection. Whether you sit quietly or explore the area, the sunsets in Mount Abu offer a perfect end to your day.

name: Pepper Trail
intro: As the mist gently lifts and the first rays of the sun filter through the dense canopy, 200 acres of silent, serene coffee and spice plantations beckon in warm invitation. Welcome to Pepper Trail!

news_article.title: Experience Wayanad’s Beauty at Pepper Trail
news_article.description: Choose to Stay in a Treehouse or a Historic Bungalow

postcards.name: Take a Guided Tour to a Local Brick Kiln
postcards.intro: If you find yourself wandering through Pepper Trail's surreal landscape between October and March, be sure to carve out time for a guided tour to the local brick kiln. It promises not just a tour but a journey into the heart of traditional craftsmanship. Witness firsthand how skilled artisans craft each brick by hand, using techniques passed down through generations.
postcards.story:
Upon arriving at the local kiln, you’ll be greeted by the sight of skilled artisans working with finely ground mud and water, mixing them by hand to achieve the perfect consistency. The atmosphere is filled with the earthy aroma of wet clay and the rhythmic sounds of hands working the mixture. Watching this process unfold, you gain an appreciation for the labour-intensive nature of this ancient craft.

Once the mud reaches the ideal texture, it is carefully set into wooden moulds. Each mould is filled with the mud mixture, then smoothed out to ensure uniformity. You are sure to notice the precision and care taken during this stage. The filled moulds are then left out in the sun to dry for a day.

The next stage in the process is the stacking of the dried bricks. They are arranged in a neat pyramid-like structure, alternating layers of bricks and firewood.  You will see how the sight of these neatly arranged pyramids is a testament to the artisans' expertise and attention to detail.

As evening approaches, the kiln workers ignite the firewood. The flames slowly engulf the pyramid, casting a warm, mesmerising glow. The fire burns steadily for hours, baking the bricks to perfection. This slow, deliberate process ensures that the bricks are evenly baked, resulting in a product that is both strong and long-lasting.

Witnessing the entire process, from the initial mixing of mud to the final firing of the bricks, is an enriching experience. It highlights the blend of skill, tradition and patience required to produce these essential building materials. 

The visit to the brick kiln at Pepper Trail is not just a tour; it’s a journey into the heart of traditional craftsmanship, offering a profound appreciation for the artisans and their timeless techniques.

postcards.name: Visit the famous Edakkal Caves
postcards.intro: Delve into the ancient mysteries of Edakkal Caves that are perched atop forested slopes. These caverns display Stone Age rock art, etchings that have endured for millennia; each stroke of the chisel echoing the stories of ancestors. As you step into the darkness of the caves, you are sure to enjoy the scent of earth and history that surrounds you.
postcards.story:
Discovered in 1890 in true Indiana Jones style by intrepid explorers Fred Fawcett and Colin Auley Mackenzie, Edakkal caves hold a treasure trove of history waiting to be uncovered. Anticipation builds with every twist and turn leading to these caves, which are only 9.5 kilometres away from Pepper Trail.

The trek to the caves is an adventure in itself, with a duration of approximately two hours. The moderate difficulty level, marked by a steep incline covering one kilometre followed by a climb of 150 steps, adds a thrilling challenge to the experience. But the reward awaiting you at the end is beyond measure.

Arriving at the caves, you're greeted by a sense of awe as you behold the ancient rock inscriptions that have stood the test of time for over 6000 years. Human and animal figures come to life in a striking yet unique style, each chiselled stroke preserving the stories of the ancestors. You can almost feel the echoes of the past reverberating through the cavernous chambers.

Stepping into the darkness of the caves, you're welcomed with a sensory experience. It's as if the very walls whisper secrets of times long gone, inviting you to unravel the mysteries that lie within.

The Edakkal Caves are open from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., offering ample time for exploration and discovery. However, do note that they are closed on Mondays and public holidays, so plan your visit to the caves during your stay at Pepper Trail accordingly.

name: Résidence de l’Evêché
intro: Embark on an Easter weekend escape to the historic charm of RESIDENCE DE L'EVECHE. Immerse yourself in its rich history, indulge in made-to-order Franco-Tamil cuisine, unwind in luxurious bedrooms, and discover Pondicherry in a new light. It's an Easter experience you'll cherish for years to come.

news_article.title: Escape to the Past at Résidence de l’Evêché
news_article.description: A Heritage Residence in Pondicherry, India

postcards.name: Experience the Thrill of a Yacht Cruise
postcards.intro: Imagine starting your day with the gentle sea breeze caressing your face as you stand on the deck of a luxurious yacht. Your adventure begins at the picturesque Résidence de l’Evêché, a charming hotel that perfectly combines heritage with modern comforts. Ready to experience the thrill of a yacht cruise?
postcards.story:
Located in the heart of Pondicherry, this residence offers not only a comfortable stay but also the opportunity for an unforgettable yachting experience in the mighty Bay of Bengal. 

Staying at Résidence de l’Evêché, you’re just a short walk away from the Pondicherry Yacht Club, your gateway to the open sea. 

The anticipation builds as you approach the marina, where sleek yachts bob gently in their berths. The crew greets you warmly and soon you’re stepping aboard, ready for an adventure.

As the yacht sets sail, you’re immediately inspired by the expansive views of the Bay of Bengal. The horizon stretches endlessly, promising the thrill of discovery. The yacht glides smoothly over the waters, powered by the wind and the expertise of the crew. 

You can choose to relax on the sun deck, feeling the warmth of the sun and the cool spray of the sea, or take an active role in sailing, guided by experienced sailors.

Every moment on the yacht is an opportunity to connect with nature. Dolphins might leap alongside the yacht and seabirds glide gracefully overhead. The crew shares stories of the sea and points out landmarks along the coast, enriching your journey with local lore and natural history.

Midway through the cruise, the yacht anchors at a serene spot where the water is crystal clear. On board, a delicious lunch awaits – perhaps fresh seafood paired with local specialities – prepared by the onboard chef.

As the sun begins to set, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink, the yacht heads back to the marina. The experience is both exhilarating and peaceful, leaving you with lots of beautiful memories. 

This yachting adventure is a chance to embrace the sea and create lasting memories.

postcards.name: Walk Down to the Promenade Beach
postcards.intro: Staying at Résidence de l’Evêché offers more than just a place to rest your head. It’s an invitation to explore the charming streets of Pondicherry. One of the most delightful activities during your stay is a short walk to the Promenade Beach. Simply walk out of the hotel and immerse yourself in the wonders of slow walking.
postcards.story:
As you step out of the residence, you’re immediately greeted by the quaint, pastel-coloured houses that line the streets. These homes, with their French colonial architecture, create a warm and inviting atmosphere. 

The narrow streets are perfect for a relaxed stroll and you’ll find yourself enchanted by the vibrant facades and the occasional glimpse into a homey courtyard garden.

The streets are lively yet serene, offering you a perfect combination of local life and historical charm. You might pass by small cafes with outdoor seating, where the aroma of freshly brewed coffee and baked goods fills the air. Friendly locals greet you with a smile, adding to the welcoming vibe of the neighbourhood.

As you make your way towards the beach, the sound of waves becomes more profound, guiding you towards the coastline. The walk is short but filled with interesting sights. You might encounter street vendors selling handmade crafts, fresh fruits or aromatic spices, giving you a taste of the local culture.

Reaching Promenade Beach, you’re welcomed by the expansive view of the Bay of Bengal. The long stretch of sandy beach is perfect for a casual walk along the shore. 

The promenade itself is a hub of activity, with joggers, families and couples all enjoying the scenic views. The sound of the waves crashing against the rocks provides a soothing soundtrack as you walk along.

You might decide to sit on one of the benches facing the sea, simply soaking in the peaceful ambience. The cool breeze from the ocean is refreshing, making it an ideal spot to relax and unwind. 

The combination of charming streets, friendly faces and the calming presence of the sea makes the experience truly special.

name: Golden Haveli
intro: Golden Haveli is an intimate living space reimagined. Drawing inspirations from its origins and our learnings, Golden Haveli finds the perfect balance inviting you to experience an enduring and enticing heritage made accessible.

news_article.title: Travel Back in Time at Golden Haveli
news_article.description: A Heritage Hotel in the Heart of Old Delhi

postcards.name: Experience a Cultural Evening in Delhi
postcards.intro: A visit to Golden Haveli isn't complete without indulging in the richness of folk art. Every evening, whether it's the sweet melodies of thumris, the soulful strains of ghazals, or the graceful movements of Kathak dancers, guests get to glimpse the old-world charm of Delhi-6.
postcards.story:
The UNESCO award-winning property whisks guests away to the grandeur of the Mughal era, where fine arts thrived under royal patronage. 

Here, ornate jharokhas, restored wood carvings, and intricate fresco panels adorn the lavish courtyard, while the sweet scent of blooming roses and the spicy fragrance of vetiver attar welcome the nose. The soft twang of a sitar being tuned and the vibrant colours of Kathak dancers' attire complete the sensory experience.

During the evening mehfil, artists become the torchbearers of Delhi-6's history, weaving tales of romance, drama and passion through their performances. Every story, be it a highlight of mundane events, or the lore of historic wins, gets a visual or auditory voice to paint a vivid picture of life in the Mughal capital.

At one side, a master of the tabla may conjure up a rhythmic magic, while heart-tugging ghazals may bring forth a bittersweet beauty. Similarly, the rhythmic tapping to the hypnotic tunes of classical melodies may present dancers lost in the craft, or thumris may captivate you with their emotive and lyrical grace.

But cultural evenings at Golden Haveli aren't just about the performances; they're a feast for the senses. Pairing the entertainment with dinner at Lakhori, the in-house restaurant, offers a culinary journey through the flavours of Old Delhi. Alternatively, simply basking in the ambiance, with laughter mingling with applause and decor reminiscent of a bygone era, provides an equally immersive experience.

postcards.name: Savour Delhi’s Favourite Street Foods
postcards.intro: Enjoy a culinary experience as you travel the alleyways of Old Delhi on foot. Amidst the bustling food markets, shopping streets and heritage havelis and buildings, find yourself sampling Shahjahanabad’s historic delights.
postcards.story:
Organised by Golden Haveli, the food walk begins in the vibrant chaos of Chandni Chowk, where tantalising aromas waft from street-side griddles.

Try the iconic Aloo Tikki or venture into the renowned Gali Paranthe Wali for an assortment of deep-fried parathas, ranging from sweet jaggery to savory mint and mixed veggies. And if this platter does not satisfy, a request to pop by street stalls selling ram ladoos or dahi papdi chaat may just satiate your curiosity.

The market is also specked with an assortment of meat offerings, with succulent kebabs, rich kormas, spicy nihari, humble biryani, creamy butter chicken and decadent phirni parked alongside the iconic Jama Masjid— Delhi's largest mosque and a culinary hub in its own right.

Don't miss the opportunity to explore the lesser-known culinary treasures tucked away in the nooks and crannies of the market, too.

Take a leisurely break to explore the bustling wedding market, where vendors peddle everything from shimmering fabrics and designer outfits to glittering jewellery. Also take to the 17th-century street market brimming with silver jewellers and artisans, carrying on a tradition that dates back to Mughal times.

However, no culinary adventure in Old Delhi would be complete without satisfying the sweet tooth. Though extremely humble, sample the freshly fried goodness of cardamom-scented Jalebis; head into old establishments serving decadent kulfi flavours like saffron, rose, almond or pistachio; or tear apart a syrup-soaked and almond-coated Sheermal. If you stumble upon the streets in winter, treat yourself to cloud-like Daulat ki Chaat, a cult favourite.

Whether you're a seasoned foodie or an adventurous traveller looking to experience something new, this heritage food walk promises a round-up of Delhi’s culinary offerings along the historic streets.

name: Mantra Koodam
intro: Find refuge from your hectic life at Mantra Koodam, tucked away in a quiet corner of Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu.  Where cocooned within nature's greenest wonders, you go on a journey steeped in legend.

news_article.title: Eat, Pray, Love at Mantra Koodam
news_article.description: A Property Surrounded Amidst 5,000 Temples

postcards.name: Uncover the Magic of Lost Wax Casting at Mantra Koodam
postcards.intro: During your stay at Mantra Koodam, you can journey back in time to uncover the secrets of lost wax casting, an intricate craft that has flourished in the village of Swamimalai. Located along the serene banks of river Kaveri, this village is renowned for its exquisite bronze idols, each piece a testament to the skill and dedication of its artisans.
postcards.story:
As you arrive at the factory of Rajan and Sons, you are greeted by the sight of master craftsmen at work, their hands moving deftly as they mix bee wax and tree wax to create intricate wax models. The air is filled with the rich scent of the clay that will soon encase these delicate structures. You watch in awe as the craftsmen coat the wax models with layers of clay, their practised hands ensuring every detail is preserved.

The process takes a dramatic turn as the clay moulds are heated, causing the wax to melt away and leave behind a perfect cavity. This cavity is then filled with a molten blend of five metals, including gold and silver, which, when combined with brass, transforms into the lustrous bronze. This is the moment where the artistry of lost wax casting truly shines - where a simple mixture of metals and wax is alchemized into something timeless and magnificent.

Your journey continues as you explore a museum filled with an array of bronze idols, each with its own story and unique design. The museum is a treasure trove of cultural heritage, showcasing the myriad shapes and styles that have been perfected over centuries. The statues seem to come alive under the soft lighting, their intricate details telling tales of gods, goddesses and ancient legends.

For those who find themselves fascinated by this artistry, there is an opportunity to commission custom-made idols. Imagine bringing home a piece of Swamimalai’s history, a unique creation that embodies the spirit and skill of these master craftsmen.

Doesn't this sound like one unforgettable experience, where you can witness the harmonious blend of history, culture and craftsmanship that defines an artform of the past?

postcards.name: Explore a Local Village for a Holistic Experience
postcards.intro: Sign up for a holistic experience at Mantra Koodam. Discover the rural life of Veppathur village, engage with friendly locals and witness firsthand the authenticity of rural life. Learn about arts like Kalamkari or the lost wax; or take a relaxing dip in the pool. No matter what your mood, there is something for you.
postcards.story:
For those with a thirst for cultural enrichment, delve into the world of ancient art forms that thrive in the region surrounding Mantra Koodam. Visit the homes of master craftsmen to witness the intricate techniques of Kalamkari, where mesmerising designs come to life with natural colours sourced from local flora. Or explore the traditional craft of Pattu Silk weaving, observing artisans as they skillfully transform raw materials into exquisite fabrics steeped in heritage.

Unwind amidst nature's embrace with a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear swimming pool, surrounded by lush greenery that soothes the soul. Feel the stresses of modern life melt away as you lounge poolside, soaking in the tranquillity of your surroundings.

You can embark on a journey of sensory discovery with a bullock cart ride through the village, where the rustic charm of rural transportation offers a unique perspective on local life. Marvel at the simplicity and beauty of this age-old tradition as you traverse the countryside, greeted by warm smiles and welcoming gestures along the way.

You can also experience the magic of hands-on craftsmanship with pottery workshops led by skilled artisans, where the ancient art of clay moulding comes alive beneath your fingertips. Delve into the intricate process of bronze sculpture-making with Sthapatis, master craftsmen who breathe life into their creations using the traditional 'Lost Wax' technique.

You may end your day with a leisurely stroll through the village, taking in the sights and sounds of a community steeped in tradition and culture. As the sun sets on another unforgettable day at Mantra Koodam, you'll find that a stay here is more than just accommodation - it's a gateway to authentic experiences that nourish the mind, body and soul.

name: Isla's Ridge
intro: A place where nature's grace and an artist's imagination come together – that's one of the best ways to describe Isla’s Ridge. Named after Isla Van Damme, also known as ‘LouLou,’ an internationally acclaimed designer, the bungalow is perched above a tranquil ridge with vistas stretching over the Tamil Nadu plains.

news_article.title: Enjoy the Art of Doing Nothing at Isla’s Ridge
news_article.description: Just Breathe Fresh, East Organic and Relax in Nature’s Lap

postcards.name: Explore the Lakeside Town of Kodaikanal
postcards.intro: Located amidst the flourishing slopes of the Palani Hills, Kodaikanal is a lakeside gem of Tamil Nadu. Its pleasant and refreshing climate, mist-covered cliffs and cascading waterfalls offer an idyllic escape. From exploring bustling markets to indulging in local delicacies, a visit to Kodaikanal from Isla’s Ridge promises you some adventure time.
postcards.story:
Aptly named 'the gift of the forests,' Kodaikanal exceeds every expectation with its ethereal beauty. Located about an hour and a half away by car, this hill station invites you to unwind and commune with nature - whether by embarking on scenic road trips or trekking trails or simply taking a leisurely stroll through the sprawling forests covering the town.

As you traverse the mist-kissed pathways and delve deeper into the town's vibrant heart, you'll discover a world teeming with life and vitality. Each corner reveals a new facet of Kodaikanal's charm, from its colonial-era architecture to the lively bustle of its markets.

Head to the popular Kodaikanal Lake, a man-made, star-shaped lake surrounded by the rich green Palani Hills Range. You can circle around the lake on foot; stopping and shopping from different vendors along the way, selling everything from clothes to food to toys.

Just two kilometres away from the scenic Kodaikanal Lake lies the renowned Bear Shola Falls—a beloved picnic spot that truly comes alive during the monsoon season. Legend has it that the falls earned its unique name from a bear who frequented the area to quench its thirst, adding a touch of mystique to its charm.

For those passionate about trekking, a must-visit destination in Kodaikanal is the Dolphin's Nose - a scenic viewpoint perched atop a flat, jutting rock resembling the nose of a dolphin. Situated at an impressive altitude of 6,600 feet, this natural marvel offers awe-inspiring sights of cascading valleys, rugged terrain, skies and lush greenery.

Whether you choose to explore the lake, chase waterfalls or marvel at panoramic views from lofty heights, a day dedicated to discovering Kodaikanal during your stay at Isla’s Ridge promises to create cherished memories and add a touch of adventure to your trip.

postcards.name: Connect With Nature on a Plantation Tour
postcards.intro: Discover the natural beauty and rich vegetation of Palani Hills by signing up for a village and plantation walk. Picture yourself strolling through lush green pathways, sipping traditional tea and witnessing the age-old practices of pepper harvesting. This experience offers a glimpse into village life, inviting you to connect deeply with the land and its people.
postcards.story:
As you set out along the meandering paths of tea plantations, the greenery serves as a serene escape from the bustle of modern life. The air is filled with the earthy scent of the soil and the subtle fragrance of growing crops, offering a soothing and rejuvenating treat.

Your stroll leads you to the quaint village settings within the plantations. Here, life moves at a gentler pace, allowing you to truly appreciate the simple joys of daily routines. Friendly villagers greet you with warm smiles, embodying the genuine hospitality that defines the local culture. As you wander through the village, you’ll notice the seamless blend of tradition and nature, evident in the well-tended gardens and traditional homes.

One of the highlights of this visit is the chance to enjoy a cup of tea at a local tea stall. This is no ordinary tea; it’s brewed using age-old methods that have been passed down through generations. 

Next, venture into the pepper plantations, where you’ll witness firsthand the taxing process of gathering and preparing pepper. The villagers’ skilled hands move with practised precision, depicting the expertise honed over centuries. They will gladly share their knowledge with you, explaining the intricate steps involved in cultivating this essential spice. Watching them work, you gain a profound respect for the labour and dedication required to sustain these traditional practices.

This activity is more than just a visit. By the end of your tour, you’ll carry with you a deeper connection to the land, enriched by the stories and traditions of the people of Tamil Nadu, who call it home. The plantation visit is an invitation to slow down, savour the moment, and embrace the beauty of a life lived in tune with the natural world.

name: Anvil Hotel & Cache House
intro: Located at the gateway to Yellowstone in the lively town of Jackson, Anvil Hotel embraces the magnificence of its surroundings. With Wyoming’s iconic National Parks serving as our backdrop, we embrace the vibrant ebb and flow of the seasons.

news_article.title: Join a Community of Explorers at Anvil Hotel & Cache House
news_article.description: A Magnificent Hotel in Jackson, United States

postcards.name: Immerse Yourself in the Thrill of Mountain Adventure
postcards.intro: When you come for a stay at the Anvil Hotel & Cache House, a visit to Snow King Mountain Resort offers a wealth of adventure activities for all ages. Known locally as the ‘Town Hill,’ Snow King provides a variety of experiences that make the most of both winter and summer seasons.
postcards.story:
In the winter, Snow King is the perfect place for skiing and snowboarding enthusiasts. The mountain features a range of slopes catering to all skill levels, from beginner to advanced. The thrill of carving down the fresh powder while enjoying stunning views of the Teton Range is unforgettable. 

If you’re new to the sport, Snow King offers lessons to help you get started. Additionally, the resort has night skiing, which allows you to enjoy the slopes under the stars, adding a magical twist to your skiing experience.

Beyond skiing and snowboarding, Snow King offers a winter tubing park, perfect for family fun. The park has several lanes of varying speeds, ensuring excitement for both kids and adults. Another winter attraction is the Cowboy Coaster, an exhilarating ride that twists and turns down the mountain, providing breathtaking views and plenty of thrills.

As the snow melts and summer arrives, Snow King transforms into an outdoor playground. Hiking trails abound, offering everything from gentle walks to challenging treks. The trails take you through lush forests and open meadows, with the reward of panoramic views of Jackson Hole and the surrounding mountains. 

If you enjoy mountain biking, Snow King has numerous trails designed for all skill levels, providing a mix of technical challenges and scenic rides.

One of the standout summer attractions is the Alpine Slide. Riders control their own speed as they navigate down the winding track, making it a fun activity for both kids and adults. 

The resort also hosts various events and festivals throughout the year, ensuring there's always something happening to enhance your visit. From outdoor concerts to mountain races, these events add to the vibrant atmosphere of Snow King.

postcards.name: Spend Time at the National Elk Refuge
postcards.intro: Anvil Hotel & Cache House provides an excellent base for visiting the National Elk Refuge, a sanctuary that offers incredible wildlife experiences. Established in 1912, the refuge is home to one of the largest elk herds in the world. A visit here is a must if you’re a wildlife enthusiast and looking to experience the natural beauty of Jackson Hole.
postcards.story:
During the winter, the National Elk Refuge becomes a focal point for elk watching as thousands of these majestic animals migrate to the area. The highlight of a winter visit is the sleigh ride tour, which takes you directly into the heart of the elk herd. 

These tours provide a unique opportunity to see the elk up close, observe their behaviour and learn about their habitat and conservation efforts from guides. The sight of these large herds, sometimes numbering in the thousands, is beautiful.

For photographers, the National Elk Refuge is a paradise. The winter landscape, combined with the abundance of elk, offers countless opportunities for capturing stunning images. 

Whether you’re an amateur with a smartphone or a professional with advanced gear, the refuge provides the perfect setting for wildlife photography.

In addition to elk, the refuge is home to other wildlife species. You might see bison, wolves, coyotes and various bird species, including bald eagles and trumpeter swans. The diversity of wildlife makes every visit unique, as you never know what you might encounter.

Beyond the sleigh rides, the refuge has a visitor centre that provides educational exhibits about the elk and other wildlife. Here, you can learn about the history of the refuge, the challenges of wildlife management and the importance of preserving these natural habitats. The centre also offers information on seasonal activities and the best times for wildlife viewing.

In the warmer months, the refuge offers different experiences. While the elk migrate to higher elevations, you can still enjoy the scenic beauty of the area through hiking and birdwatching. 

The landscape transforms with the changing seasons, offering a different but equally exciting experience.

Visiting the National Elk Refuge from Anvil Hotel & Cache House surely combines adventure and education.

name: Huffman Creek Retreat
intro: Tucked along a magical creek in the heart of Appalachia, Huffman Creek Retreat is home to seven unique cabins ready to be the basecamp for your next mountain getaway.

news_article.title: Relax in Unique Cabins at Huffman Creek Retreat
news_article.description: Your Private Mountain Escape in the United States

postcards.name: Spend Time at the Fontana Dam
postcards.intro: Staying at Huffman Creek Retreat offers a unique opportunity to explore the nearby Fontana Dam and Marina, a destination rich in history and outdoor activities. Fontana Dam, a hydroelectric dam on the Little Tennessee River, is an engineering marvel and a gateway to a variety of water-based adventures on Fontana Lake.
postcards.story:
The first thing you notice when visiting Fontana Dam is its impressive structure. Completed in 1944, it stands as the tallest dam in the Eastern United States. 

A visit to the Fontana Dam Visitor Center provides insights into the dam’s construction, its role in the region’s power supply and its historical significance during World War II. Exhibits and informational panels make the visit educational and interesting for all ages.

The marina on Fontana Lake is a hub of activity, especially in the warmer months. Here, you can rent a variety of boats and watercraft, making it easy to explore the lake at your own pace. 

Whether you prefer a pontoon boat ride, the excitement of a jet ski or the tranquillity of a kayak, the marina has options to suit every preference.

Fishing enthusiasts will find Fontana Lake a prime spot for angling. The lake is well-stocked with a variety of fish, including bass, walleye and crappie. Renting a fishing boat or joining a guided fishing tour can enhance your experience, offering both relaxation and the thrill of the catch.

If you enjoy swimming and sunbathing, the lake's clear, calm waters and scenic beaches provide a perfect setting. Pack your picnic bag and spend the day by the water, taking breaks to cool off with a swim or exploring the shoreline.
Hiking and nature trails around the dam and lake offer additional ways to enjoy the outdoors.
