The Appalachian Trail, which crosses the dam, provides opportunities for both short hikes and longer treks. Walking across the dam itself offers stunning views of the lake and surrounding mountains, making it a memorable experience. 

The Fontana Marina also offers houseboat rentals if you’re looking to extend your stay on the water. Sounds exciting, right?

postcards.name: Drive through the Tail of the Dragon
postcards.intro: Huffman Creek Retreat provides a perfect base for exploring the legendary Tail of the Dragon, a must-visit destination for driving enthusiasts. This scenic, 11-mile road, renowned for its 318 sharp turns, stretches across the border of North Carolina and Tennessee, offering a thrilling experience for anyone who loves the open road.
postcards.story:
The journey to the Tail of the Dragon from Huffman Creek Retreat is a beautiful prelude to the adventure. Winding through lush forests and picturesque landscapes, the drive sets the stage for what’s to come. 

As you approach the Tail of the Dragon, the anticipation builds, knowing you’re about to tackle one of the most famous driving roads in the world.

Once you start on the Tail of the Dragon, the first thing you notice is the sheer number of curves. Each turn presents a new challenge and an opportunity to test your driving skills. The road demands full attention and respect, with sharp bends and steep drop-offs that keep you on your toes. 

Motorcyclists and car enthusiasts alike flock to this road for the pure joy of navigating its twists and turns.

The experience is not just about the drive but also about the stunning surroundings. As you wind through the dense forest, the scenery is breathtaking. The road is flanked by trees that form a canopy overhead, creating a sense of immersion in nature. 

Occasional glimpses of distant mountains add to the scenic beauty, making the drive as visually rewarding as it is exhilarating.
Safety is paramount on the Tail of the Dragon. It’s essential to drive responsibly, keeping an eye out for other vehicles and respecting the road’s challenging nature. 

Pull-off areas along the route provide spots to rest, take photos, and let faster vehicles pass. These stops offer a chance to appreciate the natural beauty and chat with fellow enthusiasts, sharing stories and tips.

The sense of accomplishment after completing the route is palpable, and the camaraderie among those who’ve driven it adds to the experience.

name: Laalee
intro: The word Laalee, comes from the colour red, a colour usually associated with love and passion. “Laalee” is how a lover would address their beloved, a mother would dotingly call their child, a devotee would address the Devine

news_article.title: Seek a Unique Artistic Experience at Laalee
news_article.description: A Charming Heritage Property in Jaipur

postcards.name: Learn about the Living Traditions of Jaipur
postcards.intro: Enhance your visit to Jaipur with a walking tour guided by Shan Bhatnagar, Laalee’s co-creator and interior designer. This tour is about experiencing the living tradition of Jaipur. Shan, an art enthusiast and lover of Jaipur, offers you a unique opportunity to explore the old city, delving into its rich traditions and vibrant culture.
postcards.story:
Join Shan as he leads you through the historic streets of Jaipur, designed as a craft city. This tour will take you to the heart of Jaipur’s traditional craftsmanship, where you can see artisans at work. Each craft area within the walled city is dedicated to a specific trade and you’ll visit places where craftsmen like thateras (brass utensil makers), sonis (kundan jewelry craftsmen), miniature painting artists and sculptors continue their work in the traditional style, largely untouched by modern conveniences.

This walking tour offers a rare glimpse into the daily lives of these craftsmen, often found working in the back lanes of showrooms. You'll have the chance to observe and appreciate the intricate processes involved in creating Jaipur's famous artistic handicrafts. The tour also includes visits to bustling bazaars filled with a vast array of these handicrafts, allowing you to browse and perhaps purchase unique souvenirs directly from the artisans who make them.

Alongside the exploration of crafts, the tour includes a hearty breakfast experience that combines history with local flavours. Starting at one of Jaipur's well-known spots, you'll enjoy a meal that’s simultaneously spicy, savoury and sweet. This culinary journey provides an excellent introduction to Jaipur’s rich food culture.

As you walk through the city, Shan will share fascinating stories and historical insights about Jaipur that you won’t find on any website or in any guidebook. You'll learn about the city’s origins, its architectural marvels and the hidden frescoes in ancient temples that have withstood the test of time.

You'll leave with a rich understanding of the city's heritage and the timeless craftsmanship that defines it. Book this tour with Shan in advance and let his passion for Jaipur enhance your stay at Laalee.

postcards.name: Delve into Spirituality and Meditation at Laalee
postcards.intro: During your stay at Laalee, join a unique spiritual and meditation experience guided by the hotel’s co-creators, Dr. Preeti and Ganesh Kohli. At Laalee, art is more than just decoration – it is mystical and symbolic, offering a pathway to deeper self-awareness and connection. This is an experience you shouldn’t miss when you’re at Laalee.
postcards.story:
Laalee provides an ideal setting if you’re seeking inner peace and healing. Dr. Preeti and Ganesh Kohli offer meditation and healing sessions designed to help you explore your inner self and achieve a state of calm and clarity. These sessions are tailored to meet your personal needs and can significantly enhance your mental and emotional wellbeing. You will experience the love and dedication that has gone into creating Laalee, making your stay not just a vacation but a rejuvenating retreat.

Whether you are a beginner or have an established meditation practice, you will find these sessions beneficial. They include various techniques such as guided meditation, mindfulness practices, and energy healing. These methods can help reduce stress, improve concentration, and promote emotional health. By participating in these sessions, you can develop skills to manage everyday stress and find a sense of balance in your life.

You have the flexibility to join these sessions whenever Dr. Preeti and Ganesh are available. Additionally, you can plan your visit around the workshops and extended sessions they conduct, which can range from two hours to two days. These workshops offer a deeper dive into spiritual practices and provide a more comprehensive understanding of meditation and healing techniques.

Participating in these sessions at Laalee will not only enhance your stay but also equip you with tools to improve your overall wellbeing long after you leave. You will return home with a greater sense of inner peace, clarity and a renewed connection with yourself. Additionally, engaging with art at Laalee can help you gain profound insights into yourself and your surroundings.

Dr. Preeti and Ganesh’s guidance will help you go on a journey of self-discovery and healing. Plan your stay at Laalee to coincide with these workshops for a transformative experience.

name: Nimmu House
intro: Nimmu House is a noble house that was built a century ago for the cousin of the King of Ladakh. It is nestled at 10 000 feets of altitude surrounded by Himalayan panoramas. Converted in 2012 into a charming glamping retreat, Nimmu keeps its authenticity by respecting Ladakhi traditions and offering modern comfort

news_article.title: Stay in a Heritage Eco-Resort at Nimmu House
news_article.description: A Glamping Retreat in Ladakh

postcards.name: Trek through the Stunning Landscapes in the Himalayas
postcards.intro: When staying at Nimmu House in Ladakh, the experience of trekking through the region's stunning landscapes is unparalleled. Located in the heart of Ladakh, Nimmu House offers you a perfect base for exploring the majestic Himalayan paths. The serene atmosphere of the house, combined with the breathtaking surroundings, makes for an exciting adventure.
postcards.story:
One of the most popular trekking routes accessible from Nimmu House is the Hemis Chupachan to Temisgam trek. This trek provides an excellent opportunity to witness the rich beauty of the Himalayas. The journey begins with a trek through lush valleys, offering you panoramic views of snow-capped peaks. The fresh air and the sound of the wind rustling through the trees enhance the feeling of being deeply connected with nature.

As you progress along the trail, you'll come across traditional Ladakhi villages. These villages, with their whitewashed houses and colourful prayer flags, offer a glimpse into the local culture and way of life. The villagers are warm and welcoming, often inviting trekkers to rest and share a cup of butter tea. This interaction adds a rich cultural dimension to the trekking experience, allowing you to learn about the traditions and customs of the region firsthand.

The trek also takes you through various beautiful terrains, from verdant meadows to rocky outcrops. Each turn reveals a new and stunning view, whether it's a hidden waterfall, a crystal-clear stream or a vast expanse of wildflowers. The contrast between the vibrant green valleys and the stark, rugged mountains is truly striking.

Taking breaks amid this natural beauty is one of the highlights of the trek. Sitting by a mountain stream, you can soak in the peace and majesty of the surroundings. These moments of rest provide a perfect opportunity to reflect on the journey and appreciate the unspoiled beauty of the Himalayas.

In essence, trekking while staying at Nimmu House in Ladakh offers an enriching experience. Sharing stories of the day’s adventures with fellow trekkers over a delicious meal rounds off the day perfectly.

postcards.name: Raft through the Zanskar and Indus River
postcards.intro: Nimmu House in Ladakh offers you a unique opportunity to experience the thrill of rafting on some of the world's most breathtaking rivers. Located in the serene landscape of Ladakh, Nimmu House serves as a perfect base for exploring the dynamic and exhilarating rafting routes on the Zanskar and Indus rivers.
postcards.story:
Rafting in Ladakh is an adventure that combines the excitement of navigating rapids with the stunning backdrop of the Himalayan mountains. The journey begins with a briefing on safety and rafting techniques. Once equipped, you board the raft, ready to go on a thrilling ride through the heart of Ladakh's terrain.

The Zanskar River, often referred to as the Grand Canyon of India, offers one of the most spectacular rafting experiences. The river cuts through deep gorges and canyons, presenting a dramatic landscape of towering cliffs in shades of red and grey. As you paddle down the river, the sheer scale and raw beauty of the surroundings are inspiring. The rapids range from moderate to challenging, providing an adrenaline-pumping ride that is both exhilarating and rewarding.

Alternatively, rafting on the Indus River offers a different yet equally exciting experience. The Indus flows through a wide valley, surrounded by high mountain ranges. The contrast between the turquoise waters of the river and the arid, rocky landscape creates a striking visual experience. The rapids here are generally more gentle, making it suitable for those who are new to rafting while still providing plenty of excitement.

Throughout the rafting journey, you’ll encounter a variety of landscapes, from narrow gorges to open valleys. The sight of snow-capped peaks in the distance, combined with the vivid colours of the surrounding mountains, adds to the visual feast.

The experience of rafting also includes moments of calm, where you can drift along quieter sections of the river. These stretches provide an opportunity to relax and take in the stunning scenery, spotting local wildlife or watching the interplay of light on the water. The clarity of the air and the sound of rushing water enhance the sense of adventure in nature.

name: The Nanee
intro: The Nanee has been designed and created by the daughter in law of the family who understands architecture and the need for comfort for those who come to Bhaktapur to “seek”. It is in this comfort that we want you to experience, engage and explore the many facets of Bhaktapur and all it has to offer.

news_article.title: Be a Part of the Newari Culture at The Nanee
news_article.description: An Ultimate Luxury Boutique Accommodation in Nepal

postcards.name: Visit a Local Artisan
postcards.intro: During your stay at The Nanee in the historic city of Bhaktapur, Nepal, take the opportunity to experience the rich cultural heritage and exceptional craftsmanship that the city is renowned for. One of the highlights of your visit will be a two-hour tour to witness the remarkable skills of a local woodcarver, a tradition deeply rooted in Bhaktapur’s history.
postcards.story:
Bhaktapur, known as the 'City of Devotees,’ is celebrated for its well-preserved architecture, vibrant festivals and artisanal legacy. The city’s woodcarvers are particularly famous for their intricate designs and traditional techniques passed down through generations. These artisans contribute significantly to Bhaktapur's aesthetic and cultural richness, creating everything from detailed windows and doors to ornate statues and altarpieces.

Your experience begins with a guided walk through the ancient streets of Bhaktapur. Accompanied by a local guide, you will gain insights into the historical and cultural significance of the art forms that thrive in this city. The guide will share fascinating details about the evolution of woodcarving in Bhaktapur, the symbolic meanings behind the designs, and the processes involved in creating these masterpieces.

Arriving at the artisan’s workshop, you will be welcomed into a world where tradition meets artistry. Watch as the woodcarver deftly wields chisels and mallets, transforming blocks of wood into detailed works of art. The demonstration will showcase the various stages of woodcarving, from the initial sketching and rough carving to the intricate detailing and finishing touches.

Throughout the tour, you will be provided with drinking water and hand towels for your comfort. This intimate experience not only highlights the beauty of Nepali woodcarving but also honours the artisans who keep this heritage alive.

In addition to witnessing the craftsmanship, you can also explore the surrounding areas of Bhaktapur, where temples, courtyards and palaces are adorned with similar woodcarvings, further illustrating the profound influence of this art form on the city’s architectural landscape.

This experience promises to be a memorable highlight of your time in Nepal, connecting you to the rich traditions and vibrant artistry that define this remarkable city.

postcards.name: Explore the Hilltop Village of Nagarkot
postcards.intro: During your stay at The Nanee in Bhaktapur take a short 40-minute drive to Nagarkot, a hilltop village known for offering some of the most breathtaking views of the Himalayas. In Nagarkot, you’ll get an unparalleled opportunity to witness one of the most spectacular natural sights on the planet.
postcards.story:
Nagarkot is renowned for its panoramic views of the Himalayan range, including major summits from the eastern and central parts of Nepal. The village’s strategic location makes it an ideal spot for those looking to experience the serene beauty of these majestic mountains. The drive from The Nanee to Nagarkot is itself a scenic journey, winding through lush landscapes and traditional Nepali villages that offer glimpses into the local way of life.

Arriving in Nagarkot, you will be greeted by the cool mountain air and expansive views that stretch across the horizon. The highlight of the tour is, undoubtedly, the sunrise and sunset over the Himalayas. Watching the sun slowly rise, casting a golden glow on the snow-capped peaks, is a wonderful experience. 

The sunset in Nagarkot is equally enchanting. As the sun dips below the horizon, the sky transforms into a canvas of vibrant colours, with the Himalayan peaks bathed in the soft light of dusk. This calm moment allows for reflection and appreciation of the natural beauty that surrounds you.

In addition to the stunning views, Nagarkot offers a peaceful retreat from the rush of city life. This village is home to a variety of flora and fauna, making it a great spot for nature walks and bird watching. The local culture is rich with traditional practices and hospitality, offering you a chance to engage with the warm and welcoming community.

You can also visit small temples, interact with local residents and learn about their customs and traditions. The experience is not just about the visual spectacle but also about learning about the natural and cultural heritage of Nepal. It’s a perfect combination of nature and culture, providing lasting memories of Nepal’s unparalleled beauty.

name: Nimali Serengeti
intro: Nimali means "wealth" in the Swahili language and represents the blessings we have all around us - the incomparable wilderness areas of northern Tanzania and the wonderful people we work with and alongside. We get to share these blessings with guests from allover the world, each and every day.

news_article.title: Elevate Your Senses in the Wild with Nimali Serengeti
news_article.description: Stay in a Prolific Wildlife Region in Tanzania

postcards.name: Join an Unforgettable African Safari
postcards.intro: Join a unique Tanzanian adventure with Nimali Serengeti for a redefined safari experience that engages all your senses. From sight to touch, these safaris connect you profoundly to the African wilderness, offering unforgettable journeys that leave a lasting impact on you. This is your Africa and these are safaris designed exclusively for your senses.
postcards.story:
A safari at Nimali Serengeti is exceptionally memorable due to the chance to witness the great migration, encounter diverse wildlife and enjoy well-situated accommodations. As you journey through the diverse terrain of Tanzania, you’ll experience the pulse of local life, where vibrant cultures integrate beautifully with the rhythm of the wild. Here, you discover a profound connection to the spirit of Africa, where the simplicity of everyday moments merges with the extraordinary. 

Discover the rugged beauty of Tanzania at Nimali Serengeti. Knowledgeable guides make your adventure memorable, offering a true glimpse into Tanzania's natural beauty.

At Nimali Serengeti, a sense of calm greets you, allowing you to witness the diverse wildlife here – lions, wildebeest, elephants and giraffes, among other animals. Whether it's the beautiful landscapes or the intimate encounters with nature's inhabitants, each experience offers lifelong memories. 

Situated in a key location along Tanzania's renowned northern safari circuit, Nimali Serengeti encapsulates the unique charm of East Africa. When you return from your game drives, you can relax with views of the expansive landscapes that teem with wildlife. 

The stunning landscapes and unique wildlife encounters create lasting memories for every visitor. Every moment you spend here becomes a part of your personal safari chronicle. Here, you’ll discover the true essence of Tanzania – a land that invites you to forge a deep connection with its wild heart. Are you ready to immerse yourself in the stories of the African wilderness?

postcards.name: Explore the Wild Beauty of Africa
postcards.intro: Surrounded by the vast expanse of the savannah, Nimali Serengeti immerses you in the unfiltered rhythms of nature. With minimalist comfort, it allows you to connect with the primal essence of the wild. Come and connect with the vibrant and authentic essence of Tanzania's wildlife in Serengeti.
postcards.story:
When the Maasai gave Serengeti its name, it was to pay tribute to the seemingly infinite landscapes that stretched endlessly before them. They named it ‘Seringit’, meaning endless plains. Today, it is known as the Serengeti – a spectacular safari destination in Africa where the earth and sky unite. Here, in the heart of this legendary landscape, you'll discover Nimali Serengeti, situated in the midst of one of the continent's most abundant wildlife regions.

Here, you can witness the beauty of the wild and listen to the soft sawing call of the elusive leopard as it moves near the camp at night, navigating through a diverse landscape teeming with abundant life. Throughout your stay, you'll catch the distinct scent of mineral-rich dust carried by a gentle breeze as it sweeps across the Serengeti plains. 

When it comes to taste, imagine enjoying a hearty bush breakfast al fresco in the heart of the Serengeti, accompanied by champagne and a generous serving of adventure. As you walk around the property, you can touch ancient rocks shaped by wind, rain and sun, formed deep within the earth during the planet's infancy. These experiences are a true delight for your senses.

In this serene setting, you’ll find yourself surrounded by the prolific wildlife of the legendary Serengeti. The vast landscapes that stretch before you showcase the raw beauty of Africa. Positioned amidst this natural wonder, Nimali Serengeti offers you an unfiltered and memorable safari experience. 

Here, you’ll find enough space for contemplation, appreciation and a profound sense of connection with the remarkable wonders of Tanzania's natural world. Your journey at Nimali Serengeti unfolds against the timeless backdrop of one of Africa's most extraordinary landscapes.

name: Nimali Tarangire
intro: It’s easy to lose your heart at Nimali Tarangire. Although easily reached by road from Arusha, it is a world away from the everyday, with vast landscapes teaming with an abundance of life. From ancient towering baobabs and huge herds of elephants to more than 500 species of birds and plains games aplenty.

news_article.title: Discover the Land of the Giants at Nimali Tarangire
news_article.description: A Luxury Stay in the Heart of Tanzania

postcards.name: Get Excited for the Hot Air Balloon Adventure
postcards.intro: Staying at Nimali Tarangire offers an exceptional opportunity to experience the African wilderness from a unique perspective: a hot-air balloon flight. As you go on this adventure, the anticipation builds in the early morning darkness, just before dawn. The balloon, a vibrant work of colours, is prepared and inflated as you watch in wonder.
postcards.story:
Once aboard the hot air balloon and with a gentle lift-off, the ground slowly falls away, revealing the sprawling landscape of Tarangire National Park. As the balloon ascends, the first light of day breaks over the horizon, bathing the land in a golden glow. The burners roar, sending flames into the envelope and the balloon gradually takes shape, ready for its journey into the sky. The vastness of the African sky stretches from horizon to horizon, an uninterrupted expanse that underscores the immense scale of the wilderness below.

From the elevated vantage point of the balloon, the scenery unfolds in a way that is both breathtaking and humbling. The Tarangire River winds its way through the landscape, a lifeline for the diverse wildlife that inhabits the park. You’ll watch herds of elephants moving in graceful formation, their movements almost rhythmic as they navigate through the savanna. 

Giraffes stretch their long necks to nibble at the acacia trees, while zebras and wildebeest traverse the plains in search of fresh grazing grounds. The rich biodiversity of the park is on full display, with the chance to observe behaviours and interactions that are often missed on traditional game drives.

The balloon drifts silently, allowing for an undisturbed view of the animals in their natural habitat. Predators like lions and cheetahs can occasionally be spotted, their keen eyes scanning the terrain for potential prey. The serenity of the flight enhances a sense of connection to the environment, offering a peaceful yet exhilarating experience.

As the flight progresses, the balloon follows the gentle currents of the air, providing ever-changing views of the park. The experience culminates in a smooth descent and landing, where a celebratory breakfast often awaits, allowing you to reflect on the incredible journey you've just undertaken.

postcards.name: Relish a Unique Safari Experience
postcards.intro: Staying at Nimali Tarangire provides a unique safari experience due to its location on a private concession. This setting allows for activities that are not available in national parks like the Serengeti, enhancing your exploration of the African wilderness. Are you ready for this incredible adventure?
postcards.story:
The African wilderness around Nimali Tarangire comes to life as the sun rises. Climbing into an open safari vehicle, you set off into the early morning stillness, filled with anticipation for the day’s discoveries. 

The first rays of light illuminate the savanna, casting long shadows and highlighting the contours of the land. The calls of birds create a rhythm of natural sounds that signal the start of a new day. The open vehicle allows for unobstructed views and close encounters with wildlife, providing an exciting experience.

Elephants, the giants of Tarangire, are often among the first animals you encounter. Watching these majestic creatures in their natural habitat, moving gracefully and interacting with each other, is a humbling experience. Further along, herds of zebras and wildebeests graze peacefully, their black-and-white stripes and shaggy coats blending into the grasslands.

As you drive deeper into the park, the landscape changes, revealing the diversity of Tarangire. Towering baobab trees stand like ancient sentinels, their massive trunks and gnarled branches providing shade and shelter for various animals. Giraffes can be seen nibbling at the treetops, their long necks swaying gently as they feed.

Predators like lions and cheetahs are a thrilling sight, often spotted lounging in the grass or stalking prey. The opportunity to observe these magnificent animals up close, undisturbed by the presence of other vehicles, is a highlight of the Nimali Tarangire experience. The guides’ expertise and knowledge enhance your journey, providing insights into the behaviours and habits of the animals you encounter.

Returning to Nimali Tarangire after a day of exploration, you reflect on the incredible diversity and beauty of the African wilderness. Each safari outing offers a new perspective and appreciation for the natural world, making your stay an unforgettable adventure.

name: Lchang Nang Retreat
intro: Lchang Nang retreat – The House of Trees is an eco-conscious luxury hotel and resort in Nubra Valley that celebrates local experiences, people, and culture. Located in the fabled Nubra Valley of Ladakh, on the banks of the Nubra River and on the last stop of the ancient Silk Route.

news_article.title: Revel in Conscious Luxury at Lchang Nang Retreat
news_article.description: A Peaceful Stay Surrounded by the Indian Himalayas

postcards.name: Engage in a Mindfulness Session with the Monk
postcards.intro: Go on a journey of self-discovery and peace with the mindfulness session with the monk at Lchang Nang Retreat. A mere 2.2-kilometre drive takes you to the serene Samstanling Gompa, where you'll immerse yourself in a transformative experience. Are you ready to learn the art of mindfulness?
postcards.story:
Mindfulness cultivates awareness, clarity and acceptance, fostering a deeper connection with oneself and the world around us. As you step onto the sacred grounds of the monastery, a sense of peace envelops you. Guided by the gentle footsteps of the monk, you go on a mindful walk, allowing each step to ground you in the present moment.

In the tranquil garden or courtyard, you'll engage in a rejuvenating yoga session, synchronising movement with breath to cultivate harmony within body and mind. Under the open sky, surrounded by the ancient walls of the monastery, you'll find a sanctuary for inner reflection and renewal.

Led by the venerable Geshe, the guided meditation unveils the profound essence of inner peace. With his wisdom and guidance, you delve deep into the recesses of your consciousness, shedding layers of stress and distraction to reveal the peaceful core of your being.

The tea meditation offers a simple yet profound practice of mindfulness. With each sip, you relish the present moment, fully immersing yourself in the experience of tea drinking. Every aroma and flavour becomes a gateway to mindfulness, allowing you to appreciate the beauty of simplicity.

As the session draws to a close, you carry with you a sense of clarity and calm. The teachings of the monk resonate within you, guiding you towards a life of mindfulness and presence. With each breath, you celebrate the essence of inner peace, knowing it is always within reach, waiting to be rediscovered.

Stay at Lchang Nang Retreat for an unforgettable journey into the heart of mindfulness. Let the wisdom of the monk and the serenity of the monastery inspire you to cultivate a life of balance, clarity and inner harmony.

postcards.name: Visit the Samstanling Monastery
postcards.intro: Just a brief 2.2-kilometre drive from Lchang Nang Retreat, Samstanling Monastery offers a unique and enriching experience. This 170-year-old monastery, steeped in history and tradition, invites you to explore its sacred grounds and embrace its spiritual ambience. Celebrate the opportunity to connect with this sacred place and let it inspire you on your path to inner peace.
postcards.story:
Upon arrival at the monastery, you are greeted by the serene atmosphere, where the sounds of monks chanting and performing prayer ceremonies fill the air. This daily practice creates a peaceful and contemplative environment, perfect for reflection and mindfulness.

As you wander through the monastery, you discover exquisite Buddhist carvings and relics. These ancient artworks, some hidden behind overgrowth to the north of the monastery, stand almost two metres tall and tell stories of a rich spiritual heritage. The intricate carvings and temple paintings, including tankhas, offer a glimpse into the profound artistic tradition of Buddhism.

The monastery also houses a monastic school, where young monks learn and practice their faith. Observing their dedication and discipline is both humbling and inspiring, reminding you of the importance of spiritual practice and community.

Throughout the year, Samstanling Monastery hosts various cultural and religious activities that bring the community together in celebration and reverence. Around mid-May, the monastery celebrates the birthday of their Rinpoche with a vibrant festival. Over two days, you can witness traditional song and dance performances, participate in archery contests and immerse yourself in the joyous festivities.

In mid-September, the monastery holds a special puja ceremony where monks create an intricate sand mandala. This breathtaking piece of art takes about 10 days to complete and symbolises the impermanence of all things. The coloured sands are eventually swept up and poured into a nearby river or stream, spreading healing energies throughout the world. Witnessing this process is a powerful reminder of life's transient nature and the beauty of letting go.

Visiting Samstanling Monastery from Lchang Nang Retreat is a journey into the heart of Buddhist culture and spirituality. The monastery’s peaceful setting, combined with its rich history, offers a profound experience that resonates long after you leave.

name: Haveli Dharampura
intro: Step into a time capsule from the Mughal era through the architectural beauty and grandeur of Haveli Dharampura. Indulge in comfort, luxury and relaxation with our royal pampering.

news_article.title: Delight in the Vibrance of Old Delhi at Haveli Dharampura
news_article.description: A UNESCO-Awarded Heritage Haveli

postcards.name: Go for the Old Delhi Heritage Walk
postcards.intro: When staying at Haveli Dharampura, the Old Delhi Heritage Walk offers a mindful journey through the historical and spiritual heart of the city. This three-hour ‘Heritage and Divine Spirituality Tour’ provides an exciting experience of the grandeur of Shahjahanabad, built along the banks of the Yamuna River.
postcards.story:
The ‘Heritage and Divine Spirituality Tour’ begins with a visit to the magnificent Jama Masjid, India's largest mosque. Here, you can marvel at the architectural design and learn about its historical significance from the expert tour guides. The next stop is the Digambar Jain Naya Mandir, a place of serene beauty and spirituality, offering insights into Jain culture and beliefs.

From there, the tour takes you to Khari Baoli, Asia's largest spice market. This bustling market is a sensory delight, where you can experience the rich aromas and vibrant colours of Indian spices. The guides will explain the various uses of these spices in traditional Indian cooking and their importance.

Next, the tour moves to Kinari Bazaar, a market famous for its delicate lace, blingy borders and sparkly sequins. This is a perfect spot to understand the traditional craftsmanship and the vibrant fabric of Old Delhi's commerce.

The tour concludes with a visit to Gurudwara Sis Ganj, a significant Sikh temple. Here, you can take part in spiritual rituals and receive blessings, providing a moment of peace and reflection amidst the city's chaos.

In the afternoon, the ‘Old Delhi Street Food Walk’ offers a culinary adventure through the streets of Chandni Chowk. This three-hour tour is designed to treat your taste buds to the finest street food. Starting with the famous ‘Paranthe Wali Galli,’ you will visit at least 10 food joints, sampling various dishes that define Delhi's street food culture.
Highlights include the all-time favourite sweets, gulab jamun and jalebi, and the delicious Natraj dahi bhalla. Each stop offers a taste of the unique flavours and culinary traditions that have been perfected over generations. This mindful experience allows you to experience the rich heritage and diverse flavours of Old Delhi, making your stay at Haveli Dharampura even more memorable.

postcards.name: Say ‘Yes’ to Your Pre-Wedding Photoshoot
postcards.intro: A pre-wedding photoshoot at Haveli Dharampura becomes a deeply memorable and mindful experience, capturing the essence of Old Delhi’s rich history and timeless charm. The haveli, with its ornate architecture and delightful blend of light and shadow, provides an ideal setting for couples looking to document their journey together.
postcards.story:
Upon arriving at Haveli Dharampura, you’ll be greeted by the serene and historic atmosphere that makes this location unique. The haveli's intricate woodwork, traditional jharokas and antique balconies create a stunning backdrop that enhances the beauty of your pre-wedding photos. The interplay of light and shadow throughout the day offers a dynamic canvas for your photographer, ensuring each shot is filled with depth and emotion.

Starting your photoshoot, you might choose to capture moments in the central courtyard. The space, surrounded by thick stone walls that shield you from the rush of Chandni Chowk, offers a private and intimate setting. Here, the traditional Mughal-style architecture, with its detailed carvings and elegant arches, provides a sense of timeless elegance. Posing in this serene environment allows you to connect deeply with your partner, making each photograph a genuine reflection of your bond.

Moving to the rooftop, you’ll find a panoramic view of Old Delhi that is both breathtaking and evocative. The sight of Jama Masjid’s majestic domes against the skyline adds a layer of historical grandeur to your photos. This juxtaposition of personal moments against the vast expanse of Old Delhi highlights the timeless nature of your journey together.

Throughout the photoshoot, the mindful experience of being in such a historically rich location helps you to stay present and connected. The haveli’s peaceful ambience allows you to focus on each other, making your interactions more natural and heartfelt. Every laugh, every shared look, is captured in an environment that feels both grand and intimate.

There are countless opportunities to create compelling visual stories, from the detailed architectural elements to the soft, natural lighting that bathes the space. Each corner of the haveli offers a new perspective, allowing for a diverse range of shots that capture the essence of Old Delhi’s charm.

name: Ging Tea House
intro: Built in 1864, legend has it that The Tea House was one of the first colonial tea planter’s bungalows made in the region. The house which has been tastefully restored keeping its colonial heritage intact, is admirably classic in style.

news_article.title: Stay in a Heritage Plantation Retreat in Ging Tea House
news_article.description: A Premier Hotel in Darjeeling

postcards.name: Taste the Darjeeling Tea on a Tea Tour
postcards.intro: A stay at Ging Tea House offers an interesting journey into the heart of Darjeeling's tea culture, beginning with a comprehensive tour of the tea estate. This experience is designed to deepen your appreciation for the beloved Darjeeling tea, offering insight into its rich history and notable production process.
postcards.story:
The tour starts with an engaging session where your guide recounts the exciting tales of how tea made its way from China to East India. These stories are steeped in history and intrigue, setting the stage for your adventure through the estate. You are invited to let your imagination wander as you ponder the various narratives and their historical significance.

Next, you will walk through the lush tea gardens, where your guide will demonstrate the delicate art of plucking the 'two leaves and a bud' from the tea bushes. This practice is crucial for producing high-quality tea. If you visit during the plucking season, you will witness the skilled tea pluckers at work, deftly collecting leaves with wicker baskets slung over their backs and umbrellas protecting them from the sun or rain. Observing this process firsthand offers a profound understanding of the labour and expertise involved in tea harvesting.

After the morning’s activities, you'll pause for a rustic lunch, echoing the traditional meals of tea pickers. This break provides an opportunity to savour local flavours and experience the simplicity of a picker’s meal, weaving a deeper connection with the land and its people.

Post-lunch, the tour continues to the tea factory, where you will observe the timeless process of tea manufacturing. This segment of the tour highlights the various stages of tea production, each step carefully executed to create the distinctive Darjeeling tea. You will learn about withering, rolling, fermenting, drying and sorting — each phase essential in developing the unique characteristics of the tea.

The tour culminates in a tea-tasting session. Here, you will engage your senses in evaluating the day’s brew. This part of the experience allows you to apply your knowledge and appreciate the subtle nuances in flavour, aroma and appearance of the freshly prepared tea.

postcards.name: Explore the Beautiful Town of Darjeeling
postcards.intro: Just a short half-hour drive from Ging Tea Estate lies the beautiful town of Darjeeling, nestled against the backdrop of the majestic Khangchendzonga. Once a prized possession of the British, gifted by the Raja of Sikkim, Darjeeling served as both a strategic outpost in the Himalayas and a favoured summer retreat.
postcards.story:
Begin your day early with a mesmerising sunrise viewing at Tiger Hill, offering a breathtaking panorama of the mighty Kanchenjunga, India’s highest peak. The spectacle of the Himalayas unfolding before you is bound to inspire awe and reverence. It's a moment to soak in the beauty of nature's marvels and appreciate the vastness of the mountainous landscape.

Next, go on a ride aboard the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, affectionately known as the ‘Toy Train.’ This iconic journey takes you through scenic views, including the engineering marvel of Batasia Loop. As you traverse the picturesque terrain, you'll witness the harmony between human ingenuity and natural beauty, creating a profound sense of connection to the land and its history.

During the day, make a stop at the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, where you can draw inspiration from the legacy of Tenzing Norgay, the legendary mountaineer. Alternatively, explore the tranquil surroundings of the Lloyd Botanical Gardens, immersing yourself in the diverse flora of the region. These encounters with nature and human achievement offer moments of reflection and appreciation for the wonders of the Himalayan ecosystem.

In the afternoon, walk along the Mall Road, lined with quaint shops and inviting cafes, including the renowned Keventer’s. Here, you can indulge in the simple pleasures of browsing local crafts or savouring a cup of tea while enjoying the atmosphere of this charming hill station. It's a chance to unwind and appreciate the unhurried pace of life, relishing the small joys found in everyday moments.

A day trip to Darjeeling Town from Ging Tea House offers you an opportunity to engage with the essence of the Himalayas, fostering a mindful connection to the natural and cultural heritage of the region.

name: Blue Book
intro: Nestled in the picturesque locales of Nainital, Blue Book transcends the ordinary. This boutique hotel near Nainital offers a sanctuary of unparalleled luxury. Tucked away in the laps of Jeolikote Valley, this bungalow from the 1890s is tastefully done to give you the charm of bygone eras and the feel of Kumaoni hospitality.

news_article.title: Choose Peace and Silence at Blue Book
news_article.description: A Luxury Boutique Hotel Near Nainital

postcards.name: Spend Quiet Moments at the Neem Karoli Baba Ashram
postcards.intro: Staying at Blue Book and visiting the Neem Karoli Baba Ashram offers a unique and mindful experience that deeply resonates with visitors seeking a connection with spirituality and inner peace. The experience at Neem Karoli Baba Ashram leaves a lasting impression, encouraging a deeper engagement with one’s inner self.
postcards.story:
Blue Book, known for its serene environment and comfortable accommodations, serves as an ideal base if you want to explore the Neem Karoli Baba Ashram. The calm and simplicity of Blue Book prepares the mind for the reflective journey that awaits. Mornings at Blue Book often begin with the gentle chirping of birds, a sound that complements the serenity of the place. This calmness helps set a meditative tone for the day.

A short walk from the Blue Book leads you to the Neem Karoli Baba Ashram. The pathway itself is part of the experience, lined with trees. This walk provides a moment to mentally prepare for the visit, to leave behind worldly concerns and to focus on the present.

Entering the ashram, the first thing that strikes you is the sense of peace that pervades the area. The ashram is simple yet profound in its atmosphere. Devotees and visitors alike move with quiet reverence, creating an environment where silence is not just the absence of noise, but a presence in itself.

Inside the ashram, the scent of incense lingers in the air, mingling with the fresh, earthy smell from the gardens. The central temple, dedicated to Neem Karoli Baba, invites you to sit and reflect. The simplicity of the surroundings encourages a meditative state, where thoughts slow down and a sense of calm prevails.

Afternoons can be spent in the ashram’s garden, where the natural beauty adds to the contemplative mood. Sitting under a tree, you can observe the gentle flow of life around the ashram – the flutter of a bird’s wings, the soft chatter of fellow visitors and the distant sound of a temple bell. After returning to the hotel, you’ll surely feel a sense of fulfilment and peace.

postcards.name: Visit the Alluring Garur Taal
postcards.intro: Visiting Garur Taal provides a mindful experience, ideal for those seeking peace and a connection with nature. Blue Book, with its calm ambience and comfortable settings, serves as the perfect base for such explorations. The serene environment of Blue Book, complemented by its thoughtful amenities, allows you to relax and prepare for a day of mindful engagement with nature.
postcards.story:
Garur Taal is a short drive from Blue Book and the journey itself is a part of the experience. The road winds through picturesque landscapes, gradually shifting the mind from the routine of daily life to the serenity of nature. This transition is smooth and helps set a reflective tone for the visit.

Upon arriving at Garur Taal, the first impression is of its untouched beauty. The lake, surrounded by lush greenery, creates a peaceful and welcoming atmosphere. The clear, calm waters of the lake mirror the sky and surrounding trees, enhancing the sense of stillness and peace. Take a moment to simply stand by the water, absorbing the quiet and the natural beauty around you.

Walking around Garur Taal, the sounds of nature – the occasional bird call and the gentle lapping of water – become a natural soundtrack to the experience. These subtle yet constant sounds help ground you in the present moment, encouraging mindfulness and a deeper connection with the surroundings.

Sitting by the lake, it's easy to engage in silent reflection. The simplicity of the environment encourages a meditative state. Thoughts slow down and there is an opportunity to simply be present, observing the small details – the way the sunlight dances on the water, the patterns of the ripples and the slow movements of fish beneath the surface.

The presence of other visitors, often few and far between, adds a sense of shared solitude. People respect the quietude of the place, maintaining a peaceful atmosphere conducive to contemplation and introspection. There’s a shared understanding that Garur Taal is a place for quiet appreciation of nature.

This wonderful experience at the lake, coupled with the restful environment of Blue Book, creates a holistic sense of peace – encouraging a continued practice of mindfulness and presence.

name: The Legacy Mandawa by The Machan
intro: As we venture into the Land of Kings, we are thrilled to present The Legacy Mandawa - a heritage haveli built by a legendary trader of spices. With its history dating back over two centuries, the culture of art and architecture here is visible in every hand-painted wall.

news_article.title: Explore Rajasthani Culture at The Legacy Mandawa
news_article.description: A Heritage Haveli Redefining Luxury

postcards.name: Share the Joy of Watching a Rajasthani Folk Dance
postcards.intro: Staying at The Legacy Mandawa by The Machan offers a wonderful opportunity to immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Rajasthan. Among the many vibrant experiences available, witnessing the traditional Ghoomar dance stands out as a highlight. This dance form is not just a visual delight but also a cultural journey to cherish.
postcards.story:
Evening at The Legacy Mandawa begins with the anticipation of seeing Ghoomar, a dance that has its roots in the Bhil tribe and has been embraced by the royal communities of Rajasthan over centuries. The setting at The Legacy Mandawa is perfect for such an experience, with its blend of traditional Rajasthani architecture and modern amenities. As you settle into the courtyard, the ambience is set with soft lighting that accentuates the intricate designs of the haveli, creating an intimate atmosphere.

The dancers, dressed in vibrant ghagras (long skirts) and adorned with traditional jewellery, enter the performance area gracefully. The ghagras are particularly noteworthy for their bright colours and elaborate embroidery, which reflect the mindful craftsmanship of Rajasthani artisans. As the music begins, a blend of traditional instruments like the dhol and harmonium fills the air, setting a rhythmic foundation for the dance.

Ghoomar involves a series of graceful twirls, each executed with precision and poise. The dancers move in a circle, their skirts flaring out like blossoming flowers, creating a mesmerising visual effect. The coordinated movements and the rhythmic clapping of hands and tapping of feet are captivating. This dance form is traditionally performed by women on auspicious occasions and its steps are both elegant and intricate, showcasing the skill and dedication of the performers.

As you watch, it's easy to get lost in the hypnotic rhythm and the fluidity of the dancers' movements. The performers' expressions and the communal harmony in their movements reflect the deep-rooted traditions of Rajasthan.

The experience is enhanced by the interactive nature of the performance. You are often invited to join, providing a hands-on appreciation of the dance. This participatory element breaks the barrier between performer and audience, allowing you to feel a part of the rich culture being showcased.

postcards.name: Join the Exciting Mandawa Tour
postcards.intro: Staying at The Legacy Mandawa by The Machan provides a perfect base for exploring the historic town of Mandawa, known for its rich heritage and stunning architecture. A town tour, guided by knowledgeable locals, offers a deep dive into the cultural and historical significance of this once-bustling trading outpost in the Shekhawati region.
postcards.story:
The Mandawa Tour typically begins with a visit to the iconic Mandawa Fort. As you approach, the fort's painted arched gateway, adorned with intricate frescoes depicting Lord Krishna and his cows, immediately captures your attention. This entrance reflects the artistic flair that defines Mandawa. Walking through its courtyards and chambers, you can almost hear the echoes of the past.

From the fort, the tour continues through the narrow, winding streets of Mandawa, lined with havelis (traditional mansions) that are adorned with elaborate frescoes. These havelis, built by wealthy merchants, feature walls covered in vibrant paintings depicting scenes from Hindu mythology, folklore and everyday life. Each haveli tells a story and the local guides are adept at bringing these stories to life with their detailed explanations and anecdotes.

One of the most fascinating aspects of the tour is the visit to the Murmuria Haveli. This particular haveli is known for its unique frescoes, including some that depict modern elements like trains and cars, reflecting the blend of traditional and contemporary influences.

The town tour also includes stops at local markets, where you can witness the rush of daily life. The markets are a sensory delight, with vendors selling everything from traditional textiles and jewellery to spices and handcrafted souvenirs. Engaging with the local shopkeepers offers a glimpse into the commerce that has long been a part of Mandawa’s identity.
Throughout the tour, the guides share insights into the socio-cultural dynamics of the region, explaining how the trade routes influenced Mandawa’s development and how the town has preserved its heritage while adapting to modern times. Their narratives are enriched by personal stories and historical facts, making the tour both educational and engaging.

name: The Apricot Tree Hotel
intro: Located just off the Leh-Srinagar highway and perched on a gentle slope overlooking the Indus river, the Apricot Tree Hotel hotel is set in an orchard of apple and apricot trees, offers sounds and views of the river and crisp mountain air.

news_article.title: Enjoy Exclusive Views of the Indus River at The Apricot Tree Hotel
news_article.description: A Charming Ladakhi-Style Boutique Hotel

postcards.name: Wander through the Apricot Orchard
postcards.intro: Walking through the apricot orchard at The Apricot Tree Hotel in Ladakh is a refreshing immersion into nature, offering a serene retreat from the rush of daily life. Located amidst a picturesque landscape, the orchard provides a tranquil setting where you can connect with the natural world and experience the simple pleasures of rural life.
postcards.story:
As you step into the orchard at The Apricot Tree Hotel, the first thing you notice is the cool, fresh air, carrying with it the faint scent of apricots and other local vegetation. The orchard is a mosaic of colours, with the green foliage of the trees contrasting beautifully against the arid background of the Ladakhi mountains. The trees, heavy with ripe apricots, create a canopy of leaves that move gently in the breeze, offering shade and a sense of peaceful seclusion.

Strolling along the well-trodden paths, you can take your time to observe the intricate details of the orchard. The apricot trees, with their gnarled trunks and boughs laden with fruit, tell a story of resilience and adaptation to the harsh climatic conditions of the region. The ground is covered with a soft carpet of fallen leaves and apricots, adding a magical charm to the surroundings. Occasionally, you might spot a local bird or two, chirping from the branches, adding to the orchard’s serene atmosphere.

One of the highlights of this experience is the opportunity to learn about the region’s agricultural practices directly from Wangchuk, the knowledgeable and friendly host. He shares stories about the history of the orchard, the unique qualities of the Ladakhi apricots and the traditional methods used in cultivating and harvesting them. His narratives provide a rich understanding of the local culture and the significance of apricot farming in the region.

If you enjoy hands-on experiences, the orchard offers activities like preparing butter tea or momos, traditional Ladakhi delicacies. Under Wangchuk’s guidance, you can learn the art of making these dishes using fresh, local ingredients. This interactive experience not only enriches your culinary skills but also gives you a taste of Ladakhi hospitality and traditions.

postcards.name: Go for a Village Walk Near The Apricot Tree Hotel
postcards.intro: Exploring the villages around The Apricot Tree Hotel in Ladakh offers an authentic and enriching experience, deeply rooted in the region's natural beauty and cultural heritage. The walks through these villages provide an intimate glimpse into the daily lives of the local people and the stunning landscapes they call home.
postcards.story:
Setting out from the hotel, the first thing you notice is the serene, untouched beauty of the surroundings. The paths are often lined with apple orchards, their branches heavy with fruit during the harvest season. The fresh, crisp scent of apples fills the air, mingling with the earthy aroma of the land. Walking through these orchards, you can hear the soft crunch of leaves underfoot and the occasional rustle of wildlife in the bushes.

As you move further along the trails, you encounter small, traditional Ladakhi villages. The houses, built with stone and mud, blend beautifully into the landscape. Their flat roofs, often adorned with drying apricots and barley, showcase the self-sustaining lifestyle of the villagers. The simplicity and practicality of these homes reflect the resourcefulness and resilience of the people who live here.

The villagers themselves are warm and welcoming, often greeting you with a friendly smile and a nod. Walking through the narrow lanes, you might see local women tending to their gardens or spinning wool, while children play nearby. The villagers are usually happy to share stories about their way of life, their customs and the challenges they face living in such a remote area. This interaction provides a deeper understanding of the cultural richness and community spirit that defines Ladakh.

Guided walks enhance the experience, as local guides share their extensive knowledge of the area. They point out medicinal plants, explain the significance of various agricultural practices and help spot local bird species, adding layers of understanding to the journey. Birdwatching is particularly rewarding, with opportunities to see species unique to this high-altitude region.

Walking through the villages around The Apricot Tree Hotel is a journey into the heart of Ladakh’s natural and cultural heritage, offering an experience that is both grounding and inspiring.

name: The Rajbari Bawali
intro: Located about an hour and 30 minutes from Kolkata, The Rajbari Bawali is a 300-year-old boutique heritage property that has been elegantly turned into the best luxury heritage resort near Kolkata.

news_article.title: Experience Old-World Charm at The Rajbari Bawali
news_article.description: A Heritage Resort Near Kolkata

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding at The Rajbari Bawali
postcards.intro: Celebrating your wedding at The Rajbari Bawali offers a uniquely romantic and thoughtfully luxurious experience that you’ll cherish forever. Located near Kolkata, this heritage hotel is perfect for events, weddings, movie shoots and photography, providing an ideal blend of ambience, service and cuisine.
postcards.story:
The Rajbari Bawali stands out for its accessibility and excellent organisational capabilities. Its proximity to Kolkata ensures easy access for guests, making travel arrangements seamless. Open throughout the year, the hotel offers different experiences with the changing seasons, allowing you to choose the perfect backdrop for your special day. Each season at The Rajbari Bawali adds a unique touch to your wedding celebrations.

The team at The Rajbari Bawali takes pride in personalising your wedding to meet your desires. From the moment you start planning to the final moments of your big day, the friendly and attentive staff is there to assist you at every step. They handle all aspects of the event, ensuring that every detail is perfect. This includes arranging exquisite decorations that reflect your vision and providing sumptuous cuisine that delights your guests. The chefs create a diverse menu that combines traditional flavours with contemporary twists, catering to a variety of tastes and preferences.

The luxurious setting of The Rajbari Bawali adds to the romantic atmosphere of your wedding. The historic architecture, with its grandeur and elegance, provides a stunning background for your ceremonies and celebrations. The lush gardens and serene surroundings enhance the experience, offering picturesque spots for wedding photography and quiet moments with loved ones.

The Rajbari Bawali ensures that your wedding is a stress-free and memorable event. The staff’s professionalism and attention to detail allow you to relax and enjoy every moment of your special day. They are always there to assist with any last-minute requests or adjustments, ensuring that everything runs smoothly.

Celebrating your wedding at The Rajbari Bawali is a beautifully romantic and luxurious experience. The combination of its historic charm, attentive service and exquisite cuisine creates a memorable event that you and your loved ones will cherish forever.

postcards.name: Visit the Magnificent Victoria Memorial
postcards.intro: When you stay at The Rajbari Bawali, a visit to the Victoria Memorial in Kolkata is an experience not to be missed. This majestic white marble edifice stands prominently in the heart of the city, surrounded by beautifully maintained gardens that offer a peaceful retreat from the urban hustle.
postcards.story:
Constructed from the same Makrana marble used in the Taj Mahal, the Victoria Memorial exudes historical significance and architectural grandeur. As you approach the memorial, the sheer size and elegance of the structure are immediately striking. The blend of British and Mughal architectural styles creates a unique visual experience.

The sprawling gardens surrounding the Victoria Memorial are a highlight of the visit. Spread over 64 acres, these gardens are beautifully maintained and offer a space for leisurely walks. The well-maintained lawns, blooming flowerbeds and serene water bodies create a picturesque setting perfect for relaxation and reflection.

Inside the Victoria Memorial, the experience is equally enriching. The museum houses an extensive collection of artefacts, including paintings, manuscripts and relics from the British colonial period. Each exhibit provides a glimpse into the rich history of India during the British Raj. The central hall, with its impressive dome and high ceilings, adds to the grandeur of the visit.

A visit to the Victoria Memorial is not complete without experiencing the sound and light show. Held in the evening, this show brings the history of Kolkata and the memorial to life through a wonderful display of lights and narration. It’s a fascinating way to learn about the historical significance of the monument and the city. Interestingly, your visit to this iconic monument is both educational and enjoyable.

The accessibility of the Victoria Memorial from The Rajbari Bawali makes it an easy addition to your itinerary. Upon returning to The Rajbari Bawali, the serene and luxurious environment offers a perfect contrast to the vibrant city experience. Visiting the Victoria Memorial while staying at The Rajbari Bawali is a must. The combination of historical significance and architectural beauty makes it a memorable experience.

name: Ramathra Fort
intro: Ramathra Fort lies between two of India’s internationally famous wildlife reserves. Keoladeo Ghana Bird Sanctuary in Bharatpur and Ranthambore Tiger Reserve in Sawai Madhopur. The closest wilderness area, Kailadevi national Park, is just 15 Kms away.

news_article.title: Experience Royal Indulgence at Ramathra Fort
news_article.description: A Luxury Stay in a Charming Fort in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Enjoy the Thrill of Night Driving in a National Park
postcards.intro: While enjoying your stay at Ramathra Fort, a night drive into the buffer zone of Kaila Devi National Park is an adventure you shouldn’t miss. As the sun sets, you’ll go on a thrilling journey across the Daang plateau, stretching east to the Chambal River valley and south towards Ranthambhore.
postcards.story:
The rugged area around the Kaila Devi National Park is filled with gorges and diverse landscapes that create a perfect backdrop for nighttime wildlife sightings. While tigers once roamed these parts, the buffer zone is still teeming with wildlife. During your drive, you’ll have the chance to see various species of deer, blue bulls and an array of predators like wolves, jackals and hyenas. Foxes dart through the underbrush, and with a bit of luck, you might even spot a wild boar, bear or elusive leopard.

The night drive offers a unique opportunity to experience the park's nocturnal life. As darkness falls, the landscape transforms and the behaviour of the animals changes. Predators become more active and the park comes alive with the sounds of the night. Your guide, knowledgeable about the area's wildlife and ecology, will help you spot and understand these creatures in their natural habitat.

The drive itself is an adventure, navigating through the rugged terrain of the Daang plateau. The vehicle's headlights cast eerie shadows, illuminating the paths taken by countless animals before you. The silence of the night, disturbed by the occasional call of a distant animal, creates a sense of mystery and excitement.

Throughout the journey, your guide will share insights into the park's history and the efforts being made to preserve its unique ecosystem. You’ll learn about how the buffer zone plays a crucial role in protecting the core areas of Kaila Devi National Park.

After a few hours of exploration, you’ll return to the comfort of Ramathra Fort, enriched by the experience. The night drive into the buffer zone offers more than just wildlife sightings – it connects you with nature, making you understand the challenges and triumphs of conservation efforts in this remarkable region.

postcards.name: Go for a Day Trip to Karauli
postcards.intro: When staying at Ramathra Fort, a day trip to Karauli is an enriching experience that shouldn’t be missed. Just an hour's drive away, Karauli offers a glimpse into Rajasthan's vibrant history and culture. The warmth and hospitality of the locals will make your visit even more memorable.
postcards.story:
Your journey begins with a visit to the Karauli City Palace, a stunning example of Rajput architecture. This well-preserved palace showcases intricate carvings, beautiful frescoes and an array of courtyards and halls that tell stories of the region’s royal past. As you explore the palace, you’ll gain insight into the lives of the maharajas and the rich cultural heritage of Karauli.

Next, head to the temple of Madanmohanji, another highlight of Karauli. This temple, dedicated to Lord Krishna, is renowned for its exquisite architecture and serene ambience. The temple is a spiritual haven where you can witness local rituals and feel the devotion of the worshippers. The tranquillity of the temple grounds provides a stark contrast to the bustling life outside, offering a moment of peace and reflection.

After soaking in the historical and spiritual vibes, make your way to the Karauli Bazaar. This bustling market is rich in local crafts and products. One of the specialities here is lacquered bangles. Watching the bangle makers at work is a fascinating experience. The skill and precision with which they craft these colourful accessories are mesmerising, and you can even purchase a few to take home as souvenirs.

The bazaar is a vibrant place where you can experience the daily life of the locals. The sights, sounds and smells of the market immerse you in the culture of Karauli. From spices and textiles to traditional Rajasthani attire, the market offers various items that reflect the local way of life.

Throughout your day trip, you’ll have the opportunity to interact with the people of Karauli, gaining a deeper understanding of their customs and traditions. This day trip offers a perfect blend of history, spirituality and local life, making your stay at Ramathra Fort truly special.

name: ABN Rajmahal
intro: ABN Rajmahal is a 50m long and powered by 3 engines; her extra-shallow draught and a lower profile than conventional designs allow her to cruise further upstream than any of her competitors.

news_article.title: Sail through the Ganges with ABN Rajmahal
news_article.description: A Luxury River Voyage Offering Cultural Immersion

postcards.name: Visit Varanasi – One of the Oldest Cities in the World
postcards.intro: Go on a memorable river cruise aboard the ABN Rajmahal, setting sail towards the historic city of Varanasi, formerly known as Banaras. Varanasi, often referred to as the ‘City of Light,’ is renowned as one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, with a history spanning over 3,000 years.
postcards.story:
As Mark Twain famously remarked, "Banaras is older than history, older than tradition, older even than legend and looks twice as old as all of them put together." This characterisation captures the essence of Varanasi, a place where ancient traditions and spiritual practices thrive amidst the bustling life of a modern city.

The journey on the ABN Rajmahal offers a unique perspective on the timeless landscapes of the Ganges River. The vessel itself is a modern marvel, designed to provide comfort and luxury while cruising through the heart of India. As you sail, you can relax on the sun deck, enjoying the panoramic views of the riverbanks, dotted with rural villages, ancient temples and vibrant ghats where daily life unfolds beautifully. The onboard amenities include spacious cabins with large windows, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the serene beauty of the Ganges.

Arriving in Varanasi, you are immediately struck by the city’s vibrant energy and profound spirituality. Varanasi is the most significant religious site for Hindus, attracting pilgrims and visitors from all over the world seeking moksha or salvation. The ghats or riverfront steps, are the heart of the city’s spiritual life. Here, you witness rituals of life and death, with devotees performing ablutions, conducting ceremonies and offering prayers. The sight of the evening Ganga Aarti, where priests perform a mesmerising ritual with lamps and chants, is a highlight that leaves a lasting impression.

After lunch, venture to Sarnath, a short distance from Varanasi. This Buddhist site holds immense historical and spiritual significance, as it is the location where the Buddha delivered his first sermon. This journey on the ABN Rajmahal encapsulates the richness of cultural heritage, spirituality and history, providing an unforgettable experience that resonates deeply with every traveller.

postcards.name: Explore the Temples of Bengal
postcards.intro: Begin your day on the ABN Rajmahal with breakfast, enjoying the ever-changing scenery as you sail upstream. The Ganges River offers a tranquil start to your day, with its calm waters and the peaceful activities of riverside villagers. This journey isn't just about the destination but also about the experience of visiting temples along the way.
postcards.story:
The first stop of the river cruise is the country town of Kalna. Here, you’ll step out and take cycle rickshaws to explore one of Bengal's architectural gems. Kalna is home to a remarkable collection of terracotta temples, showcasing intricate designs that reflect the rich artistic heritage of the region. These temples, adorned with detailed carvings, offer a glimpse into Bengal's history and religious traditions. The highlight is the unique Shiva temple, featuring concentric rings of 108 small shrinelets. This distinctive structure is both an architectural marvel and a spiritual site, providing a deeper understanding of the local culture and religious practices.

After exploring Kalna, the journey continues through the picturesque countryside to Mayapur. This town is renowned for the vast new ISKCON (International Society for Krishna Consciousness) temple. As the headquarters of ISKCON, also known as the Hare Krishna movement, the temple dominates the skyline with its impressive size and grandeur. The ISKCON temple attracts over a million devotees each year from around the world to sing, dance and engage in communal worship. The vibrant atmosphere at the temple is infectious, offering a unique cultural experience as you witness the devotion and joy of the Krishna followers.

Returning to the ABN Rajmahal, you sail downstream as dusk falls, heading back towards a mooring near Kalna. The evening on the river is serene, with the setting sun casting a golden glow over the water. The gentle movement of the ship and the soothing sounds of the river create a perfect environment for relaxation and reflection. Each stop along the way, from the terracotta temples of Kalna to the spiritual fervour of Mayapur, enriches your understanding of Bengal's heritage. The ABN Rajmahal provides not just a mode of transportation, but a comprehensive experience that combines luxury with cultural immersion.

name: Saruni Mara
intro: Saruni Mara is a small, luxury lodge in the Masai Mara, with 5 cottages, 1 family villa and 1 private villa. It is located in a secluded valley in one of the most exciting wildernesses in Africa – the Mara North Conservancy.

news_article.title: Enjoy the Ultimate Family Safari Destination at Saruni Mara
news_article.description: An Unforgettable Safari Adventure in Kenya

postcards.name: Build Safari Memories with Your Family
postcards.intro: Saruni Mara believes that a family safari is one of the most enriching experiences you can share with your loved ones. Here, the family units are designed with your comfort in mind, making it easy for families to explore the African bush together. These adventures create lasting bonds and unforgettable memories.
postcards.story:
Children have a natural curiosity and enthusiasm for nature and wildlife. They quickly engage with their surroundings, finding the African bush both exciting and educational. Saruni Mara caters to the unique needs of children, ensuring that they have a safe and enjoyable experience.

The family-oriented itineraries offer a perfect combination of adventure and relaxation. These journeys combine the thrill of wildlife encounters with the comfort of luxury accommodations, providing something for everyone. Parents and children alike will find joy and inspiration in the wild landscapes and vibrant cultures of Kenya.

One of the highlights of a family stay at Saruni Mara is the Warriors Academy. Available in both Samburu and the Masai Mara, this interactive program is designed specifically for families. It’s an educational and fun-filled adventure where you can explore the wilderness and learn about the Maasai and Samburu tribes. Guided by the warriors, or ‘moran,’ your family will gain a unique perspective on the Kenyan wilderness, understanding it through the eyes of those who have lived there for centuries.

To make the safari experience even more engaging for children, there’s also a Young Explorers Club. This program teaches children about the environment and nature while offering plenty of fun activities. Kids can learn bush survival skills, shoot bows and arrows, bead with local Maasai ladies, track animals with guides, play board games and even bake cakes and bread in the kitchen. These activities keep them entertained and learning throughout their stay.

For parents who need a break, a babysitting service is available upon request, ensuring that both children and adults can enjoy their time at Saruni Mara to the fullest. Saruni Mara’s commitment to making safaris accessible and enjoyable for families means that your adventure in the African bush will be a memorable, life-enriching journey.

postcards.name: Join a Maasai-Guided Safari in Beautiful Nature
postcards.intro: Go on a Maasai-guided safari during your stay at Saruni Mara for an exciting journey through the heart of the African wilderness. Here, your guides are Maasai warriors with a deep-rooted connection to the land that stretches back generations. This unique experience combines professional guiding qualifications with a profound cultural heritage, offering a safari like no other.
postcards.story:
Each Maasai-guided safari is led by a Maasai warrior who shares their intimate knowledge of the terrain, flora and fauna. These guides provide insights into the behaviour and habitats of the wildlife in this region. You'll learn to track animals, understand their patterns and witness the intricate balance of the ecosystem through the eyes of those who have lived in harmony with nature for centuries.

Your guide will introduce you to the customs and traditions of the Maasai people. You'll hear stories passed down through generations, gaining deeper knowledge of their way of life. This cultural immersion adds a rich layer to your safari, making it not just a visual feast, but an educational journey as well.

The landscape itself reflects the beauty and diversity of the African wilderness. From the sweeping savannahs to the rugged hills, every part of the journey offers something new. The Maasai guides navigate these areas with ease, pointing out hidden gems and sharing their personal anecdotes, making the experience both informative and deeply personal.

At Saruni Mara, the commitment to conservation and respect for the environment is evident in every aspect of the safari. The guides emphasise the importance of preserving this delicate ecosystem, ensuring that future generations can enjoy its wonders. Their passion for wildlife conservation is contagious, inspiring you to appreciate and protect the natural world.
Walking through the bush, you’ll experience this incredible landscape up close, noticing the small details that make this wilderness so unique. A Maasai-guided safari at Saruni Mara is more than just a wildlife adventure. It’s a journey into a way of life that respects and honours the natural world, led by those who know it best.

name: Desert Lodge
intro: Positioned in one of the most enviable locations that the NamibRand has to offer, Desert Lodge has a stunning outlook. Think vast orange-hued dunes, mountains, rolling skies and, well, nothing….

news_article.title: Escape to the NamibRand with Wolwedans Desert Lodge
news_article.description: Surround Yourself with Sand and Solitude in Namibia

postcards.name: Bike Along Undulating Sand Dunes
postcards.intro: While enjoying your stay at Desert Lodge, prepare for an exhilarating adventure: dune surfing on an e-bike. Cycling in the NamibRand reserve allows you to connect deeply with the environment. This unique experience combines the thrill of cycling with the stunning beauty of the NamibRand reserve’s endless landscapes.
postcards.story:
Desert Lodge believes that where you lay your head is just the beginning. The true essence of your stay lies in the experiences you will have with them. Dune surfing on an e-bike is one of the most exciting activities here, making it easier than ever to explore the vast, undulating dunes and the rugged terrain of the reserve.

The e-bikes are designed to make gliding up and down the dunes effortless. You'll follow winding roads that snake through the reserve, taking you over hills, across sand dunes and through expansive plains. As you cycle, the breathtaking scenery unfolds before you, each turn revealing new views and unique perspectives of the desert.

Whether you’re an experienced cyclist or a casual rider, these e-bikes offer a happy medium. You can ride at your own pace, enjoying the freedom to explore as much or as little as you like. You may also love the challenge of cycling until your legs are exhausted or prefer a light ride to a serene desert picnic spot. The quiet hum of the e-bike, the gentle breeze and the soft crunch of sand under your tyres create a peaceful yet invigorating experience. 

A ride on the e-bike is not just about the thrill but also about immersion in the beauty of the desert. The vast open spaces and the sense of endless horizons shift your perspective, offering moments of reflection. Don't miss out on the unforgettable experience of biking in the desert.

After a day of dune surfing, return to Desert Lodge with a sense of accomplishment and deep respect for the NamibRand reserve. At Desert Lodge, it’s the experiences and the connection to the landscape that make your stay unforgettable.

postcards.name: Go for a Scenic Drive in the Namib Desert
postcards.intro: Prepare for scenic drives in the desert when staying at Desert Lodge. These journeys through the NamibRand reserve offer breathtaking views and unforgettable encounters with the desert’s unique landscape and wildlife. These rides will surely captivate your heart and soul. Get ready for the adventure!
postcards.story:
Imagine setting off in a comfortable vehicle, the open desert stretching out before you. As you drive, you’ll be immersed in a variety of colours. The vast plains, majestic mountains and rolling sand dunes create a dynamic and ever-changing canvas. The shades of the desert shift with the light, from the golden glow of sunrise to the deep reds and purples of sunset, each moment a new visual feast.
