The scenic drives are more than just sightseeing tours. They are exciting experiences that connect you deeply with the environment. Knowledgeable guides will share their insights about the desert's small and large inhabitants, revealing the intricate details of their quest for survival. You’ll learn about the resilient flora that thrive in this harsh climate, each plant reflecting nature’s strength.

As you traverse the NamibRand reserve, your guide will point out the fascinating geology that shapes this unique landscape. From ancient rock formations to vast sand dunes, the geological diversity of the region is beautiful and inspiring. You’ll gain an understanding of how these formations came to be and their significance in the desert ecosystem.

Wildlife encounters are a highlight of the scenic drives. The NamibRand reserve is home to a variety of animals, each adapted to the desert's challenging conditions. You might spot a graceful oryx, a herd of springbok or the elusive desert fox. Birds of prey soar overhead and smaller creatures like beetles and lizards scuttle across the sand. Each sighting offers you a glimpse into the complex web of life that sustains the desert.

These drives also provide moments of peace and reflection. The vastness of the desert, the silence interrupted only by the wind and the endless horizons create a sense of calm. It’s a chance to disconnect from everyday life and reconnect with nature.

name: M.V. Rudra Singha II
intro: M.V. Rudra Singha II are owned by lahé life, brought to you by Assam Bengal Navigation, the pioneer of long-distance river cruising in India and the country's largest and most experienced river cruise operator.

news_article.title: Embark on a Private Cruise on M.V. Rudra Singha II
news_article.description: Your Home on the Brahmaputra River in Assam

postcards.name: Explore the Silk-Weaving Town of Sualkuchi
postcards.intro: Go on an extraordinary journey with the M.V. Rudra Singha II and discover the beautiful silk-weaving town of Sualkuchi on the second day of your river cruise. Sualkuchi is a vibrant centre of traditional silk production. Get ready to explore this fascinating town, a journey that promises both cultural immersion and scenic beauty.
postcards.story:
Sualkuchi stands out as one of the world’s largest weaving villages, producing some of the finest silk in Assam. This quaint village holds a unique place in global silk production, often referred to as the ‘Manchester of the East.’ Here, weaving is not just a tradition passed down through generations but a way of life and a labour of love. Almost every house in Sualkuchi has hand-operated looms, known locally as ‘taatxaal,’ where the rhythmic click-clack of weaving can be heard throughout the streets.

As you walk or cycle through the village, you'll witness the entire process of silk production, from cocoon to exquisite sari. Begin with a visit to a local sericulture farm, where silkworms are carefully tended as they spin their cocoons. Next, observe the intricate process of spinning and dyeing, where raw silk fibers are transformed into vibrant threads. Finally, watch the talented weavers at their looms, skillfully crafting intricate patterns of the golden Muga Silk and other varieties like Eri and Pat silk.

The experience in Sualkuchi offers a deep dive into a craft that is integral to the region's culture and economy. The village’s weavers have been producing exotic indigenous silk for centuries, providing employment and fostering self-reliance among the locals. This industrious spirit is palpable as you watch artisans create beautiful silk fabrics, each piece reflecting their dedication and skill.

The sight of vibrant saris hanging in doorways, the sound of looms in action and the warmth of the local people create rich experiences that will stay with you long after your visit. Your journey to Sualkuchi with the M.V. Rudrasingha II is an immersion into the cultural heart of Assam. Embrace the adventure, appreciate the artistry and take home memories of a unique and inspiring cultural heritage.

postcards.name: Spot Rhinos at the Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary
postcards.intro: Go on an unforgettable adventure aboard the M.V. Rudra Singha II and discover the wonders of Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary. Located to the east of Guwahati, Assam, Pobitora is renowned for its conservation efforts for the one-horned rhinoceros. This sanctuary is a stage for displaying diverse landscapes and rich wildlife, making it one of Assam's premier destinations for nature enthusiasts.
postcards.story:
As you step ashore from the M.V. Rudra Singha II, prepare for an exhilarating jeep safari through the heart of Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary. This sanctuary is home to the highest density of greater one-horned rhinoceroses in India, offering you a unique opportunity to observe these majestic creatures in their natural habitat. The sight of a rhino roaming freely in the grasslands is a powerful reminder of nature's blessings, evoking a sense of wonder.

The sanctuary's varied terrain, comprising alluvial lowlands and marshlands along the southern banks of the Brahmaputra River, provides a rich habitat for a wide variety of wildlife. As you traverse the park, stay alert for other incredible species such as Asiatic buffaloes, leopards and wild bears. Birdwatchers will be delighted by the vast collection of avian species, adding another layer of excitement to the journey.

If you’re seeking a more exciting experience, pedal through the rural countryside on a mountain bike to reach Pobitora. This active approach not only allows you to connect with the local landscape but also enhances the thrill of your adventure. As you cycle through picturesque villages and open fields, the anticipation of encountering wildlife builds, culminating in the sanctuary's breathtaking scenery.

Once inside Pobitora, you’ll feel the grasslands come alive. Apart from the rhinos, you might spot wild water buffaloes, monitor lizards and wild boars, each encounter adding to the excitement of your safari. The diverse flora and fauna of Pobitora create a dynamic environment where every moment is filled with discovery.

Your visit to Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary is not just a wildlife encounter but a journey into the heart of Assam's natural beauty. The M.V. Rudra Singha II offers a perfect gateway to this wilderness, combining the serenity of a river cruise with the thrill of a wildlife safari.

name: Basecamp Masai Mara
intro: At the doorstep of Masai Mara National Reserve, Basecamp Masai Mara is where our journey once began. This is why now it is much a home as it is a travel destination.

news_article.title: Embrace Cultural Immersion at Basecamp Masai Mara
news_article.description: Your Peaceful Home in the Kenyan Wilderness

postcards.name: See Incredible Wildlife on a Game Drive
postcards.intro: While you enjoy a wonderful stay at Basecamp Masai Mara in Kenya, you're in for an unforgettable experience of game viewing amidst the beautiful landscapes of the Masai Mara. Imagine waking up to the crisp morning air, knowing that the day ahead is filled with opportunities to witness the wonders of the African wilderness.
postcards.story:
As you venture out into the savannah, you'll be greeted by a diverse variety of wildlife that calls this place home. From graceful giraffes grazing on acacia trees to majestic lions basking in the golden sunlight, every moment promises a new and exciting encounter with nature. Keep your camera ready, for you never know when you might spot a playful herd of elephants or a stealthy leopard prowling through the tall grass.

One of the highlights of your stay will undoubtedly be witnessing the great wildebeest migration, a natural spectacle unlike any other. From July to October or November, millions of wildebeest, accompanied by zebras and other herbivores, make their way across the Mara River in search of greener pastures. Standing on the banks, you'll feel the thrill of anticipation as you watch the herds gather, their hooves kicking up dust as they prepare to brave the river's currents. It's a sight that will stay with you long after you've returned home.

But the Masai Mara isn't just about the big game – it's also a paradise for birdwatchers. With over 450 species of birds, including vibrant kingfishers, majestic eagles and elusive owls, there's always something new to see overhead. Whether you're an avid birder or simply appreciate the beauty of these winged creatures, you'll find yourself enchanted by the diversity of avian life in the Mara.

Back at Basecamp Masai Mara, you'll have the opportunity to relax and unwind in comfortable accommodations that integrate mindfully with the surrounding environment. Tucked away in the heart of the wilderness, the eco-friendly tents offer a peaceful retreat where you can recharge after a day of exploration. Enjoy delicious meals prepared with fresh, locally sourced ingredients and swap stories with fellow travellers around the campfire as the stars twinkle overhead.

postcards.name: Hop on Hot Air Balloon Safari over Masai Mara
postcards.intro: Experience the Masai Mara like never before with a breathtaking Hot Air Balloon Safari. Glide over vast savannahs, witness wildlife in their natural habitat and soak in a golden sunrise. This unforgettable adventure offers you a bird’s-eye view of one of Africa’s most iconic landscapes, the Masai Mara.
postcards.story:
A Hot Air Balloon Safari at Basecamp Masai Mara is an unforgettable way to experience the African wilderness from a unique perspective. Your adventure begins before dawn when you’re driven to the launch site. The fresh morning breeze carries a sense of anticipation as the balloon is inflated. Watching it come to life against the background of the slowly brightening horizon is a spectacle in itself.

Once aboard, the takeoff is surprisingly smooth. As you rise above the treetops, the Masai Mara stretches out in all directions. The landscape shifts from rolling grasslands to acacia-dotted plains and the first rays of sunlight paint everything in shades of gold and amber. From this vantage point, the sheer scale of the Mara comes alive.

Below, wildlife roams freely. You might spot herds of wildebeest and zebras during their great migration, elephants moving in their majestic stride or even a pride of lions basking in the morning light. The silence of the balloon adds to the serenity — no engine noises, just the occasional roar of the burner and the calls of the wild.

Being in a hot air balloon over the Masai Mara is like floating in a dream. The gentle sway of the balloon adds to the feeling of effortless exploration, almost as if you’re gliding on air. The experience feels timeless, a quiet moment where nature speaks and you simply listen.

Back at Basecamp, the stories continue. Sharing the morning’s highlights around the lodge, you realise that this safari isn’t just about the sights — it’s about feeling a part of a natural world that thrives in its own rhythm. It's an experience that leaves you truly exhilarated.

name: Soulitude by the Riverside
intro: Situated alongside the banks of the Kalsa River in Chanfi village (near Nainital), Soulitude, as the name suggests, provides complete solitude for the soul. Just watching the glacial stream gracefully move through the valley is mesmerising and with it you will flow into the world of Soulitude.

news_article.title: Dive into Bliss at Soulitude by the Riverside
news_article.description: Your Peaceful Abode in Uttarakhand

postcards.name: Visit the Charming Lake Town of Nainital
postcards.intro: Geroge William Traill, the first Deputy Commissioner of Kumaon was so mesmerised by Nainital's enchanting lake-ringed mountains and meadows that he kept its location a secret even from the locals for a long time. Soulitude by the Riverside offers travellers a rare glimpse of Nainital and how it came to be the most cherished summer home of the British Raj.
postcards.story:
Explore the township that became a health resort for British soldiers, officials and their families. Visit the Pilgrim Lodge constructed by Peter Barron in the mid-1800s. 

Walk through the older colonial part of town where a promenade of hotels, restaurants and souvenir shops prevails. Visit the Nainital Boat House over a naturally-formed landslide-induced flat plain called The Flats. You can also see a rare communal sight of a Gurdwara, Jama Masjid and Naina Devi temple beside each other. You’ll enjoy visiting India's First Methodist Church of St. Francis. Additionally, you can also see many Tibetan market stalls with colourful sweaters, momos and more.

Soak up the stillness of St. John in the Wilderness, a Gothic church that stood the test of natural calamity. Inside the church lies a brass memorial commemorating victims of the landslide of 1880 and the tombstone of George Thomas Lushington, the Kumaon commissioner who developed the town.

A four-kilometre hike up the Ayarpatta Hill is the Tiffin Top trail flanked by lush fir, oak and deodar trees. Visit Dorothy's seat, a stone picnic perch dedicated in memory of Dorothy Kellet and installed by her husband, Col. JP Kellet. 

On the western slope of the lake resides the Gurney House, the last known Indian home of well-known conservationist Jim Corbett and Clifton, the summer residence built by his family that now operates as a homestay.  

Visit the late 19th-century European schools that taught children of British soldiers and colonial officers during the Victorian and Edwardian eras – the Sherwood School and the St. Joseph's built by Irish Brothers. 

Dine at the famous Sakley's bakery, which has been serving sumptuous eats since 1944. Spicy sriracha wings, Thai curries, roast lamb steaks, homemade cakes, pastries and banoffee pies are must-tries here.

postcards.name: Experience Uttarakhand’s Local Traditions
postcards.intro: Uttarakhand, rightly called Dev Bhoomi (abode of the gods), has something to offer every traveller through its picturesque landscape and vibrant culture. Most lakes, peaks or mountains here commemorate divinities. Soulitude by the Riverside's festival and fair walks introduce you to an immersive experience of the vibrant festivities and traditions of Nainital's local communities.
postcards.story:
In Uttarakhand, faith is expressed as a melange of nature, deities, cultural performances, elaborate celebrations, camaraderie and a sense of community. 

Indulge in Ghughuti sweetmeats made of flour and jaggery, deep-fried in ghee into fun shapes like drums, pomegranates, knives and more. These are also strung into a necklace with orange the next day, worn by kids as a token to welcome the migratory birds while they sing folklore songs about black crows, inviting them to eat the crumbs thrown at them. 

Nanda Devi, the chief patron goddess of Uttarakhand, has numerous shrines, temples and grand festivals to her name. The Nanda Raj Jat held during September in Nauti and the Nanda Mahotsav held in Almora are a must-see.

The Nanda Raj Jat is a duodecennial 21-day 280-kilometre-long trek undertaken by numerous pilgrims led by a four-horned sheep bearing gifts for the Goddess until it is released at the base of Nanda Ghunti mountain and never seen again. The Nanda Devi Festival celebrated across Garhwal and Kumaon, honours the annual visit of the Goddess to her birth home and culminates with her return to her marital home. On the final day of the fair, Nanda and Sunanda Devi idols in the palanquin are submerged in the water by the devotees.

Be a part of the annual Jauljibi and Thal fairs held from 14-21 November at Jauljibi, a meeting ground for three cultures – the Shauka, the Nepali and the Kumaonis. 

Attend the much-celebrated Hilljatra festival of pastoralists and agriculturalists in Pithoragarh. The festival observes the farming tradition of ropai (plantation of paddy) and other pastoral activities. Engage in a spectacular parade of beautifully sung folklore and the chanchari (circle dance) by locals, a theatrical representation of pastoral activities with masks and other rituals.

name: Kila Dalijoda
intro: This family is considered as one of the most ancient families of pre Independence India, with a well documented lineage dating back to as early as 81 AD. This 1900 years of heritage belongs to the erstwhile Royal familiy of “Panchakote Raj“ Estate from eastern India.

news_article.title: Explore the Untold Royal Saga of Rural Odisha at Kila Dalijoda
news_article.description: A Luxury Heritage Stay in Odisha

postcards.name: Uncover the Sacred Roots of Rural Odisha on a Religious Walk
postcards.intro: Kila Dalijoda, a hunting mansion with a history of royal legacy, offers religious walks that enthral travellers in the marvellous world of Odisha's historical landmarks and panoramas. Uncover the local folklore of the mystical sacred sites. Witness architectural remnants of ancient Kalinga of Mahabharata fame. Discover reclusive sadhus and explore the varied spectrum of Indian religious beliefs.
postcards.story:
Travel to Bhubaneshwar, the temple city of Odisha, where architectural marvels of the Kalinga dynasty and folklore abide in every detail – the historical sites, museums, ancient temples or the stone crafts.
 
Visit the meditative Joranda Gadi temple, one of the few early 20th-century religious wonders you can find in the country. The site that used to be the Samadhi Peetha of Mahima Goswami is today considered the world headquarters for the Alekh Mahima Dharma – a sect that belongs to the ascetics. Unlike usual Indian temples, you won't find idols inside; they worship the formless supreme god. 
 
You can take a motor boat or the bridge to Dhabaleshwar – a temple perched upon a hillock on a beautiful island surrounded by the Mahanadi riverine. En route, you can indulge in bird photography and spot swimming river turtles. As the name suggests, Dhabala means white, which is also the colour of the quaint-looking monument. 
 
There is a story behind Dhabaleshwar. Legend has it that Lord Shiva performed a miracle here, converting a black bull calf into white, saving the thief who ran into the lord's sanctum and sought divine help to save himself from the villagers. Lord Shiva appeared as a saint and reasoned with villagers, revealing a white calf instead of the black one that went in with the thief.
 
Explore the Chhatia Bata temple of Jagannath, a divine abode awaiting the arrival of its deity, the future avatar of Lord Jagannath – Kalki. The monument holds significance in the works of 15th-century Vaishnavite saint Achyutananta Das, whose writings predict the arrival of the Kalki to restore order and righteousness during the age of darkness. 

Beautiful hand paintings depicting Hindu mythology adorn the inside walls of Chhatia Bata. This spiritual journey promises to be an unforgettable experience for you.

postcards.name: Enjoy Odisha's Pastoral Scenery on a Canoe Trip
postcards.intro: Kila Dalijoda, at first glance, may seem like a hunting mansion straight out of history books. This hidden gem of monarchical heritage in rural Odisha epitomises the fondness of local royals for the pastoral lifestyle, and a canoe trip is a great way to explore the area.
postcards.story:
The forest reserve has three contrasting habitats of vegetation – open scrubs, dense teak forests and wetlands. Paddle upon lilly-strewn wetlands; drive through teak forests observing resident and migratory birds of the forest as well as waterfowl; take a refreshing swim in a pond or trek up the mighty hills in the area. You’ll also enjoy visiting fish farming ponds and seeing mushroom cultivation.

The Dom Domoni temple at the entrance of Dalijoda Forest Reserve of Kapilas Elephant Sanctuary is still a custom followed to the present day.
 
Visit Janaki Jhar, a watch tower near a water hole used by the monarchs of Kila Dalijoda for hunting. The spot, now abandoned by the Forest Department, still retains the construction of a small concrete hideout for hunting surrounded by high walls. 
 
The remote Banjhiama village is a perfect example of the relationship between humans and nature. Although adjacent to civilisation, the hamlet remains primitive in terms of the lifestyle and livelihoods of its occupants. Witness old-fashioned rice mills – dhenki — in operation. The neighbourhood has excellent scenic routes through forests and hills. There is a small pond that is a summer haven for elephant herds. You can also spot rare birds and butterflies from your canoe. 
 
Bhitarkanika National Park, approximately 120 kilometres from Kila Dalijoda, is a habitat for some of Odisha’s best natural marvels. Estuaries and saltwater crocodiles are the main attractions here. This place is surely every nature lover's paradise.

The parklands have India's second-largest mangrove forests and hold the Guinness record for housing the world's longest saltwater crocodile – about 24 feet. You can also spot plenty of rare animal species here. Kila Dalijoda will help arrange a full day's excursion in the nature reserve, including boats and taxis.

name: The Bentwood Inn
intro: The Bentwood Inn, built in 1995, was constructed using massive 200-year-old logs brought in from Yellowstone National Park after the great fire of 1988.

news_article.title: Get Amazed by Mindful Sustainability at The Bentwood Inn
news_article.description: An Iconic Lodge in Jackson Hole

postcards.name: Enjoy the Thrill of Rock Climbing
postcards.intro: During your stay at the Bentwood Inn, you're in for an adventure-filled experience with rock climbing as an interesting and adventurous activity. Located in the heart of Jackson Hole, Wyoming, the Bentwood Inn serves as your warm home base for exploring the rugged beauty of the surrounding landscapes.
postcards.story:
Just a stone's throw away from the Bentwood Inn lies Exum Mountain Guide Service, a renowned establishment that has been facilitating climbing adventures for decades. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned climber, there's something for everyone here. With expert instructors and guides at your service, you can go on a two-day climbing instruction that will have you scaling the iconic Grand Teton in no time. It's an opportunity to push your limits and conquer new heights, regardless of your age or experience level.

From the moment you set foot on the rocky terrain, you'll feel the adrenaline coursing through your veins. With each step, you'll learn about the ropes of rock climbing, mastering essential techniques and safety protocols under the guidance of knowledgeable professionals. As you ascend further, you'll be rewarded with breathtaking views of Grand Teton National Park and its beautiful surroundings.

But the adventure doesn't stop there. If you’re seeking a different kind of thrill, Jackson Hole Mountain Resort offers an exhilarating alternative with its climbing wall and ropes course. Here, you can test your agility and strength as you navigate challenging obstacles and reach new heights. It's a fun-filled experience that promises excitement for the whole family.

After a day of adrenaline-fueled exploration, return to the comfort of the Bentwood Inn, where warm hospitality and rustic charm await. Relax and unwind in homey accommodations, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of nature. Share stories of your adventures with fellow travellers around the fireplace, savouring the camaraderie that comes from shared experiences.

As the sun sets over the majestic peaks of the Tetons, you'll find yourself filled with a sense of accomplishment and wonder. And as you drift off to sleep, you'll carry with you memories that will last a lifetime.

postcards.name: Tackle the Rapids on a White Water Rafting Trip
postcards.intro: When you stay at the Bentwood Inn, the Snake River in Wyoming invites you to experience a variety of adventures, catering to every taste and temperament. Come and enjoy the white water rafting and scenic float trips. Whether you're a thrill-seeker craving excitement or a nature enthusiast seeking serenity, there's something here for you.
postcards.story:
If you have a thirst for adrenaline, white water rafting on the Snake River offers you an exhilarating experience like no other. Buckle up and prepare for a wild ride as you navigate through the rushing rapids, feeling the rush of the water against your skin and the wind in your hair. It's a heart-pounding adventure that will leave you breathless and craving for more.

But if you prefer a more leisurely pace, a scenic float trip down the Snake River is the perfect option. Drift along the calm waters, soaking in the breathtaking views of rugged mountains, sprawling plains and diverse wildlife. Keep your eyes peeled for glimpses of deer, elk and maybe even a majestic bald eagle soaring overhead. It's a peaceful journey that offers you a glimpse into the raw beauty of the Wild West.

These float trips are suitable for adventurers of all ages, making them a wonderful option for families and groups looking to bond over shared experiences. The best part is that you can immerse yourself in the wonders of nature without the worry of getting wet, making it an accessible and enjoyable activity for everyone.

Drenched in anticipation, you’ll enjoy the river's wild embrace. Your raft will pass through tumultuous rapids and all you can sense is adventure and laughter echoing over the roar. You’ll feel an adrenaline surge with each heart-stopping drop, bonding you with other travellers in shared exhilaration. Amidst nature's beauty, your fear will dissolve, replaced by the euphoria of conquering the untamed waters together.

Surely, this activity promises to be an adventure of a lifetime for you. Come back to the hotel and relax in the inviting atmosphere of Bentwood Inn, recounting the highlights of your river adventure with fellow travellers.

name: Eighth Bastion
intro: Step into a chapter of history when you come to Eighth Bastion, in the heart of Fort Cochin. Located on once historical Dutch landmark, this hotel conjures up visions of the past, and brings alive a time when this Malabar region was a battleground for Europe’s most prominent seafaring nations, who fought over spices and trade routes for 300 years.

news_article.title: Stay at Eighth Bastion Where History Meets Hospitality
news_article.description: A Luxury Boutique Hotel in Kerala

postcards.name: Discover Kochi's Charm in a Tuk-Tuk
postcards.intro: Cruise through the historic streets of Fort Kochi on a leisurely tuk-tuk ride, soaking in the sights and sounds of this vibrant city. With charming architecture, picturesque churches and bustling markets, it's the perfect excursion to experience the local lifestyle up close. Plus, it's an economical and sustainable way to navigate the narrow pathways of Kochi's bustling markets with ease.
postcards.story:
In Kochi, tuk-tuks reign supreme as the ideal mode of transport, offering a convenient alternative for those who prefer not to walk long distances. Navigating through these narrow lanes aboard a tuk-tuk adds an extra layer of excitement to the exploration, allowing you to soak in the sights and sounds of Kochi's vibrant streetscape in true local style.

You can start with a leisurely stroll through the narrow bylanes of Fort Kochi, where every turn reveals centuries-old architecture steeped in history. The grandeur of picturesque churches, their spires reaching for the sky, is sure to fascinate you.

Experience the charm of exploring Kochi like a local, gliding effortlessly from one attraction to another in the comfort of a tuk-tuk. Let the city unfold before you, as you admire the impressive architecture of majestic palaces, formidable forts and intricately designed ancestral homes, each telling a story of its own.

As you meander through the maze-like streets, try to observe Kochi's past. Discover the city's pivotal role in the spice trade and maritime commerce, with echoes of its bustling markets and lively harbours resonating through the air.

Engage with the warm-hearted locals, whose stories breathe life into Kochi's vibrant history, offering glimpses into the cultural prowess of this enchanting state. Kochi's thriving art scene at galleries and cafés like David Hall, where every brushstroke and sculpture speaks volumes about the city's creative spirit is also worth exploring.

You can also wander through designer boutiques, art stores and cultural hubs scattered around Fort Kochi, each offering a unique perspective on the city's eclectic culture and artistic heritage. With its blend of history, culture and artistic expression, a tuk-tuk adventure in Kochi promises an unforgettable journey of discovery to experience the very essence of Kochi.

postcards.name: Savour Culinary Excellence at Eighth Bastion
postcards.intro: Explore the culinary world that Eighth Bastion offers. With a blend of colonial influences meeting innovative creations, a dining experience here is a highlight of your stay. From Dutch specialty bread to inventive dishes like curry pasta, every bite offers a unique fusion of flavours, curated to allure your taste buds and ignite your senses.
postcards.story:
As you step into the charming ambiance of Eighth Bastion’s dining hall, the air is filled with the aroma of freshly baked Dutch specialty bread, known as "Bruder." Originating from the colonial era, this bread is a testament to the rich history of Fort Kochi and the culinary influences brought by its visitors. Take a moment to savour the warm, crusty exterior and soft, fluffy interior of the Bruder, as each bite reveals layers of flavour that bring back to a bygone era. 

Back at Eighth Bastion, the kitchens are bustling with creativity and innovation, as master chefs blend distinctive flavours from the West and the East to create culinary masterpieces. Inspired by the richness of Kochi's cultural heritage, the chefs have crafted a menu that celebrates the fusion of flavours and techniques from around the world.

Indulge in dishes like curry pasta, a culinary creation born from the imagination of the celebrity chef, David Rocco. This innovative dish seamlessly combines the aromatic spices of Indian curry with the comforting allure of Italian pasta, resulting in a symphony of flavours that dance on your palate with each mouthful.

Allow the expert chefs to guide your meals with their daily recommendations of specials, offering tempting hints of the delights that await your palate. Alternatively, explore the extensive selection of seafood, meat and vegetarian tasting menus at the East Indies restaurant, where each dish is crafted with care and attention to detail.

Whether you're savouring the rich history of Dutch bread, exploring innovative fusion dishes or feasting on a culinary adventure guided by the expert chefs, Eighth Bastion promises a gastronomic experience that transcends boundaries and celebrates the diversity of flavours from around the world.

name: Beach Gate Bungalows
intro: Down time-worn lanes, under huge rain trees, just a stroll away from the beach of Fort Kochi, is where you come across Beach Gate Bungalows. Built in the 50s for the Sterling Companies in Kochi, this heritage property was restored and has been operational since 2015.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Dutch-Style Stay at Beach Gate Bungalows
news_article.description: A Restored Heritage Property in Kerala

postcards.name: Learn About Fort Kochi's Chinese Fishing Nets
postcards.intro: Discover Fort Kochi's fascinating history at Beach Gate Resort by visiting the iconic Chinese fishing nets. Once believed to be from China, recent studies suggest a Portuguese origin, adding to their allure. Watch these nets in action, marvelling at the blend of human ingenuity and mechanical precision they represent. It's a unique experience not to be missed during your stay.
postcards.story:
Step into a world where history and tradition intertwine at Beach Gate Resort in Fort Kochi. Just a stone's throw away from the property lies one of the most iconic symbols of Kerala's coastal heritage - the Chinese fishing nets. 

As the sun sets over the Arabian Sea, take a leisurely stroll along the road from the jetty to the beach, where these towering nets stand in silent vigil. Marvel at their intricate design and ponder the centuries-old craftsmanship.

Pause for a moment and watch as the fishermen deftly manoeuvre the massive nets, a ritual of movement and rhythm against the backdrop of crashing waves. Each pull of the rope is a proof of human ingenuity, as simple mechanical principles and physical strength combine to harvest the bounty of the sea.

For the first-time visitor to Fort Kochi, this experience is a must. It's not just about witnessing a traditional fishing method; it's about seeing a piece of living history. Feel the weight of the ropes in your hands, hear the creak of the wooden pulleys and smell the salty sea breeze.

Afterward, return to Beach Gate Resort, where the echoes of Fort Kochi's storied past linger in every corner. Reflect on your experience as you relax in the comfort of your elegant accommodation, knowing that you've glimpsed a rare combination of tradition and innovation that defines the soul of this beautiful coastal town.

postcards.name: Enhance Your Stay at Beach Gate with Kochi Muziris Biennale
postcards.intro: Elevate your stay at Beach Gate in Kochi by immersing yourself in the transformative experience of the Kochi Muziris Biennale. This international exhibition showcases contemporary artworks in unconventional settings, blending history with creativity. Join the vibrant cultural scene of Fort Kochi as you explore works by talented artists from around the world.
postcards.story:
When you plan your stay at Beach Gate in Kochi, seize the opportunity to participate in an artistic exploration by aligning your dates with the biennial Kochi Muziris Biennale. Established in 2013, this event has quickly become a highlight of the international art scene, drawing visitors from far and wide to experience its dynamic offerings.

Set against the backdrop of Fort Kochi's rich cultural heritage, the biennale offers a blend of tradition and innovation. Wander through the town's twisting lanes, where ancient buildings and spice warehouses serve as galleries for cutting-edge installations, paintings, sculptures and performance art. Each venue tells a story, weaving together the past and present.

What sets the Kochi Muziris Biennale apart is its unconventional approach to exhibition spaces. Unlike traditional art festivals, this event sprawls across the town and surrounding islands, using heritage structures, disused buildings, cafes and galleries as makeshift galleries. As you traverse Fort Kochi's streets, you'll encounter art in unexpected places, from dilapidated warehouses to quaint alleyways, creating an immersive and ever-evolving experience.

The biennale's dynamic nature invites visitors to engage with the town's ancient character while exploring contemporary art forms. It's an opportunity to witness the intersection of cultures, ideas and perspectives, as artists from diverse backgrounds come together to ignite dialogue and inspire change.

For art enthusiasts, the Kochi Muziris Biennale is more than an exhibition; it's a journey of discovery, a celebration of creativity and a testament to the enduring spirit of Fort Kochi. So when you plan a stay at Beach Gate, be sure to align it with the magic of the Kochi Muziris Biennale.

name: Saruni Wild
intro: Saruni Wild is a 5-tents camp located at the very heart of the Masai Mara ecosystem, in a community-owned conservancy called Lemek.

news_article.title: Become One with Nature at Saruni Wild
news_article.description: A Luxury Camp in the Heart of the Masai Mara

postcards.name: Spot Incredible Wildlife at the Mara-Serengeti Ecosystem
postcards.intro: When you stay at Saruni Wild, you step into a space where the heartbeat of Africa pulses through the air you breathe. Located within the wild and beautiful embrace of the Mara-Serengeti ecosystem, Saruni Wild invites you to witness the wonders of nature in its purest form.
postcards.story:
Imagine waking up to the sounds of the wild, where each dawn is greeted by the calls of lions, the trumpeting of elephants and the thundering hooves of wildebeest. As you move out from your tent, you find yourself immersed in a landscape teeming with life. The air is alive with anticipation as if every rustle in the bushes promises a new discovery.

Your senses come alive as you traverse the terrain, your eyes scanning the horizon for signs of movement. And before you know it, you find yourself face to face with Africa's most iconic creatures. Majestic lions bask in the golden light of the savannah, their mane ruffled by the gentle breeze. Towering giraffes graze leisurely amidst the acacia trees, their graceful silhouettes painting a picture of serenity against the vast expanse of the sky.

But it's not just the big cats and giants of the savannah that captivate your attention. Every corner of Saruni Wild reveals a hidden world waiting to be explored. Agile cheetahs dart across the plains in pursuit of prey, their sleek forms blending effortlessly with the tall grass. Playful zebras frolic in the distance, their distinctive stripes forming a mesmerising mosaic against the landscape.

As you journey deeper into the heart of the wilderness, beautiful nature unfolds before you – each moment more enchanting than the last. And when the sun sets on the horizon, casting shades of orange and pink across the sky, you realise that you are but a guest in this ancient land.

At Saruni Wild, the wonders of Africa are not just a spectacle to behold, but a reminder of the intricate web of life that sustains us all.

postcards.name: Join the Warriors Academy with the Maasai
postcards.intro: Warriors Academy is offered at Saruni Samburu where you’ll learn about the fascinating Samburu way of life, and at Saruni Mara and Saruni Wild in the Masai Mara, where you’ll delve into the vibrant culture and customs of the Maasai. Get ready to be inspired as you learn the classic survival skills of the legendary Maasai warriors at Saruni Wild.
postcards.story:
Imagine stepping into the shoes of a junior warrior, learning the age-old survival skills that have been passed down through generations. Guided by the Maasai, you'll delve into the heart of the Masai Mara, where the vast plains become your classroom and nature your teacher.

As you set out on your adventure, you'll learn the art of tracking animals, following in the footsteps of the Maasai as they read the signs left behind by wildlife. Every footprint, every broken twig, becomes a clue in the intricate puzzle of the savannah.

But the experience goes beyond mere observation. Under the expert guidance of the Maasai, you'll also learn to craft tools using traditional methods, connecting with the ancient wisdom that has sustained their way of life for centuries. From crafting spears to fashioning shelters, you'll gain invaluable insights into the resourcefulness and resilience of these legendary warriors.

What makes this experience truly special is its accessibility to families with children. As you learn alongside your loved ones, you'll not only bond over shared experiences but also instill in them a deep appreciation for nature and the cultures that call it home.

Here, each day brings new challenges and discoveries. As the sun sets on another day of adventure, you'll carry with you not just some amazing skills but also memories that will last a lifetime.

If you're seeking an unforgettable journey that combines education with excitement, look no further than the 'Warriors Academy' at Saruni Wild. Come and let the spirit of the Maasai warriors ignite the fire of adventure within you. The African wilderness is a profound teacher, igniting your spirit and offering invaluable lessons. Are you prepared to learn the teachings of a warrior?

name: Wellcomm Spa & Hotel
intro: Wellcomm to your own reconnection sanctuary. A concept that merges hospitality and wellness, allowing human beings’ inner nature to grow.

news_article.title: Reconnect with Yourself at Wellcomm Spa & Hotel
news_article.description: A Luxury Hotel in Medellín, Colombia

postcards.name: Challenge Your Limits by Indulging in a Wellness Program
postcards.intro: When you step into Wellcomm Spa & Hotel, you're stepping into a world where every aspect of your well-being is nurtured and embraced. From the moment you arrive, the wellness program is designed to guide you on a journey of transformation, helping you cultivate habits that promote balance in your life.
postcards.story:
Imagine starting your day with energising workouts that aren't about perfection but about building a positive relationship with your body. Here, it's not about sculpting muscles, it's about nurturing a lifestyle that's both healthy and sustainable.

Prioritising wellness is vital because it fuels our ability to thrive. It enhances our physical health, mental clarity and emotional resilience, enabling us to navigate life's challenges with strength and vitality.

As you nourish yourself throughout the day, you'll discover a mindful approach to eating. The delicious and healthy foods are carefully selected to honour their origin and natural nutrients, satisfying both your palate and your well-being.

But the Wellcomm experience goes beyond physical nourishment. It's about holistic healing, both physically and mentally. Picture yourself indulging in personalised massages and stretches or unwinding in the signature thermal baths at AKEN Spa & Wellness. It's a comprehensive healing process, restoring your energy levels and revitalising your spirit.

If you've been struggling with insomnia, you’ll receive help here. The experts work tirelessly to identify triggers and offer innovative solutions, so you can finally experience restful sleep. You’re covered when it comes to mental and emotional well-being. The training is designed to reduce the impact of stress and anxiety, incorporating meditation, mindful breathing and other relaxation techniques into your daily routine.

The Wellcomm wellness program isn't just a luxury, it's a necessity in today's fast-paced world. It's a reminder to slow down, to take care of yourself and to prioritise your health and happiness above all else.

So whether you're here for a weekend getaway or an extended stay, immerse yourself in the Wellcomm experience. Rediscover what it means to truly thrive and leave feeling refreshed, rejuvenated and ready to take on the world.

postcards.name: Heal Yourself at AKEN Spa and Bath House
postcards.intro: When you visit AKEN Spa and Bath House at Wellcomm Spa & Hotel in Medellín, you're going on a journey to enhance your quality of life through the healing power of water. Here, the personalised experiences prioritise your well-being, focusing on every sense. Let’s begin your healing journey!
postcards.story:
Inspired by ancient civilisations, the facilities at the AKEN spa echo the therapeutic traditions of utilising water for physical, mental and social wellness. From the moment you step in, you're surrounded by a welcoming atmosphere, beginning with a ritual foot immersion featuring salts and aromatherapy to calm your mind, invigorate your body and uplift your spirit.

The spa offers you a sanctuary for relaxation and healing, providing a refuge from the stresses of daily life. Through therapeutic treatments, such as massages and hydrotherapy, they promote physical and mental well-being, restoring balance and vitality to the body and mind.

Each AKEN moment is tailored to your needs. With the guidance of personal wellness creators, you'll select rituals that resonate with you, ensuring a truly bespoke experience. Whether you seek relaxation, rejuvenation or simply a moment of calmness, your desires are mindfully looked into.

As you immerse yourself in the thermal baths and indulge in the rituals, you'll feel the tension melt away, leaving you refreshed and revitalised. Gladly, it doesn't end there. Before you leave, enjoy the balancing AKEN infusion, a blend crafted to calm your senses and leave you feeling grounded and energised.

AKEN Spa believes that prioritising your physical and mental balance is essential for a fulfilling life. By taking the time to care for yourself, you're investing in your overall well-being, ensuring that you can enjoy not just more years, but more quality years.

Whether you're here for a weekend retreat or an extended stay, make sure to carve out time for yourself at AKEN Spa and Bath House. Let them guide you on a journey of relaxation, renewal and restoration, so you can leave feeling truly nourished and ready to celebrate whatever lies ahead.

name: Travesia Atacama-Uyuni
intro: The architecture of the Lodge at Uyuni’s Salt Flat and our Mountain Lodges has been planned to reduce the interference with the natural surrounding as much as possible and to highlight the landscapes that host each construction.

news_article.title: Traverse the Salt Flats Surrounding Explora Travesia Atacama-Uyuni
news_article.description: A Remote Luxury Stay in Chile and Bolivia

postcards.name: Explore the Beauty of the Andean Night Sky
postcards.intro: When you choose to journey through the cosmos with Explora Travesia Atacama-Uyuni, you're in for an exceptional experience. As a traveller drawn to the mysteries of the stars, you'll find the Andean skies offer unparalleled conditions for your exploration. With minimal light and air pollution, the stars and constellations reveal themselves with striking clarity, inviting you to gaze in wonder.
postcards.story:
The night sky's vastness, stars' twinkling dance and cosmic wonders evoke awe, connecting us to the infinite beauty of the universe. Depending on the season of your visit, you'll encounter different celestial features in Atacama-Uyuni. The Southern Cross and Orion may dominate the sky, their patterns etched against the vast expanse above. Then there's the Milky Way, weaving its luminous path across the darkness, its presence intertwined with the history and culture of the Andean people.

As you go on your nighttime adventure, you'll find yourself immersed not only in the beauty of the sky but also in the rich cultural landscapes that surround you. Exploring local villages under the cloak of night, you'll discover a deeper connection to the people who call this region home. Their stories and traditions echo through the darkness, adding depth to your understanding of this unique corner of the world.

But the exploration doesn't end when the sun rises. With Explora Travesia Atacama-Uyuni, you have the opportunity to delve further into the archaeological wonders that lie hidden beneath the surface. From ancient ruins to mysterious artefacts, each discovery adds another layer to the story of this land.

Throughout your journey, you'll be guided by experts who share your passion for discovery. Whether it's unravelling the mysteries of the cosmos or uncovering the secrets of the past, you'll find yourself in good company. Together, you'll explore, learn and marvel at the wonders that await you.

So, if you're ready to chart a course through the stars and the sands, consider joining Explora Travesia Atacama-Uyuni. Your adventure awaits, promising not only a journey through space and time but also a deeper understanding of the world we inhabit.

postcards.name: Enjoy Your Overland Exploration to Ramaditas
postcards.intro: Go on an unforgettable overland journey from Explora Travesía Atacama to Ramaditas. As you traverse the Altiplano, you'll witness the raw beauty of the Andes. Setting out from the lodge, your adventure begins, crossing into Bolivia with ease. Are you all set for this incredible road journey?
postcards.story:
While on your overland exploration journey from Atacama to Ramaditas, your first stop is the mesmerising white lagoon. Walk along its southern border, soaking in the breathtaking high-altitude landscape and spotting diverse birdlife. Next, head to the green lagoon, a picturesque spot that serves as a gateway to the Apachetas viewpoint. From here, marvel at the majestic Licancabur and Sairecabur volcanoes, their towering peaks dominating the skyline.

Continue your journey to the Sol de Mañana Geysers, where the pungent scent of sulfur hangs in the air, a telltale sign of the rich mineral deposits beneath the earth's surface. As you walk amidst these otherworldly geothermal wonders, you'll be intrigued by the raw power of nature.

But the real highlight awaits at the lagoons, where vibrant flocks of flamingos and other avian species gather in abundance. Here, amidst this serene landscape, you'll enjoy a delicious lunch, savouring not just the food but the entire experience of dining amidst the vast expanse of the Altiplano.

As you gaze out over the red lagoon, its waters shimmering in the sunlight, you'll feel a sense of calmness. It's a rare and precious moment of silence in a world that often feels consumed by noise.

Throughout your journey, the sense of exploration and discovery will accompany you every step of the way. You'll find yourself immersed in the beauty of the Andes, surrounded by picturesque landscapes.

As you return to Explora Travesía Atacama-Uyuni at the end of the day, you'll carry with you memories that will last a lifetime. Memories of vast open skies, towering mountains and the unspoiled wilderness of the Altiplano. Memories that remind you of the sheer wonder and beauty of our planet and the joy of going on a journey into the unknown.

name: Sawantwadi Palace
intro: The Royal Palace of Sawantwadi is truly an architectural masterpiece that effortlessly merges the English arches with the native workmanship and the vibrant red laterite stones. The bricked brown walls add to the ethnicity of this two-storied Palace and makes it a unique, unmissable tourist attraction of Sawantwadi.

news_article.title: Experience a Royal Stay at Sawantwadi Palace
news_article.description: A Luxurious Abode Showcasing Unmatched Heritage

postcards.name: Rediscover Forgotten Crafts at Sawantwadi Palace
postcards.intro: Sawantwadi stands as the sole bastion of India's ancient Ganjifa tradition, skillfully preserved by the Sawant Bhonsle family. With unwavering dedication, they safeguard the legacy of Ganjifa and lacquerware crafts, and by taking a workshop, you can try these time-honoured art forms.
postcards.story:
At the boutique art hotel in Sawantwadi, you can learn about the ancient crafts of Ganjifa and Lacquerware. Experience firsthand the techniques passed down through generations, as artisans breathe life into intricate designs. From the vibrant hues of Ganjifa cards to the lustrous finish of lacquerware, each piece tells a story of heritage, resilience and artistic innovation.

Ganjifa, originating from Persia, found its home in Sawantwadi during the 18th and 19th centuries, where it was nurtured and revived by the visionary H.H Rajesaheb Shivramraje Bhonsle and his wife. Their encounter with Sawantwadi Cards at the Victoria and Albert Museum ignited a revival mission, leading to the establishment of Sawantwadi lacquerware.

Under their patronage, the art of Ganjifa was not only preserved but also rejuvenated, with intricate floral and mythological motifs adorning hand-painted cards and wooden objects. The meticulous craftsmanship of Ganjifa, once on the brink of extinction, now thrives as a testament to Sawantwadi's artistic prowess.

In parallel, the craft of lacquerware found its roots in Sawantwadi in the late 17th century, introduced by Telangana Brahmins. Flourishing under royal patronage, this art form expanded its horizons beyond wooden furniture to encompass board games, chess sets, candlesticks and more. 

Today, the Sawant Bhonsle family continues to uphold these traditions, ensuring the legacy lives on. In Sawantwadi, the art isn't just a reflection of the past, it's a living legacy, inviting you to partake in a journey of discovery and appreciation.

Dive into the magnificent world of Ganjifa art by attending a unique workshop. A Ganjifa card of your choice can be painted beautifully by you with the guidance of a professional Sawantwadi lacquerwares artist. Your hand-painted card will be a token of this rich cultural exchange.

postcards.name: Enjoy a Private Picnic Amidst Amboli Ghats' Serenity
postcards.intro: Escape to the serene Amboli Ghats with a private picnic experience curated by your hosts at Sawantwadi Palace. Located amidst the lush green hills of Amboli in the Western Ghats, this picturesque hill station offers an abundance of experiences for nature lovers. Lose yourself in the region's rich biodiversity and unwind amidst scenic surroundings.
postcards.story:
Sawantwadi Palace entices travellers of all kinds, offering a number of experiences that cater to diverse interests. Whether you're a history enthusiast, a culture buff, a culinary connoisseur, or simply a nature lover, the palace has something special in store for you. 

For all nature lovers, here’s an activity we highly recommend. Venture into the serene Amboli Ghats on the property’s exclusive private picnic experience, a perfect retreat to seek solace in nature's embrace. Set atop the vast mountain estate sprawling across 28 acres, you are treated to a leisurely three- to four-hour picnic amidst the verdant landscape. Delight in the tranquil ambiance, surrounded by lush flora and fauna, as you relax at tables adorned with delectable sandwiches and your choice of wine or coffee.

Discover the magic of Amboli Ghats as you wander through the verdant hills. Adventure-seekers can embark on thrilling treks, exploring uncharted paths and uncovering hidden gems nestled within the lush greenery.

For those seeking a more leisurely experience, find solace near the historic remains of the palace, soaking in the timeless beauty of the surroundings. Reflect on the rich heritage and cultural significance of the region, as you bask in the calmness of the mountain retreat.

Whether you're embarking on a solo journey of self-discovery, enjoying a romantic getaway with your loved one, or embarking on a family adventure, the private picnic at Amboli Ghats promises an unforgettable experience tailored to your preferences. 

Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and reconnect with nature's wonders amidst the breathtaking landscape of Amboli through this activity curated by Sawantwadi Palace.

name: Nadis Hotel
intro: When day ends and night falls and its quiet and you can see the stars. On the foot hills of Zabarwan hills and few kilometers from the famous Mughal garden. Nadis is a modern Kashmir House, inspired by the picturesque alpine landscape and rich heritage of Kashmir culture.

news_article.title: Delve into Kashmir’s Cultural Richness at Nadis Hotel
news_article.description: Your Kashmiri Home Surrounded by Nature

postcards.name: Buy Vegetables from the Floating Vegetable Market
postcards.intro: Imagine waking up early in the morning during your stay at Nadis Hotel in Kashmir. As you step out onto the balcony, there's a hint of chill as you watch the first light of dawn break over the majestic Dal Lake. You've heard stories about the floating vegetable market that operates before sunrise – come and witness it firsthand.
postcards.story:
As you make your way to the edge of the Dal Lake, you're greeted by a scene straight out of a postcard. The channels are alive with activity, bustling with boats decorated with colourful produce from the floating gardens. These gardens, nurtured by the lake's waters, yield a variety of fresh vegetables – from runner beans to carrots and even squashes as big as baseball bats.

The air is filled with the hum of conversation as men in traditional kurta-pyjamas navigate their long boats skillfully, manoeuvring prow to prow to negotiate deals. More boats glide in along the mirror-like waterways, adding to the lively atmosphere.

The beauty of the surroundings is undeniable. Marzipan-coloured lilies and lotus flowers dot the surface of the water, their petals still closed in anticipation of the rising sun. In the distance, the mountains stand tall, their peaks tinged with shades of purple and pine green.

As you observe this bustling scene, you’ll feel a sense of wonder at the ingenuity of the farmers who have adapted to the unique conditions of the lake. The floating vegetable market is not just a place to buy and sell produce but it also reflects the resilience and resourcefulness of the local people.

You take it all in, savouring the moment and feeling grateful for the opportunity to experience something truly special. The floating vegetable market on Dal Lake is a window into the soul of Kashmir, where tradition and innovation meet against the backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty. And as the sun rises higher in the sky, casting its golden glow over the scene, you know that this is a memory you'll cherish forever.

postcards.name: Visit the Beautiful Town of Pahalgam
postcards.intro: While staying at Nadis Hotel in Kashmir, visiting Pahalgam is a must for any traveller. Located in the Anantnag District, this popular tourist destination attracts visitors from far and wide every year. Come and experience the charm of Pahalgam and immerse yourself in its beauty.
postcards.story:
As you venture into Pahalgam, also known as the ‘village of shepherds,’ you'll be greeted by breathtaking views that stretch as far as your eyes can see. This picturesque hill station serves as the entry point for the famous Amarnath Cave, a sacred site for Hindu pilgrims. Along the way, you can even indulge in the thrill of water rafting, adding an adventurous twist to your journey.

Pahalgam's charm lies in its panoramic views of the majestic Himalayan ranges. The town is surrounded by snow-covered mountain peaks and dense pine and deodar forests, creating a serene and tranquil atmosphere that's perfect for a holiday getaway.

One of the highlights of your visit will be exploring Betaab Valley, just seven kilometres from Pahalgam. This enchanting valley, immortalised by actor Sunny Deol's movie ‘Betaab,’ offers a glimpse into paradise with its lush greenery and the gushing Sheshnag River at its mouth.

For a truly memorable experience, make your way to Aru, a village located 11 kilometres from Pahalgam. Located at an elevation of 2,408 metres, this meadow serves as the starting point for the famous trek via Lidderwat, leading all the way to the majestic Kolahoi Glaciers at an altitude of 3,400 metres. The journey promises breathtaking views and an opportunity to connect with nature in its purest form.

Pahalgam is not just about natural beauty but it's also a haven for food enthusiasts. A visit to the Himalayan Cheese Factory promises to delight your taste buds as you discover the finer nuances of cheese-making and indulge in some delectable samples.
Your visit to Pahalgam promises to be an unforgettable experience filled with amazing landscapes, thrilling adventures and culinary delights. Pack your bags and go on a journey of discovery and relaxation in this charming hill station.

name: Brij Bageecha
intro: Nestled amidst 11 acres of lush greenery and surrounded by water bodies, blooming fruit orchards, organic vegetable farms s and manicured gardens, Brij Bageecha Kukas – Jaipur welcomes guests to a world of luxury and tranquillity.

news_article.title: Unwind in Style at Brij Bageecha
news_article.description: A Luxurious and Peaceful Oasis in Jaipur

postcards.name: Witness the Timeless Art of Brick-Making in Jaipur
postcards.intro: During your stay at Brij Bageecha, explore the colourful city of Jaipur in the age-old craft of brick-making, offering a fascinating glimpse into the city's ancient art practices.
postcards.story:
Discover the heart of Jaipur's industrial landscape with a visit to its renowned brick factories. Stepping into these bustling hubs of activity, you'll be transported back in time as you witness the traditional art of brick-making in action. 

From the moment clay is harvested to the moulding and drying processes, every step unfolds before your eyes, revealing the intricate craftsmanship that goes into producing each brick.

The brick-making industry holds a significant place in Jaipur's economic and cultural fabric. As one of the city's oldest and most vital sectors, it provides employment opportunities for countless individuals and contributes to the region's growth and development. Visiting a brick factory offers a rare glimpse into the lives of the hardworking artisans who dedicate themselves to preserving this ancient craft.

At the heart of the brick-making process lies a deep-rooted connection to Jaipur's rich heritage. Passed down through generations, the techniques and traditions employed in these factories reflect the city's enduring commitment to its cultural legacy. From the earthy scent of freshly moulded clay to the sounds of workers shaping each brick by hand, every moment spent in these factories is a testament to Jaipur's enduring spirit of craftsmanship and ingenuity.

Moreover, a visit to a brick factory is not just an educational experience; it's also an opportunity to support local artisans and communities. By engaging with the craftsmen and learning about their craft, you contribute to the preservation of Jaipur's cultural heritage and ensure the continued vitality of its traditional industries.

In essence, exploring Jaipur's brick factories offers a window into the soul of the city itself. It's a chance to witness history in the making and to forge a deeper connection with the richness of life that defines this remarkable destination.

postcards.name: Master Rajasthani Cooking
postcards.intro: Unlock the secrets of authentic Rajasthani cuisine during your stay at Brij Bageecha. Join the culinary experts for a cooking class, where you'll learn to prepare traditional dishes like gatta curry, ker sangri and dal baati churma. You’ll also learn about other popular delicacies and recipes loved by not just Indians but foodies from around the world.
postcards.story:
Experience the colourful tastes of Rajasthan through the interactive cooking classes taught by skilled chefs. Learn how to prepare classic dishes such as gatta curry and laal maas as you delve into the rich culinary history of Rajasthan. 

Start each session by exploring local markets to select the freshest spices, vegetables and meats for an authentic cooking adventure. In the property’s modern kitchen, the chefs will teach you traditional cooking methods that have been handed down for generations. 

Discover the secrets of blending spices, balancing flavours, and perfecting the timing in Rajasthani cuisine. Whether you're making crispy baatis or cooking fragrant curries, each stage of the recipe allows you to explore the vibrant culinary heritage of Rajasthan.

As your dishes come to life, the aromas of cumin, coriander and chilli fill the air, exciting your taste buds and stirring memories of Rajasthani feasts. Once your creations are complete, gather around the table for a traditional lunch to savour the fruits of your labour amidst the serene surroundings of Brij Bageecha.

With each bite, you'll taste the heart and soul of Rajasthan, celebrating the vibrant culture and heritage of this enchanting region. Whether you're a beginner eager to learn the basics or a seasoned cook looking to expand your repertoire, the Rajasthani cooking classes offer an unforgettable gastronomical journey that will leave you inspired.

name: Chitoor Kottaram
intro: Chitoor Kottaram as its very name implies was the royal residence of the erstwhile ruling family of Cochin when the king sought to take some time off from their worldly duties and pay homage to the family deity in the temple nearby.

news_article.title: Stay in a Heritage Mansion at Chittoor Kottaram
news_article.description: A Secluded Retreat in Kerala

postcards.name: Explore Kerala's Textile and Handloom Heritage
postcards.intro: Explore the vibrant and traditional textile and handloom heritage of Kerala during your stay at Chittoor Kottaram. Venture into the bustling streets of Ernakulam, where the allure of Kasavu dresses and handloom apparel is irresistible. From traditional sarees and exquisite gold jewellery to boutique stores offering handcrafted clothing, Ernakulam boasts a treasure trove of fashion delights.
postcards.story:
As you envision the vibrant and traditional fabric and textile heritage of Kerala, the first image that springs to mind is that of a woman gracefully draped in a Kerala Kasavu saree, adorned with intricate gold jewellery, and a man donning a Kasavu dhoti. This iconic attire beautifully exemplifies the distinctive and expressive nature of Kerala's clothing tradition.

Delving deeper into Kerala's rich cultural heritage, you will discover a world intricately woven with handicrafts, coir weaving, ivory works, and most notably, handloom weaving. These crafts not only serve as symbols of tradition but also play a pivotal role in Kerala's economy, providing livelihoods for many.

The acclaim garnered by Kerala handlooms transcends borders, with people from around the globe praising the exceptional structure and texture of these fabrics. Renowned for their fine quality,  thread count, and vibrant natural colours, Kerala handloom products are highly coveted.

Within Kerala, four main locations stand out as bastions of traditional handloom weaving: Balaramapuram, Kuthampully, Chendamangalam, and Kasaragod. Each region infuses its unique geographical and cultural influences into the fabrics, resulting in distinct styles and techniques. A stroll in the markets of Ernakulam will get you a glimpse of all these styles. 

Witnessing the artistry firsthand, one cannot help but be enticed by the harmonious shades of the looms. In the handloom villages of Kerala, golden yarns intertwine with hard work, faith, dedication, and mastery to produce some of the finest hand woven Kasavu fabrics. The very essence of these villages is infused with the charm of the looms, as dancing yarns give birth to elegant Kasavu clothing that embodies the soul of Kerala's textile tradition.

postcards.name: Indulge in Exclusive Cultural Immersion in Kerala
postcards.intro: Indulge in an exclusive cultural immersion at Chittoor Kottaram with specially curated private performances especially for you and your loved ones From traditional dance spectacles to devotional melodies, these bespoke shows offer a glimpse into Kerala's rich heritage, promising an unforgettable stay filled with fun and lively moments, climbed with a comfortable stay.
postcards.story:
During your stay at Chittoor Kottaram, you can sign up for specially curated traditional performances where you’re treated to a truly unique experience. These private performances are curated to evoke the essence of Kerala's cultural world. These fascinating shows, spanning 30 minutes, are an evidence to the property's commitment to offering you a journey beyond mere accommodation.

The first act, Muhini Attam, and Bharat Natyam, evoke a sense of nostalgia, transporting you back to the opulent courts of the Kochi Raja. These classical dance forms, characterised by their fluid movements, intricate gestures, and emotive expressions, were once patronised by royalty and esteemed for their elegance and grace. As you recline in luxury, enveloped by the timeless ambiance of Chittoor Kottaram, you witness the continuation of a tradition that has endured for centuries, forging a profound connection to the region's rich history and heritage.

Following this mesmerising display of classical dance, the atmosphere shifts to one of reverence with the Temple Song performance. Accompanied by the rhythmic beats of traditional instruments, you are invited to partake in a spiritual journey as the melodious chants fill the air, echoing the devotion of generations past.

What sets these performances apart is not just their cultural significance but also their exclusivity. Available only to guests staying for more than two nights, these shows offer a personalised touch, ensuring each visitor leaves with memories that linger long after their departure.

Imbued with authenticity and charm, these private performances elevate your experience at Chittoor Kottaram, providing a window into Kerala's vibrant cultural landscape. Whether indulging in the graceful movements of classical dance or being transported by the soul-stirring melodies of the Temple Song, you are sure to cherish these lively moments for years to come.

name: Quiet by the River
intro: Enveloped by the Malayattoor forest, the eco lodge allows you to experience nature in all its forms. From the harried and time-crunched city dweller seeking some peace and quiet, to the adventurer who can’t wait to get out and explore, there is something for everyone at Quiet by the River.

news_article.title: Find Peace at Quiet by the River
news_article.description: A Riverside Lodge Surrounded by a Forest Range in Kerala

postcards.name: Explore a Birder's Paradise
postcards.intro: Experience a one-of-a-kind birding expedition amidst the lush beauty of Malayattoor. Home to over 250 bird species, Quiet by the River welcomes both avid birders and first-timers to explore the natural habitat of some of Kerala’s exotic birds, tucked away in this well-kept secret.
postcards.story:
As dawn breaks, and the forest awakens to bird calls, you can set off on an exhilarating journey with expert naturalists. Armed with binoculars and boundless curiosity,  it’s time to uncover the hidden treasures of the bird kingdom.

Quiet by the River offers a gateway to explore the surrounding wilderness, where the Periyar River gently flows nearby. Amidst the evergreen and semi-evergreen forests of the mountain reserve, you can encounter diverse flora and fauna.  
Traverse the waters of the Periyar River, venturing to neighbouring islands and the mainland in search of elusive birds. Anticipation builds as you await the sight of a raptor soaring overhead or the graceful glide of a brahminy kite across the sky. Or simply wait to see the birds quench their thirst by the river.

Under the guidance of knowledgeable naturalists, discover the intricacies of bird behaviour and habitats, gaining insights into the fascinating world of ornithology. From the majestic lesser fish eagle to the elusive inhabitants of the Thattekad bird sanctuary, every sighting is a testament to the biodiversity of this pristine ecosystem.

As the sun climbs higher in the sky, be prepared to be delighted by the sheer diversity of birdlife that thrives in this wilderness. Whether you're a seasoned birder or a novice, Quiet by the River offers an opportunity to connect with nature and witness the magic of birding in its purest form. 

Grab your binoculars, unleash your sense of wonder, and prepare to be swept away!

postcards.name: Sign Up for a Farm Fresh Discovery
postcards.intro: Sign up for a guided tour at Quiet by the River’s organic farm, led by the ever-smiling Omana Chechi, a local team member at the property. Enjoy the delights of nature as you bite into a ripe star fruit, guava or a mango straight from the tree and witness the cultivation of spices like nutmeg, cardamom and pepper.
postcards.story:
How often do you get to experience what goes into building an organic farm? In city life, fresh food has become a rarity. At Quiet by the River, a farm-to-table experience is guaranteed. Extend this experience into an organic farm visit to understand how fresh food is farmed, maintained, and delivered to your plate for each meal. Peel back the layers of agricultural life and discover the journey from soil to supper, as expert guides lead you through the fields and vibrant orchards that sustain the culinary offerings.

Join Omana Chechi as she leads you through the expanse of the organic farm, situated just steps away from the lodge. Delight your senses as you sample the succulent flavours of freshly harvested starfruit, chikoo, guava, and mango…each bursting with the essence of nature's bounty.

As you wander through the lush greenery, discover the intricate process of cultivating spices such as nutmeg, cardamom, and pepper, gaining insight into the traditional methods passed down through generations. Explore the garden beds brimming with vibrant produce, from crisp cabbage and fiery chilli peppers to verdant spinach and fragrant lemons.

At Quiet by the River, sustainability is more than just a philosophy. The majority of the ingredients used in the culinary creations are sourced directly from the farm, ensuring that every meal is a celebration of freshness and flavour.

During your tour, glean valuable tips and tricks from Omana Chechi that you can incorporate into your own gardening endeavours, empowering you to cultivate your own patch of paradise. Whether you're a seasoned green thumb or a novice enthusiast, this organic farm tour promises an enriching experience that will deepen your connection to the land and the food it provides.

name: Basecamp Hill Top
intro: Basecamp Hill Top is an experience before being a property. Located in one of the newest and most exciting conservation projects of the Masai Mara region, Pardamat Conservation Area, it offers access to the first triple-use community-owned conservancy in the Masai Mara region.

news_article.title: Stay in a Safari Camp at Basecamp Hill Top
news_article.description: Culture & Wildlife in the Kenyan Wilderness

postcards.name: Walk in the Wild and Get Closer to Nature
postcards.intro: When you choose to stay at Basecamp Hill Top in Kenya, you're opening yourself up to an unparalleled experience: walking in the wild. Here, amidst the beautiful landscape of the Mara, every step you take brings you closer to the heart of nature. Come and walk in the wild and get closer to nature.
postcards.story:
Step out on foot, with nothing but the vast expanse of wilderness stretching out before you. As you walk, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of wonder, where every rock, tree and blade of grass tells a story of its own. Take the time to notice the smaller details — the delicate dance of a butterfly and the intricate patterns of a leaf — as you learn to appreciate the beauty that surrounds you.

The landscape itself is a masterpiece, painted with the rich colours of the African savannah. Rolling plains extend as far as the eye can see, punctuated by the iconic silhouettes of acacia trees. Here, you'll feel the pulse of the earth beneath your feet, connecting with the rhythm of the natural world in a way that can only be experienced on foot.

But it's not just the scenery that will captivate you; it's the wildlife encounters that make walking in the wild truly unforgettable. Stay attentive and you may be rewarded with glimpses of Africa's most iconic animals: the majestic lion, the graceful giraffe, the elusive leopard. Each sighting reflects the incredible biodiversity of the Mara and is a reminder of the importance of preserving this precious ecosystem for generations to come.

As you walk, you'll also have the opportunity to connect with the local community, learning about their traditional way of life and gaining insights into the delicate balance between humans and nature. Whether you're sharing stories around a campfire or joining a guided nature walk with Maasai warriors, you'll discover a deep appreciation for the land and its people.

So lace up your boots and prepare to go on the adventure of a lifetime. At Basecamp Hill Top, the wild awaits, ready to show you the true meaning of freedom and exhilaration.

postcards.name: Enjoy Al Fresco Dining Under an Acacia Tree
postcards.intro: At Basecamp Hill Top, al fresco dining is an experience that brings you closer to your surroundings. Come and enjoy a peaceful picnic lunch beneath the shade of an acacia tree after a morning walk with the Dorobo hunter-gatherers or dine under a starlit sky by the warmth of a campfire.
postcards.story:
Al fresco dining at Basecamp Hill Top is a highlight of the experience, offering you a chance to connect with nature while enjoying thoughtfully prepared meals. After a morning walk with the Dorobo hunter-gatherers, you’ll sit down for a picnic lunch in the shade of an acacia tree. The Dorobo guides, with their deep understanding of the land, show you how the environment serves as a source of food, shelter and even spiritual meaning. 

As you settle in for lunch, the vast plains stretch out before you. The simple yet delicious meal features local flavours and fresh ingredients, perfectly complementing the serene environment. Your guides share fascinating stories and bush lore, turning the meal into a cultural exchange. It’s a time for reflection, where you not only enjoy the food but also learn about the landscape around you.

Evenings bring a different kind of magic. Dinner is served under the open sky, with lanterns and a campfire providing gentle light and warmth. The night is quiet, apart from the soft sounds of the wilderness — distant animal calls and the crackling fire. Sitting around the table, you’ll enjoy a hearty meal, cooked with care and attention to detail.

What makes al fresco dining unique is the way it blends comfort with the raw beauty of the wild. Here, each meal feels like a celebration of the land. It’s a reminder of the simple joys of good food, great company and the endless wonders of the natural world.

name: Nimali Mara
intro: In the extreme north of the Serengeti, close to the border with neighbouring Kenya, the Mara River slices through one of the most far-flung corners of Tanzania where rolling green hills dotted with acacia trees open into wide, grassy savannahs.

news_article.title: Discover the African Wilderness with Nimali Mara
news_article.description: Where Remote Takes on New Meaning

postcards.name: Soak Up the Beauty of Nimali Mara’s Location
postcards.intro: Located discreetly on the side of a low kopje, Nimali Mara offers you a space amidst the sweeping plains of the northern Serengeti, where the rhythm of nature unfolds in countless stories of sights and sounds. As you gaze out from your luxurious accommodation, you'll be greeted by views of gently rolling plains stretching to the horizon.
postcards.story:
In one of the most remote corners of the Serengeti, you'll discover a sense of exclusivity and intimacy that sets Nimali Mara apart. Away from the crowds, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of pristine wilderness, where the wonders of nature unfold at their own pace. And while the great migration may draw the crowds from July to October each year, the allure of Nimali Mara extends far beyond this seasonal spectacle, offering you exceptional game-viewing opportunities year-round.

Prepare to be enchanted by the abundance of wildlife that calls this wilderness home, from the majestic elephants that roam the plains to the elusive predators that stalk their prey with stealth and precision. With some of the highest concentrations of lion, leopard, cheetah and hyena in the Serengeti, every game drive promises an unforgettable encounter with Africa's iconic wildlife. Here, you’ll love the views with distant hills painting a picture-perfect backdrop against the endless sky.

Just a short 35-minute drive from camp lies the Mara River, a lifeline for the countless creatures that inhabit these lands. Here, huge pods of hippos laze in the sun, while the largest crocodiles in Africa lurk beneath the surface, patiently awaiting their next meal.
