Witness the drama of nature unfold as wildebeest and zebra brave the treacherous waters during the great migration, their frantic crossings a reflection of the cycle of life and death that plays out on the plains.

As you go on your safari adventure with Nimali Mara, let the beauty of the Serengeti captivate your senses and ignite your spirit of adventure. Whether you're seeking solitude amidst nature's splendour or thrilling encounters with Africa's iconic wildlife, you'll find it all and more in this remote corner of paradise.

postcards.name: Enjoy the Adventures of a Game Drive
postcards.intro: Immerse yourself in the untamed beauty of the Serengeti with an unforgettable safari experience at Nimali Mara, where every moment promises adventure and discovery. As the sun rises over the vast savannah, go on a morning game drive that will take you deep into the heart of one of Africa's most remote and pristine wilderness areas.
postcards.story:
As you journey through the vast expanse of the Serengeti, keep your eyes peeled for the iconic silhouette of elephants roaming gracefully across the plains, their majestic presence reflects the enduring spirit of the African wilderness. Be prepared for thrilling encounters with the apex predators that reign supreme in these untamed lands — lions, leopards and cheetahs prowling the savannah in search of their next meal.

In the afternoon, as the sun begins its descent towards the horizon, go on another exhilarating game drive, where the golden light of dusk bathes the landscape in a magical glow. With the day's heat giving way to the cool embrace of twilight, the Serengeti comes alive with the sights and sounds of nocturnal creatures emerging from their daytime hiding places. From elusive nocturnal predators to the gentle giants of the plains, each moment offers you a new opportunity for discovery and wonder.

For the ultimate Serengeti adventure, consider taking to the skies on a hot-air balloon flight over the northern plains and the Mara River — an experience that promises unparalleled views of this breathtaking landscape from above. Drift gracefully over herds of wildebeest and zebra as they make their annual migration across the plains, their rhythmic movements a timeless spectacle that unfolds beneath you.

During the peak of the great wildebeest migration, from July to October each year, focus on the Mara River crossings — a dramatic display of nature's raw power and resilience as thousands of wildebeest brave crocodile-infested waters in search of greener pastures. Witness this breathtaking spectacle up close, as the drama of survival unfolds before your eyes in a primal dance of life and death. With expert guides at your side, you'll traverse rugged terrain in search of the majestic creatures that call this wilderness home.

name: Get Hotel Molvento
intro: Get Hotel, an active resort framed by the mountains of the Calamuchita Valley, in the Province of Córdoba, a forest more than 70 years old and Los Molinos Lake. A place of rest and connection. An invitation to enjoy and share.

news_article.title: Enjoy Your Luxury Vacation at Get Hotel Molvento
news_article.description: A Resort Designed for Your Well-Being in Argentina

postcards.name: Enjoy Thrilling Sailboat Rides
postcards.intro: When staying at Get Hotel Molvento, enjoy the exhilarating experience of sailboat rides on Lake Los Molinos. These trips offer you a unique way to enjoy the natural beauty of the surroundings. Depending on the weather conditions and your preferences, you can choose between a leisurely tour of the lake or a more adventurous journey filled with speed and excitement.
postcards.story:
Sailing trips provide an excellent opportunity to immerse yourself in the world of sailing, allowing you to participate in manoeuvres under the guidance of an experienced captain. It's a chance to learn new skills and gain a deeper understanding of the art of sailing while enjoying the thrill of being out on the water.

But the experience doesn't stop there. As you glide across the shimmering waters of Lake Los Molinos, you'll be surrounded by breathtaking scenery and immersed in the rich history of the area. The landscape unfolds before you, revealing towering mountains, lush forests and serene coves waiting to be explored.

As you sail, you'll also have the chance to learn about the lake and its fascinating history. Your captain may share stories and anecdotes about the area, adding an extra layer of depth to your journey. It's a chance to connect with the natural world and gain a deeper appreciation for the beauty and complexity of the environment.

But perhaps the most thrilling aspect of sailboat rides at Get Hotel Molvento is the feeling of being surrounded by nature. As you leave the shore behind and venture out onto the open water, you'll feel a sense of freedom and adventure unlike anything else. The wind in your hair, the sun on your face, and the sound of the water lapping against the hull – it's an experience that's both invigorating and calming at the same time.

So whether you're looking for a relaxing cruise or an adrenaline-pumping adventure, sailboat rides at Get Hotel Molvento offer something for everyone. Step aboard, set sail and let the beauty of Lake Los Molinos take your breath away.

postcards.name: Trek Your Way to Breathtaking Landscapes
postcards.intro: When you stay at Get Hotel Molvento, don't miss the opportunity to embark on thrilling trekking adventures that offer a direct encounter with nature. The guided hiking practices are perfect for small groups and families eager to explore the rugged beauty of the eastern fraction of Molvento and La Alemana.
postcards.story:
One of the most popular treks takes you through the foothills of the mountains to the Chañares, offering breathtaking views and an immersive experience in nature. Starting from the greenhouse areas, you'll traverse trails specially prepared for hiking, ensuring a safe and enjoyable journey. Throughout the trek, the expert guides will accompany you, providing valuable information and assistance every step of the way.

As you hike, you'll feel a sense of excitement and adventure building with each passing moment. The rugged terrain and ever-changing landscape offer a thrilling challenge, while the tranquil surroundings provide a peaceful escape from the rush of daily life. With each step, you'll be surrounded by the rhythms of nature, from the rustle of leaves in the breeze to the soulful sound of birds overhead.

But the real highlight of the trek comes when you reach the mountain viewpoint. Here, you'll be rewarded with panoramic views that stretch as far as your eyes can see. The majestic mountains loom large in the distance, their peaks reaching towards the sky in silent reverence. Below, lush valleys and winding rivers paint a picture of natural beauty that's simply inspiring.

As you take in the stunning scenery, you'll feel a deep connection to the world around you. Surrounded by nature in all its glory, you'll experience a sense of peace and calm that's hard to find elsewhere. It's a moment of pure bliss, a chance to disconnect from the chaos of modern life and reconnect with the beauty of the natural world.

Come and lace up your hiking boots, pack your water bottle and get ready for an adventure of a lifetime. With guided trekking experiences at Get Hotel Molvento, you'll discover the thrill of exploration and the beauty of nature in its purest form.

name: Saruni Rhino
intro: Saruni Rhino is a unique, 4 “bandas” (stone cottages) camp located in the large and remote Sera Conservancy, in the wild, undiscovered northern frontier of Kenya. It is little over 1.5 hours’ drive from our Saruni Samburu lodge in nearby Kalama Conservancy.

news_article.title: Tour the Endless Landscape Surrounding Saruni Rhino
news_article.description: A Luxury Camp in the Heart of Kenya

postcards.name: Track Black Rhinos in East Africa
postcards.intro: At Saruni Rhino, you'll discover the thrill of the first walking safari of its kind in East Africa, offering an unparalleled adventure that not only immerses you in the magical beauty of the African wilderness but also allows you to play a vital role in the protection of a majestic species: the black rhino.
postcards.story:
Be a part of an unforgettable journey at Saruni Rhino, located in the heart of Kenya's wild landscapes. Picture yourself stepping into the vast expanse of the 25,650-acre sanctuary, guided by the expertise of a Saruni Basecamp guide and accompanied by a highly trained ranger from the Sera Community Conservancy. As you set out on foot, your senses come alive with anticipation, knowing that you are about to go on a rare and exhilarating experience.

The air is alive with the sounds of the bush, especially the calls of distant wildlife. Every step you take brings you closer to the elusive black rhino, whose presence looms large in this wilderness. With each moment, you become more attuned to the rhythms of nature.

As you traverse the terrain, your guide shares insights into the behavior and habitat of the black rhino, enhancing your understanding of these magnificent creatures. Together, you scan the horizon, searching for signs of movement that betray the rhino's presence. 

Time stands still as you observe the black rhino in its natural habitat, a sight few have the privilege to witness. Your heart swells with gratitude for the opportunity to be part of something greater than yourself, contributing to the conservation efforts that safeguard the future of these endangered animals.

As the sun begins to dip below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the savannah, you return to Saruni Rhino, your senses buzzing with the thrill of the day's adventure. Gathered around the campfire, under the canopy of stars, you reflect on the profound connection you've forged with the African wilderness and its inhabitants.

In every whisper of the wind and every beat of your heart, you carry with you the memories of your first black rhino tracking experience in East Africa.

postcards.name: Be Surprised by the Tradition of Singing Wells
postcards.intro: When you stay at Saruni Rhino in Kenya, you have the opportunity to witness a truly remarkable tradition: the singing wells of Samburu. These are not just any wells; they are a lifeline for local pastoralists and their livestock, providing much-needed water in the midst of the dry landscape.
postcards.story:
Imagine a series of springs dotting the earth, where pastoralists gather with their livestock to quench their thirst. With each dig into the dry earth, the sound of singing fills the air. Each Moran, or warrior, sings a unique melody that his animals recognise and respond to. It's a rhythm of voices and movements, carved by generations of tradition and necessity.

As you stand amidst the singing wells, you can't help but be drawn into the tunes of the moment. The earth reverberates with the sound of digging, while the melodies of the warriors weave through the air. It's a scene of raw beauty and primal energy, where humans and animals work together to survive in a harsh environment.

What makes this experience truly special is its intimacy. You're not just observing from a distance; you're right there, alongside the pastoralists, as they go about their daily routine. You can feel the bonds of community and tradition that run deep in this land, connecting people to each other and to the earth beneath their feet.

As you witness this age-old tradition unfold before your eyes, you can't help but be moved by the resilience of the human spirit. Despite the challenges they face, the pastoralists of Samburu have found a way to thrive in their environment, drawing on the wisdom of their ancestors and the strength of their traditions.

Long after you leave Kenya, the memory of the singing wells will stay with you. It's a reminder of the power of tradition, the beauty of human connection and the resilience of life in even the harshest of environments. It's surely an experience that will inspire you to carry a piece of Kenya's spirit with you wherever you go.

name: Basecamp Mara Houses
intro: Basecamp Mara Houses is a unique property that offers complete seclusion and privacy for the ultimate in luxury safari experiences.

news_article.title: Join a Family Safari at Basecamp Mara Houses
news_article.description: Your Ultimate Luxury Safari Experience in Kenya

postcards.name: Become One with the African Wilderness
postcards.intro: Imagine yourself staying in the peaceful embrace of Ol Chorro Losoit Valley, surrounded by the untouched beauty of the African wilderness. This is where you'll find Mara House, Acacia House and Dik Dik House, situated in the heart of the Mara North Conservancy. Here, you're a part of the landscape, immersed in the vast expanse of nature.
postcards.story:
Step outside your camp and breathe in the crisp, fresh air as you take in the breathtaking views that stretch as far as your eyes can see. From rolling hills to sprawling plains, the landscape is a canvas painted with shades of green and gold, punctuated by the occasional acacia tree silhouetted against the horizon.

As you explore the surrounding area, you'll discover that this secluded location provides access to exclusive experiences in the world-renowned Mara-Serengeti ecosystem. With both the Mara North and Lemek Conservancies at your doorstep, you have the opportunity to witness the incredible diversity of wildlife that calls this region home.

Keep your eyes peeled for the iconic Big Five – lions, elephants, buffaloes, leopards and rhinoceroses – as they roam freely in their natural habitat. Watch in awe as herds of wildebeests and zebras migrate across the plains, their synchronised movements reflect the rhythm of life in the wilderness.

But it's not just about the wildlife but also about the sense of connection you feel to the land and its people. Engage with the local Maasai community and gain insight into their traditional way of life, passed down through generations. Learn about their deep-rooted connection to the land and their efforts to preserve it for future generations.

At the end of each day, return to the comfort of Mara House, Acacia House or Dik Dik House, where every detail is thoughtfully designed to enhance your experience. Relax on your private veranda and watch as the sun dips below the horizon, painting the sky in shades of pink and orange before giving way to a blanket of stars.

In this secluded oasis, surrounded by the raw beauty of the African wilderness, you'll find not just a place to stay, but a home away from home.

postcards.name: Get Excited for the Magical Mara Safari
postcards.intro: Go on an unforgettable adventure with a Magical Mara Safari while staying at Basecamp Mara Houses in Kenya. This experience promises to immerse you in the essence of safari, offering a glimpse into the Kenya of your dreams – the Kenya that has long adorned travel bucket lists worldwide.
postcards.story:
From its sprawling landscapes to its diverse wildlife, the Mara encapsulates the quintessential safari experience. Here, you'll witness nature's grandeur firsthand, from the majestic lions to the graceful giraffes roaming freely in their natural habitat.

One of the Mara's most inspiring spectacles is the great wildebeest migration. During certain months, hundreds of thousands of antelope traverse the plains in a breathtaking display of raw beauty and instinctual movement. As you witness this phenomenon, you'll feel a profound connection to the rhythm of the natural world.

But the Mara isn't just about wildlife; it's also a place of cultural richness. Home to the Maasai, one of Africa's most iconic tribal groups, the Mara offers you a chance to engage with the local community and learn about their traditional way of life. Through Saruni Basecamp’s partnership with the Maasai, they are committed to conservation efforts that preserve both the land and its people.

Your safari journey begins at Basecamp Mara Houses, where every detail is mindfully crafted to enhance your safari experience. From the warm hospitality to the eco-friendly accommodations, you'll feel right at home in this oasis amidst the wilderness. Choose to follow the suggested safari itinerary, carefully curated to showcase the best of Saruni Basecamp experiences. 

Or, if you prefer, let the expert team tailor the program to your specific preferences, ensuring a personalised adventure that takes you far from the beaten path.

Whether you're a seasoned traveller or going on your first safari, the Magical Mara Safari promises an unparalleled experience that will stay with you long after you return home. Pack your bags, leave the ordinary behind and prepare to go on the adventure of a lifetime in the heart of Kenya's wilderness.

name: Basecamp Dorobo Mobile
intro: Basecamp Dorobo Mobile is a movable camp inside Naboisho Conservancy in the Masai Mara ecosystem. In the tradition of classic “fly camps”, Basecamp Dorobo Mobile is the result of years of admiration and respect for the ancient section of hunter-gatherers who were assimilated into the Maasai people and became known as the Dorobo.

news_article.title: Feel the Essence of the African Savannah at Basecamp Dorobo Mobile
news_article.description: A Movable Camp Inside Naboisho Conservancy in Kenya

postcards.name: Discover the Wonders of Authentic Bush Camping
postcards.intro: Go on a journey of true connection at Basecamp Dorobo Mobile, where nature, wildlife and people intertwine in a unique harmony. Here, amidst the vast expanse of the Mara Naboisho Conservancy and Pardamat Conservation Area, you'll discover the essence of authentic bush camping — a place where you can truly immerse yourself in the wonders of the wilderness.
postcards.story:
Basecamp Dorobo Mobile is inspired by the Dorobo people and rooted in the tradition of classic “fly camps”.

Step into the footsteps of the Dorobo hunter-gatherers, part of the greater Maasai tribe, and experience the wandering lifestyle that inspired this lodge. As you venture into the heart of the wilderness, you'll find yourself surrounded by serene landscapes and untouched beauty, where every moment is an opportunity to connect with nature in its purest form.

Indulge in the freedom of exploring private and secluded sites, far away from the rush of modern life. Here, amidst the tranquil serenity of the bush, you'll find a sense of peace and calm that rejuvenates the soul.

Wake up to the gentle rustle of leaves and the melodious chirping of birds, as the sun bathes the landscape in a golden shade. Step outside your tent and breathe in the crisp, fresh air, as you gaze upon the untouched beauty of the surrounding wilderness.

As you wander through the savannah, guided by experienced locals who share their local stories from the land, you'll witness the wonders of nature unfold before your eyes. From the graceful movements of giraffes to the majestic presence of elephants, every encounter reflects the raw beauty of the natural world.

At night, gather around the campfire and listen to the tales of the bush, as the stars twinkle overhead and the sounds of the wilderness serenade you to sleep. Here, amidst the warmth of the fire and the camaraderie of fellow travellers, you'll make bonds that transcend time and space.
Come and celebrate the extraordinary at Basecamp Dorobo Mobile. Let nature be your guide as you immerse yourself in the beauty of the wild and experience the true essence of authentic bush camping in Kenya. Are you ready for this unforgettable adventure?

postcards.name: It’s Time for the Mara Under Canvas Safari
postcards.intro: Immerse yourself in the authentic essence of the Masai Mara with the Mara Under Canvas Safari, an experience that promises to unveil the true soul of Kenya. Settle into the heart of the wilderness at Basecamp Dorobo Mobile, where adventure awaits amidst the iconic landscapes of Africa's renowned wildlife haven.
postcards.story:
As you begin the extraordinary safari journey, you'll discover more than just majestic views and untamed wilderness. It's about delving into a realm where every sunrise and sunset brings new stories. Here, amidst the endless savannah, rugged kopjes and solitary acacia trees, you'll find yourself surrounded by the spirit of the land, embraced by the communities who call it home.

At Basecamp Dorobo Mobile, you'll awaken to the calls of the wild and the whispers of the wind, surrounded by the raw beauty of the Masai Mara. Each moment offers you a chance to connect with nature in its purest form, to witness the ebb and flow of life in the wilderness. 

Your days will be filled with unforgettable encounters as you venture off the beaten track, guided by experienced locals who share their deep-rooted knowledge and passion for the land. From thrilling game drives to tranquil bush walks, every experience is crafted to immerse you in the authentic rhythm of the Mara.

As you explore, you'll not only witness the incredible diversity of wildlife but also gain a deeper understanding of the intricate ecosystems that sustain them. From the graceful movements of the big cats to the playful antics of the elephants, every sighting reflects the enduring beauty of the natural world.

Back at camp, you'll find comfort in the simplicity of safari life, where the flicker of lanterns and the crackle of a campfire set the stage for stories shared under the vast African sky. Whether you choose to follow the suggested safari itinerary or tailor your own adventure, the Mara Under Canvas Safari promises an experience unlike any other — a journey of discovery, connection and immersion into the true soul of Kenya.

name: Saruni Samburu
intro: Saruni Samburu is a deluxe, design lodge located in Kenya’s wild north. It is the only lodge in Kalama Conservancy, a community-owned wildlife reserve that borders Samburu National Reserve, with 200,000 acres of unspoiled wilderness to explore and enjoy exclusively.

news_article.title: Appreciate the Deluxe Design and Ambience at Saruni Samburu
news_article.description: Your Home in the Kenyan Wilderness

postcards.name: Explore the Diversity of Wildlife Surrounding Your Camp
postcards.intro: When you stay at Saruni Samburu in Kenya, get ready to immerse yourself in an extraordinary wildlife experience. The area surrounding the lodge is a bustling place for a variety of creatures, offering you a front-row seat to the wonders of the animal kingdom. Are you all set to witness the incredible diversity of wildlife around you?
postcards.story:
Imagine waking up to the sight of giant herds of elephants congregating at nearby waterholes, their majestic presence a reflection of the abundance of life in this region. As you sip your morning coffee, you might catch a glimpse of a leopard stealthily manoeuvring among rocky outcrops, its spotted coat blending perfectly with the surroundings.

But the wildlife sightings don't end there. Keep your eyes peeled for packs of African wild dogs traversing the plains below the lodge, their playful antics and coordinated hunting strategies are a sight to behold. And don't forget to keep an eye out for the rare and elusive Samburu special five: the grévy’s zebra, reticulated giraffe, beisa oryx, Somali ostrich and the peculiar gerenuk antelope.

Venture out on guided game drives or bush walks led by expert trackers, who will share their knowledge of the local flora and fauna with you. Whether you're admiring the graceful movements of a giraffe or marvelling at the intricate patterns of a zebra, each encounter offers you a glimpse into the richness of life that thrives in this raw wilderness.

Back at Saruni Samburu, take time to reflect on the day's adventures as you relax in the comfort of your luxury accommodations. From your private veranda, soak in panoramic views of the surrounding landscape, where every corner holds the promise of another wildlife encounter.

As the sun sets on another unforgettable day, you'll be filled with a sense of gratitude for the opportunity to witness such incredible diversity up close. And as you drift off to sleep, the sounds of the African night will serenade you, a gentle reminder of the magic that awaits you each day at Saruni Samburu.

postcards.name: Join the Inspiring Supreme Safari
postcards.intro: When you choose to go on the Supreme Safari and stay at Saruni Samburu in Kenya, you're in for an unforgettable adventure that combines the best of wildlife encounters and cultural experiences. Located amidst the raw beauty of northern Kenya, Saruni Samburu offers you a unique perspective on this iconic safari destination.
postcards.story:
From the moment you arrive at Saruni Samburu, you'll be immersed in the magical sounds of the wild. The expansive landscape of Samburu National Reserve provides the backdrop for your safari, where you'll have the chance to spot a diverse variety of wildlife, from elephants and lions to rare species such as the grevy's zebra and the reticulated giraffe.

But the experience doesn't stop there. Saruni Samburu is more than just a place to rest your head – it's a sanctuary where you can connect with nature and with the local Samburu people. Take part in guided bush walks led by knowledgeable Maasai warriors, who will share their insights into the land and its inhabitants. Visit nearby Samburu villages to learn about traditional ways of life and to interact with community members.

As you explore the area around Saruni Samburu, you'll discover the unique contrasts that define this region. From the arid landscapes of the Samburu plains to the lush banks of the Ewaso Nyiro River, each day of the safari brings new surprises and delights. And with the expertise of your guides, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of these diverse ecosystems.

Back at the lodge, you'll be treated to exceptional hospitality and luxurious accommodations. Relax in your private villa, complete with stunning views of the surrounding wilderness. Indulge in delicious meals crafted from fresh, locally sourced ingredients and unwind with a massage or wellness treatment at the on-site spa.

But perhaps the most memorable aspect of your stay at Saruni Samburu is the sense of connection you'll feel – to the land, to the wildlife and to the people who call this place home. This experience will surely inspire you to continue exploring the wonders of the natural world.

name: La Urumpta Hotel
intro: La Urumpta is nature but also lifestyle, exclusivity and architecture. It is a place to disconnect for the traveler looking for new sensations, to get break away from your everyday life and tune in with the environment.

news_article.title: Revive Your Senses at La Urumpta Hotel
news_article.description: A Perfect Combination of Sophistication and Nature in Argentina

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding at La Urumpta Hotel
postcards.intro: When it comes to your wedding day, every detail matters. From the grandest celebrations to the most intimate gatherings, La Urumpta Hotel by AKEN MIND brings your dream wedding to life. The dedicated team will guide you through every step of the planning process, ensuring that your special day is nothing short of magical.
postcards.story:
The staff at the La Urumpta Hotel understands that your wedding day is one of the most important days of your life. That's why they go above and beyond to make sure that every aspect of your celebration is perfect. From personalised touches to intimate details, they work closely with you to create an unforgettable experience that reflects your unique style and personality.

Wedding days are special because they symbolise the beautiful union of two souls in love. It's a day filled with joy, laughter and heartfelt vows, marking the beginning of a lifelong journey together. 

When it comes to your wedding night, La Urumpta Hotel is the perfect place to celebrate your love. The specially curated wedding night package includes everything you need to make your first night as a married couple truly special. From a bottle of sparkling wine to decadent chocolates and a beautiful flower bouquet, they make sure that every moment is filled with love and romance.

As part of the wedding night package, you'll also enjoy two AKEN moments 30-minute massages, perfect for relaxing and unwinding after your big day. And with a late check-out time, you can take your time and enjoy every moment of your first day as newlyweds.

Whether you choose a luxurious Suite room or a homey Deluxe room, you can rest assured that your accommodations will be nothing short of spectacular. And with limited spaces available, be sure to book in advance to secure your spot.

When it comes to your wedding day, every moment should be filled with joy, love and unforgettable memories. So go ahead, dream big and without limits. Celebrate your love at La Urumpta Hotel, where you’ll be taken care of thoughtfully.

postcards.name: Connect Your Mind, Body and Spirit at AKEN Spa
postcards.intro: At La Urumpta Hotel, the AKEN Spa & Wellness offers a unique sanctuary for your mind, body and spirit. Rooted in a comprehensive philosophy of well-being, AKEN spa believes in the power of connection and achieving spiritual alchemy. Are you ready to rejuvenate and reconnect with yourself?
postcards.story:
A spa experience offers you a space for relaxation, rejuvenation and renewal. Through soothing massages, calming aromas and peaceful environments, it provides a much-needed escape from the stresses of everyday life, leaving you feeling refreshed.

Designed to reflect the essence of the local culture, the AKEN spa provides a native and unparalleled experience, integrating the inner and outer being. Here, you'll discover personalised moments that engage all your senses, inviting you to go on a journey of beauty, health and relaxation.

The facilities are mindfully crafted to evoke great sensations, revitalising your mind, nurturing your soul and rejuvenating your body. Each space encourages reflection, deep breathing and the opportunity to disconnect from the daily chaos of life to reconnect with your inner self.

Guided by the personal wellness creators, you'll go on a path toward optimal wellness tailored to your specific goals. From the moment you step into the spa, you'll be immersed in a multisensory experience where music and aromas intertwine to create a truly unique and unforgettable journey.

At La Urumpta Hotel's AKEN Spa & Wellness, everyone understands that love begins from within. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking a moment of tranquillity, the spa offers you the perfect setting to nurture your relationship with yourself and your loved ones.

Imagine unwinding in a luxurious setting, surrounded by the soothing sounds of nature and the gentle scent of essential oils. Picture yourself indulging in a revitalising massage or a rejuvenating facial, feeling all your worries melt away as you sink deeper into relaxation.

Come and treat yourself and your loved ones to the gift of wellness. Let La Urumpta Hotel’s Spa & Wellness guide you on a journey of self-discovery and renewal.

name: Svatma Thanjavur
intro: Thanjavur is one of the ancient cities of India in the Southern State of Tamil Nadu. The prosperous agrarian city was ruled by various dynasties like Cholas (850-1279 AD), Pandyas (1279-1311 AD), Vijayanagaras (1535 AD), Madurai Nayaks, Thanjavur Nayaks, Marathas (1674 AD) and later the British Colonists (1799 AD).

news_article.title: Experience Tamil Culture and Charm at Svatma Thanjavur
news_article.description: Your Luxury Abode in South India

postcards.name: Indulge in a Cooking Class: A Signature Svatma Experience
postcards.intro: Enjoy a culinary and cultural journey through Tamil cuisine, an experience that will broaden your palate and deepen your appreciation for regional gastronomy. Step into the special guest experience kitchen at Svatma, where you'll have the opportunity to learn authentic techniques and recipes from in-house expert chefs.
postcards.story:
The essence of Tamil cuisine lies in its use of rice, organic grains, lentils, fresh vegetables and various plant-based ingredients. A typical Tamil meal comprises a light and nutritious breakfast complemented by an array of chutneys, steamed rice, lentils, yoghurt and a variety of vegetables, ensuring a well-balanced diet. Even on special occasions, traditional Tamil dishes are meticulously prepared, following age-old techniques, and served in a manner that preserves their authentic taste and ambience. 

One of the highlights of the culinary class is the emphasis on nutrition and good health. Through interactive discussions and hands-on activities, you will gain a deeper understanding of the nutritional value of vegetarian cuisine. You will learn how to create balanced meals that provide essential nutrients while delighting the senses. Delve into the culinary heritage of Tamil Nadu, where cooking techniques such as steaming, stir-frying, sautéing, grilling, roasting, tossing and garnishing transform simple, healthful ingredients into gourmet delights. 

Discover the rich and authentic flavours of Tamil vegetarian cuisine by learning to prepare classic dishes such as coconut-based chutneys; crispy rice and lentil crepes, known as Dosai; and spinach and lentil fritters called Keera Vardai. Alternatively, warm your soul with a comforting bowl of Rasan, a tomato, tamarind and lentil ginger soup. 

All in all, you experience a transformative journey through the Culinary Class. It leaves a lasting impact on you, empowering you to embrace vegetarianism as a lifestyle choice for health and vitality. Beyond just learning new recipes, you gain valuable skills and knowledge that you can easily incorporate into your everyday life. Armed with a deeper appreciation for local cuisine and a heightened awareness of nutrition, you embark on a journey towards holistic wellness and conscious living.

postcards.name: Bask in Tamilian Charm at Svatma
postcards.intro: Beyond being just a luxury boutique hotel, Svatma stands as a testament to the rich cultural heritage and architectural marvels of the region. The property embodies the essence of Tamil Nadu's history, art and spirituality through its meticulously crafted interior, decor and design.
postcards.story:
As soon as you step inside, you will be transported to a world where time seems to stand still. Restored and converted from a century-old mansion, Svatma boasts traditional architecture and modern comforts making it an exceptional destination for immersing oneself in the local culture as a traveller.

Every aspect of Svatma reflects meticulous attention to detail. From Mahabalipuram rock sculptures to Swamimalai bronzes, Chettinadu woodcraft, Kumbakonam brass lamps and the iconic Tanjavur paintings, the property serves as an educational journey through Tamil Nadu's cultural heritage. Each element has been carefully handpicked, created or modified to create a tranquil retreat, appealing to individuals who seek a blend of history and relaxation in their vacations.

The heritage wing, which comprises the low two-storied structure, embodies a timeless appeal with its tiled roofs, old stone columns, pillared verandas and arched doorways. These architectural elements harken back to a bygone era, evoking a sense of nostalgia and historical significance. In contrast, the modern four-story structure stands adjacent to the heritage wing, offering contemporary aesthetics infused with local flair.

Divided into seven categories, the rooms and suites are spread across both the heritage structure and the millennium wing. While each room maintains its own unique style, they collectively reflect the traditional Tamil ethos through period furniture, handwoven fabrics and carefully selected curios, creating a serene atmosphere in the well-lit spaces.

Throughout the premises, walls are graced with murals depicting dancers, architectural sketches of Chola-era structures, religious verses and monochrome photographs, all contributing to the immersive cultural experience. The seamless integration of these artefacts and artworks not only adds to the aesthetic appeal but also enriches the stay with a deeper understanding of the region's rich cultural legacy.

name: The Grand Dragon
intro: The Grand Dragon, Ladakh located at a height of 11,562 ft in Leh, Ladakh in the Himalayas, holds a place of pride in the hearts of the locals as it was the first international class hotel in this remote and isolated outpost.

news_article.title: Explore Ladakh with The Grand Dragon
news_article.description: Enjoy Your Journey of Discovery and Relaxation

postcards.name: Visit Stok Palace and Museum
postcards.intro: The Stok Palace beckons those seeking to immerse themselves in Ladakh's rich heritage and stunning landscapes. It offers an opportunity to experience the regal essence of Ladakh, delving into its captivating history and culture. Whether you opt for a day visit or an extended stay, the charm and sophistication of the Stok Palace are sure to captivate you.
postcards.story:
Think of palaces and heritage stays and chances are you will think of Rajasthan. However, journeying further north to the stunning moonscape of Ladakh offers an architectural marvel unlike any other. Near Leh lies the Stok Palace, once belonging to the Namgyal Dynasty, which governed the region until its absorption by Kashmir’s Dogra king in 1834. This palace stands as a testament to Ladakh's rich history and cultural heritage, offering visitors a glimpse into the region's royal past.

As you step through the grand gates of Stok Palace, you will be instantly transported back in time to an era of regal opulence and cultural richness. The imposing facade of the palace looms before you, its ochre walls adorned with intricate carvings that speak volumes of its storied past. The air is thick with history and you can't help but feel a sense of reverence as you approach the entrance.

Inside, the Stok Palace Museum unfolds like a treasure trove of Ladakhi heritage. It houses a variety of artefacts and remnants associated with Ladakh's historical monarchy. You can explore ancient coins, royal seals, attire, jewellery and photographs, alongside the royal family's assortment of thangkas, with some dating back over four centuries.

Other noteworthy features within the Stok Palace museum include the Queen’s ancient yub-jhur, a headpiece adorned with 401 uncut turquoises, coral, gold nuggets and various precious stones; a thousand-year-old crown; and an actual knotted sword. Each artefact tells a story of Ladakh's royal lineage, offering visitors a deeper understanding of the region's rich cultural tapestry.

In essence, Stok Palace stands not just as an architectural marvel, but as a living testament to Ladakh's rich history, inviting you to delve into its storied past and cherish the legacy it preserves.

postcards.name: Shop for Shawls, Jewellery and More at the Souvenir Gallery
postcards.intro: The Grand Dragon Ladakh offers a cultural immersion through its in-house Souvenir Gallery. So, if you're seeking a special gift for a loved one or simply wish to immerse yourself in the beauty and craftsmanship of Ladakh, the hotel’s curated selection of handpicked treasures reflects the essence of this unique region, where tradition meets artisanship in every piece.
postcards.story:
Step into the Souvenir Gallery and admire the exquisite array of Pashmina shawls, renowned for their unparalleled softness and warmth. These luxurious garments, delicately woven from the finest cashmere wool, are not just accessories but symbols of timeless elegance and refinement. Each shawl tells a story of centuries-old weaving techniques passed down through generations, making it a cherished heirloom for generations to come.

You can also immerse yourself in the spiritual legacy of Ladakh with their collection of Buddhist masks, Thangka paintings and Tibetan prayer wheels. These sacred artefacts offer a glimpse into the deeply rooted Buddhist heritage of the region, inviting contemplation and introspection. As you admire the intricate details and vibrant colours of these religious artworks, you can't help but feel a sense of awe and reverence for the spiritual traditions that have shaped the cultural landscape of Ladakh.

The gallery also boasts an assortment of silver and turquoise jewellery, handcrafted with precision and passion by local artisans. In addition to these treasures, their collection also includes hand-woven carpets and rugs, renowned for their durability and intricate designs. 

Finally, no visit to the Souvenir Gallery would be complete without admiring the Choktse, intricately carved low tables that epitomise the fine woodworking tradition of Ladakh. Crafted from solid wood and adorned with ornate carvings depicting motifs inspired by nature and spirituality, these timeless pieces of furniture are not just functional but also works of art that add a touch of elegance to any space.

In conclusion, the Souvenir Gallery at The Grand Dragon Ladakh offers a truly enriching experience for you, allowing you to acquire beautiful mementoes and gain a deeper appreciation for the rich cultural heritage of Ladakh.

name: Rann Riders
intro: In the far west of India, wedged hard under the ribs of the subcontinent and stretching to the Western horizon and the sea beyond, are the bleached flat lands of the Rann of Kuchh – Little & Greater.

news_article.title: Say Yes to Adventure and Nature at Rann Riders by Kaafila
news_article.description: Rustic Elegance and Eco-Conscious Comfort in Gujarat

postcards.name: Ride into Adventure on a Cycling Safari
postcards.intro: Saddle up for an unforgettable journey through the wild landscapes of Rann Riders. Feel the exhilaration as you gallop across open desert plains or pedal through lush countryside teeming with wildlife. Whether you're a seasoned rider or a cycling enthusiast, the horse and cycling safaris promise an immersive experience.
postcards.story:
Imagine the wind in your hair as you mount one of the indigenous Kathiawadi or Marwari horses, prized for their grace and strength. Or perhaps you prefer the freedom of exploring on two wheels, pedalling through open country rich in both wildlife and cultural wonders. As you set off on your adventure, the world around you comes alive with sights and sounds that stir the soul. 

Picture yourself trotting quietly through the countryside, the rhythmic beat of hooves blending with the rustle of grass and the song of birds overhead. Or feel the thrill of galloping across vast desert plains, the horizon stretching out before you in a breathtaking panorama - the stunning vistas that define the Rann landscape.

Watch in awe as graceful birds take flight, and elusive wildlife makes fleeting appearances. With each turn of the trail, you uncover hidden gems of culture and history, connecting with the land and its people in a profound way. These journeys of discovery, weaving through nature and culture define this unique region. 

In case you are travelling with a group who prefer to experience this adventure from the comfort of a safari vehicle, fear not! Non-riders and non-cyclists travelling with the group can still partake in the excitement by joining the riders at their resting spots. Here, let the tales of the trails be shared over hearty meals under the open sky. 

So whether you choose this adventure from the saddle of your horse or the seat of your bicycle, you have a front-row seat to the wonders of the Little Rann!

postcards.name: Celebrate Local Culture with Rann Riders
postcards.intro: Complement your wilderness experiences with Gujarat's vibrant cultural heritage at Rann Riders. From the historic Tarnetar Fair to the enchanting Modhera Dance Festival, experience the richness of local traditions alongside the welcoming communities of the region.
postcards.story:
Step into a world of colour, music and tradition as Rann Riders invites you to partake in the seasonal festivals and fairs that grace the landscape of Gujarat. At the historic shrine of Tarnetar, gift yourself the experience of centuries-old rituals and modern-day celebrations. Believed to be the original course of the river Ganga, Tarnetar Fair pulses with the energy of folk dances, vibrant attire and bustling markets, offering a glimpse into the heart of Gujarati culture.

For a deeper dive into local traditions, venture to the Ravechi Mata temple during the Ravechi Mela - a highlight for the Rabari community of Kutch. Here, amidst the colourful festivities, witness the Rabaris at their most exuberant, adorned in their finest attire and showcasing their age-old customs and crafts. From intricate embroidery to lively folk music, every corner of Ravechi Mela is alive with the spirit of community and celebration.

But the cultural exploration doesn't end there. As winter sets in, journey to the 11th-century Sun Temple at Modhera, where the annual dance festival unfolds against the backdrop of majestic architecture. Illuminated by the soft glow of lights, the temple becomes a stage for classical dance performances from across India, each telling stories of love, devotion and mythology through graceful movements and stirring music.

At Rann Riders, you can indulge in unique experiences that allow you to fully witness the magic of Gujarat's festivals - one of the most vibrant Indian states. If you are somebody with keen interest in photography, capturing lively snapshots of the festivities should be on your to-do list. Similarly, for foodies, savouring the flavours of local cuisine and learning about Indian masalas used in the dishes would be an interesting activity. No matter what your interest, there is something for everyone!

name: Aashraya on the Ganga
intro: If you love nature, appreciate efforts on going green, recycling / upcycling almost everything, going organic, integrated farming, healthy living, connecting with nature, disconnection from urban life, and letting nature help you relax, then, Aashraya is the perfect place for you.

news_article.title: Go Green at Aashraya on The Ganga
news_article.description: A Unique Farmstay Retreat in Rishikesh

postcards.name: Prepare for a Thrilling River Rafting Adventure
postcards.intro: When you're staying at Aashraya on The Ganga in Rishikesh, get ready for an exhilarating river rafting experience unlike any other. The property has partnered with experts to ensure that your adventure on the Ganges is safe, thrilling and unforgettable. Are you already feeling the adrenaline rush?
postcards.story:
Picture yourself gliding through the pristine waters of the Ganges, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of the Himalayan foothills. With contact information provided, arranging your rafting excursion is a breeze. Simply reach out to the property and all the details will be shared with you.

One of the best parts of the river rafting experience with Aashraya on The Ganga is the flexibility it offers. You have the freedom to discuss and negotiate payments and prices directly with your guide, ensuring transparency and peace of mind throughout the process.

As you go on your rafting journey, you'll be in the capable hands of experienced guides who know the river like the back of their hand. These guides will provide thorough safety briefings and instructions, ensuring that you feel confident and prepared before going on your journey. They'll lead you through exhilarating rapids, offering expert guidance to navigate the twists and turns of the river safely.

The thrill of conquering challenging rapids is matched only by the beautiful scenery that surrounds you. From cascading waterfalls to lush green forests, every turn of the river unveils a new marvel to behold.

But river rafting isn't just about adrenaline-pumping action; it's also an opportunity to connect with nature on a deeper level. As you paddle downstream, take a moment to soak in the tranquillity of your surroundings, the sound of rushing water soothing your soul. Whether you're an experienced rafter or a first-time adventurer, the river rafting experience caters to all skill levels. 

After an exhilarating day on the river, return to the hotel, where you can relax and unwind in comfort. Share stories of your adventure with fellow travellers as you enjoy a delicious meal prepared with locally sourced ingredients.

postcards.name: Visit the Nearby Waterfall and Immerse in Hydrotherapy
postcards.intro: Being a guest at Aashraya on The Ganga in Rishikesh, take some time to explore the nearby waterfall for a rejuvenating experience that will ease you into vacation mode. A short hike leads you to this natural marvel, where the soothing sound of cascading water instantly calms your mind and spirit.
postcards.story:
When you're staying at Aashraya on The Ganga, be sure to carve out some time to visit the nearby waterfall. The to-and-fro walk to the waterfall takes approximately three hours. As you approach the waterfall, you'll be greeted by the sight of pristine water tumbling down rocky cliffs, surrounded by lush greenery. It's a picturesque scene that invites you to immerse yourself in the beauty of nature.

Take a moment to pause and appreciate the serenity of your surroundings before venturing closer to feel the gentle spray of mist on your skin. The coolness of the water refreshes you, washing away any stress or tension accumulated from your journey.

But visiting the waterfall isn't just about admiring its beauty; it's also about embracing the healing power of hydrotherapy. As you stand beneath the cascading water, you'll feel its therapeutic effects wash over you, soothing tired muscles and invigorating your senses.

Let the water massage away any aches and pains, leaving you feeling refreshed and revitalised. Allow yourself to surrender to the rhythm of the waterfall, letting go of any worries or distractions as you bask in the moment.

After indulging in some hydrotherapy, take the time to explore the surrounding area, perhaps finding a quiet spot to sit and reflect on the natural wonders that surround you. Listen to the sounds of birdsong and the rustle of leaves in the breeze, allowing yourself to be fully present in the moment.

As you make your way back to Aashraya on The Ganga, you'll carry with you a sense of tranquility and rejuvenation that will stay with you long after your visit to the waterfall. It's a reminder of the restorative power of nature and the importance of taking time to nourish your body, mind and spirit.

name: Diphlu River Lodge
intro: Perched on the periphery of Kaziranga National Park, Diphlu River Lodge is the ideal getaway for a never-before intimacy with the natural world.

news_article.title: Experience the Wonders of the Natural World at Diphlu River Lodge
news_article.description: A Charming Boutique Stay in Assam

postcards.name: Stay Comfortably in a Cottage at Diphlu River Lodge
postcards.intro: Discover an unparalleled communion with nature at Diphlu River Lodge, the quintessential destination if you’re seeking a unique and immersive experience. The lodge, designed to compliment its surroundings, offers you a unique mix of luxury and authenticity in the heart of Assam. Your cottage is not just a stunning retreat but it also offers you genuinely immersive experiences.
postcards.story:
Diphlu River Lodge offers you an exclusive and tranquil experience with its 12 cottages, providing accommodation for up to 24 guests. Situated on cement stilts, these cottages feature natural materials such as bamboo and wood, with thatched roofs that perfectly blend into the forest surroundings. Among the 12 cottages, four face the river, while the remaining ones offer you a view of the paddy fields.

Each cottage is uniformly designed in terms of size and interiors, with minor stylistic variations. All cottages are equipped with air conditioning to ensure your comfort. The interiors of each cottage include well-sized cosy beds, a spacious seating area, a writing desk, a mini-bar, a small fridge and an electric kettle. Complimentary tea and coffee selections are also provided.

The en-suite shower bathrooms in each cottage feature a roomy dressing area and a fitted wardrobe containing a safe. Special attention has been given to utilising local materials and artefacts, reflecting a commitment to the environment and the surrounding culture. A wide folding glass door in each cottage opens onto a verandah furnished with inviting cane chairs, allowing you to immerse yourself in the natural beauty of the surroundings.

While Wi-Fi is available in the cottages, you are advised that the signal may be intermittent due to the jungle setting. Despite occasional spottiness, the Wi-Fi ensures connectivity for those who need it. This practical approach acknowledges the lodge's unique location in the jungle, where technology may face occasional challenges.

Diphlu River Lodge offers you a serene retreat with its well-designed cottages, blending comfort with the natural environment. The focus on local materials and artefacts, along with the thoughtful layout of each cottage, contributes to a harmonious and peaceful stay for you.

postcards.name: Visit the Renowned Kaziranga National Park
postcards.intro: Going on a journey to Kaziranga National Park is a wonderful adventure into the heart of Assam's biodiversity. Home to the iconic one-horned rhinoceros and a myriad of other wildlife species, the park's sprawling landscapes offer a mesmerising combination of lush greenery and diverse ecosystems. Every moment you spend here is a contribution to the preservation of this ecological treasure.
postcards.story:
Nestled between the Brahmaputra River to the north and the Karbi Anglong hills to the south, the Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, stands as a crown jewel among India's wildlife sanctuaries. Encompassing a vast expanse of 884 square kilometres, the park boasts diverse landscapes, featuring expansive wetlands, mixed deciduous forests and subtropical semi-evergreen terrain. Despite its elephant grass-dotted grasslands that evoke images of the African savannah, Kaziranga retains its unique and unmistakable charm.

Celebrating the essence of this remarkable ecosystem is the Diphlu River Lodge, a haven for nature enthusiasts. With its own team of knowledgeable naturalists, many hailing from nearby villages, the lodge offers you a personalised experience. These experts guide you through the park, assisting in the discovery and identification of its rich array of wildlife and avian species.

Kaziranga's fame extends to hosting the largest populations of the Indian one-horned rhinoceros, the Asiatic wild water buffalo and eastern swamp deer. Furthermore, the park proudly claims one of the world's highest densities of the majestic Royal Bengal tiger, symbolising India's wilderness in its purest form.

The park's reptilian residents include the Assam roofed turtle, water monitor, Indian python, common cobra and the elusive king cobra. As for its avian inhabitants, Kaziranga's diverse landscape harbours over 400 bird species. The numerous water bodies within the park serve as rich reservoirs of food, attracting thousands of migratory birds, some travelling from as far as Siberia. 

Noteworthy bird species include the black-necked stork, spotted owlet, hornbills, greater and lesser adjutant storks, Pallas's fish eagle, grey-headed fish eagle, Bengal florican, swamp partridge, grey peacock-pheasant, green imperial pigeon, silver-breasted broadbill and Jerdon's bushchat. Kaziranga, with its unrivalled biodiversity, stands as a testament to the beautiful and delicate balance of nature.

name: Casino Hotel
intro: Our flagship hotel, Casino Hotel was where the CGH Earth brand and its unique vision was born. The hotel, located on the historic Willingdon island of Kochi, wears a distinct character that is a blend of the old and the new, the conventional and the contemporary giving rise to an aura of timelessness.

news_article.title: Engage in Kerala’s Old-World Charm at Casino Hotel
news_article.description: A Luxury Art Decor Styled Hotel

postcards.name: Refresh and Revitalise at Casino Hotel’s Wellness Oasis
postcards.intro: If rejuvenating and relaxing at staycations is your thing, you are going to love Casino Hotel - your perfect wellness retreat. From the salt mineral water swimming pool to an expansive fitness centre and an Ayurveda centre, discover the perfect blend of reinvigoration to elevate your stay filled with luxury, comfort and all things natural.
postcards.story:
Have you ever experienced the bliss of swimming in a saltwater pool? At the wellness retreat of Casino Hotel, you can indulge in this refreshing alternative to traditional pools, harnessing the soothing benefits of saltwater therapy. Indulge yourself in the spa-like ambience, where the water is gentle on your skin and eyes, devoid of chlorine irritation and harmful chemicals. Open from 7 am to 7 pm, it's the perfect oasis to beat the heat and unwind during your stay.

Continue your wellness journey at the expansive fitness centre, equipped with state-of-the-art equipment including treadmills, weights, cycles and rowers. Whether you are seeking to de-stress after a long day or burn off last night's indulgence, the gym has everything you need to stay active and maintain your regular fitness routine from back home.

For the ultimate relaxation, step into Thulasi, the Ayurveda centre at the wellness retreat. Here, a range of herbal massages and therapies await to harmonise your body, mind and spirit, leaving you re-energized. Every treatment is provided by an expert whom you can consult for specific issues like muscle or joint pain.

Whether you choose to pamper yourself with a dip in the pool or opt for an invigorating workout in the well-equipped gym, at the wellness retreat of Casino Hotel, you can't afford to miss out on these exceptional experiences. Who doesn't appreciate a dedicated wellness day on vacation, especially when your hotel is a wellness retreat with a special focus on providing the best environmental therapies and facilities?

postcards.name: Explore Fort Kochi: Uncover History & Art with Casino Hotel
postcards.intro: Step into a world where history meets art, courtesy of Casino Hotel, a CGH Earth Experience housed on the historic Willingdon Island of Kochi. From the oldest European church in India to vibrant art galleries, Fort Kochi awaits your exploration. Prepare to be swept away by the allure of Fort Kochi's rich heritage and thriving artistic scene.
postcards.story:
Situated on the historic Willingdon Island of Kochi, Casino Hotel invites you on an unforgettable journey through the heart of Fort Kochi. Here, you get to witness forgotten world history and a blend of cultures as you explore Dutch, Portuguese, and Jewish influences that thrive in beautiful harmony with the local Malabar heritage. A sight you will not find in many places around the world.

Begin your adventure with a blissful 10-minute ferry ride from the jetty near the hotel, transporting you straight to the heart of history in Fort Cochin. Wander through the cobblestone streets and marvel at the architectural wonders, including the iconic St. Francis Church, the final resting place of Vasco da Gama.

Continue your exploration at the vibrant Mattancherry Spice Market, where the air is filled with the aroma of exotic spices being dried, sorted and packed. Witness the age-old tradition of Chinese Fishing Nets being lowered into the sea, a testament to Kochi's maritime heritage. You might also want to try your hand at fishing here.

But the journey doesn't end there. Dive into Fort Kochi's thriving art scene at galleries like David Hall, where local and globally renowned artists express themselves through fascinating paintings, sculptures and installations. This is the part when you would want to slow down to soak in all the globally influential art. Until you set back to explore designer boutiques and shops, each offering a glimpse into the city's creative pulse.

With Casino Hotel as your base, every moment in Fort Kochi is a chance to uncover hidden treasures and create lasting memories. Let the hotel be your guide as you explore the enchanting blend of history, art and culture that awaits you in this vibrant coastal city.

name: ABN Charaidew II
intro: ABN Charaidew II is our latest ship to join the fleet. Her length is 44.50 m and breadth is 11.00 m and she is powered by 2 engines. Her extra-shallow draught and a lower profile than conventional designs allow her to cruise faster.

news_article.title: Discover Shore Excursions with ABN Charaidew II
news_article.description: Your Unforgettable River Cruise Adventure in Assam

postcards.name: Indulge in Holistic Fitness and Wellbeing
postcards.intro: A  cruise vacation filled with holistic health and vitality awaits you. Relax in the spacious air-conditioned salon, rejuvenate your senses at the serene spa offering an array of treatments, or energise your body at the state-of-the-art in-house gym. Elevate your maritime experience with wellness and fitness tailored to your desires.
postcards.story:
Step into a world of peace and rejuvenation as you set foot on the ABN Charaidew II in Assam designed with your well-being in mind. The spacious air-conditioned salon welcomes you with open arms, offering a sanctuary of comfort amidst the waves. Sink into plush seating and unwind as the gentle ocean breeze caresses your skin, creating an ambiance of pure serenity.

For those seeking to nurture their body and spirit, the spa awaits, a haven of blissful relaxation where skilled therapists pamper you with an array of rejuvenating treatments. From soothing massages to invigorating facials, the spa menu is curated to cater to your every need, ensuring a holistic wellness experience that revitalises both body and soul.

Fuel your passion for fitness in the in-house gym, equipped with cutting-edge facilities and expert guidance to help you achieve your goals. Whether you prefer cardio workouts to get your heart pumping or strength training to sculpt your physique, the gym offers a dynamic space where you can push your limits and embark on a journey to peak fitness.

As the sun sets on the horizon, bask in the glow of contentment knowing that aboard the ship, wellness and fitness are not just amenities but integral components of your maritime experience. Whether you're seeking relaxation, rejuvenation or a revitalising workout, here, the commitment to your well-being ensures that every moment spent onboard is a step towards a healthier, happier you.

postcards.name: Unwind in Style on a Cruise Sundeck
postcards.intro: Set sail on the luxurious cruise ship of ABN Charaidew II in Assam, where relaxation meets excitement in the heart of the river. With a vast sundeck offering both open-air freedom and shaded comfort, indulge in the ultimate getaway. Sip fine wines and complimentary beverages and immerse yourself in local culture with onboard performances.
postcards.story:
Unwind in style aboard the cruise ship, where every moment is a celebration of luxury and leisure. The expansive sundeck, with plush sofas and sun loungers, provides the perfect setting to soak up the sun or find refuge in the shade as the breathtaking scenery glides by.

Satisfy your palate with a wide array of beverages, from exquisite wines and spirits to refreshing beer, ensuring there's something to please every taste. For those seeking a quieter moment, complimentary tea, coffee and water are available throughout the journey, ensuring you stay refreshed and hydrated.

You can also enjoy the lively onboard dance and song performances, showcasing the rich traditions and talents of local artists. Whether you're tapping your feet to the tunes or simply enjoying the spectacle, these experiences add a touch of authenticity to your journey.

And for those moments when you crave digital connection, fear not — the onboard Wi-Fi keeps you seamlessly connected to the world, even in the midst of the river. Whether you're sharing your adventures on social media, catching up on emails or simply browsing the web, you can stay connected while surrounded by the serenity of nature.

Experience the perfect blend of relaxation, indulgence and entertainment on the luxurious cruise ship while  sipping cocktails on the sundeck, enjoying local performances or staying connected online. This journey promises to be nothing short of unforgettable!

name: Tilar Siro
intro: Nestled between a verdant rainforest and white sand beaches, Tilar Siro evokes the tranquillity associated with your ideal island escape. Bid adieu to the drudgery of work life, and step into spaces that resonate the serene calm of island life.

news_article.title: Tilar Siro: Journey into Andaman to Dive, Explore and Indulge
news_article.description: Your Next Luxury Island Retreat in India

postcards.name: Sunset Cruising in the Andaman Island
postcards.intro: When in the Andamans, every opportunity to explore the ocean and the turquoise blue waters is a delight. But when you add the spectacle of a sunset into the mix, the experience becomes nothing short of magical.
postcards.story:
If your heart is full from adventure sports like underwater diving, snorkelling or island exploration on foot and you're now looking for an experience that simply lets you slow down, a sunset cruise is the perfect activity for you. 

Unlike other sunset experiences, the Andaman Islands present a singular spectacle where the sun dips below the horizon of the expansive sea, evoking pure magic. Yet, this phenomenon hinges on favourable weather conditions. Thus, it's crucial to communicate your interest to the property and be flexible to accommodate the activity on optimal days.

As you step aboard the sunset cruise, feel the anticipation build in the air. The sun begins its descent, casting a warm glow over the turquoise waters, and you can't help but marvel at the breathtaking beauty surrounding you. Sipping on a refreshing cocktail, you breathe in the salty sea air and feel a sense of peace wash over you. It's moments like these that remind you of the magic of travel.

As the boat glides smoothly through the gentle waves, you find yourself completely lost in the moment, the cares of the world slipping away with each passing minute. The sky above transforms into a theatre displaying vibrant colours, with shades of orange, pink and purple blending together. You find yourself lost in the beauty of it all, grateful for the opportunity to witness such a breathtaking sight. 

As the sun dips below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the water, you can't help but feel a sense of awe and wonder. It's a reminder of the beauty and majesty of the natural world, and a moment that will stay with you long after your stay at Tilar Siro has ended.

postcards.name: Go Birdwatching in the Andaman Islands
postcards.intro: With diverse ecosystems and stunning landscapes, the Andaman archipelago promises an unforgettable experience for birdwatchers. From colourful tropical birds to rare endemic species, the Andaman Islands offer a treasure trove of feathered wonders waiting to be discovered. And what makes it all more special? You get to watch these birds within the premises of Tilar Siro.
postcards.story:
As you set out on your birdwatching adventure in the Andaman Islands, you'll find yourself surrounded by the beauty of nature at every turn. With over 270 species of birds recorded in these pristine surroundings, each moment holds the promise of a new sighting. Keep your eyes peeled for sought-after avian species such as the Andaman woodpecker, Andaman serpent eagle, Andaman coucal, Andaman crake and Andaman drongo, each adding to the rich diversity of birds in the region.

Explore the dense forests of Havelock Island, where the vibrant calls of tropical birds fill the air and the lush foliage provides the perfect hiding spot for elusive species. You can journey to Mount Harriet National Park and Chidiya Tapu, where panoramic views and diverse habitats offer fantastic opportunities for birdwatching. Or visit Saddle Peak National Park, home to a variety of endemic birds found only in the Andaman Islands.

For a different perspective, you can venture into the mangrove ecosystems of Wandoor and Baratang Island, where wetland and shorebird species thrive in abundance. Here, you can observe herons, egrets, kingfishers and waders as they go about their daily routines in these unique habitats.

With the help of an in-house naturalist at Tilar Siro, you'll gain valuable insights into the behaviour and habitat of the birds you encounter, enhancing your bird watching experience even further. Whether you're a seasoned birder or a novice enthusiast, birdwatching in the Andaman Islands promises to be an unforgettable journey of discovery and appreciation for the natural world. 

So pack your binoculars, lace up your boots and get ready for a birdwatching adventure!

name: Reni Pani Jungle Lodge
intro: Reni Pani Jungle Lodge, located in a pristine forest typical of the Satpura Tiger Reserve, gets its interesting name from a neighbouring tribal village. Reni Pani features twelve luxury cottages encompassing three distinct architectural designs.

news_article.title: Go on a Journey to Serenity with Reni Pani Jungle Lodge
news_article.description: A Luxury Forest Resort in Madhya Pradesh

postcards.name: Explore Satpura Tiger Reserve on a Thrilling Horse Safari
postcards.intro: Step into the stirrups and prepare for a thrilling journey through the heart of Satpura Tiger Reserve, but in a way you have probably never tried before - on a horse safari! Reni Pani Jungle Lodge invites you to embark on an unforgettable journey through rugged terrain, where every hoofbeat echoes the spirit of adventure.
postcards.story:
As you mount your trusty steed, the wilderness awaits for you to explore its hidden treasures. Reni Pani Jungle Lodge offers a unique opportunity to traverse the landscapes of the Satpura Tiger Reserve aboard horses, bred and trained by a family with generations of expertise in equine care.

The Satpura Tiger Reserve, with its vast expanse of woodlands, meandering streams, and picturesque villages, sets the stage for an unforgettable horseback adventure. The carefully curated trails wind through private and reserve forest patches, offering glimpses of native wildlife in their natural habitat. From graceful spotted deer to elusive sloth bears, each encounter adds to the allure of the journey.

But it's not just about wildlife sightings; it's about immersing yourself in the rhythm of nature. Feel the breeze on your face as you trot along forest trails, the sound of hoofbeats blending harmoniously with the sounds y of the wilderness. Stop by Indigenous villages, where time seems to stand still, and connect with the locals, sharing stories and experiences that bridge the gap between cultures.

The knowledgeable guides accompany you every step of the way, sharing insights into the region's flora, fauna and cultural heritage. Learn about the significance of Reni Trees, after which the very name of the lodge is derived, and their role in attracting wildlife to the area. Marvel at the resilience of Indigenous communities living in harmony with nature, their way of life intricately woven into the fabric of the forest.

As the sun sets on another day of adventure, unwind with a well-deserved bush breakfast or a sundowner at a scenic viewpoint. The camaraderie forged on horseback, the memories created amidst the wilderness - these are the moments that define a horse safari at Reni Pani Jungle Lodge.

postcards.name: Explore the Great Outdoors
postcards.intro: At Reni Pani, there are a number of activities waiting to be explored, allowing you to elevate your experience. Whether you're travelling with a group of friends who share your interests or a diverse mix of individuals, there's something for everyone to discover.
postcards.story:
If you're seeking a respite from the ordinary routine, get ready to dive into a world of thrilling adventures. Whether you consider yourself an avid adventurer or prefer to stay within your comfort zone, Reni Pani offers everybody opportunities to try something new.

Picture this: you, surrounded by the untouched beauty of Satpura National Park, with nothing but the sounds of nature to keep you company. Open sky above and the wonders of wildlife around… If this sounds fascinating, try the guided walking tours. Led by seasoned naturalists, you will trek through winding paths and rugged terrain, discovering all the hidden gems this wilderness has to offer.

If you are more of a water baby, you are covered, too. Consider the tranquil canoeing excursions that will have you gliding along serene waterways, surrounded by lush greenery and the sweet melody of birdsong. It is the perfect opportunity to unwind and let the stresses of everyday life drift away.

If you are more adventurous, you have the option for cycling expeditions too. Strap on your helmet and hit the trails as you pedal through rugged terrain and verdant forests. There's nothing quite like the rush of adrenaline you will feel as you navigate through twists and turns, with nature as your playground.

And for the ultimate wilderness experience, the camping safaris are a must-do. Picture yourself under blanket of stars, surrounded by the sights and sounds of forest. Gather around the campfire with your fellow adventurers and swap stories late into the night. It's the kind of experience that will leave you feeling truly alive.

As you explore the diverse landscapes and abundant wildlife that surrounds Reni Pani Jungle Lodge, find yourself falling more and more in love with the great outdoors. Pack your bags and grab your sense of adventure!

name: Jim's Jungle Retreat
intro: My father Inder Pratap was introduced to the Kumaon hills in the 1950s, his earliest recollection of this spectacular region an elaborate shikaar. An old spool-reel unearthed from a forgotten trunk revealed a treasure of fascinating moments from another era: of commandeering mahouts and white-turbaned bearahs; family members kitted in their safari best following a full day of jungle sport.

news_article.title: Escape into Luxury Jungle Camps at Jim’s Jungle Retreat
news_article.description: An Experiential Lodge in Corbett Tiger Reserve

postcards.name: Join an Expert Naturalist on a Wildlife Expedition
postcards.intro: Jim's Jungle Retreat is perhaps the only holiday destination in India that offers travellers premium experiences while empowering them with opportunities to be a wildlife-conscious individual.  Expeditions are guided by expert naturalists as you sojourn on birding, butterfly, riverbed or village walks. Get ready to capture impeccable flora and fauna sights unique to the Corbett Tiger Reserve.
postcards.story:
Jhirna is a rehabilitated village with a distinguishable grove of flame forest trees. You can spot wild cats here due to its abundant inhabitants- the nilgai(spotted deer), sambhar, wild boars and sloth bears; also a stupendous bird-watching site for great hornbills, paradise flycatchers, peacocks, magpies and more. 

The crisscrossed jungle roads of Bijrani make it a conducive spot for tiger sightings. If you are lucky, you can meet Sharmili, the Bijrani tigress. The region is a prey base for tigers and leopards due to its consistent water resources and biodiverse vegetation- sal trees on the upper reaches, deciduous mixed forests in the valley and three grasslands.

If you wish to spot leopards exclusively, explore no further than the densely wooded hilly terrain of Durgadevi village, the prime habitat for these animals. The lush foliage also provides impeccable birding opportunities in the area. 
 
Overnight stays in century-old forest rest houses of Dhikala are meditative with the sounds of wilderness. Being the largest zone in Corbett, with diverse vegetation, you will discover ghorals grazing on wild fodder at higher altitudes; the gharial, maggars, and great mahseers populate river banks below; elephants, tigers and hog deers that are also exclusive to the region, roam the trail. 

The mixed forest plantation and moist deciduous trees attract sambhars - the tiger's most loved meal. 

Retire into a tent in the hilly terrains of Marchula, well-known for angling and bird-watching. Angling here can be a fun experience for kids- the fish caught are put back into the river. 
 
Visit Tumheria, Corbett Reserve's primary birding base, a four-kilometre-long reservoir considered Asia’s largest mud dam. The vegetation here attracts migratory winter birds. 

A hike in the Sitabani forests will unravel varying trails that scenically interlace jungles with local human settlements like the Sitabani temple.

postcards.name: Unwind Where the Jungle Greets You
postcards.intro: Everything at Jim's Jungle Retreat is an open invitation to venture into the wilderness. You are bound to discover lodging and facilities that attempt to blend in without upsetting the surrounding habitats. Camouflaged rocks and signages guide most pathways until a pebbled road flanked by forest trees leads you— to a cottage.
postcards.story:
The interiors of the estate contrast with its humble eco-exteriors— a vintage colonial-British and Indian contemporary architecture with a hint of minimalist rustic neo-classical charm. 

The architecture was inspired by forest camps of the British Raj era— characteristic whitewashed brick walls, accentuating arches, French windows, and wooden cane furnishings. A nature-friendly palette of whites, browns and yellows plays out throughout the property. Wildlife-inspired ceramics, cushions, lithographs and accessorised animal motifs— notably the woodpecker and elephant door knobs; keep you 'in the jungle'. 

The two-storeyed Jungle Lodge, elevated at 15 feet, enveloped by a 10-foot-wide Raj-style wrap-around veranda, allows sensational sights of surrounding Shivalik hills and a riverbed that hosts deer, the occasional tiger or elephant. 

The Jungle Cottages have characteristic high-sloped thatched roofs like households of local Van Gujjars (nomadic community) in addition to the verandas, giving easy access to nearby trails. 

For an authentic eco-luxury ambience and to encourage a sense of community, the room service, television sets or Wi-Fi are limited to only common areas. The property uses eco-friendly utilities— solar geysers, rain showers, LED lights, organic detergents etc.

A night swim and dinner set in the forest or by the pool are surreal, with nature and animal sounds permeating the ambience. You will find animal paw marks aesthetically laid on the concrete where the pool beds recline. 
 
Retire in nature with Jungle Spa sessions in the forest amidst the greenery, overlooking ponds with lotus or lily blooms. Bibliophiles can unwind in the library on winged-back chairs, reading from an extensive selection of local wildlife and history.

Four machans in the property await those who wish to tune into the sights and sounds of the jungle—the trumpeting, the roars, the howls and grunts are unmissable from here.

name: Windermere Riverhouse
intro: Nestled on a two-acre expanse of lush tropical gardens along the serene banks of the Periyar River, The River House is an exquisite retreat specialising in the art of Slow Travel. Here, tranquillity reigns supreme, where the gentle splash of water and the melodious calls of birds set the symphony of nature.
