news_article.title: Embrace the Panoramic Views of Nature at Windermere Riverhouse
news_article.description: A Serene Retreat Amidst Nature’s Bounty

postcards.name: Trails of Tales: Exploring Bhoothathankettu's Mythical Realm
postcards.intro: Journeying to the renowned Bhoothathankettu Dam will lead you through lush evergreen riverside forests, traversing diminutive caves believed to be inhabited by the legendary Bhoota tribe and encountering a colossal tree with a cavernous interior spacious enough for a person to enter. Embark on this unforgettable adventure and immerse yourself in the enchanting beauty and mystique of Bhoothathankettu Dam.
postcards.story:
Bhoothathankettu presents an enthralling blend of nature and folklore. One side of the dam is enveloped by dense forest, while the other side is graced with sprawling plantations of coconut and rubber trees. Amidst this picturesque setting, Bhoothathankettu, which means ‘Ghost Dam’, is mired in stories relating to ghosts or ‘bhoothams’. 

As you navigate the surrounding biome, you will encounter two dam structures: the contemporary man-made dam and a natural formation characterised by colossal rocks, believed by past generations to be constructed by "bhoothams" or ghosts. Legend has it that ancient demons once endeavoured to submerge the Trikkariyoor temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, by damming the Periyar and flooding the region. However, Lord Shiva, anticipating their deceit, thwarted their efforts by mimicking the approach of dawn with a rooster's crow. Fooled into thinking daybreak had arrived, the demons fled, leaving behind evidence of their endeavour in the form of enormous stones, now known as the Old Bhoothathankettu.

Once at Bhoothathankettu, you can partake in various activities. The region boasts some of Kerala's finest trekking trails, offering an exhilarating journey through lush forests. The lively chirping of unfamiliar birds and the playful calls of monkeys, echoing from the teak trees lining the forest trails, greet the intrepid travellers, while non-slippery rocks ensure a safe adventure. The occasional feel of the chilled water of the rock pits and the wild breeze laden with the scent of forest adds to the enchantment. 

Exploring the area via boat provides a scenic perspective of its natural splendour, while a meticulously maintained garden near the dam offers a tranquil recreational space. Additionally, Bhoothathankettu hosts the Mud Race competition during the annual Onam festival, drawing participants and spectators from across Kerala for a memorable experience.

postcards.name: Savour the Flavours of Windermere
postcards.intro: Escape the ordinary and savour the flavours of culinary excellence amidst nature’s abundance. Let Windermere be your haven for unforgettable gastronomic adventures, where every meal is a fusion of flavours, crafted with care and served with love. So come, and indulge in the magic of Windermere Riverhouse, where every dining experience is a celebration of life's simple pleasures.
postcards.story:
Dining at the Riverhouse evokes a sense of nostalgia, reminiscent of a time when meals were based on the day's harvest. So instead of sticking to a fixed menu, the chef creates each meal using the freshest ingredients sourced from on-site gardens and local markets, following nature's cues. 

Located separately from the main house, the dining area boasts an open-sided design that overlooks the river, allowing the scenery and cuisine to shine. All meals are served in this serene setting with the option to enjoy breakfast outside in the garden during cooler mornings.
The chef, who specialises in curating traditional Keralan home-cooked dishes, typically plans set meals. Each dish showcases a skilful blend of locally grown spices and coconut, tantalising the palate and providing a deeply satisfying culinary experience for both body and soul. You will be surprised to know that there are no menu cards or buffet spreads; instead, meals are served in multiple courses, with Windermere staff offering suggestions along the way.

Guests are encouraged to interact with the chef, learning about local recipes and sharing their own. Additionally, the chef gladly accommodates individual preferences and offers a selection of continental classics upon request. This personalised approach fosters a sense of connection between guests and the culinary experience, making each meal a memorable journey of flavours and stories shared.

In essence, the dining experience at Windermere goes beyond what you typically find in hotels. It transcends mere sustenance, embodying a philosophy that celebrates the beauty of simplicity and the richness of local flavours. With its dedication to sourcing fresh and seasonal ingredients, personalised service and a tranquil riverside setting, Windermere offers not just a meal but a holistic experience that nourishes both body and spirit.

name: Windermere Estate
intro: Everything at the Windermere Estate is geared towards a different time, a different pace – inspired by the magic of plantation life. The property is intimate, with just 18 lovingly handcrafted rooms arranged around the original Planter’s Bungalow which still serves as the owner's residence.

news_article.title: Surrender to the Beauty of Nature at Windermere Estate
news_article.description: Your Ultimate Secluded Sanctuary in Kerala

postcards.name: Feel the Fresh Air on a Tea Trail
postcards.intro: If you're captivated by the beauty of Munnar's picturesque tea gardens, you're in for a treat, and there's so much more to discover than what initially meets your eyes. Picture yourself going on a guided trek through the lush tea plantations at Windermere Estate in Kerala. It's an immersive experience that offers insight into the fascinating world of tea.
postcards.story:
As you set out on your tea trail walk, you'll find yourself surrounded by the majestic beauty of the tea gardens. But it's not just about the scenery – it's about understanding the intricate workings of these estates and the people who dedicate themselves to cultivating the perfect cup of tea. You'll have the chance to meet the friendly faces behind the scenes, gaining a deeper appreciation for their dedication and expertise.

If you enjoy hiking, a visit to Kolukumalai is a must. Situated among the clouds, it's one of the highest tea estates in India. The breathtaking views alone are worth the journey, and the opportunity to explore the tea factory adds an extra layer of fascination to the experience.

If you prefer a more leisurely approach, the Tea Museum awaits. Step into this charming establishment and be transported into the world of tea through artefacts, video explanations and even a mini factory tour. Mattupeety and Lockart Estates also welcome you to witness their tea-making processes firsthand, offering a unique glimpse into the craft.

And let's not forget about the tea itself. Windermere Estate invites you to indulge in a tea-tasting experience like no other. Relish the flavours of fresh, rare single-estate teas, each sip telling a story of its own. Be sure to notify the hotel in advance so they can ensure your tasting session is nothing short of exceptional.

As you explore the many tea outlets scattered throughout Munnar, don't miss the chance to treat yourself to some of the finest teas the region has to offer. Whether you're a connoisseur or simply curious, there's something for everyone to enjoy. From guided treks to immersive factory tours and tantalising tastings, every moment promises to make a tea lover's dream come true.

postcards.name: Treat Your Eyes with the Experience of Bird-Watching
postcards.intro: Imagine waking up to the soothing sounds of birdsong echoing through the lush gardens of Windermere Estate in Kerala. Here, birds and butterflies are not just visitors but are considered part of the family, adding to the enchanting atmosphere of this idyllic retreat.
postcards.story:
Each morning at Windermere Estate, as the sun rises, you'll be serenaded by the cheerful chirping of the red-whiskered bulbul and the haunting melody of the Malabar whistling thrush. It's a magical start to the day – one that will leave you feeling refreshed.

If you're eager to deepen your connection with the avian residents of Windermere Estate, you're in luck. Here, you’re offered early-morning bird walks around the estate, providing the perfect opportunity to observe these feathered friends in their natural habitat. Simply let them know in advance and they'll arrange a guided tour that's sure to delight bird enthusiasts of all levels.

But the magic of bird-watching doesn't end at Windermere Estate – it's just the beginning. Venture into the Chinnar and Munnar regions, where over 300 species of birds call it their home. From vibrant kingfishers to majestic eagles, you'll encounter a diverse variety of avian life, many of which are rare and once endangered.

As you wander through the verdant landscapes, keep your eyes peeled for flashes of colour and graceful movements among the trees. With each sighting, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the beauty of these winged creatures and the ecosystems they inhabit.

Whether you're a seasoned birder or simply curious about the world around you, bird-watching at Windermere Estate promises an unforgettable experience. 

As you reflect on your morning spent in the company of birds, take comfort in knowing that these enchanting moments are just a glimpse of the natural wonders that await in Kerala. Remember, the door is always open for you to return and explore further – because here at Windermere Estate, every day is an opportunity to connect with the magic of the natural world.

name: Wild Mahseer
intro: Spread over 22 acres and surrounded by tea gardens, the Wild Mahseer in Balipara, Assam is a British- era heritage bungalow that could easily become a habitual getaway. Nestled in the Addabarie Tea Estate the 145 years old Eastern Himalayan Botanic Ark in Residence at Wild Mahseer, will gently sweep you back in time.

news_article.title: Stay in the Wild with Wild Mahseer
news_article.description: History, Heritage and a Haven in Assam’s Wilderness

postcards.name: Savour Organic Gastronomy in the Eastern Himalayas
postcards.intro: Nestled amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Assam's wilderness, Wild Mahseer beckons travellers with the promise of an authentic gastronomic journey through the Eastern Himalayas. At the heart of this culinary adventure lies a commitment to sustainability and authenticity, making Wild Mahseer a certified organic retreat unlike any other.
postcards.story:
One of the defining features of Wild Mahseer is its dedication to organic farming and sustainability. The property boasts its own lush gardens and herbal patches, where a diverse array of plants and herbs thrive under the nurturing care of local farmers. From fragrant spices to aromatic teas, every ingredient is cultivated with the utmost care and respect for the environment. This ensures a truly organic and flavoursome dining experience.

What truly sets Wild Mahseer apart is its deep-rooted connection to the local Indigenous tribes of Assam. The property's strong community ties extend beyond its organic gardens, encompassing a rich tapestry of cultures and traditions that have been passed down through generations. You are invited to immerse yourself in the vibrant culinary heritage of these tribes. Here, each dish tells a story of tradition, history and regional diversity.

From the Mishing tribe's delectable fish preparations to the Garo tribe's hearty meat dishes, Wild Mahseer offers a tantalising array of flavours that showcase the best of Assam's gastronomy. You can savour the subtle nuances of Bodo cuisine, with its emphasis on fresh, locally sourced ingredients. You can also indulge in the fiery flavours of Nepali delicacies infused with aromatic spices and herbs.

Perhaps the most memorable aspect of dining at Wild Mahseer is the sense of community that permeates every meal. Whether gathered around a communal table or sharing stories with local chefs, you are welcomed into the fold of Assam's Indigenous tribes. This forges connections that go beyond mere sustenance. 

Here, food is more than just nourishment; it's a celebration of culture, tradition, and the timeless bond between people and the land they call home. And who would want to miss being a part of such a celebration?

postcards.name: Learn about the Local Handicrafts at O' Hastashilpa
postcards.intro: On your visit to Wild Mahseer, discover the richness of Assamese culture at O' Hastashilpa, where you can learn about the art of handloom weaving and handicrafts whilst engaging with local artisans, learning traditional techniques, and witnessing the creation of exquisite textiles and artworks firsthand.
postcards.story:
O' Hastashilpa, meaning "Handloom & Handicraft" in Assamese, is a vibrant community space nestled within the serene surroundings of Wild Mahseer. In this haven, you are invited to delve into the age-old traditions of Assamese craftsmanship. Experience how every aspect of your stay tells a story of heritage and artistry. You can witness the magic of nature firsthand, as you explore the vibrant ecosystem that sustains Asaam’s handloom and artisan offerings.

Upon arrival, you are greeted by the rhythmic clacking of looms and the skilled hands of local artisans at work. The air is filled with the earthy scent of natural dyes and the vibrant colours of Assam's Indigenous textiles. You can participate in hands-on workshops, where you learn the intricate techniques of handloom weaving and handicraft production from master craftsmen.

From spinning yarn to creating intricate patterns, every step of the process is a testament to the skill and dedication of Assam's artisans. You can try your hand at weaving their own textiles, guided by experienced instructors who share their knowledge and passion for the craft. In addition to weaving, O' Hastashilpa offers a wide range of traditional handicrafts, including bamboo and cane work, pottery and basketry. You can explore the workshop spaces, where local artisans showcase their craftsmanship and demonstrate their techniques.

O' Hastashilpa is more than just a place to learn and create - it's a hub of community and culture. You can engage with artisans, share stories and gain insight into the rich heritage of Assam's handloom and handicraft traditions. Whether participating in a workshop, browsing the curated selection of artisanal products, or simply soaking in the atmosphere, a visit to O' Hastashilpa is an unforgettable journey into the heart of Assamese craftsmanship.

name: Farmhouse Rwanda
intro: The story of our farmhouse is one that resonates with the spirit of following one’s dreams and never losing sight of what truly matters. The owner, who spent his childhood in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo surrounded by vast farmland and an abundance of horses and cows, carried those cherished memories with him as he ventured into the world.

news_article.title: Connect with Animals at Farmhouse Rwanda
news_article.description: An Organic Farm Near Volcanoes National Park

postcards.name: Feel the Benefits of the Wellness Spa Treatments
postcards.intro: When you step into the serene space of Farmhouse Rwanda, you're not just going on a journey of relaxation but immersing yourself in a holistic wellness experience that nurtures your body, mind and soul. Here, you’ll experience more than just spa treatments – it's about reconnecting with yourself, nature and the community around you.
postcards.story:
Picture yourself sinking into a state of pure bliss as you indulge in Farmhouse Rwanda’s Wellness Spa Treatment. This experience is a sublime fusion of rejuvenation and sustainability. Imagine being enveloped in nutrient-rich mud sourced sustainably from the surroundings, each stroke of the therapist's hands working to revitalise your body while honouring the commitment to the environment. It's an experience that not only leaves you feeling pampered but also deeply connected to the earth.

Farmhouse Rwanda understands the importance of organic practices, which is why their massage and body treatments are mindfully curated to nourish your skin with natural, chemical-free ingredients. From essential oils to herbal extracts, every element is chosen with care to ensure that you leave feeling refreshed and rejuvenated from head to toe.

Here, you’ll also love the facial treatment – a luxurious experience reserved exclusively for the in-house guests. Imagine basking in the gentle glow of the skilled estheticians' hands as they work their magic, using organic products to cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate your skin. It's not just about looking good but also about feeling confident and radiant from the inside out.

The Farmhouse Rwanda experience goes beyond the spa treatments. It's about embracing a lifestyle of wellness and sustainability. Here, you’ll also be offered enlightening workshops, immersive farm-to-fork experiences and educational sessions designed to empower you with knowledge. From learning about sustainable farming practices to celebrating conscious living, you’ll get inspired to make positive changes that extend far beyond your time at Farmhouse Rwanda.

Come for a relaxing stay at the Farmhouse Rwanda and start your journey of self-discovery and rejuvenation. Whether you're seeking relaxation, connection or simply a break from the rush of everyday life, you’ll be welcomed here with open arms.

postcards.name: Try Milking a Cow
postcards.intro: At Farmhouse Rwanda, milking cows isn't just a chore – it's a cherished tradition and an opportunity to connect with nature in a meaningful way. When you join a farm tour here, you're invited to witness the age-old process of milking firsthand, gaining insights into the rich nutritional benefits of fresh milk straight from the organic cows.
postcards.story:
As you observe the gentle rhythm of the milking process in a farm tour at Farmhouse Rwanda, the knowledgeable staff will be on hand to offer insights into the significance of milk as a wholesome food source. They'll gladly answer any questions you have, whether it's about the milking technique or the nutritional value of the milk itself.

Milking cows is more than just a learning experience. It's a chance to forge a deeper connection with these gentle creatures and immerse yourself in Rwandan culture. Farmhouse Rwanda believes in fostering a bond between their visitors and their animals, strengthening understanding and appreciation for the vital role they play in providing nourishing milk for us all.

Their commitment to animal welfare is paramount. Here, the cows live in a stress-free environment, with plenty of clean water, nutritious food and ample space to graze. Farmhouse Rwanda adheres to ethical practices, treating their cows with kindness and respect at all times.

During the milking process, the trained staff ensures the comfort and hygiene of these cows. Each cow is thoroughly cleaned and their udders are inspected to ensure their well-being. They opt for hand milking, a method that's both efficient and gentle, tailored to meet each cow's individual needs.

The result is fresh milk that's brimming with essential nutrients – from calcium for strong bones to vitamins and minerals that support overall health. It's a pure, wholesome delight that embodies the essence of farm-to-table goodness.

When you visit Farmhouse Rwanda, don't miss the chance to experience the tradition of milking cows. It's a hands-on adventure that promises to enrich your understanding of agriculture, deepen your connection to nature and leave you with an appreciation for the simple joys of farm life.

name: Purity at Lake Vembanad
intro:
Purity is a magnificent lake front resort in an outstanding location overlooking the peaceful waters of lake Vembanad
at its widest point. The superbly crafted Purity offers a basket of outstanding experiences, its situated at Muhamma,
Alappuzha district, Kerala.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Wellness Staycation at Purity at Lake Vembanad
news_article.description: Steeped in Kerala's Tropical Beauty

postcards.name: Discover Ayurvedic Bliss at Purity at Lake Vembanad
postcards.intro: Inside the home of God’s own country in the district of Alappuzha in Kerala, lies a beautiful      wellness resort, Purity at Lake Vembanad. With a focus on physical and mental rejuvenation, you can indulge in authentic Ayurvedic-based wellness treatments and therapies that offer the utmost relaxation of the body and soul.
postcards.story:
Indulging in an Ayurvedic massage can be a far more holistic experience than your typical spa treatment. Purespa at Purity resort offers you a diverse array of therapies tailored to your individual needs. These speciality treatments aid in your muscle relaxation, stress relief, muscle toning and body pain relief and they increase blood circulation and even help improve your skin texture.

One of the signature treatments at Purespa is Abhyangam. A deeply nourishing body massage treatment using medicated oil, Abhyangam helps your body recover its strength and tones muscles, increases blood circulation and stimulates the senses. The rhythmic strokes of the therapist's hands not only ease muscular tension but also stimulate the flow of prana, or life force, throughout the body, promoting overall well-being.

If you are seeking primary relief from body pain, stiff joints or backaches, treatments like      Ela kizhi and Sirodhara can be an ideal choice. Herbal leaves and medicated powders are tied together in small bundles, dipped into warm medicated oil, and applied all over your body, providing soothing relief to those tired muscles. Watch out for that feel of healing energy flow from your head to the rest of the body.

Purity even offers you seven- to 14-day programs for a complete detox and rejuvenating experience.  

Derived from the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda and inspired from the martial art forms of Kalaripayattu, every massage you enjoy at Purity is delivered with expert care, ensuring a transformative experience. Whether you're embarking on a journey of self-discovery or seeking respite from the stress of daily life, Purity at Lake Vembanad provides a sanctuary for your holistic wellness and rejuvenation.

postcards.name: Embark on a Houseboat Experience from Malabar Escapes
postcards.intro: Purity at Lake Vembanad offers you not just a luxurious stay but also a way to explore Kerala's natural resources through backwater journeys. Opt for the luxurious Discovery Houseboat, offering customized cruise options with luxurious accommodation. Indulge in gourmet meals prepared by in-house chefs while discovering historical sites like Kottayam, Ambalapuzha temple and Mannar's bronze casting hub.
postcards.story:
Situated in the epicentre of Kerala’s longest lake, Vembanad, Purity is also intertwined with other water bodies. The state’s landscapes, flora and picturesque backwaters provide the perfect canvas for this pure unadulterated resort.      

Purity takes you on an extraordinary adventure through these enchanting waterways, where every turn reveals a side of Kerala's rich heritage and natural splendour. Begin your backwater journey on a small country boat or a speedboat through the narrow canals alongside small fishing villages, dotted with coconut palm trees, on a day trip. Visit old ancestral homes near the shore line and relish an authentic Kerala Sadhya lunch served up in a traditional banana leaf. 

The Discovery Houseboat, however, is your ultimate way to cruise through the channels. Choose from the numerous options including all-inclusive one-, two- and three-night cruises. Embark on a luxury houseboat journey, tailored just for you and a select group of up to four passengers.  
     
There’s no dearth of luxury aboard the Discovery. It features a spacious air-conditioned double bedroom, a cosy living room and a well-appointed bathroom. Relax in your private sitting area on the sundeck, basking in the sunshine and enjoying the scenic views. Plus, the in-house chef will delight your taste buds with delectable meals prepared to perfection, reflecting the excellence of Purity's menu.

Your travel adventure kicks off with a guided visit to Ambalapuzha, a 17th-century temple dedicated to Lord Krishna, known for its distinctive wooden carvings, and intricately adorned gopuram (entrance tower).

Cruise onwards to Mannar, Kerala's historical hub of bronze casting, where you'll witness centuries-old craftsmanship in action. You can even shop for some bronze cookware, traditional handicrafts and wall hangings. 

Explore the splendor of Krishnapuram Palace, renowned for its exquisite woodwork and the largest single mural in Kerala, depicting the salvation of an elephant.

name: Tara Mountain Sarai
intro: Welcome to Tara Mountain Sarai - A Melange of adrenaline adventure and mindful meditation. Nestled amidst the untamed wilderness of the Zanskar valley, where the Tsarap and Kargyak rivers converge in a mesmerizing dance, lies Tara Mountain Sarai, Purne.

news_article.title: Soak Up the Adventure and Mindful Meditation at Tara Mountain Sarai
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay Surrounded by Ladakhi Himalayas

postcards.name: Step onto Your Mat for a Morning Yoga Session
postcards.intro: By staying at Tara Mountain Sarai, you immerse yourself in the very essence of the Ladakhi plateau. Imagine waking up to the gentle whispers of the mountains, feeling the crisp mountain air against your skin as you step onto your mat for a morning yoga session.
postcards.story:
Surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of the mountains, you'll find a sense of peace and calm wash over you. As you move through each yoga pose, guided by experienced instructors, you'll feel a deep connection to the natural world around you. The sky above stretches endlessly, a canvas of ever-changing colours, while the earth beneath you grounds you in its ancient wisdom.

Yoga isn't just a physical practice here; it's a way of tapping into the energy of the mountains, of breathing in the pure essence of the Ladakhi landscape. Whether you're a seasoned yogi or a beginner, the complimentary daily sessions cater to all levels, ensuring that everyone can experience the transformative power of yoga amidst this stunning backdrop.

In the embrace of the mountains, surrounded by nature, you'll find a renewed sense of vitality and well-being. Each breath becomes a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things – the sky, the earth and you. As you flow through your practice, you'll feel a sense of gratitude for the opportunity to be present in this moment, in this majestic landscape.

After your yoga session, you can continue to bask in the tranquillity of the mountains, walk through the gardens or simply sit in quiet contemplation, soaking in the beauty that surrounds you. And as the day unfolds, you'll carry with you the sense of peace and calm that you found on your mat, a reminder that the true beauty of Ladakh lies not just in its landscapes, but in the moments of stillness and connection that it inspires within you.

If you're ready to go on a journey of self-discovery and renewal, join a yoga session at Tara Mountain Sarai. Let the mountains be your guide as you find harmony and balance amidst the breathtaking beauty of Ladakh.

postcards.name: Join a Cooking Class at Tara Mountain Sarai
postcards.intro: At Tara Mountain Sarai, you're not just booking a room but also immersing yourself in the richness of Ladakhi culture, especially through its culinary delights. Nestled amidst the stunning landscapes of Ladakh, this retreat is more than just a place to rest your head – it's an invitation to explore, learn and savour the authentic flavours of this beautiful region.
postcards.story:
One of the highlights of your stay with Tara Mountain Sarai is the opportunity to participate in the exclusive cooking sessions. You, alongside fellow travellers, gather around a rustic kitchen, surrounded by the aroma of spices and the warmth of camaraderie. Led by talented chefs, who are not only masters of their craft but also passionate storytellers, you'll go on a journey through the traditional cuisines of Ladakh.

From aromatic stews simmering gently on the stove to freshly baked bread cooling on the countertop, every dish tells a story – a tale of heritage, tradition and the fusion of diverse influences. Islamic, Tibetan and local flavours meld seamlessly, creating a culinary landscape as diverse as the landscape itself.

During the cooking session, you won't just learn recipes; you'll gain insight into the cultural significance of each ingredient, technique and dish. As you chop, stir and sizzle your way through the recipes, the chefs will regale you with anecdotes and legends, painting a vivid picture of Ladakhi life and traditions.

But it's not just about mastering recipes; it's about experiencing the essence of Ladakhi hospitality. As you bond over shared culinary experiences, you'll forge connections that transcend language and borders. And when the meal is finally ready and you sit down to feast on your creations, you'll taste more than just delicious food – you'll taste the spirit of Ladakh itself.

From hearty soups to delicate dumplings, each dish offers a new dimension of flavours, textures and aromas. Armed with new culinary skills and stories to share, you'll return home not just with memories but with a taste of Ladakh that stays long after your journey ends. Come hungry, leave inspired – that's the promise of the Ladakhi cooking experience at Tara Mountain Sarai.

name: Sukoon Houseboat
intro: Moored on the mirror-calm waters of Kashmir’s Dal Lake surrounded by the snow-dusted peaks of the Himalayas, Sukoon perfectly symbolises it’s Sufi meaning; an elevated state of mind combining peace, wisdom and contentment.

news_article.title: Live Like a Royal at Sukoon Houseboat
news_article.description: Unwind like a Sufi in Kashmir

postcards.name: Uncover Kashmir’s Gastronomic Farm-to-Table Journeys
postcards.intro: From spiced curries, rice or coastal coconut-infused southern cuisine to wheat, bread and non-vegetarian northern cooking, extravagant banquets are a love language of social dining and festivities in India. Sukoon's Nourishing Retreat sets travellers on a 'conscious' gastronomic adventure to better understand what a farm-to-table nourishment experience feels like.
postcards.story:
The ethos of Indian cuisine transcends the popularity of its dishes like butter chicken or tikka masala. Although a catalyst for indulgent celebrants, it is also a product of Ayurvedic science and a cultural after-effect of historical pardesi trades and invasions. 
 
In the Indian subcontinent, nourishment is an act of homage—Vedic Upanishads construe eating as a conscious act of consuming matter that composes our bodies. Ayurveda illustrates a well-balanced diet as proportionate in six rasas (flavours)—sweet, salty, hot, bitter, sour and astringent. Yoga advocates intentional ingestion of food, understanding the impact of its three gunas (qualities)—rajas (energetic), tamas (dull) and sattva (purity) upon health. To understand nourishment is to traverse its path.
 
Sukoon's Nourishing Retreat is a bespoke programme lasting four to six days where you will experience immersive food journey of conscious cooking under the guidance of a local chef de cuisine. Learn the secrets of Kashmiri cuisine that borrows culinary influences from the Persian rulership of 200 years mingled with native Sufi cuisine. 
 
Enjoy journeying on a shikara ride, learn bartering for produce with floating market vendors bustling over Dal Lake or shopkeepers by the shoreside. Shop for condiments, handpick veggies or freshly caught fish of choice. Pick up traditional family recipes visiting local household. You will then cook your dinner at Sukoon witnessing a scenic sunset over the majestic Himalayan mountains. 
 
The retreat continues onto Sukoon Safari Camp, set amidst a verdant valley flanked by lush pine forests. On your way, you will pick up trout from local farms for your evening meal. Here, the cooking lessons begin on wood fires against a stunning panorama of mountains. Post dinner, you will retire to luxury tents pitched under a starry night sky. 
 
At the end of the retreat, you are given a handout of recipes as a souvenir.

postcards.name: Join a Sukoon Water Safari
postcards.intro: Experience the romance of voyaging through sublime panoramas and backwaters once traversed by the Mughals. Revel in Srinagar's changing vistas as you are carried comfortably through the quiet backwaters of river Jhelum, reclining on a bed in a vibrant shikara (a canopied rowboat) paddled by two boatmen. Witness waters that reflect a strange ephemeral quality.
postcards.story:
Slowly down the Jhelum, a six-day water safari begins with a recess at Sukoon's patio and an evening shikara ride through Dal Lake's lively waterways, floating markets and shops. It then moves on to Manasbal and Wular Lake, culminating at a luxury camp in the magnificent Sonmarg Valley. All water safaris conclude with travellers retiring to deluxe alpine tents pitched on the respective shores. 

Manasbal Lake is every birdwatcher's delight, as it is home to migratory aquatic birds. You will also find enchanting lilies and lotus blossoms populating the perimeter of the lake. Jaroka, a garden built by Nur Jahan (a Mughal queen), overlooks the lake. 

Wular Lake is the second-largest freshwater lake in Asia, also famous for its water chestnut and fresh fish harvests. The lake views here are crystal-clear mirror-like reflections of the landscapes above. Ashore, in Watlab, stands the celebrated Muslim Sufi shrine of Baba-Shakur-Din, known for the entrance door believed to have mystical powers. 
 
The water safari ends with the ascent to Sonmarg Hill Station and begins at the eighth-century Wangath Shiva temple complex. The tour progresses onto Sukoon Sonmarg camp, serving warm kahwa and cold towels. Premium tents with large windows, embroidered carpets, twin mattresses, independent toilets and showers await. Sonmarg's wildflower meadows and Himalayan views from the comfort of your bed are spellbinding. A gourmet meal is served as dinner under the stars around a bonfire. 

Three-hour hike uphill to Sonmarg Valley displays breathtaking sights of Thajiwas glaciers. Enjoy a hot cup of salt tea at Gujar (nomad) huts and indulge in their lifestyle. A delectable lunch spread is set further ahead over an ornate carpet with views of the beautiful terrain. The high tea and dinner under the stars will resume at the camp.

name: Visalam
intro: The palatial home of Kanadukathan village, Visalam is a heritage house of rare distinction. It is an endearing symbol of paternal love that equally captures the soul of Chettinad, a region renowned for its palatial homes, fiery cuisine and colourful culture.

news_article.title: Embrace the Chettinad Way of Life at Visalam
news_article.description: A 70 year old Chettinad Mansion in Tamil Nadu

postcards.name: A Bridge to Chettinad's Architectural Past
postcards.intro: 'Visalam', a 100-year-old mansion in Kanadukathan village, is a majestic expression of Chettinad's rich architectural history, people and culture. It embodies the essence of paternal love, as the estate was a gift from KVAL Ramanathan Chettiar to his daughter Visalakshi. 'Visalam' is every traveller's delight, welcoming guests with its warm ambience of teakwood, lavish corridors and spacious rooms.
postcards.story:
Chettinad's buildings are as distinct and timeless as its culture. On a casual trip around 'Visalam', you will discover a barrage of abandoned palatial mansions with unique South Indian architecture influenced by East Asian and post-colonial styles. From the mid-18th century, for 100 years, over 30,000 mansions were built in the region. They belonged to the affluent mercantile community of Nattukottai Chettiars, who constructed them with materials sourced during their international trades. You can see their passion for extravagance reflected in their estates. 'Visalam' is one such property restored to its original splendour with the help of local artisan communities.
 
'Visalam's' visually appealing rooms with solo balconies, lofty ceilings with chandeliers and ornate wooden craftsmanship and pillars with intricate carvings beckon you with a warm, regal yet cosy vibe. Classical furniture made of Burmese teak, handmade flooring tiles procured from Athangudi village, bed linen, runners, and cushions sourced from famed handloom weavers of Chettinad all promise you an experience indulgent in luxury and comfort. 
 
A stark contrast to the splendid decor is the simplicity of the style. You will find the pearly white textured walls particularly intriguing. They are made of raw eggshells, an art known only to the remaining few in occupation. A base mixture of eggshells, lime, palm jaggery and seashells is first finely ground together by hand for plastering. Polishing is then completed using egg whites. 
 
Like any Chettiar home, Visalam's construction was strategically planned to suit its owner's occupational and domestic convenience. The site has four different feasting areas - sapadu shala, terrace grill, garden cafe and poolside cafe; several spacious rooms; backyard-facing game room with antique board games; an open garden; a central courtyard for natural ventilation and more. It is a must-see if you want to escape 'the noise' and immerse yourself in nature.

postcards.name: Let Chettinad’s Piquant Cuisine Invigorate Your Palate
postcards.intro: The kitchen at 'Visalam' is vibrant with local chefs who carry a treasure trove of spice mixes unfamiliar to most foreign palates. Chettinad cuisines are infamous for their harmonious blend of fragrance and fiery flavours. The secret sauce is a carefully curated concoction of freshly ground masalas and aromatic blends.
postcards.story:
There is a history of how spices made their way into local cooking. In the late 18th century, mercantile Chettiars travelled often to East Asian countries like Ceylon, Burma, the Dutch East Indies, French Indo-China, Malaysia and Singapore for trade. They are known to be heavily involved in the spice trade. Gradually, Tellicherry pepper, Ceylon cardamom, Indonesian nutmeg, Madagascar cloves and galangal from Laos and Vietnam found their way into South Indian coconut and rice. Although, historically, the community is primarily vegetarian, their travels led them to embrace non-vegetarian dishes. Chicken Chettinad is an extensively popular scorching dish served pan India. 
 
'Visalam' strives to carry forward the legacy to give you an authentic Chettinad cuisine experience. Food is a hypnotic, sensual adventure here. A few aromatic spices used in cooking are star anise, local lichens, tamarind, chillies, fennel seeds, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaves, peppercorns, cumin seeds and fenugreek. Cooking is done with genuine brass utensils (considered healthy). 
 
Popular dishes like idli, dosa and appams are a staple at 'Visalam' in addition to non-vegetarian dishes. Vazhai ilai sapadu, or banana leaf meal, is an all-encompassing gastronomic delight served during festive occasions. It consists of steam-boiled rice with an assortment of lip-smacking side dishes and curries, each made of different flavours. Paniyaram - a steamed muffin made of rice and black lentil batter, and adhirasam - rice flour and jaggery sweet are must-have delicacies here.
 
An exclusive tea kadai(shop) is parked in the garden during the morning and evening for your beverage and snacking needs. You can also witness the delicate art of making rice flour fried crisps — kai murukkus (a local snack) by Aachis (grandmothers) at Chettinad Mithai. Cooking enthusiasts can book a Live Kitchen session to learn local recipes from the chef de cuisine.

name: Utsav Camp
intro: Located in a remote area near the boulders of Tehla, Utsav Camp Sariska is a nature retreat founded with the intention of creating a sanctuary where you can reconnect with Mother Nature.

news_article.title: Immerse Yourself in Rajasthani Hospitality at Utsav Camp
news_article.description: Fusing an Eco-Haven with Blissful Luxury

postcards.name: Experience an Eco-Conscious Design Camp
postcards.intro: On your visit to Utsav Camp Sariska, do not be surprised at the boutique’s unwavering attention to design and detail just because it is situated amidst the stony and woody landscapes of Sariska National Park. Instead, expect a bespoke experience of lounging in quiet luxury tuned to the Aravali’s character. The remarkable design sensibilities here are sure to be enjoyed.
postcards.story:
When picking a lodging option, you will be presented with a trio of options: Forest Bungalows, Stone Cabins and Swiss Tents. Though each space is a sanctuary in itself, echoing the untamed beauty of Sariska, their zen, charm or facade set the stage for three different moods. 

If the ‘modern elegance’ theme best appeals to you, the opulent Forest Bungalows will be the best pick. Take to the Stone Cabins if exposed brick and rustic designs are more your style. Or, opt for the elegant Swiss Tents to soak yourself in desert glamour. Across all three styles of lodging, every dawn will break with chirping birds, and nights will set with the clearest sky for a quiet stargazing session.

Beyond these abodes, every shared space at Camp brings forth Utsav’s philosophy of integrating spaces with nature. The airy, eco-conscious layout of the Forest Lounge makes it a rooftop haven, perfect for comfortably sipping a refreshing drink to a velvety sunset. On the other hand, The Patio right below it offers a change of scenery with bamboo sheds; lush creepers; and bright, contrasting furniture against stone walls. Here, a lazy luncheon will transport you to a bright Mediterranean day.

One of the perkiest lounging spots is the cosy library room—a green-walled studio space which feels like a soothing lemonade on a summer day. Its vibrant upholstery, jungle-themed, hand-painted wallpapers and fine wood furnishings, make it a reader’s paradise and the perfect spot to wind down. 

Utsav Sariska is an invitation to slowly connect with nature to ensure that every moment is a celebration of the wild and a commitment to sustainable living. Immerse yourself in Utsav’s curated haven to experience a design-forward retreat.

postcards.name: A Birding Stint at Utsav Sariska
postcards.intro: Peeking into the world of local and seasonal birds is a highlight at Utsav Camp Sariska.
postcards.story:
Aravali’s golden and green-tinted forests have an endless bounty of rustic wilderness. On one side, thorny shrubs stand before an army of grand trees, while on the other side, endless grasslands run between boulders made of magma. Here, the eyes are met with blue skies peering through the tall scrubby trees and the ears with the chatter of plum-headed parakeets.

A naturalist-led birding walk will allow you to explore the vastness of the forest, with many bird sightings and lessons on their songs and calls. However, it is not just an experience for seasoned ornithologists, but for all ages and interests.

In the Tehla region, smaller birds populate the low-lying scrub forests. Sightings of black-shouldered kites, white-eyed buzzards, peregrine falcons, jungle bush quails, pied crested cuckoos and brainfever birds are common. 

While the perennial water bodies in the nearby Malana and Mangalsar forests offer sightings of the spot-billed duck, northern shoveler, northern pintail, white-breasted waterhen, common moorhen, common coot, black-winged stilt and even the whiskered or the river tern. 

Down in the scrub forests, other residents of the forest, from crawlies like reptiles and snakes and small carnivorous mammals to larger predatory birds thrive in camouflage, foraging for insects and seeds.

An early morning expedition through the jungles near Tehla village has the potential to reveal over 280 species of native and migratory birds in the local region, and work with a local expert is bound to reveal the forest’s best-kept secrets. Our recommendation is to lace up your hiking shoes, and head out with a set of binoculars.

name: The Mountbatten Lodge
intro: Rajasthan is renowned for its palaces, forts, and royal kingdoms, but those who venture off the well-beaten tourist trail, will be delighted by the richness and beauty of rural Rajasthan.

news_article.title: Soak Up the Serenity at The Mountbatten Lodge
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Jawai Leopard Safari: A Glimpse into Rajasthan's Wild Side
postcards.intro: Rajasthan, the land of kings and forts, offers not only a glimpse into its rich history but also a rendezvous with its untamed wilderness. Among the many experiences it presents, the Jawai Leopard Safari stands out as a thrilling adventure that beckons nature enthusiasts and wildlife aficionados from around the globe.
postcards.story:
Located an hour’s drive away from The Mountbatten Lodge, the Jawai region in Rajasthan is renowned for its thriving population of leopards, making it one of the prime destinations for wildlife safaris in India. The rugged terrain, dotted with rocky outcrops and scrub forests, provides an ideal habitat for these elusive predators, offering a unique opportunity to observe them in their natural habitat.

The thrill of a leopard sighting is unparalleled, as these solitary hunters gracefully traverse the rocky terrain or lounge languidly atop the granite hills, blending seamlessly with their surroundings. With each sighting, you are treated to mesmerising encounters that offer a glimpse into the intricate dynamics of predator and prey in the wilderness.

The sprawling hills of Jawai offer a sanctuary for nature enthusiasts eager to delve into the mysteries of the wild. Apart from leopards, you can indulge in the tranquil pursuit of birdwatching. From the elusive Indian courser to the majestic eagle owl and the vibrant Indian pitta, diverse birdlife awaits exploration.

And, the adventure doesn’t end there! Jawai Dam teems with crocodiles, providing a rare opportunity to observe these reptiles in their natural habitat. Witnessing them bask in the sun, glide through the waters or engage in territorial disputes is an experience in itself. And if time permits, you could also explore the nearby Rabari village.

Every moment spent immersed in this untamed landscape is an opportunity to connect with nature in its purest form, leaving an indelible imprint on the soul. The allure of Jawai's wilderness beckons adventurers to explore further, promising unforgettable encounters at every turn.

postcards.name: Journey Through Time: A Visit to Kumbalgarh Fort
postcards.intro: Nestled amidst the rugged Aravallis in Rajasthan lies a historical gem that whispers tales of valour, architectural grandeur and cultural richness — the Kumbalgarh Fort. Embarking on a journey to this majestic fortification is akin to stepping back in time, immersing yourself in the glorious chapters of India's past.
postcards.story:
During your stay at The Mountbatten Lodge, a visit to Kumbalgarh Fort is a must-do experience. Located just a scenic drive away from the lodge, Kumbalgarh Fort sits majestically at the base of the Aravalli ranges, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding locale.

The journey to Kumbalgarh Fort is as enchanting as the destination itself. You will encounter quaint villages, vibrant markets and sprawling fields as you wind your way through the countryside. The scenic drive offers glimpses of rural life, where time seems to stand still amidst the rural beauty.

Upon reaching Kumbalgarh Fort, you'll be greeted by its imposing walls, which stretch over 38 kilometres, making it one of the largest fortifications in the world. Step through the massive gateways adorned with intricate carvings, and let the stories of centuries past unfold before your eyes.

Built during the 15th century and subsequently expanded in the 19th century, the Kumbhalgarh Fort was founded by Rana Kumbha, the then ruler of Mewar in western India. It was one of the 32 forts erected during his reign, aimed at safeguarding the kingdom from external threats. 
The fort boasts seven grand gates, step-wells, approximately 360 Jain and Hindu ancient temples from different periods of history, about 700 cannon bunkers and imposing watch towers, making it a remarkable testament to the architectural prowess and strategic foresight of its builders.

As you wander through the fort, don't forget to climb to the top of the ramparts for panoramic views of the surrounding countryside. The sweeping vistas offer a glimpse into Rajasthan's eternal beauty, with undulating hills, verdant forests and azure skies stretching as far as the eye can see.

name: Abode Ahangama
intro: Abode Ahangama is the latest project from the team behind Abode Bombay, Mumbai’s first socially responsible luxury boutique hotel. Designed for the style-conscious traveller, our guests appreciate the generosity and attention to detail in everything we do.

news_article.title: Chill Out at Sri Lanka's Abode Ahangama
news_article.description: A Slice of Jungle Paradise with a Vintage Beach Vibe

postcards.name: Stay Committed to Your Fitness Journey
postcards.intro: Staying committed to your fitness routine while travelling can often feel like an uphill battle. Abode Ahangama has crafted an immersive fitness experience to ensure that health-conscious travellers can easily integrate their wellness practices into their journey. Whether you're looking for guidance on proper form or seeking inspiration for new workout routines, the team is here to assist you.
postcards.story:
At Abode Ahangama, the outdoor gym serves as a great place to offer you a dynamic range of bodyweight exercise equipment tailored to support cardiovascular fitness and overall conditioning. Here, the outdoor gym provides the perfect environment to stay active while enjoying the natural beauty of the surroundings.

If you prefer a more mindful approach to fitness, you’re offered a variety of yoga options. Join one of the recommended local studios for a group session or indulge in a personalised one-to-one yoga session in the comfort and privacy of your own room. The team here is dedicated to curating an experience that aligns with your wellness goals, connecting you with experienced instructors who can guide you on your yoga journey.

Maintaining a fitness routine while travelling can be challenging, which is why Abode Ahangama expanded its network of fitness teachers to ensure that you have access to the support and resources you need to stay true to your wellness regime. In addition to the exceptional fitness amenities, you’ll have exclusive access to the only outdoor gym in the area. Surrounded by lush greenery and breathtaking scenery, the outdoor gym provides the perfect backdrop for a rejuvenating workout experience.

If you crave adventure, Abode Ahangama is ideally situated at the heart of a surfer's paradise. With 12+ breakaway beach entries within a five km radius of the hotel, there are plenty of opportunities to catch some waves. Whether you're a beginner looking to learn the basics or a seasoned pro seeking a new challenge, the trusted local partners offer kit hire, guides and lessons to suit every skill level.

Abode Ahangama is committed to empowering you to prioritise your health and well-being, ensuring that every stay leaves you feeling refreshed, rejuvenated and inspired to conquer your fitness goals.

postcards.name: Indulge in an Unforgettable Wellness Experience
postcards.intro: Go on a transformative journey of self-discovery and well-being at Abode Ahangama, where you’re invited to embrace new skills and rethink your lifestyle with a renewed focus on wellness. The exclusive "You are the sea" packages offer you therapeutic programs rooted in holistic bodywork, designed to nurture your body, mind and soul.
postcards.story:
Indulge in a blissful massage experience that blends long integrative strokes with precise deep tissue work, allowing you to surrender to a continuous, recycling energy flow. Each session is crafted to immerse you fully in the present moment, leaving you feeling profoundly calm and deeply connected to your inner self.

At the heart of the wellness offerings lies The Spa Room, where you’ll indulge in a curated selection of the finest local and visiting therapists. Each therapist is handpicked to bring a diverse range of skills and expertise to the guests, ensuring that every treatment is tailored to meet your unique needs and preferences. Whether you seek the restorative benefits of a deep-tissue massage or the ancient healing wisdom of Ayurvedic treatments, the team here is dedicated to guiding you on a journey of profound relaxation and rejuvenation.

In today's fast-paced world, it's more important than ever to prioritise your well-being and carve out moments of peace and tranquillity amidst the chaos of daily life. Wellness is about nurturing a deeper connection to our bodies, minds and spirits, allowing us to live more fully and authentically.

By embracing a holistic approach to wellness, you can cultivate greater balance, harmony and resilience in all aspects of your life. Whether you're seeking to alleviate stress, release tension or simply take a moment to pause and recalibrate, the wellness offerings provide the perfect opportunity to slow down, breathe deeply and reconnect with yourself on a profound level.

At Abode Ahangama, you’re invited to go on a journey of self-discovery and transformation, where you can cultivate a deeper sense of well-being and vitality that extends far beyond your time with them. Come and embrace the power of wellness to elevate your life and awaken your true potential.

name: The Rohet House
intro: Established in 1969 by the Late Thakur Manvendra Singh and Late Thakurani Jayendra Kumari, The Rohet House is our family home in Jodhpur, a beloved haven amidst the bustling modernity of Rajasthan’s second largest city.

news_article.title: Be Amazed by the Opulent Offerings at The Rohet House
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay in Jodhpur, India’s Blue City

postcards.name: Explore the Blue City at Dawn
postcards.intro: While enjoying a luxury stay at The Rohet House, seize the opportunity to immerse yourself in the exciting experience of exploring the blue city of Jodhpur on early morning walks. As the sun gently rises, go on a journey through the historic streets of Brahmpuri, where you’ll find hidden treasures at every step.
postcards.story:
Commence your blue city excursion at the serene lakes tucked behind the majestic Mehrangarh Fort. Follow the meandering pathways that hug the fort's outer walls, granting you a bird's eye view of the waking city of Jodhpur. It's a thrilling sensation as you observe the city stirring to life beneath the soft morning light.

Venture into the labyrinthine streets of the old market, eventually arriving at the revered Kunj Behari temple, the cherished patron deity of Jodhpur. Arrive just in time for the morning prayer service and witness the bustling market surrounding the temple slowly awakening. Watch as shopkeepers begin their day, raising shutters and engaging in their morning rituals in preparation for the day's commerce.

After a walk, indulge your senses with Jodhpur's renowned street food breakfast delicacies. Treat yourself to refreshing lassi, crispy jalebis, savoury samosas, flavourful kachoris and spicy mirchi vadas. These time-honoured recipes have been perfected over generations, each bite offering you a taste of tradition passed down by families who have been serving them to satisfied patrons for over a century.

The blue city walk at dawn is an unparalleled experience in Jodhpur, offering a glimpse into the city's soul as it bathes in the soft shades of morning light. The distinct azure facades of the buildings create a surreal ambience, evoking a sense of wonder and calm. It's a journey that allows you to connect with the essence of Jodhpur's rich heritage, leaving a lasting mark on your travel memories.

So, when you stay at The Rohet House, don't miss the chance to go on this unforgettable exploration of the blue city at dawn. It's an experience that promises to enrich your spirit and leave you with wonderful memories to last a lifetime.

postcards.name: Say Yes to Shopping Excursions in Jodhpur
postcards.intro: When you stay at The Rohet House, you're in for a treat that goes beyond the comfort of your accommodations. Venture into the vibrant and lively streets of Jodhpur, where every step tells a story and every shop invites you with treasures waiting to be discovered.
postcards.story:
Start your adventure at Sardar Market, a bustling hub named after Maharaja Sardar Singh of Jodhpur. Here, you'll find yourself amidst a maze of lanes teeming with shops offering a variety of goods. Lose yourself in the charm of handicrafts, from intricate antiques to colourful glass bangles that catch the eye. Spice stalls waft enticing aromas, while old-fashioned scales weigh out chunks of naturally occurring salts. Don't forget to sample local delicacies and browse textiles, accessories and daily essentials that reflect the pulse of the city.

For a deeper dive into traditional wear, Nai Sarak Market and Sojati Gate Market await with their vibrant offerings of kurta-pajama sets, saris and turbans crafted from the renowned 'tie-and-dye' fabrics, known as bandhani or bandhej.

Step into Mochi Bazaar, aptly named the 'Cobbler's Market,' where ingeniously designed leather footwear, including the famed Jodhpuri jutti, awaits your perusal. Don't miss out on Tripolia Bazaar, a haven for collectors seeking unique handicrafts in brass, marble or wood, as well as exquisite jewellery and decorative accessories to adorn your home.

As you navigate these markets, immerse yourself in the sights and sounds that define Jodhpur's vibrant culture. Engage with the ever-friendly purveyors who are eager to share stories and insights about their wares. Whether you're a seasoned shopper or just beginning your exploration, each interaction offers a glimpse into the richness of Rajasthan's heritage.

While exploring these bustling markets, remember to carry cash. Should you need assistance, the hotel reception is always available to help ensure a seamless experience.

Venture out from The Rohet House and let the colourful markets of Jodhpur captivate your senses, offering an unforgettable journey into the heart of Rajasthan's bustling bazaars.

name: Neeleshwar Hermitage
intro: Welcome to Neeleshwar Hermitage, not just a stylish hotel but a transformative experience. This hidden tropical destination, set in a secluded palm grove beside the Arabian Sea in Northern Kerala, is quietly changing the understanding of what a holiday really means.

news_article.title: Experience Mindful Luxury at Neeleshwar Hermitage
news_article.description: Find Your Inner Peace in Kerala

postcards.name: Discover Wellness and Spirituality at Neeleshwar Hermitage
postcards.intro: For a holiday that combines the best of relaxation and wellness, Neeleshwar Hermitage is ideal for you. The emphasis here is on wholeness and guiding you in rejuvenating your body, mind and soul. It also focuses on helping you carry those principles forward. With yoga and meditation, your stay here will help you feel rested and refreshed.
postcards.story:
All treatments here begin with a complimentary consultation with the in-house Ayurvedic doctor, Dr. Dilna, who has worked at some of the best Ayurvedic hospitals in India. There are over 20 ayurvedic programmes, both general and localised, for you to choose from, as well as some Western spa treatments, should you wish to pamper yourself. 

Along with your treatments, if necessary, Dr. Dilna will advise you on the most ideal food menu for your stay without taking away from the pleasures of all the delicious food on offer at the resort's two restaurants, Annapurna and Meenakshi. 

In collaboration with the Sahayadri Foundation, Neeleshwar Hermitage practices traditional Ayurvedic treatments and uses 100 percent organic herbal medicine. Great care is taken to ensure that the sourcing of ayurvedic herbs from the Sahayadri Mountains is done ethically.

The Priya Ayurvedic Spa at Neeleshwar is calm and meditative. Five spacious treatment rooms are arranged around a central courtyard garden, and you will hear the sound of birds and waves. The mild fragrance of ayurvedic oils and herbs is all-pervasive, and you are encouraged to focus on healing your body and easing your mind.

The yoga programmes at the Hermitage have everything from yoga for beginners to advanced one-on-one sessions. Classes are held at the Patanjali Yoga Hall next to the beach. Dr. Saranya Pullur is an in-house consultant yoga and naturopathy doctor. She is the backbone of naturopathy and yogic sciences at Neeleshwar. She emphasises the importance of yoga and meditation for the maintenance of physical and mental health. Every morning, she holds a complimentary yoga class for beginners. Private classes with Dr. Pullur are available throughout the day, but do book in advance. Dr. Saranya also teaches two types of yoga meditation: Ashtanga meditation and Pranic Energy meditation.

postcards.name: Embrace the Natural Beauty of the Malabar Villages
postcards.intro: In Kerala, connecting with nature and the locals is like meeting two old friends after a long time. There are many ways to embrace the natural beauty of the land and explore village life during your stay at the property. These include village trips and plantation nature walks, to see how the locals have always lived in harmony with nature.
postcards.story:
Venture into the heart of a typical Hindu village during an engaging and immersive three-hour village trip, where you will see farm activities that are an integral part of Kerala life. Witness the collection of delicious saltwater mussels from the backwaters, watch the farmers during their work as they plant crops and vegetables in the fields using traditional methods and observe the agility with which villagers harvest area nuts from towering palm trees. 

The village visit also includes the chance to watch a puja ritual at the local temples. And you can top all this off with a ferry ride on the river while you savour some fresh and invigorating toddy. It may not be something you are used to, but get adventurous and give it a try if you wish.

The Plantation Nature Walk is a half-day experience that will take you to the lush green hills of Kundamkuzhi, located an hour’s drive northeast of The Hermitage. The hills welcome you with open arms, offering solace and adventure in equal measure. Wear sturdy walking shoes, and always carry a sun hat and an umbrella. 

This excursion takes you through rubber and areca palm plantations that dot the hillside. Pepper vines grow on tall trees, and the area is rich in wild species of many plants and fruits like water apples, chillies, coriander, papaya and lemongrass. During the walk, you will get to visit deep, man-made caves that have been cut into the hillsides as drinking water conduits. During the monsoons, natural waterfalls dot the hillsides. The area is also rich in birdlife and is a stopover point for both migratory and resident birds, including the buff-breasted sandpiper, pectoral sandpiper, bristled grassbird and grey-necked bunting.

name: Nepali Ghar
intro: The great lake of Kathmandu Valley transformed herself into a beautiful land against the backdrop of the magnificent Himalayas after the mountains cleaved to drain-off water to the last drop. This great event occurred about 2000 years ago.

news_article.title: Connect with Nepali Culture and Hospitality at Nepali Ghar
news_article.description: Your Home Away from Home in Nepal

postcards.name: Visit the Boudhanath Stupa for a Spiritual Experience
postcards.intro: When you stay at Nepali Ghar and venture to Boudhanath Stupa, just a stone's throw away from the revered site of Pashupatinath, you're in for an enriching experience. As you approach the stupa, its grandeur moves you. Built with a style akin to Swayambhunath, it stands as a larger pilgrimage site, drawing travellers and faithful alike.
postcards.story:
Stepping into this sacred space of the Boudhanath Stupa, you're surrounded by a bustling array of restaurants and monasteries, each offering a glimpse into the vibrant culture intertwined with the spiritual aura of the stupa. It's not just a monument but a living, breathing symbol of devotion and reverence.

The history whispers through its very stones. Dating back to around AD 600, the first stupa at Boudhanath emerged during the era of King Songtsen Gampo's embrace of Buddhism. And as you take in its graceful contours and immaculate design, you'll find no equal in Nepal. From the pristine white dome to the gilded tower adorned with the watchful eyes of the Buddha, every element is mindfully crafted, exuding a sense of perfect harmony.

Joining the Tibetan pilgrims in their rhythmic koras, circumambulating the stupa in the morning and evening, envelops you in a calm atmosphere, steeped in devotion and tradition. It's a timeless ritual that connects you to something greater, something beyond the tangible.

But it's not just the physical beauty that mesmerises; it's the profound symbolism embedded within its architecture. The layers of meaning unfold as you contemplate each element: the plinth representing earth, the dome symbolising water, the tower embodying fire, the spire evoking air and the umbrella atop signifying the void, transcending space itself. And in the 13 levels of the spire, you glimpse the stages of enlightenment, the journey towards nirvana laid bare before you.

Visiting Boudhanath Stupa is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the richness of Buddhist philosophy and tradition, to witness firsthand the simplicity of enlightenment's path. So when you find yourself at Nepali Ghar, don't miss the chance to explore this iconic landmark, for in its sacred embrace, you'll discover a deeper understanding of yourself and the world around you.

postcards.name: Go for a Heritage Walk around the Patan Durbar Square
postcards.intro: Visit the Patan Durbar Square when you stay at Nepali Ghar. It’s a place where you'll step into the beating heart of Lalitpur, a city known for its history and artistry. This UNESCO World Heritage Site was once the majestic palace of the Patan kings and today it’s a symbol of the rich cultural legacy of the Malla Dynasty.
postcards.story:
As you wander through the Patan Durbar Square, you'll be mesmerised by the elegant fusion of palace buildings, artistic courtyards and majestic pagoda temples, all showcasing the pinnacle of Newari architecture. Take your time to explore the museum housed within the renovated Keshav Narayan Chowk, where bronze artifacts tell stories of ancient craftsmanship.

Marvel at the intricate carvings adorning the three-tiered Krishna Mandir, each telling tales from the Mahabharata. Pause to admire the sculptures of the elephant god Ganesh at the Vishwanath Temple and bask in the golden glow of the Bhimsen Temple's balcony. And don't miss the beautiful Sundari Chowk, where delicate woodwork adorns every corner.

Step inside the Royal Palace, an ancient complex with three main courtyards brimming with temples and shrines. Sit on the temple steps, letting the sounds of religious music and sacred chants wash over you, connecting you to centuries of devotion and tradition.

Throughout the square, you'll feel the pulse of life, especially during religious festivals and celebrations. Join in the vibrant festivities of the Teej festival, where women clad in red sing and dance to honour Lord Shiva and Parvati. Witness the reverence of the Buddha Jayanti festival at Krishna Mandir in May, commemorating the birth of Siddhartha Buddha.

As you explore the ancient streets and vibrant squares of Patan Durbar Square, you'll be immersed in a world where past and present integrate effortlessly.

Accessible on foot from all corners of the city, Patan Durbar Square invites you to discover the valley's finest craftsmen, guardians of ancient metalworking techniques. So when you stay at Nepali Ghar, don't miss the chance to explore this charming centre of culture and heritage, where every corner reflects craftsmanship and devotion.

name: Explora Atacama
intro: The Atacama Desert stretches from the rugged Pacific coast of northern Chile to the steep Andean slopes of southwestern Bolivia. Famous for its aridity, Atacama is proof of how life can flourish even in the harshest of conditions.

news_article.title: Stay in the Rugged Desert at Explora Atacama
news_article.description: A Boutique Property on the Pacific Coast of Northern Chile

postcards.name: Delve into the Adventure of Horse Riding to Solor
postcards.intro: Horse riding to Solor is about plunging into the heart of Chile's landscapes and immersing yourself in thrilling adventures. When you stay at Explora Atacama, your journey isn't just about relaxation. So saddle up and go on a journey unlike any other.
postcards.story:
As you mount your trusty steed, excitement courses through you. The anticipation of exploring the rugged terrain of Chile's Atacama Desert fills your veins. The wind whispers tales of ancient civilisations as you set off towards the ayllu in Solor, nestled to the south of San Pedro.

As you traverse the landscape, you'll be greeted by the sight of typical desert constructions, crafted from adobe with straw roofs. These humble abodes signify human resilience in the face of harsh desert conditions. Crossing over a small irrigation canal, you'll witness the ingenuity of those who have called this arid land home for generations.

But the real thrill lies in the ride itself. Your horse's hooves pound against the earth, creating a rhythmic melody that echoes through the desert. With each stride, you feel a sense of freedom wash over you as if you were born to ride across these vast expanses.

As you delve deeper into the landscape, you'll encounter one of the oasis's most developed farming areas. Here, amidst the seemingly inhospitable desert, life flourishes, sustained by the precious waters that flow from hidden sources. 

And just when you think the adventure couldn't get any better, you'll arrive at the mythical Librería del Desierto. This oasis of knowledge amidst barren landscape offers a glimpse into the cultural richness of the Atacama Desert, with books and artifacts that tell stories of past generations.

But perhaps the most exhilarating part of the journey is the sense of discovery that accompanies every step. With each turn of trail, you uncover new wonders, from the geometric expanse of the Atacama salt flat to the vibrant shades of the desert flora.

Let the thrill of the ride and the beauty of the Atacama Desert ignite your sense of wonder and leave you craving for more.

postcards.name: Learn about Andean Astronomy
postcards.intro: Imagine yourself under the vast expanse of one of the world's clearest skies, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of the Atacama Desert. When you stay at Explora Atacama, you have the opportunity to delve into the mysteries of the cosmos through Astronomia Andina, an immersive experience in Andean astronomy that will leave you awestruck.
postcards.story:
As night descends over the Atacama Desert, the sky transforms into a space of infinite wonder, adorned with the shimmering powder of the Milky Way, known as the Celestial River in these parts. 

Here, your journey begins with a briefing under the open sky, where basic concepts of astronomy come to life against the backdrop of twinkling stars. Guided by expert astronomers, you'll learn about orientation, distances and the richness of local culture.

But the real magic happens when you step into Explora's own observatory, equipped with state-of-the-art telescopes that unlock the secrets of the universe. Here, you'll witness stellar objects in the solar system and beyond, from the majestic planets of our own celestial neighbourhood to the distant galaxies that dot the far reaches of space.

As you gaze through the lens of a telescope, you'll be transported to worlds beyond imagination, where moons orbit gas giants and star clusters twinkle in the darkness. Each observation is a revelation, a glimpse into the vastness of the cosmos and our place within it.

Here, you're an active participant in the exploration of the night sky. With each question you ask and each constellation you identify, you deepen your understanding of the universe and forge a connection with the wonders above.

But it's not just about the science; it's about appreciating the beauty of the night sky. As you stand beneath a canopy of stars, surrounded by the silence of the desert, you'll feel a sense of wonder wash over you. 

So don't miss your chance to experience Astronomia Andina during your stay at Explora Atacama. Reserve your session at the lodge reception upon check-in and prepare to be amazed by the beauty of the cosmos unfolding before your eyes.

name: M.V. Rudra Singha
intro: India is blessed with many bountiful rivers, but Assam's Brahmaputra river is undoubtedly the mightiest of them all. Presenting a variety of cultural and wildlife delights along its course, like tracking rhinos and tigers at Kaziranga National Park, and discovering the dancing monks of the neo-Vaishnavite sect at Majuli, there's plenty to enthral travellers of all ages on our cruises.

news_article.title: Step Aboard Your Houseboat on M.V. Rudra Singha
news_article.description: A Luxury Cruise on the Brahmaputra River

postcards.name: Watch the Majestic Rhinoceros at Kaziranga National Park
postcards.intro: As you plan your cruise at MV Rudra Singha, visit the Kaziranga National Park, a gem renowned for its diverse ecosystem. Spread across elephant-grass meadows, swampy lagoons and dense forests, it's a sanctuary for various species, including the iconic Indian one-horned rhinoceros.
postcards.story:
Imagine yourself going on a jeep safari from the comfort of MV Rudra Singha, your base for exploration. As you traverse the Kaziranga National Park's terrain, you'll encounter not only the majestic rhinoceros but also elephants, wild water buffalo and swamp deer. Kaziranga boasts the world's largest population of Indian rhinoceros, offering you a rare opportunity to witness these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.

While exploring the park's elephant grass and dense forests, keep your eyes peeled for other fascinating inhabitants. Spot the agile hoolock gibbon swinging through the trees, the elusive tiger stealthily prowling and the leopard blending into its surroundings. Be prepared for unexpected encounters with the Indian elephant, the playful sloth bear and the formidable wild water buffalo.

Guided by experienced experts, your safari becomes an educational journey, deepening your understanding of the park's intricate ecosystem. From the smallest insects to the largest mammals, each creature plays a vital role in maintaining the ecological equilibrium of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.


As you navigate through the park's varied landscapes, each turn of the trail unveils a new spectacle. Capture the beauty of the scenery and the serenity of nature with your camera, preserving these moments for a lifetime.

The highlight of your safari awaits as you come face to face with the Indian one-horned rhinoceros. Witnessing these gentle giants grazing peacefully, you'll feel a profound connection to the wilderness.

As your safari draws to a close and you return to MV Rudra Singha, you carry with you not just memories, but reverence for the beauty and diversity of Kaziranga National Park. Inspired by your journey, you'll leave with a deeper commitment to conservation and a desire to protect these precious habitats for future generations to enjoy.

postcards.name: Pray at the Umananda Temple on Peacock Island
postcards.intro: Umananda Temple stands as a symbol of the rich religious heritage of Guwahati, situated amidst the flowing waters of the Brahmaputra River. Dedicated to Lord Shiva and his consort Parvati, this temple holds significance for devotees, drawing crowds, especially during the auspicious festival of Shivratri. The tranquil surroundings of the island provide a peaceful environment for spiritual reflection and devotion.
postcards.story:
On a four-day river cruise aboard MV Rudra Singha, include a visit to the Umananda Temple on Peacock Island. On the first day of your cruise, you'll start your journey from Uzanbazar Ghat in Guwahati. As you set sail towards Peacock Island, one of the world's smallest inhabited river islands, anticipation builds for the cultural and natural wonders awaiting you.

As you step foot on Peacock Island, you'll encounter not only the spiritual realm of the temple but also the vibrant biodiversity of the region. Keep your eyes peeled for the golden langurs, a rare primate species found exclusively in the Assam forests bordering Bhutan. Their playful antics add to the enchantment of the island, offering you a glimpse into the unique wildlife of the area.

Exploring the temple grounds, you'll marvel at the intricate rock-cut figures adorning the walls, showcasing the craftsmanship of Assamese artisans. From depictions of Hindu deities like Surya, Shiva, Ganesha and Devi to sculptures portraying Lord Vishnu and his ten incarnations, each carving tells a story of devotion and artistic mastery. Climb the steep steps to reach the main shrine, where the aura of sanctity envelops you in reverence.
As you immerse yourself in the spiritual ambience of Umananda Temple, you'll also appreciate the journey to reach this sacred site. While your river cruise offers a unique and convenient way to access Peacock Island, the knowledge that ferries and motor launches from Umananda Ghat are the only alternative routes adds a sense of exclusivity to your experience.

Visiting Umananda Temple during your stay at MV Rudra Singha promises not just a cultural excursion but also a deeper connection to the spiritual and natural heritage of Assam. Soak in the serenity of the Brahmaputra river and enjoy the peaceful environment surrounding you.

name: Explora Rapa Nui
intro: Rapa Nui may be a small island stranded in the infinite Pacific Ocean, but it can certainly be assured that never has a single place baffled the world as much as this one.

news_article.title: Delve into the Wonders of Easter Island at Explora Rapa Nui
news_article.description: A Luxury Stay Surrounded by the Infinite Pacific Ocean

postcards.name: Start Your Overland Exploration at Cook’s Bay
postcards.intro: When you come for a stay at Explora Rapa Nui, going on an overland exploration of Cook's Bay promises to unveil the rich culture and history of Rapa Nui. Set out on a half-day journey that combines ease of travel with immersive discovery, offering you a glimpse into the island's interesting heritage.
postcards.story:
Your overland adventure and exploration of Cook’s Bay begins as you board a van, ready to traverse the rugged terrain of Rapa Nui. Sit back and relax as you're transported to the Hanga Kioe archaeological site, home to the ancient Ahu Akapu, located along the west coast near the town of Hanga Roa. Here, amidst the whispers of the past, you'll feel a connection to the island's indigenous inhabitants and their enduring legacy.
