Continuing your journey, the van winds its way to the anthropological museum, inviting you to delve deeper into the island's past. Step inside and explore the exhibits that shed light on Rapa Nui's unique cultural heritage, offering you insight into the traditions, rituals and beliefs that have shaped its identity.

From the museum, your exploration takes on a more intimate pace as you set off on foot along the scenic coastline. As you walk, you'll pass by the Tahai archaeological complex, where ancient stone structures stand as silent witnesses to centuries of history. Take your time to soak in the atmosphere, imagining the lives of those who once called this place home.

As you make your way toward the village cove, each step brings you closer to the heart of Rapa Nui's cultural landscape. Along the way, you'll encounter other interesting historical sites, each offering a glimpse into the island's past and the resilience of its people.

And looming in the distance, the majestic presence of Rano Kau serves as a constant reminder of the island's volcanic origins, its silent vigil watching over the enigmatic beauty of Rapa Nui. With each stop along the way, you'll uncover layers of history and culture, weaving together the threads of Rapa Nui's past and present.

postcards.name: Hike Along the Coastal Path to Poike
postcards.intro: Going on a hike to Poike offers you an exhilarating opportunity to immerse yourself in Easter Island's rugged beauty and rich history. Setting out from Mahatua, located in the Poike peninsula, your journey begins with a challenging ascent up a cliff to reach the trachyte or white rock domes that dot the landscape.
postcards.story:
As you hike along the coastline, you'll be greeted by sweeping views and dramatic panoramas, a reflection of the harsh conditions that have shaped this terrain over centuries. Along the way, you'll encounter archaeological remains that offer glimpses into the island's ancient past, including the remarkable sight of the only trachyte moai standing sentinel against the elements.

Continuing your trek, you'll make your way to Tongariki, where the inspiring sight of 15 moai standing in silent vigil awaits. Here, amidst the calm landscape, you'll feel a deep connection to the island's indigenous inhabitants.

Throughout your hike, you'll be accompanied by the soothing sounds of nature and the invigorating sensation of the fresh island air, offering a welcome respite from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. With each step, you'll feel a sense of accomplishment and empowerment, as you push your limits and embrace the challenges of the trail.

But the rewards of hiking at Poike extend beyond physical exertion. As you traverse the rugged terrain, you'll gain a much-needed appreciation for the island's ecological predicaments, witnessing firsthand how the landscape is eroded by the relentless forces of sea and water. In doing so, you'll come to understand the importance of conservation efforts in preserving Rapa Nui's delicate ecosystem for future generations.

Upon completing your full-day exploration, you'll return to the comfort of Explora Rapa Nui by van, where you can unwind and reflect on the unforgettable experiences of the day. 

Hiking offers you a sense of freedom and adventure, fostering a deeper connection with the environment and providing a refreshing escape from the everyday routine. Whether you're an avid hiker or simply seeking adventure in the great outdoors, a hike at Poike surely promises to be a transformative journey.

name: Tambopata Research Center
intro: Explore the heart of the Tambopata National Reserve and actively participate in the conservation of its forests through citizen science on this Amazon ecolodge in Peru.

news_article.title: Discover Unparalleled Biodiversity at the Tambopata Research Center
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay in the Tambopata National Reserve in Peru

postcards.name: Explore the Adventures of Amazon Bird-Watching
postcards.intro: Be a part of an unforgettable journey into the heart of the Amazon Rainforest with Tambopata Research Center, where every turn of the trail displays a new wonder of avian life. Located deep within the lush canopy, this retreat offers a place for both novice and seasoned birdwatchers alike, boasting over 600 species waiting to be discovered.
postcards.story:
If you’re a beginner eager to dip your toes into the world of birding, the introductory activity at the Tambopata Research Center provides the perfect gateway. Led by expert guides, you'll learn the fundamentals of bird-watching, from mastering binoculars to identifying the distinctive calls of major bird families. As you traverse the diverse landscapes of Tambopata, you'll quickly find yourself entranced by the diversity of winged creatures flitting among the foliage.

If you’re seeking a deeper dive into the realm of avifauna, the moderate excursions offer a more immersive experience. With knowledgeable guides at your side, you'll hone your skills in distinguishing between habitats and species, unlocking the secrets of bird behaviour along the way. Each sighting becomes a lesson in ecology, revealing the intricate relationships that bind birds to their environment.

For hardcore enthusiasts hungry for rare sightings and adrenaline-fueled pursuits, the intensive birding sessions promise an unparalleled thrill. Guided by seasoned professionals, you'll venture into the heart of the wilderness in search of elusive species that elude the casual observer. With Tambopata's protected status preserving its rich biodiversity, every moment spent scanning the treetops brings the possibility of a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.

Whether you're tracing the arc of a soaring raptor or marveling at the iridescent plumage of a tropical gem, each birding experience at Tambopata Research Center is a reflection of the wonders of the natural world. From the misty dawn chorus to the twilight serenade, the rainforest teems with life at every hour, inviting you to join in this adventure. So hold your binoculars, lace up your boots and prepare to be awed by the diverse marvels of Amazonian bird-watching. At Tambopata Research Center, every feathered friend tells a story. Are you ready to hear it?

postcards.name: Go for the Rainforest Master Hike
postcards.intro: As the first rays of dawn filter through the rainforest canopy, you lace up your boots and set out on an exhilarating adventure: the Rainforest Master Hike. Guided by seasoned experts intimately acquainted with every twist and turn of the jungle trails, you're poised to go on a six-hour odyssey through one of the world's most biodiverse ecosystems.
postcards.story:
Traversing the labyrinthine pathways of the rainforest, you'll witness nature's beauty unfolding before your eyes. From the industrious leaf-cutter ants carving out their highways to the melodious calls of elusive birds echoing through the foliage, each step brings you closer to the heart of the wilderness.

Led by knowledgeable guides, whose years of local experience have honed their keen eyes to detect even the most cryptic of creatures, you'll delve deep into the hidden realms of the jungle. With their expert guidance, you'll marvel at the intricate patterns of life woven into the fabric of the forest, from the smallest fluttering butterfly to the majestic canopy-dwelling primates.

The Rainforest Master Hike isn't just a physical journey but a voyage of discovery that offers you unparalleled access to the wonders of wildlife. As you traverse diverse ecosystems, from lush new-growth islands to tranquil palm swamps, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the web of life that sustains the Amazon Rainforest.

But beyond the thrill of encountering rare and endangered species in their natural habitat, hiking through the rainforest offers a profound sense of rejuvenation for the soul. The rhythmic pulse of your footsteps melds with the chorus of the forest, washing away the stresses of modern life and reconnecting you with the primal rhythms of nature.

With each breath of fresh, oxygen-rich air and each glimpse of vibrant flora and fauna, you'll feel a sense of wonder that can only be found in the embrace of the wild. So, grab your sense of adventure and step into a journey that offers unforgettable wildlife encounters and a deep connection with nature. Are you geared up for the adventure ahead?

postcards.name: Learn About the Tambopata Macaw Project
postcards.intro: At the Tambopata Research Center, you have a unique opportunity to learn about the Tambopata Macaw Project. This project, which began in 1998, focuses on the conservation of macaws in the Tambopata National Reserve and the Bahuaja Sonene National Park. It’s time to celebrate the conscious traveller in you!
postcards.story:
Macaws are iconic species of the Amazon, known for their vibrant colours and significant ecological role. 

These birds nest in naturally formed cavities in the largest trees of the forest, making them particularly vulnerable to habitat loss and other environmental threats. 

The Tambopata Macaw Project aims to mitigate these threats and promote the conservation of several macaw species, including the scarlet macaw, the red-and-green macaw and the blue-and-yellow macaw.

The project was initiated by Eduardo Nycander between 1989 and 2000. Nycander's work laid the foundation for understanding macaw behaviour and their reproductive needs. 

Building on this knowledge, the current phase of the project aims to enhance the design of artificial nests. These improvements are crucial for reducing parasite proliferation, preventing chick predation and extending the lifespan of the nests, which also helps reduce maintenance costs.

When you stay at the Tambopata Research Center, you can participate in this important conservation effort. You’ll have the chance to see the artificial nests and learn about the ongoing research to improve them. 

The researchers will explain how these nests are designed to mimic natural cavities and the challenges they face in ensuring the macaws’ safety and reproductive success.

Your visit to the Tambopata Research Center not only deepens your understanding of macaw conservation but also makes you a more responsible traveller. 

You’ll gain insights into the delicate balance of the Amazon ecosystem and the role that macaws play in it. 

This hands-on experience allows you to appreciate the complexity of conservation work and the dedication required to protect these magnificent birds.

The Tambopata Macaw Project reflects the power of focused conservation efforts and the impact that they can have on preserving biodiversity. 

By learning about this project, you contribute to the broader goal of protecting the Amazon rainforest and its inhabitants.

name: Brij Pola
intro: Billions of years of rock formations have contributed to preserving the flora and fauna of Jawai. This small village named after the river Jawai, is becoming an exploration hot-spot among adventure seekers, families and friends across various age-groups.

news_article.title: Become One With Nature at Brij Pola
news_article.description: A Stay at One of the Best Wildlife Resorts in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Engage in Immersive Local Village Activities
postcards.intro: At Brij Pola, you're not just a visitor – you're welcomed into the heart of the local community. It's a place where the wisdom of past generations meets the vibrant rhythms of everyday life. The village experiences are crafted to immerse you in the richness of local culture, offering a glimpse into the traditions and culture that define this place.
postcards.story:
Engaging in village activities offers you an unparalleled opportunity to delve into the essence of a place. Actively being a part of these activities helps you connect with the local people on a personal level. From cooking local dishes to observing age-old practices, you gain insight into the rhythm of life in the community. 

Here, amidst the rustic charm of thatched roofs and open courtyards, you'll enjoy a meal unlike any other. Fresh, local produce forms the cornerstone of every dish, lovingly prepared and served with a generosity that knows no bounds. As you dine under the open sky, surrounded by the laughter and chatter of your hosts, you'll feel a sense of kinship that transcends language and culture.

But the village experience doesn't end with just a meal. It's an invitation to participate, to engage with age-old customs and practices that still thrive in this corner of the world. Take, for instance, the traditional art of milk churning and cow milking. If you're inclined, you can join in the process, learning firsthand the time-honored techniques passed down through generations.

Beyond its culinary delights, this experience is also a window into the soul of the community. As you work alongside your hosts, you'll have the opportunity to ask questions, to learn about the area's history, traditions and wildlife. It's a chance to connect, to forge bonds that transcend the boundaries of time and place.
So, when you find yourself at Brij Pola in Jawai, don't miss the chance to immerse yourself in the rhythms of village life. Let the warmth of hospitality and the richness of tradition envelop you, leaving you with memories that will last a lifetime. After all, it's not just about what you see and taste – it's about the connections you make along the way.

postcards.name: Make your Evening Special With a Sunset Safari
postcards.intro: When you stay at Brij Pola in Jawai, there's a timeless ritual waiting for you: the sunset safari. As the day wanes and the nocturnal world begins to stir, you'll find yourself going on a journey unlike any other. Are you ready to enjoy the countless shades of dusk?
postcards.story:
Picture the cool evening air whispering through the forest as you venture out with the seasoned naturalists at Brij Pola. Their keen eyes and attuned ears pick up on the subtle cues of nature's orchestra – the hushed rustle of leaves, the distant calls of unseen creatures. It's a melody of anticipation, leading you deeper into the wilderness.

And then, as the sun starts its descent, painting the sky in shades of crimson and gold, you’ll find your perch. Here, amidst the rugged beauty of Jawai, you’re offered a moment of respite. Tea, coffee, homemade snacks – simple comforts to complement the grandeur unfolding before you.

The sunset safari is more than just the beauty of nature's brushstrokes across the sky. It's the sense of connection, of being a part of something larger than yourself. As the sun dips below the horizon, casting its warm glow over the landscape, you're reminded of the fleeting beauty of life. In this moment of quiet reflection, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the wild, you find a sense of peace unlike any other.

That's why a sunset safari is a must-do activity at Brij Pola. It's an experience that touches the soul, leaving a lasting mark on your memory. Whether you're an avid nature enthusiast or simply seeking a moment of tranquillity amidst the chaos of everyday life, the sunset safari offers something to everyone.

So, when you find yourself at Brij Pola in Jawai, don't miss the chance to go on this timeless adventure. Let the beauty of the setting sun illuminate your path, guiding you toward a deeper appreciation of the world around you. After all, some moments are simply too precious to be missed.

name: Casa Baronesa Waterfront Villa
intro: Experience a level of peace, tranquility, and privacy that is only available on such an idyllic island. The Casa Baronesa Waterfront Villa, is the ultimate island getaway.

news_article.title: Enjoy Vast Beach and Ocean Views at Casa Baronesa Waterfront Villa
news_article.description: A Luxury Villa in the Pristine Galapagos Islands

postcards.name: Get Ready for the Stand Up Paddle Expedition
postcards.intro: When you choose Casa Baronesa as your Galapagos retreat, get ready for an unparalleled adventure on the water with the exclusive stand up paddle (SUP) expedition. As a stand up paddleboarder, you'll glide atop the ocean's surface, propelled by your own paddle and enjoy an experience unlike any other.
postcards.story:
Join a thrilling stand up paddle expedition, immersing yourself in the heart of adventure and discovery. Glide atop crystal-clear waters, your paddle carving through the waves as you navigate exclusive routes around the Galapagos Islands. With every stroke of the paddle, you’ll feel closer to the wonders of the Galapagos Islands.

Dive into vibrant underwater realms, snorkeling amidst schools of tropical fish and graceful rays. Each stroke of your paddle propels you further into the natural wonders of this marine sanctuary. With every moment filled with excitement, this SUP journey promises an unforgettable experience of immersive exploration and pure exhilaration.

Led by highly rated SUP naturalist guides, your journey with Neotropic Expeditions combines the thrill of SUP with immersive sea and land excursions, all while focusing on the inspiring natural history and evolution of the Galapagos Islands. Picture yourself paddling alongside penguins, sea lions, marine iguanas, sea turtles and even sharks, as you explore the pristine waters surrounding three different islands and numerous islets in this marine sanctuary.

But the adventure doesn't stop there. Dive beneath the waves and snorkel at multiple sites, where you'll encounter hundreds of rays and tropical fish in their vibrant underwater habitats. You’ll enjoy the thrill of paddling with quality SUP boards, ensuring stability and ease as you navigate the archipelago's stunning coastline. And after a day of adventure, retreat to your hotel, where comfort and relaxation await, ensuring you're ready for another day of exploration.

With Neotropic Expeditions, you can rest assured that every aspect of your journey is expertly curated, ensuring your safety and enjoyment throughout your SUP experience. With a commitment to sustainability, seventy percent of your vacation investment stays in the islands, supporting the local economy and preserving this unique ecosystem for future generations to enjoy.

postcards.name: Enjoy Ecuador’s Finest Hiking Adventures
postcards.intro: Picture yourself traversing some of Ecuador's finest hiking trails, each one a reflection of the country's unparalleled beauty and diversity. As you lace up your boots and set out on your expedition, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of wonder, where towering mountains give way to lush valleys and dense forests teem with life.
postcards.story:
Go on an unforgettable journey through the breathtaking landscapes of Ecuador, where every step unveils a new wonder and every trail calls you with the promise of adventure. At Casa Baronesa, your gateway to Ecuadorian adventures, prepare to be captivated by the beauty of nature and the richness of cultural heritage that awaits.

With Neotropic Expeditions as your trusted guide, you'll venture off the beaten path to discover hidden gems that most travellers only dream of. From the verdant paramo to the mystical cloud forests, every step brings you closer to the heart of Ecuador's natural beauty. Along the way, keep your eyes peeled for a mesmerising array of native wildlife, from colourful birds to elusive jungle creatures, as they go about their daily rituals in their natural habitats.

But the allure of Ecuador extends beyond its breathtaking landscapes. Prepare to be enchanted by the warmth and hospitality of the Kichwa Indians, as you delve into their rich cultural heritage during immersive community visits. Here, amidst the rhythms of traditional music and the aroma of freshly prepared cuisine, you'll gain insight into a way of life that has endured for centuries.

After a day of exploration, retreat to the comforts of Casa Baronesa, where rustic charm meets modern luxury. Relax and rejuvenate your weary muscles in the mineral-rich waters of the Papallacta hot springs or simply unwind in the tranquil ambience of your colonial hacienda or eco-lodge.

At Casa Baronesa, every moment is an opportunity for discovery and every experience is a beautiful indication of the wonders of Ecuador. So why wait? Go on an epic adventure unlike any other and let the magic of Ecuador unfold before your very eyes. With Neotropic Expeditions as your guide, the journey promises to be nothing short of extraordinary.

name: Killa Bhawan
intro: Killa Bhawan has simple but refined charm that suits its remote, romantic Arabian Night setting in the desert town of Jaisalmer. Discretely nested in three bastions of the Fort walls, converted into a spectacular hotel where taste and refinement soften the impressive military past felt in every of its stones.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Luxury Stay at Killa Bhawan
news_article.description: Unveiling the Charms of Jaisalmer, Rajasthan

postcards.name: Enjoy a Memorable Stay at 12th-Century Jaisalmer Fort
postcards.intro:
If you are visiting Jaisalmer and looking for a culturally immersive stay, then Hotel Killa
Bhawan is the go-to option. Come and experience what it means to stay inside a living fort, where every corner echoes with the tales of history, and each moment is a seamless fusion of Rajasthani charm and modernity.
postcards.story:
Imagine waking up to the magical hues of sunrise, surrounded by centuries-old walls that echo the tales of gracious history and valour. A stay inside the Jaisalmer Fort is truly a unique opportunity to experience the allure of bygone eras and Rajasthan’s rich cultural tapestry firsthand.

Located within the ancient walls of the majestic Jaisalmer Fort, Hotel Killa Bhawan (one of the city’s best B&B options) offers all that and more! With just eight rooms on offer, the property has an intimate and personal feel. Each room is unique due to the age and character of the fort—think latticework, winding doorways, delicate stone filigree Jharokhas and embroidered furnishings.

Killa Bhawan Heritage Family Room is the ideal choice if you are travelling with friends or
family. Nestled in the private section, these rooms come with a private lobby and terrace on the first floor. The Deluxe Heritage Rooms, on the other hand, are located at the top-end section and offer the best views of the surrounding locale. All of the accommodations are tastefully done, keeping in mind the traditional and cultural aesthetics of the region.

Apart from a picturesque setting and laid-back vibe, Hotel Killa Bhawan promises unmatched
hospitality to ensure a comfortable and memorable stay. The dedicated staff are at your
disposal to assist you with travel arrangements, sightseeing recommendations or simply share the stories behind the ancient walls—guiding you through the living history of the fort.

postcards.name: An Exhilarating Jeep Safari Through the Ancient Settlements
postcards.intro: Immerse yourself in the charm of Jaisalmer, where the rustic terrain of the countryside awaits your exploration through an invigorating jeep safari. Unveil the secrets of this golden city as you traverse its winding paths, encountering ancient settlements, architectural marvels and the warm hospitality of the locals, creating memories that will linger long after the desert winds have settled.
postcards.story:
Whether you’re a seeker of adventure, a connoisseur of culture or someone simply looking to unwind, Jaisalmer offers an array of activities to keep you engaged and enthralled throughout your visit. Explore the rustic terrain of the countryside and untamed landscape with a thrilling jeep safari.

Drive through the silent ruins of Kuldhara that serve as a poignant reminder of a bygone era
when it thrived as a vibrant community. The village, known for its fair share of legends and
myths, is said to be haunted. A walk through these deserted settlements will make you feel like you have stepped into a time capsule, where the echoes of the past resonate with a haunting beauty.

Built during the 16th and 17th centuries, Bara Bagh is a royal burial ground of the erstwhile
rulers of Jaisalmer. You will spot several cenotaphs crafted from sandstone and adorned with delicate stone latticework and filigree patterns that showcase the architectural prowess of the craftsmen. As you explore further, you will come across the Amar Sagar Lake, which was once the chief water source for the city. Amidst the captivating desert scenery, the serene oasis offers a calm ambience. As the sun begins to descend, the ethereal glow of the cenotaphs transforms Bara Bagh into a spectacle of unrivalled beauty. The golden hues of the sunset create a captivating ambience, making it an ideal spot for photographers and nature lovers alike.

The charm of Kuri unfolds as you continue your journey through the rugged terrain. A camel ride through the age-old streets becomes a magical experience, allowing you to relish the rustic beauty of the exotic location at your own pace. As the day concludes, the Jeep Safari leaves you with a sense of awe and enchantment.

name: Glenburn Tea Estate
intro: Started by a Scottish tea company in 1859, Glenburn then passed into the hands of one of India’s pioneering tea planting families – The Prakashes, One of India's pioneering tea-planting families, we have, over the years, come to be known as the “Chaiwala family“ - which literally means “tea planters“.

news_article.title: Visit the Glenburn Tea Estate
news_article.description: A Soulful Himalayan Retreat in Kolkata

postcards.name: Tea Trails, Flavours and Craftsmanship at Glenburn
postcards.intro: As you enter the vast Glenburn Tea Estate, a simple visit to the Tea Factory pulls you into the heartland of the beverage’s secrets and offers a newfound appreciation for every sip you’ll subsequently savour. Here, the tea leaves' journey from the lush fields to your cup is demystified, then, the tea-tasting session grabs one by the senses.
postcards.story:
Pick your hike intensity from moderate to tough for a one-and-half to three-hour trail and kick start the experience with and audio-visual presentation on the history of Glenburn. 

Start your adventure with a walk to unearth the meticulous processes of withering, rolling, fermenting, drying, and sorting the fragrant and delicate tea leaves. Then once seated, take your time to learn to distinguish the whites from the oolongs and the greens from blacks by their aroma, flavour, and appearance, and the knowledge that they change with the seasons and processing methods. 

Beyond the factory, whether walking or driving through the verdant expanses or interacting with the tea pickers adds a human touch to the experience, as they demonstrate the delicate art of plucking "two leaves and a bud." These interactions are not just educational; they're a bridge connecting you to the lives of those who nurture these fields.

The tour is interspersed with moments of relaxation and delight. A mid-way break for refreshments amidst the fields, catching crabs, or picking watercress by the springs makes for a delightful interlude. Lunch at No. 10 Bamboo Grove or the Coffee Bari offers a chance to unwind by the River Rung Dung, as it silently meanders in the near distance. Additionally, for high-spirited visitors, Glenburn offers the option to extend this trail into a walk to The Glenburn Campsite, which goes through the Simbong Tea Division.

This immersive experience, set against the backdrop of stunning landscapes and rich cultural interactions, isn't just about tea; it's about connecting with the soul of a place where every leaf has a tale to tell. So soak into the landscape, before you revel in the abode that awaits.

postcards.name: Nature’s Symphony at Glenburn Tea Estate
postcards.intro: Nestled in the Himalayan embrace, Glenburn reveals the vibrant wonders of the mountain ecosystem. Delicately perched on the hill, the mansion leaves no stone unturned to offer you a cherished vacation. From tea-time chatter, and tasting experiences to wholesome nature walks and engaging fishing sessions—its canvas of offerings is an embodiment of quiet luxury.
postcards.story:
Our strongest recommendation would be to head to the River Rangeet, a snow-fed and perennial water body that stretches 60 feet wide, on a bright sunny day with side sandwiches, vibrant juices or floral teas. While you may stumble across cold, crystal-clear waters devoid of bankside vegetation, trust the fierce rapids and deep pools to offer a big score of fresh bounty.

The perennial river is home to Rainbow Trout, Brown Trout, and the majestic Golden Mahseer, along with Snow Trout, Goonch, and Carp (locally known as Katli). The best fishing period extends from October to May along a four to six-kilometre stretch of the river, with Mahseer fishing being particularly prolific in April, May, and early June.

Though seasonality is key, a riff with the estate’s guides promises an enriching experience with lessons about both wet and dry fly fishing techniques being effective for the Trout, while Mahseer fishing may require wet fly and spinning tackle. If you are a seasoned angler, expect a colourful chat and a very peaceful morning. Regardless, once geared up, your day is bound to be filled with excitement in nature.

In addition to fishing, Glenburn is also a huge sanctuary for birdwatching and butterfly observation. Satiate your birder’s curiosity by scanning the estate for a multitude of birds like the Red Junglefowl, Yellow-Rumped Honeyguide, and the Indian Peafowl, and butterflies such as the Crimson Rose and Paris Peacock, and chance at your luck to even recognise a few bird calls.

Glenburg is in the heart of nature. Whether casting a line in the shimmering waters of the Rangeet or observing the delicate dance of butterflies, each moment at Glenburn echoes the serene, enriching, and diverse offerings of this Himalayan haven.

name: Chapslee
intro: Built in 1830, Chapslee was purchased in 1938 by the Hon’ble Raja Charanjit Singh of Kapurthala as his summer residence. His grandson, the late Kanwar Ratanjit Singh, popularly known as Reggie, opened it as a small exclusive hotel in 1976. With Reggie’s passing, his wife Pronoti now carries on this legacy and so “The Chapslee Experience” lives on.

news_article.title: Share in the Royal Legacy of Reggie’s Own Chapslee
news_article.description: A Luxury Boutique Stay in Himachal Pradesh, India

postcards.name: Enjoy Distinctive Cuisines in the Ancestral Shimla Mansion
postcards.intro: When you head to Chapslee, one of the oldest heritage royal summer residences in Shimla, leave calorie counting by the wayside. For here, it is not one but three delicious cuisines that vie for your attention.
postcards.story:
At Chapslee you will not only discover that the late Honourable Raja Charanjit Singh of the House of Kapurthala was a connoisseur of fine dining. You’ll find he was beyond particular about the cuisines that graced his tables. The family’s culinary secrets followed the right chain of command, so he made sure his guests took home a piece of his gastronomic legacy with each morsel. You will too.
 

The kitchens of Chapslee, where his grandson, the late Kanwar Ratanjit Singh, popularly known as Reggie, was born and grew up, were a confluence of Royal Indian, Continental and Anglo-Indian cuisine.
You will discover that the delectable royal dishes on your dining table carry influences of the royal flavours of Kapurthala, Patiala, Awadh and Bhawalpur. Enjoy your royal meal as everything from aloo bukhara gosht, pasanda kebab, aam ka pulao and badami murgh to bharwa lauki, followed by delectable desserts like lahsun ki kheer and kaddu ka halwa, teases your tastebuds. Royal meals are served on heritage silverware here.
 
For the royals, getting chefs to replicate Continental dishes to a T in their kitchens was quite the thing. So, even today, you will find fritters, eggs Florentine, roast mutton/chicken, shepherd's pie, fish meuniere, cannelloni, lemon meringue pie and many other specialities that burst with flavour at Chapslee.
 
One among the few heritage properties to promote and preserve Anglo-Indian food, Chapslee has an Anglo Indian menu that includes mulligatawny soup, glace chops, panteras, beckti moilee, pish pash and bread and butter pudding, here.
 
If the weather permits, don’t forget to ask to be seated outdoors for a meal. It is truly the icing on the Chapslee cake.

postcards.name: Unearth a Luxury Antique Extravaganza in Shimla
postcards.intro: If you are a lover of antiques and imperial collectibles, the Chapslee royal summer residence in Shimla is an out-and-out museum of living history. Even if you aren’t so inclined, the sheer magnificence of the collections in the home is sure to leave you spellbound and pique your interest.
postcards.story:
Built in 1830, Chapslee was bought by the late Raja Charanjit Singh of the illustrious Kapurthala kings in 1938 as a summer home. As with all the Kapurthala rajas, he too was connoisseur of fine legacy antiques and a collector of repute. Take a walk around, and you will see that the Raja was also a keen chronicler of family history. He took personal interest in guaranteeing that every room In Chapslee was a carefully curated visual and historical treat. 

His grandson, the late Kanwar Ratanjit ‘Reggie’ Singh, took great pains to ensure that the grandeur of the mansion and its vintage and antique pieces were maintained year after year. Reggie’s wife,  Kanwar Rani Pronoti Singh, the ever gracious hostess of Chapslee continues to carry the royal Chapslee experience forward, on her elegant shoulders.
 
Under one roof, from the hall to the glazed room, you will find elegant artefacts that transport you to a different era. Gilded cabinetry and lush velvet drapery from the Doge’s palace in Vienna; intricately crafted heritage Japanese porcelain; Royal Doulton figurines from England; an original etching from the East India Company era (1838), which contains the core structure of the mansion; arresting oil canvas portraits of the family; Flemish and French tapestries; a Murano chandelier; a service set for the Dutch East India Company; and an Italian Renaissance chair, to name a few.  You’ll also find signed photographs, personal collectibles, and artefacts owned by the family.
 
Every wall of Chapslee holds stories of its place in history – The Simla Manifesto of 1938 and the Declaration of the War against Afghanistan were signed here.

A  true treat for your senses, would be to uncover each space of the mansion, one room at a time.

name: Kanha Jungle Lodge
intro: The history of Kanha Jungle Lodge is closely intertwined with the contemporary tiger conservation movement in India dating back to the 1960s when Shri Kailash Sankhala raised an alarm about the shocking scale of tiger hunting that was driving this great cat to extinction.

news_article.title: Visit the Kanha Jungle Lodge
news_article.description: A Rich Legacy of Four Generations

postcards.name: Learn about Animal Conservation at Kanha Jungle Lodge
postcards.intro: As a fourth-generation conservationist, young Jaisal Singh Bhati carries the weight of a powerful and motivational legacy on his shoulders. It is a responsibility this teenage wildlife prodigy takes very seriously as he educates guests at Kanha Jungle Lodge and his followers on social media about the role we play in maintaining a symbiotic and respectful relationship with wildlife.
postcards.story:
Jai has been exploring the jungle tracks of the Kanha forests since he was just one year old. If you spot him with a camera around his neck, leading the way on nature walks and giving valuable insights on the ‘creepy crawlies’, you’ll soon find out where it all comes from. His parents, Tarun and Dimple Bhati, who own and run Kanha Jungle Lodge, paved the way for Jai to pursue his passions and his love for everything related to nature. Tarun is his mentor and a highly knowledgeable naturalist. Jay and Dimple are working on a book about the insects of the jungles, which they hope will be out soon.

As one of the most popular wildlife experts of his age and among the youngest in the world, Jai has given a TEDx talk; appeared in programmes on wildlife; and was also featured in the Discovery Channel documentary Tiger Land, which showcased how four generations of the Sankhala family contributed to tiger preservation.

The Sankhala family has had a long relationship with conservation and tiger preservation. Jai’s great-grandfather, the late Kailash Sankhala, is hailed as the Tiger Man of India. He was one of the first founding directors of Project Tiger. 

Kailash’s younger son Pradeep founded the Tiger Trust, which, along with conservation, also took on poaching in a big way. Conservationist Amit Sankhala, Kailash’s grandson, continues the work of the Tiger Trust, handling the challenges of habitat loss, nature tourism and tiger-human conflict. 

The focus on the family properties in Kanha and Bandhavgarh is also to empower the local communities and promote responsible, sustainable tourism. Something Jai is committed to and believes in wholeheartedly.

postcards.name: Meet the Locals at the Heart of Kanha Jungle Lodge
postcards.intro: The smiling faces, endless warmth and folded hands that greet you at Kanha Jungle Lodge are a sincere welcome to the forest, by the people of the forest. Their connection with the Kanha forests and its wildlife which they revere, goes back hundreds of years, and you will see this in their everyday lives and philosophy.
postcards.story:
Many of the tribal people trace their roots to the indigenous Gond and Baiga tribes, who used to live together with wildlife in Kanha National Park, which is situated in the Mandla and Balaghat districts of Madhya Pradesh.

The Sankhala family has for generations worked to promote the preservation of the tiger and its habitat and to reduce human-wildlife conflict. They have worked tirelessly to help the locals and the tribals of the region with job opportunities and chances to promote their skills and showcase their culture.

The local population makes up almost 95 per cent of the employees at the lodges owned by the family. They have been trained in hospitality and are encouraged to help empower their tribal brethren as well. You will find that a huge part of the workforce is made up of tribal women, whose talents are seen everywhere, from the kitchen to housekeeping to the vegetable farms and even the herb garden.

The Bhati family is close to the tribals and has overseen their welfare for decades now. They also support local education and related community initiatives. If you are looking for a village excursion to try a local meal or a trip to the village markets near Mukki or Kisli Gate of Kanha, speak to some of the staff at the lodge for their recommendations. You will gain valuable insights on Gond art, bamboo artefacts, fabrics and metalware from them.

The locals are also at the heart of conservation efforts in the lodge and in the forest area. You will see that most safaris have a local guide, naturalist or tracker, as their deep knowledge of the Kanha forest and its flora and fauna is invaluable.

name: Discovery Houseboat
intro:
Discovery, the Malabar escapes houseboat
offers the ultimate cruise in the fabled backwaters of Kerala.The traditional hull of a rice barge is blended with contemporary tropical architecture, creating the space for an air-conditioned suite. All discovery cruises operate from purity at lake Vembanad.

news_article.title: Stay Aboard the Discovery Houseboat on Lake Vembanad
news_article.description: Your Exclusive Floating Kettuvallam

postcards.name: A World-Class Houseboat All to Yourself
postcards.intro: The Discovery Houseboat is your personal floating hotel suite for a stress-free and exclusive water journey. The all-inclusive houseboat has a captain who will guide you on the waters, a full crew to help make your stay comfortable and relaxed, and a personal on-board chef to pamper you as you cruise along the waterways.
postcards.story:
Discovering Lake Vembanad’s best-kept secrets on shore and the waters, with the luxury of having a world-class houseboat entirely to yourself, makes your journey more intimate, as this is a private charter. That means you have the freedom and flexibility to make your own plans and create a vacation that fits you and your loved ones. Your time for relaxation and rejuvenation will also be at your convenience, and you can choose how to plan your day based on what your requirements are.


Not only will you get quality time and peace and quiet, but you will also be able to enjoy the comforts on board to the fullest without sharing common areas with other guests. The Discovery has just one spacious bedroom suite, which connects to a living room and dining space. If required, the living area can be converted into a twin-bed space. 

The rooms are luxurious and elegantly furnished with modern amenities and thoughtful touches, like a spacious wardrobe with matching bathrobes, a petal-decorated bed and fresh coconut water on arrival.

The upper deck offers panoramic views of the lake, canals and backwaters, and you can enjoy a yoga class, an aperitif on the deck or a meal under the night sky.

One of the best parts of having a houseboat all to yourself is that you can personalise all your meals with the chef. You can also choose your meal times and customise your menu, whether you are looking for gluten-free options or food that is low in spice.
 
The Discovery welcomes children of all ages on this special sailing experience. Life jackets are available for all passengers and crew on board. It is truly the most unique cruising getaway that you can have on the Kerala Coast.

postcards.name: Make the Most of Your Shoreside Experiences
postcards.intro: The many shades of Kerala’s awe-inspiring beauty are best explored at a leisurely pace. But if you would like to get the most out of your holiday, it's always good to customise your journey. The Discovery houseboat on Lake Vembanad offers tailor-made and fine-tuned cruise options, which will allow you to experience the best of the Vembanad wetlands.
postcards.story:
From day cruises to cruises of three nights, The Discovery Houseboat will take you on journeys that include historic temples, palaces, paddy fields, islands rich in flora and fauna, ancestral homes and local villages. You will also get to experience the best of local culture, traditions, food, religion and village life when you step onshore. Your crew on board The Discovery will guide you at every step, and as most of them are locals, you will hear wonderful tales about Lake Vembanad as well. This is an exclusive houseboat experience, so you set the pace and agenda.
 
The houseboat sets sail at Purity Resort, which is owned by Malabar Escapes, and returns to Purity after your journey. Purity is a picturesque lakefront resort in Alleppy and overlooks Lake Vembanad at its widest point. The closest airport to the resort is Cochin, and the nearest train station is at Ernakulum.
 
As you enjoy delicious local and international cuisine prepared just for you by your private chef, in the comfort of your lounge or on the spacious upper deck, your senses will be overwhelmed by what nature has to offer you. Besides spectacular sunsets, at Lake Vembanad you will see rare species of resident and migratory birds,  rich marine life and various species of plants. 
 
Your shore experiences will include a guided visit around the Ambalapuzha Shree Krishna Swamy Temple and a trip to Mannar, which is Kerala’s historic centre of bronze casting and is famous for its urulis, cookware, traditional crafts and elephant wall hangings.
You will also get to see the murals and wood crafts of Krishnapuram Palace. 

For an authentic culinary experience, a small country boat will take you through narrow canals to an old ancestral home, where you will be served a traditional lunch on a banana leaf.

name: Bagh Villas
intro: Bagh Villas is a boutique jungle camp located on the periphery of Kanha Tiger Reserve. Tucked away in the heart of Central India’s mystical forests, the Bagh Villas experience seamlessly connects its guests with the jungle. With our primary objective being wildlife conservation and sustainable tourism, all our curated experiences & practices focus on leaving zero - minimal carbon footprint.

news_article.title: Visit a Boutique Jungle Camp at Bagh Villas
news_article.description: An Eco-Camp Surrounded by the Kanha Tiger Reserve in India

postcards.name: Make Your Dining Experience Memorable at Bagh Villas
postcards.intro: Picture yourself dining in adorned settings that exude warmth and sophistication. Whether you're seated indoors, basking in the soft glow of ambient lighting, or outdoors, surrounded by natural beauty, every aspect is orchestrated to elevate your dining experience. As you peruse the menu, you'll sense the creativity woven into each dish. Are you prepared to taste the exquisite flavours?
postcards.story:
At Bagh Villas, the culinary ambience is designed to immerse you in a delightful world of flavours and aesthetics. As you step into the dining spaces, you'll find an inviting atmosphere that complements the carefully curated menu. Bagh Villas has crafted a menu that blends regional culinary treasures with contemporary international dishes. Here, you'll enjoy a diverse range of Thai, Mediterranean, Italian, Chinese and Indonesian cuisines. The goal is to offer you a memorable dining experience, focusing on taste and ambience, all while minimising the carbon footprint.

They take pride in sourcing ingredients responsibly. Most of the produce comes from their organic garden or from local farmers who embrace sustainable, traditional farming methods. Seasonal vegetables and fruits are cultivated without synthetic chemicals, pesticides or insecticides, ensuring a healthier and tastier outcome. The delightful flavour of natural and organic vegetables is truly appealing if you appreciate the authentic taste of wholesome, unadulterated food.

Head Chef Sandeep brings his expertise to recreate local favourites, while Lia, the health and nutrition expert, guides the selection of non-Indian offerings. The menu is flexible enough to accommodate personalisations for you with specific preferences, allergies or spice tolerances. 

By choosing organic and locally sourced options, we not only contribute to your well-being but also support the local economy. Their commitment to mindful luxury extends beyond the dining table; it's a reflection of their values in promoting sustainability and fostering a connection with the surrounding community.

At Bagh Villas, you’re invited to savour the rich flavours and aromas of thoughtfully prepared dishes while knowing that every bite comes with a commitment to mindful and responsible dining. Here, your culinary journey becomes a shared celebration of sustainable practices and a genuine connection to the local environment.

postcards.name: Enjoy an Immersive Birdwatching Experience Around Camp
postcards.intro: The excitement of birdwatching lies not only in spotting a diversity of birds but also in their behaviours – the graceful flight of a hawk, the comical antics of a sparrow or the delicate balance of a hummingbird hovering near a flower. Each bird tells a story, and by observing them, you become a part of their narrative too.
postcards.story:
Imagine yourself in a serene natural setting, surrounded by the gentle rustle of leaves and the distant hum of the wind. Bagh Villas believes in the rejuvenating power of connecting with nature and encourages you to engage in outdoor activities, including birdwatching. This activity offers unique joy as you observe the avian wonders, appreciating their colours, feathers, calls and behaviours. It's an addictive and rewarding experience that you can enjoy from the comfort of a recliner, by the pool or on a leisurely walk around the property.

As you patiently wait and observe, you become attuned to the subtle symphony of nature. The sudden burst of wings, the melodious chirps and the rhythmic hopping of birds create a mesmerising tableau. You’ll feel thrilled to spot a new species or identify familiar ones in their natural habitat.

Whether you're watching winter visitors, year-round residents or summer arrivals, the diverse birdlife adds to the serene ambience. Don't worry, you’ll be assisted by naturalists in spotting and identifying these beautiful creatures. For a deeper dive into birdwatching, these naturalists can lead you on trails to the forest fringe and nearby lakes, sharing interesting trivia about birds and their behaviours. You can also borrow the resort’s binoculars and field guides.

Birdwatching is seamlessly integrated into the Safari drives too, where over 300 bird species, including the Indian white-eye, grey francolin and oriental scops owl, have been observed in the Kanha Tiger Reserve. Embracing this mindful activity allows you to appreciate the natural beauty surrounding Bagh Villas and adds beautiful memories to your experience.

This birdwatching experience teaches you patience, mindfulness and the art of being present in the moment. In a world that often rushes by, bird watching offers you a chance to slow down and appreciate the beauty that surrounds you.

name: The LUNGMĀR Remote Camp
intro: The LUNGMĀR -red valley in Ladakhi - is named for the iconic landscape around us. Nestled deep in the Ladakh Range of India, beyond medieval Tibetan Buddhist Monasteries and past ancient shepherding hamlets, our spectacular location and timeless Silk Road feel strike the perfect balance between remote luxury and rugged adventure.

news_article.title: Revel in the Ultimate Adventure at The LUNGMĀR Remote Camp
news_article.description: A Leading Wilderness Camp in the Indian Himalayas

postcards.name: Enjoy Dining and Mingling at Sumdo Sarai
postcards.intro: Sumdo Sarai is a central dining and lounge space that will captivate you with its ambience. Tailored for mindful and adventurous travellers, this welcoming venue in the wilderness ensures a personalised and immersive experience, allowing you to forge a deep connection with the peaceful surroundings.
postcards.story:
LUNGMĀR stands out with its commitment to exclusivity and an intimate connection with the wilderness. Nestled within the mountains, Sumdo Sarai is a magnificent stone and carved wood building offering you a welcoming space. It boasts a commanding south-facing view of the mountains and features a traditional skylight. Inspired by local caravansaries and historical roadside inns along the Great Silk Road, this building serves as the central dining and lounge area known as Sumdo Sarai.

Sumdo Sarai is where you’ll gather for meals and conversations. The menu, curated by Chef Corey Ferguson from El Five in Denver, explores cuisines along the Great Silk Road, with touches of Indian and Ladakhi influences. The kitchen, led by Chef Sajan Rai and Sous Chef Gagan Rai, offers a diverse range of dishes, including pan-seared roast duck and classic fettuccini Alfredo. The restaurant accommodates various dietary preferences, such as vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and halal. Meals, often reflecting local flavours, are simple yet satisfying, contributing to a wholesome and authentic experience.

In the mornings, you can enjoy espresso and tea while having breakfast. Evenings are lively here and you can socialise with other guests over drinks after a day of snow leopard spotting. Sumdo Sarai is equipped with a small specialised library, board games and other amenities to create lasting memories.

The building also houses fascinating old maps showcasing over two centuries of exploration during the Great Game between Czarist Russia and Great Britain. These maps document High Asia's rugged terrain and remote cultures. So, if you find joy in unravelling the world through maps and absorbing inspiring information, Sumdo Sarai is undoubtedly the perfect place for you. The environment here caters to the curiosity of those who appreciate exploring the intricacies of this world.

postcards.name: Spot Rare Wildlife with the World's Best Trackers
postcards.intro: When you’re at LUNGMĀR, tracking and spotting snow leopards is a truly immersive experience. Throughout the day, trackers will help you meticulously scan your surroundings for any signs of wildlife. The rush of witnessing such a majestic creature in its habitat can be awe-inspiring, providing you with a profound connection with the wilderness.
postcards.story:
LUNGMĀR's tranquil valleys shelter an array of fascinating wildlife, including snow leopards, blue sheep, Tibetan wolves and foxes. Their team specialises in crafting unparalleled snow leopard tours, led by seasoned trackers, acclaimed conservationists and engaging guides who unravel the mysteries of the majestic mountains. Here, you’ll enjoy group wildlife tracking, guided by knowledgeable naturalists and spotters, ensuring an extraordinary and memorable stay. Indulging in this activity with these amazing trackers fosters a sense of trust and assurance.

Integral to your journey, they stand as the most sought-after trackers globally. Setting the global standard for snow leopard tours, their extensive knowledge and passion for wildlife contribute significantly to the unparalleled experience offered here. The LUNGMĀR takes pride in its world-renowned and legendary snow leopard trackers, with senior members boasting two decades of international experience in North India and Central Asia. Armed with top-tier Swarovski optics, these trackers diligently scan for wildlife and signs throughout the day. 

In the event of a snow leopard sighting, you are swiftly transported to the nearest vantage point, either by vehicle or on foot, depending on the spotter's location. The process of scanning the vast expanse for signs of wildlife creates a heightened sense of awareness, keeping you alert and in tune with the natural surroundings. This activity is bound to evoke a sense of anticipation and excitement in you.

Other spotters from various locations converge on the sighting, led by the Chief Tracker. Leveraging their collective experience, they strategise to track the snow leopard effectively while ensuring a respectful distance is maintained to minimise stress on the wildlife. Meals, coffee, tea and snacks are continually provided from the camp for the duration of the sighting, ensuring a comfortable and immersive experience for you.

name: Mary Budden Estate
intro: Bought in 1899 by Ms. Mary Budden herself, and converted into a school for local orphans, the estate lay derelict until nearly a hundred years later when Serena Chopra — a Delhi-based photographer and writer, purchased the property and turned it into her mountain home.

news_article.title: Enliven Your Senses in the Primaeval Forests of Binsar at Mary Budden Estate
news_article.description: Tranquil Cottages Surrounded by the Indian Himalayas

postcards.name: Visit Ancient Indian Temples in Jageshwar
postcards.intro: India is a land of the divine, where spirituality resides in every corner. What if you get a chance to walk down the path of tranquillity and experience spirituality amid the lush green mountains in Almora? Come and witness more than a hundred temples situated in one place that are made entirely using local stone.
postcards.story:
Uttarakhand is blessed with many pilgrimage sites and ancient wonders. When you come for a stay at the Mary Budden Estate in Binsar, don’t forget to delve into an immersive, divine experience here. Situated amidst dense Deodar forest, the ancient pilgrimage town of Jageshwar will cradle the spiritual seeker in you. The well-known temple complex is named after the presiding deity Jageshwar, which is dedicated to Lord Shiva. 

As you walk around Jageshwar, marvel at 100-plus Shiva temples made entirely using local stone. With a stream flowing within the premises, these temples are one of the most iconic temple complexes in northern India. Each masterpiece of architecture is intricately carved, showcasing the faith of the Hindu community.

There’s a lot going on here that weaves the tapestry of devotion – the ringing of temple bells, the chanting of devotees, the soothing aroma of incense and the continuous flow of water streams. Located in the scenic Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, this abode of faith and spirituality will attract you with its mesmerising scenery and beautiful forests. 

On the way to Jageshwar, you’ll notice the last vestiges of a cave with ancient rock paintings that silently share stories of creativity and ingenuity of those who once took shelter in these hills. The paintings also include handprints from the past. These pictorial depictions are simply a treasure of art, culture and history, depicting scenes of daily life and rituals of the early inhabitants of this region.

So you see, a stay in Binsar will not only offer you luxury and comfort in abundance but will also help you embark on a journey to the divine. The Kumaon mountains beckon you to unravel the mysteries of the ancient past. You never know which beautiful moments will be permanently etched in your memory.

postcards.name: Surround Yourself with the Mighty Kumaon Himalayas in Binsar
postcards.intro: Cuddled by the Kumaon Himalayas, Binsar is an enchanting place in the lap of nature. Located in the primaeval forests of Binsar, the luxurious Mary Budden Estate is an astonishing place of awakening. Remote experiences in this part of Uttarakhand will help you connect with nature and nurture you to connect with yourself.
postcards.story:
The Indian Himalayas have countless remote jewels, some of which are incredibly breathtaking. The lush green and emerald forests are forever kissed by the mist, making the surroundings fresh and serene. This place will gently pull out the nature-lover in you – the one who got lost in the busy city life. As you reach Binsar, you’ll start embracing the gifts of nature and celebrate your homecoming!

The meandering mountain roads will lead you to the Mary Budden Estate, a tranquil and undisturbed haven of luxury and comfort. Nestled in the wilderness of the Himalayas, every moment spent here will make you feel nostalgic, especially with the rustic interior and vintage appearance of the property.

Spread over five acres of land, the premises of this boutique hotel blend naturally with the surroundings, blurring the boundaries between the two. The surreal views of the valley, endless passing of clouds, cool breeze, melodious chirping of the birds and greenery all around will teleport you to a world of joy and peace. The warm, golden rays of the sun feel like you’re under a spotlight. During both dawn and dusk, the sun holds the paintbrush of its rays and paints the entire sky with shades of countless colours. 

The unspoiled beauty of this magical abode instantly connects you with untamed nature. You can even spot some of the most spectacular Himalayan peaks, including the magnificent Nanda Devi. But it’s not just the views outside that steal your heart, the vintage and antique furniture, and every wall and every corner of this property reflect timeless stories of the past. The comfortable sofa will hold you warmly in its arms, and the incredible Indian artefacts and traditional handicraft objects will capture your attention. A dreamy world indeed!

name: Bari Kothi
intro: After being locked down for half a century, ‘Bari Kothi’, 4 hours from Kolkata, located on the banks of River Ganges was magically restored, over 5 years, into the First Grand Heritage Hotel of East India led by brother-sister duo Darshan Dudhoria & Lipika Dudhoria.

news_article.title: Unwind at Bari Kothi
news_article.description: Experience Rustic Luxury in Bengal

postcards.name: Taste the Popular Sheherwali Cuisine
postcards.intro: If you're a mindful traveller with a penchant for culinary explorations, the Sheherwali community’s Sheherwali cuisine in Bengal is a hidden culinary delight waiting to be discovered. Rooted in a 300-year history, their love for food, especially the sweet variety, has evolved into a culinary legacy that beautifully blends the flavours of both the west and east of India.
postcards.story:
Bengal's culinary delights are a delightful blend of sweet and savoury. Step into any Sheherwali home and you'll find a harmonious co-existence of dishes that reflect the unique cultural melting pot that defines this community. The cuisine, a fine example of vegetarian delights, is a testament to the culinary journey this community has taken over the centuries.

In Sheherwali kitchens, traditional Bengali dishes like chhaata ka tarkari, mocha ka tarkari, kathbel chutney, muri ka laddoo, pitha, kache aam ka kheer and bore ka boondiya take center stage. Each preparation tells a story of the region, with vegetables and fruits abundantly available in Bengal.

But what sets Sheherwali cuisine apart is its ability to embrace diversity. Sharing the culinary stage are Rajasthani dishes like dal-baati-choorma, kairsangri, gatta and saunth ka laddoo. The Sheherwalis have seamlessly integrated these dishes, incorporating regional spices and green vegetables into their vegetarian palate.

While Rajasthani cuisine relies on gram flour, pulses and rich, oily preparations suited for the arid desert climate, Sheherwali cuisine takes a different route. Here, local vegetables like bottle gourd, cucumber, raw banana, ridge gourd, bitter gourd and ladyfinger make their way into the kitchen, adding a fresh and vibrant touch to the culinary offerings.

If you’re a mindful traveller, this journey into Sheherwali cuisine is not just about tasting exquisite dishes; it's a cultural exploration. It's all about savouring the rich history, appreciating the blending of diverse flavours and witnessing how a community has beautifully preserved its culinary traditions over centuries. So, as you go on your journey, let the Sheherwali kitchens inspire you to savour not just the flavours on your plate but the stories woven into every dish, making each bite a celebration of history and culture.

postcards.name: Learn About Organic Farming at Bari Kothi
postcards.intro: Experience the essence of sustainable living at Bari Kothi through their organic farming initiative. The on-site farms cultivate a diverse range of seasonal fruits and vegetables, embracing a holistic approach to agriculture. Immerse yourself in the beauty of organic farming as you witness the careful cultivation and harvesting of produce that graces your plate.
postcards.story:
Bari Kothi’s pride lies in the authenticity of the five-course Sheherwali meal they serve. Yet, the story of their ingredients and meal preparation is a tale in itself. They prioritise freshness and health by incorporating a variety of fresh fruits and vegetables. The on-site farms and gardens yield seasonal produce, ensuring a direct source for the kitchen. Here, the freshest flavours are cultivated responsibly, connecting you directly to the earth and the authentic taste of organically grown produce.

Dedicated to supporting local farmers and maintaining ecological balance, Bari Kothi extensively sources from nearby vendors. This approach not only sustains local livelihoods but also minimises the food miles and carbon footprint. Choosing to go completely local is a conscious effort towards environmental responsibility.

One unique aspect of the hospitality here is involving you, the mindful guest, in this culinary journey. Visit the farms, explore the vibrant array of vegetables and handpick your preferences. This personalised experience adds a special touch to your meal as the chosen vegetables become a part of your dining experience.

By immersing yourself in this process, you not only enjoy a fresh and healthy meal but also contribute to the sustainability of local agriculture. It's more than just a dining experience and is an opportunity to connect with the region, its farmers and the rich flavours that define the Sheherwali cuisine. 

Choosing Bari Kothi isn't just about indulging in grand meals but also about celebrating a mindful and sustainable approach to dining. It's a chance to support local communities, reduce your ecological impact and relish the genuine flavours of Bengal that come straight from the farm to your plate. Come, join this culinary journey where every bite tells a story of responsible dining and a deep connection to the local culture.

name: RAAS Devigarh
intro: Holding a commanding position with views across the valley and the village of Delwara, RAAS Devigarh showcases an array of decorative styles and tranquil landscaped gardens. Minimalist interiors are polished and comfortable, beautifully juxtaposing the ancient, ornate backdrop. Enter a world of Marwari horse murals, mirrored ante-chambers, courtyards, arches, and, come night, a thousand candles and stars.

news_article.title: Experience Boutique Luxury at RAAS Devigarh
news_article.description: A Regal Stay in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Indulge in Wellness Programs at RAAS Devigarh
postcards.intro: Amidst the natural beauty of the Aravalli hills, RAAS Devigarh's wellness experiences promise to purify, enrich and nourish you, leaving you with a stronger body and a healed mind. The aim is to integrate holistic habits into your everyday life, fostering harmony, peace and healing. Here, you'll discover a space where you can achieve harmony with yourself and your surroundings.
postcards.story:
RAAS Devigarh provides personalised health programs with expert consultants overseeing various offerings, including Yoga, Meditation, Ayurveda, healthy food options and natural treatments. Whether you choose Relaxation, De-stress, Detox, Weight Loss or Yoga retreat, you'll undergo a journey that cleanses and awakens your energies and senses.

Your experience begins with an initial consultation with a doctor to identify Dosha imbalances and body constitution. The doctor supervises wellness treatments, identifying root causes and prescribing remedies through diet, herbal medicines, routine, therapies, yoga and rituals. The focus is on balancing each individual, addressing specific concerns and promoting overall well-being. 

Achieving clarity in the soul, senses and mind are indicators of good health. At RAAS Devigarh, Ayurveda immersions offer you physical, mental and spiritual rejuvenation. Traditional Ayurvedic therapies are complemented by Yoga in a peaceful environment. The introduction of an Ayurvedic Dosha-based food menu aims to promote internal balance.

The RAAS Yoga program, complete with a Yogic diet, Kriyas, Asanas, Pranayama and meditation, empowers you to explore the subtle layers of your mind, expanding and unfolding them. It's a holistic journey towards personality development, tapping into the benefits of Yoga Sutras: experiencing deep muscular relaxation, slowing down your breath, boosting willpower and creativity, calming your mind intellectually, enhancing emotional happiness and acknowledging the innate divinity within yourself and all aspects of life.

During a RAAS Devigarh yoga retreat, you can align with your infinite self, where you elevate yourself through increased self-esteem and willpower. As your body becomes lean and light, your face radiates delight, your mind becomes clear, and your body becomes healthy, you'll recognise the purification of Nadis and the approach towards mastering Hatha yoga. It's a transformative journey that invites you to connect with your best self.

postcards.name: Relish Delicious Food at the Kothar Bar at RAAS Devigarh
postcards.intro: The Kothar Bar at RAAS Devigarh invites you to a refined yet relaxed setting, where you can indulge in the art of sophisticated leisure. With its thoughtfully designed interiors and a well-curated selection of beverages, this bar is a perfect place if you’re seeking a blend of luxury and comfort.
postcards.story:
Dining at Raas Devigarh offers you a distinctive experience, reflecting the essence of the palace. Whether you choose to relish breakfast or dinner in the restaurant, enjoy a laid-back lunch at the bars or opt for a private dining experience in your room or by the pool, you'll find a tailored culinary adventure awaiting you.

Anytime during the day, whether you're in the mood for a glass of wine on the balcony or a mid-morning chai masala in the lounge, the bar is well-equipped for all your needs. You can catch the sun setting behind the hills from the deck, creating a perfect evening atmosphere to enjoy with refreshing cocktails. Open all day and into the late evening, the Kothar Bar offers fresh coffee, hand-squeezed juices and a variety of alcoholic options. The wine list features the best of India's emerging vineyards and a thoughtfully chosen selection of international wines, including the finest champagnes for you to enjoy.

Devigarh provides a variety of local and international cuisine to cater to all tastes, set in different spaces that highlight the palace's hidden gems. Whether you prefer your meals in your room, by the pool or any part of the palace, your choices are happily accommodated here. Private dining options are available for groups of all sizes. The wellness menu offers you options to enhance your health with pure ingredients, including medicinal herbal teas.

Dedicated to authenticity, their kitchens strive to champion all things local, ensuring that every culinary experience is deeply rooted in the essence of the region. As you raise your glass, you can also enjoy the panoramic views from the bar, offering you serene views of the Aravalli hills and the surrounding landscape.

name: Qayaam Gah
intro: Set on a secluded ridge high above the calm waters of Dal Lake with a backdrop of the rugged Zabarwan Hills, Qayaam Gah Retreat is a place to slow down and tune out of the modern world immersed in peace and tranquility with superlative views of the majestic beauty of the Vale of Kashmir.

news_article.title: Making Amazing Travel Experiences With Qayaam Gah
news_article.description: Enjoy the Best Views of Nature in Kashmir

postcards.name: Experience Fine Dining at Ruh in Qayaam Gah
postcards.intro: When considering where to dine, Ruh at Qayaam Gah stands out as a compelling choice. Ruh offers you uninterrupted 360-degree views of the majestic Zabarwan Mountains and the tranquil Dal Lake below. Here, you'll find a thoughtful fusion of local and international flavours. Are you ready for a soul-stirring experience?
postcards.story:
Nestled at the core of Qayaam Gah is Ruh, the embodiment of Sufi expression for the soul. Dining at Ruh provides a laid-back setting with good food and scenic views. This multifaceted space seamlessly intertwines a restaurant, living quarters and library, blending Kashmiri design, culture and cuisine. Perched atop a stone plinth adorned with classical lamp niches, you can reach Ruh by a short walk from the infinity pool, surrounded by terraced plum and cherry orchards. 

When you arrive, indulge in the unforgettable experience of sipping the signature Kashmiri Kahwa. Imbued with the fragrance of exotic spices and the subtle touch of delicate saffron, this elixir is a must-try.

You’ll notice how the restaurant is beautifully crafted from glass, cedar and pine. Elaborate carvings featuring lotus motifs and intricate jali screens embellish the structure, while the homey interiors boast antique rugs and a mix of contemporary and traditional wooden furniture. The staff at Ruh is attentive and professional, ensuring that your dining experience is seamless and enjoyable. You can expect genuine warmth and service that enhances your overall visit. 

The wraparound panoramic windows showcase the breathtaking location, inviting you to enjoy the view from the terrace during balmy summer days or bask in the warmth of a roaring Bukhari wood-burning stove on snowy winter nights. The innovative menu at Ruh focuses on authentic local flavours and internationally inspired fusion dishes, promising to delight and excite diverse palates.

Inside, you can choose a book from Ruh's captivating library and delve into local history and Sufism while sipping a warm cup of tea. As the sun sets, you can lounge in the sunken al fresco fire pit, surrounded by an ornamental pool that reflects the ever-changing colours of the sky and the flickering candles illuminating the night.

postcards.name: Go for an Old City Walk in Kashmir
postcards.intro: Sukoon Old City Walk is an experience you shouldn’t miss when you visit Qayaam Gah. Sukoon means a sense of calm. It's a state of being where you find inner peace. The narrow alleys, ancient buildings and historical landmarks tell stories of the past, allowing you to connect with the roots of the local community in Kashmir.
postcards.story:
Sukoon Old City Walk is a beautiful exploration of the local surroundings in Kashmir. Kashmir's rich history is reflected in its diverse population, encompassing various ethnic and religious groups. Going for a local city walk in Kashmir unfolds as a genuine immersion into the stories of everyday life. Starting at Zaina Kadal Bridge, you’ll witness local architecture, with homes standing steadfast for more than a century. Traversing the aged quarters of Srinagar, you’ll wind through narrow streets, passing by structures and buildings that carry the weight of history, endeavouring to preserve their identity in a swiftly changing world.

The culmination of the walk brings you to the Zaina Kadal Market. Here, amid the hustle and bustle, your senses come alive with the sights and aromas of spices and dried fruits on display. Witness coppersmiths diligently plying their craft, transforming sheets of copper into souvenirs, each telling a story you might want to carry back with you.

After absorbing the local market atmosphere, a traditional Kashmiri lunch at a local restaurant offers you the taste of authenticity. The subsequent drive to the Shankaracharya temple marks a shift to a more serene setting. The journey takes you to the foot of a flight of stairs, and from there, the climb offers panoramic bird's-eye views of the valley from the temple precincts, a stark contrast to the earlier city walk.

Capping off the experience, a Shikara boat ride back to Sukoon provides a reflective moment, allowing the day's diverse encounters to settle in. The city walk in Kashmir becomes an authentic journey through time, space and culture, offering you a genuine connection to the heart of the region.

name: Brij Villa
intro: Brij Villa is a beautiful abode located amid peaceful surroundings in Dalhousie. Refurbished and refreshed, it is an elegant, vintage-style property, built over 150 years ago, that is perfect for honeymooners, family and leisure travellers looking for a perfect memorable getaway in the hills.

news_article.title: Enjoy Expansive Views of the Himalayas at Brij Villa
news_article.description: A Beautiful Abode in Dalhousie

postcards.name: Visit the Picturesque Town of Khajjiar
postcards.intro: The town of Khajjiar will offer you mesmerising views of nature's grandeur. Khajjiar is blessed with panoramic views that stretch as far as the eye can see, revealing lush valleys, majestic mountains and serene lakes. The air is imbued with tranquillity, creating an idyllic setting if you’re seeking respite from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
postcards.story:
Located amidst the enchanting landscapes of Himachal Pradesh, Brij Villa enjoys a strategic location that invites you to the beautiful town of Dalhousie. This picturesque destination is adorned with colonial-era masterpieces, exuding a timeless charm that tells tales of the past. Each step through the town's labyrinthine streets is a journey through history, with heritage architecture standing proudly as a testament to Dalhousie's rich past. Encounter warm smiles and hospitality as you interact with the locals, gaining insights into their way of life.

Among Dalhousie's crown jewels is the breathtaking town of Khajjiar, a destination that captures the essence of sublime beauty. Nestled amidst rolling hills and verdant meadows, Khajjiar is a sanctuary for nature lovers. Often referred to as the "Mini Switzerland of India," this enchanting locale boasts a pristine lake surrounded by cedar forests, making it a haven if you’re seeking tranquillity. 

The centrepiece of Khajjiar's charm is its pristine lake, a mirror reflecting the azure sky above and the verdant surroundings. Immerse yourself in the ethereal beauty as you stroll along the lakeside, the gentle rustle of leaves and the melody of birdsong creating a symphony of peace. Picture-perfect landscapes unfold before you, with lush green meadows extending as far as the eye can see, surrounded by towering deodar trees. The tranquillity of the place creates an inviting atmosphere, enticing you to escape into the lap of nature.

For the adventurous spirit in you, Khajjiar offers a myriad of activities. Whether it's horseback riding through the meadows or simply unwinding with a picnic by the lake, every moment is an opportunity to forge unforgettable memories. The beauty of Khajjiar invites you to immerse yourself in the serenity of nature, forging memories that stay with you long after leaving this idyllic corner of Dalhousie.

postcards.name: Indulge in a Yoga and Wellness Experience at Brij Villa
postcards.intro: At Brij Villa Dalhousie, your yoga and wellness experience is designed to rejuvenate and empower you. The serene surroundings and tailored programs ensure that you find balance and harmony during your stay. You'll discover a range of yoga sessions, carefully curated to meet your needs and enhance your well-being.
postcards.story:
Nestled in the heart of Dalhousie, Brij Villa provides a peaceful retreat for you to prioritise your well-being. The staff, warm and accommodating, ensures that your experience is seamless and tailored to your preferences. Discover the serenity of early morning yoga in the inviting garden at Brij Villa. Align your chakras amidst the natural beauty, setting the tone for a day of indulgence. Yoga mats are thoughtfully provided for your use; simply reach out to the front desk to enhance your wellness routine.

Immerse yourself in the healing traditions of the Himalayas with the Ayurvedic herbal oil preparation experience. Meet with a knowledgeable Ayurvedic expert at Brij Villa who will guide you through the fascinating science of crafting herb-infused oils tailored to your specific health needs. The Himalayan region is a treasure full of medicinal plants and this hands-on experience allows you to tap into the therapeutic benefits they offer.

Brij Villa believes in enhancing your well-being through authentic and enriching wellness experiences. These activities not only contribute to your physical health but also provide a deeper connection to the natural beauty that surrounds you. Celebrate the tranquillity, balance and rejuvenation that come with the yoga and Ayurvedic offerings, ensuring a truly enriching stay at Brij Villa.

The wellness offerings extend beyond yoga, with opportunities for meditation and mindfulness. You'll be encouraged to connect with your inner self, fostering a sense of calm and mental clarity. 

In essence, your time at Brij Villa Dalhousie is an invitation to invest in yourself. Through yoga and wellness practices, you'll find a renewed sense of vitality and balance. It's not just a yoga session but an opportunity for you to go on a journey of self-discovery and well-being.

name: BrijRama Palace
