intro: BrijRama Palace, which stands mighty on the serene banks of Darbhanga Ghat, is one of the oldest man-made structures in the city and is considered to be a top-tier luxury hotel in Varanasi. The palace is often praised for its striking architecture and design which mirrors the rich heritage and culture of the city that it calls home.

news_article.title: Bask in Heritage Beauty at BrijRama Palace, Varanasi
news_article.description: Timeless Grandeur along the Ganges

postcards.name: Dine on a River Boat and Enjoy the Views of Varanasi
postcards.intro: BrijRama Palace offers you a truly exceptional experience that sets it apart – the opportunity to dine in Varanasi while gently floating on the sacred Ganges River. These traditional boats, thoughtfully equipped with modern amenities, offer you an intimate setting to relish a regal vegetarian dinner curated by the in-house chefs.
postcards.story:
After a day of immersing yourself in the vibrant chaos of Varanasi's bustling streets, ancient temples and lively markets, unwind as you glide along the historic ghats. From the iconic Dashashwamedh Ghat to the serene Chausatti Ghat and the spiritual Assi Ghat, each step leading down to the Ganges on the west riverbank tells the story of Varanasi's rich history. BrijRama takes this experience a step further by providing private dining on traditional boats, known as Bajras, available through pre-booking.

The curated menu boasts a diverse array of mouth-watering delicacies, ensuring a culinary journey that complements the cultural immersion Varanasi is known for. To ensure your dining experience aligns seamlessly with your preferences, you can reserve your choice of mealtime before your arrival at the palace. This helps tailor the experience to your liking, ensuring that every moment on the Bajra is uniquely yours.

BrijRama Palace’s commitment is to make your stay in Varanasi truly special. Among the myriad of unique experiences offered, private dining holds a distinct place. It's a reflection of their dedication to providing personalised and memorable moments for you. Their humble efforts extend beyond providing luxurious accommodation, reaching into the realm of dining experiences to enrich your time here. The flavours of thoughtfully crafted dishes undergo a remarkable enhancement against the backdrop of the gently flowing river.

Immerse yourself in the rich culture and heritage of Varanasi and make your stay truly unforgettable. The team here will wholeheartedly serve you, ensuring that every aspect of your visit, from the historic explorations to the tranquil river dining, reflects the essence of this sacred city. Your journey is an opportunity to connect with the soul of Varanasi in a way that only BrijRama can offer.

postcards.name: Witness the Evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
postcards.intro: Experiencing the evening Ganga aarti at Varanasi's Dashashwamedh Ghat is an exceptionally enriching event. As the sun begins to set, the ghats in Varanasi come alive with the rhythmic chants and prayers. This aarti is not just a religious ceremony but a communal gathering that transcends boundaries, bringing people together in shared reverence for the sacred Ganges.
postcards.story:
A visit to Dashashwamedh Ghat is a must if you’re exploring Varanasi, immersing you in both history and spirituality. Named after a horse ritual conducted by Lord Brahma, this ancient site holds a profound significance in Hindu mythology, believed to have been created by Lord Brahma himself to welcome Lord Shiva. The ghat, considered the oldest and holiest in Varanasi, is renowned for its captivating Ganga aarti.

Every evening, as the sun sets, lose yourself in the mesmerising Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat. This sacred ritual, performed by several priests, involves bhajans and offerings to the holy Ganges, creating a captivating ambience along the riverbanks. This aarti is a daily occurrence that attracts hundreds of people from around the world. The experience becomes even more special on Tuesdays and during religious festivals, when unique aartis are conducted.

Varanasi's Ganga aarti offers you a glimpse into the spiritual essence of the city. BrijRama Palace strives to enhance your cultural journey in every way possible. They organise shared evening boat cruises, providing the perfect vantage point to witness the enchanting Ganga aarti. 

The atmosphere is charged with a palpable sense of spirituality. The aarti is a moment of connection, not just with the divine but also with the rich history and traditions of Varanasi. As the priests make offerings to the river, and the crowd joins in the collective prayers, there is a sense of unity that transcends differences.

The flickering flames from the multiple oil lamps, synchronised to the resonant prayers, create a mesmerising scene along the riverbank. This shared experience fosters a sense of community, allowing you to connect with the locals and fellow mindful travellers as you collectively absorb the beauty and spiritual energy that emanates from this age-old tradition.

name: El Chaltén
intro: With views to the Electric Valley and the Marconi Glacier, Explora in El Chaltén opened its doors on December 15, 2021.17 km away from El Chaltén –in the Argentinean Patagonia– the lodge is a headquarters from where to explore a world-renowned destination by those who love nature and trekking.

news_article.title: Explore the Renowned Beauty of Patagonia at Explora El Chaltén
news_article.description: A Luxury Hotel in Argentina

postcards.name: Go Rock Climbing in La Roca
postcards.intro: When you go on a journey to El Chaltén, nestled amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Patagonia, you're not just going on a mere vacation but also diving headfirst into a world of adventure and discovery. Among the myriad of exhilarating activities awaiting you, none quite compare to the heart-pounding thrill of rock climbing.
postcards.story:
Imagine yourself standing at the foot of majestic peaks, their sheer cliffs reaching towards the sky like ancient sentinels guarding the secrets of this untamed wilderness. With each breath of crisp mountain air, you feel a surge of excitement coursing through your veins.

Rock climbing isn't just about scaling mountains; it's about pushing your limits, conquering your fears and immersing yourself in the raw beauty of nature. Whether you're a seasoned climber seeking a new challenge or a novice eager to test your mettle against the elements, the expert guides are here to ensure that every step of your journey is both safe and unforgettable.

As you strap on your harness and chalk up your hands, you can't help but marvel at the sheer scale of the cliffs that loom before you. With each handhold and foothold carefully mapped out, you begin your ascent, feeling the adrenaline coursing through your veins with each move you make.

But rock climbing isn't just about the thrill of reaching the summit; it's also about the camaraderie forged between fellow climbers as you navigate the challenges together. With each encouraging word and supportive gesture, you feel a sense of unity and shared purpose that transcends language and culture.

And when you finally reach the summit, standing atop the world with the wind in your hair and the sun on your face, you can't help but feel a sense of accomplishment unlike any other. In that moment, surrounded by the beauty of Patagonia, you realise that rock climbing isn't just about conquering mountains — it's about conquering yourself.

When you come for a stay at Explora El Chaltén, the exhilarating world of rock climbing awaits, ready to ignite your sense of adventure and leave you craving for more.

postcards.name: Enjoy Your Road Trip to Rio Arriba
postcards.intro: When you go on a road trip from Explora El Chaltén, you're not just setting out on a journey but also going for an exploration of the raw beauty of Patagonia. Picture yourself boarding a comfortable van, anticipation bubbling within you as you set off northward towards the Laguna del Desierto Provincial Reserve, leaving the chaos of everyday life behind.
postcards.story:
As you traverse the rugged terrain of Patagonia, the landscape beautifully unfolds before you, revealing hidden treasures at every turn. Along the way, you'll pass by magnificent waterfalls, their cascading waters a reflection of the power of nature and the unique geography of the Las Vueltas River Valley. With each passing mile, you'll feel yourself drawn deeper into the heart of Patagonia, captivated by its beauty and mystique.

But the true magic of the journey lies not just in the destinations you'll visit, but in the journey itself. As you wind your way through the nothofagus rainforest, you'll feel a sense of wonderment wash over you, marvelling at the ancient trees that have stood sentinel for centuries. With each twist and turn of the road, you'll discover new sights and sounds that will leave a lasting mark on your soul.

And then, just when you think the adventure couldn't possibly get any better, you'll arrive at the Lake of the Desert lookout point. Stepping out of the van, you'll be greeted by a breathtaking panoramic view of the lake, its shimmering waters reflecting the towering mountains and majestic glaciers that surround it. In that moment, you'll feel a profound connection to the natural world, as if you've stumbled upon a hidden oasis in the midst of the wilderness.

But what makes road trips truly unforgettable isn't just the sights you'll see, but the memories you'll make along the way. Whether it's bonding with fellow travellers over shared experiences or simply taking a moment to appreciate the beauty of the world around you, every moment spent on the road is a treasure to be cherished. When you come for a stay at Explora El Chaltén, the adventure of a lifetime awaits, just beyond the horizon.

name: Bera Safari Lodge
intro: Led by Shatrunjay Pratap, a passionate photographer, leopard-lover, and devoted conservationist, our relentless efforts saved the leopards’ last refuge from mining, granting us an intimate understanding of their lives. Unveil the untamed beauty and remarkable tales of survival that await you in this idyllic leopard land.

news_article.title: Discover Bera Safari Lodge
news_article.description: Feel the Heartbeat of Leopard Country in India

postcards.name: Jawai’s Big Cats and the Shepherds Who Revere Them
postcards.intro: The land they share may well be barren, but the indelible bond between the leopards of Jawai and the Bera shepherds is an evergreen one. In this part of southwest Rajasthan, shepherds and leopards cohabit harmoniously, much to the astonishment of the world, as you will see on your wildlife experiences organised by Bera Safari Lodge.
postcards.story:
A part of the Jawai region, Bera is a small village in Pali district. The semi-nomadic Rabari shepherds and the majestic leopards have a symbiotic, almost spiritual, relationship here. The shepherds trace their ancestry to Lord Shiva, who is said to sit on leopard skin, and they revere the leopards as gifts of God.

Human-leopard conflict isn’t unheard of across India. But in Jawai, the leopards don’t feel threatened by the presence of humans from the settlements in Bera and vice versa. During your village forays from Bera Safari Lodge, a luxury boutique homestay, take time to chat with the locals. You will hear that there has not been a single incident of a leopard killing humans, or the other way around, for centuries. It’s a delicate and peaceful balance. The leopards here are known by the names given to them by the shepherds.

Shatrunjay Pratap Singh of Bera Safari Lodge is a man who wears many hats: naturalist, sommelier, wildlife conservationist and co-author of Leopards and Shepherds of Jawai. He is also called the guardian of the leopards of Jawai. Along with the support of the shepherding tribes, Singh has been instrumental in protecting the leopards from the dangers of uncontrolled mining in the region and conserving wildlife habitats.

On your immersive safaris and game drives organised by the lodge, take time to learn from the naturalists how positive wildlife-human interaction helps to balance the ecosystem. And how you can do your bit to help that balance.

postcards.name: Meet the Colourful, Semi-Nomadic Rabari Shepherds
postcards.intro: Journey into the everyday lives of the Rabari herdsmen as a part of your Bera Safari Lodge village excursions. With their intricate hand-knotted red turbans, silver jewellery and weather-beaten faces, these hardy shepherds are known for their love of music, spirituality, rich culture and harmonious coexistence with wildlife, especially the Jawai leopards.
postcards.story:
There are numerous nomadic tribes in India’s desert regions, each with its own unique and captivating attributes. It is thought that the Rabaris originally came from the plateaus of Iran, via Afghanistan, hundreds of years ago and settled in Gujarat, Punjab and Rajasthan. The word Rabari in Marwari roughly translates to ‘outsiders’.

You will hear more about their enthralling history as you share a cup of tea with them in their hand-plastered mud and twig huts. Or as you listen to the fascinating fables passed down orally from generation to generation, often in the form of folk songs. It’s the most endearing mix of hospitality and rustic charm.

While the Rabaris have inhabited the desert lands for generations, many have settled in villages and head to the grasslands to graze their cattle. You can still see them across the desert regions of western India, leading their camel caravans and herding their livestock from one settlement to another. These tough-as-nails shepherds and their families take pride in their lineage and traditions. They consider themselves custodians of the livestock and believe that their association with the leopards is a spiritual one, with the blessings of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.

The Rabari women, with their beautiful jewellery, stunning features and necks and arms adorned with tattoos, are homemakers. But they also sell exquisite handcrafted goods, including pottery, hand-embroidered garments, jewellery and shawls, in the local markets, which are a few kilometres from the Bera Safari Lodge. 

If you are lucky, you may even get to be a part of the dance and music performances at the market square. Take a shopping bag with you; buying local crafts and produce will go a long way in helping the Rabaris keep their magical traditions alive.

name: Shreyas Yoga Retreat
intro: Shreyas is recognised as one of the finest wellness retreats in the world and we are dedicated to promoting healing the body, mind and soul through authentic Ayurveda, Panchakarma, Naturopathy and spiritual tradition of yoga in a holistic manner.

news_article.title: Discover Shreyas Yoga Retreat
news_article.description: A Holistic Haven for Mind, Body and Soul

postcards.name: Explore Community Activities at Shreyas Yoga Retreat
postcards.intro: Shreyas Yoga Retreat is more than just a wellness retreat. From advocating holistic living to developing a sense of well-being among local communities, Shreyas seamlessly integrates community service into its array of offerings, ensuring a transformative experience that encompasses not just personal growth, but also a positive impact on the community.
postcards.story:
Escape the mundane city life and immerse yourself in tranquillity at Shreyas Yoga Retreat. 
This haven offers more than just a break; it provides an opportunity for self-discovery and rejuvenation through an array of activities—think yoga, meditation programs, guided city tours, trekking, cooking classes, temple and village tours, community services and even organic farming.

Apart from wellness activities, you can indulge in mindful living and learn about eco-friendly practices. Engage in hands-on experiences that foster a deeper connection with nature, such as organic farming, picking vegetables from the on-site gardens and exploring the art of healthy gourmet vegetarian cuisine with skilled chefs. As you embark on this holistic journey, you'll discover the joy of mindful living, leaving behind the stresses of urban life and embracing a more sustainable and balanced way of being.

Shreyas Yoga Retreat encourages its guests to partake in community service to foster a sense of connection and shared responsibility. You can source herbs and vegetables from Shreyas’s organic farm, chop them and help the chefs prepare a simple yet healthy meal for the local orphanage children. The retreat’s staff take the food to the children and serve them on traditionally laid-out banana leaves. 

Additionally, you can spend time with these children and the elderly members of the village school to gain a better understanding of their daily lives and the challenges they face. Many guests often find joy in giving back, aiding support to orphanage children with essentials like books, stationery items, uniforms and school bags.

Engaging in community service not only helps you connect with the local culture and make a meaningful impact during your stay, but it also offers a deeper perspective on life. Come and embrace the opportunity to enrich both your own experience and the lives of those around you.

postcards.name: Indulge in Yoga and Wellness at Shreyas Yoga Retreat
postcards.intro: Whether you are a seasoned yogi or a novice seeking a wellness escape, Shreyas Yoga Retreat offers a diverse range of yoga and meditation programs tailored to individual needs. Nestled in the tranquil surroundings of nature, the retreat provides a serene and rejuvenating atmosphere conducive to self-discovery and inner peace.
postcards.story:
Shreyas Yoga Retreat is not merely a destination but a haven for those seeking solace and rejuvenation. Nestled amidst lush greenery, the retreat’s serene ambience envelops you, instantly transporting you to a realm of tranquillity as soon as you enter the property. 

The lush gardens serve as an open-air studio, where you can practice yoga under the open sky. Seasoned instructors will guide you through a myriad of yoga practices. From the gentle stretches of Hatha yoga to the dynamic flows of Vinyasa, each session is tailored to suit practitioners of all levels, ensuring a fulfilling and enriching experience for everyone involved.

The focal point of the retreat is the meditation hall, a space where silence speaks louder than words. The air is charged with the energy of countless souls who have found solace within these walls, while the gentle aroma of incense heightens the sensory experience.

The retreat's commitment to holistic well-being extends beyond yoga and meditation. The wellness spa, with its array of rejuvenating treatments, beckons guests to indulge in massages, Ayurvedic therapies, and healing rituals. Each of the wellness programs is designed to address physical, mental and emotional health, offering a comprehensive approach.

Beyond the physical practices, Shreyas places a strong emphasis on spiritual development. Daily Satsang and philosophical discussions led by enlightened teachers provide an opportunity for introspection and the exploration of one's innermost being.

As you immerse yourself in the soul-stirring ambience of the property, the transformative power of this haven becomes evident, fostering a renewed sense of balance, mindfulness and inner peace that extends far beyond the duration of your stay. In essence, Shreyas stands not just as a destination but as a peaceful haven, where the journey within is as enriching as the lush surroundings that cradle it.

name: Bori Safari Lodge
intro: Tucked amidst the lush and rustic locale of Dhapada village, Bori Safari Lodge is a charming resort in Madhya Pradesh that offers the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Soak in the raw beauty of nature as you stay in this village lodge located near the Bori Wildlife Sanctuary, nestled amidst a 7.5-acre farmland estate.

news_article.title: Explore Bori Safari Lodge's Unique Overture of Nature and Luxury
news_article.description: A Luxury Stay in Madhya Pradesh, India

postcards.name: Experience a Luxury Retreat in the Wilderness
postcards.intro: Surrounded by lush landscapes and teeming with wildlife, Bori Safari Lodge invites you to immerse yourself in the raw beauty of the untamed wilderness. The lodge, a sanctuary of tranquillity, offers a unique blend of luxury and nature, promising an unforgettable escape into a realm where every moment is marked by the magic of the wild.
postcards.story:
Stepping into the lodge is like entering a jungle storybook, with each chapter unfolding in the arms of the surrounding wilderness. The earthy scent, the rhythmic chirping of crickets and the gentle rustle of leaves serenade you.

Bori Safari Lodge has eight accommodations on offer. Each comes with two bedrooms and contemporary ensuite bathrooms. The interiors are tastefully done, complementing the rustic ambience of the surrounding locale—think muted tones, wooden decks, local Raisen stones and rattan accents. Private patios offer panoramic views of the lush forests and each room is a window to the untapped wonders that lie just beyond.

The rooms span 525 square feet and are designed to provide comfortable accommodation for a family of three adults and one child. The suites are spacious and thoughtfully designed, incorporating fine details such as multiple plug points (a notable convenience for photographers), a king-sized bed with reading lights, an ante-room equipped with a wardrobe and luggage space and twin vanities leading to individual shower and toilet spaces. 

Guests can enjoy a tea and coffee station that offers the choice of freshly brewed coffee along with a jar of homemade cookies. With attention to both functionality and aesthetics, these accommodations provide an ideal retreat for families seeking a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

In essence, Bori Safari Lodge is more than a destination; it is an immersive retreat in the heart of nature's grandeur—a sanctuary that seamlessly blends luxury with wilderness, inviting guests to forge a profound connection with the untapped wonders that lie just beyond the room's window.

postcards.name: An Exhilarating 4X4 Game Drive in Bori Wildlife Sanctuary
postcards.intro: Embarking on a 4X4 drive in Bori is not merely a tourist excursion, it is an immersive experience where the boundaries between spectator and spectacle blur, and the wonders of the natural world unfold before your eyes. Here, the wild canvas comes alive with the vibrant hues of life, and each moment carries the potential for awe-inspiring discoveries.
postcards.story:
Setting out on a safari in Bori Wildlife Sanctuary is like stepping into a living, breathing documentary. You have the chance to witness the daily lives of the resident wildlife, observe their behaviours, and if you’re lucky, capture the elusive moments of predator-prey interactions. Imagine the thrill of spotting a Bengal tiger camouflaged in the dense undergrowth or a family of Indian gaur grazing peacefully on the grasslands.

The 4x4 game drives in Bori Wildlife Sanctuary amplify the adventure by allowing you to explore the more rugged and off-the-beaten tracks of the sanctuary. Specially designed vehicles navigate through the challenging terrain, providing a closer encounter with the wilderness. 

The thrill of catching glimpses of magnificent creatures such as leopards, sloth bears, wild dogs, giant squirrels and gaur adds an unparalleled sense of excitement to the safari. Bird enthusiasts will be delighted by the diverse avian population, adding another layer of fascination to the immersive safari experience.

The enchanting mosaic of ecosystems, from dense forests to gentle rivulets, creates an awe-inspiring tableau of nature's wonders. As the sun dips below the horizon, painting the sky in hues of orange and pink, the sanctuary transforms into a magical realm where the nocturnal creatures come to life. 

Beyond the exhilaration of encountering wildlife, safari and 4x4 game drives in Bori Wildlife Sanctuary play a crucial role in conservation and education. These experiences foster a sense of responsibility and appreciation for the delicate balance of ecosystems. Trained and knowledgeable guides accompany visitors, sharing insights into the flora, fauna and conservation efforts within the sanctuary. 

All in all, guests leave with a heightened awareness about the importance of preserving these natural habitats and the role each individual plays in ensuring their survival.

name: Lotus Houseboat
intro: Explore Northern Kerala’s palm-fringed tropical backwaters in ultimate comfort onboard the spacious and elegant Lotus houseboat; a symbol of purity and beauty.

news_article.title: Experience the Elegance of Lotus Houseboat
news_article.description: Your Luxury Home on the Water

postcards.name: Cruise Along Beautiful Backwaters in this Stylish Houseboat
postcards.intro: The magic of Kerala is incomplete without a traditional houseboat experience. As you glide along the Malabar backwaters in this home on the water, you will experience tranquility and comfort in all its forms. Step into the Lotus Houseboat in North Kerala for a journey of a lifetime and special memories.
postcards.story:
Of the many ways you can discover the backwaters of Kerala, a houseboat is one that gives you close glimpses of everything from wildlife at the waterfront and breathtaking village scenes to beautiful Kerala homes. The spacious and elegant Lotus Houseboat, which cruises on the Tejaswani River in Neeleshwar, North Kerala, is a beauty that offers both overnight and day cruises and a hospitality experience you will thoroughly enjoy.

The houseboat is 104 feet long and 18 feet wide, with two luxuriously furnished bedrooms, Lalima (beauty) and Sukhima (happiness);  luxurious ensuite bathrooms; and private sit-outs, where you can put your feet up and enjoy the cruise.

On the main deck, there is a common living area and dining area designed with your comfort and relaxation in mind. From the lobby area, you can also see your captain at the helm as he steers the houseboat on the calm waters.

There is an upper sundeck with sunbeds and provisions for dining, where you can get panoramic views of the river as you watch the sunrise or have a meal under the stars.

The exterior of the Lotus Houseboat is a traditional rice-boat style, with large sliding windows and open areas for stunning backwater views. You will see kingfishers skim across the water looking for fish, local fishermen deftly casting nets into the waters, fishmongers in small paddle boats with the day’s catch and charming temples as you pass by.

The Lotus can accommodate six guests for an overnight cruise and around 12 guests for a day cruise. A private crew looks after all your needs, and there is a personal chef who ensures that all meals are delicious and to your liking.

postcards.name: Experience Local Treasures with Onshore Adventures
postcards.intro: The Tejaswani River connects to the serene Valiyaparamba backwaters, and there is a wealth of onshore experiences for you to enjoy during your cruise on the luxurious Lotus Houseboat. Make the most of your one- or two-night trip with waterfront encounters that showcase the best of the Malabar region’s culture, tradition, heritage, wildlife and village life.
postcards.story:
From Neeleshwar Hermitage, a luxury eco-hotel that is a part of AB Chapri Retreats, take a small drive to the Lotus Point jetty to begin your cruise. Not too far from the jetty is a snake temple dedicated to the goddess Bhadrakali.

On day one, plan various shore visits along the way, including a trip to Valiyaparamba Village, which is between the backwaters and the Arabian Sea. The coir fibre from the village production unit, made from coconut husks, is used to make twine, mats and mattress stuffing. Don’t miss a visit to the small-scale Women’s Khadi Handloom Centre further down the backwaters, which has beautiful handloom fabrics on sale. 

Monkey Island, further up the bank, is a small village known for a forest inhabited by monkeys and an ancient shrine dedicated to Naga snake deities.

On day two, cruising farther south towards the Ezhi Elimala range, you disembark at Kotti jetty in Payyannur for a short auto-rickshaw ride to a temple dedicated to Lord Subramanyam, which dates from about 800 CE. This town is famous for the sacred science of astrology.

An hour's cruise farther south will take you to Sultan Thodu, a canal that was made between the Payangadi River and the Moolakkeel River in the late 18th century by Tipu Sultan, the ‘Tiger of Mysore,' to facilitate the movement of cargo hundreds of years ago. If you are adding an extra night on board to your itinerary, do plan to visit the Sri Muthappan temple dedicated to Lord Shiva in his avatar as a local tribal hunter.

There are plenty of opportunities to go cycling or for guided walks onshore when your houseboat drops anchor. Make sure you plan well ahead to get the most out of your Lotus Houseboat journey.

name: Brij Nest
intro: Welcome to Brij Nest Suites, a charming boutique hotel in the heart of Jaipur, also known as the Pink City. We take pride in showcasing and celebrating Jaipur's vibrant local culture and traditions throughout your stay with us.

news_article.title: Experience Rajasthani Hospitality at Brij Nest Suites
news_article.description: A Luxury Retreat in Jaipur

postcards.name: Visit the Magnificent Amber Fort
postcards.intro: When you visit the majestic hilltop fort of Amer in Jaipur, anticipation fills the air and you can almost sense the rich history and architectural wonders that await you. This magnificent fort stands proudly atop a hill. White marble accents add a touch of elegance, showcasing the artistic blend of Hindu and Rajput elements that characterise this iconic structure.
postcards.story:
Don't miss experiencing the majestic Amber Fort when staying at Brij Nest in Jaipur; its rich history, intricate architecture and panoramic views over Maota Lake offer you an unforgettable glimpse into the grandeur of Rajasthan's past.

As you approach the fort, you're greeted by its imposing ramparts, a reflection of its former grandeur and strategic importance. The series of gates and cobbled paths leading up to the main entrance, Suraj Pol or Sun Gate, evoke a sense of wonder, hinting at the magnificence that lies within.

Stepping through Suraj Pol, you find yourself in the first main courtyard, where armies once held victory parades, showcasing their war bounty to the delight of the royal family's womenfolk who watched from behind intricately latticed windows. The atmosphere here is palpable as if you can almost hear the echoes of past celebrations reverberating through the centuries.

Exploring further, you discover the intricate beauty of the palace complex, divided into six distinct sections, each with its own entry gate and courtyard. Everywhere you look, there are architectural marvels to behold – from intricately carved pillars to delicate jharokhas (overhanging balconies), each telling a story of the opulence of the past.

One particular attraction catches your eye – the ‘magic flower’ carved marble panel nestled at the base of a pillar in the mirror palace. As you approach, you're mesmerised by the intricate designs depicting hovering butterflies and other motifs, each revealed uniquely as you partially hide the panel with your hands. It's a reflection of the skill and craftsmanship of the artisans who once graced these halls.

From the vantage point of the fort, you gaze out over the tranquil waters of Maota Lake, its shimmering surface reflecting the beauty of the surrounding landscape.

postcards.name: Discover the Heart of Rajasthani Culture at Chokhi Dhani
postcards.intro: Go on an enchanting journey into the heart of Rajasthani culture at Chokhi Dhani, a beautiful village resort in Jaipur. Here, you'll immerse yourself in the vibrance and richness of Rajasthani traditions, where every moment promises an authentic experience that will make you fall in love with Rajasthan.
postcards.story:
As you step into Chokhi Dhani, you'll be greeted by a vibrant atmosphere pulsating with the rhythms of folk music and dance. Be mesmerised by amazing performances showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Rajasthan, from graceful Kalbeliya dancers to energetic Ghoomar dancers. Lose yourself in the infectious beats of traditional music, as skilled artisans demonstrate age-old crafts, weaving intricate patterns and creating stunning handicrafts before your eyes.

If you possess an adventurous spirit, Chokhi Dhani offers you thrilling camel rides, allowing you to traverse the rustic landscape like a true Rajasthani nomad. Feel the gentle sway of the camel's gait as you journey through the sandy terrain, soaking in the panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.

The highlight of your visit to Chokhi Dhani lies in its culinary offerings. Prepare to tantalise your taste buds with an exquisite feast of Rajasthani cuisine, a true gastronomic journey through the flavours of the desert. Indulge in a lavish spread of aromatic curries and savoury snacks like kachori and samosa, each dish carefully prepared to perfection using age-old recipes passed down through generations.

Enjoy the warmth and hospitality of Rajasthan as you dine under the starlit sky, surrounded by the rustic charm of the village setting. Engage in lively conversations with fellow travellers, sharing stories and laughter over hearty meals that celebrate the culinary traditions of the region.

As you bid farewell to Chokhi Dhani, you'll carry with you not just memories, but a deep appreciation for the Rajasthani culture. You'll leave with an understanding of the region's customs and traditions and perhaps a few recipes to recreate the magic of Rajasthan in your own kitchen.

So, whether you're seeking adventure, cultural immersion or simply a memorable dining experience, Chokhi Dhani invites you on a journey of discovery unlike any other.

name: Wayanad Wild
intro: Wayanad Wild is a holiday space located in the rain forests of Lakkidi, the gateway to Kerala’s picturesque Wayanad District. Surrounded with the sounds of the forest’s many birds and insects, as well as majestic trees, gurgling streams and magical rock formations, this resort is built to provide an exclusive travel experience in the heart of the woods.

news_article.title: Feel the Rainforest Magic at Wayanad Wild
news_article.description: Embrace Nature’s Beauty Deep in the Western Ghats in India

postcards.name: The Magical World of Kerala Spices is Open to You
postcards.intro: Food is an integral part of all memorable vacations. And when the food is organic, fresh from the farm and bursting with the deliciousness of regional flavours, you know that your culinary experience is authentic. Nestled in the Western Ghats, Wayanad Wild in north Kerala serves up the right variety of cuisine filled with local goodness.
postcards.story:
Head chef Velayudhan has been with this eco-hotel for close to three decades and is said to have quite a fan following when it comes to his food. He is happy to share his recipes and his secrets to getting the dish just right and finger-licking good. Don’t be surprised if, when you head to the local markets, you see him carefully picking ingredients for your next meal and choosing the best fish and other seafood from the harbour and riverside stalls.

Right from breakfast to dinner, the menu here offers the best of vegetarian and non-vegetarian delights, with an emphasis on wholesomeness and nutrition. The kingfish stuffed with chillies and onions is a huge favourite at the hotel. The Wayanadan Chetti Mulake is also much sought-after here, as are the delicious Payasam and varieties of Puttu. 

Kerala desserts are made with jaggery, and cakes and pastries are made keeping health-conscious eaters in mind. Everything from the pepper and cardamom to the native Paalthondi rice and vegetables is locally sourced and is part of the resort’s sustainability efforts.

Even the masalas here are freshly ground, as the chef insists on only the freshest for his kitchen and for his guests. Don’t miss the traditional Malabar tea here, made by layering fresh cloves, cardamom and ginger before adding tea leaves. It is perfect for cold, misty mornings or evenings by the campfire.

Chefs at Wayanad Wild share their skills in the evening cooking classes that are held exclusively for guests. Right from Wayanadan cooking basics to the secrets of traditional Kerala cooking, the chefs here will guide you on your gastronomic journey. There are also special cooking classes for little chefs who want to learn simple dishes and local cooking techniques.

postcards.name: Unleash Your Inner Adventurer in the Shayadris
postcards.intro: During your stay at Wayanad Wild, you will discover that there are curated adventures for all kinds of thrill-seekers and adventure lovers. Whether it’s the exhilaration of going up the misty mountain or staying up late at night to uncover the magic of a night walk, as they say in Wayanad, the forest never leaves your side.
postcards.story:
Wayanad Wild organises several nature experiences and excursions that will suit every level of adventure, from simple walks around the hotel to more advanced outdoor adventures like longer hikes and treks. It helps if you inform the team of naturalists there of what you or your family and friends have in mind. Check with team well ahead of time about the weather conditions, the duration of the trip, what to carry, what rules to follow while in the forest and the minimum age specifications for activities. 

At this biodiversity hotspot, you will encounter a rich variety of birds, mammals, amphibians and unique plants and trees, so keep your eyes open and your senses on high alert as you unleash the adventurer in you. Remember to always be respectful of the wild and to follow instructions given by your guides and naturalists.

The Silent Shayadris walk gives you an unmissable experience of the biodiversity of the Shayadri hills of the Western Ghats. As you walk through the plantations and the hill paths to reach the top with your guide, you see a view that both overwhelms and wows you.

There is so much to discover about the natural flora and fauna here. On the Woods and Whistles tour, which is a guided tour of the property, look out for rare birds, frogs, small mammals and butterflies, too. Make sure you bring a good pair of binoculars with you, and if it is the rainy season, bring an umbrella and raincoat as well.

Brace for a night-time walk into the wilderness as you discover the creatures of the forest that hide in the foliage during the day. Explore the Elusive—Night Edition is an after-hours expedition with the naturalist, where you will get a chance to see the nocturnal residents of Wayanad Wild.

name: Torres del Paine
intro: Explora in Torres del Paine was designed as the perfect haven for exploring the region’s wondrous geography and wildlife. Besides the favored location inside Torres del Paine National Park, this lodge’s architecture was planned in a way that interferes the least possible with its natural surroundings.

news_article.title: Relax and Unwind at Torres del Paine
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel in Chile

postcards.name: Go for the La Pampa Exploration Hike
postcards.intro: As you go on the exploration hike through the breathtaking landscapes of La Pampa, you'll find yourself immersed in an enchanting world of natural wonders and historical treasures. The conservation reserve unfolds before you like a magnificent canvas, adorned with rugged mountains, sweeping steppe and tranquil valleys, each offering you a glimpse into the raw beauty of Patagonia.
postcards.story:
As you traverse the trails of the hike, your senses will be captivated by the charming sights and sounds. The majestic silhouette of the Paine range looms in the distance, its peaks reaching towards the heavens in silent reverence. Cerro Obelisco stands tall against the horizon, a sentinel of ancient times, while Laguna Jara glistens like a precious jewel amidst the vast expanse of the steppe. Sierra Baguales completes the panorama, its rugged contours weaving a tale of resilience and endurance.

Amidst this breathtaking scenery, the flora of La Pampa thrives in abundance, painting the landscape with vibrant hues and delicate fragrances. The coirón sways gently in the breeze, its verdant blades whispering tales of resilience and adaptability. Matabarrosa blooms defiantly amidst the harsh terrain, a symbol of endurance in the face of adversity, while the noble ñirre stands as a reflection of the enduring spirit of Patagonia.

But it is not just the flora that enchants in La Pampa; the fauna of the region adds another layer of wonder to your journey. Guanacos roam freely across the steppe, their graceful movements echoing the rhythm of the land. Pumas, elusive and majestic, prowl in the shadows, their presence a reminder of the untamed wilderness that surrounds you. Chingues scuttle across the trail, their curious eyes betraying a playful spirit, while caranchyos soar overhead, their majestic wings casting shadows upon the earth below. And high above, condors glide on the thermals, their regal presence a symbol of freedom and grace.

In the midst of this natural splendour, traces of human history echo through the ages, telling stories of resilience and adventure. And amidst it all, the legacy of Lady Florence Dixie, the first woman explorer in Patagonia, invites you to delve deeper into the history of this remarkable region.

postcards.name: Go Horse Riding at Negra Lagoon
postcards.intro: Go on a horseriding adventure unlike any other, where every hoofbeat resonates with the rhythm of nature and every turn of the trail unveils a new marvel. At the helm of your equine companion stands Gaela Hourcq, a maestro of the equestrian world whose expertise spans continents and cultures.
postcards.story:
With Gaela's guidance, you'll set off from the stables, your trusty steed eager beneath you, ready to carry you across rivers, through forests and over the vast expanse of the pampas. As you ascend towards the lofty heights of the Negra Lagoon viewpoint, the world around you transforms completely.

Along the way, the trail meanders past pristine lagoons, their tranquil waters reflecting the boundless sky above. Keep your eyes peeled, for these oases are teeming with life, providing sanctuary to a myriad of bird species. You may catch a glimpse of the majestic queltehues, their vibrant plumage a sign of the beauty of the Patagonian wilderness. Or perhaps you'll spot the graceful magellanic geese, gliding effortlessly across the water's surface, their presence a reminder of the delicate balance of this ecosystem.

As you ride, immersed in the natural splendour that surrounds you, Gaela's wealth of knowledge and experience shines through. Her years of dedication to the care and well-being of these magnificent creatures ensure that your journey is not only exhilarating but also safe and enriching. From breeding to raising, breaking to feeding, Gaela's expertise encompasses every aspect of equine care, allowing you to relax and fully immerse yourself in the experience.

At last, you reach the pinnacle of your ride — the viewpoint overlooking the Negra Lagoon. From this vantage point, the beauty of the landscape unfolds before you in all its glory. The shimmering waters of the lagoon stretch out beneath you, framed by the verdant expanse of the surrounding pampas. 

In every direction, mountains rise majestically against the horizon, their peaks reaching towards the heavens. In this enchanted realm, where horses and humans unite in harmony, every moment is a reflection of the magic of exploration.

name: Machu Picchu Lodge
intro: Explora in the Sacred Valley of the Incas was designed as a headquarters from where to explore a remote and great destination: Cusco, Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley of the Incas.

news_article.title: Stay Connected with Nature and Culture at Machu Picchu Lodge
news_article.description: A Heartwarming Boutique Stay in Peru

postcards.name: Ride a Bicycle Through Explora’s Surroundings
postcards.intro: When you're seeking to immerse yourself fully in the rich offerings of Peru's Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu, there's perhaps no better way to do so than by going on a two-wheeled adventure through the beautiful landscapes surrounding Explora's Machu Picchu Lodge. Your journey begins with the simple act of mounting a bicycle. Are you ready for the adventure?
postcards.story:
As you pedal through the quaint village of Urquillos, every rotation of the wheels brings you closer to the beating heart of this agricultural region. Here, amidst fields lush with vibrant crops, you'll witness the timeless rhythms of rural life, where the echoes of ancient farming practices still resonate in the air.

Following the sinuous path of the Urubamba River, your journey unfolds with each bend revealing a new view of breathtaking beauty. The river, a lifeline for countless generations, winds its way through the valley, carving out a path that echoes the passage of time itself. Along this route, you'll encounter the remnants of Inca architecture, a reflection of the ingenuity and craftsmanship of those who once called this land home.

Arriving at Huayabamba, you'll find yourself enveloped in the serenity of this picturesque hamlet. Here, the pace of life slows to a gentle rhythm, inviting you to explore at your leisure. With the freedom of a self-guided tour, every path becomes a potential adventure, inviting you to wander and discover hidden treasures tucked away in every corner.

As you navigate the easy terrain, each pedal stroke brings you closer to the essence of this place. With a distance of just 10 kilometres, this half-day excursion offers you the perfect balance of exploration and relaxation. Take your time to soak in the sights and sounds of Huayabamba, allowing yourself to be fully present in this moment of peace.

Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or a novice adventurer, the beauty of Huayabamba is sure to capture your heart. So, saddle up and go on a journey of discovery, where every turn of the pedals brings you closer to the soul of Peru's Sacred Valley and the timeless wonder of Machu Picchu.

postcards.name: Experience the Culinary Delights of the Sacred Valley
postcards.intro: When you step foot into the culinary realm of Machu Picchu Lodge, you're not just indulging in a meal – you're going on a journey of discovery, guided by the visionary palate of a Peruvian chef Virgilio Martínez. Renowned worldwide for his culinary mastery, Chef Martínez has woven flavours that pay homage to the richness of Andean culture and biodiversity.
postcards.story:
With each dish mindfully crafted at Machu Picchu Lodge to showcase the essence of the Sacred Valley, you're invited to savour the magic of this ancient land with every bite. Drawing inspiration from the vibrant history and traditions of the Andean people, Chef Martínez has curated a menu that transcends mere sustenance, offering you a sensory experience that is both enlightening and enriching.

As you dine amidst the stunning natural beauty of the Sacred Valley, every ingredient tells a story – a tale of resilience, harmony with the land and the profound connection between food and culture. From the earthy aroma of freshly harvested produce to the delicate flavours of indigenous herbs and spices, each element of your meal is a reflection of the deep-rooted traditions that have shaped this region for centuries.

Whether you're enjoying a meal in the comfort of the lodge or dining al fresco during your explorations, every dish is a celebration of this wonderful land. With a commitment to sustainability and community empowerment, Chef Martínez ensures that every ingredient is sourced responsibly, with full traceability back to the local farmers who tend to the land with care and dedication.

For Chef Martínez, cooking at the foothills of the Andes Mountains is more than just a culinary endeavour – it's a profound and inspiring experience that fuels his creativity and passion. Through his innovative approach to gastronomy, he invites you to go on a sensory voyage that transcends borders and connects you to the soul of Peru.

So, as you enjoy each exquisite bite and sip, remember that you're not just dining – you're immersing yourself in a timeless tradition, a celebration of Andean culture and cuisine that will leave a lasting mark on your palate and your soul.

name: Brij Anayra
intro: Immerse yourself in a captivating blend of history, luxury, and natural beauty at Brij Anayra Dharamshala. Our resort seamlessly merges rich heritage with contemporary comforts, making for an unforgettable stay. From spacious accommodation to delectable dining options and expansive outdoor spaces, our all-suite property provides a serene retreat where you can truly appreciate the calmness of this tranquil destination.

news_article.title: Feel the Mountain Air at Brij Anayra
news_article.description: A Peaceful Stay in the Heart of Nature in Himachal Pradesh

postcards.name: Visit the Majestic Bhagsunag Waterfall
postcards.intro: Nestled amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Dharamshala, lies a magical oasis waiting to be discovered by intrepid travellers like you – the enchanting Bhagsunag Waterfall. Tucked away close to the Bhagsunath Temple, this majestic cascade stands as one of the wonders of nature, drawing visitors from far and wide to bask in its serene beauty.
postcards.story:
Going on a journey to Bhagsunag Waterfall is not merely a trek; it is an odyssey through verdant forests, offering you a respite from the chaos of everyday life. As you traverse the winding paths, surrounded by lush greenery, the melody of chirping birds and rustling leaves serenade your senses, guiding you towards the hidden gem that awaits.

Upon reaching the waterfall, a melody of sight and sound unfolds before your eyes. The crystalline waters cascade from a height of approximately 30 feet, creating a mesmerising spectacle that captivates the soul. During the monsoon season, when the rainfall is abundant, the waterfall attains its peak magnificence, casting a spell of awe and wonder upon all who behold it.

Adjacent to the cascading waters lie the sacred grounds of the Bhagsunath Temple, adding a spiritual dimension to your experience. The gentle murmur of the stream as it meanders through the temple grounds echoes the tranquillity that permeates this sacred space, inviting you to pause and reflect in its serene ambience.

If you’re seeking respite from your journey, the nearby cafes and coffee houses welcome you. Here, amidst the aroma of freshly brewed coffee and delectable delicacies, you can unwind and savour the moment, all while feasting your eyes on the breathtaking views of the Bhagsunag Waterfall.

While the allure of the waterfall invites many to its shores, adventurous souls may also choose to immerse themselves in its invigorating waters. Though the chill may prove bracing to some, the experience of bathing beneath the cascading waters is nothing short of exhilarating, leaving you refreshed and rejuvenated. As the day draws to a close, you reluctantly bid farewell to this place, carrying memories that will stay with you long after your departure.

postcards.name: Enjoy Birdwatching at the Pong Dam Wildlife Sanctuary
postcards.intro: Located just 100 kilometres away from the town of Dharamshala lies a haven for bird watchers and nature enthusiasts alike – the Pong Dam Wildlife Sanctuary. Enveloped by the serene beauty of the Shivalik hills in the Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh, this sanctuary invites you to immerse yourself in the wonders of the natural world.
postcards.story:
Staying at Brij Anayra offers you the perfect opportunity to go on a memorable journey through the Pong Dam Wildlife Sanctuary. A mere stone's throw away from this enchanting sanctuary, Brij Anayra provides a tranquil retreat amidst the beautiful landscapes of Himachal Pradesh.

As you venture into the sanctuary, guided by seasoned experts, you are greeted by avian melodies that resonate throughout the lush surroundings. With over 220 species of resident and migratory birds calling this sanctuary home, including majestic black-necked cranes and graceful bar-headed geese, every moment spent here is a reflection of the boundless beauty of nature.

At the heart of the sanctuary lies the tranquil expanse of Pong Dam Lake, a shimmering jewel amidst the verdant landscape. Formed by the construction of the Pong Dam on the Beas River, this manmade reservoir serves as a sanctuary for a myriad of avian species, making it a veritable paradise for bird enthusiasts.

The sanctuary's wetlands boast a rich biodiversity, catering to the needs of children, students, environmentalists, tourists and adventurists alike. Here, amidst the serene waters and verdant foliage, you can witness nature's splendour in its purest form, with over 420 species of birds gracing the skies above.

From the majestic jungle fowls and peafowl to the elegant waterfowl such as bar-headed geese, pintails and common pochards, the sanctuary offers you a captivating glimpse into the diverse avian world. Whether you're a seasoned bird watcher or a novice enthusiast, each encounter with these feathered inhabitants is sure to leave a lasting mark on your soul.

As the sun sets beyond the horizon, casting a golden hue upon the tranquil waters of Pong Dam Lake, you’ll bid farewell to this sanctuary with your heart filled with memories of a truly unforgettable experience.

name: Refugio Amazonas
intro:
Our Refugio Amazonas is located deep in the tropical jungle, an oasis in nature.
Refugio Amazonas is an ecolodge in the Peruvian Amazon with 32 rooms. It is located two hours from the Puerto Maldonado airport, in southeastern Peru.

news_article.title: Indulge in Rainforest Expeditions at Refugio Amazonas
news_article.description: A Nature-Lover’s Paradise in Peru

postcards.name: Look for Monkeys in the Floodplain Forest
postcards.intro: Go on an enchanting adventure through the floodplain forest near Refugio Amazonas, where the air thrums with the symphony of jungle sounds, setting the stage for an unforgettable monkey search experience. Guided by expert naturalists, you'll traverse this lush, verdant landscape, where every rustle and chirp hints at the diverse array of wildlife hidden amidst the towering trees.
postcards.story:
As you journey deeper into the heart of the rainforest, strange and unfamiliar sounds surround you — caws, screeches and purrs echoing through the canopy. With each step, anticipation builds as you eagerly await your first encounter with the elusive inhabitants of this vibrant ecosystem. Suddenly, a crashing brash, a wind-like roar pierces the air — your guide points and there it is: the majestic red howler monkey, the first of many remarkable sightings to come.

The floodplain forest, near the Tambopata Research Center Lodge, teems with life, thanks to its rich soil and towering trees that attract many monkey species. Spider monkeys swing gracefully through the canopy, while red howler monkeys announce their presence with resounding calls. Brown capuchin monkeys dart amongst the branches, their playful antics a joy to behold. But the monkey search offers you more than just primate encounters; it's a journey into the heart of biodiversity, where every turn reveals a new marvel of nature.

As you meander along the trail, you'll be captivated by the sheer diversity of wildlife that calls this forest home. From white-lipped peccary herds to colourful manakins and melodious antbirds, the floodplain forest is full of biodiversity waiting to be discovered. Keep your eyes peeled for the flash of a toucan's vibrant plumage or the elusive glimpse of a jaguar's tracks.

But perhaps the true magic of the monkey search lies in its ability to immerse you in the richness of Amazonian life. As you wander through this diverse ecosystem, you'll gain a newfound appreciation for the delicate balance between flora and fauna that sustains this pristine wilderness. And with each sighting and discovery, you'll come to understand why the floodplain forest is hailed as one of the last bastions of untouched, truly wild Amazonia.

postcards.name: Experience the Mesmerising Sunset Cruise
postcards.intro: As the Amazon jungle dips in twilight, a serene journey awaits you aboard a canoe drifting gently down the Tambopata River. The glistening sunlight bathes the landscape in a golden glow, casting enchanting patterns upon the water's surface. As the afternoon transitions into the evening, prepare to witness one of nature's most spectacular displays — the Amazonian sunset.
postcards.story:
Go on a Sunset Cruise, a tranquil voyage down the wide expanse of the Tambopata River, where hues of orange and pink dance upon the rippling waters. With each passing moment, you'll be captivated by the beauty of the setting sun, casting its radiant light upon the verdant landscape.

As you leisurely glide along the water's edge, keep a keen eye out for the shy wildlife venturing out before the onset of nightfall. From the chunky capybaras basking along the riverbank to the elegant macaws soaring gracefully overhead, every encounter offers you a glimpse into the rich biodiversity of the rainforest.

As you soak in the breathtaking views and feel the refreshing breeze upon your skin, your guide will regale you with tales of the fascinating natural and human history that has shaped this pristine ecosystem. From the intricate web of life that thrives within the rainforest to the cultural heritage of the indigenous communities that call this region home, each story adds depth and meaning to your Amazonian adventure.

From your vantage point on the Tambopata River, you'll be treated to a panoramic view of the surrounding rainforest bathed in the warm hues of sunset. Stretching as far as the eye can see, the rich lowland forest unfolds in all its splendour, while distant blue hills invite from the horizon, offering you a tantalising glimpse of the Puno Cloud Forest beyond.

As the day draws to a close, there's no better way to unwind than with the cruise — a leisurely, romantic journey that allows you to enjoy the beauty of the Amazonian landscape at your own pace. It's an experience that promises to leave a lasting mark on your heart, as you bid farewell to another day in paradise, under the spell of the Amazonian sunset.

postcards.name: Discover the Crested Eagle’s Nest
postcards.intro: At Refugio Amazonas, a Crested Eagle nest has been recently discovered, providing you with an incredible chance to observe these magnificent birds up close. This marks the second time a crested eagle has successfully raised a chick near the lodge, underscoring the vibrant health of the surrounding ecosystem.
postcards.story:
The eco-friendly lodge, Refugio Amazonas, is located deep in the Peruvian Amazon, offering you an unparalleled birdwatching adventure. 

Just 30 minutes from the lodge, their team discovered the nest, allowing you to witness the rare and elusive crested eagle in its natural habitat. 

From a specially designed viewing spot, you can watch as the mother eagle interacts with and cares for her chick — a rare and intimate glimpse into the lives of these wonderful birds.

The nest was found by the diligent field researchers of the Wired Amazon program, who tirelessly monitor the diverse wildlife in the Tambopata National Reserve. 

It was the experienced birding guide, Fernando Ccoa, who first noticed unusual bird activity in a remote area and discovered the nest. 

Excited by the find, the Rainforest Expeditions team, including researchers Aracely Meza and Gabriel Serrano, quickly established protocols to ensure the eagles were not disturbed.

To provide you with a safe and enjoyable viewing experience, a blind was installed at a respectful distance from the nest. This allows you to observe the eagles without causing any disturbance, offering a unique opportunity to connect with nature in a responsible way.

This birdwatching experience at Refugio Amazonas is more than just a chance to see a rare bird. It reflects the thriving ecosystem of the Amazon rainforest and the successful conservation efforts taking place here. 

By visiting here, you contribute to these efforts, supporting the preservation of this incredible habitat and its wildlife.

Whether you’re a keen birdwatcher or a nature enthusiast, witnessing the crested eagle and its chick in their natural environment is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. 

Come and join Refugio Amazonas Lodge for an unforgettable adventure and become part of the story of conservation and natural wonder in the heart of the Peruvian Amazon.

postcards.name: Disconnect for Your Wellbeing at Refugio Amazonas
postcards.intro: At Refugio Amazonas, you’ll find the perfect opportunity to disconnect and recharge. Located deep within over 200 private hectares in the buffer zone of the Tambopata National Reserve along the Tambopata River in Madre de Dios, Peru, this eco-lodge offers you a serene escape from the rush of everyday life and encourages you to enjoy the simple wonders of life.
postcards.story:
You don’t need to be a nature lover to appreciate what Refugio Amazonas has to offer. This lodge provides a unique combination of comfort and adventure, making it ideal for anyone looking to unwind. 

Upon arrival, the first thing you’ll notice is the sense of peace and isolation. The sounds of the jungle, the sight of the lush greenery and the fresh, clean air create an environment where you can truly disconnect from the outside world.

Wellbeing is essential for a healthy, balanced life, allowing you to function optimally both physically and mentally. Regular breaks from our daily routines help reduce stress, prevent burnout and rejuvenate our minds and bodies. 

Disconnecting from everyday pressures enables us to reconnect with ourselves, giving us a sense of peace and clarity that enhances our overall happiness and productivity.
You might start your day with an exciting guided walk through the rainforest, learning about the diverse native flora and fauna. 

This wonderful walk will encourage you to be more present, cultivating a sense of mindful living. Additionally, the medicinal plants trail is particularly fascinating, offering mindful insights into the traditional uses of jungle plants for healing. This experience makes you more thoughtful about the wonders of the Amazon.

You can find a quiet spot anywhere around the lodge to sit, relax and enjoy the meditative silence. You can even go for night walks to experience the jungle’s nocturnal life. 

If you prefer a more relaxed pace, you can spend your time lounging in a hammock, listening to the sounds of the forest or enjoying a book from the library.

A stay at Refugio Amazonas is about finding balance, peace and reconnecting with yourself. The combination of natural beauty, calm surroundings and mindful activities provides the perfect setting for relaxation.

name: Papaya Playa Project
intro: Cocooned by the jungle on a pristine stretch of the Caribbean coast lies a communal playground for the creative community. Papaya Playa lets you reconnect to nature with an urban spirit.

news_article.title: Discover an Immersive Stay at the Papaya Playa Project
news_article.description: A Design Hotel on the Mexican Caribbean Coast

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding at Papaya Playa Project
postcards.intro: Located within the breathtaking natural beauty of Tulum, Papaya Playa Project invites couples to celebrate their love amidst the splendour of Mexico's Caribbean coast. The dedicated team specialises in curating unforgettable wedding experiences, infusing each celebration with a deep commitment to sustainability and responsibility.
postcards.story:
From the moment you set foot on the pristine shores of the Caribbean coast, the Papaya Playa Project strives to create a wedding that reflects your unique personality and love story, ensuring every detail is attended to. Immerse yourself in the raw, unfiltered beauty of nature as you exchange vows in a setting that epitomises romance. Whether you envision an intimate ceremony beneath swaying palms or a grand celebration under the starlit sky, the Papaya Playa Project offers you the perfect backdrop for your dream wedding.

Here. the focus on sustainability extends to every aspect of your special day, from locally sourced, delicious cuisine to eco-conscious decor that reflects your style. With an emphasis on reducing environmental impact, the aim is to set an example of responsible hospitality development for the world to follow.

Music fills the air, adding to the joyful ambience as you dance the night away with your loved ones, surrounded by the gentle rustle of palm leaves and the rhythmic crash of waves against the shore. Every moment is infused with love and laughter, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

Papaya Playa Project considers it an honour to witness and facilitate the most sacred day of your lives. Their goal is to ensure that your wedding is not only a celebration of your love for each other but also a reflection of the beauty and wonder of Tulum's natural surroundings.

As you exchange vows amidst the sun-kissed sands and azure waters of the Caribbean, know that you are contributing to a vision of sustainable and responsible tourism that can serve as a model for hospitality development worldwide. Contact the Papaya Playa Project  today to begin planning your dream wedding and go on a journey of love and adventure in the heart of Tulum.

postcards.name: Immerse Yourself in a Soulful Massage Experience
postcards.intro: At the Papaya Playa Project, wellness is not just a concept — it's a way of life. Here, the spa offers you a comprehensive range of treatments mindfully designed to soothe the mind, body and soul, providing you with a truly immersive experience of rejuvenation and renewal. Are you ready to immerse yourself in a soulful massage experience?
postcards.story:
Whether you seek relaxation, relief from tension or a holistic approach to wellness, the experienced therapists at the Papaya Playa Project combine traditional Mayan techniques with modern practices to ensure every treatment leaves you feeling refreshed and revitalised.

Step into the tranquil spa oasis, where the gentle whispers of the Caribbean breeze and the rhythmic sounds of the ocean waves set the stage for unparalleled relaxation. Here, the massage services are crafted to address your unique needs and preferences, offering a variety of modalities including Holistic, Deep Tissue, Relaxing Harmony, Mayan Abdominal and Foot massages. Each session is tailored to promote deep relaxation, release muscular tension and restore balance to the body and mind.

Immerse yourself in the healing power of touch as skilled therapists work their magic, coaxing stress and fatigue away with expert hands and intuitive care. Beyond physical relaxation, these massages offer you numerous wellness benefits, including improved circulation, enhanced flexibility and a heightened sense of well-being. Whether you're seeking relief from chronic pain or simply craving a moment of indulgence, massage treatments provide a space of solace and renewal.

In addition to massages, the spa menu features an array of rejuvenating treatments such as body wraps and facials, each designed to nourish the skin, promote detoxification and enhance overall wellness. This holistic approach to wellness extends beyond individual treatments to encompass the entire spa experience.

As you surrender to the healing touch of the therapists and bask in the serenity of the spa surroundings, you'll find yourself transported to a state of profound relaxation and inner harmony. As you simply treat yourself to a moment of self-care, the Papaya Playa Project invites you to celebrate the transformative power of wellness and go on a journey of holistic healing and renewal.

name: Posada Amazonas
intro: Connect with the Native Community of Infierno and the protected forest of Posada Amazonas through unique activities. Embrace Tambopata's nature, and leave a positive impact on its people.

news_article.title: Embrace Natural Living at Posada Amazonas
news_article.description: An Eco-Lodge in the Peruvian Amazon

postcards.name: Spot the Giant River Otters
postcards.intro: Go on an exhilarating quest through the untamed wilderness of Posada Amazonas in search of the majestic giant river otters. As the first light of dawn kisses the lush canopy above, you'll find yourself drawn into a world of unparalleled beauty and intrigue, where every moment promises a new discovery.
postcards.story:
Your adventure begins with the soft crunch of footsteps on the forest floor as you make your way towards the winding river. With each step, anticipation builds, fueled by the knowledge that you're about to delve into a realm where nature rules. Upon reaching the water's edge, a sturdy boat awaits, ready to carry you on the next leg of your journey.

Your expert guides share their wealth of knowledge, pointing out hidden treasures along the way and setting the stage for the unforgettable encounters to come. After a brief yet captivating journey, you arrive at the edge of an oxbow lake, its glassy surface shimmering in the morning light. From here, a walk leads you deeper into the heart of the wilderness, where the chorus of the jungle surrounds you in a symphony of life.

Finally, you arrive at the water's edge, where a comfortable catamaran invites you, poised to carry you on a voyage of discovery. With each gentle stroke of the paddle, you navigate the labyrinthine channels of the lake.

As you immerse yourself in this pristine sanctuary, the air crackles with anticipation, every ripple on the water holding the promise of a thrilling encounter. And then, as if summoned by the magic of the forest itself, they appear – the giant river otters, playful and graceful, their sleek forms slicing effortlessly through the water.

In their presence, time seems to stand still as you bear witness to a spectacle unlike any other. And as you watch these magnificent creatures in their element, you can't help but feel a profound sense of gratitude for this incredible opportunity. In the end, your journey isn't just a quest for adventure – it's a journey of discovery, a journey of connection and above all, a journey of conservation.

postcards.name: Immerse Yourself in the Adventure of Jungle Mountain Biking
postcards.intro: As you pedal your bike along the winding trail, the dense foliage of the jungle gradually gives way to a brilliant burst of sunlight, revealing a breathtaking panorama before you. Perched high atop an Amazon overlook, above the majestic Tambopata River, you can't help but feel a sense of wonder at the sheer magnitude of the beauty that surrounds you.
postcards.story:
Jungle mountain biking at Posada Amazonas is an exhilarating experience that promises excitement and discovery at every turn. With ten kilometres of trails snaking through pristine forests, each twist and turn offers you a new opportunity to immerse yourself in the magical wilderness of the Amazon. As you navigate through this lush paradise, you'll be accompanied by the thrilling possibility of encountering wildlife along the way. This moment alone makes the journey worthwhile, but the real adventure is just beginning.

Equipped with a top-of-the-line GT mountain bike, helmet and all the necessary cycling gear, along with a water bottle and a seasoned mountain biking guide by your side, you're ready to go on a journey unlike any other. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a novice to the world of mountain biking, the allure of exploring one of the world's most diverse and enchanting settings is impossible to resist.

Jungle mountain biking is the perfect way to satisfy your adventurous spirit. While expert guides ensure your safety and readiness, the thrill of mountain biking through the jungle still offers a great adventure. With each pedal stroke, you'll push your physical limits and emerge with a profound sense of accomplishment, along with unforgettable stories to share with friends and family.

Moreover, jungle mountain biking allows you to see the Amazon in a whole new light. Even seasoned bikers will delight in the opportunity to explore this wild and diverse environment, unlike any other forested mountain paths in the world. Here, in the Amazon jungles of Tambopata, you'll have the chance to venture into areas rarely seen by others, immersing yourself in the heart of one of the planet's most remarkable ecosystems. So saddle up and get ready to go on the adventure of a lifetime.

postcards.name: Get a New Perspective of the Amazon from a Canopy Tower
postcards.intro: At Posada Amazonas, one of the most thrilling experiences is reaching the Canopy Tower. From here, you can enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding forests and enjoy the vibrant life of the Amazon rainforest. Come and join Rainforest Expeditions at Posada Amazonas and let the beauty of the canopy leave you inspired.
postcards.story:
As you approach the Canopy Tower, it doesn’t look that high. But once you start climbing the staircase and reach the top platform, the perspective changes dramatically. 

You realise just how elevated you are, free from the dense undergrowth of the forest floor. The horizon stretches out before you, framed by an endless sea of treetops, offering a stunning and expansive view.

Most of the rainforest’s life thrives in the canopy, the highest reaches of the trees. Hiking on the jungle trails, you’ve already marvelled at the massive trunks of towering trees. 

But ascending to the canopy provides a completely different appreciation. From the top of the tower, you can see centuries-old Brazil nut trees, acacias, ceibas and ironwoods standing tall and majestic above the rest. It’s a sight that leaves a lasting impression.

The Canopy Tower is designed to give you a bird’s eye view of the rainforest. The guides will lead you on a hike to the tower, providing insights into the flora and fauna along the way. As you climb the steps at your own pace, anticipation builds. 

When you finally reach the top, the view is nothing short of spectacular. You can see miles of pristine forest in every direction, a green ocean of trees under the vast sky.

Because so much of the rainforest’s life is active in the canopy, the tower offers incredible wildlife viewing opportunities. You might see colourful birds, playful monkeys or even sloths hanging from branches. 

The beautiful views of treetop animals, paired with the sweeping panorama of the jungle, make for an unforgettable experience.

Whether you’re a nature lover or simply someone seeking a unique adventure, the Canopy Tower experience offers a refreshing and inspiring perspective on the Amazon rainforest.

postcards.name: Explore the Medicinal Plants Trail
postcards.intro: When you stay at Posada Amazonas, one of the most enlightening experiences is walking on the Medicinal Plants Trail. This journey reveals the Amazon's incredible biodiversity and the traditional healing secrets of its plants. Ready to acquire new and exciting knowledge about the medicinal plants on this exciting trail?
postcards.story:
As you start walking on the trail near the lodge, you’re immediately immersed in the dense forest, a reminder that you’re in the world’s most biodiverse place. 

The Amazon is not only rich in animal life but also in a vast variety of plants, each with unique properties and uses. The expert guides will introduce you to the amazing array of plants and their traditional roles in local healing practices.

The people of the Peruvian rainforest have relied on plants for medicinal purposes long before modern medicine was developed.

This deep connection to nature is still evident today, as many native people in Tambopata visit local shamans for treatments. These traditional healers use plants to treat a wide range of ailments, from insomnia to cancer. 

Walking along the trail, you’ll learn about these practices and the specific plants involved.

For instance, you might encounter the cat’s claw vine, known for its anti-inflammatory properties or the ayahuasca vine, used in traditional spiritual ceremonies. 

Your guide will explain how these and other plants are harvested and prepared for medicinal use, offering you a fascinating glimpse into the ingenuity of native knowledge.

Marvelling at the miracles of the Amazon, you’ll discover that many plants have developed unique compounds to defend against predators. These natural chemicals have been harnessed by native peoples for thousands of years. 

Understanding this relationship between plants and people enriches your appreciation for the rainforest's complexity.

The Medicinal Plants Trail at Posada Amazonas is an educational adventure that connects you to the ancient traditions and wisdom of the Amazon. 

If you’re a nature enthusiast or someone interested in traditional medicine, this experience offers a simple yet profound look into the healing power of the rainforest.

name: Sadhrana Bagh
intro: Surrounded by fields of seasonal crops and marigolds, and designed by the iconic architectural firm Pradeep Sachdeva Design Associates, Sadhrana Bagh is a haven of natural elements within nature.

news_article.title: Relax and Rejuvenate at Sadhrana Bagh
news_article.description: A Perfect Weekend Getaway from Delhi

postcards.name: Stay at the Haveli-Style Beri House
postcards.intro: Located within the serenity of Sadhrana Bagh lies Beri House, a haven of peace and charm that draws inspiration from the timeless elegance of the neighbouring Beri village. Infused with the rich heritage of the region, this enchanting villa is a reflection of the art of blending tradition with modern comforts, offering you an unforgettable retreat amidst its beautiful surroundings.
postcards.story:
From the moment you step into Beri House, you are enveloped in an atmosphere of understated luxury and rustic allure. The design pays homage to the architectural marvels of the havelis, with reclaimed elements sourced from dismantled buildings in the vicinity lending a sense of history and character to every corner.

Each of the five exquisitely styled bedrooms invites you to unwind in blissful comfort, while the spacious living and dining area invites you to enjoy leisurely conversations and sumptuous meals. Outside, the private pool glistens invitingly, flanked by a charming pool house and entertainment pavilion where you can bask in the warmth of the sun or seek shade beneath the clear sky.

If you’re seeking moments of inner reflection, Beri House offers you ample indoor and outdoor space for meditation or yoga practice, with attentive staff ready to provide you with a mat at your request. Alternatively, indulge in friendly competition with a selection of board games or treat yourself to a rejuvenating massage either in the privacy of your room or by the tranquil poolside.

As the day unfolds, savour the magic of sunset with a refreshing beverage in hand or delight in the tantalising aromas of a delectable barbecue feast served either poolside or amidst the lush garden greenery.
