If you’re a nature enthusiast, go on a sanctuary walk through the enchanting Sultanpur National Park, which is not very far from your stay.

Whether you choose to take a dip in the crystalline waters of the pool, explore the whimsical delights of the custom-designed treehouse or simply lose yourself in the timeless beauty of Sadhrana Bagh, Beri House promises an enchanting escape where cherished memories are made and the soul finds solace in every moment.

postcards.name: Appreciate the Perfect Location of Sadhrana Bagh
postcards.intro: Whether you're seeking a tranquil escape in nature or a convenient retreat from city life, Sadhrana Bagh promises an experience that is as unforgettable as it is rejuvenating. Let the beauty of this enchanting locale inspire you to go on a journey of exploration and discovery, where every moment is filled with wonder and the promise of adventure.
postcards.story:
Located amidst the beauty of nature, Sadhrana Bagh is a hidden gem that offers you the perfect combination of peace and convenience. Located just a stone's throw away from one of the country's most renowned bird sanctuaries, the Sultanpur National Park, and within easy reach of the bustling New Delhi Airport, this idyllic retreat invites you with its promise of natural beauty and accessibility.

If you’re a bird enthusiast or a nature lover, the Sultanpur National Park is a sanctuary like no other, home to over 100 species of resident and migratory birds. Immerse yourself in the rhymes of avian calls as you wander through its lush foliage, capturing glimpses of colourful plumage and graceful flight against the backdrop of azure skies.

Beyond its natural wonders, Sadhrana Bagh offers the added allure of its proximity to the vibrant heart of Delhi and the bustling city of Gurugram. A mere 35-kilometre drive transports you from the chaos of urban life to the serenity of this verdant oasis, making it the ideal destination for a rejuvenating weekend getaway.

Upon arrival at Sadhrana Bagh, you are welcomed into a world of luxury and comfort, with four exquisite villas awaiting your indulgence. Stylishly appointed and impeccably designed, each villa boasts top-of-the-line amenities and exemplary service, ensuring a stay that is nothing short of extraordinary.

Venture beyond the confines of your villa and you'll discover the true beauty of Sadhrana Bagh lying within its six acres of beautifully landscaped gardens. Here, every corner reveals a new delight, from secluded alcoves perfect for quiet contemplation to vibrant blooms that dance in the gentle breeze, captivating the senses and soothing the soul.

name: ShivAdya Manali
intro: Escape from the daily grind into airy heights of the Himalayan Mountains at ShivAdya located in the Manali region of Himachal Pradesh. Flanked by the majestic Himalayan range, the Boutique property commands spectacular views of the verdant valleys, lush apple orchards, tall deodar trees and the snow-capped peaks in a landscape that a Rembrandt or Monet would love to paint.

news_article.title: Relax and Unwind at ShivAdya in Manali
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel in Himachal Pradesh

postcards.name: Immerse Yourself in the Thrill of Mountain Biking
postcards.intro: During your stay at ShivAdya, immerse yourself in the thrill of mountain biking with a range of bicycles available for your exploration. Whether you're seeking a leisurely ride or a more adventurous journey, there are options to suit your preferences, allowing you to traverse the stunning landscapes that surround you.
postcards.story:
Picture yourself setting off on a scenic ride from ShivAdya, the mountain air invigorating your senses as you pedal along winding trails that lead to picturesque destinations. With each turn of the wheel, you'll discover hidden gems waiting to be uncovered, from quaint villages like Haripur to the charming town of Naggar, each offering you a glimpse into the richness of life in the Himalayas.

For a more immersive experience, you’re offered special biking trips accompanied by a backup vehicle to ensure your safety and comfort as you venture further afield. Whether it's a journey to the rustic village of Jana, where panoramic views and warm hospitality await or a pilgrimage to the sacred site of Bijli Mahadev, where ancient temples stand in silent reverence to the divine, the expert guides will lead the way, providing insights into the history and culture of the region.

As you pedal through breathtaking landscapes, you'll feel a sense of liberation and exhilaration unlike any other, the rhythm of your heartbeat matching the cadence of your bike as you conquer each ascent and descent with determination and grace. Along the way, take time to pause and absorb the beauty that surrounds you, from lush forests teeming with wildlife to cascading waterfalls that offer a refreshing respite from the journey.

For the truly adventurous, why not combine your bike ride with a night of camping under the starlit sky? Imagine pitching your tent amidst the tranquil wilderness, the crackle of a campfire warming your soul as you share stories and laughter with fellow travellers. 

At ShivAdya, you’re invited to enjoy the spirit of adventure and go on a mountain biking journey that promises to awaken your senses. So why wait? Grab your bike, hit the trails and let the adventure begin.

postcards.name: Dine Alfresco in the Forest
postcards.intro: Imagine yourself walking through the serene expanse of a sprawling apple orchard, the air filled with the sweet scent of ripe fruit hanging tantalisingly from the branches above. The mere sight of the trees, laden with crimson-red apples, invites you to explore further. With each step, the anticipation of indulging in a picnic lunch amidst this natural wonder grows stronger.
postcards.story:
As you wander through the orchard, the vibrant hues of the apples contrast beautifully with the lush green foliage. The gentle rustle of leaves in the breeze provides the perfect soundtrack to your walk, while the warm rays of the sun kiss your skin, enveloping you in a sense of contentment.

Finding the ideal spot beneath a leafy canopy, you spread out a blanket and unpack a delightful feast prepared with care by the team at ShivAdya. Savoury sandwiches, crisp salads and succulent fruits await your enjoyment, each bite full of flavours that tantalise your taste buds and nourish the soul. Laughter and conversation flow freely as you bond with your companions, creating memories that will be treasured for years to come.

As you indulge in the delicious fare, your senses are heightened by the beauty that surrounds you. The crisp crunch of an apple, freshly plucked from a nearby tree, echoes the crispness of the mountain air, while the sweet aroma of blossoms perfumes the atmosphere, infusing it with an intoxicating fragrance. Time seems to stand still as you savour each moment, grateful for the opportunity to connect with nature and with those who matter most to you. Alternatively, picture yourself standing on the banks of a fast-flowing Himalayan stream, its crystal-clear waters cascading over smooth rocks with a melodic rhythm that soothes the soul. 

At ShivAdya, you’re offered a chance to immerse yourself in this breathtaking experience, organising a picnic lunch beside the Himalayan stream that promises to be both rejuvenating and inspiring. The towering peaks, the verdant forests and the rushing waters all come together to create a scene of unparalleled beauty, inviting you to pause, reflect and marvel at the magnificence of the world around you.

name: ABN Sukhapa
intro: In an effort to conserve India’s forests, her 12 upper deck cabins are bamboo-paneled, air-conditioned and roomy with en suite bathrooms; these cabins also have large, sliding windows that offer panoramic views of the river.

news_article.title: Navigate the Mighty Brahmaputra River with ABN Sukhapa
news_article.description: Journeying through India's Majestic Waterways

postcards.name: Learn About Assamese Silk Production With ABN Sukhapa
postcards.intro: Go on an enchanting voyage from Guwahati to Silghat, where every moment promises to immerse you in the rich stories of Assam's culture, natural heritage and silk production. Experience the magic of Assam's rivers and jungles, where every twist and turn reveals a new chapter in your adventure.
postcards.story:
On day one, your journey begins with a warm welcome at Guwahati airport, where you'll be transferred to Pandu Port to board ABN Sukhapa. As you sail downstream towards Sualkuchi, indulge in a delightful lunch onboard while soaking in the breathtaking views of the Brahmaputra River. 

In the afternoon, enjoy a walk through Sualkuchi, renowned as the epicentre of Assamese silk production. Here, you'll have the opportunity to witness the intricate process of silk manufacture and visit weaving workshops, where skilled artisans craft exquisite mekhela chadars.

Day two invites you to explore the spiritual heart of Assam as you drive up Nilachal Hill to visit the revered Kamakhya temple. Dedicated to the goddess Kamakhya, this sacred site symbolises the fusion of diverse faiths and practices in the region. Immerse yourself in the vibrant energy of the temple surroundings before returning to the vessel and cruising towards Mayong.

As day three dawns, cruise upstream and visit a charming riverside village nestled amidst lush green fields of vegetables. Spend the day leisurely cruising upstream, taking in the picturesque vistas of jungle-covered hills and life along the riverbanks. Don't miss the opportunity to participate in an Indian cooking demonstration onboard, where you can learn the secrets of traditional Assamese cuisine.

On day four, your adventure continues as you cruise towards Silghat and go on an exhilarating jeep safari in the Western range of Kaziranga National Park. Explore this UNESCO World Heritage Site, home to an incredible array of wildlife, including the iconic Indian one-horned rhinoceros and royal Bengal tigers. Marvel at the park's rich biodiversity and diverse ecosystems, reminiscent of the African savannah. As day five dawns, bid farewell to the crew and fellow travellers as you go on your journey back to Guwahati airport.

postcards.name: Opt for the Brahmaputra Maximum Cruise on ABN Sukhapa
postcards.intro: Experience the wonders of Assam's rivers and jungles on the unforgettable journey on the Brahmaputra River, where each moment is filled with discovery and adventure. During your voyage on the ABN Sukhapa, immerse yourself in the rich stories of Assam's history and culture. Are you ready for this exciting adventure?
postcards.story:
Your cruise adventure begins with a warm welcome as you arrive at Dibrugarh or Jorhat, both gateways to the mesmerising Brahmaputra River. From there, a scenic drive from Dibrugarh or Jorhat will lead you to Neamati Ghat, where you'll go on your river cruise with ABN Sukhapa.

Explore Sibsagar, the ancient capital of the Ahom kings, where you'll marvel at the unique blend of Indian and Southeast Asian architecture. Lunch at Horu Charai offers a taste of Assamese hospitality amidst the serene surroundings of a tea estate.

As you cruise downstream to Majuli island, the world's largest river island, you'll encounter a microcosm of Assamese culture. Visit the elegant island satras or monasteries, where devotees lead a simple life, expressing their devotion through music and readings. Sail leisurely along the Brahmaputra on day four, pausing to visit a tribal river village and catch glimpses of wildlife in Kaziranga National Park. Keep your eyes peeled for wild elephants and, if you're lucky, perhaps even a tiger.

Day five brings you to the charming temple town of Vishnath, where you can explore ancient temples and village life before venturing into the lush wilderness of Kaziranga. Go on your first safari, traversing woodlands, grasslands and wetlands in search of elusive wildlife. The following day promises more wildlife encounters as you go on a morning jeep safari in Kaziranga's Central Range. With its diverse ecosystems and rich biodiversity, Kaziranga is a paradise for nature lovers and bird enthusiasts alike.

On your final days, explore the historic city of Guwahati, from its sacred temples to its vibrant bazaars. Walk through Sualkuchi, the heart of Assamese silk production, before bidding farewell to the enchanting Brahmaputra River and transferring to Guwahati airport for your departure.

name: ABN Charaidew I
intro: ABN Charaidew I is a heritage passenger vessel from the 1970s that's been completely renovated to provide guests an experience of tasteful riverine living.

news_article.title: Cruise the Brahmaputra River on ABN Charaidew I
news_article.description: Discovering the Natural Beauty and Rich Biodiversity of Northeastern India

postcards.name: Step Aboard a Heritage Passenger Vessel
postcards.intro: As you step onto the deck of the ABN Charaidew I, you're immediately enveloped in an atmosphere of timeless elegance fused with modern comfort. This heritage passenger vessel, hailing from the illustrious era of the 1970s, has been lovingly renovated to offer you an unparalleled experience of refined riverine living.
postcards.story:
Your journey with ABN Charaidew I begins as you're greeted by the gentle sway of the vessel, drifting gracefully along the tranquil water. With only 10 air-conditioned twin-bedded and two double-bedded cabins adorned with en-suite bathrooms, the Charaidew I ensures an intimate escape from the bustling pace of life on shore. As you settle into your cabin on the upper deck, you're embraced by a sense of serenity, cocooned in luxurious comfort amidst the gentle flow of the river.

Venturing further, you find yourself drawn to the inviting bar and saloon, where the front deck invites with promises of breathtaking views. Here, you can unwind with a refreshing drink in hand, the soft hues of the setting sun casting a warm glow over the scene. The dining room below, with its full-length glass doors, invites you to indulge in culinary delights while surrounded by the tranquil beauty of the river.

As you explore the vessel, you can't help but marvel at the meticulous attention to detail in the decor. Local handloom fabrics, specially woven for the Charaidew I, adorn the interiors, adding a touch of artisanal charm to the surroundings. Comfortable cane sofas and chairs invite you to sink into relaxation, each piece a reflection of the vessel's commitment to both style and comfort.

For those with a penchant for history, the Charaidew I offers you a captivating glimpse into the past. The traditional wheel or helm, stands as a silent witness to the vessel's storied heritage, while the brass speaking tube serves as a conduit for the Master's commands to the Driver in the engine room. These untouched relics, gleaming in polished brass, serve as a poignant reminder of the vessel's rich legacy, preserved with the utmost respect and reverence.

postcards.name: Explore the Brahmaputra River Valley on ABN Charaidew I
postcards.intro: Join an exclusive adventure aboard the ABN Charaidew I, as you book a private charter to traverse the breathtaking Brahmaputra River. This luxurious vessel offers the perfect sanctuary for you and your companions to immerse yourselves in the splendour of the Brahmaputra River Valley, a hidden gem nestled in the heart of the Indian subcontinent.
postcards.story:
As you set sail on your private journey, prepare to be captivated by the allure of the Brahmaputra River Valley. This mighty river, one of Asia's most significant nurtures a rich ecosystem along its banks. From the icy heights of the Himalayas to the lush forests and sprawling grasslands of Arunachal Pradesh and Assam, each stop along the river promises an unforgettable experience.

Discover the valley's diverse ecosystems, each a beautiful collection of unique life forms waiting to be explored. Delve into the alpine regions of Arunachal Pradesh, where vibrant rhododendrons paint the landscape with their striking hues and large blossoms, creating a mesmerising spectacle for you to behold. Journey deeper into the valley to encounter over 200 species of orchids, including the exquisite foxtail orchid, the state flower of Assam and the delicate bamboo orchid, each showcasing the valley's unparalleled botanical beauty.

The Brahmaputra River Valley is not just a haven for plants — it's also home to an impressive array of wildlife, many of which are found nowhere else on Earth. Keep your eyes peeled for the majestic Indian rhinoceros, roaming the grasslands of Assam's Kaziranga National Park or the elusive Bengal tiger, prowling through the dense forests of Manas National Park. Listen for the distinct calls of the hoolock gibbon as they swing through the tropical forests.

On board the ABN Charaidew I, every moment is an opportunity for discovery. Whether you're gazing out at the stunning views from the comfort of your cabin or venturing ashore to explore the valley's hidden treasures, your private charter promises an experience like no other — a journey that will leave you with memories to last a lifetime. So set sail with ABN Charaidew I and uncover the secrets of the Brahmaputra River Valley, where adventure awaits at every turn.

name: Brij Gaj Kesri
intro: Featuring 40 rooms and suites, Brij Gaj Kesri is a modern-day manor house that spans 16 acres and is a testament to the Marwari patronage of art and architecture. Each kingdom in Rajasthan boasts of a unique aesthetic and Brij Gaj Kesri showcases the late-19th-early-20th century Bikaneri Rajput style.

news_article.title: Indulge in Extraordinary Art and Architecture at Brij Gaj Kesri
news_article.description: A Regal Abode in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Relax Yourself in a Regal Accommodation
postcards.intro: Accommodation at Brij Gaj Kesri epitomises luxury and heritage. Lavish rooms adorned with traditional decor and modern amenities offer you a regal experience. Here you’ll indulge in unparalleled comfort amidst the palace's grandeur, relishing every moment of your stay in a setting steeped in history and elegance.
postcards.story:
When you stay at Brij Gaj Kesri in Bikaner, you'll find a variety of accommodations designed to suit your preferences and needs. The main building boasts 24 rooms adorned in glorious art deco style, featuring traditional fine pieces that add a touch of elegance to your stay. Whether you're drawn to the rich history of the décor or the comfort of modern amenities, these rooms offer you a homey retreat after a day of exploration.

If you’re seeking a more spacious and luxurious experience, Karni Vilas awaits you at the southernmost part of the estate. With seven expansive suites, each featuring large bathrooms and built around a charming courtyard, you'll discover a serene oasis where you can truly unwind and rejuvenate.

If contemporary style is your vibe, Mohini Mahal presents 10 eclectic rooms furnished with modern comforts. Here, tranquillity and serenity are the hallmarks of your stay, providing a peaceful sanctuary amidst the chaos of the city.

For the utmost comfort and privacy, consider the Karni Suites, located in the southernmost part of the estate. With seven spacious suites designed to cater to your every need, you'll find a generous layout complemented by large bathrooms and a serene courtyard ambience.
And if you're looking for a delightful space that merges modern comforts with traditional elegance, the Mohini Room awaits you. Thoughtfully designed to provide a tranquil space for relaxation, this room type invites you to unwind and indulge in the beauty of your surroundings.

No matter which accommodation you choose, your stay at Brij Gaj Kesri promises to be a memorable experience. The team here is dedicated to ensuring that your stay is comfortable and relaxing. Visit this regal property for a truly memorable experience.

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding at Brij Gaj Kesri
postcards.intro: Welcome to Brij Gaj Kesri, a palatial haven that whispers tales of Rajasthan's grandeur, inviting you to indulge in unforgettable moments. Here, amidst the opulent splendour, you'll discover the perfect setting for your dream wedding celebration. Celebrate your special day at Brij Gaj Kesri and create lasting memories with your loved ones.
postcards.story:
Picture a majestic wedding entrance, where every step down the grand driveway is a prelude to the magnificence that awaits. Step into the embrace, where 41 luxurious rooms await, each a space of comfort and refinement. Whether you seek the intimacy of a private gathering or the grandeur of a lavish affair, the eight venues, both indoor and outdoor, offer you a canvas for your imagination to roam freely. As you approach, the red turrets stand tall against the azure sky, painting a picture of regal elegance.

Stroll through the expansive lawns, where verdant greens stretch as far as the eye can see. Reflective ponds shimmer in the sunlight, casting a serene ambience over the surroundings. Amidst this natural splendour, let your heart guide you to moments of pure bliss. Imagine exchanging vows amidst the enchanting gardens, bathed in the soft glow of ambient lighting and adorned with the finest floral arrangements. With world-class entertainment to complement the atmosphere, every moment becomes a cherished memory.

Brij Gaj Kesri understands that your vision is unique. Whether it's a destination wedding, a private photo shoot or a grand family reunion, they will turn your dreams into reality. Choose a spot that speaks to your soul and watch as they weave magic into every detail, leaving nothing to chance.

Let them be your trusted guide on this journey of love and celebration. From the moment you arrive, until the last guest departs, the dedicated team here is committed to ensuring that every aspect of your event surpasses expectations.

Simply immerse yourself in the allure of Rajasthan's heritage and hospitality. Let Brij Gaj Kesri be the backdrop to your most cherished moments, where every glance, every smile, is etched in the tapestry of time.

name: Villa Nai 3.3
intro: Ahoy there! Villa Nai 3.3 is moored in a haven on the island of Dugi Otok, in the heart of Dalmatia, near the village of Žman. It offers a luxurious stay only a few minutes away from Telašćica Nature Park, its beaches and cliffs, olive groves, and Aleppo pine and oak forests.

news_article.title: Celebrate Olives at Villa NAI 3.3, an Organic Island Farm and Luxury Retreat
news_article.description: A Croatian Beauty in the Dalmatian Islands

postcards.name: Unwind at the Indoor and Outdoor Swimming Pools
postcards.intro: At Villa Nai 3.3, immerse yourself in a thoughtful combination of nature's embrace and luxurious indulgence. Discover moments of relaxation awaiting you at the indoor and outdoor swimming pools. Indulge in peaceful solitude as you immerse yourself in the refreshing waters, surrounded by the beauty of nature. In this quiet oasis, every moment is worth remembering.
postcards.story:
The crown jewel of the outdoor offerings at Villa Nai 3.3 is the expansive 23-metre infinity swimming pool, located within the verdant embrace of the thriving olive grove. Here, you become one with nature, as you gaze out over the azure expanse of the sea and the scattered jewels of nearby islands. 
The air is redolent with the intoxicating fragrance of Mediterranean herbs, while the gentle chorus of crickets provides a serene soundtrack to your leisurely swim. This saltwater oasis is a sanctuary that mindfully integrates with the organic ethos of the farm, inviting you to reconnect with the earth while luxuriating in the tranquil waters.
Indulgence knows no bounds here. The indoor swimming pool invites you to enjoy moments of solitude. Tucked away within a secluded grotto, this intimate space offers you a space for relaxation and rejuvenation. As you slip into the embrace of the salt water, the ambient tranquillity envelops you, cocooning you in a sanctuary of serenity. 
Above, the skylight bathes the pool in a soft, ethereal glow, casting mesmerising patterns of light and shadow that dance across the water's surface. Here, time seems to stand still as you surrender to the meditative rhythm of your surroundings, allowing the lingering sun rays to caress and soothe your skin.

Whether you're basking in the boundless expanse of the outdoor infinity pool or seeking solace in the secluded serenity of the indoor grotto, Villa Nai 3.3 offers you a swimming experience like no other. Here, you're invited to immerse yourself fully — to let go, to reconnect and to find harmony in the union of land, sea and self. So, dive in, and let the journey to serenity begin.

postcards.name: Indulge in a Mindful Wellness Experience at Villa Nai 3.3
postcards.intro: Villa Nai 3.3 believes in nurturing your well-being, offering you a sanctuary where you can prioritise self-care and rejuvenation. Step into a rejuvenating and mindful world and go on a journey of holistic wellness that encompasses mind, body and soul.
postcards.story:
Begin your wellness odyssey at the small outdoor gym, thoughtfully equipped to keep you active during your holiday retreat. Here, amidst the verdant beauty of the surroundings, you can engage in invigorating workouts using the stationary bike, elliptical or yoga mats. Feel the gentle island breeze caress your skin as you breathe in the pure air, invigorating your senses and energising your body.

Indulge in the ultimate pampering experience at the exclusive spa, a place where you can lavish yourself with rejuvenating treatments crafted from olives and olive oil — ingredients imbued with the essence of the land and culture. The spa program combines modern technology with ancient healing traditions, offering a diverse array of treatments ranging from Balinese and Thai body massages to cutting-edge cold plasma therapies. Each experience is designed to replenish your body, soothe your soul and leave you feeling utterly renewed.

Unwind in the Finnish/Bio sauna, a tranquil retreat where you can customise your experience by selecting your preferred scents. Let the gentle heat envelop you, melting away tension and stress, while the aromatic fragrances transport you to a state of profound relaxation. The carefully curated selection of traditional and innovative treatments, sourced from both Croatia and abroad, ensures that your moments of downtime are unparalleled in their effectiveness and luxury.

In today's fast-paced world, prioritising your well-being is essential for maintaining balance and vitality in every aspect of your life. Taking time to care for yourself isn't just a luxury but a necessity. By nurturing your physical, mental and emotional health, you empower yourself to live life to the fullest, celebrating each day with enthusiasm. At Villa Nai 3.3, you’re invited to prioritise your well-being, indulge in moments of self-care and emerge feeling refreshed, revitalised and ready to enjoy the world anew.

name: RAAS Jodhpur
intro: RAAS is Jodhpur’s first boutique hotel with a signature look born from a fusion of modern and ancient styles. The courtyard is a tranquil haven within the hustle and bustle of Jodhpur’s old town.

news_article.title: Experience Regal Elegance at RAAS Jodhpur
news_article.description: Jodhpur’s First Boutique Hotel

postcards.name: Explore the Blue City of Jodhpur
postcards.intro: Welcome to Jodhpur, the Blue City in Rajasthan, where the sight of hundreds of indigo houses stretching into the distance is truly mesmerising. While the exact reason behind Jodhpur's distinct blue hue remains a mystery, popular theories include homage to Lord Shiva, practical uses by Brahmin priests and its reflective properties against the Sun's rays.
postcards.story:
As you wander through the labyrinthine streets of Jodhpur, you'll find yourself immersed in a blend of old and new. Spotting stunning details becomes a delightful pastime, from ancient Deodi entrances to intricately carved jharokha window balconies. Explore hidden courtyards, temples and untouched havelis amidst the bustling cityscape. Even the city's remnants, like the crumbling red sandstone walls, hold tales of its storied past. Regardless of its origin, this city exudes a unique and wise aura through its wonders.

Venturing into the heart of the city offers a glimpse into Jodhpur's vibrant shopping scene. While the Clock Tower market is renowned, true gems await discovery in lesser-known corners. Seek out quaint shops and bustling bazaars, where you can find unique treasures and sample local delights. Don't miss the opportunity to savour a samosa from the famed shop near the south gate — it's a local favourite.

Beyond the blue houses lies a world of endless excitement. Explore the city's rich heritage by visiting its temples, quirky shops and elegant jharokas. Appreciate the grandeur of the city, where remnants of the past still stand tall. The six majestic Pol gates serve as gateways to history, offering you a glimpse into Jodhpur's illustrious past.

No visit to Jodhpur would be complete without experiencing its culinary delights. Indulge in the flavours of Rajasthan as you dine at charming rooftop restaurants scattered throughout the city. From traditional Rajasthani cuisine to international fare, there's something to satisfy every palate.

As you wander through the vibrant streets of Jodhpur, let curiosity be your guide. Discover hidden gems, unravel the city's mysteries and immerse yourself in its timeless charm. With each step, you'll uncover a new facet of the Blue City's captivating allure, leaving you with memories to cherish for a lifetime.

postcards.name: Get Inspired by the Grandeur of Mehrangarh Fort
postcards.intro: When visiting Jodhpur, Mehrangarh Fort is a must-see attraction that warrants a full day of exploration. Delve into its rich history with an audio guide, discovering tales of battles and royal intrigue. Admire the stunning views of Jodhpur from the top of the fort. Don't miss the intricately carved white marble screens and serene Jaswant Thada cenotaph.
postcards.story:
Upon reaching the Mehrangarh Fort, you are recommended to invest in an audio guide along with your museum ticket. The uphill walk to the fort takes around ten to fifteen minutes and is well worth the effort. The fort's rich history, including tales of elephant battles and political intrigue, is truly fascinating. In remarkably good condition, thanks to being inhabited by Jodhpur's royal family until the 1950s, the fort houses stunning collection of extravagant paintings, palanquins and even cribs, some of which were used until the twentieth century. Don't forget your camera — the panoramic views of Jodhpur from the top rooms of the museum are simply breathtaking.

After admiring and appreciating the grandeur of the fort, head to Jaswant Thada – the serene white stone cenotaph, to unwind. Relax in the gardens and admire the memorial's beauty or spend time birdwatching by the small lake. It's the perfect spot for a leisurely picnic. Inside, marvel at the intricately carved white marble screens, which appear to glow in the sunlight.

Be sure to explore Chokelao Bagh, the picturesque garden nestled at the foot of Mehrangarh Fort. The route to the gardens offers you opportunities to discover more hidden corners of the fort, so take your time. Recently restored, this 18th-century Rajput garden boasts traditional flowers and designs. It's a delightful place to visit at night, especially the enchanting Mehtab Bagh (Moonlight Garden), adorned with white flowers and ideal for a romantic walk under the stars.

Conclude your day with a memorable dinner at Chokelao restaurant, located on the upper terrace of the gardens. With its panoramic views of the fort and Jodhpur, along with delectable cuisine, it offers you an unforgettable dining experience. Immerse yourself in the ambience as you enjoy a sumptuous meal with unparalleled views as your backdrop.

name: Sanctuary Resort
intro: Sanctuary Resort is a haven of comfort and luxury in the heart of Nepal’s finest nature. Our safari resort is nestled on the banks of the Narayani River in the lush green region of Amaltari on the western edge of Chitwan National Park.

news_article.title: Explore Nepal's Exquisite Natural Beauty at Sanctuary Resort
news_article.description: A Luxurious Safari Resort on the Edge of Chitwan National Park

postcards.name: Unwind on a Refreshing Nature Walk
postcards.intro: Go on a mesmerising journey through the heart of nature, where the early bird not only catches the worm but also treats you to a spectacular show of vibrant birds and other jungle creatures. Your adventure awaits at Chitwan National Park and the nature walk is the key to unlocking the treasures hidden within its lush landscapes.
postcards.story:
Picture yourself as an intrepid explorer, stepping into a world where every step brings you closer to the wonders of abundant flora and fauna. This is not just a walk but a sensory immersion into the beauty that surrounds you. As you traverse the trails on foot, the sights, sounds and scents of the local landscapes will envelop you in an unforgettable experience.

The expert guides, the custodians of Chitwan's secrets guide you through this enchanting journey. With their knowledge and passion, they ensure that your experience is not only safe but also intellectually stimulating. They lead the way, unveiling the richness of nature that sprawls before you, sharing tales of the diverse wildlife that calls this national park home.

The well-crafted packages thoughtfully weave together the best Chitwan National Park offers. Here, each activity is thoughtfully curated to immerse you in the essence of the natural landscape. Your senses will be awakened as you witness the dance of sunlight on vibrant feathers, the rustle of leaves underfoot and the distant calls of unseen creatures.

The Sanctuary Resort goes beyond the ordinary. Their goal is to create an experience tailored to your desires and interests. When you book with them, share your preferences and let them shape an adventure that resonates with your soul. Whether you seek the thrill of wildlife encounters or the serenity of a quiet nature walk, they've got you covered.

As you explore Chitwan National Park and make this jungle home your own, you’ll leave not just with memories but with a warmth that lingers long after your journey concludes. The Sanctuary Resort invites you to a world where nature's wonders unfold at every turn, and you, dear traveller, are invited to be a part of this extraordinary tale.

postcards.name: Admire the Comforts of a Luxury Stay at Sanctuary Resort
postcards.intro: Sanctuary Resort understands that your accommodation is not just a place to sleep but an integral part of your overall experience. With the commitment to natural elegance and modern comfort, this resort invites you to make yourself at home in the embrace of nature, where every corner is designed to inspire and rejuvenate you.
postcards.story:
Welcome to Sanctuary Resort, where every accommodation is a thoughtful combination of its signature natural style and modern comfort. As you step into this resort, you'll find that the rooms are more than just places to stay; they are reflections of the beauty that surrounds you. Imagine a space built with locally sourced natural materials, mirroring nature's own colour palette to blend with the innate charm of the landscapes that envelop you. 

Fabrics, upholsteries and sheets are crafted from rich locally sourced natural fibres, a reflection of their commitment to sustainability. Collaborating with local artisans, the resort has carefully designed and fashioned its furniture, adding a touch of authenticity to your stay. All rooms boast a bright and airy ambience, creating an inviting atmosphere that welcomes you. 

Step outside and you'll discover your private sanctuary – an outdoor seating area where you can soak in the natural beauty that surrounds you. If you’re seeking the epitome of privacy and comfort, the villas stand as separate, freestanding cottages, offering a haven of tranquillity. 

Each villa is equipped with all the amenities you desire, providing a perfect retreat after a day of exploration. The bungalow villas feature king-sized beds and luxuriously spacious bathrooms, complete with a bathtub for a rejuvenating soak, offering an ideal romantic escape for couples or a homey family retreat. 

Just like these villas, the deluxe rooms embrace a stylish decor that prioritises your comfort, showcasing the same earthy tones and natural aesthetic that defines the property. Whether you opt for a double or twin bed, each of the spacious deluxe rooms comes with all the amenities found in the villas. Open the door to your private oasis – a patio area overlooking the lush grounds and the jungle beyond the river.

name: Rohet Garh
intro: Rohet Garh is a classified Heritage Hotel. Since 1990 it has been nurtured and developed with great love and care by the family into one of the finest Heritage hotels in the country. No new building has been added in the renovation process, but rather, old edifices have been skilfully redesigned to create a heritage property that has few parallels.

news_article.title: Indulge in Sublime Heritage at Rohet Garh
news_article.description: A Luxury Hotel Offering You Unbeaten Rajasthani Hospitality

postcards.name: Be a Part of the Gangaur Festival
postcards.intro: If you find yourself at Rohet Garh during Gangaur, brace yourself for an extraordinary cultural spectacle! Gangaur, Rajasthan's indigenous festival, joyously marks the divine union of Lord Shiva and Parvati incarnated as Ishar and Gangaur. Post-Holi, noble houses across Rajasthan display their avatars in ornate celebrations resembling a wedding.
postcards.story:
Rajasthani culture is vibrant, adorned with colourful attire, intricate art, rich traditions and warm hospitality. At Rohet Garh, Gangaur transforms into a unique experience! Witness the adorned deities of Ishar and Gangaur showcased every evening in the Zenana court of Rohet Garh for five consecutive days. Women and young girls converge daily, offering homage and prayers for a husband akin to Ishar. At its heart, this festival pays homage to Goddess Gauri or Parvati, emphasising the celebration of marriage and love. Primarily for women adorned in their most exquisite jewellery and attire, it centres around offering prayers to Goddess Parvati. The heartfelt prayers seek blessings for a loving husband or the well-being of their marital partners.

Following Rajasthan's wedding traditions, the women and girls engage in the captivating Ghoomar and Garbha dances for the deities, a nightly celebration at Rohet Garh. On the festival's climax, the deities go on a grand procession, accompanied by dancers, musicians and lance-wielding horsemen, reaching the bustling fairgrounds. The fair, a diversity of colours, attracts throngs of people. Here, dance contests and athletic competitions unfold, creating a vibrant spectacle. A priest orchestrates the wedding ceremony, symbolising the festival's culmination and the deities retire to the family temple until the following year.

Immerse yourself in this cultural extravaganza, where each day unveils new facets of Rajasthan's opulence and breathtaking traditions. Experience the fervour of the Ghoomar and Garbha dances, the grandeur of the procession and the vibrant fair, all unfolding against the backdrop of Rohet Garh's historical Zenana court. Celebrate Gangaur like never before, creating memories that intertwine with the richness of Rajasthan's cultural heritage. Your presence during this festival becomes a cherished part of the divine union celebration, leaving you with an indelible connection to the spirit of Gangaur.

postcards.name: Join a Unique Equestrian Adventure at Rohet Garh
postcards.intro: Join a unique equestrian adventure at Rohet Garh, where you'll find one of the country's finest stables of Marwari horses. Known for their sensitive yet honest disposition and graceful gait, these horses offer you a delightful riding experience. Personally schooled by the owner, these horses become your companions during your stay.
postcards.story:
You’re invited to seize the special opportunity to join an equestrian adventure at Rohet Garh and ride the beautiful horses. This is an opportunity for you to forge a unique bond with majestic horses amidst breathtaking landscapes, creating lasting memories. Rohet Garh proudly presents a tailor-made equestrian program, ranging from a one-hour morning ride to a six-day/six-night riding safari exploring the captivating region of western Rajasthan around Rohet. 

Beyond the superb riding experience, it's an immersive cultural journey, offering you insights into the rich traditions of Marwar. Plus, you'll have excellent game-viewing opportunities – animals in the wild react differently when approached on horseback.

This western Rajasthan region, with its semi-arid shrub and bush vegetation, wide open spaces and soft terrain, creates an almost perfect riding country. Carefully curated itineraries eliminate riding on tarmac roads, guiding you through delightful villages, Dhanis, and the legendary hospitality of the people of Marwar. It's an overwhelming cultural experience. Despite the dryness, the region is surprisingly rich in wildlife. 

Encounter herds of the rare black buck antelope, the blue bull antelope and the petite chinkara during your rides. The area is also a haven for bird watchers, with over 200 different species to spot. Tailor-made itineraries consider your riding ability and time duration, with overnight accommodations provided at Rohet Garh.

On longer rides, enjoy the comfort of luxury mobile tents furnished with full-sized beds, luggage stands, lounge chairs and tables. The attached bathrooms offer running water, regular washbasins and showers. While riding hats are provided, you’re recommended to bring your own gear. These programs use regular English saddles and tack, requiring basic riding ability. October to March is the best season to join this unique equestrian adventure in the enchanting landscapes of Rajasthan.

name: Kasbah Tamadot
intro: Marhaba! Step inside Sir Richard Branson’s Moroccan home: wander through verdant gardens and tiled courtyards, discover warm Berber hospitality, learn local traditions and take in the striking views of the spectacular Atlas Mountains from your room or suite. You won’t want to leave.

news_article.title: Escape to Kasbah Tamadot: A Luxury Retreat in the Atlas Mountains
news_article.description: Make Lifelong Memories in Morocco's Mountain Wilderness

postcards.name: Experience the Moroccan Spa and Intensive Massages
postcards.intro: Experience the Moroccan hammam and intensive massages at Kasbah Tamadot. From invigorating massages to cleansing rituals, each moment at the spa at Kasbah Tamadot is tailored to refresh both your body and mind, leaving you with a renewed sense of well-being and vitality. Come for a rejuvenating escape and celebrate the essence of Morocco in every soothing moment.
postcards.story:
A spa experience is refreshingly rejuvenating as it provides a dedicated sanctuary for self-care and relaxation. The soothing ambience, combined with expertly crafted treatments, creates a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. Asounfou, the Berber term for relaxation, perfectly captures what you'll experience at Kasbah Tamadot's spa. 

If you're looking for an authentic Moroccan ritual, you’re invited to try the hammam or treat yourself to a series of soothing face and body treatments. Immerse yourself in tradition with the genuine hammam experience, creating a welcoming pause for you. Here, you can take the time and space you need to unwind.

Indulge in a comprehensive cleansing ritual tailored just for you. Picture a full-body exfoliation, a nourishing body mask and a refreshing crystal face massage. Allow the tension to evaporate as you emerge from this experience feeling not just refreshed but completely rejuvenated and re-energised.

If you’re seeking a more intensive escape, the massage treatments target deeper tissue structures, addressing chronic muscle tension and knots. The skilled therapists, trained in these specialised techniques, use the power of specific Moroccan Glee Naturals products to release the pressure held in your muscles.

At Kasbah Tamadot, it's all about you and your relaxation journey. Asounfou is not just a word but an invitation to immerse yourself in the genuine, time-honoured spa experiences offered here. From the traditional hammam to the personalised massage treatments, every detail is designed with your relaxation and well-being in mind. 

Let the therapists guide you through a transformative experience, where the cares of the world dissolve, leaving you with a profound sense of tranquillity and renewal. You deserve this indulgence and Kasbah Tamadot truly ensures that every moment you spend here is tailored exclusively for you.

postcards.name: Stay in a Berber Tent at Kasbah Tamadot
postcards.intro: Moroccan hospitality is a warm embrace of tradition and generosity. Whether you choose a standard Berber tent or one with a hot tub, your experience here is defined by the charm of traditional Moroccan decor and the breathtaking landscapes that surround you. Cherish the unique experience of a tent stay and create lasting memories.
postcards.story:
Explore the diverse accommodations at Kasbah Tamadot, from rooms and suites to luxurious Berber Tents, each uniquely adorned with traditional Moroccan furnishings and antiques, including items from the extensive collection of former owner Luciano Tempo. Here, you can retreat to one of the ten available Berber Tents.

These tents are an atmospheric space capturing the romance and beauty of Morocco. Picture draped fabrics, traditional glass lanterns and majestic carved furniture, complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows framing the landscape. Your tent boasts a king-size bed, a spacious bathtub for soaking in mountain views and a private terrace with sun loungers. Relish captivating views of the Atlas Mountains and valley from your private terrace adorned with sun loungers and an outdoor dining area. Immerse yourself in a large bathtub and enjoy the convenience of a fully stocked complimentary minibar and bottled water. 

Step outside to an outdoor dining area, creating the perfect setting for magical evening meals – no tent pegs in sight! The only thing that could surpass a Berber Tent is a Berber Tent with its own hot tub. These expansive spaces deliver the decadence of the Berber Tents, featuring rich draped fabrics, carved wood accents and vast outdoor terraces overlooking the landscape.

What makes these tents even more special is the inclusion of a sunken outdoor hot tub – an ideal spot for you to unwind with a chilled glass of something sparkling while absorbing the panoramic views. Embrace the cultural touch with provided babouches, bernous, blankets and sunhats. The Berber Tents, each thoughtfully designed, offer you a unique and comfortable retreat amidst the Moroccan surroundings. Your stay in these enchanting accommodations is an invitation to immerse yourself in the amazing ambience of Morocco.

name: Ladakh Sarai
intro: Ladakh Sarai started with an erstwhile adventure travel company, Tiger tops in a Ladakhi Village by the name of Stok which lies below the mighty Stok Kangri Range next to the Stok Palace.

news_article.title: Experience Authentic Ladakhi Hospitality at Ladakh Sarai
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay Offering Majestic Views of the Himalayas

postcards.name: Explore the Beauty of Ladakhi Himalaya on a Mountain Bike
postcards.intro: Explore the enchanting landscapes of Ladakh on a thrilling mountain biking adventure with Ladakh Sarai. Nestled in the shadows of the majestic Ladakhi Himalayas, the region offers a diverse range of mountain biking options for all levels of enthusiasts. Whether you're seeking a leisurely ride of a few hours or an extended multi-day exploration, Ladakh Sarai has you covered.
postcards.story:
Cycling in the mountains is an exhilarating experience that combines the thrill of physical exertion with breathtaking natural beauty. Go on the Ladakh Sarai-Choglamsar-Palam-Ladakh Sarai route, spanning approximately 14 kilometres. This journey takes you along windswept trails and roads, with the refreshing mountain air accompanying you. As you descend to the Indus at Choglamsar, the ride is mostly effortless for about four kilometres. Crossing the Indus on its left bank, you'll cycle mostly flat for five kilometres, treating yourself to breathtaking views of Leh town, surrounding mountain ranges and villages as the sun sets. At Palam, take a break with a cup of tea and indulge in freshly baked cookies and muffins at Ladakh Sarai while witnessing the tranquil beauty of the sun going down. 

For a more extensive adventure, consider the Ladakh Sarai-Shey-Thiksey-Karu-Indus-Marstelang-Stakna-Chushot-Choglamsar route, covering 68 kilometres over five hours. This journey offers a mix of terrains, taking you down to Leh-Manali highway with minimal effort. Riding along the Indus, pass through the villages of Shey, Thiksey, Ranbirpur-Stakna and Karu. After crossing the Indus at Karu, a short uphill stretch towards Marstelang awaits. The return ride is mostly flat, with a challenging seven-kilometre ascending segment that requires some extra effort. Rest assured, Ladakh Sarai provides full support with a backup truck, ensuring your safety and comfort throughout the trip.

Your biking experience is enhanced with top-notch equipment, including well-maintained bikes from brands like Wheeler, Giant, Cannondale and GT. Helmets, a trail guide and a route guide are provided, along with a backup jeep stocked with tea, coffee, energy drinks and snacks. Whether you opt for a short, scenic ride or a longer, more challenging journey, Ladakh Sarai ensures a memorable mountain biking experience amidst the unparalleled beauty of Ladakh.

postcards.name: Immerse yourself in yoga practice amid the mountains
postcards.intro: Ladakh Sarai is committed to providing complimentary daily yoga sessions, catering to both beginners and advanced practitioners. Whether you're just starting or have a seasoned practice, these sessions are designed to inspire mindful travellers like you. Yoga amidst mountains creates a sublime synergy, merging the serenity of nature with the practice's meditative essence.
postcards.story:
The Ladakhi plateau breathes life into its vast expanse. The sky's breath swirls around the towering mountains and sweeps across the high desert. Meanwhile, the earth's breath rises through poplar trees and the green shoots of the garden. Ladakh Sarai integrates these natural flows into a dynamic and beautiful relationship with daily life. The origins of yoga, a vital practice, trace back to this landscape and peacefully flourishes here.

Begin your day by greeting the sun with mindful breaths, guided by experienced leaders in the yoga field. Enjoy nutritious meals sourced from the organic gardens, lovingly tended and prepared by the cheerful chefs. The Sarai grounds are thoughtfully designed for tranquillity, featuring a yoga pavilion for introspective journeys within. Take time to explore the cultural and wilderness areas nearby, each infused with mastery, spirit, power and culture.

Enjoy the opportunity to connect with the natural rhythm of the Ladakhi plateau during your stay. The breath of the sky and earth becomes a backdrop to your journey, guiding you towards mindfulness. The yoga pavilion within the serene Sarai grounds offers a space for you to centre yourself, surrounded by the raw beauty of the landscape.

Savour each meal, knowing it comes from the organic gardens, tended to with care and devotion. The chefs, motivated by joy, present you with delicious and healthy options. As you explore the cultural and wilderness areas surrounding Ladakh Sarai, immerse yourself in the essence of each location, enriched by a blend of tradition and nature.

Ladakh Sarai is a mindful retreat where the elements of the sky and earth converge. Whether you seek a quiet moment in the yoga pavilion or an adventure in the cultural and wilderness areas, let the natural flows of Ladakh inspire and rejuvenate you.

name: Craveiral Farmhouse
intro: 15 minutes from the beaches of Zambujeira do Mar and Carvalhal. It's where we're at home, away from home. Where there is always something to do, even if it is doing nothing.

news_article.title: Connect with Nature at Craveiral in Portugal's Sun-Splashed Alentejo
news_article.description: Where Luxury Meets Simplicity

postcards.name: Nurture your wellness at Craveiral Farmhouse
postcards.intro: Craveiral Farmhouse curates experiences that elevate your sense of wellness. From rejuvenating yoga classes to the soothing embrace of the sauna, each activity is designed to foster a deep connection with yourself. By making conscious choices to prioritise wellness, you’ll invest in long-term happiness, fostering a sense of purpose and fulfilment that extends far beyond the immediate moment.
postcards.story:
Prioritising wellness is of paramount importance as it serves as the cornerstone for a fulfilling and balanced life. In the fast-paced and demanding world we navigate, emphasising our well-being becomes an essential act of self-care. When we prioritise wellness, we are essentially acknowledging the interconnectedness of our physical, mental and emotional states.

Craveiral Farmhouse prioritises your well-being, aiming to create an environment where you can truly be yourself and embrace a sense of comfort and connection with others. Their commitment to fostering a space free from constraints and limitations reflects their dedication to enhancing your overall wellness.

Immerse yourself in a range of enriching experiences designed to elevate your sense of well-being. From the inviting pools, both indoor and outdoor, to the soothing ambience of the sauna, invigorating gym sessions and tranquil hammam, you’re offered a variety of amenities to cater to your individual needs. Indulge in the relaxation of the jacuzzi, explore the surrounding area with the bikes and unwind with rejuvenating massages. You can even engage in rejuvenating yoga classes and invigorating functional training or go on the scenic Vincentian route, discovering the beauty of the Santa Clara dam and the pristine beaches of the Alentejo Coast.

Here, the goal is to seamlessly integrate you into the Craveiral Farmhouse experience, allowing you to feel like an integral part of this unique journey that is distinctly yours. Prioritise your well-being with Craveiral and make the most of your time here by embracing the authenticity of Alentejo and the wholesome atmosphere you’re offered. Here, your path to wellness is not just a destination but a journey you can truly call your own. Prioritising wellness is an investment in ourselves, a commitment to leading a more vibrant, meaningful and enriching life.

postcards.name: Experience a Luxurious Stay in Nature at Craveiral Farmhouse
postcards.intro: In the unassuming yet extraordinary setting, Craveiral Farmhouse stands as a testament to the art of inventing a space that captures the essence of home, offering you a refuge where simplicity and luxury intertwine to create an unparalleled retreat. Craveiral is a unique haven, thoughtfully blending authenticity and modernity across its expansive nine-hectare domain.
postcards.story:
At Craveiral Farmhouse, the genuine warmth of hospitality coexists with the simplicity that defines true luxury. The atmosphere is such that one could almost imagine basking in the sunlit threshing floor or finding solace in the rhythmic sound of rain.

Nestled within this vast expanse are four distinct housing clusters, ranging from studios to two-bedroom homes. Each enclave is a beautiful combination of countryside charm and seaside tranquillity, offering a variety of typologies to suit your preferences. The landscape unfolds with three inviting pools, including a serene indoor option, a restaurant serving garden-fresh and organic fare, a nature interpretation center, an orchard and a lively animal farm.

At Craveiral, the feeling of being at home, yet away from home, prevails. It's a place where the art of hospitality lies in allowing you to simply be. Whether engaging in activities or savoring the luxury of doing nothing at all, there's a unique sense of belonging. Here, you can reap the rewards of your efforts, closing your eyes to feel the gentle breeze and inhaling the deep serenity that surrounds you.

Time at Craveiral flows at a pace of one's choosing, where the freedom to disconnect is as accessible as the earth beneath your feet. Opening windows to welcome in tranquility becomes second nature, as does the leisurely act of walking barefoot through herb-laden paths and retiring to fresh sheets, stretched out in repose.

This remarkable place, born out of necessity, finds its home amidst the stunning Alentejo Coast, near Zambujeira do Mar. Craveiral is a testament to the perfect synergy between nature's beauty and the comforts of modern living. It seamlessly blends the autonomy and privacy of an independent house with the assurance of attentive support whenever needed.

name: Dune Camp
intro: Positioned on the edge of a 250-metre high dune, Dune Camp has the most extraordinary views across the Namibrand Reserve.

news_article.title: Immerse Yourself in the African Wilderness at Dune Camp
news_article.description: Enjoy Extraordinary Views Across the NamibRand Reserve

postcards.name: Take a Scenic Drive from the Dune Camp for a Great Escape
postcards.intro: Scenic drives from Dune Camp allow you to be an active participant in the exploration of the NamibRand Reserve. Throughout your journey, you'll find yourself surrounded by the vastness of the plains, the mountains and the undulating patterns of the sand dunes. This journey will be all about connecting with the raw beauty of nature that unfolds around you.
postcards.story:
At Dune Camp, you’re guided through captivating scenic drives and get an opportunity to witness the stunning colours across the expansive plains, mountains and sand dunes of the NamibRand Reserve. You'll have a chance to absorb the beauty of the desert landscape, observing the vibrant shades that paint the surroundings. Throughout your journey, you'll gain insights into the lives of both small and large desert dwellers, understanding their relentless quest for survival.

As you traverse the reserve, you'll encounter diverse flora, ranging from resilient beauty to tenacious survivors. The landscapes unfold before you, revealing the intricate balance of nature in this arid environment. The experienced guides share their knowledge with you about the fascinating geology that shapes the NamibRand, providing you with a deeper understanding of the forces at play in crafting this unique terrain.

The exploration extends beyond mere observation, offering you the chance to learn about the survival strategies adopted by the various inhabitants of this desert landscape. From the smallest creatures to the larger dwellers, you'll gain insights into their adaptations and resilience in the face of challenging conditions. This firsthand knowledge provides a more profound connection to the intricate web of life in the NamibRand.

The guides are eager to share their understanding of the diverse flora that thrives in this harsh environment. From the delicate beauty of resilient plants to the hardy survivors that endure, you'll develop an appreciation for the richness of NamibRand's plant life.

This experience makes you appreciate the intricate processes that have sculpted the reserve over time. In every aspect of your journey from Dune Camp, you are invited to engage with and comprehend the unique facets that make NamibRand a captivating destination.

postcards.name: Sleep Peacefully in a Comfortable Tented Room
postcards.intro: Dune Camp at Wolwedans offers you exceptional accommodation for a memorable desert retreat. With comfortable tented rooms, it's ideal for families. Here, you’ll enjoy spacious interiors and stunning dune views. The simplicity and practicality make Dune Camp a great choice for you if you’re seeking comfort and immersive experiences in Namibia's breathtaking landscapes.
postcards.story:
Dune Camp accommodates a maximum of 16 guests, offering six tented rooms and a two-bed tented family suite. The tented rooms, placed on raised wooden platforms, provide comfortable and spacious lodging with twin or king-size beds. Each room is equipped with full indoor and outdoor bathrooms, excluding bathtubs. Outside, private decks invite you to relax, featuring the Wolwedans Chiller — small water-filled silos for cooling off in the hot summer months.

The tented family suite, located a short walk from the main camp over the dunes, is well-suited for families. Comprising two en-suite rooms and a children's sala room with two single beds. The family suite boasts a lounge, spacious deck and outdoor bathrooms.

Dune Camp's tented rooms offer a practical and comfortable stay on raised wooden platforms. The absence of flowery descriptions highlights the straightforward features, such as twin or King-size beds and full indoor and outdoor bathrooms. The private decks, part of each tented room, are perfect for lounging and include the refreshing Wolwedans Chiller to combat the summer heat.

For families, the tented family suite stands a brief walk from the main camp, providing a thoughtful arrangement. With two en-suite rooms and a children's sala room, the family suite accommodates everyone comfortably. The lounge and spacious deck offer you additional communal spaces, complemented by a soothing ambience.

In essence, Dune Camp offers you a mindful accommodation setup. The focus is on providing comfort, ensuring a relaxing stay. Whether you opt for a tented room with its private deck and Wolwedans Chiller or the family suite with communal spaces and additional amenities, the camp caters to diverse preferences within a simple and efficient framework.

name: Lengishu
intro: Some destinations simply touch your heart like no other. Playing our part in supporting rhino conservation on Borana Conservancy is a dream come true, born of an enduring passion for Kenya, its wildlife and its amazing people.

news_article.title: Lengishu is Your Kenyan Home Away from Home
news_article.description: A Luxurious and Environmentally Mindful Accommodation

postcards.name: Immerse Yourself in a Relaxing Stay at Lengishu
postcards.intro: Lengishu, boasting six elegantly designed bedrooms across four separate cottages, provides a tranquil retreat surrounded by the African wilderness. Each room offers you breathtaking sunrise views over the valley below, enhancing your experience. The thoughtful arrangement ensures privacy and a connection with nature, creating a serene ambience for a truly memorable stay.
postcards.story:
Lengishu, a luxury safari lodge located in Kenya, offers you an alternative to traditional accommodations by providing the privacy and adaptability of an exclusive family home. Distinguished by its friendly staff dedicated to meeting your every need, Lengishu enables you to forge your own itineraries, unburdened by the limitations of conventional safari lodges.

Constructed using locally sourced materials, the lodge integrates into its natural surroundings. The edifice, a reflection of the local craftsmanship, showcases exquisite Kenyan timber work and stone floors derived from the very site on which it stands. The interior aesthetic follows a tasteful palette of neutral tones, accentuated by touches of red paying homage to both the owner's Scottish roots and the vibrant culture of their Maasai neighbours.

Within Lengishu, you’ll find spacious bedrooms, each equipped with fireplaces or wood-burning stoves to combat cooler evenings. En-suite bathrooms boast rain showers and freestanding copper bathtubs, ensuring a luxurious retreat for you. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows frame panoramic views of the undulating plains beyond, inviting you to indulge in bathtub game viewing, a unique and immersive experience.

This exclusive family home epitomises a harmonious blend of comfort and sustainability, with a commitment to utilising indigenous resources. The lodge's reliance on local artisans not only highlights the skilled craftsmanship of the region but also underscores a dedication to minimising environmental impact.

When you visit Lengishu, you become an integral part of a community that values both cultural diversity and environmental responsibility. The lodge's design and ethos align seamlessly with the natural beauty that surrounds it, creating a serene and inviting shelter if you’re seeking a personalised and eco-conscious safari experience in Kenya.

postcards.name: Experience the Thrill of Biking around Lengishu
postcards.intro: If you indulge in an e-biking or mountain biking experience around Lengishu, you're in for an adventure tailored to your preferences. With e-bikes available, you can explore the hills and valleys at your own pace, peacefully enjoying the rugged terrain. If you're up for an adrenaline-fueled ride, a range of mountain bikes will make your journey seem effortless.
postcards.story:
At Lengishu, you have the freedom to tailor your biking experience according to your preferences. Whether you crave an action-packed adventure or a more laid-back safari encounter, Lengishu serves as a serene home base for both excitement and relaxation.

For the adventurous soul inside you, Lengishu offers a fleet of mountain bikes, promising an adrenaline-fueled exploration of the surrounding hills and valleys. This option isn't for the faint-hearted, as the hill climbs can be both lengthy and steep. However, it provides a unique opportunity to traverse long distances at your own pace, enveloped by the beauty of nature.
If you’re seeking a more effortless ride, Lengishu provides e-bikes, where a battery assists your pedalling efforts, making uphill climbs feel remarkably easy. 

You have the flexibility to adjust the level of assistance the battery provides, ensuring a truly exhilarating exploration of Borana Conservancy. Keep in mind that the use of e-bikes comes with an additional cost and this activity is facilitated by Wild Rides, an e-bike touring company operating within the Borana Conservancy.

The hills and valleys surrounding Lengishu present an ideal terrain for both traditional and e-bike excursions. These ventures offer you a unique perspective of Borana Conservancy, allowing you to connect intimately with its landscapes and wildlife. If the prospect of a heart-pounding ascent on a traditional mountain bike is not your preference, the e-bike option provides a more accessible yet equally thrilling experience.

To express your interest in this activity or gather more details, reach out to the reservations team. Lengishu is committed to ensuring your stay caters to your desires, whether you're an avid adventurer or someone seeking a more tranquil escape. Enjoy the freedom to engage as much or as little as you please, creating lasting memories in the heart of Borana Conservancy.

name: MANVĀR Kumat
intro: An oasis of luxury has been crafted in the vivid dunes, inspired by the indigenous Kumat trees that you see all around you, where wind and sand dance together to create fluidic patterns. 100 acres of private estate, proliferated with indigenous scrub in the heart of Thar is home to MANVĀR Kumat, Khagan of Luxury Camps.

news_article.title: Experience Rural Rajasthan at MANVĀR Kumat Thar Serenity Camp
news_article.description: An Elegant Desert Camp in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Explore the Diverse Fauna of the Thar
postcards.intro: Your presence at MANVĀR is not just a beautiful journey but a commitment to respecting nature's rhythm and contributing to the sustainability of the desert's fauna and unique life forms. The Thar's ancient communities hold a wealth of traditional knowledge, inviting you to appreciate the interconnectedness of all living things and the importance of responsible travel.
postcards.story:
The Thar desert, a vast sea of sand, invites explorers and adventurers with its ever-changing dune-scapes. Its allure is unparalleled, serving as the gateway to the Indian Silk Road and weaving a narrative that is India's own. Beyond its historical significance, the Thar stands as the world's most diverse and rich desert ecosystem, fostering a delicate balance that’s exceptionally inspiring.

As you traverse the landscape near MANVĀR camp, you'll find yourself immersed in the intricate web of life that calls the Thar home. The fauna here, comprising 68 species of large animals, is a testament to the desert's unique biodiversity. Among them, the chinkara (Indian gazelle), nilgai, desert fox and Asiatic desert cat thrive in this arid yet vibrant environment. The ecosystem's intricacies extend to specialised rodents, lizards, monitor lizards, rabbits, hedgehogs and mongoose, each playing a crucial role in maintaining the delicate equilibrium.

Protected by the Indian Wildlife Act, these creatures find refuge in the desert fringes, creating oasis-like sanctuaries. This haven extends to the skies, where avifauna, both indigenous and migratory, flock undisturbed by human activities. Harriers, falcons, buzzards, kestrels and vultures soar above, while sand grouse and peacocks grace the landscape. Birders from around the globe seek out the famed Demoiselle cranes and their feeding grounds at Khichan, adding a touch of global significance to this pristine desert environment.

As you explore the Thar, mindful luxury travellers like you are reminded of the need for stringent protection under the law to ensure the preservation of this fragile ecosystem. Enjoy the raw beauty of the desert and let its diverse ecosystem inspire you to tread lightly on an inspiring journey.

postcards.name: Enjoy a Desert Safari in the Golden Sand of the Thar Desert
postcards.intro: Going on a jeep safari in the Thar desert is an exhilarating adventure. The relentless sun beats down on the vast, arid landscape as the sturdy jeep navigates through the sandy terrain. The ride can be bumpy and dusty, providing a true off-road experience, where the unobstructed views of the barren surroundings offer you a stark contrast to urban life.
postcards.story:
Experience the exhilaration of a rugged four-wheel-drive desert excursion in the Thar desert, navigating through its challenging terrain. The enthralling drive involves scrambling over dunes and crests, providing an authentic taste of the desert's wild character. You’ll inevitably encounter moments of getting stuck in the sand, adding a touch of adventure to your journey. The thrill lies in digging out from these situations, relishing the soft sand beneath your feet before continuing the drive.

Go on a leisurely hour and a half desert safari, a key highlight of MANVĀR experiences, offering you a glimpse into Rajasthan's diverse wildlife. Witness the elegant chinkara and its harem, gracefully navigating the desert landscape. Keep a keen eye out for the rare desert fox, a species exclusive to this region and observe herds of chinkara as they seek out watering holes in the arid expanse. Delve into the sands to uncover fascinating creatures like the saw scaled vipers and sand boas, showcasing the unique biodiversity of the Jodhpur and Jaisalmer desert.

This desert excursion promises an unparalleled adventure, providing an authentic and unfiltered experience of Rajasthan's natural beauty. The blend of excitement and discovery defines this desert safari, making it an essential part of your MANVĀR experience.

In the heart of the Thar desert, the MANVĀR desert safari offers you an exploration of the region's rich ecosystem. The rugged charm of the terrain unfolds before you, offering a glimpse into the intricate balance of life in the desert. Here, each sighting adds depth to your understanding of the unique flora and fauna that call this harsh environment home. So, rev up your four-wheel-drive jeep and go on an unforgettable journey through the untamed beauty of the Thar desert.

name: Mihir Garh
intro: From village safaris to royal picnics, from the novel experience of riding some of the finest specimens of Marwari horses, to watching a pronking Antelope, or simply gazing at the magnificent night sky after a Shikar Dinner, Mihir Garh will keep you yearning for more.

news_article.title: Discover Royal Indulgence at the House of Rohet's Mihir Garh
news_article.description: A Luxury Boutique Escape in Rajasthan's Thar Desert

postcards.name: Stay Comfortably in the Suites of Mihir Garh
postcards.intro: In the suites at Mihir Garh, you'll experience a unique blend: modern conveniences in a city steeped in tradition and plush furnishings against the backdrop of a barren landscape. Your experience here is a true indulgence amid the expansive wilderness. The suites at Mihir Garh adapt to your needs, whether you seek solitude, intimacy, opulence or meditation.
postcards.story:
In the serene expanse of Mihir Garh, you'll discover a unique combination of contemporary comfort set against the backdrop of the culturally rich city of Jodhpur. The paradoxical harmony of modern amenities amidst traditional landscapes defines your experience, where plush furnishings meet the vast wilderness, offering you sheer indulgence.

Here, there are nine splendid suites, each generously providing more than 1700 square feet of personal space. Alishan, the ground-floor suites, boast individual plunge pools and courtyards. On the first floor, Shandar suites feature open-air jacuzzis and private terraces. Named after the legendary stallions Alishan and Shandar from the Rohet stables, these spaces embody luxury within simplicity.

Every suite is a labour of love, thoughtfully crafted by the dedicated team. Handpicked furnishings, carefully chosen down to the smallest detail, adorn each space. The unique plaster flooring, a well-kept regional secret, is a testament to the exclusive touch Mihir Garh exudes. Executed by a skilled artisan and his assistant, these floors symbolise the dedication invested in creating a distinctive experience for mindful travellers like you.

To ensure your absolute comfort, each suite is equipped with modern amenities – flat-screen TVs, DVDs, tea and coffee stations and mini-bars. However, tradition is seamlessly woven into this contemporary property. Handcrafted fireplaces, the work of local women from neighbouring villages, add a rustic charm to every room, creating a balanced fusion of the past and present.

Mihir Garh's suites are designed to be versatile, adapting to your needs – whether seeking solitude or intimacy, opulence or meditation. Your experience is the priority here, from furnishings to linen, this boutique property strives to provide you with the very best. Mihir Garh invites you to immerse yourself in mindful luxury, offering you a sanctuary where the essence of tradition gracefully converges with modern sophistication.

postcards.name: Join a Village Safari Near Mihir Garh
postcards.intro: Since 1988, the village safari has remained a flagship experience at Mihir Garh, offering you a deep dive into the cultural soul of the region. Delve into the heart of village life as you interact with local communities, witness traditional customs and discover the vibrant crafts of the region. Come and immerse yourself in this genuine and heartfelt experience.
postcards.story:
The village safari goes beyond a mere tour, encapsulating the essence of the land. As you go on this journey, you'll find yourself immersed in the warmth of the local community, witnessing diverse customs, ceremonies and the richness of local crafts. It's an intimate encounter with the locals, a rare privilege that allows you to step into the homes of the gracious hosts.

At the heart of the safari is an encounter with the Bishnois, revered as the premier ecologists of the world. For over 500 years, they have safeguarded nature, playing a crucial role in preserving species like the black buck antelope, now a rare and protected species. The unique bond between the Bishnois and the antelope, where trust is displayed in proximity to their habitation, unfolds before you, offering a glimpse into a harmonious coexistence.

The journey introduces you to the Raikas, shepherds adorned in splendid costumes, and the Paliwals and Meghwals, the Brahmin farmers and weavers. It's a mosaic of lives, each contributing to the cultural richness of the region. What makes this tour truly exceptional is the special rapport the host family shares with the local communities. This connection grants you rare access into the homes of these diverse communities, where you are not just a guest but welcomed as one of their own.

This Village Safari is not just a glimpse into the past but is also an opportunity to connect with your roots. It allows you to understand and experience a way of life that brings you closer to the core of existence. As you traverse through the cultural landscapes, you are invited to appreciate the authenticity of this experience – a unique mix of tradition and hospitality that defines the very soul of Rajasthan.

name: Spice Village
intro: Spice Village is modelled on the dwellings of the native Manan tribe of this region and exudes the raw spirit of unblemished nature. This CGH Earth experience is a seamless extension of the verdant landscape around and celebrates all things spice: be it our unique spice-enriched culinary offerings or the spice tours.

news_article.title: Experience Eco Living at Spice Village in Kerala
news_article.description: Stay Peacefully Amidst a Lush Spice Garden

postcards.name: Savour the flavourful South Indian cuisine
postcards.intro: Spice Village, part of the CGH Earth group, offers you a culinary experience that reflects the rich diversity of Indian cuisine. The focus here is on authentic, traditional dishes that capture the essence of Indian home-cooked meals. The food here is known for its rich flavours, with spices playing a prominent role in enhancing the taste of each dish.
postcards.story:
South Indian cuisine is renowned for its aromatic flavours, largely owing to the skilful use of a distinctive blend of spices. These spices play a pivotal role in elevating the taste profile of South Indian dishes, making them a sensory delight for you. The chefs at the Spice Village skillfully balance the use of spices, ensuring that the flavours are intense but not overpowering. From aromatic curries to simple yet flavourful vegetarian options, the menu caters to a wide range of palates.

One notable aspect of the cuisine at Spice Village is the emphasis on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. This commitment to quality is evident in the taste and texture of the dishes. The menu includes a variety of meat and vegetarian options, allowing you to explore the culinary traditions that reflect the diverse offerings of Indian food.

You’ll feel satisfied in knowing that nearly all the ingredients in the food come from nearby places. The 50 Mile restaurant adheres to a diet where ingredients are sourced within 50 miles of the resort, emphasising Spice Village’s dedication to sustainability. This approach results in gourmet dishes made exclusively from locally sourced elements.
