This commitment to local sourcing ensures freshness and nutrition in the dishes, while also contributing to the well-being of nearby communities. Moreover, it helps the hotel minimise its carbon footprint by reducing the need for extensive transportation. Most of the vegetables are grown in-house at the organic farms and the fish is sourced fresh from the nearby rivers.

Additionally, the Tamarind Restaurant features a buffet where experienced chefs use exotic spices and aromatic herbs from the region, presenting bold flavours with a modern twist. It's a mindful culinary experience, complemented by the serene setting of a candle-lit dinner in the heart of the wilderness.

postcards.name: Immerse yourself in a spice plantation visit
postcards.intro: Located in the heart of the lush Western Ghats, Spice Village offers you a unique and immersive experience if you’re seeking a deeper connection with nature and the rich cultural heritage of spice plantations. A visit to the spice plantation is a wonderful experience in the world of spices that have shaped Kerala's culinary history.
postcards.story:
When you stay at the Spice Village, you can take a day trip to a nearby pepper plantation. Walk through the rows of vines climbing on trellises. The right time to pluck the peppercorns is when they start to turn red, just before full ripening. You can give it a try, but make sure to wash your hands before touching your eyes or nose. Walk past the mats where the picked peppercorns are left to dry. The scent of pepper mixes with the fresh mountain air. This marks the beginning of the centuries-old spice trade and the distinct flavour that influences foods globally.

As you step into the vibrant greenery of the plantation, the air becomes infused with the aroma of cardamom, cinnamon, pepper and other spices. Knowledgeable guides lead you through the lush groves, unravelling the stories behind each spice and sharing the intricate methods of cultivation and harvesting. You have the opportunity to witness the various stages of spice production, from the tender saplings to the fully matured plants, offering a comprehensive understanding of the labour-intensive process involved.

The plantation visit is not merely an educational tour but is also a sensory extravaganza. You can touch, smell and taste the raw spices, gaining a hands-on experience that enhances your appreciation for the flavours that grace your culinary adventures. The interactive nature of the tour allows you to pluck fresh spices from the plants, engaging in the ancient art of spice harvesting under the guidance of local experts.

The generous use of spices not only enhances the taste of your food but also contributes to the vibrant colours that characterise South Indian dishes. The combination of these spices, along with others like cumin, coriander and cardamom, creates intricate spice blends that form the backbone of iconic South Indian dishes.

name: Maison Perumal
intro: Maison Perumal is a period bungalow that we had the privilege to turn into a distinguished boutique hotel. Located in the Tamil quarter of Pondicherry, this 18th-century house exudes a legacy that reflects the French colonial aura of this small seaside town, known for its alluring history, spiritual culture, imaginative crafts, trendy shopping and gourmet food.

news_article.title: Stay in a Franco-Tamil Heritage Property at Maison Perumal
news_article.description: A Boutique Hotel Showcasing the Charm of its Rich Heritage

postcards.name: Taste authentic South Indian delicacies at Maison Perumal
postcards.intro: Characterised by its diverse range of dishes, South Indian cuisine is a celebration of the region's cultural heritage and culinary ingenuity. Maison Perumal, much like all CGH Earth properties, places a strong emphasis on locally sourced produce, ranging from yams and okra to drumsticks. This commitment is evident in the culinary offerings, where locally-grown ingredients are top choices.
postcards.story:
One of the culinary highlights at Maison Perumal is the opportunity to savour the finest Franco-Tamil cuisine in town. This culinary fusion reflects a blend of French and Tamil influences, creating a distinctive and flavourful dining experience. If you have an interest in food history, there's an exclusive chance to delve into the intricacies of local cuisine. Engage in a live cooking session with the chef for a personal initiation into the culinary secrets and techniques employed in the preparation of regional dishes.

The objective of Maison Perumal is clear — to celebrate and promote the distinct culinary traditions of the various regions in which CGH Earth establishments are situated. Even seemingly familiar dishes like pasta receive a local twist, featuring elements such as tiny prawns, fish, chillies, garlic and the chef's unique blend of regional spices.

To further immerse yourself in the local culinary scene, Maison Perumal offers you a unique experience — accompanying the chef to the Goubert market, a historical landmark in Puducherry. Here, you can join the chef in selecting the day's fresh seafood, aromatic spices and herbs, directly from the market. This hands-on engagement adds an authentic touch to your culinary journey, allowing you to witness and be a part of the selection process for the ingredients that will grace your meals during your stay.

Among the local delicacies to be tasted is the Karivepillai Fish, a Tamil Nadu speciality. This dish involves wrapping fresh fish with a curry leaf paste before grilling, resulting in a flavourful and aromatic delicacy. It's a prime example of Maison Perumal's commitment to showcasing the rich and diverse flavours of the region, ensuring that you have a genuine and immersive culinary experience during your visit.

postcards.name: Stay in a Beautiful Heritage Mansion
postcards.intro: Maison Perumal takes pride in offering you a comfortable stay, where the spirit of Southern India is embodied in the details. The well-arranged rooms offer you a simple and welcoming atmosphere. Your room is equipped with all the essentials, ensuring a hassle-free stay. You’ll wholeheartedly experience the essence of Indian hospitality during your stay here.
postcards.story:
When you stay at Maison Perumal, you'll find that the accommodation is designed with your comfort in mind. The rooms are thoughtfully arranged, offering you a pleasant and welcoming atmosphere that allows you to unwind after a day of exploration. The simplicity of the decor is intentional, providing you with a space where you can easily feel yourself at home. 

Staying in a traditional Tamil home used to be a highly respected experience. Guests were considered part of the family and treated with great kindness. Maison Perumal aims to recreate this special atmosphere, making you feel like a welcomed member of their family. They embrace a simple and relaxed lifestyle that reflects the gracious guest traditions of Tamil Nadu with a subtle French influence, providing a truly enriching experience.

The attention to detail in the furnishings ensures that you have everything you need within arm's reach, making your stay convenient and enjoyable. The period furniture at Maison Perumal represents the simplicity and elegance of prosperous Tamil households in the past. The stained glass balconies add a unique touch to the local white plaster houses. In keeping with tradition and the appreciation for uniqueness, the rooms are equipped with the renowned Dindigul locks and keys, known for their antique and intricate designs.

The staff at Maison Perumal goes out of their way to make sure you feel comfortable and cared for. Whether you have a special request or simply need information about the local area, they are there to assist you. The unassuming charm of the accommodation reflects a commitment to providing you with a genuine and unpretentious experience. When you choose Maison Perumal for your stay, you can expect a thoughtful blend of comfort and luxury that ensures a pleasant and memorable visit.

name: Kamara House
intro: Opened in May 2023, the exclusive-use Kamara House is the newest luxury safari accommodation in the Thornybush Nature Reserve and is part of Game Lodge’s refurbishment. A private house overlooking a small riverbed, it’s perfect for multigenerational families or small groups.

news_article.title: Experience the African Wilderness at Thornybush’s Kamara House
news_article.description: A Luxury Safari Lodge in South Africa

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Luxury Safari Wedding at Kamara House
postcards.intro: The Kamara House, with its open spaces and delightful elegance, becomes a sanctuary where moments of joy and connection take centre stage. The simple yet profound beauty of the African landscape becomes a silent witness to the vows exchanged, grounding the celebration in the heart of Thornybush.
postcards.story:
At Kamara House, you find yourself immersed in a world where time slows down and the air is filled with the sweet scent of anticipation. As you approach your venue, the rustling leaves and distant calls of native birds create a natural symphony, setting the stage for a celebration that immerses you in nature. The sun dips low on the horizon, casting a warm glow on the sprawling landscape that unfolds before you.

You stand under the age-old acacia tree, its branches gently swaying in rhythm with the gentle breeze. The earth beneath your feet, adorned with indigenous flowers, cradles the footsteps of family and friends who gather to witness a union that mirrors the eternal beauty of Thornybush. Kamara House, with its rustic charm, becomes a homey place for the unfolding of your love story — a tale told not only through vows but also through the whispers of the surrounding wilderness.

Few occasions compare to exchanging your sacred vows in the vast African wilderness, surrounded by nature and loved ones. At Thornybush, you and your guests are offered an unforgettable Kruger Park safari wedding experience, complete with amazing animal sightings, breathtaking sunsets and open-air dance floors beneath the expansive starlit sky.

From the initial planning stages to the final preparations, the dedicated teams at the luxury safari lodge will go the extra mile to ensure your safari wedding is nothing short of extraordinary. Thornybush's luxury safari lodges can accommodate up to 60 guests. Depending on the size of your wedding party, Kamara House can be exclusively used, creating an intimate and memorable reception setting.

With daily airline connections from major South African cities and just over a five-hour drive from Johannesburg, Thornybush offers an easily accessible wedding destination for both you and your guests.

postcards.name: Enjoy an Immersive Game Drive Experience
postcards.intro: The game drives at Thornybush are exceptionally exhilarating, leaving you with amazing memories of a safari experience that goes beyond the ordinary. Whether it's the stealthy movements of a leopard on the prowl or the distant calls of hyenas echoing through the darkness, the game drives become an unforgettable narrative of the wild.
postcards.story:
Begin your day with a safari at Thornybush with the soothing melody of early birdsong, marking the dawn of your exploration. Following a cup of morning coffee, go on an open-air safari vehicle to uncover the events that unfolded in the bush overnight.

The optimal time for game viewing is during the cool morning hours. Guided by the expert teams, you'll come across the famous Big Five and other animals. The guides at Thornybush go beyond the iconic animals, taking a moment to appreciate the smaller wonders of the bush – from vibrant birds perched on branches to the intricate patterns of animal tracks in the soil. 

There's a genuine enthusiasm to share the wealth of knowledge about the ecosystem, creating a deeper connection with the surroundings. A coffee break allows you to stretch your legs and have a discussion about the morning's sightings before returning to the safari lodge for breakfast.

Consider joining an afternoon game drive after a day of poolside relaxation, rest and alfresco lunch. Tea marks the beginning of the afternoon drive through the Greater Kruger Park. As daylight softens, game viewing becomes a delight for photographers. Lions napping in the shade, wild dogs on the hunt, a group of zebras in the dust or a majestic bird of prey circling overhead — each moment unfolds in the softening light.

After enjoying drinks and witnessing the sunset at one of the stunning viewpoints, the nocturnal wildlife takes centre stage. Guides shift focus to the excitement of spotting an elusive leopard silently traversing a moonlit riverbed or lions moving in the darkness, accompanied by distant hyena laughter. Your game drive experience surely becomes a captivating narrative of the wild.

name: Shahpura Bagh
intro: Look beyond the beaten track amid the golden sands of Rajasthan and you will glimpse an oasis - A dazzling shimmer of sunshine on water that hovers on the edge of a mirage. Drive on. This is timeless Rajasthan - untouched by the creeping fingers of ‘modernity’ - unchanged in its unpretentious natural grandeur.

news_article.title: Explore Shahpura Bagh in the Vibrant Landscape of Rajasthan
news_article.description: Celebrate Life at an Unhurried Pace in India

postcards.name: Indulge in the Dhikola Dining Experience at Shahpura Bagh
postcards.intro: Rajadhiraj Umaid Singhji had a discerning palate and a true appreciation for good food. In the culinary haven of Shahpura, you have the privilege of choosing from diverse options. Whether it's the authentic, home-cooked Rajasthani dishes prepared over a crackling wood fire or the well-crafted continental and traditional meals, each dish is tailored to satisfy your taste buds.
postcards.story:
Rajasthani cuisine is a rich and flavourful reflection of the cultural heritage of the vibrant desert state of Rajasthan. Renowned for its royal grandeur, Rajasthan boasts distinct and enduring culinary traditions that have persisted over time.

Considered one of the finest dining experiences in Rajasthan, Shahpura boasts tables laden with refined, homemade recipes passed down through generations. The head chef, with a culinary journey spanning three generations of the family, brings expertise honed in some of Jodhpur's top hotels. Accompanying him are skilled assistants, trained in the art of Tandoori cuisine through apprenticeships at luxury hotels in Jodhpur.

Shahpura takes pride in offering you delightfully light vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals. Many of the vegetables used are homegrown and organic, adding a fresh and wholesome touch to the culinary delights served at this gastronomic oasis.

As the sun sets over Shahpura, the evening begins with refreshing sundowners on the well-lit ramparts of Fort Dhikola, showcasing its architectural intricacy against the night sky. Perched high above, you can enjoy stunning views of the lakes and the village below. 

Savour a bottle of champagne under the night sky full of stars. You’ll love the attentive service of a private attendant and the company of one of their knowledgeable naturalists. This exclusive setting is designed to provide you with a private haven for a romantic evening or to create cherished moments with your family and friends.

Featuring secret recipes from the royal kitchens, the dramatic ramparts reflect the glow of fire-lit torches and sunsets paint the sky. Your experience is enhanced with a private dinner of regional delicacies against the backdrop of this 400-year-old fort. These private dinners will captivate your heart making you feel special. It's a truly unique and unforgettable experience.

postcards.name: Stay in a Luxury Villa Suite at Shahpura Bagh
postcards.intro: Surrounded by the tranquil beauty of two lakes and enhanced by the lush charm of Neem, Ashoka, Peepal and Mango trees, Shahpura Bagh stands as an exceptional oasis. The ambience of a Luxury Villa Suite is a blend of regality and modern comforts, creating an atmosphere that is both grand and welcoming.
postcards.story:
Rajasthani hospitality offers warmth, tradition and an unwavering commitment to making you feel special. Shahpura Bagh nestles in the heart of Rajasthan, offering you an unparalleled blend of luxury and heritage. Indulge in the lavish ambience of Shahpura Bagh, where its 11 bedrooms are exquisitely appointed. These accommodations are thoughtfully equipped with modern amenities to enhance your experience. Each room boasts a distinctive design, adorned with antiques and opulent fabrics. Immerse yourself in comfort with crisp white linens, plump pillows and luxurious Vispring beds, ensuring a restful night's sleep.

Highlighting a minimalistic approach, every suite and bathroom has been designed with a unique colour scheme, striking the perfect balance between space, luxury and comfort. Here, you’re offered five Royal Suites, four Suites and two Luxury Villa Suites, each promising a personalised and elegant retreat for an amazing experience.

The Luxury Villa Suite is a breathtaking two-bedroom villa situated next to the pool, perfect for families and friends seeking an exceptional experience. Meticulously crafted for utmost privacy, the villa features two sophisticated suites, each spanning 1200 square feet. Enhancing the charm of your stay is an outdoor shower, a secluded verandah offering scenic views and a luminous courtyard exuding a bright and airy ambience. 
From the vibrant decor that reflects Rajasthan's royal history to the aromatic waft of traditional cuisine that invites from every corner, every aspect of Rajasthani hospitality is curated to evoke a sense of cultural immersion. Step outside your room into a world of enchantment, where winding walking trails trace the lakeside. Discover idyllic spots adorned with hammocks and charpoys, offering you perfect havens to unwind, read, meditate or witness breathtaking sunsets. 

Whether you're yearning for quality family moments or seeking a space to strengthen bonds with friends, this retreat is tailor-made for an unforgettable getaway.

name: Kipling Camp
intro: Kipling Camp is the perfect destination for those who wish to relax in idyllic surroundings and explore the remote forests and villages of central India. Over the years, the Camp has moved gently with the times, without spoiling its magical atmosphere.

news_article.title: Tread Softly in the Jungle at Kipling Camp
news_article.description: A Premier Wildlife Camp in India

postcards.name: Meet Tara, a Famous Asian Elephant
postcards.intro: When you’re at Kipling Camp, the beloved elephant Tara will capture a special place in your heart. The joy of strolling with her down to the Banjar River and participating in her afternoon bathing ritual will be a cherished experience for you. Tara resides in her grand 'palace' at the camp and will be happy to see you.
postcards.story:
Tara stands as an iconic figure among Asian elephants globally, capturing the spotlight at the renowned Kipling Camp. Interacting with Tara offers you a rare opportunity to connect with a living legend, whose captivating journey is chronicled in Mark Shand's bestselling book, ‘Travels on my Elephant’. You’ll be drawn to Kipling, not just for its scenic charm but for the enchanting presence of Tara. 

Many newfound friends reluctantly bid farewell to Kipling Camp, their hearts touched and eyes misty from the emotional connection forged with remarkable Tara. Tara's life began as a begging elephant, scraping together a livelihood for herself and her caretakers. In a heartwarming turn of events in 1989, Mark Shand and Aditya Patankar came to Tara's rescue, purchasing her in Odisha. Mark, displaying remarkable gentleness, went on an extraordinary journey with Tara, covering several hundred miles to reach the Sonepur Mela — an immense annual animal fair in Bihar. 

Accompanied by a jeep laden with provisions and delicacies, and guided by Aditya and a mahout, their expedition unfolded into a captivating tale detailed in Mark's book. Setting up a camp at Sonepur, Mark, adorned in a dhoti, prepared to auction Tara to the highest bidder. Amidst numerous offers, Tara's unique docility set her apart in a crowd of more challenging elephants. Mark gifted Tara to the Wright family, the owners of Kipling Camp, ensuring she would find joy and refuge at Kipling Camp instead of enduring a life of labour. While you're at the camp, make sure to meet Tara and capture a memorable moment by being photographed with her.

postcards.name: Stay in a Relaxed Accommodation Surrounded by Nature
postcards.intro: A stay at Kipling Camp is truly worthwhile. The accommodation, featuring comfortable cottages with scenic views and essential amenities, enhances your overall sense of comfort and relaxation. Whether it's the captivating tales shared around the campfire in the evenings or the immersive experiences like massages, every aspect of a stay at Kipling Camp is carefully curated for you.
postcards.story:
Kipling Camp stands out as a family-owned and operated retreat, distinguished by its intimate, homely atmosphere, ensuring a personal touch for you. The camp is committed to addressing your every need. Here, the accommodation offers you comfort in two-to-four-room cottages, each featuring a private verandah with views of the camp and the surrounding forest. The rooms have twin or double beds, tea/coffee-making facilities and tiled ensuite bathrooms with showers. Heaters and hot water bottles are provided during winter, while coolers or air-conditioners are available in the summer. 

Kipling Camp warmly welcomes families as it provides an ideal setting for children to discover the wonders of nature and have their initial wildlife encounters. Here, there are 15 double rooms, including 11 deluxe rooms (four with double beds) and four standard rooms with twin beds. You’ll particularly enjoy the Private Cottage, which includes a bedroom, sitting room, two bathrooms and a patio overlooking the waterhole.

Throughout the camp, there are various comfortable areas for you to relax, including a well-stocked library with wildlife, research books and novels. A hammock provides the perfect spot for you to unwind. If you enjoy playing sports, step out of your room and walk to the volleyball court that comes to life every afternoon. 

To minimise environmental impact, Kipling has implemented a water filter system for safe drinking water and ice, eliminating the need for plastic bottles. With a rich history spanning decades in the region, coupled with a steadfast commitment to wildlife and the local community, the camp offers you a distinctive and deeply personal encounter amid the wilderness of Kanha Tiger Reserve. A stay at Kipling Camp is an opportunity for you to connect with nature and embrace the warmth of a truly hospitable environment.

name: The Alpina Gstaad
intro: Welcome to a true Alpine hideaway, a discreet and personalized hotel experience. Comfort, privacy, artistry and tradition live together harmoniously. Come and make them your own.

news_article.title: The Alpina Gstaad
news_article.description: Cosy up in a Winter Wonderland Nestled in the Bernese Alps

postcards.name: Join a Tibetan Healing Retreat at the Six Senses Spa
postcards.intro: When you’re at The Alpina Gstaad, you cannot miss visiting the Six Senses Spa. The three-day, four-night Tibetan Healing Retreat at the spa is designed to help you alleviate stress through daily meditation and Tibetan Yoga breathing, providing a positive start to your day. This retreat is available to you as a guest of The Alpina Gstaad throughout the year.
postcards.story:
Wellness matters because it encompasses the holistic state of physical, mental and emotional well-being. Taking proactive steps towards wellness means acknowledging the interconnectedness of these aspects and understanding that a balanced and healthy lifestyle contributes to a more fulfilling life.

In Tibet, people follow an esoteric philosophy that touches every aspect of life, emphasising the interconnectedness of the body, mind and nature. According to this tradition, the universe is formed by the primary five elements: Air, Water, Fire, Earth, and Space. These elements give rise to three humours, namely Wind, Bile and Phlegm. Achieving well-being, prosperity and spiritual fulfilment in Tibetan culture involves maintaining a balance among these humours. This equilibrium is achieved through proper nourishment, lifestyle choices, herbal remedies and external treatments. 

The Tibetan Healing Retreat at Six Senses Spa is a soothing experience that promises unparalleled peace and rejuvenation in the heart of the Swiss Alps. When you consult with a practitioner, they typically assess your body constitution through visual observation, pulse reading and questioning. Based on this evaluation, they recommend specific treatments and lifestyle adjustments tailored to your individual needs.

You'll kick off the retreat with a 60-minute wellness screening based on Tibetan healing knowledge, followed by a session of Tibetan sound healing and a Kunye massage incorporating Hor-Me, small warm herbal poultices. On the final day, you'll experience Tsalung therapy, aimed at restoring your subtle wind and energy flow system and normalising any blocked channels. 

Throughout the program, you'll engage in daily sessions of meditation and Tibetan Yoga breathing to foster a sense of calm. The itinerary also includes a Six Senses Signature Massage called Tension Soother, a Yoga Nidra session and an indulgent Alchemy facial. Each element is thoughtfully curated to contribute to your overall relaxation and rejuvenation during this three-day retreat.

postcards.name: Taste the Smokey Takezaru at the Japanese Whisky Bar
postcards.intro: Savouring whisky at The Alpina Gstaad Hotel promises to be an exceptional experience, mindfully blending luxury with authenticity. Indulging in the Smokey Takezaru promises a delightful experience for you. Set amidst the picturesque Swiss Alps, this esteemed establishment offers not just a drink, but a journey — a journey through the nuanced flavours and rich heritage of whisky.
postcards.story:
Nestled within Megu, a distinctive space awaits, exclusively dedicated to the realm of Japanese whisky. The Whisky Bar, adorned with well-crafted wood shingles, invites both connoisseurs and enthusiasts into an atmosphere of unparalleled intimacy. The skilled bar hosts have thoughtfully curated an exquisite selection of Japanese whiskies, proudly showcased behind the bar. 

The Japanese Whisky Bar boasts some of the world's most exclusive bottles, including unique types not found elsewhere in Switzerland. The Alpina Gstaad is delighted to offer you access to Switzerland's premier collection of Japanese whiskies, currently featuring more than 40 distinct types. 

Inspired by Switzerland's largest Japanese Whisky Collection, the Smokey Takezaru is a classic after-dinner indulgence for a delightful gathering with friends. Presented in the iconic old-fashioned glass, this whisky concoction blends the rich flavours of Japanese whisky with the nuanced notes of smoked Martini Rosso and Bianco infused with Italian botanicals and plums. The scarlet-hued vermouth, along with the sweet-sour maraschino liqueur, imparts a distinctive taste, complemented by hints of coriander and angostura bitters. Elevate your experience by garnishing the glass with the enticing aroma of clove-smoked orange zest. This carefully crafted recipe captures the essence of Switzerland's remarkable Japanese whisky collection, offering you a memorable experience.

With The Alpina Gstaad’s thoughtfully curated whisky selection and unparalleled ambience, each sip you take becomes a moment of discovery and delight. The Smokey Takezaru is a sensory journey that captures the essence of craftsmanship and sophistication. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or a curious novice, the unique setting and unparalleled attention to detail at The Alpina Gstaad elevate your whisky-tasting experience, creating memories that last long after your glass is empty.

name: Basata Eco-Lodge
intro: Established by Sherif El-Ghamrawy in 1986, Basata preserves in many different ways the environment and supports the local community.  Its concept and design are reflected in its name which means simplicity in Arabic. Basata attempts to create a simple and unique form of tourism that has a relatively low impact on the surrounding environment and native inhabitants.

news_article.title: Celebrating Ecotourism at Basata Eco-Lodge
news_article.description: A Nature-Dependent Tourist Lodge in Egypt

postcards.name: Stay in Beautifully Designed Bamboo Huts at Basata Eco Lodge
postcards.intro: Embracing the ethos of simplicity and a close connection to the sea, the thoughtfully designed huts at Basata Eco Lodge prioritise natural and simple living. Step inside and you'll discover a thoughtful blend of mindful luxury. As you step onto the sun-kissed sands outside your hut, you'll immediately feel a sense of peace washing over you.
postcards.story:
Nestled on the beautiful shores of the Red Sea, Basata Eco Lodge entices you with its simple charm and profound connection to nature. In this coastal retreat, every individual hut boasts a distinctive design, tastefully adorned with simplicity and charm. Each abode features elevated bamboo beds, offering you a touch of rustic elegance, complemented by additional mattresses thoughtfully arranged on the floor. The decor, though understated, carries a pleasant aesthetic, creating an inviting atmosphere that speaks to the innate beauty of uncomplicated living.

Here, the absence of private bathrooms is intentional, with two shared facilities discreetly located on either side of Basata, thoughtfully separated for your comfort. In a deliberate choice to minimise environmental impact, these huts eschew electricity to prevent light pollution. Instead, you’re encouraged to use candles, offering a more romantic and intimate alternative. Venturing beyond the conventional, these accommodations are free from air-conditioning, designed to harness the refreshing sea breeze as a natural ventilator, ensuring a connection to the elements.

As stewards of the environment, Basata actively strives to reduce its ecological footprint. To achieve this, you’re requested to bring your own bedding and linens, a small gesture with a significant impact in minimising the use of cleaning detergents and promoting sustainable practices.

Here, you'll find yourself surrounded by modest yet comfortable accommodations, designed with a thoughtful touch that respects the environment. From your window, you'll witness the azure waters blending seamlessly with the endless sky, creating a horizon that invites introspection. The subtle luxury of the lodge lies not in its opulence, but in the mindfulness of its design – a place where you can appreciate the raw beauty of your surroundings.

postcards.name: Relish authentic local food at Basata
postcards.intro: Basata Eco Lodge’s food philosophy is simple, focussing on a genuine appreciation for the flavours of the local cuisine. When you're here, you'll have the opportunity to fully experience and relish the authentic tastes of Egypt. Immerse yourself in this experience and enjoy the richness of Egyptian culture and cuisine.
postcards.story:
Egyptian cuisine, deeply rooted in tradition, is simple and full of flavours. It’s a celebration of communal dining, with dishes often served in family-style, encouraging shared moments around the table. Staple elements such as rice, lentils and beans form the backbone of many dishes.

Basata takes pride in offering you an authentic local food experience, showcasing the rich flavours of traditional Egyptian cuisine. The menu features a diverse array of dishes, predominantly vegetarian with occasional poultry options, emphasising both flavour and nutritional value. Whenever possible, they source healthy, organic ingredients to ensure a wholesome dining experience.

If you have specific dietary preferences or needs, vegan dishes and tailored options are readily available upon request. Start your day at the bakery, where you’ll be served freshly baked bread, cheese bread and feta pockets in the morning, along with hearty pizzas for lunch.

Dinner is a communal affair, provided upon request as a mini buffet featuring various vegetarian Egyptian dishes. Gather around small communal tables to share a meal and engage in conversation, fostering a sense of connection and community. The expanded menu offers you a variety of breakfast and lunch/snack options, complemented by a selection of fresh juices and freshly ground coffee. Whether you're seeking a nourishing start to your day or a satisfying meal to fuel your adventures, Basata provides a simple yet delightful culinary experience that reflects the true essence of local flavours. 

The ambience for dining at Basata Eco Lodge is as genuine and unpretentious as the ingredients that grace your plates. This ambience is an extension of the lodge's commitment to mindful living, encouraging you to enjoy the flavours on your plates and the tranquil surroundings accompanying each nourishing meal.

name: Cloud Forest Lodge
intro: The Cloud Forest Lodge offers the perfect combination between isolating yourself in nature and staying close to all of Monteverde´s facilities. We are located within the Bellbird Biological Corridor, two kilometres from the main town – literally in the middle between the Monteverde Reserve and the Santa Elena Reserve.

news_article.title: Discover the Cloud Forest Lodge Experience in Costa Rica
news_article.description: A Luxury Stay Offering Seclusion in Nature

postcards.name: Relish Local Fusion Cuisine at the Endémica Restaurant
postcards.intro: Rooted in Costa Rica’s agricultural abundance, the cuisine here celebrates fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Experience an authentic and delicious array of plant-based dishes crafted to satisfy your palate at Endémica Restaurant at the Cloud Forest Lodge. When you’re here, you simply cannot miss tasting the satisfying flavours of the vegan ice cream offerings without compromising on taste and quality.
postcards.story:
Böëna's array of wilderness lodges in Costa Rica stands out for the excellence and ingenuity showcased in its dining establishments. The chefs have crafted a vibrant and fresh menu, drawing from the abundant local offerings of fruits, vegetables and responsibly sourced meats, dairy and seafood. Each dish is a delightful fusion of traditional and international flavours, expertly complemented by the lodge's exclusive selection of fine wines.

Böëna’s commitment to hospitality and customer service is unparalleled. The majority of their staff hails from the local community, and their authentic warmth and friendliness stand as their most cherished assets. You’re warmly invited to indulge in the distinctive blend of culinary excellence and genuine hospitality here.

Explore the new plant-based menu at the Endémica Restaurant featuring a variety of vegetarian options. Delight in choices such as pumpkin risotto, a comforting bean stew paired with handmade chickpea gnocchi and chard, or cauliflower tempura complemented by grilled pineapple, pine nuts and a flavourful yellow curry sauce. Another satisfying option includes an eggplant with a miso glaze, served alongside a quinoa salad featuring olives and cranberries, topped with a rich chickpea hummus sauce. 

You can even indulge in a selection of delightful vegan ice creams, including the tempting Banana Honey made from ripe plantains, tapa de dulce (sugar cane brown sugar), cinnamon and cloves. Another option to try is the Carrot and Fennel Honey, featuring ice cream crafted from slowly cooked carrot puree and ginger syrup with fennel. 

If you prefer a classic choice, relish the Organic Chocolate and Nibs, highlighting local organic chocolate and cacao nibs. For a unique taste, explore the Mountain Coffee ice cream, crafted from a high-altitude coffee infusion. You’re bound to fall in love with the hearty and rich flavours prepared exclusively for you.

postcards.name: Experience the Heartbeat of the Forest in a Manakin Suite
postcards.intro: Immerse yourself in the rhythmic pulse of the forest within the confines of the Manakin Suite at Cloud Forest Lodge. Here, the essence of nature beats in harmony with your surroundings, inviting you to experience the heartbeat of the lush, private forest reserve. Resonate with the melodies of the vibrant ecosystem around you from the tranquillity of your suite.
postcards.story:
Nestled high in the mist-kissed embrace of the mountains, you’ll find yourself at the doorstep of the Cloud Forest Lodge. The occasional soft patter of raindrops above only enhances the sensory immersion, refreshing and grounding you in the essence of this boutique property. Arriving at the lodge, perched on the edge of the wilderness, you feel a sense of warmth and comfort.

The Cloud Forest Lodge invites you on a journey of discovery. As the sun sets, evenings unfold into a serene retreat, offering you moments of relaxation and rejuvenation. The Manakin Suites, named after the lively Manakin bird with its spirited courtship dances, is designed to showcase the lodge's splendid gardens and the adjacent 23-hectare private cloud forest reserve, predominantly featuring pristine primary forest.

Stepping onto your suite's private terrace, you're greeted by a melodic symphony of birdsong and the gentle caress of mist, carried by the refreshing mountain breeze that drifts in from Monteverde's renowned clouds. Let the heartbeat of the forest simply captivate your senses, creating an unforgettable connection with the natural beauty that surrounds you.

The spacious terrace, adorned with a comfortable sitting area, invites you to witness the wonderful spectacle of Monteverde's cloud forest. Inside, an atmosphere of warm, understated elegance prevails, with natural hardwood and artisanal accents creating a restful retreat. This suite boasts a king bed adorned with plush pillows and the finest linens. The bright and airy bathroom complements the experience, featuring naturally sourced amenities, soft bathrobes, twin vanities and a solar-heated rain shower. While you’re here, you can also immerse yourself in nature with walking trails within the expansive private reserve, offering self-guided exploration. This suite is a harmonious blend of comfort and nature, inviting you to enjoy the simple luxuries of this unique Costa Rican haven.

name: Marari Beach Resort
intro: Our seaside resort, Marari beach in Mararikulam, is a tribute to the fisherfolk of this region who populate its spirit in obvious and subtle ways. Our guest cottages echo their dwellings in style and character while our cuisine reflects the culinary subtleties of these people whose sensibilities and culture have been influenced by the charms and challenges of the oceans.

news_article.title: Visit CGH Earth’s Marari Beach Resort in Kerala
news_article.description: Embrace Sea-Side Living in Coastal India

postcards.name: Relax in a Garden Villa
postcards.intro: At Marari Beach Resort, you'll find yourself surrounded by lush greenery and swaying coconut palms, creating a picturesque and calming atmosphere. The resort's architecture and design are in harmony with the local surroundings, giving you an authentic experience of Kerala's coastal beauty. Here, you’ll always find yourself in the company of nature – rustling leaves, whispering winds and shimmering stars.
postcards.story:
The charming accommodations at Marari Beach Resort beautifully embody the rich culture and lifestyle of the local fisherman community. With a distinctively indigenous aesthetic, the roofs are skillfully thatched using coconut leaves. When you stay in the Garden Villa, you'll enjoy a room that seamlessly combines your living and bedroom space. Your private verandah provides a homey spot to unwind, and the partially open-to-sky bathroom adds a touch of nature to your experience. 

Choose between twin beds or a larger bed based on your preference. If you're travelling with your friends or family, three pairs of interconnected rooms are available for added convenience. The bathrooms seamlessly blend with nature, providing an enchanting experience of bathing beneath the open skies. The tranquil private pools, surrounded by lush greenery and caressed by the sea breeze, create an atmosphere of profound relaxation. 

If you’re seeking a more accessible stay, two cottages have been thoughtfully designed with you in mind. There are also wheelchair-friendly rooms that eliminate steps and include features such as railings in the bathroom. Your comfort and accessibility are a top priority, ensuring that your stay is as enjoyable and stress-free as possible.

The beds in the room are adorned with unique floral art, crafted by the imaginative housekeeping staff. This thoughtful touch adds a burst of vibrant colour to the warm welcome that eagerly awaits you.

At Marari, cottages and villas are crafted with simplicity and care, utilising predominantly local materials and celebrating a native aesthetic. These spaces are designed to be more than just accommodations; they're sanctuaries of privacy, creating an uncommon sense of being truly at home. Immerse yourself in the live spectacle of breathtaking sunsets, the rhythmic dance of ocean waves and the gentle sway of trees each day, creating moments that unfold naturally around you.

postcards.name: Taste the Marari Cuisine and Revel in a Coastal Extravaganza
postcards.intro: The cuisine at Marari Beach Resort in Kerala is a delightful journey if you appreciate the diverse offerings of coastal living. Focused on bringing the essence of the ocean to your plate, the resort’s culinary offerings revolve around fresh and organic food. Kerala's food invites you to savour the flavours that make this region a food lover's paradise.
postcards.story:
When you explore Kerala, you'll find that its food is as diverse as its landscapes and is a treat for your taste buds. At Marari, the cuisine revolves around the bounties of the ocean. You'll discover a variety of dishes crafted from fresh fish and crustaceans, blended with coconut and spices for a distinctive taste. Accompanied by produce from their organic gardens, Marari’s menus offer you a wholesome variety. The Club House, boasting a 200-year-old legacy, invites you to unwind and enjoy fine wines and spirits in a Portuguese-style interior.

For a more laid-back experience, the Beach Shack serves you beverages and mixed drinks in the garden or coconut grove. It also functions as a pizzeria offering authentic Italian flatbreads with a touch of Indian influence. Ideal for daytime relaxation or an evening with good music and occasional live performances, it hosts barbecue nights twice a week.

Additionally, the Chakara Restaurant presents a buffet featuring the best of Indian and continental cuisines, set against lush greenery. You’ll notice that the menu explores coastal cuisines from Kerala, Konkan and other fishing communities. If you enjoy eating spicy food, you’ll appreciate specialities like Chemeen Manga Curry and Kozhi Kurumulagu roast. Don't miss the chef's daily recommendations, especially if you're a seafood enthusiast. A Marari Beach must-try is the freshly caught squid grilled with masala. 

And, of course, you can't leave without trying the sambhar and rasam. These tangy, flavourful soups are a staple in every Kerala home. Pair them with some rice or idli and dosa for a comforting meal. Amid your culinary journey, don't shy away from sampling the local snacks. Grab a banana fry and tea from a roadside stall — you'll blend right in with the locals.

name: Chanoud Garh
intro: A luxuriant 300-year-old fort-palace that blends modernity with imperial splendor, Chanoud Garh stands as an oasis amidst the golden sands of the Thar desert. A magnificent palace steeped in history, the Garh has been painstakingly restored and transformed into one of the best heritage hotels in Rajasthan, bringing together the famed Rajput hospitality, complete with bespoke experiences.

news_article.title: Experience Rajput Hospitality at Chanoud Garh
news_article.description: An Authentic Stay in a Rajasthani Fort Palace

postcards.name: Celebrate Your Wedding in a Romantic Fort in Rajasthan
postcards.intro: Experience the unique blend of history and romance at Chanoud Garh, where every corner tells you a story, and every moment is infused with the magic of the past. This hidden gem promises an unforgettable romantic retreat, allowing you to create timeless memories in a setting that breathes life into the spirit of love.
postcards.story:
Indulge in romance at Chanoud Garh, a captivating fort nestled in the heart of Rajasthan. This enchanting destination is perfect for you if you’re seeking a special getaway, whether it's for a proposal, to rekindle romance, to celebrate a honeymoon or simply to unwind during a relaxing staycation.

Chanoud Garh, renowned as one of the most romantic forts in Rajasthan, seamlessly combines rustic beauty with heritage charm. Immerse yourself in the wonders of this 300-year-old fort, a place that exudes majestic splendour and invites you to step back in time. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, Chanoud Garh caters to every preference. Here, you’ll enjoy the tranquillity of well-appointed rooms adorned with traditional touches, providing a peaceful retreat for you and your partner. 

The fragrant breeze carries the promise of a lifetime together, enhancing the magic of the moment. This fort has been a witness to countless love stories. As you declare your love, surrounded by the ancient walls and the heritage charm, it becomes a celebration not just of your union but also of the rich history that surrounds you.

Post-ceremony, the fort transforms into a haven of romance with bespoke experiences for both of you. Candlelit dinners under the starry sky, serenaded by soulful melodies, elevate your celebration to an unforgettable experience. 

Take a step back in time with a village walk with your partner, exploring the unique culture and history surrounding this enviable fort in Rajasthan. You’ll love witnessing stunning sunsets over the Aravali hills from the terrace in the evenings. Chanoud Garh ensures that every detail of your wedding celebration is imbued with the magic and grandeur worthy of a love story that endures gracefully.

postcards.name: Head Out for an Invigorating Desert Safari
postcards.intro: A jeep safari offers you a genuine and unfiltered exploration of Rajasthan’s diverse landscapes, allowing you to witness the raw beauty of the countryside. You'll have the opportunity to observe traditional practices, such as salt mining, and gain insights into the daily lives of local communities. Are you ready to experience the joy of a jeep safari?
postcards.story:
Whether you're a wanderer, nature enthusiast, history buff or food lover, Chanoud Garh offers you a variety of activities to suit your interests. Explore the beautiful terrains of Rajasthan with the dynamic jeep safaris. Here, the sturdy wheels of your jeep navigate the untouched countryside, revealing the raw beauty of the landscape. 

Discover the desert in its diverse colours and gain insight into the lives of its residents. Along the route, catch a glimpse of the vibrant Rabari settlements, where nomadic sheepherders, known as Dhanis, stand out with their striking red turbans. Villagers pause from their daily chores to exchange warm smiles with you.

The safari not only provides a unique cultural insight but also offers a perfect spot for a picnic with tea and snacks served at sunset. Don't forget to click pictures as you traverse through this landscape, documenting unique experiences.

You’ll also enjoy a refreshing drive into the countryside and witness the breathtaking sight of the saltwater pan shimmering under the desert sun. 

As your jeep traverses the dusty trails, the air is infused with a medley of scents – the earthy aroma of the arid landscape, the sweet fragrance of indigenous flora and the occasional whiff of traditional Rajasthani cuisine wafting from nearby villages. Beyond just a ride, the jeep safaris at Chanoud Garh offer you an unfiltered glimpse into the essence of Rajasthan, where each turn in the trail unfolds an exciting adventure.

name: Saseka Tented Camp
intro: At Saseka Tented Camp our purpose is to open your heart and soul to the wonders of safari and the wild beauty of the Greater Kruger Park. Sustainability is a distinctive feature of the design approach, and the flooring of both the tented suites and the public spaces are made of recycled, environmentally friendly materials.

news_article.title: Welcome to the Extraordinary Saseka Tented Camp
news_article.description: A Luxury Camp Prioritising Sustainability in South Africa

postcards.name: Revel in Bush Dining in the African Wilderness
postcards.intro: When you indulge in bush dining at the Saseka Tented Camp, the flavours of the cuisine harmonise with the melodies of the bush. Whether it's a leisurely breakfast, a sun-drenched lunch or a candlelit dinner, each meal is an opportunity for you to indulge in mindful appreciation, to savour not just the food but the essence of the Thornybush wilderness.
postcards.story:
Your dining experience at Saseka Tented Camp is a delightful journey amidst the beauty of the African bush. As you gather under the expansive skies, a canvas painted with the shades of sunset, the atmosphere transforms into an intimate celebration of flavours and nature's grandeur.

From a classic barbecue in a lantern-lit boma to a fireside feast under the starry sky on a riverbed, you’ll celebrate dining experiences that are both distinct and enchanting. The table is set with thoughtful precision and the flickering flames of lanterns cast a warm glow, creating an ambience that's as inviting as it is mesmerising. Thornybush’s commitment to providing unique moments extends to crafting a romantic à la carte dinner for you, served on your private deck or setting the stage for special celebrations. 

The bush breakfasts are a nod to the classic Out Of Africa style. Sitting under the trees, you’ll savour platters of seasonal fruit, yoghurt and the delectable homemade muesli, followed by a choice of continental or full-cooked breakfast, accompanied by coffee, Mimosas and Bloody Marys.

Thornybush prides itself on pairing menus with superb South African wines, sourcing fresh produce from local suppliers and community farms. They happily accommodate all dietary requirements, and upon request, offer Halaal and Kosher food options too.

As you relish each bite, the rich flavours are woven with the abundance of local ingredients and the heartfelt passion of the chefs.

postcards.name: Experience the beauty of the wild at Saseka Tented Camp
postcards.intro: Discover the epitome of luxury at the exquisite Saseka Tented Camp. Saseka doesn't rush you; it invites you to linger, to appreciate the small wonders and grand landscapes of South Africa.
postcards.story:
At Saseka Tented Camp, the mission is to bewitch your heart and spirit with the marvels of safari and the beauty of the Greater Kruger Park. Their commitment to sustainability is intricately woven into their design ethos, with the flooring of the tented suites and public spaces crafted from recycled, environmentally friendly materials.

The moment you arrive here, you'll feel a gentle shift in the air, inviting you to surrender to the unhurried rhythm of nature. As you enter your tented suite, a sense of serene seclusion envelops you, gently fading the world outside.

The nine tented suites offer you elevated views of the riverbed and boast ample space on permanent foundations. These tents are crafted with a discerning touch, offering a retreat that mirrors the surrounding splendour. Featuring glass doors that open onto expansive private decks with pools, complete with sun loungers and chairs, each suite provides you with a secluded outdoor shower with bush views. 

Every detail at Saseka is thoughtfully curated for you. The exclusive interior canvas fabric designed for the camp, featuring prints from the Pretoria herbarium showcases the region's plants. The interior also exudes a tranquil and cool ambience, painted in serene tones of sage, grey, apple and dusty pink that seamlessly echo the natural surroundings. The artful fusion of old and new elements is skillfully woven into every design detail, where steel frames coexist with traditional rattan and riempie furniture.

What sets Saseka apart is not just its opulent accommodations, but the sounds of the bush that filter into the tented suites, creating an immersive safari experience. You’ll discover an easygoing atmosphere here. It's a space where connections are made, stories are shared, and your bond with the wilderness deepens.

name: Jehan Numa Retreat
intro: Located on the outskirts of Bhopal, about 9 km away, Jehan Numa Retreat is a quiet getaway, entrapping you with its scenic views of nature and vast open spaces. This luxury resort in Bhopal is a 12.5-acre spread of lush green carpet and shares its boundaries with Van Vihar Urban National Park, which is also a drive-through zoo.

news_article.title: Enjoy a Charming Holiday Experience at the Jehan Numa Retreat
news_article.description: A Hidden Gem in Bhopal

postcards.name: Indulge in Fine Dining at The Coriander Leaf Restaurant
postcards.intro: Dining at Jehan Numa Retreat promises you a memorable experience. Here, you’re offered customised dining experiences in various locations. They source all vegetables from their organic garden, following a straightforward ‘farm-to-table’ concept. This commitment to locally grown, organic vegetables reflects Jehan Numa Retreat’s dedication to providing simple, wholesome dining experiences to you.
postcards.story:
Dining at the Jehan Numa Retreat means immersing yourself in its renowned excellence in fine cuisine and wine. One of the key reasons you’ll be drawn to this resort is the diverse and expertly crafted menu that caters to a wide range of palates. The culinary offerings at Jehan Numa remain a well-kept secret, with exclusive access to recipes known only to the royal families of Bhopal. 

The Coriander Leaf restaurant offers you an experience marked by simplicity and genuine warmth. It stands out as a fine-dining spot, serving delightful dishes from various corners of the world. The simple design of The Coriander Leaf allows you to focus on the heart of the experience – the food. With a bar offering a diverse selection of cocktails and mocktails, the in-house restaurant is a top choice in Bhopal, meeting all your culinary preferences. The ample lounge space and an outdoor private deck contribute to your experience, providing a relaxing setting to enjoy a variety of global cuisines.

As you explore the menu, you'll discover a mix of traditional Indian dishes and influences from various cultures. You’ll love the exquisite taste of paneer, the crispiness of kurkuri bhindi and the aroma of dal fry, each dish crafted to delight your palate. Don't miss the decadent desserts – from the fragrant saffron and gulkand phirni to the velvety baked cheesecake and the refreshing burst of fresh fruit in custard sauce. The simplicity of the local taste allows you to appreciate the nuances of each ingredient, highlighting the freshness and quality that defines the food at The Coriander Leaf restaurant.

postcards.name: Celebrate Nature Living in a Luxury Suite
postcards.intro: Welcome to the Retreat Luxury Suite at Jehan Numa Retreat, an exquisite suite that promises unmatched leisure experiences and exceptional facilities. Immerse yourself in the charm of this retreat, designed to create a holiday experience so delightful that you'll find yourself drawn back to it time and again.
postcards.story:
Bhopal, as a city, encapsulates authenticity and simplicity, qualities that become palpable during your stay at Jehan Numa Retreat. The Retreat Luxury Suite offers you a serene and comfortable space designed for a truly relaxing stay. It's the quiet, thoughtful moments that etch lasting memories during your stay here. 

Striking a balance between functionality and comfort, the suite provides you with an elegant environment. As you enter your room, you’ll notice how the room's layout is thoughtfully arranged to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience, with attention to details that enhance your overall comfort.

These carefully crafted suites redefine comfort at one of Bhopal's top luxury resorts, combining earthy elegance with modern amenities. As you settle in, you'll find free Wi-Fi, television and air-conditioning at your fingertips – creating a genuine paradise for your stay, where you can unwind and indulge in exceptional leisure and luxury.

When you choose the Luxury Suites at this resort, you're in for a truly unique experience. Picture yourself enjoying an "open to sky" shower and a relaxing bath in the tub. The decor is tasteful and understated in a space that exudes peace and solace. The ample natural light streaming through the windows creates a bright and inviting atmosphere.

At Jehan Numa Retreat, the rooms offer you outdoor seating areas, allowing you to enjoy a quiet moment or a cup of coffee while soaking in the natural ambience of the retreat. The simplicity of this outdoor space thoughtfully complements the overall ease and comfort of the stay.

Whether you're here for business or leisure, this suite offers you a comfortable retreat where you can unwind and recharge, appreciating the simplicity that defines your stay here.

name: Dera Amer
intro: A 180-acre wilderness camp, Dera Amer strives to provide our guests with an alternative exclusive hospitality experience. Our aim is to create a sanctuary for animals to live in and our guests to enjoy, coupled with acres of protected jungle and farm-fresh homemade meals.

news_article.title: Feel the Vibrance of Jaipur Like Never Before At Dera Amer
news_article.description: A Rare Glamping Experience in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Experience Jaipur Mindfully and Sustainably at Dera Amer
postcards.intro: Dera Amer is more than a destination; it's an embodiment of the spirit of Jaipur. Here, your journey goes beyond the ordinary. Your presence is not just a visit but a shared commitment to their animals, their team, the local environment and the local community. Are you excited to be a part of this meaningful and responsible journey?
postcards.story:
In Jaipur, the beauty lies not just in the monuments but in the everyday moments that compose the city's narrative. It’s a place where you can enjoy a cup of tea shared with locals, the echo of traditional music drifting through the air or the vivid hues of a Rajasthani sunset. It's a place where the present harmonises with the past, where the modern markets coexist with ancient palaces, creating a cityscape that mirrors the diversity of its people.

At Dera Amer, it's not just about indulging in glamping; it's about immersing yourself in the marvels of safeguarding and cherishing the natural world that envelops you. 

Animal welfare is the very essence of this place. The elephants and camels at Dera Amer have found sanctuary after being adopted from the challenges of urban life and rescued from the hardships of strenuous labour. You'll only witness any form of restraint on the beloved elephants, Laxmi and Rangmala, when the vet pays a visit. Otherwise, they thrive in harmony at the camp, always accompanied by their dedicated mahout.

Your stay at Dera Amer is more than a retreat; it's a chance to contribute to positive change. Here, you actively engage in a mindful travel experience that values sustainability and community empowerment. Your choice to indulge in responsible tourism at Dera Amer aligns with their eco-sensitive mindset. As you explore the lush surroundings, know that your impact is far-reaching — from supporting organic farming practices to utilising solar-powered water pumps and drip irrigation.

Together, you create ripples of positive influence, shaping a better environment for all. Your mindful choices, both big and small, weave into the fabric of responsible tourism, making your journey with Dera Amer not just memorable but meaningful.

postcards.name: Experience Glamping in Jaipur like Never Before
postcards.intro: Imagine a world where the wilderness isn't just observed but embraced with a touch of luxury — where the rugged outdoors meets the comfort of a plush bed and the flicker of a bedside lamp. Dera Amer offers you a glamping experience that elevates the outdoor experience without compromising the authenticity of nature.
postcards.story:
In the heart of Jaipur, Dera Amer makes you feel the palpable connection to the grandeur of the Rajputana heritage along with the comforts of the modern world. In the vast expanse of wild scrubland, you'll discover six inviting safari-style tents strategically placed for your utmost comfort. Here, you’ll enjoy nature and solitude, surrounded by miles of untouched beauty. 

The furnishings are not just decorative and vintage; they carry the legacy of travellers who once reclined on the same chairs centuries ago. Crafted by local artisans, these pieces seamlessly marry form and function, adding a timeless touch to your Rajasthani tent.

Your tent is more than just a shelter; it's a haven equipped with all the modern comforts you desire. Step into the attached shower room where complimentary Forest Essentials toiletries await, promising a touch of luxury in the heart of the wilderness. As the evening unfolds, find yourself by a roaring bonfire, drink in hand and the irresistible aroma of a live barbecue filling the air. The experience is yours to customise, whether you're a honeymooning couple seeking intimacy or a family with children creating lasting memories.

For an exotic touch, private musical and dance performances by local folk artists can be arranged, serenading you into the night. In this secluded wilderness camp, accompanied by Dera Amer's friendly elephants, every moment becomes a unique blend of tranquillity and adventure. 

The luxury camp comfortably accommodates groups of up to 12 adults, ensuring an exclusive experience with no more than one family or two couples sharing the camp at a time. It's not just a stay; it's an invitation to create your extraordinary moments in the heart of nature.

name: Boulders Camp
intro: Boulders Camp is three hours south of the other Wolwedans camps, as far off the beaten track as you can be. Built around the base of an enormous outcrop of granite rocks and with enormous mountains towering behind, the camp looks out over endless landscapes of gravel plains, dotted with the tops of submerged mountains.

news_article.title: Stay at the Scenic Boulders Camp Surrounded by Massive Granite Rocks
news_article.description: A Picturesque Camp in NamibRand Nature Reserve

postcards.name: Stay in a Camp Surrounded by Massive Granite Rocks
postcards.intro: In the heart of the arid Namib Desert, where the vastness of the landscape echoes the silence of the ages, lies the Boulders Camp. Surrounded by an unyielding expanse of golden sands and weathered rocks, the camp beautifully compliments the raw beauty of nature. Welcome to a camp surrounded by massive granite rocks, thoughtfully sheltering you during your stay.
postcards.story:
In Namibia, the sprawling plains, baked by relentless sunlight, exhibit a palette of earthy tones that stretch to the horizon. Boulders Camp offers you a tranquil perspective with colossal mountains in the background. The camp gazes upon an expansive gravel plain, punctuated by the protruding peaks of mighty mountains. Here, your accommodation seamlessly blends with its desert surroundings. 

Accommodating a maximum of 10 guests, this camp features five spacious tented rooms. The central hub includes a dining and lounge tent, a breakfast deck, a library, a pool and an open fireplace. You can unwind by the pool or enjoy sundowners atop a nearby rock plateau, where the expansive beauty of the desert unfolds.

Your suite is thoughtfully positioned, boasting roomy decks and airy interiors that open on three sides, inviting in the refreshing afternoon breeze. Every suite comes complete with a separate spacious bathroom and a sala for afternoon siestas, all strategically oriented to offer you endless views that surround your camp. 

Suites 2 and 3, as well as 4 and 5, share a plunge pool, fostering a sense of shared tranquillity, while Suite 1 offers the luxury of a private plunge pool. Your accommodation is simply a blend of connection with the vast desert landscape.

Stepping outside your camp at night, you’ll notice that simplicity reigns in the surroundings. It's a view that doesn't need ornate descriptions – the raw beauty of the desert speaks for itself. The night sky, free from the city's luminous intrusion, unveils a celestial stage where countless stars appear against the velvety darkness.

Every moment spent here becomes a precious opportunity for you to rediscover the pure authenticity of nature in its most unfiltered and genuine form.

postcards.name: Experience the beauty of Namibia at Boulders Camp
postcards.intro: From Boulders Camp at Wolwedans, the views stretch into a vast panorama of the Namib Desert. The play of light and shadow over the desert floor, as the sun dips behind the horizon, reveals a quiet beauty that transcends words. Witness unfiltered and authentic views that are as far-reaching as your eyes can see.
postcards.story:
Located within the rugged embrace of one of the colossal granite outcrops scattered across the NamibRand plains, Boulders Camp inspires you with its thoughtful placement in the heart of nature. Situated a three-hour drive to the south of the other Wolwedans camps, this enclave is a deliberate departure from the well-trodden paths, ensuring an experience that is as remote as it is captivating. When you arrive here, you’ll notice a cluster of minimalist structures, weathered by time and blending seamlessly with the desert hues.

Boulders Camp invites you to delve into the secrets of the deep south of the NamibRand Nature Reserve. Guided scenic drives offer you expansive views, while moments of quiet introspection unfold during two- to three-hour walking safaris across the ancient hunting grounds of the bushmen. If you’re seeking some adventure here, e-biking on fat bikes opens up the Namib desert landscape in a unique and exhilarating way.

A sojourn at Boulders Camp invites a minimum three-night stay, allowing you to be a part of a program that unveils the desert's magic. During the period from December 1 to February 28/29, Boulders is available for exclusive-use bookings, allowing arrivals on any day of the week. If you plan to visit the camp from March 1 to November 30, the camp follows a fixed arrival schedule, with check-ins available on Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays.

As the sun retreats beyond the horizon, casting long shadows over the rocky terrain, the camp takes on an ethereal quality. The fading light plays upon the uneven surfaces of the boulders, painting them in subtle tones of amber and crimson.

Amidst this vast landscape, the tips of submerged mountains emerge, creating a captivating mosaic beneath the open sky. Here, you’ll witness the wonders of nature unfold in every direction.

name: The Malabar House
intro: The Malabar House, more than a beautifully designed heritage hotel is an art hotel, home of a carefully curated collection, highlighting Kerala’s composite culture as passage between East and West. It seamlessly combines tradition & contemporary design. The feel is small, cosy and personal, a heaven amidst this vibrant harbour city. The rooms are comfortable & the service is flawless.

news_article.title: Enjoy Genuine Hospitality, Heritage, Art and Luxury at The Malabar House
news_article.description: A Peaceful Retreat in the Heart of Kerala

postcards.name: Indulge in Fine Dining and Indian Wines
postcards.intro: Known for its emphasis on locally sourced ingredients, the dishes in Kerala are a harmonious blend of aromatic spices. As you immerse yourself in the dining experience, each dish unfolds as a chapter in the impressive story of The Malabar House's culinary expertise.
postcards.story:
Kerala cuisine reflects a rich blend of flavours deeply rooted in tradition. Staples like rice and fish form the backbone of many meals, showcasing a simple yet robust culinary approach. Whether it's the hearty coconut-based curries, subtly spiced seafood, or the array of vegetarian delights, Kerala's cuisine is a delightful exploration of regional tastes and culinary craftsmanship. The balance of flavours, textures, and a focus on authenticity make Kerala cuisine a genuine and satisfying culinary experience.

Your dining experiences at The Malabar House are complemented by classical Carnatic and Hindustani music or classical dance performances. The chefs, true masters of their craft, skillfully shape an experience that goes beyond taste, encouraging you to appreciate the subtle interplay of tradition and innovation.

Step into the open-air wonders of Malabar Junction and the sophisticated charm of Divine, the wine lounge. Malabar Junction, the esteemed fine dining restaurant of the hotel, serves as a meeting point between East and West, blending innovative Keralan and Mediterranean-influenced cuisines. Through the collaboration of local and visiting chefs, a distinctive cuisine has emerged, capturing the essence of this region's flavours. Committed to the vision of Relais & Chateaux, the cuisine offered here reflects the local culinary culture and environment. The use of local and, when possible, organic products is always prioritised.

Both spaces invite you into a lively fusion of exquisite dining, captivating performing arts, and the enchanting realm of Indian wines. At the wine lounge, you can immerse yourself in a magical ambience that unveils and celebrates the emergence of Indian wines.

postcards.name: Experience the Charm of a Heritage Hotel in Kochi
postcards.intro: The Malabar House seamlessly integrates traditional and modern elements in its design, paying attention to every detail. With 17 rooms and suites that harmoniously blend heritage and contemporary aesthetics, the atmosphere is intimate and inviting. It offers a tranquil retreat amid the bustling and historically rich harbour city of Kochi.
postcards.story:
At The Malabar House, every corner whispers stories of history, culture and a tranquil escape from the ordinary. As you step through its doors, the hushed echoes of past centuries invite you to witness the rich narrative woven into every corner. You find yourself enveloped in an ambience that transcends time, a place where the air itself seems to carry the weight of untold tales.

The Malabar House isn't just a beautifully crafted heritage hotel; it's an art hotel. Within its walls, you'll find a thoughtfully selected collection that shines a spotlight on Kerala's diverse culture, serving as a bridge between the East and West. Inside The Malabar House, time seems to gently echo the rhythm of your heartbeat. The courtyard, embellished with vibrant foliage and melodic birdsong, transforms into your oasis. 

Here, each suite features a diverse array of antiques, authentic works of art and carefully crafted designs. The uniqueness of each room is a result of the heritage building that houses The Malabar House. The warm hues, the soft caress of linens, and the subtle play of light conspire to create an environment that feels like a personal refuge. As you walk through the adorned spaces, a palpable sense of authenticity seeps into your being, leaving a lasting mark on your journey.

Kerala experiences a consistent tropical climate, with warm and humid conditions prevailing throughout the year. You'll relish the gentle breeze here that carries a touch of tropical charm, creating a year-round atmosphere of relaxation.

name: Song Saa Private Island
intro: Welcome to a carefree paradise, an intimate escape, crafted with love, inspired by our surroundings. Song Saa Private Island offers luxury, serenity and a deep connection with the environment

news_article.title: Discover the Picturesque Song Saa Private Island
news_article.description: Reconnect with Nature and Yourself in Cambodia

postcards.name: Delve into Cambodia’s Simple and Mindful Luxuries
postcards.intro: Picture yourself on the secluded shores of Song Saa Private Island in Cambodia, where the gentle sounds of the turquoise waves invite you into a world of tranquillity. As you step onto the powdery sands, the warm sunlight welcomes you to a haven crafted for mindful luxury travellers like you.
postcards.story:
Located in the heart of Southeast Asia, Cambodia intrigues you with its blend of history, culture and natural splendour. Crafted with care and inspired by the stunning surroundings, Song Saa Private Island promises luxury, tranquillity and a genuine connection with nature. Welcome to a worry-free paradise, a cosy retreat tucked away in a distant archipelago. 

Designed with sustainability in mind, the island mirrors the charm of the Cambodian coastline. It's a place that moves in harmony with nature, constructed from local materials by local hands, and enriched with local art and spirit. This refined tropical escape features a pristine private beach, roomy wooden villas, serene spa havens and a protected coral reef. Song Saa Private Island invites you to disconnect from the world and soak yourself in the simplicity of true luxuries.

Every villa stands as a private sanctuary, featuring a tasteful mix of thatched roofs, linen-draped canopy beds, upcycled décor, and repurposed furniture. Discarded oil drums find a new purpose as lamps, while driftwood serves as functional tables or benches. Salvaged wood from old fishing boats and factory yards now shapes the decks, floors and beams, embodying its commitment to repurposing and minimising waste. 

You find yourself drawn to the infinity pool, where the water seamlessly merges with the horizon, mirroring the boundless possibilities that await. As the day unfolds, you discover hidden coves and secret corners that whisper stories of seclusion and serenity. Each sunset paints the sky with hues that mirror the palette of your inner calm. Even your culinary experience is an intimate dance of flavours curated just for you, a blend of tastes that elevate your senses. At Song Saa, you’re a privileged inhabitant of a sanctuary that exists solely for moments of quiet introspection and mindful luxury.

postcards.name: Nurture Stillness, Healing and Blessings at Song Saa
postcards.intro: Song Saa offers tranquil spaces where your mind, body and soul return to their innate stillness. Here, the focus is on practical wellbeing activities, like a spa,  designed for balance and rejuvenation. You’ll be provided with accessible and effective activities that contribute to your overall sense of wellbeing. Take a deep breath and delve into the world of mindful living.
postcards.story:
Wellbeing is crucial as it directly influences our overall quality of life. It encompasses physical health, mental clarity and emotional stability, forming the foundation for a balanced and fulfilling existence. Song Saa Private Island features an innovative spa concept that seamlessly blends the wellness experience with the natural surroundings of the Song Saa Islands. Their unconventional 'spa with no walls' comprises small 'sanctuaries' scattered throughout the island, providing a setting where treatments unfold in harmony with nature.

Guided by the Buddhist tradition of metta bhavana, or the cultivation of loving-kindness, the spa philosophy here aligns with the practice of respecting all beings and bestowing blessings upon others. To reflect this, the spa menu is categorised into three themes: stillness, healing, and blessings. Stillness: The inherent serenity of Song Saa Private Island supports a calm mind, aiding in the rediscovery of your centre. Healing: Revitalising treatments are administered with compassion, recognising their potential for transformation. Blessings: The Song Saa islands have bestowed abundant natural blessings on the resort, a privilege they extend to guests like you to share in their abundance.

Tailor your rejuvenation journey with a choice of custom activities, designed to meet your specific needs and desires. Additionally, you can also immerse yourself in the beauty and energy of Cambodia's night sky through the Night Spa services, which assist in aligning your body with nature's pure cycles. 

Stretch, breathe and balance – you can schedule a private session for personalised, one-on-one yoga at your own pace. Book your spa retreats here, where you can escape into the natural realm of serenity and calm. This retreat, emphasising mental clarity and stress release, offers you luxurious spa treatments in nurturing environments, fostering profound relaxation. Doesn’t this feel like a wonderful start to your wellbeing journey?

name: Jamtara Wilderness Camp
intro: Inspired by an ancient Banyan Tree, the community, and the wilderness surrounding the area, Jamtara Wilderness Camp was built to provide an unforgettable experience with sustainability as its cornerstone. Enjoy the ancient forests that once inspired Rudyard Kipling (The Jungle Book), from the comfort of your artistically designed tents.

news_article.title: Experience Authentic Jungle Stories at Jamtara Wilderness Camp
news_article.description: Rekindle Your Connection with Nature in India

postcards.name: Stay in Luxury Wilderness Camp that Inspires Sustainability
postcards.intro: Inspired by the spirit of the banyan tree, the local community and the untamed wilderness, Jamtara Wilderness Camp stands as a testament to an unforgettable, sustainable experience. The artistically designed tents invite you to soak yourself in nature while relishing the harmonious blend of comfort and wilderness.
postcards.story:
Jamtara Wilderness Camp nestles amidst the ancient forests that once stirred the imagination of Rudyard Kipling, the author of The Jungle Book. As you step inside the camp, you’ll find yourself enveloped in quiet surroundings that speak louder than any words. The air, crisp and untouched, greets you with the earthy scent of the surrounding forest. You notice the canopy above, a natural roof filtering the sunlight, casting dappled shadows on the forest floor. You can't help but feel a sense of solitude, a communion with nature as you tread softly on the leaf-strewn paths.

As you wander through the camp, you discover the intimate connection between simplicity and luxury. You find yourself in a canvas tent that becomes your haven, a place where the only sounds are the rustling leaves and distant bird calls. The minimalist decor echoes the wild elegance outside. The comfort is understated but undeniable, inviting you to unwind and soak yourself in the beauty surrounding you.

The camp is built with a strong commitment to minimising its impact on nature. There's a focus on using reclaimed materials, particularly evident in the furniture made from recycled wood. The dining tables, crafted from mango tree logs, and the distinctive blue flooring, repurposed from government buildings and schools in Central India, all carry a unique history.
