Each piece stands as a testament to the camp's dedication to sustainability and responsible sourcing.

The evenings are a sensory symphony. You sit by the crackling campfire, the warmth on your face contrasting the cool evening breeze. The flickering flames cast a dance of shadows, and you find yourself captivated by the storytelling silence of the wilderness. You relish the flavours of the alfresco dinner, a feast prepared with local ingredients that mirror the authenticity of the environment you're immersed in.

postcards.name: Enjoy Glamping in the Heart of the Jungle
postcards.intro: Experience the heart of nature through immersive glamping, with the jungle unfolding right before your eyes. If you seek authentic accommodation amidst thick jungles, Jamtara is the perfect destination for you. Who knows, it might just spark some inspiration that you’ll cherish for life.
postcards.story:
At Jamtara Wilderness Camp, your accommodation is a blend of simplicity and comfort. The tents, designed to be your retreat in the heart of nature, offer a genuine connection with the surroundings. They are spaces that respect your need for convenience while maintaining the rustic charm that defines the camp.

This beautiful camp comprises 10 luxury tents situated in the rural heart of Pench. The camp nestles amidst towering arjuna trees and an aged banyan firmly rooted on a dry riverbed. Each tent provides you with a view of the forest, creating an ideal backdrop for your unforgettable jungle experience. As you settle in, you'll appreciate the thoughtful design that brings the outdoors in. Every luxury tent is crafted to offer you an optimal view of nature. You can roll up the front panels to lounge on the patio and enjoy a scenic overlook of a dry river bed.

If you prefer more privacy, you can roll down the windows and front panels as desired. Despite being tented accommodations, the bathroom is constructed as a permanent structure for your comfort. Aligned with sustainability principles, the tents at Jamtara were constructed with minimal impact on nature. No trees were felled to create wooden flooring in the rooms or to build furniture, aside from the beds.

Enjoy the jungle's scenic views and immerse yourself in nature's surroundings while sitting inside your tent. In the morning, as you wake up in your tent, you'll be greeted by the sounds of wildlife, and even spot deer grazing in the backyard, a gentle reminder that you are a guest in their home. The simple yet well-appointed accommodations at Jamtara Wilderness Camp allow you to relish the essence of the jungle, offering an authentic and unpretentious experience in the lap of nature.

name: Borana Lodge
intro: Borana Lodge is steeped in history and style. Located at the heart of Borana Conservancy, Kenya’s newest and most successful rhino sanctuary, Borana Lodge is set against a beautiful hillside with an organic design and panoramic views.

news_article.title: Indulge in Mindful Travel and Purposeful Adventures at Borana Lodge
news_article.description: Witness the Vast Beauty of the Kenyan Landscape

postcards.name: Embrace Eco Living at Borana Lodge
postcards.intro: You'll find boundless beauty and remarkable diversity in Kenya. Borana Lodge in Kenya invites you to be a part of its inspirational stories. It’s a place where vibrant cultures, traditions and rare wildlife await your discovery.
postcards.story:
Borana Lodge, situated in the heart of Borana Conservancy in Kenya, is known for its rich history and stylish design. It is nestled against a picturesque hillside and offers stunning panoramic views with its organic architectural approach. Additionally, the conservancy is recognised as Kenya's most effective rhino sanctuary. 

Borana Lodge offers you an opportunity to experience nature in its purest form. With every glance, you'll witness the majestic Mount Kenya, a breathtaking backdrop to your stay. Crafted from locally sourced materials by dedicated local craftsmen, the lodge stands as a testament to sustainable, harmonious living. Borana Lodge's exclusivity grants you the privilege to treat this remarkable place as your own. 

You'll find Borana Lodge situated in the heart of Borana Conservancy. The lodge was constructed using local materials by local craftsmen and is perched on a hillside overlooking a dam, which attracts wildlife regularly.

No matter what brings you to Borana, you'll discover an array of activities tailored to suit your safari preferences and adventurous spirit. This place is suitable for families, honeymooners and those celebrating special occasions. Here, you’ll be offered a variety of activities for both traditional safari enthusiasts and adventurous travellers. Since it’s a small and exclusive destination, you're encouraged to make yourself at home during your stay. 

When you choose to stay at Borana Lodge, you directly support conservation efforts. Your contribution enables Borana to sustain its commitment to conservation, with all profits dedicated to maintaining the integrity of its conservation initiatives.

In Kenya, your adventures are limitless, and the memories you create will be as vast and enduring as the landscapes that surround you. Here, you'll not only find inspiration in the breathtaking scenery, you’ll also be moved by its incredible conservation stories.

postcards.name: Experience Sustainable Living at Borana Lodge
postcards.intro: You'll experience a perfect blend of comfort and natural charm while staying at Borana Lodge. Each accommodation offers you a serene retreat, where you can relax and unwind after your adventures. With views that stretch out to the captivating landscapes of Borana Conservancy, you'll wake up to the beauty of Kenya right outside your window.
postcards.story:
At Borana Lodge, you'll find each cottage designed around the central main house, which hosts a cosy sitting room, a welcoming bar and a pleasant dining room. Farther along the ridge line, there's a horizon pool that overlooks the Hyena Valley Dam below, offering you the opportunity for game viewing right from the poolside.

Whether it's the sun rising over the savannah or the tranquillity of the nearby dam, these scenes provide a soothing backdrop to your stay. The simple yet tasteful design ensures that you feel at ease and connected to the wild, reminding you of the importance of preserving this remarkable place. Set above the pool house, the lunch pavilion offers you fantastic views across the entire conservancy, providing you with a picturesque setting to enjoy your meals.

At Borana, you'll discover four standalone cottages, each offering exceptional views. These cottages are thoughtfully designed with the hillside in mind, paying close attention to the details that ensure your true comfort. Among the accommodations, four rooms feature large double beds, while the remaining four have queen-size twin beds. The spacious interiors and rustic elegance create a cosy and welcoming atmosphere.

Constructed from rock and cedar with thatched roofs, these cottages are equipped with open fireplaces, lit every evening with a basket of sustainably sourced firewood nearby. Their verandas offer you breathtaking views, and the spacious bathrooms provide baths and showers with views of Africa's wild beauty. 

As you settle into your room or cottage, you'll find a sense of harmony with the environment, appreciating the sustainable approach of the lodge. Each space embodies a commitment to conservation and a celebration of nature, making your stay part of a meaningful journey toward safeguarding Kenya's natural wonders.

name: Chumbe Island
intro: Discover an incredible tropical paradise on Chumbe Island, located 8 km west of Unguja in Zanzibar. This fully protected island is home to a stunning Coral Reef Sanctuary and Forest Reserve that is entirely funded through ecotourism revenue. Witness the incredible biodiversity, rare species and abundant marine and forest life at this one-of-a-kind, multi-award winning destination!

news_article.title: Experience Zanzibar’s World-Class Natural Coral Heritage at Chumbe Island
news_article.description: A Private Nature Reserve in Tanzania

postcards.name: Explore the Dense Forests of Chumbe Island
postcards.intro: Exploring the forests of Chumbe Island Coral Park is a simple yet enriching experience. These forest walks provide a genuine connection with nature, allowing you to appreciate the island's natural beauty.
postcards.story:
When you go for a forest walk, you'll find a trail that encircles the southern section of Chumbe Island's coral rag forest. You’ll have the option to explore this trail independently or join a one-hour guided forest walk. As you wander through the peaceful woods, you'll encounter a diverse range of plant and animal life, including some unique and rare species. 

During the guided walk, you'll gain insights into the island's geology, discover how local plants adapt to survive without groundwater, learn about the medicinal uses of native trees and shrubs and get a chance to spot some elusive wildlife that might be hard to find on your own.

Take a walk along the footpath leading to a large intertidal pool surrounded by mangroves and shaded by enormous baobab trees. Here, you can observe sea creatures adapted to the changing tides. On the eastern side of the island, you'll find the skeletal remains of corals and giant clams, a reminder of Chumbe Island's past as a thriving coral reef, now fossilised for over 15,000 years. Finally, keep an eye out for the hermit crabs on the move and lizards basking in the sun.

The well-maintained trails guide you through the serene surroundings, offering you a chance to soak in the tranquil atmosphere. It's a place where you can escape the rush of your everyday life and find solace in the simplicity of a quiet forest stroll. Whether you're a nature enthusiast or simply seeking a peaceful retreat, these forest walks at Chumbe Island offer you a chance to immerse yourself in the island's natural wonders.

postcards.name: Stay in Zanzibar’s Sustainable Biodiversity Destination
postcards.intro: Located in the clear waters of the Indian Ocean, Chumbe Island Coral Park in Tanzania offers you a distinctive getaway. This special place harmoniously combines nature, comfort and conservation. Beneath the water's surface, the island's colourful coral reefs teem with life, welcoming you to discover their vibrant underwater world.
postcards.story:
Zanzibar in Tanzania is a fascinating island with a mix of cultures, beautiful beaches and a rich history. It's a destination where different traditions come together, surrounded by clear waters and palm-lined shores. It's also simply a great place to explore and relax. 

Chumbe Island Coral Park Ltd. (CHICOP) is a well-regarded private nature reserve that was established in 1991 to conserve and sustainably manage the uninhabited Chumbe Island, situated off the coast of Zanzibar. Here, you'll discover a fully protected Coral Reef Sanctuary and Forest Reserve, home to rare wildlife. There's also a Visitor and Education Centre, a cosy eco-lodge, serene nature trails and significant historical sites to explore. 

What sets CHICOP apart is its commitment to eco-friendly practices. From rainwater collection and photovoltaic energy to solar water heating, composting toilets and vegetative greywater filtration, the impact on the environment is minimal. It's a place where you, as a mindful luxury traveller, can enjoy both comfort and a deep connection with nature.

At Chumbe Island, eco-bungalows have been carefully designed to offer you a serene connection to nature, all while ensuring modern amenities are close at hand. Underneath a starry night sky, you'll enjoy stories from the island and the rhythmic sounds of the ocean, creating a harmonious connection with the world around you.
Here, you’ll abundantly experience the simplicity of life's finest pleasures. Whether you're snorkelling through the vibrant coral gardens or simply relaxing on the immaculate shores, you'll uncover a retreat that offers a true sense of peace and appreciation for the natural world surrounding you.

In Zanzibar, you'll find welcoming people, beautiful national parks and a chance to experience the natural wonders of Africa in a down-to-earth way. Ready to immerse yourself in African adventures? Let’s go!

name: Amazon Planet Tambopata Lodge
intro: With Amazon Planet, Tambopata Lodge, your jungle experience will be unique! A perfect combination of comfort, adventure and care for nature. You will feel at home and share incredible moments, in direct contact with the Amazon biodiversity within the Tambopata National Reserve.

news_article.title: Connect with Nature in the Amazon Rainforests with Amazon Planet Tambopata Lodge
news_article.description: An Eco-Lodge in the Peruvian Wilderness

postcards.name: Enjoy the Wonders of the Amazon with Amazon Planet
postcards.intro: Explore the Amazon like never before at Tambopata Lodge with Amazon Planet. This beautiful lodge offers a unique jungle experience, balancing comfort, adventure and environmental responsibility. Immerse yourself in the heart of Tambopata National Reserve, where you'll feel at home and connect with the incredible Amazon biodiversity.
postcards.story:
Amazon Planet Peru is a remarkable destination, a place where you can truly connect with the beauty of the Amazon rainforest. Nestled within the Tambopata National Reserve, this lodge offers an authentic immersion into the heart of the jungle. It's not just a lodge; it's an experience that immerses you in the heart of the wild, offering an authentic encounter with the lush and untamed natural world. It's an experience that leaves a lasting impression and a deep appreciation for the Amazon's unique wonders.

Amazon Planet Peru offers you comprehensive tourism packages that enable mindful travellers like you to explore the rainforest, gain insights into local conservation efforts, and unwind, disconnecting from your daily routines while communing with nature. Whether you're a solo adventurer, a couple, a family or a group of friends, these programs are suitable for all types of mindful travellers.

The cabins at the lodge are simple, yet they provide all the comfort you need. With a master bedroom, a private bathroom and a terrace, they're designed to let you unwind and reconnect with the natural world. These cabins are strategically positioned, not too close and not too far from each other, ensuring both safety and privacy in this lush wilderness.

Here, you won't find extravagant luxury, but you will find a deep connection with the forest and the wildlife that calls it home. It's a place where you can observe the intricate balance of nature, listen to the chorus of birds, and watch the mesmerising dance of the leaves in the wind. And in the evenings, as the stars emerge above the rainforest canopy, you'll realise that true luxury lies in the raw, unfiltered beauty of this remarkable ecosystem.

postcards.name: Stay Comfortably within the Amazon Rainforest in Peru
postcards.intro: Staying at Amazon Planet Peru is an authentic immersion into the heart of the Amazon rainforest, where true luxury lies in the connection to nature. Nestled within the Tambopata National Reserve, this is a place for mindful luxury travellers like you who seek a genuine experience in the wild.
postcards.story:
Amazon Planet Peru is for the mindful traveller, seeking an authentic experience and a deeper understanding of the Amazon's wonders. It's a place where you can step out of your routine, leave the distractions of daily life behind, and enjoy the serenity of the jungle. 

Here, you can stay in the Upper Jungle room with a forest view, which is also an ideal choice for couples seeking relaxation amidst nature, where the soothing sounds of the surrounding forest become an integral part of your stay. This room also offers complete privacy and comfort, making it a perfect retreat for you if you’re a solo traveller. 

You can even select a room with a river view that features two separate rooms connected by an interior door. With one double bed and two single beds, it's the ideal choice for a family jungle adventure. You also have the option to stay in a Jungle Deluxe, where your cabin becomes your cosy little house within the jungle.

All rooms are strategically placed, providing you with both security and privacy in the lush wilderness. As you wake up in the morning, the sounds of the rainforest become your alarm clock, and the vibrant colours of the jungle come to life before your eyes. In the evening, twinkling stars greet you above the rainforest canopy, where you'll realise that true luxury is in the unfiltered travel experiences.

Staying here will fill your days with authentic adventures – observing the unique flora and fauna, hearing the songs of birds and the rustling of leaves, and experiencing the untamed magic of the rainforest. With a strong commitment to conservation, this lodge not only offers a unique adventure but also fosters a sense of responsibility towards preserving the world's most diverse ecosystem.

name: Kura Boutique Hotel
intro:
A boutique, adults-only hotel high in the Uvita rainforest. Kura is an exclusive destination in its own right.

Our 8 Luxury Suites, tropical minimalist design, and panoramic views set the stage for ultra-personalized luxury, relaxation, and privacy.

Welcome to our tropical utopia.

news_article.title: Visit the Most Romantic Adults-Only Kura Hotel
news_article.description: An Exclusive Boutique Resort in Costa Rica

postcards.name: Indulge in Fine Dining at Kura
postcards.intro: The dining experience at the Kura Hotel in Costa Rica is a straightforward and satisfying affair. The on-site restaurant offers a variety of dishes that feature fresh, local ingredients. Whether you're savouring seafood, regional specialities or international cuisine, you can expect a satisfying and delicious dining experience during your stay at Kura.
postcards.story:
Costa Rican cuisine reflects a blend of simple and hearty flavours. You’ll surely enjoy eating fresh fruits like mangoes, pineapples and papayas that are copiously available here. The country's abundant coastal areas offer you a bounty of fresh seafood, from ceviche, a zesty fish or shrimp dish marinated in citrus juices, to fried fish served with a squeeze of lemon. 

For mindful travellers like you, dining at Kura is a true highlight. Here, you’ll be offered a colourful and diverse selection of distinctive and flavoursome dishes. The cooking philosophy at the hotel revolves around pure, organic and responsibly sourced ingredients. With a focus on local produce, you’ll be served with greens that grow at the hotel itself for you to enjoy.

You'll find a focus on super fresh, local seafood, too. From fish carpaccio to spiced ceviche, the catch of the day is always sustainably sourced for you. The meat dishes are hormone-free, grass-fed and ethically raised by farmers just down the road, ensuring a delectable and conscious dining experience for you.

Here, you'll find a delectable selection of vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. You’ll notice how the hotel prioritises super fresh, locally sourced seafood, with their kitchen being well-equipped to accommodate all food allergies. Their commitment to using the freshest local ingredients ensures the quality of every dish served to you. 

Interestingly, you’ll also witness how Kura takes pride in its secret homemade recipes that add a special touch to your dining experience. If you crave something not listed on the menu, the chef is more than willing to prepare it for you.

Costa Ricans love their coffee, and you’ll find strong cups of locally grown coffee throughout the country. Don’t forget to enjoy your cup of coffee here.

postcards.name: Visit the Adults-Only Boutique Hotel in Costa Rica
postcards.intro: Immerse yourself in a relaxing stay at Kura in Costa Rica. Here, you’re warmly invited to enjoy an upscale, adults-only retreat amidst the breathtaking beauty of this tropical paradise.
postcards.story:
Just a scenic 60-minute drive south of Manuel Antonio, you'll find Uvita nestled along the breathtaking South Pacific coastline of Costa Rica's pristine Osa region. From the lush, forested mountains to the expansive coastline, you'll discover an abundance of national parks and nature reserves that rank among the most extensive in Costa Rica. These remarkable destinations offer you unparalleled opportunities for snorkelling, surfing and observing the extraordinary marine life.

Nestled amid Costa Rica's lush rainforests, Kura Hotel offers you a serene escape. Its sun-soaked terraces provide clear views of the vibrant jungle canopy, where tropical birds sing soulful songs. As day turns to night, warm lantern-lit pathways invite exploration of the forest's mysteries. In this secluded haven, the unspoiled beauty of Costa Rica encourages you to immerse yourself in the natural harmony of the surroundings.

Crafted with couples in mind, Kura's eight luxury suites offer the epitome of exclusivity and privacy. Reserved exclusively for adults, these sanctuaries boast sweeping 180-degree views from the rainforest to the endless expanse of the ocean. With open and spacious floor plans, these suites feature iconic glass showers and are adorned with all the modern comforts of a relaxed retreat.

Undoubtedly, Kura is one of the most glamorous and romantic hotels in Costa Rica. At Kura, you’ll be provided intimate and guided tours to ensure you can fully immerse yourself in these diverse experiences. From trendy restaurants and local farmers' markets to thrilling whale-watching, surfing and snorkelling, this place boasts an array of attractions.

National Geographic has acclaimed this region as ‘one of the most biologically intense regions on Earth’, showcasing its unspoiled charm. It remains a largely undiscovered gem, awaiting exploration. Ready to indulge in some intimate moments with your partner at Kura?

name: Isla Palenque
intro:
Isla Palenque Resort is for the wayfarers, explorers, the seekers. The adventurous ones who still believe in wonder.

We know you have many choices in where you venture to next. If our philosophy resonates with you, you have come to the right place.

news_article.title: Discover a Tropical Island Experience at Isla Palenque
news_article.description: A Premier Island Resort in Panama

postcards.name: Enjoy Your Next Luxury Island Experience at Isla Palenque
postcards.intro: As you arrive on the shores of Panama, Isla Palenque welcomes you to soak yourself in wonder. This unspoiled location provides a true connection with nature, serving as a retreat that renews your spirit. Here’s a place where you can reflect, discover peace and wholeheartedly embrace the beauty of simplicity. Get ready for a truly untouched tropical island experience.
postcards.story:
When did you last experience a profound sense of wonder about the world? Are you curious to find an unforgettable tropical island experience? Life is nothing without a sense of wonder and curiosity. Your quest for Panama's finest island resort is fulfilled at Isla Palenque, where you’ll invigorate and rejuvenate your senses, ultimately returning home transformed.

Isla Palenque's unspoiled landscapes and pristine beaches provide a gateway to nature. Here, you can observe the intricate balance of ecosystems, serving as a gentle reminder of our duty to preserve the environment. The island's genuine allure encourages you to be in the moment, to inhale the fresh air and to cherish moments of peaceful reflection. In the heart of this natural haven, you'll find the essence of mindful travel.

Isla Palenque was home to an ancient, pre-Columbian community. Centuries ago, Indigenous tribes named it "Palenque," signifying a sanctuary. Today, the island endures as a haven for precious primary forests, teeming with hundreds of plant species, flowers, wildlife and birds. You’ll truly enjoy listening to the chirping birds here, making you feel as if they’re singing exclusively for you. 

The brilliant design, artisanal furniture, and every single detail and amenity provided here have been thoughtfully chosen to enhance and uphold what is considered to be the most prized luxury feature.

At this 400-acre private tropical island resort, you’ll find an exceptional location, with lush primary forests, seven secluded beaches and a history of archaeological significance. It’s designed for the wanderers, the adventurers and the inquisitive souls like you – those who continue to hold on to the sense of wonder.

If you’re looking for a mindful tropical island experience — you will find it here.

postcards.name: Immerse in island wellness and mindfulness at Isla Palenque
postcards.intro: Wellness is a fundamental aspect of island living. Here, you'll enjoy wholesome, locally sourced meals; wake up with the sun; and find the freedom to truly be present in the moment. Let the island's serene ambience and the rejuvenating wellness activities be your guide to a deeper, more meaningful connection with your own well-being.
postcards.story:
Wellness is about nurturing your overall well-being through mindful choices and self-care practices. It's a simple, yet powerful, act of prioritising your physical and mental health. At Isla Palenque, wellness isn't just a concept; it's a journey that leads to the perfect harmony between nature and the soul. It's an opportunity to nourish your well-being amidst the beauty of this tropical paradise, a place where serenity and rejuvenation are woven into the very fabric of the island.

If you’re a yoga enthusiast, you'll find secluded, tranquil spots and dedicated platforms where you can enhance your practice, nestled amidst thriving palms and coconut groves. If beachfront yoga sessions align with your vacation style, you'll have the luxury of choosing from seven beautiful beaches. 

You can also enjoy Relaxing or Deep Tissue Massages from the Spa and Wellness Menu and even include revitalising facial treatments. These soothing massages can be experienced in the privacy of your room or under the open sky, where you'll harmonise with the rhythm of Panama's Pacific Ocean. It's an opportunity to sync your mind and soul with nature. 

Here, you’ll notice how thoughtfully your comfort has been prioritised, offering you a homely space to relax yourself. The in-room massages are best suited to fit in your itinerary at your preferred time. You'll also find a yoga mat, block and meditation cushion in every room, allowing you to make the most of your days, taking precious moments just for yourself.

Wellness involves making conscious decisions, whether it's through a balanced diet, regular exercise or moments of quiet reflection, all aimed at ensuring you are at your best, both physically and emotionally. Stay assured that you’re at the right place – enhancing the quality of your life, one step at a time.

name: Pacuare Lodge
intro: Pacuare Lodge is a luxury, eco-hotel with only 20 suites and situated on the banks of one of the world’s most scenic, white-water wonders, the Pacuare River of Costa Rica. This unparalleled location, with its vibrant nature, offers a scenic backdrop to adventure, romance and wellness.

news_article.title: Revel in Costa Rica’s Ultimate Rainforest Experience at Pacuare Lodge
news_article.description: A Nature Stay in the Costa Rican Rainforest

postcards.name: Experience the White-Water Wonders of the Pacuare River
postcards.intro: The Pacuare Lodge in Costa Rica nestles in the heart of nature, offering you a unique and immersive experience in the lush, vibrant rainforest. When you’re here, you’re always surrounded by the sights and sounds of the jungle, providing you with a tranquil escape from the chaos of your everyday life.
postcards.story:
The rustic charm and simplicity of the Pacuare Lodge make it a perfect place to disconnect and unwind. A relaxing stay in your villa will help you wake up to the melodies of exotic birds, enjoy delicious local cuisine, and soak in the breathtaking natural beauty that surrounds you. Located on the pristine banks of the Pacuare River in Costa Rica, Pacuare Lodge stands as a luxurious eco-hotel, with just 20 elegantly designed suites – guaranteeing you many exclusive experiences when you’re here.  

If you’re seeking adventure and a deep connection with the environment, this will be an authentic and unforgettable experience for you. Here, you’ll always be surrounded by the beauty of the Pacuare River, renowned as one of the world's most scenic white-water wonders. It starts from Costa Rica's tallest mountain and flows through a large area of primary tropical rainforest before reaching the Tortuguero canals. You’ll appreciate how the Pacuare River is home to Cabécar Indigenous communities who still practise their traditions and culture.

The lodge's setting is nothing short of magical, providing an exhilarating backdrop for adventures, romantic getaways and moments of serenity. Rooted in simplicity yet graced with sophistication, you’ll notice how the architecture of the lodge draws inspiration from the Indigenous Cabécar culture. Surrounded by untouched rainforest, the lodge offers you a farm-to-table culinary experience that's nothing short of exquisite.
 
This place is simply a haven of opulence, where every detail is carefully curated to blend the finest of comforts and elegance. Here, every moment unfolds as an ode to the extraordinary, promising an experience like no other.

postcards.name: Spend the Night Among the Treetops in the Rainforest
postcards.intro: Are you a nature enthusiast who cherishes the beauty of trees? Imagine the sheer delight of spending a night in the heart of Costa Rica's breathtaking rainforest, surrounded by the lush canopy. If the very thought of this experience stirs your imagination and stokes your curiosity, you're in for a truly soothing adventure.
postcards.story:
At Pacuare Lodge, you'll witness an abundance of wildlife, from colourful birds to exotic creatures. As you explore the lush forests, you’ll instantly fall in love with the swaying trees and the gentle breeze that caresses your face and your soul from within. The Canopy Villa at Pacuare Lodge offers you an inspiring retreat high above the forest floor. Perched amidst the treetops, it provides a unique vantage point to immerse yourself in the beauty of the jungle. 

The sounds of nature envelop you, and the lush green surroundings create a serene atmosphere. It's a place where you can truly connect with the environment and find inspiration in the simplicity of being among the trees. The Canopy Villa offers you a 360-degree view of the lush rainforest, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the jungle. You'll have a private suspension bridge leading from your deck to a lofty platform nestled within a massive rainforest tree. From this aerial perch, you can enjoy sweeping views of the Pacuare River and the surrounding jungle.

In the mornings or evenings, you can spot a variety of bird species in the nearby treetops from your elevated vantage point. The villa features a high roof, teak floors, and wide-screened windows that let the breeze in, providing panoramic views of the rainforest. Your villa is tastefully furnished and boasts a comfortable king-size canopy bed. 

As you step out onto the adjacent covered deck, you'll find a cosy hammock and comfortable seating, creating a perfect spot for you to unwind. The entire suite seamlessly connects to a sun-soaked deck and a refreshing small stone swimming pool, fed by spring water. Truly, Costa Rica's natural beauty is every traveller's dream.

name: Batu Batu
intro: Batu Batu, set in the protected Johor Marine Park is an unspoilt island retreat where a deep respect for nature is at the core of everything we do. We strongly believe that private sector tourism can act as a catalyst for positive change through the preservation and regeneration of the rich but fragile biodiversity around our amazing island and beyond.

news_article.title: Discovering the Serene Beauty of Batu Batu
news_article.description: An Island Retreat Supporting Biodiversity in Malaysia

postcards.name: Relish Traditional and Fresh Seafood at Batu Batu
postcards.intro: Batu Batu is renowned for its exceptional cuisine, offering full-board meals served three times daily in the resort's main restaurant. A welcoming open-sided pavilion offers you breathtaking ocean views while you relish the local food. Enjoy the food, enjoy the views and take back some memories with you.
postcards.story:
Malaysian cuisine is a delightful fusion of diverse flavours, combining fresh herbs, aromatic spices and a rich blend of ingredients. From savoury curries to grilled skewers and mouth-watering noodle dishes, every bite offers a taste of Malaysia's culinary diversity. It's a gastronomic journey that captures the essence of this vibrant nation.

At Batu Batu, dining is an extraordinary experience, where the daily menus for both lunch and dinner showcase the finest local seafood and top-quality meats in a mix of Malaysian and Western dishes. In the resort's main restaurant, a spacious open-sided pavilion with sweeping 270-degree sea views, you can savour dishes like the classic Malaysian beef rendang, slow-cooked to perfection with the island's own coconut milk and lemongrass, served with fragrant rice. Indulge in fresh snapper grilled in homegrown banana leaves, paired with Malaysian-style chilli paste, as well as nourishing bowls, salads and chargrilled ribeye with green papaya. 

If you have a sweet tooth, the bakery and pastry kitchen will offer you an array of homemade bread, ice creams, tarts and an abundance of fresh tropical fruits. Nestled amid the rocky terrain, the bar offers beautiful views of the sea, seamlessly connected to the resort's main restaurant. Here, you can savour a lemongrass martini, a refreshing cold beer or a wholesome fresh fruit juice as you gaze upon the vast expanse of the South China Sea.

You can even go to the Tiki Bar, which typically opens at 11 am and remains in operation until nightfall. Here, you’re offered a modest yet delightful array of beverages to enjoy as you relax on the beach. Your family's dining experience at Batu Batu is tailored to ensure that everyone, no matter how young, enjoys a delightful and fuss-free meal.

postcards.name: Breathe and Reconnect at Batu Batu – a Calm Island Retreat
postcards.intro: Welcome to a pristine island haven that wholeheartedly champions ecological principles and firmly believes in the positive impact of tourism on preserving biodiversity and uplifting local communities. Batu Batu is an ideal choice if you’re seeking a harmonious and rejuvenating stay nestled in the wild and natural environment of Malaysia.
postcards.story:
Imagine yourself on an island covered in dense forest, surrounded by calm white beaches where the only movement comes from crabs scuttling around and the rhythmic dance of the ocean. The gentle waves create a soothing backdrop to the swaying coconut palms, occasionally interrupted by the calls of migratory birds. Does this sound exciting and soothing?

At Batu Batu, you'll find yourself immersed in a world of natural beauty and relaxation. This eco-conscious retreat serves as a testament to the belief that responsible tourism can enrich both the environment and the local community. Wondering what Batu Batu means? Named after the Malay word for ‘rocks’, Batu Batu is a charming island getaway nestled among coconut groves, rugged rock formations and pristine sandy shores. This hidden gem is situated on the uninhabited Pulau Tengah, gracing the eastern coast of peninsular Malaysia.  

Batu Batu, situated within the sheltered embrace of the Johor Marine Park, stands as an unspoiled island sanctuary, where an unwavering respect for nature directs every effort. Crafted by skilled local carpenters, the 20 one-bedroom and 2 two-bedroom villas are created from an array of tropical hardwoods, employing traditional methods that mirror the Malay style. You’ll notice how the villa effortlessly merges with the wild and untouched landscape of the island, creating an atmosphere of a traditional Malay 'kampung' or village.


Relaxed sun-drenched days invite you to discover the island's eight pristine sandy shores, and you can even delve into the fragile ecosystems with the guidance of on-site biologists. Apart from the serene seashore and the beach, Batu Batu's array of services and amenities are thoughtfully designed to ensure your stay is exceptionally comfortable. 

Are you prepared to be a catalyst for positive change, contributing to the preservation and revitalisation of the delicate yet abundant biodiversity on this remarkable island?

name: The Datai Langkawi
intro: Nestled in the heart of an ancient rainforest, The Datai Langkawi is a captivating beach resort that blends into its natural surroundings. Situated on the mystical island of Langkawi, the resort’s lush tropical rainforest embraces each room, suite and villa, with private verandas and breathtaking views. This serene haven is where you can reconnect with nature and uplift your soul.

news_article.title: Celebrate the Vibrant Local Culture of Malaysia With The Datai Langkawi
news_article.description: A Peaceful Stay on the Beautiful Langkawi Island

postcards.name: Rest and Pause in the Luxurious Cocoon of Silence
postcards.intro: The Datai Langkawi Resort is more than just a destination; it's a temple of nature, a reminder to cherish the simple wonders and to tread lightly upon the Earth. If you’re a mindful traveller, this resort offers a space for reflection, the pursuit of serenity and a chance to rekindle a harmonious connection with the world.
postcards.story:
Perched on the tranquil northwestern corner of Langkawi Island, along Malaysia's western shoreline, The Datai Langkawi invites mindful travellers to experience a profound sense of well-being in the midst of the island's diverse local cultures, enchanting waterfalls, serene paddy fields, meandering mangroves and concealed waterways.

Here, every room, suite and villa offers captivating views of the vibrant Langkawi rainforest, with some overlooking the serene Andaman Sea and Tarutao Island on the horizon. You'll also discover a range of dining experiences that draw inspiration from culinary traditions both local to Malaysia and across the globe. These distinctive culinary journeys unfold in exceptional settings, accentuated by breathtaking views that harmonise with the natural serenity of The Datai's surroundings.

Often referred to as the 'Jewel of Kedah', Langkawi boasts a range of captivating environments, from untouched rainforests to rugged mountains and fertile rice fields. The name Langkawi, thought to combine 'helang' (Malay for eagle) and 'Kawi' (Sanskrit for marble), resonates with the island's rich folklore, with significant landmarks like Machincang Mountain bearing testament to its cultural heritage.


Tucked within the depths of an age-old rainforest, The Datai Langkawi is a tranquil beach resort seamlessly integrated into the natural world — abundant tropical rainforest envelopes every corner of this resort. This peaceful sanctuary is your space to rekindle your connection with nature and rejuvenate your spirit.

Here, there are no extravagant flourishes or ostentatious displays; instead, it's a place where the essence of the rainforest meets the simplicity of luxury. The resort is a whispered invitation to slow down, to immerse oneself in the wisdom of the ancient jungle, and to relish the song of the birds. Pause, breathe deeply, and let the serenity of the surroundings inspire you.

postcards.name: Enjoy authentic Malaysian cuisine at The Gulai House
postcards.intro: The dining experience at The Gulai House in The Datai Langkawi is a soulful journey where local flavours come to life. Set in the heart of nature, the restaurant's tranquil surroundings and authentic Malaysian dishes make for a truly memorable meal. Let’s appreciate the dining experiences that transcend the ordinary.
postcards.story:
Authentic Malaysian cuisine is a tantalising fusion of flavours, a vibrant amalgamation of various culinary traditions. It celebrates the harmony of spices and herbs, sizzling street food and aromatic curries. This cuisine is a sensory exploration, where bold and subtle flavours come together to create an unforgettable culinary adventure.

Excite your senses with the award-winning, authentic Malaysian cuisine in Langkawi. Cocooned deep within the rainforest, The Gulai House's traditional Malay kampung house harmonises with the natural surroundings. This traditional setting beautifully features floor seating (bersila), rustic dining tables and subtle lighting, enriching your dining encounter in a serene atmosphere.

With the setting sun, the warm evening lights gently illuminate the surroundings and bring the restaurant to life. Amidst the awe-inspiring views and lush greenery, this exquisitely adorned restaurant creates a captivating ambience. The flavours of the food become even more enriched and intensified in such a soothing environment.

Indulge in the regional, authentic flavours available on the menu while being serenaded by the gentle sounds of the forest's wildlife. You can even pair your meal with an exclusive wine selection, creating an unforgettable dining experience. As you savour each bite, you can't help but feel the connection to the land and the culture, adding depth to your culinary experience. It's a reminder that simple ingredients and a harmonious setting can create a dining experience that touches the heart and soul.

Dining at The Gulai House is a mindful and reflective experience. In case you need to take a phone call or use your device briefly, you’ll be encouraged to step away from your table to do so. Such thoughtful ideas invoke a deep connection to the roots of the local traditions.

name: Arenas Del Mar
intro: If you’re searching for a full five-star Costa Rica experience — beachfront, rainforest, wildlife right at  resort, Manuel Antonio National Park a stone’s throw away and endless adventures at your fingertips — you will find it here at Arenas Del Mar Luxury Resort.

news_article.title: Experience the Rainforest Magic at Arenas Del Mar Resort
news_article.description: A Luxury Beachfront Resort in Costa Rica

postcards.name: Visit the Only Luxury Beachfront Resort in Manuel Antonio
postcards.intro: Here’s an amazing hotel right by the beach, where you can relax with comfortable loungers, enjoy the shade under beach umbrellas, and savour delicious cocktails. When you’re in Manuel Antonio, you cannot miss the chance to encounter playful monkeys and tranquil sloths in their natural habitat. Arenas Del Mar awaits you as the ultimate beachfront luxury resort.
postcards.story:
Costa Rica is a land of breathtaking diversity. It's a place where lush rainforests cascade down misty mountain sides and pristine beaches stretch out to meet the waters of the Pacific and the Caribbean. The moment you arrive here, this vibrant country will offer you a spectrum of ecosystems – from the tropical lowlands to the cool cloud forests, and from bustling urban life to tranquil rural landscapes.

Let’s see what a Costa Rican vacation could look like at Arenas Del Mar. Arenas Del Mar is a luxury haven in Manuel Antonio, offering you the unique experience of being both right on the beach and located within the rainforest. Nestled within its own 11-acre private rainforest reserve, it offers you the opportunity to witness wildlife right at your doorstep.

Here, your experience goes beyond just a stay – it's an encounter with nature. With ease, you'll spot monkeys and sloths right on the resort grounds. Your days will be filled with the beauty of two pristine beaches, Playitas Beach and Espadilla Beach, and the nearby path to Manuel Antonio town and Manuel Antonio National Park. 

You’ll be at a place where the wonders of nature and the comforts of a luxury resort come together for an unforgettable experience. As you walk around the resort, you’ll meet the locals who are celebrated for their genuine warmth and welcoming spirit, rooted in a profound connection to the land. You can savour a rich cup of coffee on a quiet patio; hike through a dense jungle; or simply relax on the shore, listening to the gentle rustle of palm leaves. Take a moment to truly absorb the sight of the waves, gently caressing the sandy shores. Let this peaceful scene invite you to dive deeper into introspection.

postcards.name: Sink Your Toes in the Sand at Playitas Restaurant
postcards.intro: Playitas Restaurant at Arenas Del Mar Beachfront is a culinary oasis where the flavours of Costa Rica come alive. Here, the essence of the rainforest meets the freshness of the ocean, creating a tantalising harmony on your plate. Ready to enjoy your meal while sinking your toes in the sand?
postcards.story:
When you’re at the Playitas Beachfront Restaurant, you’ll be excited to see that the dining options are as diverse as the landscape itself. Imagine your dining table right on the beach, enveloped by lush trees and captivating wildlife. Seated amidst the natural beauty of the coast, you'll savour your meal to the soothing soundtrack of the waves. As you sink your toes in the sand in a playful way, the sun’s warm rays gently pass through the swaying palms and fall on your face. 

Here, you have the pleasure of indulging in a relaxed midday meal, all while the service team caters to you in the comfort of your lounge chair. With each bite, you take a journey through the vibrant and diverse local ingredients, guided by the skilful hands of the chefs. Relax, kick off your shoes, and watch monkeys playfully swing through the trees overhead.

With a blend of outdoor and indoor seating, the beachfront restaurant offers a range of choices for guests. Whether you're a vegan, gluten-free or vegetarian diner, there's a menu crafted to suit your tastes. Interestingly, there’s also a kid-friendly selection that includes familiar favourites, as well as healthier alternatives to please young palates. You can even indulge in the timeless art of crafting classic tortillas with the Tortilla Making Classes at Playitas Restaurant.


As the sun sets, casting its warm, golden glow over the Pacific, Playitas Restaurant transforms into an enchanting setting for memorable dining experiences. You can join the beachside BBQs and Street Food Nights, or even go for a private dinner on their secluded beach. It's here that you'll discover the true taste of Costa Rica, where nature, culture and cuisine converge to create moments that linger long in your memory.

name: Coconut Lagoon
intro: Set amidst the backwaters and the Vembanad Lake, Coconut Lagoon is a typical traditional Kerala tharavad, painstakingly transplanted and restored. An architectural marvel, it exudes the charm of the Kerala life of yore. And transports one to a world of peace and contentment.

news_article.title: Celebrating Cultures, Community and Conservation at Coconut Lagoon
news_article.description: A Coastal Paradise in Kerala

postcards.name: Taste the Goodness of Tea from the Floating Tea Shop
postcards.intro: Life along the backwaters relies on the graceful art of floating, allowing one to seamlessly navigate from one place to another. Coconut Lagoon’s floating tea shop beautifully embodies this way of life, a delightful opportunity to meet the charming Tea Lady from the nearby village, who warmly welcomes you into her world.
postcards.story:
Nestled along the banks of Vembanad Lake, Kumarakom in Kerala is a place where life flows at an unhurried pace. Kerala invites you to discover the beauty of this backwater haven, where local culture, nature and the simple joys of life come together to create a profound and relaxed experience. 

Kerala's backwater life is simple and serene. The relaxed rhythms of village routines, the colourful boats dotting the waterways and the welcoming smiles of the local people evoke a sense of connection with a cherished way of living. Here, in the heart of this idyllic landscape, you'll discover the art of coexisting with nature and the joy of sharing in age-old traditions. 

When you’re at Coconut Lagoon, you cannot miss visiting their floating tea shop, where the aromatic whispers of freshly brewed tea blend with the gentle ripples of the backwaters. The rustic charm of Kumarakom invites you to savour a cup of tea, an experience as soothing as the surrounding backwaters. The charming Tea Lady gracefully serves you tea on serene, floating boats. 
There’s something special about meeting and greeting local people when you travel. Their stories inspire you and transport you to a very different world. As you enjoy sharing stories, time pauses, and the world drifts away – all while sipping a steaming cup of tea. Here, a sip of tea becomes a moment of connection with the local culture, an opportunity to celebrate the rich simplicity of life on the water, and an invitation to experience the ancient art of Indian hospitality.

Whether you’re watching the fishermen cast their nets or experiencing the warm hospitality of local families, the backwaters of Kerala offer a genuine and inspiring glimpse into a life intimately intertwined with water.

postcards.name: Celebrate Kerala’s Quintessential Backwater Experience
postcards.intro: Coconut Lagoon weaves a connection between coconut groves and the intricate web of backwater canals. Here, age-old Keralan homes find new life and are carefully transplanted, preserved and celebrated. Welcome to your own tranquil oasis, cocooned within the thriving beauty of Kerala's backwaters, where you can immerse yourself in the warmth of Indian hospitality.
postcards.story:
Welcome to Coconut Lagoon, a tranquil Coconut Lagoon in Kumarakom embodies the serene beauty of Vembanad Lake. Once you’re here, you’ll notice how CGH Earth takes pride in its commitment to preserving the delicate environment and rich culture of Kuttanad. The old agrarian homes have been thoughtfully and lovingly restored to offer you a distinctive experience, where the backwaters gently guide your senses.

The resort exudes an understated charm, with its rustic cottages that seem to float on the tranquil water. As you step onto the wooden walkways, the gentle lapping of the water and the chirping of birds create a soothing soundtrack. The air is fresh with the earthy scent of coconut palms, and the simple elegance of the architecture merges seamlessly with the surrounding landscape. It's a place where time slows down, taking you on a journey of introspection. All that matters here is the stillness of the moment, the whispering palms, and the reflections on the water. 

To reach this boutique property, there's just one path – across the water. Your journey begins with a boat ride from a private jetty, a kilometre upstream. Gently passing through the swaying coconut palms, you already feel welcomed. It's an adventure that sets the tone for your holiday – an exciting novelty with a deeply nurturing essence.

If you’re a bird enthusiast, Coconut Lagoon offers countless opportunities for bird-watching. The guest cottages are nothing short of living works of art, meticulously constructed from the remnants of old mansions – tharavads, that were once the family homes of the nobility of the land. These sections were transported here and masterfully reassembled, allowing you to immerse yourself in the historic opulence of old times. Come and celebrate life on the backwaters of Kerala and immerse yourself in the melodies of the Earth.

name: Emboo River Camp
intro: Emboo River is the first lodge in Kenya and beyond that has its entire fleet of Safari Vehicles powered by solar energy. Glide through the grasslands, listen to the roar of a leopard and the songs of birds and enjoy the scents of the savanna.

news_article.title: Exploring the Maasai Mara at Emboo River Camp
news_article.description: A Luxury Wilderness Camp in Kenya

postcards.name: Witness the Great Migration of Africa at Maasai Mara
postcards.intro: Welcome to the Maasai Mara, an untamed wilderness where nature's splendour takes centre stage. Here, on the vast plains of Kenya, the world awakens to a never-ending cycle of life and death, and of renewal and survival. Come, let’s take a journey to the surreal landscapes full of wildlife, stunning views and unforgettable sunsets.
postcards.story:
Nestled deep within the heart of the Maasai Mara National Reserve, Emboo River wholeheartedly invites you for a profound connection with the wild. Emboo River’s commitment to nature goes beyond the safaris. When you prepare for your safari, you notice how the lodge has been intentionally left unfenced, ensuring that the boundaries between luxury and the wilderness blur seamlessly. The moment you step into an electric safari vehicle, your adventure begins, immersing you in the raw, unspoiled beauty of this renowned reserve. 

If you’re here during the months of August to September, you’ll witness the magnificent spectacle of the Great Migration unfold right in front of you. This awe-inspiring natural phenomenon draws millions of wildebeest, zebra and antelope to the Maasai Mara in their quest for nourishing grasslands. 

These herds eternally chase the rains and the scent of ripe, red oat grass. They traverse the Maasai Mara's varied terrain, crossing grasslands and rivers in their relentless quest for sustenance. You may find it challenging to predict their exact location within the reserve well in advance because they’re beautifully attuned to the ever-shifting rhythms of nature.

The dramatic river crossings, a highlight of the Great Migration, can occur at any moment during this season. The Maasai Mara is crisscrossed by numerous rivers and crossing points, and luckily, there’s a popular crossing point next to Emboo River Camp. You can sit back comfortably and keep an eye on the crossing to witness the breathtaking annual spectacle. You're not just a guest here but a part of the Maasai Mara. Here, every moment is an opportunity to experience the essence of mindful luxury amid the awe-inspiring wildlife that thrives in this pristine wilderness.

postcards.name: Join a Tree Planting Project at the Emboo River Camp, Kenya
postcards.intro: Emboo River Camp in Kenya is a sustainable safari lodge that offers mindful luxury travellers like you an authentic, sustainable and immersive experience in the African wilderness. Their commitment to responsible tourism is evident in every aspect of their operations, ensuring you a memorable and mindful experience here.
postcards.story:
Launching and operating a fully sustainable lodge in the heart of the Maasai Mara hasn’t been an easy task for the founders of Emboo River Camp. When you arrive here, you’ll notice how the negative impacts of traditional safari lodges have been mindfully reversed. You won’t find polluting safari vehicles or roaring generators that deplete the beauty of this spectacular natural landscape in Kenya. Emboo River has taken sustainable and much-needed steps to protect this ecosystem and empower local communities. 
 
When you hop aboard the electric safari vehicles, you feel more immersed in the surrounding wilderness of the Maasai Mara. These solar-powered, noiseless vehicles leave no exhaust fumes, allowing for a respectful encounter with the local wildlife. With Emboo River, you experience safaris where you can savour the sounds and fragrance of the savanna, and get up close to your favourite animals, all while respecting their natural habitat. Such experiences truly help you become one with nature.

The more mindfully you witness the beauty of this place, the more motivated you feel to contribute towards its conservation. Here, you can actively participate in their ‘Rooting for Our Future’ tree-planting project and feel more satisfied as a responsible traveller. 

Back at the lodge, every meal is crafted from their organic hydroponic garden and cooked using biogas generated from organic waste. You not only savour fresh food here but also leave a positive impact on the environment. Such thoughtful stays allow you to relish every bite of your meal with a much deeper connection to the natural world.

Emboo River is the only carbon-neutral safari lodge in the region, and when you take a journey into the Maasai Mara with them, you, too, are at the forefront of these safaris championing sustainability.

name: SwaSwara
intro: SwaSwara means your inner voice and true to its name, this is a place of natural harmony to release, refocus and recalibrate the self.

news_article.title: Celebrate Mindful Luxury at SwaSwara
news_article.description: A Boutique Stay in India's Western Ghats in Karnataka

postcards.name: Listen to Your Inner Voice at SwaSwara on the Om Beach
postcards.intro: Have you been looking for a holiday to reconnect and reinvigorate your senses? Or seeking a transformational experience amplified by spirituality and tranquillity? If you’re a responsible traveller searching for mindful luxury experiences, the timeless beauty of the Western Ghats in India cordially invites you to immerse yourself in the symphony of nature at SwaSwara!
postcards.story:
As the sun gracefully emerges on the horizon, it joyously spreads its stunning rays on the seashore of the Arabian Sea. These bright rays exuberantly fall on SwaSwara – a boutique property nestled on Om Beach in Karnataka. SwaSwara means your inner voice, and rightly justifying its name, this is the perfect place to release, refocus and recalibrate. When you arrive, you naturally feel drawn to Om Beach, which surprises you with its natural wonders.

At the beach, the golden sands and calming waves nourish you with the healing touch of Ayurveda, the strength of yoga, the joy of art exploration and countless experiences in pristine nature. Om Beach is beautifully nestled on the coastline of Gokarna in Karnataka. This is not simply a beach, but a place where the terrestrial realm gently cradles the dancing waves of the sea. Standing on the seashore, you feel the symphony of the waves echoing with the cosmic vibrations of the vast universe. This experience will surely remind you of the interconnectedness of all things.

Interestingly, Om Beach reveals its secret from above — a natural formation that resembles the sacred Hindu symbol it's named after. This awe-inspiring visual metaphor for the unity of life becomes etched on your soul forever!

Crafted in the colours of our Earth and the sacred land that nurtures it, SwaSwara makes you feel at home. This luxurious and sustainable abode invites you to contemplate the profound meanings of life. The rhythmic melodies of the Arabian Sea soothe you like a peaceful mantra that keeps chanting during your stay at SwaSwara. This is not just a luxury haven but also a place where the mind effortlessly finds clarity, the body finds rejuvenation and the spirit finds peace.

postcards.name: Reliving the Old Traditions Inside the Walls of SwaSwara
postcards.intro: SwaSwara is an open book of poetry, which timelessly shares poems of its architecture, design and ambience. The earth tones of this boutique property blend well with the land. So when you’re here, you feel as if the cacophony of your fast-paced life no longer exists, and all that surrounds you is a blessing from nature!
postcards.story:
When you’re at SwaSwara, you start believing that true luxury is not found in opulent extravagance, but in the embrace of nature's simple havens. If you’re a mindful luxury traveller who prioritises sustainable living, then you cannot miss this place! Here, nature shares some of its best stories featuring the Arabian Sea, the rhythmic waves, the melodies of the breeze and the dancing of the rustling leaves. The swaying coconut palms welcome you, and the slow breeze on your face makes you feel nostalgic. It feels like you’re coming home after a long time.

The walls of SwaSwara are painted with colours that symbolise the grounding energy of the earth, offset by the healing purity of white. Your homely villa is surrounded by open and green spaces that have been created within the confines of your walls. Though you have your own private space, you’re exposed to nature and the open blue skies that keep peeping at you from every corner of this sanctuary. You’ll not even realise how these surroundings naturally heal you in countless ways. 

The earthy and simple design of the property provides ample comfort and luxury to you. As you step on the yoga deck on the second level, the mesmerising views of the countryside and the sea will amplify the experience of your yoga session. 

The sea-facing villas offer astonishing views of the setting sun, which paints the sky in hues of gold and orange. There’s an old tradition of keeping towels in your rooms. These are called Kara Thorthu and are made by local women weavers from the surrounding villages. In fact, there are healing plants and medicinal herbs that grow on the property in distinct spots including the courtyards of the guest villas. Isn’t this a perfect coexistence of tradition and modernity?

name: Vaidekam, Kannur
intro: Niraamaya Retreats Vaidekam is a green, eco-friendly sanctuary located in the stunning Malabar region of Kerala - Kannur. Our property is nestled within 14 acres of tranquil surroundings, offering guests a secluded and serene haven close to the Kuttikol River.

news_article.title: Experience Wellness by the River at Vaidekam
news_article.description: An Eco-Friendly Retreat in the Malabar Region of Kerala

postcards.name: Step into the Art of Wellness at Vaidekam
postcards.intro: Niraamaya Retreats Vaidekam is an eco-friendly paradise nestled in the emerald-coloured forests in Kerala. This 14 acres of tranquil surroundings will offer you a peaceful and solitary escape from the everyday hustle of life. This serene haven is located in the breathtaking Malabar region of Kerala, and every moment spent here gets collected in your treasure of memories.
postcards.story:
Rightly known as ‘God’s Own Country’, Kerala’s vibrant traditions blend well with a touch of modernity. Some of these modern yet culturally rich experiences are wholeheartedly offered at the Niraamaya Retreats Vaidekam. Here, you’ll be welcomed to a secluded and serene haven close to the Kuttikol River, making your stay full of nature’s surprises. As you delve deeper into introspection, the meditative surroundings will naturally clear your mind and relax your body. 

Kannur is a historic town on the northern shores of Kerala. Nothing short of a gem, this place is full of awe-inspiring scenery and views. The majestic Arabian Sea melodiously greets the shore and gifts the land some of its natural treasures, like seashells and other natural stones. The serene backwaters and traditional boats are a sight to behold. 

Vaidekam is a boutique property featuring 35 rooms representing a perfect blend of ancient and modern design. The thoughtful design of this boutique property creates a soothing environment where you can enjoy some authentic Ayurvedic treatments and an array of wellness activities. Being an eco-friendly and environmentally sustainable hotel, Vaidekam is a great choice for mindful travellers seeking authentic travel experiences. 

At dusk, the sun paints the sky with its shades of amber, gold and orange. The birds end their day with melodious chirping that keeps playing in a loop in your head. The entire property warmly glows when the setting sun dips into the horizon, casting its rays on the walls of this aesthetic property. 

The immersive experiences at Niraamaya Vaidekam will profoundly impact your wellness and elevate your sense of well-being. From the moment you step into this luxury property, you’ll feel enveloped by natural beauty and the warmth of a home. Every minute spent here is an opportunity to reconnect with your inner self.

postcards.name: Witness the Traditional and Mystical Dance Forms in Kannur
postcards.intro: Have you ever immersed yourself in the cultural world of South Indian dance in Kerala? Ever witnessed Kalari or Kathakali? In Kannur, you’ll get to closely watch these traditional dance forms and interact with the artists to understand the significance of every small story that these dance forms depict.
postcards.story:
The historic land of Kannur proudly represents and showcases the rich culture and heritage of Kerala. The centuries-old mystical dance form of Theyyam is worth watching if you visit this part of India. But this isn’t all that Kerala offers to its curious travellers. The martial art of Kalari Payattu gracefully catches your attention, and you’ll love every agile move of the artists who perform it. This art form beautifully combines physical prowess and spiritual discipline. 

Kerala’s cultural heritage has more to offer its visitors with a breathtaking display of storytelling – the classical dance form of Kathakali. Kathakali tells stories through intricate movements and vibrant costumes, showcasing a symphony of artistry and pure emotions. The expressive eyes, intricate gestures, colourful and vibrant costumes and elaborate makeup add depth to the performance. Every small facial expression, flickering of eyes and subtle hand movements cast a spell on those who watch it. After the dance performance, you can even interact with the artists and learn about the history and significance of each art form. 

Kannur clearly displays a world of natural beauty and cultural richness. The soul of this ancient town lies in its nearby beaches, historic sites and lively local markets. Niraamaya Retreats Vaidekam is a perfect example of the harmonious coexistence of tradition and modernity. A stay at this boutique hotel will take you a step closer to witnessing the traditional dance forms of Kerala. 

At Vaidekam, the stress of everyday life simply melts away and the comfort of this luxury retreat nourishes not just your body but your soul, too. The gentle music and calming aroma of natural oils will transport you to a world of dreams. So, come and experience the profound artistic and cultural heritage of Kerala.

name: Samroha, Athirapilly
intro: Perched on a cliff, overlooking the majestic Athirappilly Waterfalls, Niraamaya Retreats Samroha is a serene abode amid nature’s incredible beauty and just a stone's throw away from the cascading waters. It is surrounded by rugged hills, lush green forests, and magnificent views of Athirappilly Falls, which is famously known as the Niagara of India.

news_article.title: Indulge in Coastal Elegance at the Niraamaya Retreats Samroha
news_article.description: Indulge in Wellness by the Sea in Kerala

postcards.name: Rediscover Yourself in the Wilderness of Kerala
postcards.intro:
Niraamaya Retreats Samroha is a tropical getaway for any nature lover. Magnificently located on a cliff, the resort overlooks the Athirappilly Falls that gracefully flow to the Western Ghats. Samroha is the ideal place to rediscover yourself in the wilderness of Kerala. 

When nature offers such delightful views, how could you not get intoxicated with its untamed beauty?
postcards.story:
Cradled by the embrace of the Arabian Sea, Kerala is one of the most beautiful states in India. This is the land that awakens the soul and calms the mind. Kerala has some of the most incredible resorts for its visitors, one of them being the Niraamaya Retreats Samroha. This luxury resort is a serene abode surrounded by rugged hills, lush green forests and magnificent views of Athirappilly Falls. Known as the Niagara of India, the Athirappilly Falls make the heart skip a beat with their cascading water. 

This luxury yet sustainable resort gives you the comfort of your home. The breathtaking location and ambience will make you feel like adding more stars to this already 5-star luxury resort. The old-world charm of Samroha is magnified by its rustic look, but its interiors showcase luxury and elegance. The architecture of Samroha is contemporary, with natural lighting and ample meditative spaces. 

With striking views of the waterfall in front of you, every sip of your hot tea or coffee will delight you. As you recline back on a comfortable chair outside your room, you’ll get enough space and time to rediscover yourself through the calming views of nature. There’s something for everyone here: fun-filled cycling sessions in the forest, the Ayurveda Spa, taking a walk to the local village and wildlife spotting. Here, nature presents you with its best music – the chirping of birds, cascading water, and the rustling of leaves seem very poetic. 

Seems like a perfect setting for you to embrace the feeling of oneness with nature. The breeze around this property is very healing, and it carries with it the fragrance of rejuvenation and rediscovery of the self. It’s time to embrace the art of simply being and celebrate the rhythm of life.

postcards.name: A Spiritual Visit to South Indian Temples in Athirappilly
postcards.intro: The hidden gem of Athirappilly not only showcases nature’s artistry but attracts many pilgrims to two of the most magnificent temples in Thrissur. South India is home to some of the most marvellous temples in the world. Go on a spiritual visit to the Guruvayur Temple and Vadakkumnathan Temple when you come for a stay at Samroha.
postcards.story:
The Niraamaya Retreats Samroha is a sanctuary for inquisitive souls. Surrounded by lush fields, coconut palms and small villages, the resort offers many authentic experiences. The stories of the life and livelihood of the local villagers are constantly narrated by every inch of air you breathe. This air also carries with it the fragrance of incense from many temples located nearby. 

The fresh aroma in and around the boutique property soothes the tired soul and re-energises your spirit with bundles of joy. Temples in South India are not just places of spirituality and devotion, but they also share countless stories of the past. These ancient temples showcase the rich and captivating history of India. 

The two famous temples near the Niraamaya Retreats Samroha are Guruvayur Temple and Vadakkumnathan Temple. Both these temples attract pilgrims not just from India but from around the world. Guruvayur Temple is dedicated to Lord Guruvayurrappa, a form of the revered Hindu deity Vishnu, while Vadakkumnathan Temple is devoted to Lord Shiva. 

Temples in South India showcase the perfect intersection of culture, tradition, spirituality and history. The marvellous architecture of these temples is worth admiring. You can join a guided spiritual tour of both these temples and offer your prayers. These guided tours are organised by the Samroha Hotel itself, assuring you some of the best experiences of your visit. 

There is a dream-like charm that Kerala offers its visitors. As you enjoy the vibrant ecosystem here, the cool sprinkles on your cheeks from the Athirappilly Waterfall remind you of the abundant wonders of nature. And when you come back to your room after a day full of local activities, the comfortable beds will hold you in their arms and sing you to sleep.

name: Backwaters & Beyond, Kumarakom
intro: Niraamaya Retreats Backwaters & Beyond is one of the most beautiful waterfront retreats in Kumarakom, nestled on the banks of Lake Vembanad. Set amidst 8 acres of lush tropical gardens, The retreat houses ten dedicated Ayurveda Rooms offering holistic treatments, combining best practices of Ayurveda.

news_article.title: Experience the Magical Kumarakom at Backwaters & Beyond
news_article.description: A Beautiful Waterfront Retreat in Kerala

postcards.name: Experience the Magical Kumarakom at Backwaters & Beyond
postcards.intro: The enchanting landscapes of Kerala offer nature’s most beautiful secrets, one of them being Kumarakom. Nestled in Kumarakom is the Niraamaya Retreats Backwaters & Beyond, one of the most beautiful waterfront retreats located on the banks of Lake Vembanad. The beautiful tropical scenery is painted with lush green forests and endless backwaters. Welcome to Kerala – God’s Own Country!
postcards.story:
Backwaters & Beyond is a sanctuary of unforgettable memories and endless authentic experiences. Set amidst eight acres of lush tropical gardens, the retreat houses 10 dedicated Ayurveda rooms offering holistic treatments and the best practices of Ayurveda. All that you need is available in abundance at this retreat: privacy, relaxation and rejuvenation. The 5-star resort features a world-class wellness spa rooted in Kerala’s ancient wellness practices. 

Backwaters & Beyond will offer you experiences beyond your imagination. The tropical flora in Kumarakom will intoxicate you with its vibrant colours and earthy fragrances all around. This boutique resort is more than just a picturesque sanctuary of Keralite culture and heritage. A large outdoor swimming pool, a performance deck and two gourmet restaurants offering regional and global cuisine will give you the comfort of a home. 

Spread across 14 acres, the Kumarakom bird sanctuary is a paradise for visitors. Kumarakom is a cluster of many small man-made islands around Vembanad Lake. As you walk around the local streets, you’ll be enthralled by the view of lush green paddy fields and hardworking fishermen. The beauty of Kumarakom will convince you to take a boat ride in the sublime backwaters. As your boat gently dances over the clear water, time slows down to leave a lasting impression on your heart and mind. Slowly riding in a network of backwaters, you’ll relish the fragrance of the delicious and mouthwatering local cuisines of Kerala. 

This luxurious resort always offers uninterrupted views of the sky, land and sea. The fragrance of jasmine blossoms, the unending songs of the birds, and the soulful sunrises and sunsets will gracefully soothe your senses. Dive into the rhythm of nature and let the worries of the world vanish at Backwaters & Beyond.

postcards.name: Visit the Local South Indian Artisans in Kumarakom
postcards.intro: Kumarakom is a paradise of floating abodes – the beautiful houseboats. Drifting gracefully through the intricate canals, these vibrant boats will offer you some of the best glimpses of authentic local life. Visit the South Indian artisans and witness their craft of making toys and handicrafts.
postcards.story:
The aquatic poetry of Kumarakom and the rhythm of its chirping birds is worth hearing. This beautiful part of Kerala will leave you speechless with its countless stories of culture, heritage, landscape, flora and fauna. From a small boat ride to a deep and relaxing spa, every experience has a story of its own. These are the stories you’ll take back home, along with the locally handcrafted souvenirs. 

The best way to know about Kumarakom is by having some warm conversations with the locals. As you listen to their stories, you’ll feel appreciative of their culture, traditions and activities, such as coconut palm frond weaving, screw pine making and fishing. 

Backwaters & Beyond prides itself in promoting sustainable tourism and the vibrant culture of Kerala. This homey boutique property houses some of the best handpicked selection of local crafts, statuettes and exquisite fabrics. You’ll get to choose your souvenir from an array of locally crafted Channapatna toys and bric-a-brac. These beautiful handmade wooden objects are wonderfully coloured with natural vegetable dyes, reflecting the sustainable choices of local people. Any toy or handcrafted item is not just a souvenir; it proudly reflects the rich culture of India.

The eco-friendly cottages at Backwaters & Beyond are full of rustic charm. This resort also offers guided tours of nearby spice plantations that provide a sensory treat along with the scent of cardamom, cinnamon and cloves. These spices add exquisite flavours to locally prepared cuisines.

As you sip the refreshingly sweet coconut water amidst breezy coconut palms in the evening, the golden rays of the setting sun will paint your coconut in gold. Sit on a comfortable reclining chair near the pool and delve deeper into your meditative state. God's own country awaits your homecoming!

name: Surya Samudra, Kovalam
intro: Our Kovalam beach retreat, perched on a dramatic cliff edge flanked by secluded beaches celebrates its natural surroundings. A Relais & Châteaux property, our Kerala Ayurveda retreat is dotted with traditional Keralite heritage cottages that nestle in the shade of breezy coconut palms.

news_article.title: Discover Serenity Along the Shore at Niraamaya Retreats Surya Samudra
news_article.description: Stay in Traditional Keralite Heritage Cottages

postcards.name: Absorb the Colourful Culture of a Fishing Village in Kerala
postcards.intro: Peacefully located along the southwestern edges of India, Kovalam is a tropical paradise and a coastal jewel of Kerala. In Kovalam, you’ll witness the Arabian Sea gracefully meeting the emerald-green shores of Kerala. The countless coconut trees sway to the rhythm of the breeze and patiently wait to offer you their sweet water as a refreshing natural drink.
postcards.story:
Nature decorates the landscape in Kovalam with vibrant colours: turquoise water, dark green palm leaves, muddy-brown sands and endless blue skies above. The countryside in Kerala offers endless opportunities to explore the charming villages and beautiful landscapes. The meandering roads will give you a glimpse into the lives of the people living in small hamlets. 

As you step on a boat for a ride, you’ll get to see people working in the paddies or fishing, as well as children swimming in the shallow waters. These views will make you feel as if time slowed down only for you to live these moments for longer. 

The Surya Samudram retreat is full of enchanting vibes, making every corner of this resort worth clicking and capturing in a frame. The luxury resort offers many local and authentic experiences. As you walk around the resort, you can stop at a local tea shop and indulge in conversations with the locals. The bustling local bazaars are full of souvenirs to carry back home with you. 

At dusk, the rhythmic waves bid goodbye to the tired fishermen, asking them to come back again tomorrow morning. You can watch the fishermen unload their boats at the open-air fish market at Vizhinjam harbour. Evenings in Kovalam unveil the magic of the setting sun, and the gentle breeze makes you feel as if you’re dreaming. 

You can take a short 20-minute drive south of the Surya Samudram to the Poovar estuary. The resort will transfer you to a motorboat that cruises through the beautiful coconut groves on either side of the river. As the boat meanders back to the boat jetty through the mangrove forest, you’ll be accompanied by the soulful songs of the birds. Maybe you can sing along with them too!

postcards.name: Enjoy the Ayurveda Retreat at Keralite Heritage Cottages
postcards.intro: Surrounded by astonishing beach views on a cliff edge, the Surya Samudram retreat offers the traditional feel of Keralite heritage. Nestled in natural surroundings in Kovalam and washed by the waters of the Arabian Sea, this heritage abode will teleport you to a world of unmatched relaxation and luxury.
postcards.story:
With the morning sun gracefully rising above the horizon at dawn, the fishing villages in and around Kovalam come to life. As you are peacefully nestled in the shade of the coconut palms, the fresh breeze at the resort will transport you into moments of tranquillity and solitude.
