Whether you dive into the pool or sip refreshing coconut water at the restaurants, the picturesque Arabian Sea will catch your attention from any corner of this mesmerising resort.

The entire property blends traditional Kerala aesthetics with modern luxury and comfort, offering both calming and luxurious vibes. Kovalam's coastal paradise offers endless natural beauty and a gateway to the divine journey of rejuvenation. 

The luxury retreat houses 10 dedicated Ayurveda rooms offering holistic treatments, combining the best practices of Ayurveda. The award-winning Niraamaya spa is crowned as one of the best 5-star luxury ayurvedic spas in Kerala and will be among the best experiences of your life. Seems like a perfect place to rejuvenate your mind, body and soul! Be assured that nature’s soundtrack will permeate your soul and enhance the relaxation experience. 

This relaxing spa at Surya Samudram draws endless inspiration from Kerala's rich heritage of Ayurveda and the ancient Indian system of healing and well-being. The swaying palm trees and the gentle waves of the sea will wholeheartedly welcome you to the spa; don’t forget to smile as they greet you!

As you witness the eternal friendship between the land and sea, you’ll find yourself reflecting on your life’s journey. Surya Samudram is a sensory symphony that collaborates with untamed nature, luring its guests. So, when you first arrive here, you’ll realise that this retreat is more than just a place; it’s a feeling of homecoming!

name: Khem Villas
intro: Khem Villas, is a jungle camp established by Usha and Goverdhan Singh Rathore along with Pritam Singh on the outskirts of Ranthambhore. Goverdhan is the son of Fateh Singh Rathore one of India’s leading Tiger experts who is also aptly referred to as the founding father of Ranthambhore helping put the park on the Tiger Map of the World.

news_article.title: Immerse in Endless Wilderness at Khem Villas
news_article.description: A Luxury Jungle Camp in Rajasthan

postcards.name: Enjoy Dining in the Heart of the Wilderness
postcards.intro: The solitary jungles are best experienced with some curiosity in mind and love in the heart. Love for the wild, for silently flowing small streams of water, the breeze, trees and mud. When life offers sustainable boutique experiences in the heart of a jungle, it is time to don your safari hat and awaken the responsible traveller in you.
postcards.story:
The Ranthambore National Park is one of the biggest and most renowned national parks in Northern India. It attracts wildlife enthusiasts who especially come to watch the Royal Bengal tiger in action. Being one of the most visited national parks, Ranthambore assures the best sighting of this endangered wild species. The fresh air in the jungle recalls stories from the past — one that reminds us of the cultural legacy of Rajasthan and its Maharajas.

A wilderness haven, small lakes, dense jungle and an incredible luxury stay — all define what Khem Villas offers to its visitors. It is a sanctuary of the euphonic coexistence of diverse life. This jungle camp offers its timeless commitment to conservation and nurtures its deep devotion to the tigers and other inhabitants of the jungle, pushing you to be a more responsible traveller. 

The focus at Khem Villas goes beyond the tigers, rustic charms and luxury comfort. Themes related to habitat conservation and wildlife protection lead most of the conversations, and you’ll often find yourself being informed about various challenges that threaten the survival of Ranthambhore and its tigers. 

Reflecting the owners’ love for wildlife, all the food at Khem Villas is vegetarian and comes from homegrown organic vegetables and freshly picked herbs. Even the milk comes from the local farm where the cows are fed organic food. 

The happiness and excitement of rare encounters in every corner of the jungle, unimaginable sunsets and shimmering night skies will make you want to keep coming back to this place. This beautiful jungle camp was started by Usha and Goverdhan Singh Rathore along with a friend Pritam Singh. But this story goes way back to the time of Goverdhan’s father, Fateh Singh Rathore, who helped put Ranthambhore Park on the Tiger Map of the World.

postcards.name: Going Beyond the Ranthambore National Park
postcards.intro: Khem Villas is a perfect place to witness the coexistence and harmony between humans and wildlife. Located on the edges of the Ranthambore National Park, this luxury jungle camp promises to offer you unmatched experiences that touch your heart and feed your mind. The stories from the jungle come to life at Khem Villas. Are you ready to hear them?
postcards.story:
Even though the wildlife grabs your attention around Khem Villas, this boutique property offers countless experiences beyond simply sighting a royal Bengal tiger. Evenings in Ranthambore are beautifully painted in lavender, amber, gold, pink and shades of colours that you can hardly imagine. The beautiful sunsets remind us that life is a journey that should be enjoyed wholeheartedly. As the sun merges with the horizon, the moon smiles and touches your face with its silver lustre. At night, the call of wild animals and the roar of the tiger reverberates through the air.  

It’s not just the wilderness that takes centre stage at this boutique property — there’s much more to experience. After returning from the Jungle Safari, the spa is an ideal place for you to relax, rejuvenate and revitalise. The Age Veda Spa at Khem Villas is where you can connect with nature in mind and body. The perfect silence is nothing less than a meditation. It is in this silence that the sounds of the forest become more melodious. You can always go for walks in the evening, practice yoga or simply sit back and relax at the hotel.

The architecture of Khem Villas is inspired by the traditional huts and dwellings of Rajasthan and blends naturally with the surrounding wilderness. The handcrafted furniture and artisanal details celebrate the local and authentic heritage and make this place look timeless and vintage. 

You can also enjoy the Chambal River Safari in Ranthambhore, where you will not only see the Gharial but also spot some rare birds and other species like the skimmer, osprey and turtles. Additionally, you can indulge in local crafts, do some shopping and click some pictures for memories in and around Khem Villas.

name: A Stones Throw Away
intro: A Stone’s Throw Away is situated in the Bahamas on one of Nassau’s highest points, giving visitors a rare and spectacular view of the ocean and island down below. Take a dip in the gorgeous blue waters of the Caribbean, and learn a bit about the island way of life, just a stone’s throw away from home

news_article.title: Welcome to A Stone’s Throw Away
news_article.description: An Exclusive Paradise in the Bahamas

postcards.name: Witness Rare Panoramic Views of Nassau’s Land and Sea
postcards.intro: Have you heard the music of the islands in the whispers of the trade winds? Ever been to an old Bahamian home? If this is something you’ve never experienced before, it’s time to indulge in conversations with nature and sustainable luxury. Thankfully, some best memories in life are just a stone’s throw away!
postcards.story:
Here’s an archipelago with captivating luxury and natural wonders like crystal-clear aquamarine waters and powdery white-sand beaches. Welcome to the Bahamas! The rare panoramic views of Nassau’s land and sea are an invitation to this haven that is nestled on one of the highest elevations along the coast. This haven is A Stone’s Throw Away. The endless shades of blue water will make you wonder if any colour can have so many tones. 

A Stone’s Throw Away recalls the traditions of an old Bahamian home – wooden floors and wooden ceilings, louvred shutters and a large wraparound porch. The windows at this property are a gateway to some of the world's most beautiful scenery, providing the best view of the coral reefs that protect the glimmering beaches of west Nassau. Keeping its arms open for you all year-round, this property prides itself on providing extensive hospitality services with personalized stay options.

As you walk up the rustic wooden stairs, you’ll find yourself surrounded by lovely green plants and trees. These serve as a canopy to prevent the sun’s rays from kissing your cheeks. The moment you enter this charming property, the world seems to slow down and along with it, the rush of everyday life also fades away. Life is quite gentle in this warm shelter, and it is here that you can wander and wonder together. 

The swaying palms promise to keep you calm and share their stories of dancing in the rain and sun. As you enjoy their stories, you’ll realise that enthusiasm makes life worth living. And sometimes, this enthusiasm is just A Stone’s Throw Away! Welcome to your private oasis of comfort, luxury and love.

postcards.name: Enjoy Your Time on the Deck Overlooking the Atlantic Ocean
postcards.intro: Standing atop the ridge of limestone, the traditional charm of A Stone’s Throw Away is very appealing. Being a home away from home, this property is happy to become a witness to your celebrations – be it weddings, birthdays or simply a family get-together. The rustic deck of this resort awaits to host you in its all-inclusive arms.
postcards.story:
The Bahamas offer a rich diversity of experiences, and every moment spent here leaves an indelible mark on your spirit. A Stone’s Throw Away will offer you enough time and space to rejoice in the art of solitude and the happiness of simplicity. But since not all days in life should be filled with silence, this resort is a perfect place to host your next celebration.

The vintage yet luxury furniture with ocean-themed decor will constantly give you the old beachy vibes. You can take the entire property and own the space to host your parties for a minimum of a one-night stay, with additional nights if required.

You can even book the upper deck for four hours and absorb the scenic beauty that the Atlantic Ocean offers. The brown wooden floor beneath, the blue skies above and the shades of blue spread all around the resort will surely make your soul dance. Sit with your loved ones and share stories that matter while enjoying the aroma of delicious food in the air. 

As you stand on the deck and watch the ocean before you, you’ll lose your sense of where the blue sky meets the blue water. The horizon becomes magical, captivating you with its own scenic charm. Every corner of A Stone’s Throw Away will make you look photogenic. So, even the ones who often shy away from posing for pictures will happily get their smiles captured in photographs for life.

Being located on the edge of a serene woodland, the rustling of leaves will become your soundtrack for the entire stay. Of course, you’ll also enjoy the playlist you created for yourself, but nature will keep interrupting you to share its songs and stories.

name: Historic Tapoco Lodge
intro: Located at the start of the famous Tail of the Dragon drive, Tapoco Historic Lodge is home to more than 150 years of history. Nestled in the mountains of North Carolina, visit us at Tapoco to taste what it is to be really wild, whether that’s by foot or by motor.

news_article.title: Unwind at the Historic Tapoco Lodge
news_article.description: A Haven for Outdoor Enthusiasts in North Carolina

postcards.name: Welcome to the Adventuary – Where Adventure & Sanctuary Meet
postcards.intro: What will the journey to explore the unknown look like? Some places don’t just say ‘welcome’, they say ‘Welcome Home’ — and Tapoco Lodge is one such place. What would the traditions of the 1930s look like, especially if you can experience them in modern times? Maybe, it’s time to explore!
postcards.story:
Standing in front of the beautiful Tapoco Lodge, you will notice how it has been nestled in the midst of the Great Smoky Mountains and the Nantahala National Forest. When city life becomes mundane, and the mind is captured by the thoughts of having a relaxing time with friends and family, the best thing to do is to head out from your home to a place you can call home. This haven of rustic elegance and natural beauty is the country’s most popular playground at your fingertips. 

The gentle breeze brings with it the mouth-watering fragrance of the delicious food cooked locally in the lodge. Nobody ever minds eating piping-hot wood-fired pizza. Every building has a story to tell — stories waiting to be shared with the modern world. In 1913, the Tapoco Lodge provided housing for hundreds of workers constructing the hydroelectric dams. Imagine walking inside a theatre that was once used as a community centre, dance hall, and for going-away parties for the many local soldiers during World War II.

Sometimes, all you need is a strong heart to enjoy hiking, canoeing, rafting, kayaking, fishing, mountain biking and so much more just on your doorstep. This is nature’s playground. With the green grass under our feet and rustling trees around, the symphony of tranquillity strikes the light-hearted and open-minded. And while enjoying your meal under the blue skies, the sunshine convinces you to take a picture with its falling rays of love. This is a sanctuary where modern comforts coexist with the nostalgia of past stories.

postcards.name: See the Sky Reflected in Lake Santeetlah
postcards.intro: Do you crave a reunion with the natural world? If your answer is yes, then a profound experience awaits you at pristine Lake Santeetlah. It is here that you’ll find peace. It is here that you’ll fall in love with nature all over again.
postcards.story:
Tapoco Lodge places you on the doorstep of North Carolina's pristine natural beauty. Surrounded by the Great Smoky Mountains and the Nantahala National Forest, this boutique retreat offers rustic elegance and cosy comfort. From the lodge, you have direct access to thick forests and shimmering lakes, including the breathtaking Santeetlah Lake.

Just a short drive away, Lake Santeetlah is buffeted by thick national forest. It’s a journey that will surely be finely imprinted on your heart and mind. Lake Santeetlah has often been claimed as the most beautiful lake in North America and features 76 miles of shoreline and 200 miles of hiking trails. 

The lake acts as a mirror to the sky, where the passing clouds glimpse themselves in the clear water. So don’t be surprised if you feel like the sky is right below your feet! 

As you stand on the shore, taking in the serene landscape, you’ll find yourself captivated by the tranquillity and timeless beauty of this remarkable place. Tapoco Lodge and Santeetlah Lake together offer an unforgettable escape into nature.

name: Brewery Gulch Inn
intro: Just out of sight of the City by the Bay is our historic property Brewery Gulch Inn. Explore the remote and rugged beauty of northern California with long trails leading straight to the ocean, warm fire pits, and award-winning fresh west coast cuisine.

news_article.title: Appreciate Eco-Conscious Luxury at Brewery Gulch Inn
news_article.description: A Luxury Stay along the Mendocino Coast

postcards.name: The Rugged California Coastline Gives an Artistic Touch
postcards.intro: Winter storms on the North Coast can be extraordinary. Wait, but who enjoys watching storms? When mother nature is in a stormy mood, the sight can be frightening but beautiful, too. It is said that beauty lies in the eyes of the beholder, but when natural beauty is all you can see, nobody minds the stormy views.
postcards.story:
A cosy room, a warm blanket, a cup of coffee and your favourite book can comfort the soul. Snuggling up by the fire can be great, too, while watching the next series on the laptop or even on a big TV screen. Winter is perhaps the best season to enjoy at the Brewery Gulch Inn. Says who? Locals and visitors.

The rugged California coastline gives an artistic touch to this thoughtful retreat. Sitting above the Pacific, the inn presents panoramic views of the endless horizon, with every gentle breeze whispering to us for introspection. You see, luxury can be sustainable, too, where every small gesture is purposeful and full of meaning. The inn is a tribute to every ancient tree that strongly holds it, sharing stories of resilience through past times and times yet to come.

The giant redwood forest marks its presence in the timbered architecture of the inn, while the flavours of the organic garden find their way to each plate that is served here. History never dies here, and present moments always stay alive. Preserved by the cold and mineral-rich ocean water, the 100- to 150-year-old logs add immense beauty and rustic colour to the inn.

The Brewery Gulch Inn displays the thoughtful coexistence between nature and sheer craftsmanship, inviting you to surrender yourself in the lap of endless natural beauty. Every corner of this place will encourage you to enjoy the cocoon of comfort in the remarkable cathedral of eco-salvaged redwood. So, the message here is clear — enjoy a restful retreat while improving and supporting the existing ecosystem, increasing native habitat, encouraging biodiversity and regenerating the land.

postcards.name: Inn-side a Cocoon of Comfort on California's Mendocino Coast
postcards.intro: When the relentless and restless waves of the Pacific Ocean hit the high cliffs at the shore, the Mendocino Coast of California greets them with a warm welcome. The Redwood forests tirelessly share stories from history, making you feel like the protagonist of some time-travel movie.
postcards.story:
When the pines look so fine and the rugged Mendocino coast boasts its presence from the artistically crafted windows, voilà, you’re at the Brewery Gulch Inn! While you enjoy every corner of this eco-salvaged redwood place, there’s something more for you. Sitting quietly, only one mile south of the inn, is the ocean-view cottage. This is the Beach Trail Cottage. Situated on a quiet country lane just minutes away from Brewery Gulch Inn & Spa, it invites you to surrender yourself in the lap of endless natural beauty.

The scent of redwoods mingles in the air and invites you to walk on the path to the Beach Trail Cottage, located just two miles south of Mendocino Village. This place feels like you’re living in some fairy tale – a story about a fully remodelled 150-year-old home that provides white water views along the coast and enchantingly looks out over the Van Damme State Beach. 

It’s a private and quiet place with a full kitchen, an upper-floor master bedroom and fine linens. What else can you ask for? Interestingly, this place has more to offer! Look out for the sandy beach and watch the curious sea lions, spotted harbour seals, hunting osprey and many tidepools within steps from your door. 

Love is in the air! This is what you’ll feel in and around this two-story cottage. It’s just perfect for those wanting a romantic getaway, and so it is open for two adults only. Children and pets are not permitted. Stay in and cook your delicious meals together, and celebrate the joy of love. The comfort at the Beach Trail Cottage and the wild beauty of California's coast will surely make you believe that ‘love is all you need’.

name: Casa Morada
intro: Tucked away on Islamorada in the Florida Keys, Casa Morada is a sleek and cozy tribute to classic Floridian architecture and design; with bright airy buildings and palm-lined paths that lead to our gorgeous dock and floating bar. Escape the mundane and delight in the balmy weather of the Keys at Casa Morada.

news_article.title: Escape the Everyday at Casa Morada
news_article.description: Experience Slow Living in Florida

postcards.name: A Boutique Hotel with its Own Private Island
postcards.intro: Welcome to the land of sun-kissed days! Welcome to Florida! To escape the daily mundane life, one must often escape the everyday places. Unique experiences await your presence at Casa Morada, a boutique hotel with its own beautiful private island. Welcome to the awe-inspiring 16-suite boutique oasis – a place where history and modernity blend together.
postcards.story:
Cradled by the cuddles of the Atlantic Ocean and the Gulf of Mexico, Florida is a place where life is filled with happiness, the air is filled with laughter, cities are filled with art and delicious cuisine, and the energy is vibrant. The surroundings are full of nature that promises unmatched adventure for its visitors.  

But there’s something more amidst the enchanting Florida Keys: a boutique property nestled off of a quiet side road in Islamorada. This is Casa Morada – the symphony of tropical bliss. The 16-suite boutique property consists of two guest houses: the Garden House and the Seaview House. Both houses are secluded havens surrounded by the calming sound of the blue waves. 

This picturesque property will captivate you with unreal views of the shimmering turquoise waters that stretch to the horizon. Casa Morada offers something to everybody. It not only offers spaces for peace and introspection but also gives you the opportunity to use the kayaks, paddleboards and bicycles and offers complimentary yoga on Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday. So, you can kayak through the mangrove trails, lounge by the pool or even explore the nearby coral reefs. Discover and connect with yourself in this timeless modern abode.

While walking all around the property, you’ll feel as if the turquoise water is a grand stage where the clouds perform their dance throughout the day. Offering you its stunning amber views, the tired sun sleeps in the evening, only to rise back again the next morning. You can also hop on a boat to arrive at the hotel and embrace its sheer beauty. Casa Morada is a pet-friendly hotel because why should humans have all the fun? Bliss awaits you here; where are you?

postcards.name: Tour the Island on a Sunset Cruise in Islamorada
postcards.intro: When the sun dissolves into the horizon, it paints the sky in colours that go beyond our imagination. The beautiful canvas of the evening sky is covered with hues of tangerine, amber, lavender, and gold. Not only do the boats sail here under the vast blue skies, but dreams sail too endlessly. Are you ready for sailing?
postcards.story:
When the molten-gold sun takes a dip into the horizon at dawn, it becomes a perfect grand finale for the day. Now imagine if you could be a part of this grand finale and its cinematic views. “Breathtaking!” is all you will chant throughout your experiences.
 
Casa Morada is the perfect place to pause and savour the beauty of nature. The customized boat tours with Captain Bill and Elle begin at 10 a.m. daily and depart at your convenience. In addition to this, the kayaks and paddleboards are provided for the guests free of charge. 

Beneath the vast sky, time unfolds like a reverie. Watching the boats sail freely from your veranda, you'll be enticed to quickly hop onto one of them. Sunsets in Islamorada are world-famous, and one of the best ways to experience them is aboard the Sol Sister – the 32-foot Historic Skipjack. She was built by hand in Maine in 1982 and has recently undergone a full renovation. She has been living at Casa Morada since 2003.

Sol Sister is one of a kind. With her historic lines and classic wide and smooth ride, she is the perfect sailboat for Florida Bay. Since Islamorada is best viewed from the water, you can also take an island tour on the Gypsy Sol or the classic motor launch. This tour will surely satisfy your soul with the views of lovely waterfront homes and historic places, and you can even experience the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary. 

This homely haven is an exquisite fusion of the sea and sky. Hundreds of guests at Casa Morada return time and again, indicating a bond of trust, love and awe-inspiring experiences. It’s time to discover the untamed wilderness and venture into the timeless walls of Casa Morada.

name: Perfume Tourism - 24 MG Road
intro: An immersive experience in the perfume capital of India, Kannauj. Where the itinerary revolves around taking guests through the process of distilling the finest ingredients of perfumery, creating their unique signature scent at our perfume bar and indulging in a 7 course fragrance & flavour pairing degustation all while soaking in the history of an 8th generation perfume house.

news_article.title: Revel in Perfume Tourism at 24 MG Road
news_article.description: An Eighth-Generation Fragrance House in India

postcards.name: Rose Perfume & Rose Water Distillation in Kannauj
postcards.intro: The history of rose perfume and rose water production in Kannauj dates back to ancient times. Kannauj, has been known for its perfumes and fragrances since the 7th century, during the time of the Harsha dynasty. According to historical accounts, Kannauj's perfume industry thrived during the 9th to 13th centuries under the rule of the Pratiharas, Chandellas, and Gahadavalas.
postcards.story:
During the Mughal period in India (16th to 18th centuries), Kannauj's perfume industry reached new heights of sophistication and popularity.

The 17th-century Mughal court chronicler Muhammad Salih Kanbo wrote about the use of Kannauj rose water by Mughal empress Nur Jahan. According to Kanbo, Nur Jahan used Kannauj rose water to make a special perfume called "Mehar Nigar" for her husband, Emperor Jahangir.

In her book "The History of Humayun," the 16th-century Persian historian and biographer Gulbadan Begum wrote about the Mughal queen Hamida Banu Begum, who was Emperor Akbar's mother. Gulbadan Begum noted that Hamida Banu Begum used to bathe in water scented with rose petals and sandalwood, and that the rose petals used for this purpose were imported from Kannauj.

postcards.name: Relax in the Bedchambers of the Courtyard Suite
postcards.intro: With its rich history and charming atmosphere, the Courtyard Suite offers guests a truly immersive experience, where they can indulge in the traditions of perfumery and revel in the opulence of centuries old tradition!
postcards.story:
The bedchambers of the Courtyard Suite at 24 MG Road, Kannauj, whisper tales of a bygone era. This 120-year-old refurbished haveli holds secrets and stories that have woven themselves into its very walls. Nestled inside an 8th generation perfume house, these chambers have witnessed the footsteps of perfumers from around the world over the decades.

As the heavy wooden doors creak open, a sense of history and intrigue fills the air. Antique furniture, adorned with intricate carvings, stands as a testament to the craftsmanship of yesteryears. The walls, adorned with vintage photographs and artifacts, chronicle the legacy of the perfume house.

In these hallowed chambers, perfumers from diverse cultures have gathered, their shared passion for fragrance transcending language barriers. They exchanged knowledge, techniques, and tales of their craft, leaving behind a tapestry of scents and memories.

Each perfumer's presence, each whispered conversation, has left an indelible mark on the room, infusing it with an aura of creativity and artistry. The bedchambers have become a sanctuary for the fragrance enthusiasts, a place where dreams and inspiration merge.

The Courtyard Suite's allure lies not only in its physical beauty but in the intangible aura that emanates from its very core. It beckons travelers, inviting them to immerse themselves in the rich history and vibrant energy of the perfume house.

As the sun sets over the tranquil courtyard, the bedchambers continue to hold the stories of those who have come before, a testament to the enduring legacy of the perfume house and the timeless art of perfumery

postcards.name: Stay in a Scented Courtyard suite
postcards.intro: A scented welcome for our guests. Where the freshly plucked flowers and distilled floral water meet their feet in fragrant harmony. A family tradition still carried on today, cleansing of the feet upon arrival from travels afar!
postcards.story:
Throughout the decades, the courtyard has been a place of experimentation, where new scent combinations have been imagined, tested, and refined. Perfumers have sought solace here, drawing on the tranquility and natural beauty to unlock their creativity. The courtyard has witnessed the birth of iconic fragrances, their ethereal aromas mingling with the air, creating an atmosphere that is both intoxicating and evocative.

Beyond its role as an artistic haven, the courtyard has also played host to gatherings and events celebrating the art of perfume. Guests, eager to delve into the world of scents and memories, have been enchanted by the ambiance of this historic space. They have been treated to immersive experiences, where they can explore the secrets of perfume-making, engage in sensory journeys, and learn about the rich history that permeates the perfume house.

As time continues to weave its tapestry, the courtyard remains an enduring symbol of the perfume house's legacy. It stands as a testament to the passion and artistry that have been nurtured within its walls for more than a century. The courtyard's timeless charm and the whispers of perfumed history that permeate its air continue to captivate all who enter, ensuring that the legacy of the perfume house lives on, embraced by the scents and stories that unfold within its sacred space.

postcards.name: Fragrance and Flavour Pairing Dining Experience
postcards.intro: Treat your senses to a unique culinary experience with Chef and Perfumer Pranav Kapoor's Fragrance and Flavor Pairing Menu.
postcards.story: This 7 course menu pairs fragrances with each course to create an unforgettable dining experience. In every course, you'll get a delicious dish that is expertly balanced with the appropriate smells, textures, and flavors to make it truly special. The menu is sure to transport you to a world of tasteful bliss as you sample the flavors while enjoying the accompanying aromas. Experience the perfect cocktail of delectable cuisine paired with tantalizing scents!

postcards.name: Create Your Own Perfume Bar and Scent
postcards.intro: Welcome to the Perfume Bar! Here we believe that experiencing new scents is an essential part of traveling. That's why we've created a unique place where you can come and create your own scent.
postcards.story:
The Perfume Bar is an innovative concept that offers guests a unique opportunity to create their own signature scent. With over 300 carefully curated ingredients at their disposal, guests can embark on a sensory journey to craft a fragrance that is truly their own.

At the Perfume Bar, guests are guided by skilled fragrance experts who assist them in understanding the nuances of various notes and how they harmonise together. They provide guidance on blending techniques, helping guests create a scent that reflects their individuality, personality, and preferences.

The extensive range of ingredients includes a diverse selection of top notes, middle notes, and base notes, allowing guests to explore a myriad of combinations. Whether they prefer floral, woody, citrusy, or spicy aromas, the possibilities are endless.

Creating a signature scent at the Perfume Bar is an immersive experience, as guests engage their senses of smell and creativity. They experiment with different proportions, layering scents to achieve the desired balance. With each trial, they move closer to capturing their unique olfactory identity.

The Perfume Bar celebrates individuality and self-expression, providing a memorable and personalized experience that leaves guests with a one-of-a-kind fragrance to cherish and wear as a symbol of their own signature style.

postcards.name: Indulge in Perfume Tourism
postcards.intro: Welcome to the world of perfume tourism. One of the delightful activities that await you is flower plucking. Immerse yourself in nature's vibrant palette as you explore fragrant gardens, carefully selecting blossoms that will become the essence of captivating perfumes. Get ready to engage your senses and witness the beauty that blooms within this enchanting journey
postcards.story:
As part of the immersive perfume tourism experience in Kannauj, guests have the opportunity to indulge in the captivating activity of flower plucking. Nestled in the heartland of India's fragrance industry, Kannauj is renowned for its rich floral heritage and the production of exquisite natural perfumes.

Guided by skilled perfumers, visitors embark on a sensory journey through fragrant gardens. Surrounded by a tapestry of vibrant blooms, they are introduced to a plethora of aromatic flowers like roses, jasmine, tuberoses, and more. Each flower carries its unique scent profile, contributing to the diverse palette of fragrances found in Kannauj perfumes.

With gentle hands and keen senses, guests carefully pluck the blossoms, embracing the delicate beauty and scent that emanates from each petal. They learn about the optimal time for plucking, ensuring that only the freshest and most aromatic flowers are selected.

Throughout the plucking process, perfumers share their expertise, imparting knowledge about the flowers, their fragrance profiles, and the specific roles they play in perfume composition. Guests gain insight into the intricate art of perfumery, understanding how these freshly plucked flowers will eventually become the heart and soul of fine fragrances.

name: Singinawa Jungle Lodge
intro: Nestled within a sprawling forest land of 100 acres adjoining the Kanha Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh, the Singinawa Jungle Lodge is an ensemble of ecologically responsible tourism and the spirit of Kanha region.

news_article.title: Go Wild at Singinawa Jungle Lodge
news_article.description: Tracking Big Cats in India's Kanha Tiger Reserve

postcards.name: Go for an Exhilarating Wildlife Safari
postcards.intro: Go on an exhilarating journey into the wild when you stay at the Singinawa Jungle Lodge. Imagine waking up with the sun, eagerly anticipating the adventure that awaits you on a customised 4x4 jeep safari. This immersive experience allows you to delve deep into the jungle, where every moment is an encounter with the raw beauty of nature.
postcards.story:
As you clandestinely traverse the dense foliage in the Kanha National Park, the air is filled with the enchanting sounds of over 300 wild birds, a melody that becomes an everyday affair here. Picture yourself in awe as a skulk of foxes preen and big jungle cats savour their first meal of the day, all while your vehicle manoeuvres through the jungle with the stealth of a seasoned explorer.

The magic of the jungle unfolds before your eyes as you move further, catching glimpses of majestic tigers, jackals and wolves. These amazing creatures trail in wonder across their untamed habitat and you'll find yourself captivated by the sight of herds of deer and gaur leisurely drinking water from picturesque water holes or loitering around with their friends and families.

If you have a keen interest in nature, the safari offers you an opportunity to be spellbound by the diverse variety of rare insects and plants that thrive in this unique ecosystem. The expert guides accompanying you on this adventure are not just navigators but storytellers, unravelling the secrets of the jungle and enriching your experience with their extensive knowledge.

The afternoon safari is no less than a snarl in tryst with nature's secrets. Imagine treading successfully through the natural maze, guided by skilled experts in the Mukki region of the park. The guides, with their deep understanding of the jungle, skillfully trapeze you through the terrain, ensuring an unforgettable encounter with the wild.

As the afternoon unfolds, the park comes alive with the trumpet of the dawn, signalling the predators' emergence in search of prey. Your afternoon safari seamlessly transports you back to the Singinawa Jungle Lodge, leaving you with memories etched in the canvas of nature's grandeur.

postcards.name: Visit the Museum of Life and Art
postcards.intro: When you choose to grace Singinawa Jungle Lodge with your presence, a visit to the Museum of Life and Art is an absolute must. The museum doesn't confine itself to four walls; it extends its artistic embrace to the open spaces with captivating art installations that resonate with the essence of Kanha.
postcards.story:
Oscar Wilde's profound words, "Life imitates art far more than art imitates life," serve as the guiding principle for an exploration into the enchanting relationship between nature, time and human evolution within the captivating confines of the Singinawa Jungle Lodge.

As you step into the Museum of Life and Art, you'll find yourself immersed in inspiration, expertly crafted by the native Gond and Baiga artisans. Here, life and art coalesce seamlessly, creating a space where every artifact is a testament to the labour of love poured into its creation. The museum, existing within the estate, stands as an ode to the profound connection between humanity and the natural world.

Designed to mirror the undulating curves of the surrounding forest, the museum unfolds like a visual escapade, offering you a dynamic placement of artifacts that transcends soporific and predictable patterns. It becomes a figurative celebration of the untamed spirit of nature, where each exhibit tells a story of the vibrant ethos of Kanha, adding an extra layer of depth to your experience.

The immersive outdoor display adds another layer of enchantment, inviting you to connect with the surroundings on a deeper level. The outdoor art installations become a canvas where nature and art engage in a poetic dance, leaving an indelible mark on your senses.

While paying homage to art may nourish the soul, the journey of exploration can leave you yearning for refreshment. Additionally, the café nestled in the vicinity of the museum awaits, providing a serene oasis where you can rejuvenate your spirit. Picture yourself sipping a delightful beverage surrounded by the echoes of artistic inspiration, creating a moment of tranquillity that complements the rich cultural experience of the Museum of Life and Art.

name: Svasara Jungle Lodge
intro: Svasara at Tadoba is the first jungle lodge in the conscious luxury chain, and is situated 300 metres from Kolara Gate at Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve. The drive to the lodge is a convenient 2-hour journey from the “orange city” Nagpur, which has excellent air and rail connectivity.

news_article.title: Visit the Pioneering Svasara Jungle Lodge
news_article.description: Offering You the Best in Nature Hospitality in India

postcards.name: Witness the Raw Beauty of The Tadoba Tiger Reserve
postcards.intro: When you visit Svasara Jungle Lodge, make sure to include the Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve in your itinerary. Known as the Tiger Capital of the World, Nagpur serves as the gateway to Tadoba. The safari experience at Tadoba allows you to appreciate the raw beauty of the wilderness and witness the efforts put into preserving the region's rich biodiversity.
postcards.story:
The Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve boasts exceptional forest tracts and rich biodiversity. According to local legend, the tribal God 'Tadu' sacrificed his life while fighting a tiger and a shrine in his memory stands beneath a sprawling tree on the shores of Lake Tadoba. This poignant tale lends its name to the local jungle, while the Andhari River, meandering through the forest, contributes to the reserve's nomenclature.

Affectionately called the Land of the Tigers, Tadoba Tiger Reserve stands as a rare jewel among India's tiger reserves and national parks, renowned for its high tiger density. The safari takes you through rugged terrain, consisting of dense forests and open grasslands, providing glimpses of various animal species.

The reserve is a haven for wildlife enthusiasts, offering you not only tiger and wild dog sightings but also encounters with leopards, sloth bears, Indian bison, rusty spotted cats and an array of other species. With over 200 bird species, including the crested serpent eagle and paradise flycatcher, the reserve is a paradise for birdwatchers. Tadoba's pristine ecosystem provides ample opportunities for close encounters with wildlife, ensuring an immersive experience with nature. 

Less commercialised compared to other prominent parks in India, Tadoba maintains its untouched allure. The park's major flora, including bamboo, teak and various indigenous trees, creates a lush habitat. The tropical dry deciduous landscape is adorned with kusums and flowering silk cottons, adding bursts of colour from late winter to spring.

As you venture into Tadoba, you'll witness a thriving ecosystem where nature unfolds its wonders. The blend of legends, diverse wildlife and unspoiled landscapes makes Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve a must-visit destination if you’re seeking a genuine connection with India's natural heritage.

postcards.name: Admire the Impressive Architecture of The Teakhouse
postcards.intro: The architecture and design of The Teakhouse at Svasara Jungle Lodge are impressive. It's a place where you might find yourself wanting to stay longer, especially while having your dinner in the fresh air. The pleasant surroundings, coupled with wholesome and fresh food, will surely elevate your overall experience here.
postcards.story:
The Teakhouse draws inspiration from traditional garden pavilions that were favoured by the historical Maratha rulers of Central India. In the evenings, you can unwind by catching a documentary on Tadoba and then treat yourself to a delightful dinner at The Teakhouse. Designed to adapt to the tropical wet and dry climate of the region, the pavilion's orientation, from north-west to south-east, strategically captures the prevailing south-west wind for natural ventilation. 

This alignment not only wards off the intense summer sunlight but also allows the warmth of the winter sun. The architectural choice of deep roof overhangs further enhances your comfort, preventing even the low rays of the setting summer sun from intruding.

True to its name, The Teakhouse extensively incorporates teakwood, repurposed from old dismantled structures, including the white Allahabad roof tiles salvaged from such buildings. The deliberate use of reclaimed and locally available materials, like stone, reflects a commitment to minimising the carbon footprint, underscoring environmental stewardship.

In a departure from traditional designs where pitched roofs rely on trusses for support, The Teakhouse adopts an innovative approach. Eschewing trusses, the ridge member finds support through a strategically positioned central post and hip ridges at its ends. This design, made possible by the steep pitch of the roof, results in a spacious and uncluttered interior.

The meticulous attention to detail is evident in every aspect of The Teakhouse, from the broom finish plaster on walls to the motifs adorning pedestals and brackets. Even the teakwood posts and rafters feature subtle chamfers and grooves, contributing to the enduring quality of the structure. The conscious effort to blend functionality with thoughtful design choices ensures that The Teakhouse stands as a reflection of sustainable practices and a harmonious integration with its surroundings.

name: The Sarai at Toria
intro: This uniquely designed 8-room accommodation is situated on a beautiful riverside site, close to Khajuraho and Panna Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh, India. Surrounded by wonderful history and natural beauty it is a destination in itself and conveniently located to fit into a number of central India itineraries.

news_article.title: Experience Authentic Indian Hospitality at The Sarai at Toria
news_article.description: A Picturesque Riverside Retreat Near a Tiger Reserve in India

postcards.name: Stay in a Traditional Village-Style Cottage Room
postcards.intro: Step into your independent cottage room, where the elegance of traditional village architecture meets the surprise of unexpectedly refined interiors. Behind the thick mud walls lies an elegant sanctuary mindfully crafted for your aesthetic pleasure and comfort. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered, ensuring that no corner remains uncharted on your journey of delightful experiences.
postcards.story:
The Sarai at Toria is a place that doesn't rely on extravagant language to convey its elegance. Here, you'll find a pleasant retreat, where the essentials are met with a thoughtful touch.

The eight uniquely crafted rooms at the Sarai are designed with you in mind, offering a tranquil space to rest. The classic decor allows you to focus on the peace surrounding you, creating a space that feels like a personal sanctuary. It's not about the intricate details but rather the ease with which you can settle in and make it your own.

When you step into your Classic cottage room, you'll find spacious and thoughtfully designed spaces that cater to your comfort. You won't need energy-heavy heating or cooling here – the high ceilings and thick mud walls naturally keep the rooms cool in warmer months and warm when it gets colder. So, as you experience temperature changes outside of 10–15 degrees, inside, you'll only notice a slight one or two-degree difference. Your comfort is the priority here, and the rooms are crafted to provide a consistently pleasant environment.

Ascend the staircase of your Mezzanine cottage room, and you'll discover more than just a child's bed; it opens up to a small machan connecting with the neighbouring room, creating an ideal setup for extended family or friends travelling together. With room for an additional bed on the ground floor and the option of smaller three-sided cots for the little ones, stay assured that your accommodation is flexible and accommodating for everyone in your group.

In your room at Sarai, you'll discover a quiet refuge that feels like a home away from home, allowing you to fully enjoy the comforts of your stay.

postcards.name: Taste the Popular Sweet and Sour Tomato Curry at the Sarai
postcards.intro: Indulge in homey flavours at the Sarai, where every meal mirrors the heartfelt dishes you enjoy in your home. When you’re here, you must taste the popular sweet and sour tomato curry. Interestingly, you won't find a conventional restaurant menu; instead, they aim to offer you an authentic Indian culinary experience, celebrating the warmth and sincerity of homemade meals.
postcards.story:
At the Sarai, the kitchen relies on recipes passed down from immediate family and friends, prepared in the same cherished manner as they are at home. This distinctive approach not only makes a significant difference but also cultivates a unique taste seldom replicated in any other kitchen.

One of the Sarai at Toria kitchen's most popular dishes is the sweet and sour tomato dish known as ‘Khatta-Mitha Tamatar’. Such is the popularity of this delightful dish that you’ll find yourself so enamoured with its flavours, you’ll request to witness its preparation, eager to carry the essence of its taste back home with you.

This dish makes for an ideal souvenir, given its simple recipe requiring very few ingredients, all easily accessible in most places around the world. With a cooking time of less than 15 minutes, it becomes a quick delight to replicate anywhere.
